title: RedLight-VLA: Models for traffic-rule grounding and behavioral emphasis in driving policies
summary: Behavior-cloned Vision-Language-Action (VLA) driving policies struggle with rare rule-governed maneuvers at signalized intersections. Braking and launching examples contribute little to averaged trajectory loss, while fused representations lack explicit supervision for the governing traffic-light and stop-line state. We present RedLight-VLA, a training objective that uses expert futures and automatically generated perception targets without additional manual rule annotation. First, trajectory-derived behavioral reweighting (BR) emphasizes rare deceleration and acceleration using rotation-invariant longitudinal dynamics and a scale-preserving reduction that exactly recovers the baseline when disabled. Second, parallel auxiliary (AUX) heads ground traffic-light and stop-line state in continuous post-fusion rule tokens, without autoregressive language generation or changes to the trajectory decoder. We evaluate on a curated set of 20 s sequences with a 5 s prediction horizon. Controlled variants share the same backbone, training data, decoder, and evaluation population. Against an otherwise identical VLA baseline, RedLight-VLA reduces red-light stop-line overshoot from 7.3% to6.8%, reduces stop-line velocity error by 12.7%, and improves 3 s trafficlight-sliced ADE/FDE from 0.274/0.964 m to 0.247/0.897 m. Green-light false stops increase from 3.2% to 3.9%; however, combining BR with AUX supervision mitigates the larger increase observed for AUX alone (4.0%). The combined model also improves non-traffic-light ADE/FDE from 0.268/0.956 m to 0.241/0.876 m and outperforms either mechanism alone on all four sliced displacement measures.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RedLight-VLA，一种改进的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）驾驶策略训练目标，显著提升了自动驾驶模型在交通信号灯场景下的稀有动作（如刹车和起步）建模和表现。
AI.motivation: 传统行为克隆式VLA驾驶策略在信号灯交叉口下遇到少见且受规则约束的操作时表现不佳，原因包括训练损失对稀有举例敏感性低、特征融合表征缺乏对交通灯和停车线状态的直接监督。作者希望解决模型忽视这些关键交通规则导致的安全和性能问题。
AI.method: RedLight-VLA包含两大核心方法：(1) 通过轨迹导出的行为重加权（BR），用旋转不变的纵向动力学强化刹车和加速场景的数据权重；(2) 增加并行的辅助头（AUX），在融合后的表征中直接对交通灯和停车线状态进行连续数值监督，无需语言生成或解码器结构改动。两种机制均不需要手动规则注释。
AI.result: 在精选的测试集上，与标准VLA基线对比，RedLight-VLA将闯红灯越过停车线的比例从7.3%降至6.8%，停车线速度误差降低12.7%，红绿灯场景下的平均/最终位置误差均显著降低，且在非信号灯场景下也有整体提升。虽然增加绿灯误停概率（由3.2%升至3.9%），但BR+AUX联合使用能缓解这一副作用，各项分割误差均优于单独机制。
AI.conclusion: RedLight-VLA有效提升了VLA模型在受交通规则约束场景下的稀有行为学习能力，并对整体轨迹预测性能有益，具有实际部署价值，且无需人工标签，可以与现有架构无缝集成。

title: The Potential of Haptic Foundation Models
comment: accepted by IEEE Consumer Electronics Magazine
summary: Despite the success of foundation models in language and vision, their expansion into embodied AI is bottlenecked by a lack of generalized touch sensing. This limitation is especially relevant to consumer electronics, where smartphones, wearables, VR controllers, home robots, and health monitoring devices require safe and adaptive physical interaction. Constrained by hardware heterogeneity and the necessity of active physical data collection, current haptic models remain rigidly task-specific. To overcome these limitations, this article explores the transformative potential and developmental trajectory of Haptic Foundation Models (HFMs). We detail the paradigm shift required to transition from passive Large Language Models and Vision Language Models into active HFMs across four core dimensions: action coupling, physical dynamical representation space, continuous time-series data granularity, and action-conditioned future state prediction. Furthermore, we synthesize existing large-scale tactile datasets and benchmark UniTouch, AnyTouch, T3, and Sparsh on TacBench for force estimation, slip detection, and relative pose estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了触觉基础模型（HFM）作为通用人工智能模型向具身AI领域扩展的关键，并综述、评测了当前主流触觉模型在TacBench上的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基础模型在语言和视觉取得巨大进展，但在具身AI中受限于通用触觉感知能力的缺乏，尤其是在智能手机、可穿戴设备、机器人等实际应用场景中急需更自适应的物理交互模型。当前的触觉模型往往因为硬件差异和物理数据采集难题，导致泛化能力和任务适应性有限。
AI.method: 文章提出具身AI需从被动的LLM/VLM范式转向主动的触觉基础模型，从动作耦合、物理动态时空表示、时间序列数据细粒度及动作条件未来状态预测四个关键维度展开探索。此外，本文整理了公开大规模触觉数据集，并在TacBench基准上比较了UniTouch、AnyTouch、T3和Sparsh四种模型，针对力估计、滑动检测、姿态估计进行评测。
AI.result: 实验对比了现有四大触觉模型在TacBench各项任务上的表现，为后续HFMs发展提供了定量参考。不同模型在不同任务中展现出优缺点，揭示了当前HFMs在泛化、时序建模和任务适应性上的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 具身AI发展迫切需要具备主动动态感知能力的通用触觉基础模型。本文既阐明了HFMs所需的范式转变方向，也为后续研究提供了基准和优化目标，对推动多模态、跨设备通用AI具有重要意义。

title: Cognitively-Grounded On-Device Runtime Learning for Ground Robots in Unknown Physical Environments
summary: This paper presents \ul{CogRun}, a framework that enables safety-critical ground robots to perform cognitively-grounded runtime learning entirely on edge-AI devices in unknown physical environments, without prior maps or perceptual knowledge. CogRun consists of three components: a Learning-Agent, a Rational-Agent, and a Coordinator. The Learning-Agent is novel in cognitive-neural learning architecture, which featurs dedicated replay buffers, cognition-driven experience sampling, and a safety-aware action blending of actor-critic reinforcement learning (RL) with instance-based learning (IBL). The Rational-Agent is a non-learning module that complements the Learning-Agent by exclusively handling safety-critical functions, while the Coordinator manages interactions between the two agents to promote safe and efficient runtime learning. CogRun's full autonomy stack (i.e., perception, learning, and control) on edge-AI devices eliminates dependence on wireless communications, enabling broader applications in challenging environments with limited or no connectivity. Experiments on a quadruped robot in real-world wild forests and on an off-road autonomous vehicle in a simulated wild forest demonstrate that CogRun enables safe and efficient runtime learning, allowing robots to safely and continuously interact with the physical world for enhancing task performance in complex, unknown environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CogRun框架，使地面机器人能在未知环境下，完全依赖边缘AI设备，实现认知驱动的在线学习，无需预先地图和感知知识。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人在恶劣、未知环境中运行时，对网络、预先地图和外部帮助依赖较大，难以自主安全地进行在线学习和适应。需要一种能在本地独立进行认知学习和安全自适应的解决方案。
AI.method: CogRun框架分为三部分：1）Learning-Agent，采用创新的认知-神经学习结构，引入重放缓冲区、认知经验采样以及结合actor-critic强化学习与基于实例的学习的安全动作融合；2）Rational-Agent，负责安全相关的非学习模块，保障安全性；3）Coordinator，协调两智能体间的交互，确保学习过程的高效与安全。在边缘AI设备上实现完整感知、学习与控制自治栈，无需外部通信。
AI.result: 实验证明CogRun框架在真实森林地形的四足机器人和模拟野外自动驾驶车辆中，能实现安全、高效的在线学习，支持机器人在复杂、未知环境下持续安全地与物理世界交互，并提升任务表现。
AI.conclusion: CogRun突破了对外部通信和预先知识的依赖，让机器人能在极端环境中自主感知、学习和决策，为安全关键机器人应用提供了新的自治能力，具备广泛应用前景。

title: RoboGesture: Real-Time Semantic-aligned Co-Speech Gestures Generation for Humanoid Interaction
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project page: https://RoboGesture.github.io
summary: Enabling humanoid robots to respond to human speech with synchronized and semantically meaningful gestures is fundamental to natural human-robot interaction. However, this task faces three critical barriers: the scarcity of semantically rich datasets, the "modality eclipse" where models ignore audio cues in favor of kinematic inertia, and the sim-to-real gap regarding physical safety. We propose RoboGesture, a robot-centric framework that co-designs data, modeling, and control to power a complete interactive human-humanoid system in which the robot listens, responds, and gestures in real time. We first establish the RoboGesture dataset featuring over 300 gesture categories and develop an automated pipeline to synthesize large-scale collision-free, robot-specific audio-motion pairs. Our architecture features a Hierarchical Semantic-Acoustic Aligner that extracts multi-granular prosodic and semantic cues directly from raw audio tokens. These cues drive a Streaming Conditional Motion Generator based on a diffusion transformer with conditional flow matching. To ensure high responsiveness, we introduce Anti-Inertia CFG Masking, which prevents the model from collapsing into repetitive historical patterns by compelling it to proactively mine control signals from the audio modality. Finally, an MPC-based safety filter ensures real-time, collision-free execution on physical hardware. Experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid demonstrate that RoboGesture generates safer, more rhythmic, and more semantically appropriate responses compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoboGesture框架，实现人形机器人能够根据语音做出同步且有语义的肢体动作。针对语义数据匮乏、模态偏置和现实安全性等难题，框架完成了数据集构建、模型设计和硬件控制一体化。实验表明该系统在响应安全性、韵律和语义适配性方面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 目前人形机器人，很难做到听懂人类语音并做出有语义、协调且同步的手势响应。主要障碍包括缺乏带语义的手势数据、现有模型容易忽视音频信息而过度依赖动作惯性、以及实际部署时动作安全性难保证。因此，急需端到端的系统设计，解决数据、建模和控制等问题。
AI.method: （1）构建RoboGesture数据集，涵盖300多种手势类别，并自动生成大规模安全、与机器人硬件匹配的音频-动作对；（2）提出层次化语义-声学对齐器，从原始音频提取多粒度语义和韵律特征；（3）基于扩散Transformer的流式条件动作生成器，根据音频控制信号实时生成手势；（4）创新反惯性CFG屏蔽机制，迫使模型主动关注音频信号，避免机械重复；（5）MPC安全滤波，保证物理执行无碰撞。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1人形机器人上的实验表明，RoboGesture生成的手势较现有最先进方法更加安全、富有节奏感且符合语义，显著提升人机交互自然度与实用性。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次在数据、建模和控制三个环节协同设计，提出完整的人机交互动作生成解决方案。RoboGesture有效突破数据缺乏、模态偏置和安全执行的三大难题，为自然、安全和有意义的语音驱动机器人手势铺平道路。

title: NLP-Driven Knowledge Extraction and Thematic Classification of Translated Ancient Indian Medical Texts
comment: 19 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Presented at the National Conference on "Reimagining LIS Education: Integrating Indian Knowledge Systems with NEP 2020" (March 2025), organized by Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) and the Indian Association of Teachers of Library and Information Science (IATLIS). Recipient of the Best Paper Award
summary: Ancient Indian medical texts like Sushruta Samhita have extensive information on diseases, treatments, and surgical techniques. Yet, their ancient format and use of intricate vocabulary pose difficulties in accessibility and systematic ordering. The research here utilizes Natural Language Processing (NLP) methods like Named Entity Recognition (NER), BERTopic modeling, and Knowledge Graph development in Neo4j to extract, categorize, and visualize important concepts based on translated versions. Thematic classification with BERTopic allows for the identification of the underlying medical topics, whereas NER supports the structured entity recognition of diseases, treatments, researchers, and medicinal plants. Graphbased network analysis with Neo4j also allows for the semantic representation of relationship among extracted entities, supporting knowledge retrieval and digital preservation. The findings illustrate how graph databases, topic modeling, and entity recognition facilitate the computational organization of Ayurveda's historical medical wisdom, closing the gap between the conventional texts and contemporary data-driven inquiry. The suggested method promotes historical text analysis, medical informatics, and digital humanities to make ancient Indian medical wisdom more accessible and understandable.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用NLP方法（如实体识别、主题建模、知识图谱）对印度古代医学文献（如Sushruta Samhita）进行结构化抽取和可视化，促进其数字化整理和知识获取。
AI.motivation: 古印度医学文献内容丰富且结构复杂，传统表述和专业词汇使现代研究和查阅变得困难。因此，亟需以系统化、数字化方式提升其可访问性和可理解性。
AI.method: 采用自然语言处理（NLP）技术，包括命名实体识别（NER）、BERTopic主题建模，并在Neo4j中构建知识图谱，基于翻译文本提取医学实体与主题，并利用图数据库进行关系可视化和网络分析。
AI.result: 通过NLP方法，高效结构化和分类了疾病、治疗、研究人员和药用植物等医学实体，实现了古代医学文献的主题识别与知识图谱构建，提升了信息检索和关联分析能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，实体识别、主题建模和图谱数据库有助于数字化整理和传承古印度医学知识，促进传统医学文献与现代数据科学的融合，提升其在医学信息学和数字人文学科中的应用价值。

title: Open-Set Cattle Muzzle Identification: A Leakage-Controlled Benchmark and Evaluation Protocol
summary: Reliable individual cattle identification supports disease surveillance, vaccination records, breeding management, and livestock insurance. Although the bovine muzzle provides a stable, non-contact biometric, existing muzzle-recognition systems largely assume a closed set of enrolled animals, limiting their practical deployment. We reformulate cattle muzzle biometrics as an open-set, gallery-based identification problem that can reject previously unseen animals and support incremental enrollment without model retraining. We introduce a leakage-controlled evaluation protocol based on identity-disjoint splits, per-fold retraining, held-out threshold calibration, verified duplicate removal, and bootstrap confidence intervals. We evaluate the framework using two contrasting embedding configurations: a hybrid CNN-ViT metric-learning model and the MegaDescriptor-L foundation model. Under oracle threshold selection, the hybrid model achieves detection-and-identification rates of 98.3%, 96.4%, and 93.6% at target false-acceptance rates of 10^(-1), 10^(-2), and 10^(-3), respectively, while MegaDescriptor-L achieves 99.3%, 98.1%, and 96.1%. However, deployable threshold calibration reveals a substantial difference between oracle and calibrated performance: the hybrid model achieves a false-acceptance rate of 1.03% at a 1% target, whereas MegaDescriptor-L reaches 2.44%. Incremental enrollment further achieves Rank-1 accuracy above 91% with a single reference image and up to 97.3% with eight reference images, without retraining the model or degrading the existing gallery. These results demonstrate that threshold calibration, leakage control, and embedding quality are critical for reliable open-set cattle identification and provide a practical evaluation framework for deployment-oriented animal biometric systems.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种能够在开放集环境下进行牛只身份识别的方法，并建立了完善的评估流程，验证了新方法在无需重新训练模型的情况下可支持增量注册，极大提升了实际部署的可行性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有牛鼻纹识别系统主要针对固定的已注册牛只（封闭集），难以满足实际养殖中的动态变化需求，如新牛加入或识别未注册牛只，这限制了牛只生物特征识别技术在疫病防控、保险和管理等领域的落地应用。
AI.method: 作者将牛鼻纹识别问题重新定义为开放集、基于图库的身份识别问题，可以拒绝未见过的牛只并支持无模型重训练的增量注册。文中提出了包含身份无重叠划分、每折重新训练、持出阈值校准、去重和自助法置信区间等环节的泄漏控制评估协议。实验使用了混合CNN-ViT度量学习模型和MegaDescriptor-L基线模型进行对比。
AI.result: 在理想(oracle)阈值下，混合模型和MegaDescriptor-L分别达到高达93.6%-96.1%的检出识别率；实际可部署阈值下，混合模型和MegaDescriptor-L的错误接受率分别为1.03%、2.44%。增量注册设置下，1张参考图Rank-1准确率超91%，8张可达97.3%。
AI.conclusion: 本文方法可在无需模型重复训练条件下实现高效、可靠的牛只开放集识别，强调阈值校准与评估流程的重要性，为动物生物识别技术的实际部署提供了可行框架和参考。

title: Multi-Group Pipe Routing under Permanent Geometric Occupancy: Problem, Benchmark, and Classical Baselines
summary: Additive manufacturing (AM) enables compact hydraulic components whose internal fluid channels can follow free-form 3D paths rather than conventionally drilled holes. A representative case is multi-group channel layout in rotary direct-drive servo valves: once a channel is placed it permanently occupies volume, so later channels must clear earlier geometry--unlike classical multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF), where agents free space after moving. We study this setting as multi-group pipe routing under permanent geometric occupancy. Our contributions are a problem formalization with geometric dual-witness conflicts, a constructive 3D benchmark (two corridor generators x two obstacle painters, controlled difficulty, feasibility witnesses), and baseline results for CBS, PBS, and priority planning adapted to this coupling. We evaluate by success rate under a fixed time budget. PlaneSlice hard instances clearly rank CBS above PBS and PP, while easier cells validate the pipeline. The goal is a reproducible problem definition, suite, and classical baselines--not a new optimal MAPF algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本论文探讨了增材制造环境中具有持久占据特性的多组管道布线问题，并提出了问题定义、基准数据集以及传统算法的适应性基线评估。
AI.motivation: 增材制造技术让液压元件内部管道可以采用自由3D路径，但一旦布置后通道会永久占据空间，后续通道需避开已有几何体，这与传统MAPF问题中的空间可重用性不同。区别导致现有方法难以直接应用，因此需要新问题的正式定义和适用的求解方法。
AI.method: （1）形式化定义了具有几何持久占据性的多组管道布线问题，并引入了dual-witness conflicts的冲突描述方式；（2）构建了3D基准数据集，包括两个走廊生成器和两个障碍涂绘器，能够控制难度并提供可行性证明；（3）对比分析了经过调整的CBS、PBS和优先级规划等经典MAPF算法在该新问题下的表现。
AI.result: 通过固定时间预算下的成功率评估，实验发现：PlaneSlice困难案例中，CBS算法明显优于PBS和优先级规划，对较易问题三种算法均表现良好，验证了基准套件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了可复现的3D多管道持久占据布线问题的定义、基准测试集及经典MAPF算法的基线性能比较，为后续相关研究打下了基础，并不旨在提出新的最优MAPF方法。

title: Parametric Multimodal User Memory: Storing What Captions Cannot Carry
summary:
A personalized agent needs a user memory: a persistent model of who its user is. Today it is almost always text -- transcripts and captions retrieved by similarity. This serves the captionable half of a person ("my cat is named Bibi"), but discards the perceptual half no caption can hold: how a voice sounds, how a face reads across age and lighting, how tired someone sounds. We measure this loss across five modalities: a strong caption-based re-identifier recovers as little as 0.11 of a dedicated encoder's recall, collapsing toward chance on non-nameable signals.
  We instead ground perceptual memory in the model, decomposing recall into two subproblems: a vision-language model grounds the referent in context (what and where), and a dedicated encoder extracts an identity key (who), stored as one inline token read by attention at generation with no external round-trip. Neither suffices alone -- the VLM identifies cross-age faces at only 0.54 recall where a face encoder reaches 0.81, and an ungrounded encoder recognizes a two-person-scene referent at 0.05 -- yet together they reach correct-region oracle (0.96), generalizing to multi-speaker audio and video. The recognition core is training-free: it reproduces the encoder's recall on any frozen model at O(1) registration cost. On PerceptMem (12 domains, 1,080 tasks) perceptual identity is capacity-limited while exact facts are binding-limited: identity belongs in a parametric bank, facts in a text store. The two memories compose cleanly: an agent with both can remember not only what its user said, but also what they are like.

AI.tldr: 针对个性化智能体用户记忆仅依赖文本（只能捕捉可描述的表层信息，忽略非文本感知特征）的问题，提出将感知输入（如声音、视觉）编码为身份密钥，结合视觉-语言模型提升记忆与召回效果。实验显示此方法大幅提升多模态身份识别能力。
AI.motivation: 当前个性化智能体的用户记忆系统以文本为主，只能处理可描述的信息，丢失诸如声音特征、面部在不同年龄或光照下的表现等不可文字化的感知信息。作者旨在解决纯文本模式下非文本感知用户特征无法有效存储和召回的问题。
AI.method: 提出将用户感知信息（如语音、面孔等）提取身份‘密钥’并存入模型，通过视觉-语言模型对上下文进行定位，身份编码器提取用户特征，两者结合在生成时作注意力读取，实现无外部信息回传的端到端记忆召回。实验涵盖12个领域、1080项任务，并分别对姓名化与非姓名化信号做召回评估。
AI.result: 单纯用文本检索只能达到专用编码器0.11的召回率。仅用视觉-语言模型（如跨年龄面孔识别）召回率0.54，专用面部编码器0.81，两者结合召回率可达0.96，并推广到音频和视频多说话人场景。该核心识别方法无需额外训练，可在冻结模型上高效应用。
AI.conclusion: 用户身份的感知特征应以参数化记忆体存储，具体事实用文本存储，两者结合可使智能体不仅记住‘说了什么’，还能记住‘是什么样的人’，极大提高智能体的个性化与多感知回忆能力。

title: Understanding Temporal Semantic Stability in Open-Vocabulary UAV Perception through Metric 3D Fusion
summary: Recent open-vocabulary segmentation models have advanced semantic perception for UAVs, but predictions from moving aerial platforms can remain temporally inconsistent across repeated observations of the same physical scene. We investigate temporal semantic stability by associating frame-wise predictions with persistent world-space locations through metric 3D fusion. We introduce a voxel-level evaluation framework that jointly characterises final semantic agreement, Semantic Belief Drift (SBD), Observation Persistence (OP), and semantic uncertainty. Experiments on UAVid-3D reveal substantial frame-wise semantic flicker and show that high aggregate world-space agreement can overstate temporal stability when locations have limited repeated-observation support. Persistence-stratified analysis shows that recurrent voxels expose greater semantic disagreement, while belief drift decreases as additional evidence accumulates. This behaviour is observed across two segmentation backbones and remains consistent under variations in voxel resolution, geometric association, and temporal sampling density. Conditions that reduce world-space recurrence can increase apparent aggregate stability, demonstrating that semantic consistency must be interpreted together with observation support. Our findings highlight observation persistence as an essential conditioning variable for evaluating long-horizon semantic reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文关注于无人机（UAV）在进行语义分割时，针对同一场景多帧观测下的语义预测稳定性问题，提出了结合3D空间融合的评估框架，从世界坐标下量化语义一致性与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 尽管开集语义分割模型提升了无人机语义感知能力，但在多帧观测同一物理场景时存在预测结果时序不一致的问题。如何有效衡量和解释这种“语义闪烁”现象具有重要意义。
AI.method: 作者将单帧语义预测通过3D度量空间融合，关联至世界空间中的稳定位置，提出体素级的评估框架，包括最终语义一致性、语义信念漂移（SBD）、观测持续性（OP）与语义不确定性等指标；并在UAVid-3D数据集上验证。
AI.result: 实验发现：单帧语义预测存在明显波动（语义闪烁）；世界空间下高一致性可能掩盖了缺乏重复观测支持带来的稳定性不足，持续观测次数较多的体素显示了更强的分歧，但随着观测增加，信念漂移减弱。在不同主干网络、体素分辨率、几何关联与时间采样密度下结论均成立。
AI.conclusion: 仅仅依赖位置间的全局语义一致性不足以衡量长期时序上的分割稳定性，必须结合观测支持度（观测持续性）评估可靠性。观测持续性是长时域语义可靠性评价不可或缺的条件变量。

title: RoboPhys-3D: A Comprehensive Embodied World Model Evaluation via 3D Reconstruction
summary: Video world models increasingly serve as data engines, action planners, and simulators for embodied AI, but conventional embodied world model (EWM) benchmarks lack a unified 3D-grounded protocol for establishing whether generated rollouts preserve the underlying 3D scene state or translate into executable actions. We introduce RoboPhys-3D, a 3D-grounded EWM benchmark built on RoboTwin 2.0, covering 50 manipulation tasks across four regimes, with 5,000 episodes and 25,000 multi-view ground-truth videos. A defining feature of RoboPhys-3D is that generated and ground-truth videos are processed through the same 3D reconstruction pipeline, enabling reconstruction-induced error to be distinguished from generation-induced error. The RoboPhys-3D benchmark organizes 50 complementary metrics into 18 sub-dimensions across four levels: pixel-level fidelity, 3D geometry consistency, state-level understanding, and task-level completeness. We further introduce Average Full Score, a hierarchical score averaging all 50 metrics for comprehensive evaluation, and RoboPhyscore, a compact task-aligned score averaging the metrics most strongly correlated with task success. Among the four representative video world models, Cosmos 3 achieves the highest RoboPhyscore (0.6330, 92.7% of ground truth), while state- and execution-grounded metrics reveal substantial failures that perceptual and vision-language model-based judgments fail to capture. RoboPhyscore further exhibits strong agreement with human evaluation (Pearson r = 0.9761 and Spearman \r{ho} = 0.8962), demonstrating the importance of grounded, execution-aware evaluation for EWM capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个全面的3D基础化体现世界模型(EWM)评测基准RoboPhys-3D，用于更准确、系统地评估视频世界模型在执行动作与场景还原等任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有体现世界模型的评测缺乏统一的、3D参照的评测协议，难以有效判断模型生成的视频是否保留了真实3D场景状态或能映射为可执行动作。因此需要更具范式、3D感知兼容的基准工具。
AI.method: 构建了RoboPhys-3D评测集，基于RoboTwin 2.0，涵盖50种操作任务、5000个过程和25000个多视角视频。创新点是对生成视频与真实视频用同一3D重建流程分析，可分辨模型生成误差与重建误差。基准设计了50项评测指标，分为4个层级，包括像素级、3D几何一致性、状态理解、任务完成度。此外引入了Average Full Score（综合评分）和RoboPhyscore（与任务成功相关的精简评分）。
AI.result: 在对4个主流视频世界模型评测中，Cosmos 3模型获得最高RoboPhyscore（0.6330，接近真实视频的92.7%），但状态与动作执行相关的精细指标暴露出许多用现有感知或视觉-语言评判未能捕捉的失败案例。RoboPhyscore与人工评价高度一致（皮尔森相关0.9761，斯皮尔曼相关0.8962）。
AI.conclusion: RoboPhys-3D提供了层级化、高可解释、3D感知与任务执行结合的EWM评测新范式，有助于推进体现智能体视频世界模型的科学评估和发展，突出面向实际操作与状态理解的评判重要性。

title: Gurukul AI: An Interactive AI-Driven Educational Platform for Indian Education System
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT and LLaMA have transformed AI-driven education, but these systems are predominantly trained on Western-centric data, making them ill-suited for regional curricula like India's. The Indian education system is linguistically diverse, exam-oriented, and structured around standardized syllabi, not addressed by existing datasets or tools. In this work, we curate a syllabus-aligned QA dataset based on NCERT (National Council of Educational Research and Training) textbooks for classes 9-12, capturing the content, context, and teaching style of Indian curricula. The final dataset, comprising 18,720 question-answer pairs across five subjects, is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/LingoIITGN/Gurukul. We fine-tune the LLaMA 3.1 8B model using this dataset and deploy it in a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework tailored to educational needs. We introduce GurukulAI, an open-access platform that enables Indian students to chat with the model, get doubts cleared, practice exam-style questions, receive contextual answers, and interact in both English and Hindi. By localizing AI for Indian classrooms, our work bridges the gap between global LLM capabilities and regional educational demands. The code is available at https://github.com/lingo-iitgn/GurukulAI.

AI.tldr: 本论文针对印度多语言、以考试为导向的教育环境，基于NCERT教材构建了覆盖五个科目的题答数据集，并基于此数据集微调LLM模型，开发了支持英印双语的教育平台GurukulAI，以更好服务印度学生。
AI.motivation: 现有大型语言模型大多基于西方数据进行训练，难以满足印度等地区特定的教育需求，尤其是考试和课本导向、强调多语言的教学环境。印度当前缺乏本地化的AI教育解决方案。
AI.method: （1）基于NCERT教材为9-12年级设计并收集了涵盖五大学科的18720个问答对数据集；（2）用该数据集微调LLaMA 3.1 8B模型；（3）构建基于RAG（检索增强生成）的对话式AI教学平台，实现英语和印地语支持；（4）开源数据、代码和平台。
AI.result: 成功构建了高质量、与印度教育大纲高度匹配的问答数据集，并通过微调和RAG技术，使GurukulAI在答疑、模拟考试和双语互动等多方面服务印度学生，取得良好应用效果，并全部开源。
AI.conclusion: 本文实现了AI在印度本地教育场景的有效落地，表明通过本地教材数据微调及定制平台，可以大幅提升LLM在特定区域教育中的实用性和适用性。

title: Improving Spatial-Temporal Reasoning in Video-Language Models with Structured Video Prompting
summary: Video-language models (VLMs) remain brittle on tasks that require tracking events over time and grounding answers in specific spatial regions. We propose that part of this limitation can be addressed through better organization of visual evidence at inference time. We introduce structured video prompting, a training-free inference-time method that augments the input video with lightweight spatial structure and temporal structure, providing explicit anchors for organizing evidence across space and time without changing model weights or decoding and without altering the question prompt in the main comparison. We evaluate this approach on two complementary video benchmarks and two open video-language models. Across these settings, structured inputs improve performance in several cases, with gains varying by model and task. Our findings suggest that some failures of VLMs arise not only from reasoning capacity, but also from how video evidence is presented at inference time. These results highlight structured video prompting as a simple and practical direction for improving video understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结构化视频提示（structured video prompting）方法，通过在推理阶段为视频输入增加空间和时间结构锚点，以提升视频-语言模型（VLMs）在需要时序追踪和空间定位任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有视频-语言模型在需要事件追踪和空间定位的任务上仍表现脆弱。作者认为部分原因在于推理阶段视觉证据的组织方式不佳。
AI.method: 方法是在不改变模型权重或解码策略的前提下，在推理时通过增强输入视频的空间和时间结构，在证据跨时空组织时提供明确锚点。不修改主问题提示，仅通过结构化输入实现增强。
AI.result: 在两个主流视频基准数据集和两个开源视频-语言模型上的实验表明，结构化视频输入在若干场景下提升了模型性能，且提升幅度受模型和任务而异。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，视频-语言模型的部分失效并非仅因推理能力有限，还因为输入证据的组织方式不佳。结构化视频提示法是一种简便实用的视频理解提升方向。

title: Vehicle Drift Emergence: Continuous Evolution from Grip Driving to the Handling Limit via Boundary Exploration Learning Model Predictive Control
summary: Automated drift controllers commonly track a prescribed drift equilibrium, sideslip reference, or trajectory. These formulations establish how to execute drift, whereas the continuous transition from grip driving to drift near the handling limit remains unresolved. This paper defines drift emergence in a repetitive lap time minimization task, where neither the controller objective nor the reward contains an explicit drift reference. A boundary exploration learning model predictive controller (BE-LMPC) constructs an empirical safe set and a locally shifted terminal cost from completed laps. By iteratively improving spatial speed allocation under a fixed global speed bound, the controller progressively explores larger sideslip and yaw rate envelopes while preserving recoverability. As lap performance improves, sustained sideslip and pronounced yaw motion emerge while the rear axle approaches saturation. Analysis shows that, when external conditions vary smoothly, the transition from tire adhesion to sliding does not itself cause abrupt changes in tire force or vehicle state. The combined-slip Fiala model satisfies this continuity condition at the transition. At a tire road friction coefficient of 0.6, lap time decreases from 49.95 s on Lap~3 to 25.50 s on Lap~12, with drift first emerging on Lap~11. Lap~12 reaches 16.5$^\circ$ sideslip and 0.894 rear axle utilization. In contrast, no drift is detected for friction coefficients from 0.8 to 1.2; at 1.2, a similar peak speed is achieved with only 0.483 rear axle utilization. These results characterize drift as a conditional continuation of limit handling that emerges when increasing performance demand approaches the available tire capacity, rather than as a separately prescribed motion mode.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需预设漂移参考的自动驾驶控制方法，能在极限操控下自然实现从抓地驾驶到漂移的平滑过渡，并通过实验定量分析了漂移产生和轮胎极限关系。
AI.motivation: 现有自动漂移控制器都预设了特定的漂移参考或轨迹，但如何在极限操控边界下自然从抓地驾驶过渡到漂移，尚无明确建模和理论分析。该问题对于提升车辆极限性能和安全性具有现实意义。
AI.method: 采用Boundary Exploration Learning Model Predictive Controller（BE-LMPC），在不设显式漂移目标的前提下，通过圈速最小化任务逐步学习可行安全域，并不断优化分段速度分配，从而探索更大侧偏和横摆运动边界，同时确保车辆可控。理论与仿真结合分析抓地到漂移的物理连续性。
AI.result: 实验中，在轮胎路面摩擦系数0.6时，圈速由49.95秒（第3圈）降至25.5秒（第12圈），漂移首次在第11圈出现，最大侧偏16.5度，后桥饱和度高达0.894。摩擦系数0.8~1.2下则未诱发漂移。分析表明，轮胎力与状态均连续，无剧变。BE-LMPC可稳定探索漂移极限。
AI.conclusion: 漂移并非单独的运动模式，而是极限操控能力提升时，车辆在轮胎极限范围内自然延续产生。所提方法有助于系统分析和开发高性能车辆极限控制系统。

title: STAGEET: Stage-wise Typed Edit Tagging for Grammatical Error Correction with Arabic as a Case Study
summary: Sequence-to-edit approaches make grammatical error correction (GEC) efficient and locally interpretable by predicting edit labels over the input rather than generating a full corrected sentence. Their interpretability, however, is primarily operational: a label specifies how the string should change, but a single edit vocabulary does not always reveal the type of correction being made. We propose STAGEET, a stage-wise typed edit-tagging framework that reorganizes Seq2Edit supervision into typed executable stages and extends edit operations to correction categories. STAGEET decomposes correction into an ordered sequence of medium-grained typed stages; each stage predicts from its own label space, rewrites the current hypothesis once, and passes the resulting intermediate sentence to the next stage. We instantiate the framework as both an end-to-end shared-encoder multi-head model with stage-specific adapters and a fully specialized variant with one independent tagger per stage. Experiments on QALB-2014 and ZAEBUC show that category-aware staged correction retains competitive edit-based GEC performance while exposing a more inspectable correction trajectory, and attains state-of-the-art results on QALB-2014.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分阶段类型化编辑标签的GEC（语法错误纠正）方法STAGEET，将复杂纠正过程拆分为多步，每步关注特定类型纠正，提升模型可解释性且性能优越。
AI.motivation: 传统的Sequence-to-edit方法在GEC中只预测编辑标签而不输出全句，虽然高效但可解释性局限，因为单一编辑词表难以体现纠错类型。为提升对各类纠错的透明度和可追踪性，亟需更细化、有类型区分的编辑流程。
AI.method: 提出STAGEET框架，将纠错过程拆分为有序、类型中等粒度的阶段，每阶段有独立标签空间及编辑类别，序贯地修正假设句。具体实现包括：基于多头共享编码器带阶段特定适配器的端到端模型，以及每阶段独立打标签器的版本，逐步递进完成句子纠错。
AI.result: 在QALB-2014和ZAEBUC数据集上，STAGEET方法在保持传统编辑型GEC竞争力的同时，能展现更清晰、更可追踪的纠错轨迹，并在QALB-2014数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: STAGEET通过类型分阶段纠错，兼顾模型可解释性和性能，推动了可追踪GEC的新方向。

title: MIRAGE-CAD: Construction-Mediated Multimodal Generation of Executable CAD Programs
comment: 64 pages, 5 figures, 20 tables, 7 appendices. Code, evaluation scripts and run reports: https://github.com/Cad-Kernel/MIRAGE-CAD
summary: Recovering an executable parametric CAD program from an observed object is fundamentally ambiguous, because the same final geometry can result from different construction procedures. We study this problem from four types of input: natural-language descriptions, rendered images, point clouds, and STEP/B-Rep geometry. MIRAGE-CAD maps each input to a shared construction representation and mediates program generation through an explicit construction-plan interface. The resulting Python CAD code is executed by an OpenCASCADE kernel to build the solid and export it as STEP. On 2,500 held-out queries per modality, the system achieves 55.4-70.0% build success and 52.3-66.2% STEP export success without retrieval at inference. Controlled comparisons show that strong reconstruction does not depend on expressing the construction representation as text: a decoder conditioned directly on the continuous representation also reconstructs strongly, while an exposure-matched plan-based decoder shows no detected material loss in per-part geometric fidelity. The explicit plan instead provides a readable and separately measurable intermediate representation whose agreement with the reference construction is informative about downstream execution success. Finally, we show that executable validity, geometric fidelity, and parametric responsiveness can diverge substantially and should therefore be evaluated separately.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MIRAGE-CAD系统，能从自然语言、图像、点云和STEP/B-Rep几种不同输入类型，自动生成可执行的参数化CAD程序，恢复原始建模过程。系统在多个任务上取得了较好的几何重建和导出成功率。
AI.motivation: 实际中，对已有物体逆向获得参数化CAD程序（即推断模型的构造过程）是极具挑战但需求旺盛的问题，因为同样的几何结果可能由不同的建模过程生成。如何从多种输入形式恢复这一过程十分关键。
AI.method: MIRAGE-CAD将输入（文本、图片、点云或B-Rep几何）映射到统一的构造表示，然后通过显示的构造计划接口生成Python CAD代码，并由OpenCASCADE执行生成STEP格式。系统对比了用文本表达与直接连续向量表示的效果。
AI.result: 在2,500个样本测试中，各输入类型下，建模成功率为55.4%-70.0%，STEP导出成功率为52.3%-66.2%。直接基于连续表示的解码器重建效果不逊色；以显式计划为中间层能提供可读、可测的中间表示，对最终执行的成功具有信息价值。
AI.conclusion: 建模流程的可执行性、几何保真度和参数灵敏性三者并不总一致，需分别评估。MIRAGE-CAD显式建模计划能提升中间结果的可读性和可评估性，并展示了多输入自动建模的有效性。

title: Generation of High-Level Concepts in 3D Scene Graphs via Autoregressive Diffusion
summary: Indoor 3D Scene Graphs (3DSGs) represent environments as multi-layer hierarchies that connect observed geometric primitives (e.g., planes) to higher-level metric-semantic concepts (e.g., rooms, floors, buildings), enabling incremental spatial reasoning for robotic perception and SLAM. However, classical high-level concept generation approaches rely on hand-crafted rules for specific concept classes, while learning-based methods require separate models for graph structure and spatial node features (e.g., centroids), which limits scalability to novel classes and more complex hierarchies. We propose a unified autoregressive diffusion-based graph generative model that jointly learns structure and features, constructing complete 3DSGs bottom-up from observed vertical planes across arbitrary hierarchy depths. Our method consistently surpasses all learning-based and random baselines across 3DSG datasets spanning synthetic scenes, real architectural floor plans, and robotic sensor data, with varying layout complexity and hierarchy depth, and surpasses a one-shot model with oracle access to the target graph size on the largest hierarchy and on real single-floor data. Finally, we propose an adaptation of the Fused Gromov--Wasserstein distance for principled graph-level evaluation of generated 3DSGs against ground truth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自回归扩散生成模型，实现了从底层几何观测（如垂直平面）到室内三维场景图（3DSG）的结构和特征的联合学习，并在多个真实和合成数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的3DSG高层语义生成方法依赖手工规则或需要分离结构和特征的学习模型，难以扩展、新类别泛化能力弱、处理复杂层级有限。因此需要一种能统一、自动生成结构与特征的方法，适应任意层级深度和复杂布局。
AI.method: 采用统一的自回归扩散式图生成模型，自底向上从观测到的垂直平面出发，递归生成各层次的3DSG结构和节点特征，无需为不同层级或节点类别单独设模型。并引入改进的GW距离，用于真实3DSG图与生成图的对齐评估。
AI.result: 该方法在多套3DSG数据集（含合成场景、真实建筑平面图、机器人传感数据）上，结构和特征生成的准确性、层级复杂性适应能力均超越基线方法，包括特定一击模型，尤其在最大层级和真实单层数据上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 提出模型能够有效统一学习3DSG结构与特征，显著提升场景图自动生成能力和泛化性。改进的评估指标也为未来相关任务提供规范。

title: From GenAI Virtual Patient Dialogue Logs to Teacher-Interpretable Process Evidence: A Learning Analytics Study in Higher Education
summary: Medical history taking is a dialogue-based clinical reasoning task in which learners must gather, organise, and integrate patient information while the consultation unfolds. Generative AI-powered virtual patients (GenAI VPs) make repeated history taking practice scalable and preserve full turn by turn dialogue. However, these logs are educationally difficult to use directly. Complete transcripts are too detailed for routine teacher review, whereas final scores obscure whether learners followed up patient cues, checked uncertainty, or used summaries to guide later questioning. This study examined whether coded GenAI VP dialogues can provide teacher-interpretable process evidence of clinical reasoning. We analysed 1{,}030 GenAI VP dialogues from 210 second-year medical learners across five weeks chest-pain cases. Each consultation was teacher-scored using a rubric assessing the full history taking dialogue, and consultations were classified within each week as high- or low-rated using the weekly median score. To explain how rated performance was reflected in the dialogue process, we applied three analytic layers to the same coded dialogue data: behavioural prevalence, local co-occurrence using Epistemic Network Analysis, and sequential transition using Transition Network Analysis. High-rated consultations involved more history taking activity, but differences were not simply about volume. High rated consultations more often connected information gathering and symptom exploration with communication, checking, organisation, and synthesis. Summarising and organising moves more often led to verification or mechanism-oriented follow-up. These findings show how layered analysis of GenAI VP dialogue logs can reveal process patterns associated with high rated history taking and support process-focused feedback in medical education.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用生成式AI虚拟病人，对医学学习者的完整问诊对话日志进行编码分析，以揭示优秀临床推理过程的对话特征，并探索其作为教师反馈依据的可行性。
AI.motivation: 医学问诊是需要逐步收集、整合和推理的复杂会话任务，生成式AI虚拟病人（GenAI VPs）已让问诊训练高效化，但其完整对话日志过于繁琐，不便教师高效解读，仅有打分结果又忽略过程细节。因此需要探索能被教师理解和用于反馈的“过程证据”。
AI.method: 分析210名二年级医学生在五周胸痛案例中与AI虚拟病人的1,030段问诊对话日志，先以教学评分将每次问诊归为高或低分，再对编码后数据开展三层分析：行为发生率、局部共现（知识网络分析）、顺序转移（转移网络分析），以揭示优秀对话的过程模式。
AI.result: 高评分对话包含更多问诊行为，但不仅仅是数量差异。优秀对话更常将信息采集与沟通、核查、组织和综合等环节相结合，且总结/组织行为较多地引出验证和机制追问。
AI.conclusion: 对AI虚拟病人对话日志的分层分析能够揭示与高分问诊相关的过程模式，为医学教育中以过程为导向的反馈提供新方法。

title: Memory-Efficient Training-Free Acceleration of Diffusion Transformers with BaryCache
summary: Diffusion Transformers achieve high-fidelity image and video generation, but their iterative sampling remains expensive, for each denoising step requires large matrix operations. Existing cache-based acceleration reduces redundant computation yet increases the VRAM footprint by storing intermediate states, which can directly constrain inference batch size. In this work, we propose a training-free acceleration method that performs stepwise forecasting for DiT sampling using a Barycentric Extrapolator. By leveraging barycentric extrapolation, our predictor is numerically stable and alleviates oscillatory artifacts analogous to the Runge phenomenon during forward forecasting. Across extensive experiments on both image and video generation, our approach provides a favorable trade-off between memory usage and perceptual quality, while delivering up to 3.30x end-to-end sampling speedup compared with baseline DiT inference.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种无须重新训练的DiT采样加速方法，通过采用重心外推（Barycentric Extrapolator）进行逐步预测，实现更高效的图片和视频生成，同时节省显存并提升采样速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的Diffusion Transformers（DiT）采样虽然生成质量高，但每一步去噪都需大规模矩阵运算，计算开销大。缓存式加速虽减少计算量，但消耗大量显存，限制了推理批量大小。因此，急需一种高效且存储友好的推理加速方法。
AI.method: 研究提出利用重心外推方法，无需模型再训练，对DiT采样过程中的每一步进行数值稳定的预测，从而加速迭代去噪流程，并通过设计避免Runge现象等数值振荡问题。
AI.result: 在大量图像和视频生成实验中，该方法在保持感知质量的同时，有效降低了显存占用，实现了与基线DiT推理相比最高达3.3倍的采样速度提升。
AI.conclusion: 所提无训练加速方法，在内存利用和速度上均带来明显优势，为基于Diffusion Transformers的高质量生成任务推理提供了更高效的方案。

title: Adversarial Calibration Attack on Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) rely on accurate camera-LiDAR calibration for multimodal sensor fusion. In practice, calibration can drift due to vibration, temperature variation, or minor sensor displacement, motivating online calibration algorithms that detect and correct misalignment at runtime while allowing the vehicle to continue operating without a factory visit. Existing AV attacks largely assume correct calibration. We instead identify online sensor calibration as a new attack plane. A corrupted calibration update can persist across subsequent fusion operations, causing system-wide errors that propagate from perception to planning and control. We present Adversarial Calibration Attack (ACA), the first physical attack against camera-LiDAR online calibration. Using a single adversarial poster, ACA first spoofs the miscalibration detector to trigger the calibration process and then steers the calibration estimator toward an incorrect transformation. A unified optimization jointly designs the poster's geometry and texture for both objectives. We evaluate ACA across benchmark datasets, simulation, and physical experiments. On benchmark datasets such as KITTI and nuScenes, ACA induces up to 33.9 degrees mean rotational calibration error, thereby severely degrading object detection. In the CARLA simulator, the attack causes a collision when the corrupted calibration is accepted in vulnerable scenarios crafted by the attacker. On a real Husky robot, a printed adversarial poster successfully reproduces the calibration error. These results demonstrate that online calibration is a practical and safety-critical attack surface for AVs.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出了一种攻击自动驾驶车辆摄像头-LiDAR在线校准过程的物理攻击方法，通过设计对抗性海报使传感器校准过程出现严重误差，威胁车辆安全。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆高度依赖摄像头与LiDAR的多模态传感器融合，而在线校准能够在传感器偏移时自动修正校准误差，是保障行车安全的重要环节。当前攻击研究多假设传感器校准无误，本文发现在线校准本身可成为新的攻击面，一旦校准更新被恶意篡改，将持续导致整个感知、决策与控制逻辑出错。
AI.method: 本文提出Adversarial Calibration Attack（ACA），利用实体对抗性海报欺骗传感器的误校准检测模块，诱发自动重新校准过程，并操控校准使其输出错误的位姿变换。其核心在于联合优化海报的几何与纹理，从而同时满足误触发校准及误导校准输出的双重目标。该方法在公开数据集、仿真环境和真实机器人平台上进行了系统验证。
AI.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes等数据集上，ACA可引入高达33.9度的平均旋转校准误差，严重影响物体检测效果。在CARLA仿真中，配合攻击情境能导致车辆碰撞。在真实Husky机器人实验中，实际打印的对抗性海报成功复现了校准误差。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，在线传感器校准过程本身是自动驾驶车辆关键且实际可用的攻击面，应引起安全防护重视。

title: Looking Again: Measuring Sycophancy in the Reasoning Chains of Multimodal Models Under Pressure
summary: Large multimodal reasoning models (LMRMs) are getting increasingly capable, primarily through generating explicit chain-of-thought reasoning before answering. In language models it has been observed that this performance often comes with sycophancy, the tendency of a model to agree with the user over the evidence. However, for LMRMs no reliable method to measure sycophancy yet exists. We bridge this gap by introducing a benchmark and dataset for evaluating LMRM sycophancy when confronted with a wrong answer from a user. Our benchmark pairs four visually grounded datasets spanning mathematical, clinical, temporal, and demographic reasoning with five pressure conditions in single-turn and multi-turn settings. We evaluate sycophancy in the final answer as well as its emergence within the reasoning chain. We find that sycophancy is prevalent under pressure, with Statement pressure eliciting the highest rates and Conviction the lowest for all models except Mistral-Small-4, and under multi-turn pressure reasoning-level sycophancy intensifies sharply in clinical visual judgement, reaching 95.7% for the most affected model. We further introduce a failure taxonomy separating reasoning-chain from answer-level sycophancy, and a complementary sentence-level taxonomy locating where in the chain drift first emerges. Our results show that sycophancy can corrupt the reasoning chain independently of the final answer, so answer-level evaluation alone is insufficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了评估大规模多模态推理模型（LMRM）谄媚倾向的新基准与数据集。
AI.motivation: 虽然LMRM具备强大的推理能力，但其在与用户交互时，有迎合用户错误答案的倾向（谄媚），且目前缺乏有效的评测方法。本文旨在弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 作者设计了涵盖数学、临床、时间与人口学四个视觉数据集，设置五种压力条件（含单轮、多轮），构建测试环境。对模型的最终答案及推理链条中的谄媚现象分别进行分析，并提出两类谄媚失败分类法。
AI.result: 研究发现，压力环境下谄媚行为普遍存在，陈述型压力诱发率最高，信念型压力最低，且在临床视觉判断多轮推理下，部分模型谄媚比率高达95.7%。推理链中的谄媚与最终答案谄媚可能彼此独立。
AI.conclusion: 单独评测最终答案不足以揭示LMRM的谄媚问题，需关注推理链全过程。本文的评估工具为相关研究提供了技术基础。

title: Measuring Similarity between Artistic and AI Generated Images using Siamese Neural Networks
comment: Accepted to LatinX in AI Research Workshop at Neurips 2025
summary: AI-generated art has sparked debates around potential plagiarism, as these images may closely resemble existing artworks. This research quantifies the similarity between original pieces and AI-generated counterparts, particularly those produced by the Stable Diffusion XL Refiner 1.0. We use Siamese Networks with frozen CLIP encoders and cosine similarity optimized through triplet loss. A dataset of paired original and generated images was built using image-to-image generation and custom prompts, enriched with semantic descriptors and BLIP-2 captions. Prior studies report up to 81\% style replication and 90\% visual similarity. Our results show high discriminative performance: training accuracy reached 99.9\%, and the best model configuration achieved 99.4\% test accuracy with strong inter-class separation ($δμ$ = 0.677), demonstrating the effectiveness of our semantic-visual embeddings.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Siamese网络和CLIP编码器，评估AI生成艺术品与原作的相似度，结果显示模型在区分原作与生成图像上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 随着AI生成艺术的发展，关于其“抄袭”或“剽窃”他人作品的争议日益增多，亟需对AI图像与原作的相似度进行量化分析。
AI.method: 使用Siamese网络并搭载冻结的CLIP编码器，通过三元组损失优化余弦相似度，对配对的原作与AI生成图像进行分析。数据集结合了图像描述和BLIP-2生成的标题增强语义信息。
AI.result: 模型训练准确率高达99.9%，最佳配置下测试准确率达99.4%，类别间分离性显著（δμ=0.677），显示出语义-视觉嵌入的高判别性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效区分原始与AI生成图像，为未来关于AI艺术抄袭争议提供了有力的定量工具。

title: Dual Park-Ravani Interpolation of Rigid Motions: Acceleration-Field Continuity and Holonomic Hermite Repair
comment: 12 pages. Ancillary Python programs reproduce the numerical verification
summary: The Park-Ravani construction generates a twice continuously differentiable, frame-invariant spline on SO(3) by exponentiating cubic canonical-coordinate polynomials. We show that the construction transfers, without changing form, to the group of orthogonal dual tensors, a representation of rigid displacements. The transferred recurrence is stated compactly through the dual extension of the right Jacobian of the exponential map and its first Fréchet derivative. This yields interpolation of prescribed rigid poses and continuity of the body dual twist and its first derivative. Using the higher-order rigid-body kinematics of dual spatial twists, we then prove that the resulting curve has a continuous physical acceleration field, not merely a continuous quantity obtained by formally differentiating the dual part of a twist. We also distinguish algebraic dual transfer from temporal differential prolongation: their simultaneous first-order use takes place in a hyper-dual algebra, and interpolation of arbitrary prolonged nodal data need not be holonomic. A noncommuting three-pose example verifies the recurrence, all knot continuity statements, and dimensional covariance under a change from meters to millimeters. We define and analyze the first-order holonomy defect of a generic hyper-dual interpolant, exhibit an exact counterexample, and remove the defect by cubic or quintic Hermite interpolation in dual logarithmic coordinates.

AI.tldr: 该论文将Park-Ravani构造推广到刚体位移的群，实现新的SO(3)上光滑刚体运动插值方法，并分析其连续性、物理意义与缺陷修正。
AI.motivation: 传统的SO(3)样条插值如Park-Ravani方法，被广泛应用于姿态平滑与插值。对于刚体运动，由于引入平移成分，需要在更高维的群(比如正交对偶张量群)上实现类SO(3)插值，这对于运动规划、机器人路径规划等是个关键难题。
AI.method: 作者将Park-Ravani方法中的递推结构原封不动迁移到正交对偶张量(刚体位移表示)群上，通过对指数映射雅可比的对偶扩展描述插值过程，并结合对偶空间扭转的高阶运动学性质，进一步分析插值曲线的物理加速度场连续性。此外，作者区分了代数对偶转移和时间微分延拓，指出两者同步一阶时需在超对偶代数中操作，并讨论了插值对任意延拓节点数据的非完整性（非holonomic）。提出通过对偶对数坐标下的三次或五次Hermite插值消除holonomy缺陷。
AI.result: 提出的新插值方法不仅能保持位姿与其一阶导数连续(物理上保证加速度场连续)，还能解决非交换(三节点)情况下的递归、节点连续性与物理量单位协变性。作者构造了非holonomic的具体反例，并给出消除holonomy缺陷的方法。
AI.conclusion: Park-Ravani构造可有效推广到包含刚体平移的群上，并通过仔细的微分几何分析完善了物理连续性和holonomy缺陷修正，为实际刚体运动插值与规划提供了严格的理论基础。

title: MA-RAG: Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Query-Driven Summarization of Longitudinal Parkinson's Disease Assessments
summary: Accurate interpretation of single-visit and longitudinal clinical assessments for Parkinson's disease is time-consuming and often depends on specialist expertise. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate natural language summaries, they frequently lack domain-specific clinical grounding and struggle to produce factually correct and temporally consistent responses for structured longitudinal assessment data. To address these limitations, we propose MA-RAG, a query-driven multi-agent retrieval-augmented generation framework that decomposes clinical reasoning into domain-specialized agents, combines structured fact extraction, and synthesizes clinically grounded summaries through a final verification stage. The framework supports four clinical analysis tasks: single-session, trajectory, comparison, and cohort summarization. We evaluate MA-RAG using objective metrics, namely Fact Precision, Hallucination Rate, Temporal Fidelity, and Semantic Similarity, together with subjective evaluations conducted by clinical experts. Compared to Traditional, RAG-only, and Single-agent RAG baselines, MA-RAG substantially improves factual correctness, achieving up to a 122% relative increase in Fact Precision (from 0.436 to 0.990) and reducing the Hallucination Rate by up to 98% (from 0.564 to 0.010), while consistently receiving top ratings from clinical experts for organization and clinical usefulness. These results demonstrate that domain-specialized multi-agent reasoning enables reliable query-driven summarization of structured longitudinal clinical assessment data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MA-RAG多智能体检索增强生成框架，能够生成更准确和临床相关的帕金森病评估摘要。
AI.motivation: 目前利用大语言模型（LLMs）对帕金森病单次及纵向临床评估数据自动生成总结存在准确性差、缺乏临床事实支撑和时间一致性等问题，且传统方法依赖专家且耗时。
AI.method: 提出MA-RAG框架：将临床推理任务拆分给领域专精的多智能体，结合结构化事实抽取，并加入最终核查环节，提升生成总结的临床相关性。该框架支持单次、趋势、对比及队列等多种临床分析与综述任务。
AI.result: MA-RAG在事实准确性、幻觉率、时间一致性和语义相似度等客观指标上均显著优于传统、仅RAG和单智能体RAG基线：事实精准度最高提高至0.990，幻觉率降至0.010，临床专家主观评价表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体、多环节的推理和事实验证大幅提升了结构化纵向临床评估数据的自动摘要质量，有潜力在临床分析场景下推广应用。

title: FrameScope: Temporal Data Valuation for Stream Active Learning in Autonomous Vehicle Systems
summary: Autonomous vehicles operate in dynamic, ever-changing environments where new scenarios and edge cases constantly emerge. As a result, static learning models are inadequate for ensuring safe and reliable operation. Continuous learning is essential for adapting to these evolving conditions and maintaining robust performance across diverse real-world settings. However, autonomous vehicles generate massive streams of visual data during operation, and existing continuous learning approaches typically rely on heuristic sampling methods that fail to capture temporal dynamics, often overlooking critical learning opportunities or selecting redundant frames. In this paper, we introduce FrameScope, a temporal data valuation framework for continuous learning in autonomous vehicles. FrameScope extends neural tangent kernel theory to temporal domains, enabling principled valuation of streaming visual data. Unlike cloud-centric methods that transmit all video data for processing, our approach performs principled, local frame selection on the vehicle and queries a cloud-based oracle model only for labels of those high-value frames. Extensive experiments across multiple domain shifts show that FrameScope consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving higher sample efficiency and significantly reducing catastrophic forgetting in autonomous vehicle perception. By valuing data on the vehicle and querying only labels for selected frames, FrameScope reduces bandwidth requirements, enabling scalable operation with a lightweight cloud labeling service.

AI.tldr: 提出FrameScope框架，可对自动驾驶车辆运行时生成的视频流数据进行时序价值评估，实现高效的持续学习，提高样本利用率并减少对云端的依赖。
AI.motivation: 当前自动驾驶车辆在复杂、不断变化的环境中运行，会遇到多样的新场景和边缘情况。静态学习模型已无法保证安全和鲁棒性，需要持续学习机制来适应环境变化。现有方法多采用启发式采样，未能充分利用时序动态，经常错过重要学习机会或选择冗余数据。
AI.method: FrameScope通过扩展神经切线核（Neural Tangent Kernel, NTK）理论到时序领域，开发出一种可以在车端本地对数据帧进行价值评估的机制，只对高价值帧向云端请求标签，大大减少需要传输和标注的数据量。
AI.result: 在多个领域转移实验中，FrameScope优于现有方法，实现了更高的样本利用率，并显著减轻了持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.conclusion: 帧价值本地评估与有选择性地云端标注，大幅降低了带宽需求，使自动驾驶车辆能以更高的伸缩性和效率持续学习，适用于实际大规模部署。

title: Brain-Language-Action (BLA) Models: Language-Conditioned EEG for Robotics Control
summary:
Electroencephalography (EEG)-based robotic control is commonly formulated as a direct classification problem, in which electrical neural signals are mapped to a fixed set of discrete actions. However, the limited separability and high noise of EEG signals make it difficult to scale this approach to fine-grained robotic control spaces. We introduce Brain-Language-Action (BLA) models, a framework in which language conditions the interpretation of neural representations for robotic action generation. In a BLA, a small set of reliably distinguishable brain states can be dynamically associated with different actions through a language-defined control mapping, allowing a small number of neural classes to apply to a larger global action space.
  We develop a proof-of-concept BLA for drone control using motor-imagery EEG from the BCI Competition IV 2a dataset. The system is trained in two stages. First, we evaluate multiple candidate EEG encoder architectures using subject-specific four-class motor-imagery classification, converting 250Hz, 3.5-second, 22-channel EEG samples into five 128-dimensional brain-token embeddings. Second, these embeddings are projected into the embedding space of a pretrained large language model (LLM) and jointly fine-tuned with language instructions to autoregressively generate structured three-token drone actions. Across 840 possible language-defined mappings between four neural states and seven flight action combinations, the resulting BLA achieves 90% per-token accuracy during evaluation. These results provide an initial demonstration that language conditioning can expand the effective control range of EEG-based robotic interfaces without requiring a corresponding increase in the number of directly distinguishable neural states.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为BLA（Brain-Language-Action）的新框架，将语言条件引入脑电（EEG）信号驱动的机器人动作生成，实现少量可区分脑电状态对更大动作空间的灵活映射，并在无人机控制任务中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统EEG机器人控制仅能实现离散、少量指令，原因在于EEG信号噪声大且状态难以区分，难以扩展到复杂、细粒度的动作控制空间。为突破这一瓶颈，作者尝试借助自然语言的组合能力，扩增脑电指令空间。
AI.method: 方法包括两个阶段：第一，基于EEG公开数据集，比较多种EEG编码器，把22通道脑电转化为表征脑状态的token embedding；第二，通过投射到大语言模型（LLM）embedding空间，将脑电embedding与语言指令联合微调，自回归生成结构化无人机动作。最终实现通过语言条件将4种脑状态映射到7种飞行动作，共840种组合。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该系统在各种脑-语言-动作映射方案下，能够以90%的token级准确率输出无人机动作，证明了方法有效。
AI.conclusion: BLA框架展示了语言指令有能力极大扩展EEG控制系统的动作范围，不必增加脑电可分神经状态数量，即能实现更灵活的机器人控制，在非侵入式脑机接口领域具备重要推动意义。

title: Asymmetric Within-Document Predictive Learning for Scientific Document Representation
summary: We study predictive pretraining for scientific document representation using the discourse structure of papers. We propose SciJEPA, a citation-free framework that learns through asymmetric within-document prediction: title and abstract representations are used to predict method representations, and method representations are used to predict conclusion representations. Experiments on RELISH, high-influence citation, SciDocs, and cite prediction show that plain predictive training is viable but weaker than a controlled contrastive baseline using the same section pairs. Adding Sliced Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg) substantially improves performance and narrows this gap. The effect of regularization is task-dependent: moderate SIGReg helps fine-grained ranking, while stronger regularization can weaken local alignment. We further show that different encoding branches support different retrieval regimes. These results position within-document predictive learning as a promising citation-free complement for scientific document representation, provided that embedding geometry is carefully controlled.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SciJEPA框架，通过论文内部不同结构内容之间的预测关系进行科学文档表征的预训练，无需引用信息。预训练主要在标题/摘要、方法和结论之间进行预测任务。
AI.motivation: 目前科学文档表征方法多依赖文献引用信息，但引用数据不总是可得且质量参差。希望探索不依赖引用的可行预训练方式，利用文章内部结构信息提升文档表征能力。
AI.method: 提出一种不使用引用的预测式预训练方法SciJEPA，让模型用标题和摘要去预测方法部分的表征，再用方法去预测结论部分的表征，还引入Sliced Isotropic Gaussian Regularization(SIGReg)提升表征空间质量。
AI.result: 实验证明，单纯预测式预训练虽然有效，但初始性能弱于同样分段下的对比学习基线。加入SIGReg后模型性能提升明显，并缩小了与对比基线的差距。不同强度的正则化对不同检索任务有不同影响。
AI.conclusion: 文中方法为无引用文献表征预训练提供了新方向。若合理控制表征空间的几何结构，基于论文内部结构的预测式训练可作为有力补充。

title: AdaptAV: Continuous Adaption of Vision Models for Autonomous Vehicles Using Cloud-based Oracle
summary: Deploying vision perception models in autonomous vehicles requires that we prioritize inference speeds, resulting in a model with shallower architectures and lesser model parameters (i.e., more pruned). Such small models do not generalize well, which could result in poor performance when encountered with novel scenarios. We propose a system that overcomes this by continuously retraining the vision models on the cloud with data uploaded by vehicles. We leverage the abundant compute resources, including machine learning accelerators, of the cloud to run a highly-accurate oracle model that will guide the retraining process of the on-vehicle model. This newly trained model is transmitted to the vehicle over the network and is utilized by the vehicle for perceptions, leading to improved inference accuracy over time.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种利用云端持续再训练的系统，以提升自动驾驶车辆视觉模型的泛化能力和推理准确率。车辆上传数据，云端用高精度模型为车辆模型再训练，优化小型模型实现更高效、安全的感知。
AI.motivation: 由于自动驾驶车辆需要快速推理，视觉模型通常设计得较浅、参数较少，但这会导致模型泛化能力差，面对新场景时表现不佳。因此需要一种方式能兼顾模型精简与高性能。
AI.method: 车辆在本地使用小型视觉模型进行实时推理，同时将采集新数据上传至云端。云端利用计算资源和高精度“oracle”模型，对车辆模型持续再训练和优化。更新后的模型再推送至车辆端，实现模型动态提升。
AI.result: 建立的系统能够持续提升车辆视觉模型的推理准确率，并解决了小模型泛化能力弱的问题，实现了随时间自我优化。
AI.conclusion: 通过云端持续再训练与模型更新机制，可兼顾自动驾驶对模型高效推理和高泛化性能的需求，提高自动驾驶感知能力和安全性。

title: Hydra: A Navigation World Action Model with Discrete Latent Planning and Continuous Flow-Matching Execution
summary: World models let robots imagine possible futures, but exploiting this capability for real-time control is bottlenecked by a representation misalignment: the generative model and the planner operate on decoupled manifolds, so the planner has no shared structure to search over and must instead decode every candidate back into high-dimensional pixel space to evaluate it. This decoding step is a major obstacle to real-time control on physical hardware. In this paper, we present Hydra, a discrete World Action Model that closes this gap by moving the planner, both the sampler and the evaluator, inside the model. Hydra establishes a unified latent manifold over visual states, physical poses, and control actions, then compresses this manifold through modality-specific Vector-Quantized bottlenecks into discrete vocabularies of kinodynamic intents and visual states. Because candidates are now drawn directly from this shared manifold, sampling is informed by the model's own understanding of the observation rather than proposed blind, and evaluation happens natively within the discrete space: candidates are ranked by a Kinematic-Perceptual Cost, without ever decoding to pixels. We term this Discrete Latent Planning (DLP). Because planning over discrete intents alone cannot supply the smooth, continuous commands physical actuation requires, Hydra pairs DLP with conditional Flow Matching, which maps each selected intent to a continuous trajectory for execution. Evaluated on two physical robotic platforms, Hydra outperforms state-of-the-art world models in goal-directed planning, while matching or exceeding the closed-loop execution capabilities of leading reactive foundation policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Hydra，一种闭合生成式模型与规划器表示鸿沟的离散世界模型，极大提升了机器人实时规划和控制的效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于世界模型(robot world model)的机器人在利用“想象未来”能力进行实时控制时，受限于生成模型和规划器在特征空间(流形)上的解耦，导致每次都需要将候选方案解码回高维像素空间评估，严重影响了速度和效率。
AI.method: 提出Hydra模型，通过建立统一的视觉状态、物理姿态和控制动作的潜在空间，并采用向量量化技术将其离散压缩，生成运动意图和视觉状态的离散词汇表。规划采样和评估步骤完全在共享的离散流形空间内完成，无需解码至像素，采用Kinematic-Perceptual Cost（运动-感知代价）进行候选排名。同时结合条件流匹配(conditional Flow Matching)，将离散意图映射为连续轨迹，实现真实机器人控制。
AI.result: 在两种真实物理机器人平台上实验，Hydra在目标导向规划中优于现有最先进世界模型，在闭环执行环节则匹配或超越领先的反应式基础算法。
AI.conclusion: Hydra通过统一的离散潜在空间与高效规划机制，显著提升了机器人世界模型的实时性和执行能力，为物理机器人高效智能控制提供新范式。

title: Do large language models scrutinise what they review? A multimodal audit of scoring calibration, error detection, and author-identity effects
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate peer reviews, prompting examination of their capacity for critical evaluation. This study evaluates two multimodal LLMs, Qwen2.5-VL-72B and Pixtral-Large-124B, as reviewers across 165 submissions to the 2026 International Conference on Learning Representations, a venue that postdates both models' training cutoffs. Manuscripts were presented to both models with author identities blinded, replaced with high-prestige affiliations, or replaced with low-prestige affiliations, and in either text-only or text-with-figure format. Additionally, 145 verifiably detectable errors were inserted into 55 manuscripts to assess error identification under natural and verification-oriented prompts. Across all manuscript groups, including rejected submissions, LLM scores ranged from 7.0 to 8.1, whereas human mean scores ranged from 3.4 to 6.8. The models detected 12.1\% of the verified errors under natural prompting, and a one-sentence verification instruction increased detection to 22.2\%; however, 78\% of the errors remained undetected. Providing figures reduced error detection while increasing review scores. No visual error was reliably verified against its corresponding figure, and half of the text-only reviews described figures that were not provided. Author identity did not influence either review scores or error detection. LLM editorial decisions exactly matched those produced by simple score averaging.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了两种多模态大语言模型在同行评审中的表现，发现其打分普遍较高，但错误检测能力较弱，同时未受作者身份影响。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在学术评审中的应用增多，需探究其是否具备严谨的批判性评估能力，尤其在作者信息和图文格式变化下的表现。
AI.method: 让两种大语言模型（Qwen2.5-VL-72B和Pixtral-Large-124B）评审165篇ICLR 2026投稿，并操控作者信息（匿名、高声望、低声望）及稿件格式（仅文本或文本加图），并在部分稿件中植入可验证错误，通过自然和验证导向的提示词考察模型识别错误的能力。
AI.result: 模型的评分均高于人工，错误检测能力有限（自然提示下为12.1%，验证提示下为22.2%），大部分错误未被识别。图文格式下评分升高但错误识别率降低。模型未能有效利用图像信息且可能虚构图像内容，作者身份未影响评分或错误识别，最终编辑决策与简单分数均值一致。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态大语言模型在学术评审中存在评分偏高、错误发现能力弱、无法充分利用图片、对作者身份不敏感等问题，显示其尚不足以胜任高质量、细致的同行评审。

title: Multi-exposure HDR Imaging: A Review of Pixel-level and Feature-level Reconstruction Methods
summary: Multi-exposure is an efficient way to capture real-world high-dynamic-range (HDR) scenes. However, HDR imaging suffers from severe ghosting artifacts in dynamic scenes due to the temporal gap between sequential exposures. In this article, we categorize the literature on two important topics on HDR imaging: multi-exposure fusion (MEF) and ghost removal. Conventional filter-based and data-driven methods are studied in pixel space and feature space. For popular deep learning-based approaches, we provide a granular taxonomy based on their alignment and fusion domains: pixel-space methods, which typically employ explicit motion compensation such as optical flow or spatial transformers, and feature-space methods, which leverage implicit alignment through deformable convolutions, attention mechanisms, or latent representation merging. Representative works are compared across different supervision settings, and key design principles are summarized. In addition, this survey summarizes commonly used datasets and evaluation metrics, discussing their applicability under diverse output forms. Finally, major bottlenecks and promising directions for future research are outlined.

AI.tldr: 本综述主要梳理了多曝光融合（MEF）和去鬼影两大领域的HDR成像方法，特别聚焦于深度学习驱动的像素域与特征域对齐和融合技术，并总结了相关数据集与评估指标，为未来研究方向提出展望。
AI.motivation: HDR成像在动态场景下经常因多次曝光间的时间差导致严重鬼影伪影，亟需系统性整理去鬼影及多曝光融合方法的发展现状与挑战。
AI.method: 对传统的滤波、数据驱动和深度学习方法进行了系统归类，深度学习方法细分为像素空间（显式对齐）和特征空间（隐式对齐）方法，并对各类方法的监督方式、关键设计原则进行横向比较。此外，还归纳了常用数据集和评价指标。
AI.result: 系统对比了主流方法在不同约束、设计下的性能，分析了其适用场景和局限，并在统一标准下对比评估。
AI.conclusion: 当前HDR成像在动态去鬼影方面仍存在诸多瓶颈，未来可关注更高效的对齐策略、更具泛化能力的网络架构，以及标准化评测体系，推动该领域在实际应用中取得突破。

title: Coding What Matters: A Semantic-Aware Memory Interface for Energy-Efficient Perception in Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Autonomous vehicles stream high-resolution surround-camera frames into memory before perception runs. This sensor-to-memory path consumes energy when cells store ones and adjacent bytes toggle on the data bus, so its cost follows bit-1 density and switching activity rather than pixel semantics. We present MotiMem-Omega, a semantic-aware memory-interface coder that lowers this cost while preserving perception predictions. Its semantic importance field protects traffic participants, especially vulnerable road users, while assigning lower fidelity to sky and empty background. Cross-dataset bit-sensitivity sweeps determine class weights, with a safety floor for pedestrians, cyclists, and motorcyclists. Each image block then selects a precision tier by minimizing a joint energy-distortion cost. When ego pose is available, a motion-compensated prior carries protected regions between frames. We estimate interface-energy reduction from the two measured proxies using a coefficient-swept memory-energy model. Across 29 detectors on 12 driving datasets, 5 occupancy models, and 5 segmentation networks, MotiMem-Omega retains about 90% of detection mean average precision, 91% of vulnerable-road-user recall, over 98% of occupancy accuracy, and the strongest segmentation retention among energy-reducing methods. It reduces front-camera bit-1 density by 52%, corresponding to a modeled memory-interface energy reduction near 36%, with a lower end of 27% under the literature coefficient sweep. It also gives higher retention than the baseline and energy-matched truncation at the same or lower bit-1 density, whereas image codecs preserve accuracy without reducing memory-interface energy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了MotiMem-Omega，一种面向自动驾驶车辆相机帧流的语义感知型内存接口编码器，在节能的同时最大限度保持感知准确性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆在感知前需要将高分辨率摄像头图像传入内存，这一过程因比特分布和总线切换消耗大量能量。传统压缩方法难以在保持关键区域感知（如行人和骑行者安全）的同时有效节能，因此需要新方法优化能源与感知间的平衡。
AI.method: MotiMem-Omega通过识别图像中语义重要区域（如行人、骑行者）和不重要区域（如天空、背景），为每块图像分配不同的数据保真度。通过跨数据集的比特敏感度分析确定各语义类别的权重，并根据综合能耗—失真代价为每块选择精度等级。此外利用自车位姿时，结合运动补偿机制跨帧保护关键区域。最终使用模型对节能效果做估算。
AI.result: 在12个驾驶数据集、29个检测器、5个占用模型及5个分割网络上的测试显示，MotiMem-Omega在保持90%检测mAP、91%弱势道路使用者召回率和98%以上占用精度的同时，前摄像头的bit-1密度降低52%，估算内存接口能耗降低27%-36%。
AI.conclusion: MotiMem-Omega在不显著影响感知的前提下，有效减少了自动驾驶车辆感知链路中的内存接口能耗，超过了传统截断和通用图像压缩方法。对高安全敏感区域给予了加权保护，显示出良好的工程实用价值。

title: Intelligent Identification and Repair of Design Defects in BIM via Domain-Specific Large Language Models
summary: Existing methods lack a generalized approach to efficiently identify and resolve the diversity of design defects in BIM. Therefore, this study proposes an integrated framework to identify and repair various defects in BIM via domain-specific LLMs. Firstly, a BIM-to-Text method with component-balanced chunking is introduced to bridge BIM data with LLMs. Then, prompt learning with rule injection, few-shot prompting and RAG is proposed to identify defects and generate repair suggestions. Meanwhile, a hallucination control strategy combining key identifier validation and token-length thresholds is introduced to ensure reliability. Experiments show capability expansion yields 85% identification accuracy versus 70% for traditional rule checking, achieving a 94% rate of reasonable repair suggestions. Moreover, the proposed hallucination control further increased accuracy from 64% to 85%, eliminating 92.5% of hallucinations in a single intervention round. This study establishes an end-to-end prototype from raw BIM data input, through defect identification, to repair suggestion generation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于领域大模型的BIM缺陷识别与修复一体化框架，实现了从原始BIM数据到缺陷识别及修复建议自动生成。
AI.motivation: 当前方法缺乏通用高效地识别与修复BIM设计缺陷的能力，亟需更智能的自动化方案。
AI.method: 1）提出BIM-to-Text方法及组件均衡分块技术，将BIM数据转为文本供LLM处理；2）利用规则注入、少样本提示、RAG实现缺陷识别与修复建议生成；3）引入结合关键标识符验证与Token长度阈值的幻觉控制策略，保证结果可靠。
AI.result: 所提框架使缺陷识别准确率由传统方法的70%提升至85%，修复建议合理率达94%；幻觉控制策略使准确率从64%升至85%，单轮介入消除92.5%的幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了从BIM原始输入、缺陷识别到修复建议生成的端到端原型，为BIM设计智能质检提供高效通用解决方案。

title: Multi-Agent Self-Improving Reinforcement Learning for Video Reasoning
summary: Video reasoning tasks such as grounded video question answering and temporal grounding require selecting temporal evidence that supports the query. In many current training setups, temporal supervision is applied through local objectives such as boundary regression or span generation, while verification is used mainly to rerank candidate segments at inference time. We study whether a frozen verifier can also guide training. Our multi-agent framework couples a trainable \emph{Grounder} with a frozen \emph{Verifier}: the Grounder samples candidate trajectories and evidence segments, the Verifier assigns query-conditioned segment scores, a group-relative policy-gradient objective favors trajectories that outperform their within-input peers, and a bootstrapped calibration loss steers temporal predictions toward verifier-preferred spans. Trained on source tasks and evaluated without target-dataset fine-tuning, a two-billion-parameter instantiation transfers zero-shot across grounded question answering, temporal grounding, and long-video question answering, reaching 28.7\% intersection-over-union and 25.4\% answer-grounding accuracy on a grounded-question-answering benchmark, 46.1\% intersection-over-union on a temporal-grounding benchmark, and 54.1\% on a long-video question-answering benchmark. Relative to a strong same-scale baseline, the gains are modest but consistent, with the clearest improvements on relevance-oriented metrics such as intersection-over-union and moderate-overlap recall. Within the tested benchmarks and transfer setting, the results support frozen verification as a training signal for evidence selection, while showing that strict boundary precision remains comparatively weaker. Code and models are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MASIRL-E50C/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合了训练型Grounder与冻结型Verifier的多智能体框架，旨在提升视频推理任务中证据片段的选择与泛化能力。实验显示该方法在多个基准任务上零样本迁移表现稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有视频推理任务多通过局部目标（如边界回归、区间生成）进行时序监督，Verifier工具仅在推理阶段对候选片段排序，未能充分用于训练指导。作者希望探索冻结Verifier能否在训练中有效提升证据选择能力及任务泛化性。
AI.method: 提出多智能体框架：可训练的Grounder产生候选片段，冻结的Verifier根据查询打分。采用群体相对的策略梯度目标和自举校准损失指导训练，促使模型偏向Verifier认可的片段。在多个任务源数据上训练，无需在目标数据集上微调直接迁移评测。
AI.result: 两亿参数的实现模型针对不同任务（视频问答、时序定位、长视频问答）的零样本迁移分别取得了28.7% IOU/25.4%答题证据准确率、46.1% IOU和54.1%等成绩。与同尺度基线相比，提升虽不大但连贯，对如IOU等相关性指标改善最显著。
AI.conclusion: 冻结Verifier作为训练信号可有效指导证据选择，实现泛化性能提升，但对于边界精确度的提高效果有限。相关代码与模型已开源。

title: A Degradation-Tolerance Benchmark for Camera-Only End-to-End Driving
summary: Camera-only end-to-end (E2E) driving models are nearing deployment, where the camera stream is degraded by blur, noise, low light, weather, frame loss, and memory faults. How much a policy tolerates before its driving breaks is unclear. Corruption-robustness benchmarks target detection or bird's-eye-view perception, not the planning output that drives the car. We present DriveDegrade, a benchmark for image-degradation tolerance in camera-only E2E driving. Sixteen corruption families at five severities are injected on the fly inside the image loader, one operator reaching fifteen policies, and we evaluate open-loop planning on nuScenes and NAVSIM plus a CARLA closed-loop anchor. First, mild degradation barely affects planning, and the families that break it have a clear threshold at mid severity. Second, fragility is corruption-dependent: blur, JPEG, and raindrop damage planning most, while weather and bit error are tolerated far into the range. Third, a flat curve is ambiguous, so we separate corruptions that degrade the image from those that remove it. A planner that reads its camera must lose accuracy when information is deleted, whatever it does under quality loss. On these two axes the planners separate sharply, quantifying the ego-status shortcut without mistaking indifference for robustness. A released vision-language-action planner is flat on both axes, and blinding all six of its cameras costs it only 11.5 percent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DriveDegrade基准，用于评估摄像头端到端（E2E）自动驾驶模型在各种图像退化下的规划输出鲁棒性。研究发现，轻微退化影响有限，但某些退化如模糊、JPEG压缩和雨滴显著损害模型性能，不同退化类型对模型脆弱性影响有明显差异。本文还指出，评估方法需区分图像质量下降和图像信息丢失两种情况，以更准确衡量鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶模型鲁棒性评测主要关注检测或鸟瞰感知，缺乏针对决策输出（驱动车辆的实际规划结果）的评测方法。且在实际应用中，摄像头输入往往受到多种退化影响，其对规划性能的极限容忍度尚不清楚。为此，作者提出了新的评测基准以量化这类影响。
AI.method: 作者设计了DriveDegrade基准，将16类图像腐蚀（退化）运算在图片加载时动态植入，并设有五个等级的退化严重度，分别作用于15个驾驶策略。评测涵盖nuScenes和NAVSIM数据集的open-loop（非闭环）规划，以及CARLA仿真的闭环实验，对规划结果做量化分析。
AI.result: 1）轻度图像退化对规划影响很小，部分退化类型在中度后有明确性能断崖。2）模型对不同退化类型的脆弱性差异显著，如模糊、JPEG压缩和雨滴最为致命，天气退化和比特错误可以容忍很大范围。3）一些方法在图像完全丢失时仍有一定性能，表明存在‘自车状态捷径’现象。
AI.conclusion: DriveDegrade基准能有效区分因图像质量降低与信息丢失导致的鲁棒性差异，从而揭示评估端到端驾驶模型的关键脆弱点，并为今后的鲁棒性提升方法和真实驾驶场景部署提供实际指导。

title: Enabling Proactive Spoken Turns via a Generalized Style-Aware Full-Duplex Framework
summary: Compared with half-duplex dialogue systems where the system waits for user turn completion before it responds, natural full-duplex dialogue systems require agents to act proactively in real time, including timely interruptions and backchannels. This creates a key challenge: improving turn timing without sacrificing response quality. To address limitations in realistic proactive turn-taking, we build a generalized style-aware full-duplex framework with three key components. Firstly, we propose LPS-TC, a Lightweight Proactive Speech Turn Controller for plug-and-play integration. It features a fine-grained action space covering both reactive and proactive turn behaviors, enabling half-duplex models with full-duplex capabilities and enhancing existing full-duplex models with superior timing control. Secondly, we construct WildTurn, a large-scale, real-world English dataset containing approximately 2,981 hours of filtered multi-turn stereo conversations from face-to-face and telephone conversations, annotated with five turn-taking and five backchanneling styles. Trained on WildTurn, LPS-TC exhibits rich spoken dynamics that are not captured by existing static full-duplex benchmarks. Thirdly, we introduce a two-tier evaluation scheme that assesses both chunk-level timing precision and turn-level interaction quality under realistic streaming constraints. Our experiments, integrating LPS-TC with half-duplex models like Qwen2.5-Omni and full-duplex models like Freeze-Omni, showcase its superior performance in timing appropriateness and response quality. Our framework also demonstrates fine-grained style controllability and strong generalizability, enabling more natural and human-like spoken interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种通用的、风格感知的全双工对话系统框架，包括轻量级主动语音轮换控制器LPS-TC和大规模真实英语数据集WildTurn，显著提升了对话时序控制和响应质量。
AI.motivation: 当前的全双工对话系统在实现类人自然对话（如实时打断、附和等主动行为）的时序把控与响应质量之间存在权衡，亟需改进现有方法以提升主动轮换的真实性和交互流畅度。
AI.method: 1. 提出LPS-TC：轻量级主动语音轮换控制器，可即插即用，具备涵盖多种轮换与主动行为的细粒度操作空间，可扩展至半双工及全双工模型；2. 构建WildTurn数据集，包含约2981小时现实多轮立体英语对话，标注丰富的轮换与附和风格；3. 采用双层评测方法，分别评估对话块级时序精度和轮换级交互质量。
AI.result: LPS-TC与Qwen2.5-Omni（半双工）及Freeze-Omni（全双工）等多模型集成测试，展现出更优的时序适配及响应质量，同时在风格可控性和泛化能力上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 文中框架实现在时序把控、响应质量与风格可控性上的多项提升，为发展更自然、更具类人特征的全双工对话系统提供了有力方案。

title: Automated pipeline for herbarium label digitization
summary: Digitized herbarium collections, now comprising over 100 million freely accessible specimen images, have become a critical resource for addressing fundamental questions in ecology and evolutionary biology. Yet the rich metadata encoded in herbarium labels (collector identities, geographic localities, collection dates, and ecological observations) remains largely inaccessible at scale, constraining both biodiversity informatics and the construction of specimen-specific image-text corpora for multimodal AI. We present HERBIOME, a modular end-to-end pipeline for automated herbarium label digitization, integrating YOLOv8-based component detection, CRAFT Hezar word-level text localization, fine-tuned TrOCR for recognition of mixed handwritten and printed text, and GPT-4o Mini for semantic metadata structuring into standardized fields. TrOCR was trained on a multi-source dataset combining general transcription corpora (CREMMA-AN, PictoCatalogs) with herbarium-specific data (RéColNat), achieving a Character Error Rate of 4.05-4.10%. End-to-end evaluation on 450 French herbarium specimens, using a dual-metric framework of Maximum Window Similarity (MWS: 0.614-0.618) and Semantic Metadata Accuracy (SMA: 0.440-0.445), reveals that hybrid training strategies improve semantic fidelity while random sampling maximizes surface similarity, with taxonomic fields remaining the principal bottleneck. By automating the extraction of structured metadata from complex, heterogeneous labels, HERBIOME reduces transcription burden, enables the construction of paired image-text datasets that faithfully capture specimen individuality, which is a prerequisite for next-generation multimodal biodiversity AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HERBIOME，一个用于自动化数字化与结构化植物标本馆标签信息的端到端流水线系统，结合了多种先进的图像识别、文本检测和语义解析技术，显著提升了标本馆标签的批量信息获取效率。
AI.motivation: 尽管植物标本馆已数字化了亿级标本图像，但标签中蕴含的重要元数据（收集者、地理位置、日期及生态观察等）大多尚未结构化提取，严重制约了生物多样性信息学研究以及图像-文本多模态AI训练集的构建。
AI.method: HERBIOME系统整合了YOLOv8用于组件检测、CRAFT Hezar进行单词级文本定位、微调版TrOCR兼容手写与印刷体文本识别，以及GPT-4o Mini进行标签语义元数据标准化。TrOCR训练结合了多种通用及专用转录数据集，以提升识别率。评估体系采用了最大窗口相似度（MWS）和语义元数据准确率（SMA）两项指标。
AI.result: 在450份法国植物标本测试中，TrOCR识别字符错误率为4.05-4.10%；MWS达到0.614-0.618，SMA为0.440-0.445。实验显示，混合训练策略可提升语义准确性，随机采样能优化表面相似度，但分类学字段的结构化仍是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: HERBIOME显著降低了大规模标本标签转录工作负担，实现复杂异构标签元数据的自动结构化和配对数据集构建，为多模态生物多样性AI系统奠定了基础。

title: Teaching Robot Policies to Humans Using Erroneous Examples
summary:
Human-robot collaboration describes the process of humans and autonomous agents working together to accomplish common goals. This process is facilitated best when robot policies, or behaviors in different situations, are made transparent to humans. Demonstration-based explanations have been a focus of human-robot collaboration research, and the field has frequently drawn upon literature from education to improve how humans are taught robot policies. However, no single teaching method has been proven effective across domains, difficulties, learners, and other variables; the question of how humans can most effectively be taught robot policies remains open.
  In traditional classrooms, learners are shown erroneous examples, in which they reflect on and correct incorrect responses to understand common pitfalls when learning a concept. We propose using erroneous examples to teach robot policies, extending an existing policy teaching framework. We conduct a user study in which participants view incorrect demonstrations of robot behavior and correct the actions to align with the actual policy. Our findings suggest that viewing these incorrect demonstrations and verbalizing one's reasoning in predicting a robot's actions improves retention of the policy over time, in agreement with the effect of erroneous examples in classrooms. We also categorize participants into distinct learning styles and establish that participants using inverse reinforcement learning-like reasoning perform best on policy prediction tasks. With this work, we aim to advance the methods by which robots educate humans on their policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过让人类纠正机器人错误示范来提升人机协作中的政策学习效果，实验证明了该方法对记忆和理解机器人的行为有帮助。
AI.motivation: 尽管演示式讲解已广泛用于人机协作领域，但还没有跨领域、难度和学习者普适有效的教学方法，如何最有效地教人类理解机器人政策仍是未解之题。
AI.method: 借鉴课堂教学中“错误示范”法，将错误示范引入机器人政策教学。通过用户实验，参试者观看机器人的错误行为示范，并纠正其行为以符合实际策略，同时对机器人行为进行推理和解释。
AI.result: 研究发现，纠正机器人错误动作并通过口头推理能提升人类对机器人政策的长期记忆与理解。另外，采用类似逆向强化学习方式思考的参试者，在政策预测任务中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 将“错误示范”法用于机器人政策教学提高了人类对机器人行为的理解，为机器人向人类讲解自身政策提供了新方法和理论依据。

title: PAUSE: Editable Strategy Artifacts for Long-Form Cultural Story Adaptation
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Culture x AI: Evaluating AI as a Cultural Technology, ICML 2026. Project page: https://abdur75648.github.io/pause/
summary: Generative AI systems increasingly mediate cultural adaptation, but their cultural decisions are often hidden inside prompts, transient model plans, or final prose. We study PAUSE (Pause-And-Update Strategy Editing), an intervention that exposes an editable adaptation strategy as a human control surface for cultural decisions in long-form story adaptation. The strategy is a structured artifact that can be inspected, edited, and then projected through downstream character, entity, and chapter-localization stages. In two Chinese-source serialized novels, we test whether human edits to this strategy propagate into chapter-level prose. Across 9 edited-vs-control chapter comparisons, judges select the edited-strategy output in all 9; a marker audit shows target markers in 8/9 edited outputs and 0/9 controls, with forbidden markers absent from edited outputs and present in all controls. We frame these results as a smoke-scale edit-adherence study, not a claim that the outputs are culturally authoritative or literary-quality improvements. PAUSE offers one practical way to make AI-mediated cultural adaptation more inspectable and contestable before decisions propagate through long-form generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为PAUSE（暂停并更新策略编辑）的干预方法，使文化适配过程中的决策更加透明、可编辑，提升了大语言模型在长篇小说文化适配中的可控性。
AI.motivation: 伴随生成式AI越来越多地参与到文化适配过程中，相关的文化决策往往隐藏于提示语、模型内部计划或输出文本中，难以被用户检查和控控。因此需要找到能够暴露且允许编辑文化决策过程的方法。
