AI.method: 作者提出了PAUSE方法，将文化适配策略暴露为结构化且人可编辑的工件，并测试人在策略层对其编辑如何影响下游的长篇小说章节生成。评估方法是在两部中文连载小说实验中，比较编辑组和对照组生成的9个章节输出，并由评审打分。
AI.result: 评审在全部9次对比中都选中了编辑策略组的输出；指标审查显示，8/9的编辑策略输出含有目标特征，且没有违禁特征，对照组无一个命中目标特征，全部都含有违禁特征。
AI.conclusion: PAUSE方法能提升AI文化适配决策的可检查性与可争议性，使长文本生成前的适配策略更容易被人类介入，尽管并未宣称输出具有文化权威或文学质量提升。

title: Evaluating Constrained Iterative Refinement for Scalable Vector Graphics Generation with Off-the-Shelf VLMs
comment: Accepted to Pacific Graphics 2026 Poster Track. 2 Pages. 2 Figures. 1 Table
summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVGs) power much of the modern visual ecosystem, yet state-of-the-art generative models focus almost entirely on rasterized images. We explore whether inference-time methods can unlock SVG generation capabilities in off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs). We systematically evaluate a constrained iterative refinement harness that combines visual feedback, structured editing, and constrained decoding to characterize the capabilities and limitations of current VLMs for SVG generation. Across multiple VLMs and generation settings, we find that constrained decoding improves compilation success rates, while iterative refinement reveals a deficit in visual reasoning and self-correction. Our results highlight both the promise and current limitations of using inference-time methods to adapt general-purpose VLMs for SVG generation.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了能否通过推理阶段的方法，使通用视觉-语言模型（VLMs）具备生成SVG矢量图的能力，评估了多种方法提升VLM生成SVG的表现，并分析了其优缺点。
AI.motivation: 虽然SVG矢量图广泛应用于现代视觉系统，但现有生成模型主要针对光栅图片，鲜有关注SVG生成。因此，作者希望探索现有VLM是否能通过推理阶段的技术生成SVG，并明确其潜力与不足。
AI.method: 作者提出并评估了一种受约束的迭代精细化方法（constrained iterative refinement harness），结合视觉反馈、结构化编辑和受约束解码。使用该方法在不同VLM和生成配置下进行系统性实验，以测试其对SVG生成的能力提升。
AI.result: 实验发现，受约束解码可以显著提高生成SVG代码的编译成功率，但迭代精细化过程中，VLM在视觉推理和自我纠错能力方面表现不足。
AI.conclusion: 利用推理阶段的方法可在一定程度上提升通用VLM生成SVG的能力，但当前依然存在明显的局限性。未来需要进一步提升VLM的视觉推理和自纠错能力，以适用于SVG等结构化视觉内容生成。

title: DREAM: Deployment-Time Demonstration Generation via Real-to-Sim for Scalable Policy Adaptation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made strong progress in language-conditioned robot manipulation, but improving their performance in a new workspace still often requires action-labeled data from that environment. Collecting such data by human teleoperation is costly, especially when each workspace, object arrangement, or task may require new demonstrations. We present DREAM, a framework that generates fine-tuning data for a pretrained VLA from a captured workspace and a language instruction, without requiring a task-specific human demonstration. DREAM reconstructs the workspace, automatically translates the instruction into symbolic task goals and success criteria using a large language model, and uses task-and-motion planning to generate feasible robot trajectories. The planned trajectories are augmented across randomized object configurations, verified by the generated success criteria, and rendered into image-action examples for VLA fine-tuning. Through real-robot experiments on language-conditioned manipulation tasks, we study whether DREAM can serve as a scalable data-collection system for the deployment workspace by examining whether fine-tuning on its automatically generated data improves success over direct deployment and how its data-collection cost compares with human teleoperation when adapting a VLA to a new workspace.

AI.tldr: DREAM提出了一种无需人工演示、自动生成机器人操作微调数据的方法，通过对工作空间重建及任务规划，提升VLA模型在新环境中的适应性。
AI.motivation: 当前基于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）的机器人操作模型在新工作空间中的适应仍然依赖人工标注动作数据，导致成本高、效率低。急需降低对人工演示的依赖，实现VLA模型自动且高效地适应新场景。
AI.method: 提出DREAM框架，通过重建工作空间、利用大语言模型将指令转化为符号化任务目标及成功标准，并结合任务-动作规划自动生成可行的机器人轨迹。之后对轨迹进行对象配置随机化增强，并验证其成功性，将生成的数据转为图片-动作对供VLA微调使用。
AI.result: 通过真实机器人操作实验，DREAM生成的数据可有效提升VLA模型在新工作空间的操作成功率，优于直接迁移；同时，所需的数据收集成本明显低于人工远程操作。
AI.conclusion: DREAM为VLA模型在新环境下的快速适应提供了可扩展、成本低的数据生成方案，可大幅降低人工演示依赖，为机器人操作场景的落地部署带来显著价值。

title: Do MLLMs Really Understand Low-Resource Khmer Documents? A Pilot Study on Khmer Document VQA
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced document understanding, visual question answering, and text extraction. However, their reliability in low-resource, non-Latin settings remains uncertain. Khmer form documents present particular challenges because they contain complex script forms, mixed Khmer-English fields, and monetary values in both Cambodian Riel and US Dollars. Available resources for Khmer Document VQA are also limited. This paper presents a pilot diagnostic evaluation of open MLLMs on Khmer document images. We construct an evaluation subset from the previously introduced KH-FUNSD collection, covering invoices, receipts, quotations, and other business forms. The subset includes questions in English and Khmer, with answers retained in their original English, Khmer, mixed-script, or numeric forms. Rather than introducing a full public benchmark, this study examines the capabilities and failure modes of existing models. We evaluate representative open Qwen-VL models using direct image-based prompting and compare parser-assisted and external OCR-assisted configurations with Qwen3-VL-8B. Direct Qwen3-VL-8B outperforms smaller models, achieving 51.9% overall accuracy, although performance remains limited for Khmer-script and mixed-script answers. External OCR produces the strongest results, reaching 61.9% with Tesseract and 61.6% with PaddleOCR. Nevertheless, Khmer-script answers remain substantially more difficult than English and numeric fields. The results indicate that current MLLMs can process visually clear English and structured numeric content, but reliable native Khmer document understanding remains an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在低资源高棘手性的高棉文（柬埔寨语）文档问答任务中的表现和局限性。以KH-FUNSD数据集子集对Qwen-VL模型及OCR融合方式进行了实验分析。
AI.motivation: 虽然MLLMs在英文、结构化文档处理和VQA任务上取得进展，但其在低资源、非拉丁文字环境（如高棉语）下的能力尚不明朗。特别是包含复杂脚本、英高文混合、多币种的高棉文表单识别与理解缺乏有效评测，对实际应用存在很大障碍。
AI.method: 作者基于KH-FUNSD中选取发票、收据、报价单等商业表单，制作英高问答子集，答案含英、高棉语、混合文本与数字。分别测试Qwen-VL系列模型，并比较原生视觉输入、带解析器与外部OCR集成三种配置，分析模型回答准确性及常见失效模式。
AI.result: Qwen3-VL-8B直接视觉输入准确率达51.9%，优于小模型。结合Tesseract或PaddleOCR的外部OCR提升至61.9%和61.6%。但对高棉文字及混合答案的表现显著低于英文与数字。
AI.conclusion: 当前MLLMs在结构化英文和数字类内容处理上具备潜力，对高棉复杂脚本与混合域能力依然不足。高棉场景下的多模态文档理解是未解挑战，需进一步研究针对高棉等低资源语种的优化方法。

title: Multi-Sensor Mapping of Vulnerable Urban Settlements Using SAR, Multispectral, and Hyperspectral Imagery: A Case Study in Córdoba, Argentina
comment: Submitted to IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing
summary: Informal settlements represent a major urban challenge in rapidly expanding cities, yet their identification from Earth Observation (EO) data remains difficult because of their heterogeneous appearance and incomplete official inventories. This work presents a multi-sensor deep learning (DL) framework for slum-likelihood mapping in Córdoba, Argentina, integrating high-resolution PlanetScope multispectral (MS) imagery, COSMO-SkyMed (CSK) Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data, and medium-resolution PRISMA hyperspectral (HS) observations. The problem is formulated as a patch-level classification task using the official Registro Nacional de Barrios Populares (ReNaBaP) inventory as reference, and the models are evaluated through four geographically partitioned folds. SAR-only and MS-only baselines, their configurations with PRISMA HS support, and early fusion (EF), middle fusion (MF), and late fusion (LF) strategies are systematically compared. Results show that LF+HS provides the best overall balance between classification performance and spatial selectivity, while PRISMA contributes complementary spectral information alongside the higher-resolution MS and SAR representations. Beyond the standard evaluation against ReNaBaP, an external municipal vulnerability layer is used to interpret detections outside the official polygons, showing that several apparent false positives overlap broader vulnerable urban areas. Thermal analysis further shows that ReNaBaP settlements exhibit significantly higher surface temperatures than their immediate surroundings during a heatwave event, indicating localised surface-heat amplification. Taken together, these results suggest that multi-sensor EO fusion can support both the mapping of ReNaBaP settlements and the interpretation of broader urban vulnerability patterns.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种融合多种遥感数据的深度学习框架，用于更有效地识别城市非正规住区（如贫民窟），并提升贫困和脆弱地区的空间解析能力。
AI.motivation: 非正规住区在快速扩张的城市中普遍存在，官方数据不全且外观异质，利用地球观测数据自动识别难度大。亟需方法提升其识别准确性和对城市脆弱性格局的解释力。
AI.method: 集成了三个遥感源（高分辨率PlanetScope多光谱，COSMO-SkyMed合成孔径雷达，PRISMA中分辨率高光谱），用官方ReNaBaP清单构造补丁级分类任务。系统比较了不同传感器、不同融合策略（早期/中期/晚期融合）在四个地理分区的表现。还结合热异常分析和外部城市脆弱性图层，验证落在官方边界外的检测点合理性。
AI.result: 晚期融合（LF）结合高光谱（HS）信息实现了最佳的分类性能与空间区分度。多源融合发现部分“假阳性”实际对应更大范围的城市脆弱区。热浪期间，这些非正规住区地表温度显著高于周边区域。
AI.conclusion: 多传感器地球观测融合方案不仅能提升非正规住区的识别效果，也有助于理解更广泛的城市贫困与脆弱性格局。

title: GHOST in the Robots: Real-Time Exocentric Dual-Robot VR Teleoperation from Onboard Cameras
summary: Teleoperating multiple robots simultaneously enables additional views and coordinated control. Yet, it poses fundamental challenges: the system must present sensor data cohesively and allow operators to manage multiple robot bases, arms, and cameras while maintaining low latency. Current multi-robot teleoperation systems require multiple operators, rely on autonomy, or restrict operators to high-level commands. We present GHOST: an open-source VR teleoperation system that enables single operator control of two mobile manipulators via direct lowlevel commands using only onboard sensing. GHOST creates an exocentric 3D workspace by aligning real-time point clouds from the robots' RGB-D cameras, where scene coverage is improved through learning-based completion to aid operator spatial awareness. For control, the operator uses a mode-switching architecture to command either robot individually or both robots simultaneously. Experiments with 15 novice participants demonstrate 1.6-4x the success rate of an off-the-shelf tablet interface. For experts across nine challenging dual-robot tasks, our system enabled completion of two tasks that were infeasible with the tablet, and was 1.47x faster on average than the tablet. Website and code: https://h2r.github.io/GHOST/.

AI.tldr: GHOST是一个面向多机器人远程操作的开源虚拟现实系统，允许单一操作者通过低层次命令同时控制两台移动机械臂，性能和操作效率优于传统平板界面。
AI.motivation: 目前多机器人远程操作需要多个操作者、过度依赖自治或只允许高层命令，致使操作灵活性和效率受限。研究希望让单个操作者能够通过直观方式高效控制多机器人，提高整体操作能力。
AI.method: GHOST通过虚拟现实将多台机器人RGB-D相机的点云实时融合，构建三维外部观察场，利用学习型点云补全方法提升场景覆盖和操作者空间感知。操作者可通过模式切换架构独立或同步控制两台机器人，实现低延迟、低层次的实时操作。
AI.result: 新手参与者使用GHOST系统的任务成功率为现有平板系统的1.6至4倍。专家用户在9项复杂双机器人任务中，GHOST使两项平板无法完成的任务得以实现，且平均速度提升1.47倍。
AI.conclusion: GHOST有效提升了单操作者多机器人远程操作的效率和能力，是目前性能优越的开源解决方案，对实际应用与后续相关研究具有积极意义。

title: PromptKWS: A Novel Prompt-Guided Open-Vocabulary Keyword Spotting Framework
summary: In this paper, we present PromptKWS, a novel Prompt-guided keyword spotting (KWS) framework to improve the accuracy of open vocabulary KWS systems. In specific terms, we introduce the Prompt Phrases Prediction Network (PPN), an encoder-decoder architecture designed to effectively extract keyword prompts embeddings. we employ the PPN encoder to encode the keyword prompts and infuse the prompt embedding into the Prompt-guided KWS encoder by utilizing a Prompt-acoustic Multi-head Cross-attention (MHCA). Experiments show that PromptKWS improves the wakeup rate by over 10% compared to baseline system. Notably, another strength of PromptKWS is its ability to effectively leverage keyword prompts for adapting to complex real-world environments involving noise and pronunciation variations. In comparison to purely acoustic models, which often struggle in such situations, PromptKWS demonstrates remarkable performance, with an average accuracy improvement of over 15% in test sets.

AI.tldr: PromptKWS提出了一种利用提示词的关键词唤醒系统，通过新的网络结构显著提升了在复杂环境下的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇的关键词唤醒系统在噪声和发音变化等复杂现实环境下表现不佳，需要新的方法提升准确率和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的PromptKWS框架，引入了Prompt Phrases Prediction Network（PPN）编码-解码结构，用于高效地提取提示词嵌入。通过多头交叉注意力（MHCA）将提示嵌入信息引入唤醒模型，改善对关键词的识别能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，PromptKWS相比基线系统唤醒率提升超过10%，在包含噪声和发音变化的复杂环境下，平均准确率提升超过15%。
AI.conclusion: PromptKWS能够有效融合提示词信息，大幅提升开放词汇关键词唤醒系统在复杂场景下的适应能力和准确率。

title: CARD: Calibration via Agreement in Reverse Diffusion for Out-of-Domain MRI Segmentation
summary: Probability calibration aligns model confidence with predictive accuracy, enabling clinicians to identify unreliable segmentation regions. This alignment breaks down under domain shift, where artifacts and unseen protocols produce confident errors. Existing post-hoc methods adapt the correction at test time, conditioning on predictive entropy, the logit pattern, or augmentation response, but each proxy is read from the terminal prediction, the very quantity that shift corrupts. This motivates reliability evidence beyond the terminal prediction, which categorical diffusion provides in two ways. First, a generative shape prior keeps a capacity-limited reference intact when appearance is corrupted, so its disagreement with the primary segmentor highlights primary-model errors. Second, every reverse step yields a class distribution, separating persistent disagreement from transient discrepancy. Aggregated over the trajectory, this disagreement correlates with Dice at 0.788, against 0.521 for a matched discriminative control. We therefore propose CARD (Calibration via Agreement in Reverse Diffusion), which maps the temporal aggregate of this disagreement to a temperature field applied per pixel across all classes, so that confidence changes while the segmentation does not. Across cardiac, prostate and brain MRI shifts, CARD lowers calibration error in 45 of 49 comparisons against the strongest baseline in each setting.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于反向扩散分歧聚合的概率校准新方法CARD，能有效应对医学分割中由于领域偏移带来的置信度失真问题。
AI.motivation: 医学分割模型在领域偏移（如不同伪影、协议）时预测置信度易与实际准确率脱节，导致难以识别不可靠区域，现有后处理校准方法效果受限。
AI.method: 引入扩散生成型模型作为形状先验并与主分割器输出进行持续分歧比较，分歧轨迹聚合后回归至温度场，调整每像素置信度（不改变分割结果），形成CARD算法，可跨多类别及不同MRI类型应用。
AI.result: CARD方法在心脏、前列腺、大脑多种MRI领域偏移数据集上，对比最强基线，49个实验中有45次显著降低了模型校准误差。
AI.conclusion: 基于反向扩散分歧聚合的CARD方法相比现有技术能在领域偏移下更好地校准分割模型置信度，提升模型在实际医学图像中的可靠性。

title: Agri-Sim: Agricultural Simulation Platform for Embodied Intelligence Evaluation in Greenhouse Robotics
summary: Agricultural-robot development requires simulation environments that can jointly support realistic scene construction, virtual sensing, autonomous navigation, motion planning, and manipulation-task execution. This paper presents Agri-Sim, a Unity and ROS2-based simulation platform for the closed-loop development and functional evaluation of agricultural robots. The platform contains a configurable tomato-greenhouse environment, a mobile dual-arm harvesting robot, virtual RGB-D, LiDAR, IMU, and joint sensors, and a bidirectional communication interface between Unity and ROS2. Unity is responsible for scene rendering, rigid-body dynamics, collision detection, virtual sensing, and task-state execution, whereas ROS2 and MoveIt 2 provide localization, navigation, collision-aware motion planning, inverse kinematics, and trajectory generation. Autonomous greenhouse navigation and dual-arm tomato harvesting were used to evaluate the complete simulation workflow. The experiments covered virtual sensor publication, ROS2-based navigation, collision-aware motion planning, mobile-base control, tomato acquisition, inter-arm handover, and box placement. The results demonstrate that Agri-Sim supports closed-loop integration and repeatable functional evaluation of navigation and manipulation workflows in a controlled virtual greenhouse, providing a practical foundation for subsequent algorithm development and Sim-to-Real studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Agri-Sim，一个基于Unity和ROS2的农用机器人仿真平台，能够支持番茄温室中移动双臂机器人进行自主导航与采摘等任务，并实现闭环流程的可复现评估。
AI.motivation: 传统农业机器人开发缺乏能够支持拟真环境建模、虚拟传感、自主导航和操作任务一体化的新型仿真平台，极大限制了闭环开发和测试的效率与可靠性。
AI.method: 搭建了包含可配置番茄温室场景、移动双臂采摘机器人、虚拟传感器（RGB-D、LiDAR、IMU等），以及Unity与ROS2的双向通信接口的Agri-Sim平台。Unity负责场景渲染、物理仿真、传感与状态控制；ROS2与MoveIt 2负责定位、导航、避障运动规划与轨迹生成，并集成任务执行。以温室自主导航与双臂采摘番茄任务作为评测实例。
AI.result: 实验证明，Agri-Sim平台能够支持虚拟传感数据发布、基于ROS2的导航、避障运动规划、移动底盘与双臂协作采摘、手臂间物品交付及装箱等完整功能的闭环仿真与流程复现。
AI.conclusion: Agri-Sim为农业机器人导航与操作算法的闭环集成、功能可重复评估以及后续仿真到现实（Sim-to-Real）研究提供了实用基础。

title: Terminal-Bench-LILT: Multilingual Agentic Coding Benchmark Grounded in Language, Region, and Culture
summary: Most evaluations for coding agents are conducted exclusively in English, which does not reflect real-world multilingual deployment. We present Terminal-Bench-LILT, a suite of 300 authentic coding tasks in ten languages: Arabic, Czech, German, Spanish, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Serbian, Turkish, and Chinese. Each task targets issues specific to non-English software development that have no direct English equivalent, e.g., internationalization, encoding, text normalization, and cultural conventions. All tasks are authored by native-speaker programmers and validated through a multi-stage quality control pipeline. Evaluation of six frontier models reveals that even the strongest model reaches only 63.1\% pass rate, with many tasks unsolved by any model. Performance varies substantially by language and does not track general coding benchmark rankings, highlighting that multilingual coding competence is a distinct and underexplored capability axis. Sample tasks are available at https://github.com/lilt/terminal-bench-lilt

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Terminal-Bench-LILT，这是一个包含10种语言、300道人为真实编程任务的多语言编程评测基准。
AI.motivation: 当前主流编程智能体评测几乎都只用英文，但现实世界的软件开发愈发多语言，现有评测体系无法反映真实部署的需求。
AI.method: 构建了一个涵盖阿拉伯语、捷克语、德语、西班牙语、印地语、日语、韩语、塞尔维亚语、土耳其语和中文的多语言编码任务集。每道题均由母语程序员撰写，并采用多阶段质量管控流程验证。
AI.result: 评测了六个前沿大模型，即使最强模型通过率最高也仅为63.1%，很多任务无人模型能解。模型在不同语言上的表现差异很大，与主流英文编程基准的成绩无明显相关。
AI.conclusion: 多语言编程能力是与一般英文基准不同的、目前被低估和不足探索的重要方向。

title: Distributed Semantic Segmentation With Improved Rate-Distortion Trade-Off
summary: Distributed deep neural networks (DNNs) for dense perception tasks such as semantic segmentation execute an encoder DNN on edge devices, and a decoder DNN typically on a large-scale cloud platform with a particular constraint on transmission bitrate. Recent works employ source codecs to enable bitrate-efficient transmission between the edge device and the cloud. However, as these approaches are typically bound to a particular type of source codec and alternative network architectures are often not explored, this results in a suboptimal rate-distortion (RD) trade-off in the low-bitrate regime. In this work, we propose two novel source codecs that \textit{enable extremely low bitrates, while improving RD performance}. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed source codecs by achieving state-of-the-art performance in distributed semantic segmentation at below 0.2 (0.03) bits per pixel, measured using the mean intersection-over-union metric on ADE20K (Cityscapes).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种新颖的源编解码器，可在极低比特率下提升分布式语义分割任务的速率-失真（RD）性能，实验证明其在主流数据集上达到了最新的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前分布式DNN感知任务受限于边缘与云之间的带宽传输效率，现有方法常将网络设计绑定于特定类型的源编解码器，且缺乏对其他网络结构的探索，导致低比特率下的RD权衡表现不佳。
AI.method: 作者提出并实现了两种面向端云分布式分割任务的新型源编解码器，使得DNN特征在极低比特率下传输时能够维持更好的信息还原及分割精度。
AI.result: 所提方法在ADE20K和Cityscapes两个主流分割数据集上，分别以小于0.2和0.03 bits/pixel的码率环境下均获得了分割精度的最新最优值。
AI.conclusion: 两种新型源编解码器能够极大改善低比特率下分布式语义分割的RD性能，为后续更高效的端云智能感知系统奠定了基础。

title: From Multi-Modal Paths to Executable Trajectories: A Trajectory Planning Framework for 4WIS Robots
summary: Four-wheel independent steering (4WIS) mobile robots support multiple motion modes, offering high maneuverability in narrow and complex environments. However, existing planning methods often fail to fully exploit these capabilities, leading to suboptimal trajectory quality. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a multi-modal global trajectory planning framework that couples mode-augmented front-end search with mode-consistent segment-wise trajectory optimization. In the front-end stage, Hybrid A* is extended to a four-dimensional state space incorporating motion modes, while mode-switching-aware cost and heuristic functions embed mode decisions into the global search process. Multi-modal Reeds-Shepp curves and an intelligent terminal connection strategy are further designed to improve search efficiency. In the back-end stage, a segment-wise trajectory optimization framework based on an improved iterative safe corridor scheme is developed to convert discrete multi-modal paths into smooth, kinematically feasible trajectories with stationary mode transitions. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves the best overall performance in safety, arrival time, terminal accuracy and computation time. Real-world experiments on a physical 4WIS robot further validate the practical effectiveness and executability of the generated trajectories, providing a flexible and high-performance solution for multi-modal mobile robot trajectory planning.

AI.tldr: 本文针对四轮独立转向（4WIS）移动机器人轨迹规划提出了一套多模态全局轨迹规划框架，有效提升了轨迹质量和可操作性，并在实际机器人上验证了其实用性与性能。
AI.motivation: 4WIS机器人可以在复杂、狭窄环境下高机动性移动，但现有轨迹规划方法未充分利用其多种运动模式，导致轨迹质量不高。
AI.method: 提出将多模态引入全局规划流程：前端通过扩展Hybrid A*到四维状态空间，将运动模式决策融入全局搜索（含新的mode-aware代价函数与启发式）；采用多模态Reeds-Shepp曲线与终端连接策略提升效率。后端采用改进的分段式安全走廊轨迹优化框架，将离散多模态路径平滑、致动为可行轨迹且模式切换平稳。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在安全性、到达时间、终端精度和规划速度等方面整体表现优异。物理4WIS机器人上的现实实验进一步验证了轨迹的可执行性和实际效果。
AI.conclusion: 所提多模态轨迹规划方法灵活高效，能充分利用4WIS机器人多运动模式的优势，为多模态机器人轨迹规划提供了高性能的解决方案。

title: Redesigning and Auditing Deep Research Writing for Faithful Reports
summary: Rubric-based evaluations of deep-research (DR) systems often obscure fine-grained factual failures in generated reports. We introduce CLAIMPROBE, a claim-level audit that decomposes DR reports into claims and measures hallucination, misattribution, citation hygiene, and necessary-fact recall against retrieved evidence. Using CLAIMPROBE, we find that strong DR pipelines can omit key evidence and misattribute claims even when their rubric scores remain stable. We then propose CLAIMWRITER, a hierarchical claim-based writer that extracts source facts, maps them to a query-derived outline, and drafts each section from a source-linked claim representation. Across three prior DR frameworks, replacing only the report writer with CLAIMWRITER reduces hallucination by 2.6 to 4.5 times and improves necessary-fact recall by 1.2 to 1.7 times, while largely preserving overall report quality. CLAIMWRITER also enables localized revision: when sources change, it propagates changed source facts into revised reports at the highest rate among update methods, while also being more cost-effective.

AI.tldr: 提出了CLAIMPROBE用于细粒度评估DR系统事实错误，并设计CLAIMWRITER显著降低幻觉和提升必要事实召回。
AI.motivation: 现有深度调研（DR）系统主要依赖量表评分，这种方式无法揭示报告中具体的事实性错误。为更精确地分析和改进DR系统，作者需要一种更细粒度、可解释的评测方法。
AI.method: 论文提出CLAIMPROBE，一种按断言（claim）分解DR报告并分别评估幻觉、错误归因、引用规范性及必要事实召回的审计工具。进一步提出CLAIMWRITER，这是基于断言层次结构的生成器，将源事实映射到由查询生成的大纲，再逐节生成与源断言对应的内容。
AI.result: 在三个主流DR框架实验中，用CLAIMWRITER替换报告生成器后，幻觉问题减少2.6至4.5倍，必要事实召回提升1.2至1.7倍，且整体报告质量基本不变；CLAIMWRITER能更有效且低成本地在信息源变更时，传播事实更新到最终报告。
AI.conclusion: CLAIMPROBE和CLAIMWRITER为DR系统提供了细粒度评测和生成新范式，可减少幻觉、提升事实召回，增强报告的可追溯性和维护效率。

title: Data Diversity, Not Frequency Invariance: A Controlled and Self-Audited Study of Compression-Robust Deepfake Detection
comment: 38 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to IEEE Access. Code, per-video predictions and a claims-to-artifacts map: https://github.com/Capta1n-n9m0/cafrl-negative (v1.0.0); archival deposit: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22032529
summary: Frequency features and compression-invariant representation learning are widely assumed to be key to deepfake detection that survives video compression. We test this with CAFRL - block-DCT and FFT-phase streams, compression-level-conditioned band attention, and adversarial (gradient-reversal) compression invariance - and report a controlled negative. Under a pre-registered protocol with capacity- and augmentation-matched controls, a plain EfficientNet-B0 on multi-quality data beat CAFRL as specified at every compression level on the FaceForensics++ test split, by 3.66 AUC points at CRF 40 (paired, single seed). A self-audit of our own negative found four defects biased against the frequency hypothesis, and pre-specified re-tests repairing all four showed the deficit to be a recipe artifact, not an architecture failure: the baseline recipe recovered 3.96 points over the matching shipped-recipe variant. The frequency path made no detectable difference: discriminative alone (standalone validation AUC 0.91-0.98 late in training) but of no marginal value under this fusion, at two feature widths of one 4.0 M trunk, every seed-pooled interval for the intra-dataset compression contrasts including zero; on the single held-out manipulation tested, the fair variants sat below the plain backbone. The adversarial branch, as specified, added nothing and degraded its own conditioning estimator; at the fair recipe it is untested. Robustness under single-pass H.264 re-encoding came instead from data diversity: real constant-rate-factor variants beat synthetic JPEG augmentation by 7.3 points (single runs, non-overlapping intervals). The evidence is FaceForensics++-family, GAN-era and single-codec. Match controls on training recipe as well as capacity, and buy compression robustness with codec diversity before architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了频域特征和压缩不变表示对于检测压缩后深度伪造视频是否必要的主流观点，实验发现更简单的骨干网络和多质量原始数据集可以获得更优效果。
AI.motivation: 深度伪造检测常利用频域特征和压缩不变建模，假设能提升对压缩视频的鲁棒性。作者希望通过严格对照和自查实验证实这一假设。
AI.method: 作者提出了包含DCT和FFT相位流、压缩条件带注意力、对抗性压缩不变等多组件的检测模型CAFRL，并在FaceForensics++数据集下，与基础EfficientNet-B0、容量与增强匹配的控制组进行了系统对比和自查重测。
AI.result: 结果显示，在每个压缩等级下，基础EfficientNet-B0均优于含频域路径和对抗分支的CAFRL。自查发现实验配方偏差影响结果，修正后频域路径仍无显著作用，而真实多压缩质量比合成JPEG增强大幅提升鲁棒性。对抗压缩分支没有带来改进，反而降级相关性能。
AI.conclusion: 检测压缩鲁棒性优先应选用多压缩质量/多编码器的数据多样性，而非频域特征或复杂表示架构。架构鲁棒前先保证训练配方与数据多样。

title: CGFM-Nav: Cognitive Graph-Field Memory for Semantic-Guided Lifelong Multimodal Embodied Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to reason over accumulated observations while continuously exploring unseen regions. However, existing environment representations often struggle to jointly support explicit semantic memory and continuous exploration guidance. To address this challenge, we propose Cognitive Graph-Field Memory (CGFM), a persistent multimodal scene representation that couples explicit relational memory with continuous spatial intuition. CGFM organizes objects, spatial relations, and visual observations into a multimodal scene graph, enabling target retrieval and long-horizon reasoning across navigation tasks. When no reliable target match is identified, graph-based evidence is projected into a goal-conditioned semantic-frontier field to guide exploration toward semantically promising frontiers and regions. Building upon CGFM, we introduce CGFM-Nav, a foundation-model-based framework for lifelong multimodal navigation that integrates task-relevant subgraph selection, VLM reasoning, and verification feedback into a closed decision loop. Preliminary experiments on GOAT-Bench show that, under the same Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, CGFM-Nav improves the overall success rate from 53.2% to 63.0% and SPL from 30.0% to 39.6%, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining explicit semantic memory with semantic-guided exploration.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种新的视觉-语言导航框架CGFM-Nav，结合了显式语义记忆与空间探索指导，显著提升了导航任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言导航方法在显式记忆和连续空间探索上的表示存在局限，难以兼顾记忆和探索。
AI.method: 提出Cognitive Graph-Field Memory（CGFM），将物体、空间关系和视觉观测组织为多模态场景图，并利用语义前沿场引导探索。在此基础上，设计了CGFM-Nav框架，结合了子图选择、多模态推理和反馈验证形成闭环决策。
AI.result: 在GOAT-Bench测试集上，基于Qwen3-VL-8B主干，CGFM-Nav方法将成功率从53.2%提升至63.0%，SPL从30.0%提升至39.6%。
AI.conclusion: 结合显式语义记忆与语义驱动探索能够有效提升多模态导航任务表现。

title: Cross Lingual Transfer in Tulu Legal Comprehension: Script-Dependent Improvement and RAG-Induced Knowledge Conflict
summary: Low-resource languages without an adequate training corpus often use a related, higher-resource language as a scaffold for comprehension. Still, there is a need to develop rigorous evaluation methods to identify when models fail in cross lingual low-resource environments. Using the legal domain as a backdrop, three models (Llama3, Hex-1, Sarvam) were tested on the ability to classify legal complaints written in a low resource Dravidian language (Tulu). Transliterating queries across Dravidian scripts allowed models to gain a preliminary understanding of speakers' complaints without the use of wide scale training, though the level of comprehension was heavily script dependent (with Kannada - another relatively low-resource language - producing the strongest positive trend). Retrieving from a corpus of Kannada legal papers across a RAG framework caused mixed results. Some models had a weak positive trend in comprehension under certain conditions, but when models failed, it was often across two axes: fact substitution (fixating on specific passage excerpts that skewed reasoning) and confabulation (hallucination that had no basis in either query or corpus). Within low resource domains, results identify the model's parsing of information and subsequent reasoning as the source of reasoning failure, rather than corpus contents. Script-dependent comprehension and RAG robustness also seem to travel together. This is further supported by the reasoning-trace analysis and a statistical-honesty framework deployed - techniques that are more broadly applicable to low-resource multilingual RAG evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文以法律领域为例，评估了三个大模型在低资源德拉威语族语言（如Tulu）上的跨语言理解和法律文本分类能力，提出了脚本依赖性和推理失败的细致分析方法。
AI.motivation: 面对低资源语言缺乏充分训练语料的问题，当前常用高资源相关语言做支撑，但缺乏严格的方法来评估跨语言低资源环境下模型性能。本研究旨在填补该评价方法学空白。
AI.method: 作者选取三个主流模型（Llama3、Hex-1、Sarvam），在低资源的Tulu语言法律投诉分类任务上进行测试。通过德拉威语族不同文字系统的转写，模型获得初步理解能力。使用Kannada语法律语料作为RAG（检索增强生成）基础，分析模型在不同脚本和查询条件下的表现。同时结合推理轨迹分析和统计诚实性框架，调查模型失误的类型和原因。
AI.result: 转写到Kannada脚本带来最强的正面效果，脚本依赖性显著。RAG框架在信息检索下产生混合结果，有些模型在部分环境下理解力略有提升。失败主要表现在事实替代（关注于片段导致推理偏差）与虚构（无中生有）两方面。低资源领域下，模型推理失败主因在于模型本身的信息解析及推理过程，而不是语料内容。脚本依赖性和RAG稳健性具备同步趋势。
AI.conclusion: 本文验证并细化了脚本及语料转写在低资源、多语跨语言检索增强问答任务中的作用，证明推理链路和统计诚实性分析有助于细致评估模型在低资源语境下的表现与短板，为今后相关评测方法提供新工具与参考。

title: FLM: Frequency-Aware Language Models for Generative Image Compression
summary: Generative models have significantly improved the performance ceiling of image lossy compression at low bitrates by exploiting learned priors. However, the generated textures and semantic details may deviate from the source content, thereby affecting the fidelity of image reconstruction. To solve these challenges, we propose FLM, a frequency-aware language model that improves compression efficiency through frequency-domain probabilistic modeling while retaining deterministic reconstruction. At the encoder, the input image is transformed into quantized DCT coefficients, which are organized into discrete sequences using macroblock-based coefficient tokenization. FLM then performs next-coefficient prediction to autoregressively estimate token-wise conditional probability distributions for arithmetic coding, thereby generating a compact bitstream. At the decoder, the LLM and arithmetic decoder jointly recover the frequency-domain data, followed by inverse transformations for image reconstruction. A task-specific frequency-domain dataset and a two-stage fine-tuning strategy are further developed to enable the model to operate across multiple bitrate settings. FLM is a versatile compressor that is compatible with both lossy compression and lossless JPEG recompression frameworks. Experiments show that FLM exceeds conventional and generative lossy compression methods in rate-distortion performance. FLM achieves BD-PSNR gains of 3.30 dB, 3.83 dB, and 3.80 dB than JPEG baseline on Kodak, Tecnick, and CLIC2020, respectively. Better qualitative quality of FLM can be achieved in improving semantically high fidelity and suppressing blocking artifacts. FLM is also validated to be applicable to the lossless recompression task with competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FLM，一种基于频域建模结合语言模型的图像压缩新方法，兼顾高效压缩与高保真重构，优于现有有损与生成压缩方案。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式图像有损压缩方法虽然能在低码率下达到更高性能，但容易引入虚假细节，影响图像真实还原。作者的目的是解决生成压缩中失真与保真之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 1）输入图像被转换为量化DCT系数，基于宏块划分进行离散化处理；2）使用频域自回归语言模型（FLM）对这些系数的序列进行下一系数预测，获得概率分布并实现算术编码，从而生成紧凑的码流；3）解码时通过FLM+算术解码器重建频域数据，再逆变换回图像空间；4）创新性地构建了频域数据集并用两阶段微调，兼容多码率工作。
AI.result: FLM对经典数据集如Kodak、Tecnick、CLIC2020相较JPEG，BD-PSNR分别提高3.30 dB、3.83 dB、3.80 dB，压缩率与重建质量优于常规和生成式方法。同时高语义保真与低阻塞效应表现突出。在无损JPEG再压缩任务中也有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: FLM有效提升了图像有损压缩的码率-失真性能，实现高效、保真的图像重建，同时支持无损压缩应用，具有广泛适用性和优越性能。

title: Systematic Lightweight Method for Robotics Based on Strain Energy Distribution Optimization
summary: Service robots work with people and are highly expected to be lightweight for safety, agility and energy conservation. As a complex mechanical system, a robot consists of a large number of components and has various working configurations and load environments. An effective method for achieving system-level optimal robot design is a crucial requirement, but it poses significant challenges. In this study, we introduce a novel approach to optimize the distribution of strain energy, which can significantly improve the effectiveness of systematic optimization in a complex system. First, we present and demonstrate that the strain energy per unit mass should be uniformly distributed in an optimal lightweight mechanical system. Based on this criterion, the system-level problem can be decoupled and the design objective of each part can be assigned based on the strain energy. Then, each part can be optimally designed separately according to its specific circumstances by using different approaches, such as size optimization, topological optimization, and material optimization. In this way, the optimization is at the system level, while the computational complexity is at the part level. Weight reduction and improvements in mechanical properties can be obtained simultaneously. As an example, this method is applied to an arbitrarily designed robotic arm, and its effectiveness is further demonstrated in the cases of lightweight with stiffness improvement, considering multiple materials, multiple working conditions, and vibration performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种通过优化应变能分布实现机器人系统级轻量化设计的新方法，能够兼顾降重与机械性能提升。
AI.motivation: 服务机器人对轻量化有很高需求，以保证安全、灵活和节能。由于机器人结构复杂，系统级的最优设计非常具有挑战性，现有方法难以有效兼顾各部件和系统整体的性能优化。
AI.method: 论文首次提出并证明：在最优的轻量化机械系统中，应变能密度应均匀分布。基于该准则，将系统级优化问题解耦为各部件子问题，并根据应变能分配为各部件制定设计目标。然后，针对每个部件的特点分别采用尺寸优化、拓扑优化、材料优化等方法进行独立优化，实现系统级目标而将计算复杂度控制在部件级别。
AI.result: 以机械臂为例，实验验证了该方法在重量减轻和机械性能提升上的有效性，同时适用于多材料、多工况和振动性能等需求。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够实现系统级优化，但计算量仍控制在部件级别，有效解决了复杂机械系统轻量化与性能兼顾的难题，具有较高的实际应用价值。

title: Can Large Language Models Identify Meaningful Touchpoints in Conversion Attribution?
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables; accepted as a short paper at CIKM 2026
summary: Touchpoint selection in conversion attribution, namely identifying meaningful touchpoints contributing to conversions, is essential for e-commerce recommendation and online advertising. Current selection methods rely heavily on collaborative-filtering-based heuristics, which fail to align with user-perceived semantic intent. Through human annotation, we reveal a significant semantic gap: many implicitly-related, semantically relevant touchpoints remain undetected by existing rules. Therefore, we systematically evaluate the capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) in identifying these hidden associations. Our evaluation shows that while LLMs effectively uncover a substantial portion of implicitly-related touchpoints, significant room for improvement remains in their selection performance. Furthermore, we analyze the impact of different prompting strategies and foundation model choices on identification performance, providing valuable insights into their reasoning patterns and effectiveness. These insights offer a new roadmap for transitioning conversion attribution from mechanical rule-matching to human-aligned semantic reasoning. Moreover, we leverage the LLM-attributed conversion labels for enhancing industrial CVR model training and achieve significant offline performance gains, showing the potential of LLMs in conversion attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文针对电商推荐与广告中转化归因的接触点选择问题，发现现有方法难以捕捉语义相关但隐含的接触点。研究通过人工标注揭示语义缺口，评估大语言模型（LLM）识别这些隐藏关联的能力，并探究不同模型和提示策略的效果，同时将改进后的标签应用于CVR模型，获得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于协同过滤的接触点选择方法未能捕捉用户真正的语义意图，导致许多有价值的隐含接触点被忽略。为提升转化归因准确性，有必要探索更符合人类语义认知的归因方式。
AI.method: 通过人工标注揭示现有规则的不足，然后系统性地评估大语言模型在发现隐含语义相关接触点上的表现，比较不同LLM及其提示策略对识别性能的影响，最后将LLM生成的标签用于工业CVR模型训练。
AI.result: LLM能够发现大量原规则遗漏的隐含相关接触点，但选择性能仍有提升空间。不同模型和输入提示策略对识别效果有显著影响。用LLM归因增强CVR模型可带来明显的离线性能提升。
AI.conclusion: LLM为转换归因提供了更具人类语义对齐的解决路径，并能直接提升下游CVR模型的表现，是机械规则到语义推理的重要转型方向。

title: Projection-Aware End-to-End Learned Video Compression for 360-Degree Video
summary:
360-degree video supports immersive applications such as virtual reality, autonomous driving, and education. Because spherical content cannot be processed directly by conventional video codecs, it must first be mapped to a two-dimensional projection. Projection choice affects spatial continuity, sampling uniformity, motion estimation, and compression efficiency.
  This thesis investigates how projection format influences end-to-end neural compression of 360-degree video. Seven formats supported by JVET 360Lib are evaluated using the scale-space flow model, JVET test sequences, and common test conditions. Each sequence is converted from its source equirectangular projection to a coding projection, compressed at multiple rate points, reconstructed, and converted back. Performance is assessed using PSNR, spherical PSNR, weighted spherical PSNR, and Bjøntegaard delta rate. A differentiable pipeline combining projection conversion, neural compression, and inverse projection is also compared with 360Lib.
  Results show that equirectangular and padded equirectangular projections provide the highest compression efficiency with the scale-space flow model, while cubemap-based and rhombic dodecahedron projections are less effective. This differs from the conventional HM-16.16 codec, for which cubemap-based formats, particularly equi-angular and adjusted cubemap projections, outperform equirectangular formats. Neural models based on optical flow benefit from the spatial continuity of single-face projections, whereas block-based hybrid codecs better accommodate multi-face layouts. These findings show that projection efficiency is codec-dependent and provide guidance for selecting projections for learning-based 360-degree video compression.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全景视频在神经网络压缩中的不同投影格式对压缩效率的影响，结果发现最佳投影格式依赖于所用编解码器类型。
AI.motivation: 360度视频需要先转换为二维投影格式才能压缩。不同投影不仅影响空间连续性，还会影响采样均匀性和压缩效率。研究目前缺乏针对神经压缩方法下，不同投影格式效能系统评估，因此有必要探究最优选项。
AI.method: 作者基于JVET 360Lib库支持的七种二维投影格式，使用scale-space flow模型对360度视频进行端到端神经压缩。每组样本视频序列分别从等距矩形投影视图转换为目标编码投影视图，经过不同比特率点压缩、解码还原，再转回原视图，最终利用各种PSNR及Bjøntegaard delta rate进行性能对比。同时与360Lib传统流程做差异化比较。
AI.result: 等距矩形（equirectangular）及其改良版本在神经压缩下取得了最优编码效率。而基于立方体和菱形十二面体的投影表现不佳，这与传统HM-16.16编解码器下立方体投影更优的结论不同。光流相关模型更依赖空间连续单面投影，而混合块式编解码更适配多面布局。
AI.conclusion: 投影效率显著依赖于所用压缩方法。对于基于神经网络的360度视频压缩，单面连续型投影如等距矩形更优，传统混合块编解码则适合多面投影。此结论指导了不同压缩框架下全景视频投影格式的选择。

title: AdaVLA: Adaptive Step Flow Matching for Training-free Acceleration of Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, built upon Vision-Language Models (VLMs), have significantly enhanced robotic capabilities by leveraging internet-scale knowledge and multimodal reasoning. However, the intensive computational overhead of VLAs constrains on-device deployment, hindering real-time responses to environmental changes. While various acceleration techniques have been proposed, they often rely on fine-tuning or access to training datasets, which are frequently unavailable due to privacy and proprietary concerns. Moreover, although flow-matching-based VLAs have emerged as efficient alternatives to standard diffusion models, current acceleration efforts largely target VLM inference costs, failing to address the iterative ODE solving process inherent in flow matching inference. To address these limitations, we propose AdaVLA, an online, training-free adaptive framework for fast yet accurate flow-matching-based Vision-Language-Action models. We introduce a novel metric derived from the flow matching trajectory curvature to quantify action generation confidence during inference. This metric enables the dynamic reduction of inference steps and the adaptive adjustment of MLP pruning ratios through an efficiently computed importance evaluation, requiring no access to training data. Experimental results on the LIBERO benchmark using a Jetson AGX Orin device demonstrate that our method achieves $1.87\times$ and $2.24\times$ speedups for $π_{0.5}$ and X-VLA, respectively, with negligible degradation in success rates. Furthermore, we validate the robustness of our approach on real-world robotic tasks using SmolVLA.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种无需训练、可自适应加速的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推理框架AdaVLA，实现了在不牺牲精度的前提下，大幅提升了模型的推理速度，适用于资源受限设备上的实时机器人任务。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型依赖于庞大的计算资源，限制了其在设备端的实时应用。此外，主流加速方法通常依赖于微调或访问训练数据，而这些数据在实际场景中因隐私和专有性往往不可得。针对这些现实挑战，亟需一种无需访问训练数据、且高效的加速方法。
AI.method: AdaVLA无需训练数据，通过对推理过程中流匹配轨迹曲率设计新的置信度指标，根据该指标动态减少ODE推理步数并自适应调整MLP剪枝率。整个加速过程为在线、自适应，且基于高效的计算重要性评估实现。
AI.result: 在Jetson AGX Orin设备的LIBERO基准测试上，AdaVLA对π_{0.5}模型提升了1.87倍速度，对X-VLA提升2.24倍速度，且成功率几乎未降。此外，在真实机器人SmolVLA测试中验证了方案的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: AdaVLA能够无需训练数据、高效自适应地加速流匹配类VLA模型推理，显著提升机器人在边缘端的实时推理能力，有望推动相关VLM与VLA在实际机器人任务中的部署。

title: Test-Time Scaling for Scientific Equation Discovery
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves language model reasoning by allocating additional test-time compute, but prior work mainly studies closed-ended tasks such as math and coding. We study TTS for automated equation discovery, an open-ended setting where models search over candidate equations and rely on observed datapoints for feedback. We formulate LLM-driven equation discovery as an iterative search process that unifies Best-of-N, sequential refinement, tree search, and evolution-style methods under a common compute-allocation view. To isolate allocation effects from prompt engineering and other heuristics, we compare minimal parallel controllers under fixed budgets. On LLM-SRBench equation-discovery tasks, we find that search width is the dominant allocation parameter: the best width in our sweep generally increases with the compute budget, while the population--branching split and controller choice matter less. Appropriate width selection also improves wall-clock efficiency by increasing parallelism. These results suggest that, given an informative verifier, controlling exploration and exploitation is central to scaling LLM-based equation discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）在自动方程发现这一开放式任务中的测试时计算分配方法，提出统一的搜索和资源分配观点，并发现搜索宽度是提升模型性能的关键。
AI.motivation: 此前TTS主要应用在封闭式推理任务（如数学和编程），对开放式任务如自动方程发现关注较少。研究动机在于明确大模型如何在方程发现等更复杂、需要主动搜索与反馈的任务中有效利用更多测试时计算资源。
AI.method: 作者将LLM驱动的方程发现看作一个迭代搜索过程，将“Best-of-N”、“序列精炼”、“树搜索”和“进化式方法”等整合为统一的计算分配视角，并通过对比在固定计算预算下的不同并行控制器（分配策略），重点研究分配宽度、群体-分支比例、控制器类型对最终发现效果的影响。
AI.result: 实验表明：搜索宽度是最主要的影响因子，最优宽度随着计算预算增大而提升；而群体-分支比例和具体控制器类型影响较小。合适的宽度选择还可提高并行性，从而提升实际推理速度。
AI.conclusion: 要在有可靠验证器支撑时，合理控制探索与利用（如调整搜索宽度）是实现LLM自动方程发现能力扩展的核心。

title: Defending Wearable VLMs Against Private Attribute Inference
summary: Wearable VLM pipelines promise continuous multimodal assistance from egocentric visual capture: a user asks a task-driven question about the surrounding scene, and the system uses compact visual tokens to support language reasoning. The challenge motivating this work is that the same egocentric evidence needed for useful assistance can also reveal private attributes about the wearer or nearby bystanders. We investigate this as a joint privacy-utility problem for split VLM inference, where visual encoding occurs within a trusted device boundary but intermediate visual tokens may be transmitted to downstream reasoning components. This exposes an understudied leakage surface: even when final textual responses are benign, external attackers or untrusted downstream components can recover private attributes from transmitted visual tokens. To evaluate this tension, we construct a paired privacy-utility benchmark with 3,221 image-question records, each paired with a utility question and privacy labels covering location, income, sex, and interests. We further propose Token-Guided Attribute Privacy (TGAP), a pre-LLM token disentangler that learns a residual transformation of visual tokens before they leave the trusted boundary. TGAP combines utility preservation, identity regularization, semantic privacy suppression, and image-driven representation suppression, avoiding the utility loss caused by coarse hard or attention masking. On the benchmark used for source-model evaluation, TGAP reduces privacy accuracy from 56.7\% to 7.4\%, a 49.3\% absolute drop, while maintaining relaxed utility at 74.4\%. These results suggest that securing the compact token interface is a practical path toward privacy-preserving wearable multimodal AI.

AI.tldr: 本文针对可穿戴视觉语言模型（VLM）在实现连续多模态辅助时的隐私泄露问题，提出了一种在兼顾效用的前提下显著提升隐私保护的新方法。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴VLM系统通过视觉信息和语言推理为用户提供场景辅助，但这些视觉证据在提供帮助的同时，亦可能泄露用户或路人隐私属性（如地理位置、收入、性别、兴趣）。传输的视觉Token即使最终输出无涉隐私，也有被外部攻击者利用进行隐私恢复的风险，因此亟需探索既能保证效用，也能有效保护隐私的新方案。
AI.method: 作者提出Token-Guided Attribute Privacy（TGAP）方法：在可信设备内对视觉Token进行残差变换，使Token在传出设备前弱化或消隐敏感隐私属性，包括身份、语义和图像驱动的表达，同时尽量保留用户任务所需的辅助效用，规避传统遮挡/掩码带来的效用损失。方法通过联合优化效用保留和隐私抑制实现端到端学习。并建立包含3221条样本的配对隐私-效用基准用于实验评估。
AI.result: TGAP在给定基准上，可将隐私属性识别准确率从56.7%降低至7.4%，隐私提升效果显著（下降49.3个百分点），同时效用任务准确率依然达到74.4%，显示TGAP在提升隐私保护的同时能较好保持任务效用。
AI.conclusion: 本文开创性地指出可穿戴VLM系统视觉Token传输过程中的隐私泄露风险，并提出实用的Token级隐私抑制方法TGAP，在不显著损失效用的条件下大幅提升隐私保护，为构建更安全的多模态可穿戴AI系统提供了新思路和实践路径。

title: AnyWorld: Factorized Egocentric World Models for Cross-Embodiment Generalization
summary: Collecting contact-rich robot experiences at scale remains a major bottleneck for generalizable manipulation. Beyond data quantity, robot learning also requires diverse experiences across embodiments, viewpoints, and scenes. Human egocentric videos provide abundant physical interactions, but each video captures only a narrow slice of experience under a single body, camera trajectory, and environment. We propose AnyWorld, a cross-embodiment world modeling framework that expands a single human interaction into diverse robot-native rollouts without paired human-robot demonstrations. Our model factorizes an interaction into action, camera, and embodiment: action controls capture the motion structure, camera controls specify viewpoint evolution, and the target embodiment context defines the acting body and its interaction geometry. This formulation enables independent recomposition of embodiment, viewpoint, and scene factors, allowing a single model to generate many robot-domain experiences while preserving the underlying dynamics and object interactions. We train the model with large-scale human interaction pretraining followed by mixed-embodiment fine-tuning. Experiments show that our model supports controllable recomposition across embodiments, viewpoints, and scenes, and we further demonstrate that the generated data can improve manipulation performance on the RoboCasa GR1 tabletop benchmark and a real IRON humanoid robot. Beyond aggregate gains, we test whether unpaired human experience can be recomposed into robot-native video-action pairs that target a policy gap. Controlled IRON interventions correct a spurious completion prior and establish language-grounded spatial target selection; an action-only counterfactual intervention fails to learn the latter reliably, showing that both action calibration and visual recomposition are necessary.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为AnyWorld的通用跨平台世界建模框架，将单个人类交互视频扩展为多样的机器人体验，无需人机配对示范。模型通过对动作、相机和实体进行解耦，实现了多维度的可控重组，为机器人生成丰富的交互数据，有效提升了下游操控任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人通用操作学习受限于复杂多样的丰富交互数据获取，且缺少能涵盖不同机器人、视角和场景的经验。人类视角视频广泛但局限于单一条件，急需系统性方法将其迁移为机器人可用的多元体验。
AI.method: 构建AnyWorld模型，将交互分解为动作、相机、实体三部分，独立控制与重组这些因素。先以大规模人类交互预训练，再进行多实体微调，使模型能生成多种机器人-场景-视角的交互数据，同时保持物理动态和物品交互关系。
AI.result: AnyWorld模型实现了不同实体、视角和场景间的可控重组，生成的数据可提升RoboCasa GR1基准和真实IRON机器人上的操控性能。实验进一步证明，将非配对人类体验重组成机器人本地视频-动作对，可有效弥补策略空白，特别是在涉及语言和空间目标选择任务时，视觉和动作同时调节不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: AnyWorld在无需人工映射的前提下实现了从人类到机器人的大规模、多样交互数据合成，显著提升了机器人操作任务的表现，并展示了理念在突破传统人机迁移瓶颈上的潜力。

title: GreenBench: Benchmarking Energy Efficiency and Carbon Footprint of Open-Source LLM Inference on Apple Silicon
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Accepted at IEEE ICCUBEA 2026
summary: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has raised concerns about their environmental impact during inference. While Green AI research has focused on datacenter GPUs and embedded platforms, the energy profile of LLM inference on Apple Silicon, with its unified memory architecture, remains unstudied. This paper presents GreenBench, a benchmarking framework that evaluates the energy efficiency, throughput, and carbon footprint of five open-source LLMs (3-9B parameters) across three NLP tasks on an Apple M4 Pro with 48 GB unified memory. Using macOS powermetrics for direct power measurement and Ollama's nanosecond-precision timing, we find that the M4 Pro draws only 0.47 W of CPU+GPU package power during sustained inference, with total system power of 8-12 W, achieving 30-40x better energy efficiency per token than datacenter GPUs in single-user deployment. Smaller models (3-3.8B) deliver 2.6-4.2x higher throughput and up to 62% less energy per token than larger models (7-9B). Pareto analysis identifies Qwen 2.5 (7B) as the optimal accuracy-efficiency trade-off at 57% MMLU and 59 tokens/s, while Llama 3.2 (3B) suits latency-critical applications at 175 tokens/s. We provide per-token energy at package and system levels with CO2 estimates for India and US grids.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GreenBench基准测试框架，首次系统评估了在Apple Silicon设备上运行开放源代码大型语言模型（LLM）推理时的能效、吞吐量和碳足迹。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）普及，其推理带来的能耗和碳排放问题日益引起关注。过往主要聚焦于数据中心GPU和嵌入式平台，但Apple Silicon这一具备统一内存架构的新型终端设备尚未被系统性研究。
AI.method: 作者在Apple M4 Pro（配备48GB统一内存）上，选取了5个开源LLM（参数规模3B-9B），覆盖3类NLP任务。测量采用macOS powermetrics记录能耗，搭配Ollama精确计时，量化不同模型包级/系统级能效和吞吐，以及美国和印度电网下的二氧化碳排放。
AI.result: M4 Pro运行LLM推理时CPU+GPU功耗仅0.47W，系统总功耗8-12W，单用户环境下每token能效达主流数据中心GPU的30-40倍。小模型（3-3.8B）相比大模型（7-9B）每token能耗低62%，吞吐高2.6-4.2倍。Qwen 2.5（7B）在准确率与能效间表现最佳，Llama 3.2（3B）适合低延迟场景。
AI.conclusion: Apple Silicon支持下，开放LLM本地推理具备极高能效和低碳排优势。模型大小影响吞吐和能耗，不同应用宜权衡选型。未来工作建议推动绿色AI衡量标准在端侧普及。

title: Growing a Stand, Not a Tree: Joint Canopy Generation Reproduces Crown Shyness
summary: In closed forests, neighboring tree crowns often stop short of touching, leaving a network of narrow gaps known as crown shyness. The pattern belongs to the stand rather than to any single tree, which makes it a natural probe of a question in generative modeling: can a learned model produce a set of objects whose defining structure exists only between them? We formulate stand-level canopy generation as set generation with a flow-matching model, in which attention between trees is the only channel through which coupling can arise. Trained on stands grown by a resource-competition simulation that is provably not reducible to per-tree geometry, the joint model halves the clearance distribution error of an identical-capacity model that generates each tree alone, and the advantage persists at stem densities outside the training range. Against field measurements of a tropical oak forest, a single calibrated scalar yields held-out agreement in gap magnitude and crown asymmetry. The directional statistics of the gaps are controlled by stem placement rather than by the growth rule, and match the field once stem jitter is calibrated. Crown shyness, in both the simulation and the learned model, is a property of the stand and not of the tree.

AI.tldr: 本论文研究了森林中树冠羞避现象，提出了基于生成模型模拟整片林分树冠结构的方法，并在仿真和实测数据中获得准确复现。
AI.motivation: 树冠羞避现象即相邻树冠之间存在狭长间隙，这种结构属于林分整体，而非单棵树。作者希望探索生成模型是否能模拟出这种仅存在于个体间的群体属性。
AI.method: 作者将林分冠层生成建模为集合生成问题，采用flow-matching模型，仅通过树之间的attention机制建立关联。模型在基于资源竞争模拟生成的数据集上训练，并与仅能独立生成单树结构的模型对比。
AI.result: 联合生成模型能将间隙分布误差减少一半，且在未见过的树密度范围依然表现出色；通过调整一个标量参数后，模型在实地测量数据上的间隙大小和树冠不对称性表现接近真实林分。
AI.conclusion: 树冠羞避是林分层级的属性，集成生成模型能捕捉其群体结构特征，模型泛化能力强，可用于研究自然群体结构生成。

title: SGE: Semantically-Guided Exploration for Unstructured Environments via Image-Space Waypoint Sampling
summary: This work introduces Semantically-Guided Exploration (SGE), a modular exploration framework for ground vehicles that integrates pixel-level semantic segmentation into sampling-based waypoint selection and receding-horizon route optimization. Unlike conventional geometric exploration methods, SGE evaluates candidate exploration goals directly in the image space using a semantic-aware utility function that accounts for terrain traversability, obstacle proximity, objects of interest, and depth-based exploration reward. Sampled waypoints are projected into 3D and ordered through a real-time Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) formulation, enabling receding-horizon goal selection. To address real-world navigation uncertainty, the framework introduces mechanisms, including temporary taboo regions to handle navigation failures and a graph-based relocation strategy for efficient backtracking across explored areas. We evaluate SGE in standardized simulation benchmarks against state-of-the-art exploration planners and demonstrate competitive performance in volumetric coverage, while enabling semantic task biasing that cannot be achieved by purely geometric methods. The framework is further validated through real-world experiments using multiple robotic platforms in indoor campus buildings and in limestone and coal mines. Results show consistent performance and adaptability across platforms and domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于语义引导的地面机器人探索框架SGE，将图像分割信息融入采样式路径规划和递推式路线优化，提升探索效率和灵活性，并通过仿真与真实场景测试验证了其优势。
AI.motivation: 传统几何方法难以充分利用图像的高层语义信息，限制了机器人在复杂环境下的自主导航与任务特性适应能力。因此提出结合语义分割提升探索决策质量。
AI.method: SGE框架将像素级语义分割用于候选目标点的效用函数评估，综合考虑地形可通行性、障碍物距离、感兴趣目标和深度探索奖励。将采样路径投影到3D空间，并采用实时旅行商问题排序，实现递推式目标选择。引入临时禁忌区和图结构回溯机制应对实际导航失败。
AI.result: 在标准仿真基准上与主流探索方法对比，SGE在体积覆盖等指标上表现具有竞争力，并且能够实现仅几何方法无法实现的语义任务偏向。另外在多个机器人平台、室内建筑及矿区等真实场景进行了实验，展示了算法的一致性和适应性。
AI.conclusion: SGE框架有效结合了语义信息与采样探索，实现了更高效且可适应不同场景和任务的机器人导航，优于仅基于几何的传统方法。

title: ReVA: A Region-Aware Visual Assistant for Visually Grounded Question Answering
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in Visual Question Answering (VQA), yet they continue to struggle with questions requiring precise spatial reasoning and fine-grained visual understanding. These limitations often manifest as object, attribute, and spatial hallucinations, where models generate confident but visually unsupported responses due to insufficient region-level and fine-grained visual grounding. To address this challenge, we propose ReVA, a region-aware VQA model that employs a frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 Vision Transformer (ViT) and a Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct large language model (LLM) connected through a dual bridge that aligns both whole-image and region-level representations with the LLM's embedding space. The image bridge maps final transformer block features into image tokens. The region bridge maps cropped features from enriched intermediate features across ViT blocks so early texture and later object cues are more evident, into K region tokens for every bounding box. ReVA uses a detector stack that supplies automatic zero-shot bounding boxes that are both question-agnostic and question-dependent, using RAM++ (Recognize Anything Model), spaCy, and Grounding DINO. The image tokens and region tokens are concatenated as an LLM prompt prefix to jointly encode scene-level context and fine-grained regional evidence when answering questions. Evaluated on VQAv2, MMBench, POPE, and SEED-Bench, ReVA achieves 82.85% mean F1 on POPE, compared with 81.14% for an image-token baseline without region tokens. These results demonstrate that explicit region-aware visual representations reduce object hallucination and improve the factual grounding of MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ReVA的面向区域的视觉问答模型，有效提升了多模态大模型在空间推理和细粒度视觉理解上的表现，降低了幻觉现象。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉问答（VQA）任务上取得了显著进展，但在精确空间推理和细粒度视觉理解方面仍有明显短板，易产生物体、属性和空间幻觉，导致一些信誓旦旦但缺乏视觉支撑的回答。因此，急需提高区域级和细粒度的视觉结合能力，提升模型的真实推理能力。
AI.method: 作者提出了ReVA模型，采用了冻结的CLIP ViT-L/14视觉变换器和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct大语言模型，通过“双桥”机制将整体图像和区域级视觉特征与LLM嵌入空间对齐。区域桥利用被裁剪的中间特征丰富早期纹理和后期目标线索，并为每个检测框生成K个区域token。模型集成RAM++、spaCy及Grounding DINO为区域生成问题相关和无关的零样本检测框。所有图像token和区域token拼接为LLM的提示前缀，实现对场景整体和细节的联合编码。
AI.result: 在VQAv2、MMBench、POPE和SEED-Bench等基准上，ReVA在POPE数据集上取得了82.85%的平均F1分数，明显高于未采用区域token的baseline（81.14%），多项测试均显示区域引导的视觉特征有效缓解了幻觉问题。
AI.conclusion: ReVA通过引入显式的区域感知视觉表示，显著减少了MLLMs在视觉问答中的幻觉现象，提升了模型推理的事实依据，对多模态大模型的精细理解和空间推理能力具有推动作用。

title: SNF-Bench: Separating Static Drift from Natural Flow in Long-Horizon Fixed-Camera Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon video generation is evaluated with whole-frame metrics that reward motion and temporal consistency. For fixed-camera nature scenes this creates an ambiguity: motion of water, fire, smoke, or rain is desirable, whereas motion of the background is an error. A system can therefore score well on motion while its scene drifts, or on consistency while its flow stagnates. We introduce SNF-Bench, an evaluation framework for long-horizon fixed-camera generation that partitions each scene into static support and dynamic flow and reports static fidelity, flow persistence with absolute magnitude, and drift leakage separately, never as one score. Drift leakage is interpretive context rather than a headline measurement. Each factor is validated mechanistically rather than by correlation with preference: we inject global translation, rotation, and scale drift and progressive late freezing at known severity into real generations, and require each factor to respond in its stated direction and to remain selective against corruptions it does not target. Auditing publicly released long-horizon text-conditioned checkpoints under one recorded common inference configuration, plus an image-conditioned track with released-pipeline references and a deployment-sensitivity panel, we find that whole-frame motion and static-region drift induce near-opposite orderings of the same outputs. At maximum controlled translation, fBD and NBF rise to $1.86\times$ and $1.32\times$ baseline, but whole-frame Dynamic Degree reaches only $1.07\times$---rewarding the corruption. SNF-Bench measures where motion occurs and whether it persists; it does not measure physical realism. Project page: https://minar09.github.io/snfbench/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种专门针对固定摄像头长时序视频生成的评价框架SNF-Bench，通过将场景划分为静态支撑和动态流区，分别报告静态真实性、流持续性和漂移泄漏，避免用单一分数综合结果，更精确地衡量视频生成质量。
AI.motivation: 传统全帧指标在评价长时序固定摄像头下的自然场景视频时存在歧义：水、火等自然运动应被奖励，但背景的运动则是错误。使用传统指标可能无法准确区分这两种情况，导致评价结果有偏差，因此需要更精细化、可解释的评价方法。
AI.method: 作者提出SNF-Bench，将场景分成静态区和动态区，分别评估静态真实性、动态流的持续性以及漂移泄漏，并通过人为注入全局平移、旋转、缩放等失真，验证每项指标的敏感性和选择性。所有因素均从机制上验证而非经验相关性。
AI.result: 通过对不同公开长时序文本条件生成模型的基准测试发现，全帧运动和静区漂移指标对模型排序近乎相反。特定破坏（如最大平移）下，静区评价指标大幅提升，但整体运动指标变化不大，反而误奖励错误生成。
AI.conclusion: SNF-Bench能有效揭示长时序固定摄像头视频生成中运动发生的位置及其持续性，避免了传统整体指标的歧义，但不涉及物理真实性的衡量。

title: A Cognitive Architecture for Shared Autonomy in AUV Operations
summary: Operators remain essential to Remotely Operated Vehicle (ROV) operation, yet often suffer from low situational awareness and high workload, both of which negatively affect safety. This paper presents a cognitive architecture consisting of an ontology and multiple Large Language Models (LLMs) to assist the operator at all stages of the mission. Each LLM is grounded with domain-specific information from the ontology and given a simple role to create a system that can support the operator at all stages of an operation. We are aiming to prove that using the two together will allow decisions to be grounded in the relevant domain knowledge, but also benefit from the reasoning capabilities of the LLM. Our framework determines if a mission is possible for a given Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV), performs mission planning, and executes a given mission in simulation. The operator can be involved in planning and execution, ensuring the resulting plan is valid and that the vehicle behaves safely during execution. We compare different LLMs, Llama3, GPT-OSS, and Qwen2.5, to determine which are best suited to the different roles within our framework. We find that GPT-OSS performs best for feasibility assessment, planning, and execution, while Qwen2.5 is best suited to identifying mission types from natural language input.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合本体和多种大语言模型（LLM）的认知体系结构，用于辅助遥控水下航行器（ROV/UUV）操作员，从而提升其态势感知、降低工作负荷，提高作业安全性。
AI.motivation: 传统ROV操作依赖操作员，但操作员易因信息不足导致态势感知低和工作负荷高，影响安全。
AI.method: 构建了一套认知体系结构，将领域本体与分别被赋予简单角色的多种LLM结合，协助操作员完成任务可行性评估、规划和执行，在仿真中验证系统有效性，并比较不同LLM（Llama3、GPT-OSS、Qwen2.5）在不同角色下的表现。
AI.result: GPT-OSS在任务可行性评估、规划和执行表现最佳，Qwen2.5更擅长从自然语言识别任务类型。
AI.conclusion: 将本体和LLM相结合的框架能提升ROV操作员的决策效率和安全性，不同LLM适合不同子任务，未来系统具备良好应用前景。

title: Evaluating Multilingual Sentence Embeddings for Translation Error Detection:An English--Greek Contrastive Study
summary:
Multilingual sentence embeddings are increasingly used to estimate semantic similarity across languages, yet their sensitivity to fine-grained translation errors remains insufficiently understood. This study investigates whether general-purpose multilingual embedding models can distinguish correct English-Greek translations from minimally modified erroneous alternatives. A contrastive dataset was developed from FLORES+ sentence-aligned reference translations and reviewed by two translation experts. It contains 1,850 examples across ten core and five exploratory error categories, covering factual, lexical-semantic, grammatical, relational, referential, and discourse-level phenomena.
  Five multilingual sentence-embedding models (BGE-M3, Multilingual E5, Multilingual MPNet, LaBSE, and Jina Embeddings v3) were evaluated using cosine similarity between each English source sentence and its correct and erroneous Greek translations. A reference-free COMETKiwi model was also evaluated as an MT quality-estimation baseline. Performance was assessed through contrastive accuracy and score margins for category-specific sensitivity. BGE-M3 achieved the highest accuracy among embedding models at 89.30 percent, while COMETKiwi achieved 94.49 percent. Embedding models detected explicit factual and lexical changes more reliably than tense-and-aspect and pronoun-coreference errors. COMETKiwi improved performance on several difficult categories, including tense and aspect, pronoun and coreference, and semantic-role errors, but showed lower sensitivity to date-and-time errors and underperformed the embedding models on numbers. The results show complementary error-sensitivity profiles: multilingual sentence embeddings provide useful semantic adequacy signals but are better suited as components of broader translation-evaluation frameworks than as standalone metrics.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了多语句嵌入模型在区分英希翻译细粒度错误方面的能力，结果显示其对部分错误类型较敏感，但依然存在短板，适合作为翻译评价的辅助工具。
AI.motivation: 多语种句子嵌入模型被广泛用于跨语言语义匹配，但学界尚不清楚它们是否能准确识别翻译细节上的差错，尤其是在真实翻译质量评估场景下，对此展开深入研究具有理论和实际意义。
AI.method: 构建了包含1,850个英希翻译示例和多类人工标注错误的对比数据集，并使用五种主流多语句嵌入模型以及一个无参考MT质量评估模型（COMETKiwi），通过计算余弦相似度和对比准确率，分析不同类型翻译错误的区分能力。
AI.result: BGE-M3模型在嵌入模型中准确率最高（89.30%），COMETKiwi更优（94.49%）；嵌入模型对事实和词汇性错误检测较好，但对时态、代词等复杂错误不敏感。COMETKiwi在部分复杂错误上表现更佳，但对数字和时间错误不如嵌入模型，表现出互补性。
AI.conclusion: 多语种句子嵌入模型能够在一定程度上提供语义评估信号，但对翻译细粒度错误的敏感度有局限，更适合作为综合评估框架的组成部分，而非独立翻译质量评估指标。

title: Weaving Visual Narratives: Agentic Image Bundle Composition Beyond Atomic Visual Matching
summary: Image retrieval has traditionally been formulated as a point-wise matching problem, where each candidate image is scored in isolation. However, this atomic paradigm fails to capture the complexity of human search intent within personal photo collections, where users often seek compact visual stories bound by structural relations rather than isolated snapshots. To address this limitation, we introduce **Image Bundle Composition (IBC)**, a novel paradigm that shifts the objective from ranking individual images to dynamically composing cohesive image bundles from a massive, unstructured photo pool. Since target bundles are not predefined, IBC presents a severe combinatorial explosion challenge and demands modeling non-decomposable joint relevance. To establish this paradigm, we construct **IBCBench**, the first IBC benchmark dataset containing 109,467 images and 667 verified queries, built via a semi-automated verification pipeline. Furthermore, we propose **BundleWeaver**, an agentic framework that reformulates IBC as query-conditioned incremental hyperedge discovery. By employing a Large Language Model to adaptively search for missing relational roles and utilizing a Vision-Language Model for whole-bundle verification, BundleWeaver effectively navigates the combinatorial space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while state-of-the-art embedding models and static decompose-and-rerank paradigms suffer from relational blindness, BundleWeaver achieves substantial performance gains, highlighting the necessity of shifting from atomic scoring to dynamic relational composition. Our dataset and code are available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了图像检索的新范式Image Bundle Composition (IBC)，不再单独评分图片，而是动态组合相关图片组，提出了数据集IBCBench，并设计了BundleWeaver框架，通过大模型实现更有效的组图检索。
AI.motivation: 传统图像检索只考量单张图片的匹配度，忽视了用户实际搜索中对图片组间结构关系和共同叙事的需求。针对这种单点检索范式的局限，亟需新的方法更好满足用户对图片集的复杂需求。
AI.method: 提出IBC范式，将检索目标从单张排名转变为图片组动态组合；构造了第一个IBC基准数据集IBCBench；提出基于大语言模型和视觉-语言模型的BundleWeaver框架，将任务转化为增量超边发现，实现对图片组关系的建模与验证。
AI.result: 实验显示，现有嵌入模型及基于分解重排的传统方法无法捕捉组内关系，效果有限；而BundleWeaver在组图检索任务上取得了显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 验证了原子化检索范式的局限性，强调了向动态关系组合转变的必要性，BundleWeaver为高效处理组图检索提供了有力工具。

title: Bridging Semantics and Physics with Constrained LLMs for Safe and Trustworthy Robotic Manipulation
summary: A language-guided robot operating in a real kitchen must do more than produce a plan that appears correct. It must also execute that plan safely in cluttered environments under imperfect perception. Large language models (LLM) can decompose instructions into action sequences, yet a language-action gap remains: a plan may appear valid linguistically while being physically infeasible under kinematic and collision constraints. We bridge this gap by formalizing the reasoning-execution boundary as a typed contract. From RGB-D observations, the system grounds perceived objects in an explicit, collision-aware scene model and constrains language-level decisions through schema-validated tool calls defined by the Model Context Protocol (MCP), rejecting malformed commands before they reach the robot. Each validated call is deterministically grounded in a MoveIt Task Constructor pipeline, where candidate motions are evaluated against the reconstructed planning scene in a verify-then-act step. Only trajectories that pass both kinematic and collision checks are sent to the robot. On a physical UFactory 850, the method achieves up to 80% success across ten trials per task on pouring tasks involving liquids, granular media, and discrete solids. It achieves 90% success on a grasp-and-place task using the same planning, protocol, and verification stack. Although a scripted policy slightly outperforms our method on the easiest task, its success rate falls to 10% on the hardest, compared with 60% for our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的方法，将大语言模型生成的行动指令与实际机器人操作之间的“语言-动作”鸿沟进行桥接，实现语言引导下，厨房机器人在真实复杂环境中的安全执行。
AI.motivation: 传统大语言模型仅能将任务拆分为合理语句，但忽视了物理和运动学约束，因此生成的行为序列在实际操作中往往不可行，需解决语言计划与机器人实际执行间的不一致问题。
AI.method: 1. 通过模型协议（MCP）形式化推理-执行边界，使用类型合同来约束任务指令。2. 基于RGB-D视觉感知，构建带碰撞感知的场景模型。3. 对每条语言指令进行模式验证和语法校验，拒绝不规范命令。4. 经过验证的指令通过MoveIt任务构建器，按先验证再执行的步骤，筛选通过运动学和碰撞检测的动作轨迹，最终下发给机器人执行。
AI.result: 在UFactory 850真实厨房环境中，对液体、颗粒体、固体等不同倒料任务，方法平均成功率达到80%；在抓取放置任务中成功率90%。对比编程策略，本文方法在复杂任务上成功率优于脚本方法（60% vs 10%）。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的契约化推理执行框架，有效弥补了大模型的语言-动作鸿沟，提高了机器人在真实厨房环境中的语言指令可执行性和任务成功率。

title: A rigor-matched audit of periodic-step layer skipping for efficient llm inference: conflayers versus swift, with a supplemental analysis of trained routing alternatives
summary: Layer-skipping methods for efficient LLM inference decide, at some granularity, which transformer layers to execute for a given input. We present a rigor-matched, three-seed audit of two periodic-step, search-based methods that make this decision online at inference time and re-evaluate it every few generation steps: a confidence-gated early-exit baseline (ConfLayers) and genuine self-speculative decoding (SWIFT, Xia et al. 2024), together with vanilla autoregressive decoding, across two model scales (Qwen2.5-0.5B and Qwen2.5-1.5B) and two tasks (GSM8K reasoning and CNN/DailyMail summarization). SWIFT is the strongest method on accuracy in three of four cells; ConfLayers is dominated everywhere, with particularly large deficits on GSM8K at 1.5B. Once online-search overhead is separated from pure inference cost, SWIFT's true inference speed is faster than ConfLayers's in all four cells (5-21%), reversing the naive wall-clock ranking in three of them. ConfLayers's search overhead is small and stable (1-2% of cost), while SWIFT's is larger and more variable (up to 28.7%). We additionally examine two trained-routing methods, LayerRoute (Sikdar, 2026) and LayerDrop (Fan et al. 2020), as a supplemental analysis because they operate at coarser decision granularities. Under a verified protocol with genuine per-input gating, a genuine full-model baseline, and genuine inference-time compute skipping, both show modest speedups (1.08-1.33x) but accuracy well below the periodic-step methods, including a near-total collapse for LayerRoute on GSM8K at 1.5B (0.003 mean exact-match across three seeds). We release the full audit protocol as a template for rigor-matched efficiency comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了多种大模型推理过程中跳层（layer-skipping）方法的效率和准确率，提出了严格的审计协议，并在不同参数量、任务、方法之间进行了实验对比。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型在各类任务中的应用，推理延迟和计算成本成为瓶颈。跳层方法可以不必每层都执行，从而提升推理效率，但目前各方法横向对比缺乏系统性且部分评测不严谨，因此本文设计了严格的比较协议，对主流跳层方法进行分析。
AI.method: 作者引入了两种基于周期性动态决策的在线跳层方法：基于置信分数的early-exit（ConfLayers）与自发推理（SWIFT），共在两个规模的模型（Qwen2.5-0.5B和1.5B）及两个任务（数学推理GSM8K与摘要任务CNN/DailyMail）上分别评测，并进行真实硬件开销与准确率分析。同时补充分析了两类训练时定层决策方法（LayerRoute、LayerDrop）。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，SWIFT在四组实验中有三组表现出最好准确率，ConfLayers总体被全面压制，尤其在较大模型的数学推理上表现非常差。SWIFT在去除搜索开销后推理速度较ConfLayers更快（加速5-21%），但SWIFT的搜索开销波动较大（最高28.7%），ConfLayers较小且稳定。训练定层方法在速度有限提升的代价下，准确率远不及动态决策方法，尤其LayerRoute在数学推理上几乎失效。
AI.conclusion: 动态周期性决策的跳层方式是目前效率与性能兼顾的优选，SWIFT整体优于ConfLayers，训练时路由方法虽有少量加速但实用价值有限。文中公开了详细的评测协议，为后续同类方法比较提供了标准模板。

title: Instruction Distillation: Text Instructions as Visual Examples
summary: Visual in-context learning (ICL) with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is effective for fine-grained visual classification, but each retrieved image example consumes several hundred context tokens, making large-$K$ settings prohibitively expensive at inference scale. We propose Instruction Distillation: an offline procedure in which the MLLM itself generates, for each individual training image, a structured identification instruction encoding general appearance cues, features that differentiate the class from visually similar ones, and a common confusion point. Unlike prior work that produces a single description per class, our instructions are generated per training image, preserving the intra-class visual diversity that per-class descriptions collapse. At inference time, we study five configurations sharing a single CLIP retrieval index: zero-shot, image ICL, instruction-only ICL, and two hybrid variants in which retrieved neighbors are split between images and instructions. Across seven fine-grained benchmarks and two MLLM backbones, instruction based pipelines match, or exceeds image ICL at $K{=}1$ and reduces per-query tokens by $2.9\times$ and inference latency by $3.3\times$ at $K{=}5$. Hybrid configurations further show that visual and textual ICL signals are complementary, images give visual patterns to learn and see, while instructions give explicit rules and logic. When both of these are provided, the quality of context improves, which is noticeable in the performance.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种叫做Instruction Distillation的离线方法，使用结构化文本指令替代图片进行视觉上下文学习，大幅减少推理时依赖的token数和延迟。
AI.motivation: 目前多模态大模型在精细视觉分类任务中需要大量图片作为上下文，但每张图片需要消耗大量token，导致大K（检索样本数）场景下推理成本极高。作者希望找到提升效率的方法。
AI.method: 提出Instruction Distillation方法：利用MLLM为训练集中的每张图片自动生成结构化识别指令，包括外观特征、与其他类区分特征以及常见混淆点，每幅图像单独生成，保持类别内多样性。推理阶段，设计了多种方案：仅用图片、仅用指令和图文混合，全部共享同一个图像检索索引。
AI.result: 在七个精细分类数据集和两个主流多模态大模型上实验，发现基于指令的方法在K=1时与仅用图像方法表现相当甚至更好，K=5时token数量和推理延迟分别降低2.9倍和3.3倍。混合配置结果进一步说明图像和文本指令信息互补，能共同提升上下文质量和模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过对每张图片生成结构化指令替换图片上下文，可以在显著降低推理资源消耗的同时保持甚至提升模型性能。图文混合方案进一步优化了精细视觉分类任务中多模态LLM的推理质量和效率。

title: Toward Trustworthy Robot-Assisted Sliding Palpation for Shallow Vessel Localisation with a Calibrated Digital Twin
summary: Reliable localisation of shallow subsurface vessels is important for safe robot-assisted venous access and vessel-aware manipulation, but collecting diverse tactile data on physical hardware is costly, time-consuming, and can degrade soft vision-based tactile sensors. We present a robot-assisted sliding-palpation framework in which a calibrated digital twin generates labelled tactile sequences, reducing reliance on real-world data. The twin models sensor-vessel contact, is calibrated against real palpation trajectories using Bayesian-optimisation-based domain adaptation, and is randomised over sliding direction and contact conditions. A spatio-temporal graph neural network trained on simulated marker trajectories performs per-node vessel classification and produces a human-verifiable top-view localisation map through 2D-to-3D-to-2D geometric projection. We evaluate three datasets: Sim, Silicone, and Meat, the latter a raw-meat phantom with vessel models at nominal depths of 0 to 30 mm, using four train-to-test configurations: Sim to Sim, Sim to Silicone, Sim to Meat, and Meat to Silicone. The calibrated twin achieves a simulated-to-real marker-alignment mean absolute error of 0.50 mm at deepest contact across four canonical interactions. After reprojection onto a 1 mm top-view grid, predicted vessel pixels lie on average 1.05 to 5.49 mm from the nearest true vessel pixel across the four models, with 1.05 to 1.31 mm for all except Sim to Meat. The larger error for Sim to Meat reflects the greater domain shift and current limit of simulation transfer. These results demonstrate progress toward trustworthy tactile palpation through calibrated simulation, interpretable localisation, and transparent cross-domain evaluation. Code, model weights, and data are publicly available on GitHub and Zenodo.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种机器人辅助的滑动触诊框架，利用经过校准的数字孪生模型生成标注的触觉数据，从而减少对实际硬件触觉采集的依赖，并在多种数据集和配置下获得了较高的定位精度。
AI.motivation: 浅表血管的可靠定位对于安全的机器人静脉穿刺和与血管相关的操作至关重要。但在真实场景中，收集多样的触觉数据不仅耗时且昂贵，还可能损耗软性基于视觉的触觉传感器。因此，开发一种减少实际采集依赖、又能提升定位可靠性的模拟方法尤为重要。
AI.method: 构建了一个机器人辅助的滑动触诊系统。采用校准过的数字孪生体生成带标签的触觉序列，使用贝叶斯优化实现对仿真模型的域自适应校准，并在滑动方向和接触条件上引入随机性。训练了时空图神经网络对2D标记轨迹进行血管分类与空间定位，通过2D-3D-2D的几何投影实现人类可验证的二维定位图评估。
AI.result: 在Sim、Silicone 和Meat三类不同的数据集以及四组训练-测试配置下，校准后的数字孪生体在模拟与真实标记对齐上的平均绝对误差为0.50毫米。在1毫米网格的顶视定位图中，预测血管像素距离真实血管像素的平均距离为1.05至5.49毫米，多数模型在1.05至1.31毫米间。Sim到Meat的较大误差归因于域转移的难度。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过校准模拟、可解释的定位和透明的跨域评估，推动了可信任的机器人触觉滑动触诊系统的进展。代码、模型权重和数据已公开，促进研究复现和进一步发展。

title: Latent-Space Intervention for Cross-Lingual Factual Consistency: Consistency Improvements without Accuracy Drops
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often answer the same factual question differently across languages. We study whether cross-lingual latent-space intervention can reduce this inconsistency. We train layer-specific autoencoders on parallel multilingual representations and apply inference-time corrections to factual QA prompts. We find that latent intervention improves geometric alignment between languages, and that this improvement translates into consistent gains in cross-lingual consistency with English across both open-ended and multiple-choice QA formats, without degrading factual accuracy. In open-ended QA, Spearman's rank correlation between English and non-English languages improves substantially, with gains of 0.16 for English-Arabic and 0.20 for English-Russian pairs. In multiple-choice QA, answer agreement with English improves consistently across both KLAR and mParaRel. Ablations show that AE reconstruction yields consistent gains at no accuracy cost, while PCA projection contributes marginally, and mean-shift produces substantially larger consistency gains in open-ended QA at the cost of some accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出针对大语言模型在跨语言事实问答中回答一致性不足的问题，通过引入跨语言潜空间干预，有效提升答案一致性而不影响真实性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）在多语言环境下，同一事实问题往往会得出不同答案，体现出跨语言一致性差，这对多语种应用场景中的可靠性和公平性构成挑战。
AI.method: 作者在并行多语言表示上，针对模型特定层训练自动编码器（autoencoder），并在推理阶段对事实问答提示进行潜空间修正。进一步通过不同干预策略（如AE重构、PCA投影、均值漂移）验证一致性提升效果。
AI.result: 该方法提升了不同语言潜空间的几何对齐度，并带来跨语言一致性提升：在开放式问答中，英语与阿拉伯语、俄语的一致性排名相关系数分别提升0.16和0.20；在多选问答中，答案一致性也有持续提升。分 ablation 结果显示，autoencoder重构效果最稳定且不损失准确率，PCA提升有限，而均值漂移提升高但准确率略有下降。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言潜空间干预能够系统性地提升大语言模型在多语问答中的跨语言一致性，在不牺牲问答准确率的前提下，为多语大模型在现实应用中提供更高可靠性。

title: State-Conditioned Visual Evidence Retrieval for Fine-Grained Perception in Document Vision-Language Models
summary: Compared with typical vision-language tasks, document parsing places stronger demands on fine-grained visual perception. Existing vision-language model (VLM)-based parsing approaches rely on globally compressed visual tokens, where fine-grained details are entangled within a single representation and repeatedly accessed during decoding. However, we observe that the visual evidence for each prediction is typically localized and conditioned on the current decoding state, whereas such representations must be accessed in full at every decoding step, resulting in inefficient computation. To address this mismatch, we formulate perception as state-conditioned visual evidence retrieval (SCVER) during autoregressive decoding. The model operates on a compact global representation for coarse structure and retrieves a small set of relevant high-resolution regions conditioned on the current token state. This coarse-to-fine design enables on-demand access to fine-grained visual cues, relieving globally shared representations from encoding all fine-grained details. We further find that learning such state-conditioned retrieval in VLMs is challenging and unstable. To stabilize this process, we introduce a Spatially-Guided Learning Objective (SGLO) to guide the retrieval process. Experiments on document parsing benchmarks show that SCVER improves robustness under reduced input resolution and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off, demonstrating the effectiveness of on-demand visual evidence retrieval for fine-grained perception.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新方法SCVER，通过在视觉-语言模型中引入状态条件的视觉证据检索机制，实现了文档解析任务中对细粒度视觉感知的按需访问，有效提升了解析准确性和效率。
AI.motivation: 文档解析任务对细粒度视觉感知要求更高，但现有方法采用全局压缩的视觉token，导致细节混杂在单一表示中，计算效率低下。本文旨在解决细粒度信息检索与高效解码之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 提出SCVER方法，在序列解码过程中，通过状态条件化从全局表示中检索局部高分辨率区域进行细粒度感知，同时引入空间引导学习目标（SGLO）以提升检索学习过程的稳定性。
AI.result: 在文档解析基准测试上，SCVER在降低输入分辨率条件下提升了鲁棒性，并在准确率与效率之间取得了更优的平衡。
AI.conclusion: SCVER实现了基于需求的细粒度视觉证据检索，有效提升了视觉-语言模型在文档解析任务中的表现。

title: SMILE: Smooth Motion for Improved Long-Horizon VLA Execution
comment: Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models reduce inference cost by executing multiple actions per call, but longer horizons often degrade accuracy because raw chunks contain jitter and outliers. We introduce SMILE, an architecture-preserving interface that predicts B-spline coefficients and decodes them into smooth action sequences. SMILE changes only the action representation, enabling longer fixed horizons while retaining each baseline's backbone and model scale. We apply SMILE to SmolVLA, Evo1, VPP, and DAWN, improving accuracy and amortized inference efficiency across LIBERO, CALVIN, and real-world experiments. SMILE-Evo1 reaches 98.0% with a 1.1x speedup on LIBERO, while SMILE-VPP reaches an average length of 4.42 with a 1.5x speedup on CALVIN.
