At a matched execution horizon of 10, SMILE-SmolVLA reduces non-boundary acceleration by 78.6% and velocity sign-change rate by 42.3%. Real-world xArm tests show higher success, fewer drops, and fewer contacts. These results establish smooth coefficient-space generation as a route to accurate, efficient long-horizon VLA execution. Project page: jongwoopark7978.github.io/smilevla

AI.tldr: 提出SMILE方法，通过用B样条（B-spline）系数平滑表示连续动作，有效提升VLA模型在长时序任务中的准确性和推理效率，同时保持原有模型结构不变。
AI.motivation: 传统VLA模型在长时间序列推理时，由于直接输出原始动作序列，容易出现动作抖动和异常点，影响准确率和效率，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: SMILE改变动作的表示方式，采用B样条系数预测与解码，将平滑曲线映射为动作序列，插值过程消除抖动。接口形式易于集成进各类VLA模型（如SmolVLA、Evo1等），无需更改骨干网络。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、CALVIN等任务和现实场景里，SMILE显著提升了动作平滑度和准确率，同时通过减少推理轮次显著加速推理（最高1.5倍），如SMILE-Evo1在LIBERO达到98%准确率，SMILE-VPP在CALVIN平均动作长度4.42，且二者推理速度均优于原始方法。
AI.conclusion: B样条系数空间生成动作序列可有效提升VLA模型长时序高效推理能力，具备实际落地价值，为长时序场景下的多模态模型执行提供新范式。

title: No Detectable Change in Side-Level WER from Prompt-Level Context: A Preregistered Ablation on a Production Oral-History Corpus
comment: 31 pages, 1 figure. Preregistered on OSF (https://osf.io/ns49b, DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/NS49B); release materials and dated provider-documentation snapshots in the study component (https://osf.io/9nsvr)
summary: Supplying context at inference time to a large multimodal model is an inexpensive lever for adapting speech transcription to a domain, and earlier results on smaller models reported large gains. This work tested that mechanism where it ships, in the prompt-conditioning layer of a production oral-history transcription tool, on a sample from its own production corpus. Full prompt-level context did not detectably change side-level word error rate (WER), and none of the four preregistered hypotheses was supported. The design was a within-item paired ablation, preregistered with the analysis code frozen by hash before the confirmatory batch was scored; two disclosed gpt-4o pilot sides had been scored earlier, during scorer development. Nineteen cassette sides, about 10.6 hours of degraded 1970s-80s interview audio, were reprocessed through the production code path under three prompt arms, crossed with two deployed commercial configurations, gpt-4o-transcribe and gemini-2.5-flash, and scored against operator-corrected verbatim references. For gpt-4o-transcribe the median paired difference between the full-context and no-context arms was +0.6 WER points, with a side-resampled interval of [-1.1, +1.0]; the Gemini estimates were too unstable to support a comparable negative inference. A post-hoc rerun found run-to-run pipeline variability larger than the confirmatory differences, so effects of that size cannot be resolved from one transcription per cell. An implementation audit verified the manipulation was live, and sequence-alignment analysis found a small improvement on complete context-listed phrases, too small to materially change side-level WER, and for Gemini coexisting with worsened unlisted-token error. Evaluating context mechanisms therefore requires sequence-aligned term-level, insertion, and speaker-label measures alongside aggregate accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了在大规模多模态模型的语音转录任务中，在推理时供应上下文信息对转录准确率的影响，结果发现加入上下文并未显著改善转录的整体错误率。
AI.motivation: 近年来，将上下文信息作为推理时的提示被认为是一种低成本提升语音转录模型在特定领域适应性的途径，且在小规模模型上曾取得良好效果。本研究动机在于验证该方法在实际生产环境下的大型多模态模型的有效性。
AI.method: 研究采用了项目内配对消融设计，并在一实际口述历史转录生产工具的语料上进行测试。供试样本为1970-80年代劣化的访谈录音，分别用三种提示方式和两个商业模型配置（gpt-4o-transcribe和gemini-2.5-flash）转录后，与人工校正转写做比对，采用配对中位数WER差异和区间估算评估效果。
AI.result: gpt-4o-transcribe模型在全上下文和无上下文提示下，侧别WER中位差为+0.6，置信区间为[-1.1, +1.0]，没有发现显著提升；Gemini模型因为估算结果波动过大，无法得出结论。后续分析发现管道内的转录结果波动本身已超过实验中的差异。序列比对分析仅在上下文内短语有极小改善，且对整体WER影响甚微。
AI.conclusion: 该研究未发现生产级多模态转录模型在推理时补充上下文能显著改善整体准确率，建议今后在评测这类机制时，需关注细粒度的术语级、插入错误和说话者标注等多维指标，而不能仅比对整体WER。

title: Beyond Visual Boundaries: Rethinking Scene Segmentation for Movie RAG
summary: Understanding long-form video remains a fundamental challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Sparse frame sampling fails to capture fine-grained visual details, while dense sampling quickly exceeds context length limits. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) offers a promising middle ground by selectively retrieving relevant video segments for grounded generation, yet its effectiveness critically depends on the quality of the video segments used as retrieval units. In this paper, we investigate RAG for movie understanding, which demands story-level reasoning over characters, events, and narrative arcs spanning hours of content. Scene segmentation, a long-studied problem that partitions movies into semantically coherent units, is a natural candidate for defining such retrieval units. We reexamine whether existing methods actually serve this role through comprehensive evaluation on downstream movie understanding tasks, and find that they consistently fail to outperform naive uniform temporal chunking. Our audit of the most standard scene segmentation benchmarks reveals why: current annotations prioritize visually salient transitions over narrative event structure. Motivated by this mismatch, we introduce NarraScene, a narrative-centric scene segmentation dataset annotated with a three-level cognitive taxonomy spanning physical, character, and narrative change, where every valid boundary requires a narrative-level shift. When used as retrieval units, these narrative-grounded segments outperform uniform chunking on downstream movie understanding tasks, suggesting that the central challenge for scene segmentation in movie RAG is not detecting boundaries, but identifying the narrative event units that matter for movie understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了基于检索增强生成（RAG）的视频理解方法，提出现有场景分割质量不足，主张以叙事事件为单位进行分割，并引入新的数据集NarraScene，显著提升了电影理解效果。
AI.motivation: 长视频特别是电影的理解对多模态大语言模型是难题。现有的稀疏采样难以捕获细节，密集采样超出模型上下文长度。虽然RAG方法可通过检索相关片段提升生成质量，但效果取决于检索单元的质量。目前场景分割常用视觉转场作为单元，与叙事结构并不一致，限制了方法效果。
AI.method: （1）系统评估现有场景分割在下游电影理解任务中的表现；（2）分析现有分割基准的数据集，发现其标注侧重视觉而非叙事；（3）基于认知分三级（物理、角色、叙事）引入NarraScene数据集，确保每一边界都有叙事意义，并在RAG框架下测试。
AI.result: 实验发现，现有场景分割方案在电影理解任务上不优于简单的时间切割方案；而用NarraScene为单位进行检索显著提升了下游电影理解表现。
AI.conclusion: 提升RAG电影理解的关键在于定义叙事事件级的检索单元而非传统场景分割，NarraScene等数据集将事件结构纳入边界划分，是推进长视频理解的有效路径。

title: Blind Dexterity: Whole-Body Humanoid Manipulation via Pure Proprioception
summary:
We present blind, whole-body manipulation skills on a Unitree G1 humanoid using only onboard proprioception, without cameras, markers, force-torque, or tactile sensors. Despite this minimal sensing, the trained policies exhibit surprising capability across qualitatively different tasks: push-resilient bipedal walking without IMU feedback, active soccer ball trapping with a foot, seeking and lifting a suitcase by its handle, and mounting a randomly positioned skateboard.
  We argue that these capabilities arise from a key underappreciated signal: the way the joint encoder readouts evolve under purposeful compliant contact, effectively forming a whole-body tactile channel. By generating contact-rich motions, the trained policies actively probe the environment; as a result, task-relevant object state (e.g., pose) becomes increasingly decodable from short proprioceptive histories. We expose this information using compact task-specific state estimators trained alongside, but fully separately from, the policies; their prediction errors decrease rapidly after informative contact.
  Our results indicate that joint encoder-based proprioception, combined with compliant actuation (now widely available on commercial robots and low-cost motors) is already a strong, practical substrate for whole-body dexterous manipulation and interactive perception, and therefore a natural foundation on which richer sensing can be layered.

AI.tldr: 本文实现在没有摄像头、力觉或触觉传感器的极简感知条件下，仅依赖本体感觉传感器，让Unitree G1人形机器人完成了多种高难度操控任务。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人操作广泛依赖于丰富的感知（如视觉、触觉），但这些传感器带来系统复杂度和成本。因此，作者希望探索仅靠低成本、普遍存在的本体感觉（如关节编码器），是否能实现实用且灵巧的全身操作技能。
AI.method: 通过设计与训练强化学习控制器，利用关节编码器信号与合适的柔顺执行方式，促使机器人以积极接触的方式与环境交互。同时，单独训练对任务状态的紧凑估计器，仅利用短暂的本体感觉历史重建物体状态。
AI.result: 实现了多项复杂任务（如无IMU的抗干扰步行、主动控球、箱包提拉与滑板登上任务），验证即便信息有限，通过合适接触策略和本体感觉，也能较好地感知并操控外部对象。状态估计器的误差在有效接触后迅速降低。
AI.conclusion: 关节编码器等本体感觉信号，结合柔顺执行机制，是全身灵巧操作的有效基础，可作为后续添加更多感知手段的天然平台。

title: Moving the Mean Toward the Known Good, Not Beyond It: What Inference-Time Interventions and Weight Consolidation Buy in Open-Ended Generation
summary: What does a generation loop gain from learning on its own verified successes? In cycles of generate, verify, select and LoRA-consolidate on online bin packing, training on value-filtered candidates shifts what the model writes on held-out variants toward value (-1.7 points of excess, p=0.008; -3.1 against a random-consolidation control, p=0.004) while the best observed candidate converges to the classic heuristic's level and no further. A confirmation battery replicates the whole procedure three times, with fresh seeds and a never-consulted held-out set read exactly once: the mean was nearly identical in all three lineages (-2.0, -1.8, -1.9), and after aggregating within held-out variant all seven evaluable variants favored consolidation (p=0.008). The best observed candidate moved to the classic heuristic's level, exactly (0.021028 in all three lineages, for attract and for the random control alike), and never beyond it. A matched SFT-only control shows the supervised anchor, not repulsion from bad candidates, does the concentrating (96% of candidates land exactly at the classic heuristic's level). The tails cut both ways: consolidation lowers the per-candidate rate of better-than-classic candidates (10% to 3.9%) while its larger production yields more such candidates absolutely (5 against 1, on few events). As motivation we report the inference-time ledger that led here: a model-written schematic recap buys judged document integration and nothing buys development; a verifier written into the stream is imitated, 16.4 fabricated verdict lines per notebook. Mean quality among valid candidates can be bought and replicated; the observed best goes to the classic and, so far, never beyond it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究通过让生成模型只学习自证成功案例（即经验证的好结果），在在线装箱问题上，模型能否从中突破传统启发式算法的性能。作者对生成-验证-筛选-整合的LORA循环和对照实验进行了比较。
AI.motivation: 动机在于探索生成模型自证训练（即只用模型自身验证的正样本再训练）是否可以超越经典算法的表现，以及这样做对解的分布和极端值产生的影响。
AI.method: 方法是在在线装箱任务中，应用由'生成-验证-筛选-LORA整合'组成的循环训练流程，并与随机整合及SFT（监督微调）对照组进行比较，整流程包含多次种子和严格未见测试集的复现实验，严格度较高。
AI.result: 实验证明，经过价值过滤整合后，模型输出在测试集上收敛到经典启发式算法水平，且没有突破。同时，整合流程提升了好于经典解的候选生成总量（绝对数量提升，但比例下降）。用SFT锚固，几乎所有候选也收敛在经典启发式水平。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：自证式训练能稳定复制经典解的平均水平，却难以产生更优于经典启发式的创新解。整合提高了高质量候选绝对数量，但整体分布依然受限于传统 heuristics。

title: TopoAgent: A Structure-Aware Perception-to-Reasoning Framework for Diagram-to-Graph Topology Extraction with Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Diagram-to-graph topology extraction aims to extract a graph of entities and their connections from a structural diagram. This task remains challenging for current vision-language models because it requires both fine-grained perceptual grounding and topology-aware reasoning with global consistency. We present TopoBench-180, a human-verified benchmark for diagram-to-graph topology extraction, and TopoAgent, a structure-aware perception-to-reasoning framework for reliable topology extraction using large vision-language models. TopoBench-180 contains 180 structural diagrams spanning Web-style and Network-style categories, paired with canonical graph annotations. TopoAgent progressively extracts the target graph by combining grounded perception, global structural priors, canonical node inventory construction, node-centric local-to-global relation reasoning, and topological consistency enforcement. Experiments on TopoBench-180 show that TopoAgent outperforms strong vision-language model baselines and recent visual reasoning frameworks, especially on edge extraction. More broadly, this work fills an important gap in multimodal structured understanding by establishing a benchmark and framework for diagram-to-graph topology extraction. The benchmark and associated resources will be publicly released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/WayneGuo0011/TopoBench-180.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了用于图结构图谱抽取的基准数据集Topobench-180及结构感知感知-推理框架TopoAgent，有效提升了结构图谱自动化抽取的准确性，特别是在连接关系（边）识别方面。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在结构图谱（如网页结构或网络结构）中实体及其连接关系识别存在困难，尤其难以兼顾精细视觉定位和全局拓扑一致性。因此，缺乏相应的公开基准和解决方案。
AI.method: 构建并人工校验了Topobench-180数据集（含180个结构图及对应规范图注释），提出TopoAgent框架，融合视觉实体定位、结构先验、节点清单构建、节点本地-全局关系推理及拓扑一致性等多阶段感知与推理流程，逐步抽取目标图结构。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，TopoAgent在Topobench-180数据集上优于主流视觉-语言模型和最新视觉推理方法，在边抽取任务表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 本工作首次建立结构图转图谱抽取的基准和分析框架，有效推动多模态结构化理解领域的发展，数据集及资源已开源，并填补了该领域的重要空白。

title: A Sliding Window Filter on the Galilean Group for Consistent Aided Inertial Navigation with Unknown Measurement Delays
comment: Accepted to the IEEE International Conference on Multisensor Fusion and Integration (MFI), Pilsen, Czechia, Sep 2-4, 2026
summary: We study aided inertial navigation when the aiding sensor measurements are subject to an unknown constant delay. The goal is to estimate the delay and navigation state jointly so that delayed measurements correct the trajectory at the appropriate times, yielding a more accurate navigation solution. We formulate the problem on the special Galilean group, which provides a natural state-space structure for aided navigation with uncertainty in both motion and timing. We then examine the observability of joint delay and state estimation and show that, for a single delayed measurement, the model admits an exact symmetry in which a change in the delay can be compensated by a change in the navigation state, leaving the measurement unchanged. Processing measurements individually allows spurious information to `leak' along the corresponding null direction of the measurement Jacobian, producing overconfident and inconsistent estimates. Applying measurements from multiple times together can eliminate this direction when the trajectory is informative enough. Motivated by this result, we develop a sliding window filter that retains a short history of navigation states and applies delayed aiding corrections jointly across the active window. We conduct a series of simulation studies to characterize estimator accuracy and consistency. The simulations demonstrate that an estimator that does not maintain an adequate window can rapidly become highly inconsistent, whereas even a short sliding window markedly improves consistency by providing the temporal support that observability requires.

AI.tldr: 本文针对惯性导航中辅助传感器具有未知常延迟的问题，提出在状态估计中联合估计延迟和导航状态，并引入滑动窗口滤波方法提升一致性和精度。
AI.motivation: 实际惯性导航系统会遇到辅助传感器信号存在不可知的固定延迟，若不能及时准确估计，导航状态修正将无法在合适时间点进行，导致导航解误差增大。因此，需要方法可在存在延迟不确定性时提升导航精度和估计一致性。
AI.method: 作者在特殊伽利略群上的状态空间结构下，联合估计传感器测量延迟和导航状态，分析了在单次延迟测量下观测性存在对称性——延迟与状态可互补改变而不影响观测，使得单次测量信息不可补全，于是设计了基于滑动窗口的滤波方法，将多时刻的延迟辅助测量联合使用，通过窗口长度提升系统整体观测性和估计精度。
AI.result: 通过系列仿真实验证明，未使用滑动窗口的估算器会迅速变得不一致，产生过度自信的估计，而即使窗口较短的滑动窗口机制，也能大幅提升估计一致性，并支持观测性要求。
AI.conclusion: 联合状态和延迟估计时，滑动窗口方法能有效解决常延迟导致的信息缺失与一致性破坏问题，为实际惯性导航系统的高精度定位提供了可行解决方案。

title: VoiceCodeBench: Evaluating Exact Structured-Token Recovery in Automatic Speech Recognition
summary:
Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems are commonly evaluated with word error rate (WER), yet many voice workflows depend on exact written values for identifiers, paths, and measured quantities. A transcript can appear fluent and achieve low WER while corrupting a value that a downstream system must parse, store, or execute.
  We introduce VoiceCodeBench, a benchmark for evaluating exact structured-token recovery in English ASR. It contains 300 human-recorded workplace segments spanning eight workflow domains and 1,482 audited target entities across 26 entity types, each with a canonical written form recoverable from the audio. Under a raw-audio-only protocol, systems receive audio bytes without additional context or metadata. Alongside WER, we evaluate Canonical Token/Entity Match (CTEM), Task Success Rate (TSR), and per-type exact recovery.
  Across 12 baseline ASR systems, lower WER generally corresponded to better structured-token recovery but did not fully determine it: Spearman correlations were -0.73 for both WER versus CTEM and WER versus TSR. The strongest baseline by TSR reached only 68.7%, leaving nearly one third of recordings with at least one unrecovered workflow-critical value. These results show that entity-sensitive metrics are needed to assess whether ASR output preserves exact values that production systems must parse, route, store, compare, or execute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VoiceCodeBench基准，用于评价ASR系统在结构化标记精确恢复上的能力，指出仅关注WER无法衡量关键数值准确性，并给出不同ASR系统在该基准下的表现结果。
AI.motivation: 现有ASR系统主要用WER评价，但实际应用如标识符、路径、数量值等的精确识别对下游系统至关重要。WER低的转录可能在关键值上有误，对后续操作造成重大影响，因此需要一种能评价结构化数据精度的新方法。
AI.method: 作者构建了VoiceCodeBench数据集，涵盖8个工作流程领域、26类目标实体。评测中，在未提供上下文或元数据的前提下，将原始音频输入ASR系统，并采用多种指标（WER、CTEM、TSR及各类型精确恢复率）全面评估ASR输出的结构化数据准确率。
AI.result: 在12个基线ASR系统上，较低的WER通常对应于更好的结构化标记恢复，但相关系数为-0.73，说明WER无法完全代表结构化值精确性。最佳系统的TSR仅为68.7%，即约三分之一语音中的关键数据无法被完整还原。
AI.conclusion: 论文强调ASR评测应引入实体敏感的指标，仅用WER不足以反映ASR输出对关键数据的准确恢复能力，实际生产场景需要关注ASR对结构化信息的精确还原。

title: Stochastic Liquid Deformation Fields: An SDE Generalisation of Closed-Form Continuous-Time Cells for Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting (D-3DGS) reconstructs dynamic scenes by deforming a canonical set of 3D Gaussians through a deformation field of frame time. Replacing its MLP with a stack of Closed-form Continuous-time (CfC) cells-a Liquid Neural Network that solves the Liquid Timeconstant ODE in closed form-gives the field continuous-time behaviour at feed-forward cost. That closed form, however, is only the deterministic limit of a noise-driven system, and drops the stochastic term usually credited for the robustness of liquid networks. We put it back: a small Gaussian perturbation is added to the time gate of every CfC cell, turning the deterministic field into a simple stochastic (SDE) one. The noise is used only during training, needs no solver, and reduces exactly to the CfC when switched off. On the synthetic D-NeRF scenes the stochastic field is on par with the deterministic CfC and beats the MLP baseline on most scenes; on the real-world NeRF-DS scenes the deterministic limit is already best and adding noise does not help. The study thus gives both a clean way to read the CfC field as an SDE and an honest account of when a plain noise term helps and when it does not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在动态3D高斯渲染（D-3DGS）方法中，将时间变换场MLP替换为闭式连续时间（CfC）单元，并引入噪声实现简单随机微分方程（SDE）建模，从而提升部分场景的重建表现。
AI.motivation: D-3DGS借助神经网络（如MLP）建模场景的动态变形，但传统MLP并不具备连续时间特性，且鲁棒性有限。CfC（Liquid Neural Net）能高效实现连续时间建模，但丢失了随机性，因而需要探讨是否可通过引入噪声获得二者兼得的性能，并评估其实际效果。
AI.method: 将D-3DGS的MLP替换为闭式连续时间神经元（CfC），在其时间门控处加入微小高斯噪声，使其表现为简单的随机微分方程（SDE）。该噪声训练阶段生效，推理时可关闭，且无需复杂求解器。实验分别在合成D-NeRF数据集和真实NeRF-DS数据集开展。
AI.result: 在D-NeRF（合成数据集）上，带噪声的SDE方法与确定性CfC性能相当，并多数场景优于MLP基准。在NeRF-DS（真实数据集）上，确定性CfC已是最佳方案，加入噪声无额外收益。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量方式将CfC场建模为SDE，揭示了噪声对强化鲁棒性作用按场景不同效果有异，为Liquid网络建模场景动态提供理论与实践指引。

title: Task-Relevant Feature-Dynamics Fidelity Enables Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Transfer for Robotic Ultrasound Scanning
summary: Robotic ultrasound policies operating directly on B-mode images require extensive interaction data, whereas real-robot data collection is costly and safety-constrained. Simulation provides a scalable alternative, but zero-shot transfer depends not only on single-frame realism but also on whether simulated observations reproduce task-relevant feature changes induced by probe motion. We term this cross-domain consistency task-relevant feature-dynamics fidelity (TR-FDF). Under local regularity assumptions, our contraction analysis shows that greater sensitivity of TR-FDF mismatch to probe motion reduces the effective closed-loop contraction margin, whereas motion-independent errors primarily enlarge the residual error bound. Guided by this analysis, we develop a TR-FDF-oriented ultrasound simulator that combines a shared structural intermediate domain, trajectory-level fixed noise, and few-step conditional flow generation. In phantom experiments, a policy trained exclusively in simulation succeeded in 390 of 400 zero-shot deployments across four target planes. The simulator achieved an FID of 29.66 and generated observations at 67.1 Hz. Controlled interventions, ablations, and baseline comparisons showed that TR-FDF sensitivity complements single-frame realism in predicting zero-shot transfer performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对机器人超声控制策略在B超图像上的迁移问题，提出关注任务相关特征动力学保真度（TR-FDF）的新型超声模拟器，在全仿真训练下实现卓越的零样本迁移与成功率。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人采集超声训练数据昂贵且受安全约束，传统仅注重单帧仿真逼真的方法难以实现策略直接迁移。任务相关特征随探头运动而变，仿真是否能真实再现这些变化成为零样本迁移的关键。
AI.method: 理论分析TR-FDF对迁移性能的影响，证明其敏感性影响系统收敛与误差界。据此，设计具备结构化中间域、轨迹级定噪声和多步条件流生成的TR-FDF导向仿真器。
AI.result: 在仿真环境独立训练的策略于体模实验的4类目标平面部署中取得400次中390次成功。仿真器生成速率67.1Hz，FID值29.66。对比实验显示TR-FDF敏感度优于仅单帧指标预测迁移表现。
AI.conclusion: 只关注单帧仿真逼真度不足以保障策略零样本可迁移性；TR-FDF的合理建模设计对实现高效、有效的超声策略迁移至关重要。

title: Causal Interventions Reveal Typologically Organized Syntactic Mechanisms in Multilingual Language Models
summary: Linguistic theory has long recognized cross-linguistic syntactic regularities, leading to claims that these similar structures are processed by similar mechanisms. However, this hypothesis has been difficult to test empirically due to our lack of fine-grained, manipulable access of human processing mechanisms. In this work, we take advantage of techniques from mechanistic interpretability to study such a question in multilingual LMs. We first isolate language-internal mechanisms before attempting to transfer them cross-lingually. Across four models and three well-studied constructions (subject--verb number agreement, anaphoric pronoun gender agreement, and filler--gap object extraction) we find consistent cross-lingual mechanism transfer. We further find transfer to be graded, with more transfer between more typologically similar languages. We believe our work provides novel hypotheses about cross-linguistic syntactic structures and multilingual processing, and more broadly shows how the study of language models can help inform linguistic theory.

AI.tldr: 本文利用机械可解释性技术，分析多语言语言模型中句法结构跨语言处理机制的共性和转移能力，并发现模型的内部机制具备跨语言迁移性，且迁移程度随语言类型相似度增加而上升。
AI.motivation: 虽然语言学理论早已发现不同语言之间句法结构的共性，但人类处理这些结构的机制是否也相似仍缺乏实证支持，主要因为我们无法细致操控人类的处理机制。
AI.method: 作者采用来自机械可解释性的分析技术，首先在多语言语言模型中定位和分离各语言内部的处理机制，然后检验其能否在不同语言间迁移，涉及四个模型和三类句法结构（主谓一致、代词性别一致和填补-缺口宾语抽取）。
AI.result: 实验显示，不同模型均表现出一致的跨语言机制迁移现象，且这种迁移在类型学上更为相近的语言间更为显著和有效。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出了新的关于跨语言句法处理及模型迁移性的假说，并表明对语言模型的机制分析能为语言学理论提供重要借鉴和新见解。

title: Variable-Granularity Tokenization for High-Resolution Object Detection
summary: ViT detectors fix a uniform token grid before any learned stage. A native-resolution aerial detector must then choose between resolving few-pixel objects and staying inside compute and memory limits. We introduce VGTok, a training-free tokenizer that sets patch granularity per region from pixels, ahead of the encoder. VGTok scores each region by multi-scale morphological top-hat separability from its surround, then thresholds those scores at a per-image percentile, which fixes the token budget. A structure-tensor gate ($λ_{\min}$) refines only where two-dimensional object structure supports it, leaving one-dimensional clutter coarse. The resulting token set is a strict partition of the image. In a Co-DETR detector with an EVA-02 ViT-L encoder, VGTok clears every published VisDrone-val AP and AP$_S$ at every budget from 40\% to 100\% of tokens. At 40\% it records 44.22 AP with three fifths of the sequence discarded before the first transformer block; dense, it reaches 48.38 AP, $6.08$ above the strongest published entry. VGTok transfers to AI-TOD-v2 untouched, same scorer and same rank, and sets a new state of the art at 37.27 AP and 19.51 AP$_{vt}$. As a pure drop-in into a frozen checkpoint it reaches 36.29 AP at 78.5\% of tokens, above every published entry, where our 376.3M-parameter detector clears a 3.0B multi-expert model. We show that a token budget fixed before the backbone, from local separability and structure geometry alone, holds accuracy on the tiny-object regimes that dominate aerial detection, at $3.1\times$ less encoder compute and $1.9\times$ less encoder memory. Code and models are available at \href{https://github.com/khayrulbuet13/vgtok}{\texttt{github.com/khayrulbuet13/vgtok}} and \href{https://huggingface.co/khayrulbuet13/vgtok}{\texttt{huggingface.co/khayrulbuet13/vgtok}}.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种训练无关的区域自适应切分方法VGTok来优化ViT检测器在航拍小目标检测中的性能，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算和显存开销。
AI.motivation: ViT检测器通常在特征提取前对图像进行均匀切分，这导致在处理高分辨率航拍图像和小目标检测时，要么牺牲分辨率、要么超出计算资源限制。作者希望用区域自适应方式解决分辨率和资源消耗的矛盾。
AI.method: 提出VGTok分词器：　1）对图像不同区域按像素级别自适应设定patch粒度，通过多尺度形态学top-hat分离性对各区域打分；2）按每张图像分数分位数设定token数量预算；3）依据结构张量门控进一步只细化有明显2D结构的位置，对杂乱无结构区域则保持粗糙。最终形成严格互不重叠的token划分，显著减少输入ViT的token数。
AI.result: 在Co-DETR(EVA-02 ViT-L)主干下，VGTok在VisDrone-val数据集上各token预算下皆超越已有最佳AP/APS记录。40% token时得44.22AP，最密集用100% token时达48.38AP，比以前最优高6.08分。在AI-TOD-v2直接迁移同样表现出色，纯接口替换也能在token大幅减半下超越SOTA大模型。总体达到3.1倍计算、1.9倍显存节省。
AI.conclusion: VGTok可作为训练无关、纯接口的ViT兼容分词方法，在高分辨率航拍小目标检测领域，仅靠区域可分离性和结构信息就能大幅压缩ViT输入，显著降低资源消耗且提升/保持检测精度，有望推广至相关高分辨率场景。

title: AGM: Achievement-Grounded Memory for Closed-Loop Agents with Frozen VLA Policies
summary: Frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies offer broad manipulation skills but execute open-loop action chunks without tracking task progress, so the agent cannot reliably decide whether to continue, retry, or terminate. External memory is a natural remedy, yet it can be harmful when attempted actions are treated as completed progress, turning local execution errors into persistent task-state errors. We propose Achievement-Grounded Memory (AGM), a lightweight closed-loop framework for frozen VLA policies that represents a task as a subgoal sequence with a progress pointer and advances this memory only after the current subgoal is verified by physical evidence. Proprioceptive interaction cues decide when to verify, while coherent point tracking and language-conditioned cross-view comparison, sourced from frozen foundation models through a single 2.43M-parameter verification head, decide what was achieved. AGM thereby converts open-loop execution into a closed loop of execution, verification, and progress, keeping the policy frozen without test-time large-model inference. On the RoboMME Counting benchmark, AGM reaches on PickXTimes and on BinFill, surpassing the strongest memory-augmented baseline by points on average, and the framework yields equally decisive gains on a physical robot. Reliable embodied memory thus depends more on disciplined state updates than on memory capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种称为Achievement-Grounded Memory (AGM) 的轻量级闭环框架，用于提升冻结视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在机器人任务中的进展追踪与决策能力。通过将任务分解为子目标，并利用物理证据验证实现，将原本的开环执行转变为执行、验证和推进的闭环流程，从而显著提升任务完成的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前冻结的VLA策略虽然具备较强的通用操作能力，但执行中无法跟踪任务实际进展，容易因无法判断是否应继续、重试或终止，而导致任务状态长期出错。为此，需要一种既能记忆进展又能避免执行误差积累放大的可靠机制。
AI.method: AGM方法将任务表示为子目标序列，通过设置进度指针，并仅在当前子目标获得物理证据验证后才推进进度。具体做法包括：基于本体感觉交互决定验证时机，利用冻结大模型获得的点追踪和语言条件化多视角逻辑比较通过一个精简的2.43M参数验证头判断完成状态。同时，整个流程无需测试时调用大型模型，保持策略本身冻结。
AI.result: 在RoboMME Counting基准测试中，AGM方法在PickXTimes和BinFill任务上均显著超过最强的带记忆增强的基线，平均提升数个百分点；在实际物理机器人上也取得了同样确定性的提升。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的机器人记忆与状态更新机制相比于单纯的记忆容量更为重要。AGM闭环方案能够在不更新大模型的前提下，有效防止执行误差积累，提升了复杂任务中的操控与决策可靠性。

title: Leveraging Turn-taking Dynamics for Intent Recognition in Multi-party Conversations
comment: Accepted for publication at EMNLP Industry Track 2026
summary: We propose a multi-task learning approach for multi-party dialogue intent recognition that leverages an auxiliary task that models turn-taking dynamics. Specifically, we introduce turn-transition entropy, a self-supervised target computed from the sequence of speaker transitions, which quantifies the predictability of interaction patterns. Experiments on multiple pre-trained models demonstrate that incorporating this auxiliary task improves intent recognition performance, outperforming existing approaches which ignore multi-party interaction dynamics. We find that our proposed continuous target can be learned as a single-task objective, suggesting that it is an actual signal carrying useful information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于多任务学习的新方法，用于多方对话中的意图识别，通过引入转接熵这一自监督辅助任务显著提升识别效果。
AI.motivation: 以往多方对话意图识别方法忽视了说话者间的交互动态，导致识别效果有限。作者希望通过引入能够刻画交互可预测性的辅助信号，提升意图识别性能。
AI.method: 提出了转接熵（turn-transition entropy）作为辅助任务，通过分析说话者轮换序列自动生成该熵值，用于量化互动模式的可预测性，在多任务学习框架下与意图识别任务共同训练。实验使用多个预训练模型进行验证。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，加入转接熵辅助任务后，模型在意图识别任务上的表现优于忽视多方互动动态的现有方法。此外，实验证明该连续型目标本身可作为单任务学习目标，表明其携带了有用信息。
AI.conclusion: 引入自监督的转接熵辅助任务，不仅显著提升了多方对话意图识别的性能，还揭示了交互动态信号的有效性。未来意图识别任务可进一步利用交互模式变化。

title: MANTLE: A Framework for Adaptive In-Situ Planetary Perception Using a Modular Uplink Principle
summary: Planetary surface exploration missions rely increasingly on autonomous robotic platforms capable of interpreting complex terrain to ensure safe navigation, enable targeted science, and improve operational efficiency, as demonstrated across past Mars missions from Viking through Perseverance. Among the key perception capabilities, landform classification provides contextual information for landing site selection and scientific analysis, while boulder segmentation supports hazard assessment and path planning. This paper presents MANTLE, a multi-task adaptive network for terrain and landform extraction. The model uses a shared DINOv2 backbone for high-level feature extraction with task-specific heads: a classification head for large-scale landform classification, and a segmentation head for pixel-wise boulder localization, each trained on curated datasets built respectively from HiRISE orbital imagery and MSL surface-level imagery. The classification head achieved a test accuracy of 92.56% across seven Martian terrain classes, while the segmentation head achieved a validation IoU of 0.753 and showed strong cross-sol generalization on a held-out test set from previously unseen rover traverses. A key advantage of MANTLE is its modular, extensible design, formalized here as the Modular Uplink Principle: only a shared, frozen backbone needs to remain onboard, while subsequent perception capabilities are trained on Earth as lightweight task-specific heads and uplinked without retraining the full model. This work demonstrates two such high-impact capabilities, terrain classification and boulder segmentation, as an initial realization of a framework built to support many more over a mission's lifetime. With this foundation, future explorers need not arrive on Mars fully formed, but can continue to learn, adapt, and grow more capable with every uplink.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了MANTLE系统，一种基于多任务自适应神经网络的行星地表分类与巨石分割方法，显著提升了火星探测机器人地形理解能力及可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 推动火星与其它行星机器人自主探索，需要机器人具备对复杂地貌的智能识别能力，以提升导航、路径规划及科学采样的安全性和有效性。现有方案多为单一任务或缺乏模块化扩展，不适应长期、跨任务演化需求。
AI.method: 提出MANTLE框架，采用共享的DINOv2特征提取主干，配合针对性任务分支：一为基于HiRISE卫星影像训练的大尺度地貌分类头，一为基于MSL地面影像训练的像素级巨石分割头，二者分别处理分类与分割任务。
AI.result: 地貌分类模块在7类火星地形上测试准确率达92.56%，巨石分割模块验证集IoU达0.753，并能泛化至新路径数据集。MANTLE框架通过保持主干冻结，仅在地面训练任务头后上载，实现灵活扩展能力。
AI.conclusion: MANTLE展现了高精度、可模块化更新的行星地表多任务感知能力，为未来行星机器人持续学习和自适应能力打下了基础，可在任务期内不断增添新感知功能。

title: Module Number Adaptive Visual Shape Control for Serial Modular Soft Robots
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. This articles has been submitted to a IEEE Journal
summary: Image based shape control provides a simple means of controlling the whole body configuration of soft robots. However, existing data driven approaches are typically developed for fixed robot structures and require new control data when the number of modules changes. This paper presents a module number adaptive visual shape control method for serial modular soft pneumatic robots. A controller trained only on single module actuation shape data is reused for robots with one to five modules by decomposing whole body camera images into local module patches. A single common module segmenter localizes individual modules across all tested configurations, while the same local controller is applied to every extracted patch. Geometric data augmentation improves transferability to downstream modules, and a lightweight mask reconstruction network reconstructs a synthetically removed actuator mask channel. Experiments on physical robots demonstrate shape control across varying numbers of modules and under environmental changes and payload loading. The results show that single module control learning enables scalable whole body control without configuration specific control data collection.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于视觉的软体模块化气动机器人形状控制方法，实现了无需为不同模块数量单独采集控制数据即可适应多模块结构。
AI.motivation: 现有图像驱动的软体机器人形状控制方法通常只适用于固定结构，当机器人模块数量变化时需重新采集数据，限制了其扩展性和实际应用。
AI.method: 作者采用将整体机器人图像分解为各局部模块图像的方式，仅使用单模块驱动学习到的控制器，通过一个通用分割器识别各个模块区域并分别应用同一控制策略。引入几何数据增强提高下游模块的适应性，同时用轻量化的遮罩重建网络恢复去除的执行器通道。
AI.result: 在物理机器人平台上，通过实验验证了该方法能在不同模块数量、环境变化及负载下实现鲁棒的形状控制，且无需针对每种配置重新采集和训练控制数据。
AI.conclusion: 单模块控制学习与视觉分解方法能有效实现模块数自适应的软体机器人总体控制，为多配置软体机器人带来了高扩展性和实用性。

title: The Hallucination Signal Is a Mean Shift: Why Simple Probes Suffice
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 20 tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code: https://github.com/js-lee-AI/LayerMix
summary: Hidden-state probes effectively detect LLM hallucinations, but the geometry of the signal remains poorly characterized, driving increasingly complex probe architectures. Across three 7B-scale models and three datasets in a paired-example paradigm, we find the signal overwhelmingly dominated by a single mean-shift component, and removing this direction collapses detection to chance. Shrinkage linear discriminant analysis closes about 73% of the gap between 1D and full-dimensional classifiers, so apparent architectural complexity largely reflects high-dimensional covariance estimation difficulty rather than exploitable non-linearity. A simple L2-regularized logistic regression (0.952 AUROC) bounds or outperforms twelve controlled architectural alternatives, and our multi-layer aggregation exceeds CLAP cross-layer attention probing under matched paradigm. Because the signal spans a contiguous layer band, LayerMix aggregates it to match oracle-layer performance without oracle access. Our claims characterize the geometry within the controlled paired-example paradigm. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/LayerMix.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）隐藏状态探测器检测幻觉（hallucination）信号的几何特性，发现信号主要由单一均值偏移主导，简单方法已能取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 尽管隐藏状态探测器在检测LLM幻觉方面有效，但其信号几何结构尚不清晰，推动了越来越复杂的探测器架构。本文旨在揭示该信号实际的几何结构，为简化模型结构提供依据。
AI.method: 作者在3个7B规模模型、3个数据集，采用成对范例，分析隐藏状态信号的几何信息。利用主成分移除、Shrinkage线性判别分析等技术，评估不同维度与不同结构探测器的表现。提出了一种简单的L2正则化逻辑回归和LayerMix多层聚合方法，并与12种探测器架构和CLAP等方法对比。
AI.result: 实验发现隐藏状态信号的检测主要被单一均值偏移主导，移除此方向后检测效果归于偶然。Shrinkage LDA方法缩小了1维与全维检测性能73%的差距，复杂架构的提升主要来源是高维协方差估计难度。简单的L2正则化逻辑回归AUROC达0.952，优于十二种架构对照。LayerMix聚合可在无oracle访问的情况下接近最佳层表现。
AI.conclusion: LLM隐藏状态信号在成对范式下几何结构简单，主要由一维均值偏移主导，复杂探针无显著增益，推荐采用简单线性模型或LayerMix聚合进行幻觉检测。

title: Inter-3D VQA: A Roadside Multimodal Benchmark for 3D Spatiotemporally Grounded Visual Question Answering
summary: Recent advances in visual question answering (VQA) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled natural-language reasoning over traffic scenes. However, existing benchmarks are largely built from ego-vehicle views or 2D roadside videos, limiting their ability to evaluate 3D-grounded reasoning over real-world distances, trajectories, infrastructure topology, and safety-critical interactions. We introduce Inter-3D VQA, a large-scale roadside multimodal benchmark for 3D spatiotemporally grounded VQA at intersections. Built from synchronized point clouds and multi-view images, Inter-3D VQA contains 407K QA pairs covering lane-level positions, object relationships, motion patterns, and near-miss-oriented interaction reasoning. We further propose Inter-Geo, an MLLM baseline that integrates object- and scene-level aligned LiDAR representations, and Inter-Metrics, a unified evaluation framework for textual consistency, numerical accuracy, and semantic correctness. Experiments show that Inter-Geo outperforms image-based VLMs, especially on grounded spatial and temporal reasoning tasks. Our benchmark and codes are available at https://github.com/ASU-Suo-Lab/Inter-3D-VQA .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Inter-3D VQA，这是一个面向真实交通路口场景、支持三维空间和时序推理的大规模多模态视觉问答数据集，并提出了基线模型与评测框架。
AI.motivation: 现有VQA和多模态大模型的交通场景推理数据集局限于车载视角或2D视频，难以评估模型对3D空间关系、真实距离、轨迹和关键交互的推理能力。
AI.method: 作者构建了Inter-3D VQA数据集，通过同步点云与多视角图像采集交通路口场景，生成了40多万个问题-答案对，涵盖车道位置、物体关系、运动模式及高风险交互推理。此外，提出了基线模型Inter-Geo，将激光雷达的物体与场景表征融入多模态大模型，并设计了统一评测框架Inter-Metrics，衡量文本一致性、数值精度和语义正确性。
AI.result: 实验证明，Inter-Geo在3D空间和时序推理任务上明显优于仅基于图像的视觉大模型，展现出更强的空间、运动理解能力。
AI.conclusion: Inter-3D VQA为评测和推动MM大型模型在复杂交通三维场景推理方面提供了新的标准和工具，对未来交通理解、机器人和自动驾驶研究具有显著推动作用。

title: $\mathcal{N}_0$-Foundation: Towards the Age of Tactile Intelligence
summary: We present $\mathcal{N}_0$-Foundation, a paradigm for tactile-enabled embodied manipulation, which integrates tactile sensing hardware, large-scale multimodal data, tactile representation learning, and standardized evaluation. First, we engineer the infrastructure for scalable data collection, including a vision-based tactile sensor, a tactile Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI), and a synchronized visuo-tactile data collection system supporting both robot embodiments and UMI-based demonstrations. Leveraging this infrastructure, we construct NeoData, which contains more than 30000 hours of synchronized visual and tactile demonstrations, spanning six embodiments, 450 tasks, and billions of paired RGB and tactile frames collected through a mixture of real-robot teleoperation and UMI-based demonstrations. To facilitate open research, we further release OpenNeoData, a 5000-hour open-source subset of NeoData. The dataset addresses a central limitation of existing manipulation corpora, critical for deformable-object manipulation, precise assembly, delicate force control, and sustained surface interaction. Capitalizing on the large-scale, heterogeneous tactile measurements, we propose NeoForce, a visuo-tactile representation model that learn transferable tactile representations across different sensor designs. To enable systematic evaluation of tactile embodied models built upon our infrastructure, datasets and tactile representations, we further propose a comprehensive benchmark, which combines the real-world NeoReal suite and the simulated NeoSim suite for standardized evaluation. Experiments across both suites show that policies benefit from the physical contact state rather than from the device-specific appearance of the tactile signal. We release the dataset, the representation, and the benchmark, aiming at supporting future work on tactile-enabled embodied manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套完整的触觉感知支持的物理操作平台，包括硬件、数据集、表示学习方法和评测基准。作者开发了规模化数据采集系统，构建了史上最大规模的视触觉演示数据集NeoData，并提出了跨传感器通用的触觉表示模型NeoForce，还推出了全面的真实与仿真验证套件，实现了标准化评测。相关资源全部开源，推动触觉感知机器人领域发展。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人操作任务依赖视觉，但在处理变形物体、精细装配、力控制等复杂场景时，缺乏大规模高质量的触觉数据和统一的评测、通用表示模型，阻碍了触觉感知的研究进展。本研究旨在突破上述瓶颈，建设支撑触觉操作的基础设施。
AI.method: 1）开发同步的高精度视觉-触觉数据采集系统，包含自主设计传感器与UMI接口；2）采集并整理超大规模、跨设备、跨任务、跨场景的NeoData数据集及开源子集OpenNeoData；3）提出NeoForce通用触觉表征学习方法，实现跨不同触觉传感器的表征迁移；4）设计涵盖真实与仿真场景的标准化评测套件NeoReal和NeoSim。
AI.result: 实验证明，在真实与仿真环境下，使用本文平台和模型的操作策略显著受益于真实物理接触感知，而非仅仅依赖传感器的外观，所提出的NeoForce模型实现了在多种触觉设备间的良好迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 本文打造了触觉感知机器人研究的基础设施，提出了通用触觉表征模型和标准评测平台，全面推动了触觉赋能的机器人操作研究。所有数据、模型和评测工具皆向社区开放，便于各种后续研究。

title: VocalAffectBench: Evaluating Vocal Emotion Recognition in AI Audio Models
comment: 6 pages, 6 tables. Benchmark, baseline predictions, and aggregate results are publicly available
summary: Voice products increasingly need affective cues that are present in speech but absent from transcripts. We introduce VocalAffectBench, a public, test-only benchmark for evaluating whether AI audio models can identify expressed vocal emotion from raw audio. The benchmark contains 273 human-recorded English WAV clips from 51 speaker accounts totaling 1.95 hours across seven labels: angry, disgusted, fearful, happy, neutral, sad, and surprised, with 39 clips per class. All baselines are evaluated from audio alone, without transcripts or contextual metadata. Across six released baselines, average accuracy is 35.5%. The strongest baseline, gemini_3_5_flash, reaches 46.5% on the seven-way task, above the 14.3% random baseline but far from robust emotion recognition. A secondary valence-bucket analysis maps labels into positive, neutral, and negative classes, excluding surprised because its valence is ambiguous. Aggregate accuracy under this coarser view is 50.9%. Performance is highly uneven across classes. By recall, neutral is identified most reliably at 75.6% averaged across baselines, while surprised and fearful reach only 10.7% and 15.4%, respectively. These results show that the evaluated baselines can extract some affective signal from speech, but discrete expressed-emotion recognition remains fragile, especially for non-neutral emotions that are often most important in voice agent workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并公开了VocalAffectBench基准，用于评估AI音频模型从原始音频中识别情感的能力。结果显示目前主流模型效果有限。
AI.motivation: 语音产品亟需情感识别能力，但目前大多数系统仅基于文本，缺乏对实际语音中情感的捕捉和评估工具。因此，作者希望推动语音情感识别的研究与测评。
AI.method: 构建了VocalAffectBench基准，包含7类（愤怒、厌恶、恐惧、开心、中性、悲伤、惊讶）共273条、51个说话人的英语语音片段。所有基线模型均仅基于音频（无文本或元数据）进行评测。
AI.result: 六个基准模型的平均准确率为35.5%，最优模型gemini_3_5_flash在七分类任务上准确率为46.5%，高于随机猜测（14.3%），但距离实用水平尚远。在三分类（消极、中性、积极）任务上准确率为50.9%。不同情感识别效果差异很大，中性最高召回率为75.6%，惊讶和恐惧最低。
AI.conclusion: 当前音频模型能提取部分情感信号，但情感识别仍非常脆弱，尤其是对非中性类情感。研究和应用落地需进一步提升模型性能。

title: FairReL: Deepfake Detection using Fairness-Aware Representation Learning
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at BMVC 2026. Code: https://github.com/xiaoman89/FairReL
summary: Although recent deepfake detectors achieve high overall accuracy, their errors remain unevenly distributed across demographic subgroups, with real faces from certain groups more often misclassified as fake. Existing fairness-aware detectors typically regularise the entire feature representation, without identifying or controlling the specific components that drive unfair predictions. Such coarse intervention can over-suppress useful forgery cues while leaving demographic structure in component-specific subspaces. To address this, we identify two subgroup-sensitive components: multi-scale spatial features, which encode local facial and forgery patterns, and fine-tuning-induced residual features, which adapt the backbone to the unfair training distribution. We propose FairReL, a fairness-aware representation-learning framework that targets both components with dedicated demographic supervision. FairReL uses an SVD-decomposed foundation-model backbone to isolate the fine-tuning-induced residual representation, and introduces two complementary losses. Group-Conditional Wavelet Decorrelation (GCWD) suppresses subgroup-imbalanced structure across spatial wavelet sub-bands, while Subspace-Localised Mean Alignment (SLMA) aligns subgroup means within each real/fake class in the residual representation. Experiments on FF++, Celeb-DF, DFD and DFDC show that, against the state-of-the-art fairness-aware detector, FairReL improves unseen-dataset AUC by 3.9% while reducing subgroup FPR disparity by 10.2%. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaoman89/FairReL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FairReL，一个针对deepfake检测公平性的表征学习框架，能够更有效减少对不同人群的误检率差异，并提升数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 当前deepfake检测器在总体准确率高的同时，对不同人口子群体的错误率分布不均，某些群体的真实脸部更容易被误判为伪造。现有方法只粗略地正则化整体表征，难以消除这种不公，且可能损失了关键伪造信息。
AI.method: 本文分析了影响公平性的两个关键表征成分：多尺度空间特征和微调残差特征。提出FairReL框架，基于SVD分解分离出微调残差特征，并设计两种损失：GCWD用于抑制空间子带上的亚群不平衡结构，SLMA用于在残差子空间内对齐真实/伪造每个类别的亚群均值。整个过程引入群体相关监督。
AI.result: 在多个deepfake数据集（FF++、Celeb-DF、DFD、DFDC）上的实验表明，FairReL相比最新的公平性检测方法，在未见数据集上AUC提升3.9%，同时子群间FPR差异减少10.2%。
AI.conclusion: FairReL能更好地针对影响公平性的关键特征独立干预，在提升泛化能力的同时，有效降低不同人群之间的误检差异。

title: VeloBins: Learning Velocity and Its Uncertainty via Bins and Error-Conditioned Gaussian Labels for Aerial Inertial Odometry
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/QkZY0So3myw
summary: Inertial odometry (IO) is critical for aerial robots, where aggressive maneuvers and poor lighting degrade visual sensors. Recent learning-based IO methods improve traditional integration-based approaches by learning motion priors from IMU and platform-specific sensors, then fusing the predictions within an extended Kalman filter. However, learning velocity through regression is difficult, while jointly estimating uncertainty with a separate decoder and negative log-likelihood (NLL) loss further complicates training and can lead to over-confident estimates. We introduce VeloBins, which reformulates velocity regression as classification over discretized velocity bins. We decode both the velocity from the bin distribution's expectation and the uncertainty from its variance, removing the need for a separate uncertainty decoder. We further supervise the uncertainty explicitly using an error-conditioned Gaussian label centered at the ground-truth velocity, with a standard deviation set to the velocity error. We evaluate VeloBins on four aerial datasets, ranging from free-form aggressive flights and a 27 g nano-quadrotor to drone racing at over 21~m/s. VeloBins achieves the lowest average errors on all four datasets, reducing velocity, relative trajectory, and absolute trajectory errors by 3-27%, 8-40%, and 6-53%, respectively, compared with the strongest baseline. Notably, the proposed supervision achieves the lowest NLL and best filter consistency despite never optimizing an NLL loss. The code will be available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为VeloBins的新型惯性测程方法，通过将速度回归问题转化为离散分类任务，并直接从分布期望和方差解码速度及其不确定性，有效提升了无人机在复杂环境下的惯性导航精度和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的惯性测程方法受限于速度回归训练难度及不确定性解码复杂度，导致系统可能产生过于自信的估计，影响导航安全和精度。因此，亟需更简洁、有效的不确定性建模与估计方法。
AI.method: VeloBins将速度回归问题重构为离散速度区间的分类任务。速度和不确定性直接由分类分布的期望和方差解码，无需单独的不确定性解码器。此外，采用以真实速度为中心、误差为标准差的高斯标签对不确定性进行显式监督，实现了更合理的不确定性学习。
AI.result: 在四个涵盖激烈飞行动作和多种平台的数据集上，VeloBins在全部任务中均获得最低误差。与最优基线相比，速度、相对轨迹和绝对轨迹误差分别降低3-27%、8-40%、6-53%。在未优化NLL损失的前提下，VeloBins依然实现了最优的NLL指标和滤波器一致性。
AI.conclusion: VeloBins极大提升了惯性测程的精度及不确定性建模的有效性，简化了训练流程，并展示了其在实际无人机高动态任务中的应用潜力和技术优势。

title: CoVA-SFT: A Large-Scale Dataset for Chain of Visual Abstractions
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has dramatically improved large language models (LLMs) by allowing them to decompose problems into intermediate steps. While CoT is widely effective for linguistic tasks, text-only CoT forces models to serialize visual problems into awkward prose. Although architectural solutions exist to process visual inputs, the community lacks a massive, multi-step, self-corrected dataset to teach models how to build and maintain internal visual workspaces when solving purely textual reasoning problems. To address this limitation, we introduce CoVA-SFT, a highly structured corpus of 51.9K samples containing over 222K multimodal reasoning steps across 5 distinct layout families and 17 complex tasks, and CoVA-Bench, a companion benchmark of 1,700 held-out test samples spanning the same tasks for reproducible evaluation. By providing explicit rationale formulations, agentic renderings, and verification loops, CoVA-SFT teaches multimodal language models to interleave text and visual abstractions. We validate the dataset by demonstrating that models fine-tuned on CoVA-SFT outperform all interleaved CoT baselines by more than 2x on average on CoVA-Bench, though they still fall short of strong text-only CoT baselines, highlighting open challenges for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套新的、多模态推理数据集CoVA-SFT及其对应评测集CoVA-Bench，用于训练和评估大语言模型在文本与视觉抽象交错的任务中的推理能力。通过显式推理步骤、结果验证等机制，提升模型在该领域的推理表现。
AI.motivation: 当前的链式思考(CoT)推理方法多针对文本任务有效，但处理视觉相关问题时，仅用文本序列化视觉信息很不自然且有限。同时，缺乏大规模、多步、自我校正的数据集，限制了模型学习如何在推理中构建和维护内部视觉工作空间。
AI.method: 作者构建了CoVA-SFT数据集，包含51,900个样本、222,000多个多模态推理步骤，涵盖5类布局和17种复杂任务。同时提供了对应的评测集CoVA-Bench。数据集设计注重显式推理过程、视觉-文本交替表达及自验证环节，使多模态模型能够进行更自然的多步推理。
AI.result: 在CoVA-Bench评测集上，经过CoVA-SFT微调的多模态模型，在所有交错式CoT基线任务上的平均性能提升超过2倍，但在某些情况下仍未超越最强的纯文本CoT基线。
AI.conclusion: CoVA-SFT和CoVA-Bench为多模态推理领域提供了重要资源，有助于推进模型对视觉-文本融合推理的学习。实验显示新数据集有效提升了模型能力，同时也揭示了进一步优化空间。

title: ClearText-Video: A Large-Scale Text-Centric Video Dataset Bridging Video Restoration and Scene-Text Enhancement
comment: This paper is accepted by 2026 Proceedings of the European Conference on Computer Vision
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently made strong progress in visual--linguistic understanding. However, their performance on text-centric video reasoning remains highly sensitive to input quality. Real-world user-provided videos often contain motion blur, compression artifacts, noise, and low-resolution text, which impair reliable text reading and downstream reasoning. Whether MLLMs can robustly read and reason about real-world scene text under diverse quality conditions remains a fundamental open question. We introduce ClearText-Video (CTVid), a large-scale, scene-text-aware benchmark for studying text-centric video understanding under controlled quality variation. CTVid contains 4,639 real-world text-rich egocentric videos, 550K+ frames, 1.6M human-verified scene-text annotations, and 220K+ spatial/temporal question--answer pairs in Chinese and English. For each high-quality video, CTVid provides content-matched Degraded-Quality and Restored-Quality variants, supporting two task families: Text-Centric Video Restoration and Multi-Quality VideoQA. We evaluate 18 representative restoration methods and 16 state-of-the-art MLLMs on CTVid. The results show that visual enhancement does not guarantee textual fidelity or downstream reasoning gains: blur is more damaging than low resolution, restored videos can alter the textual evidence used by MLLMs, and OCR-only pipelines remain far below direct multimodal reasoning. CTVid exposes the gap between video restoration and text-grounded understanding, providing a rigorous foundation for restoration-aware, quality-robust text-centric video systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个场景文本感知的大规模视频数据集CTVid，用于研究多模态大模型在不同视频质量下的文本推理能力，并系统评测了主流的视频增强和多模态理解方法。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在视觉与语言理解方面取得进展，但在实际低质量场景文本视频上的鲁棒性不足。现实中的用户视频常有模糊、压缩、噪声和低分辨率，影响多模态推理的可靠性，需要探索提升其对真实环境的适应能力。
AI.method: 构建CTVid数据集，包含4,639个真实场景文字丰富的视频及其高质量、退化、修复版本，涵盖中英文问题与答案。在该数据集上系统评测18种主流视频修复方法和16种前沿多模态大模型，比较不同条件下的文本识别和推理表现。
AI.result: 1）视频增强不总能带来文本信息保真或推理提升；2）模糊比低分辨率破坏性更大；3）修复版视频可能改变模型采集到的文本信息；4）单纯OCR方案远远落后于端到端多模态推理能力。
AI.conclusion: CTVid数据集揭示了视频修复与基于文本理解之间的断层，可为开发更鲁棒的、感知质量的视频文本理解系统提供基础，为该领域发展指明了新方向。

title: DriftingVLA: Native One-Step Vision-Language-Action Generation via Per-Dimension Temporal Drifting
summary: Conventional flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models support expressive continuous action generation but rely on multi-step refinement to produce each action chunk, increasing latency in online robot control. To address this issue, we introduce DriftingVLA, a native one-step VLA that generates a complete action chunk with a single action-expert forward pass. Rather than learning a flow field that requires iterative integration at inference, DriftingVLA uses a distribution-drifting objective to learn a direct noise-to-action-chunk mapping for one-step deployment. Since robot action dimensions carry distinct control semantics and distributional characteristics, we further introduce Per-Dimension Temporal Drifting (PDTD). PDTD treats the complete temporal trajectory of each action dimension as a separate drifting unit, enabling finer-grained modeling and shaping of dimension-specific action distributions. This per-dimension decomposition applies only to the training objective; the shared VLA model still generates the complete action chunk jointly, thereby preserving cross-dimensional dependencies. DriftingVLA achieves 98.32% success on LIBERO, 81.09% on RoboTwin 2.0, and 77.67% across six real-world single- and dual-arm tasks, outperforming the evaluated multi-step flow policy and one-step VLA baselines. Native one-step deployment also delivers a 3.36-fold speedup in action-chunk generation, eliminating iterative refinement without sacrificing control performance.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出DriftingVLA，一种原生一步VLA模型，可一步生成完整动作片段，显著提升在线机器人控制速度并优于多步方法。
AI.motivation: 传统流式视觉-语言-动作模型虽能生成连续动作，但需多步推理，每步消耗时间，影响机器人实时响应能力。为解决这一延迟问题，作者希望设计一种能一步输出动作的模型。
AI.method: 提出DriftingVLA：摒弃以往流字段/迭代积分，直接用噪声映射到动作片段，实现一步部署；并创新性引入“Per-Dimension Temporal Drifting (PDTD)”，将各动作维度的时序轨迹看作独立单元进行建模，训练时增强了对各维度差异性的捕捉，推理时仍联合生成完整动作片段。
AI.result: DriftingVLA在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0及六项单/双臂真实任务中，取得98.32%、81.09%与77.67%的成功率，超越多步流策略及现有一步基线；动作片段生成速度提升3.36倍。
AI.conclusion: DriftingVLA通过分维漂移训练目标，实现一步生成动作片段，既保留多维依赖性，又大幅降低推理延迟，提高机器人控制效率和性能。

title: The Illusion of Replacement: Rethinking Specialized Machine Learning Models in the Foundation Model Era
summary: Can the specialized architectures that machine learning has traditionally built for structured data be replaced by language-based models? This question is examined through a review of 159 papers (2016--2026) across nine modalities, with predictive accuracy considered alongside structural representation and computation. A distinction is made between performing a task and preserving and computing the structure that makes the task tractable, and existing approaches are organized into eight representational regimes, ranging from language-only systems to fully specialized architectures. Language-mediated models are found to be highly competitive in specific settings, including extreme few-shot prediction, discretized symbolic tasks, textually annotated knowledge graphs, and large-scale single-modality pretraining. However, whenever structural representation or computation is directly evaluated rather than accuracy alone, no evidence of general architectural replacement is found. Instead, a recurring pattern is observed across independent research communities: when language alone is insufficient, the missing structure is reintroduced through a graph module, structural tokens, specialized attention, or another non-linguistic component. In this sense, specialization more often relocates than disappears. Moreover, although performance of language-based models is improved by scaling, whether the gap to a structure-aware architecture can eventually be eliminated remains untested.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了159篇跨九种模态的文献，评估了语言模型能否取代专门的结构化架构。结论是在结构性任务中，结构表示的需求并未被完全消除。
AI.motivation: 结构化数据的任务传统采用专门设计的架构，而近年来语言大模型在结构任务中表现突出，因此探讨其能否全面替代传统架构具有理论和实践意义。
AI.method: 系统综述了2016-2026年间159篇相关论文，将现有方法按结构信息表达的不同分为八类，从纯语言到完全结构化。并对比分析它们在结构表达和任务预测准确性上的差异。
AI.result: 语言模型在极少样本预测、符号化任务、带文本注释知识图谱、大规模单模态预训练等场景下表现优异。但在需要直接结构表示或计算时，语言模型无法完全胜任，研究发现这些结构往往以其他形式被重新引入。
AI.conclusion: 目前还没有证据证明语言模型能全面取代结构化架构。尽管模型规模提升带来性能改善，但结构感知的差距能否完全弥补仍未知，对结构的需求往往只是迁移而非消失。

title: Beyond Representation Learning: A Systematic Study of Joint-Embedding Predictive Generation for 3D Brain MRI
comment: Preprint, code will be released after review
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) have primarily been developed for self-supervised representation learning. Denoising JEPA (D-JEPA) recently demonstrated strong generative capabilities on natural images, yet the applicability to 3D medical imaging remains unexplored. Building on the D-JEPA framework, we present Med-D-JEPA, a systematic adaptation and evaluation of joint-embedding predictive generation for 3D brain MRI. Med-D-JEPA operates on continuous latent tokens produced by a 3D KL-regularized adversarial variational autoencoder, and combines masked context prediction, representation-level alignment, per-token diffusion, and iterative next-set-of-token sampling. We evaluate unconditional and class-conditional generation quality on BraTS2019 and OASIS-1 datasets; downstream classification utility; and preliminary whole-tumor segmentation on BraTS2020. Across different generation settings, Med-D-JEPA achieves superior or competitive performance compared to several strong baselines on fidelity and diversity metrics. Compared to training with real samples, Med-D-JEPA-based synthetic pretraining improves classification AUC from 0.63 to 0.85 on BraTS2019 and from 0.78 to 0.87 on OASIS-1. In the segmentation study, pretraining on Med-D-JEPA samples improves Dice from 0.74 to 0.80 and reduces HD95 from 13.40 to 9.56 mm. These findings establish joint-embedding predictive generation as a promising direction for 3D medical image synthesis and encourage further research in this direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的3D医学影像生成方法Med-D-JEPA，并证明其在多项图像生成和下游任务中优于其他方法。
AI.motivation: 现有JEPAs多用于自监督学习，近期D-JEPA在自然图像生成上表现优秀，但其在3D医学影像（如MRI）上的应用未被探索，而高质量3D医学影像合成在医疗AI领域至关重要。
AI.method: 作者将D-JEPA框架系统性地适配到3D脑MRI场景，提出Med-D-JEPA。该方法基于3D KL正则化的对抗变分自编码器生成连续潜在token，并结合了掩码上下文预测、特征级对齐、逐token扩散和迭代采样等技术。
AI.result: 在BraTS2019和OASIS-1数据集上，Med-D-JEPA在无条件和有条件的生成质量、多样性和真实性指标上都获得了优越或有竞争力的表现。用于下游分类预训练时，AUC大幅提升；用于分割时，Dice提升且HD95降低。
AI.conclusion: 此方法验证了联合嵌入预测生成在3D医学影像合成的潜力，并鼓励在该方向上继续研究。

title: LARC: Lazy Adaptive Reachability Certification of Robot Manipulator Trajectories
summary: Discrete trajectory checks can miss collisions between sampled robot states. Reachability-based certification bounds motion between states, but uniform time partitions waste computation where clearance is large. We present lazy adaptive reachability certification (LARC), which checks a planned trajectory by bisecting only intervals with an inconclusive clearance test. For piecewise-cubic Hermite joint trajectories, the method bounds link occupancy using midpoint capsules inflated by exact componentwise speed maxima. Certified intervals covering the trajectory provide continuous-time external-obstacle clearance, subject to geometric containment, static obstacles, and a prescribed margin. On 160 AgileX PIPER trajectories from 80 start-goal pairs, LARC matched all decisions of the fixed-fine baseline at depth nine. It used 20328 interval evaluations (24.8% of baseline work), with a median paired speedup of 10.28x. A separate MoveIt/FCL audit checked 158051 states and detected collisions in 21 direct-interpolation controls, none of which LARC certified. The method reduced computation under a shared certificate model, but 27 of 139 sampled-clear trajectories remained uncertified. The sampled audit cannot independently prove continuous-time clearance.

AI.tldr: 传统对机器人轨迹的离散检测方法可能会遗漏碰撞，本文提出了一种基于可达性、按需自适应细分的连续时间碰撞验证方法（LARC），大幅提高检测效率，同时保证安全性。
AI.motivation: 离散采样无法保证机器人轨迹在各状态之间绝对无碰撞，尤其在采样间隙较大、障碍物复杂时易出错。而全程高精度检测又极度耗时，因此亟需一种既高效又可靠的认证方法。
AI.method: 提出LARC方法：对于轨迹，每次只二分那些清晰度不足无法确认安全的区间；对关节空间三次Hermite曲线，以速度极值扩展中点胶囊，精确包络机械臂运动；当覆盖区间全部通过检测时，即为全程安全（假设障碍静止、几何可包络、具有规定裕度）。
AI.result: 在AgileX PIPER的160条实测轨迹上，LARC结果与既定精细基线方法完全一致，仅用了24.8%的计算区间、速度提升中位数达10.28倍。在更严苛状态采样下，LARC未漏报任何碰撞状态，但依靠不彻底采样无法独立验证连续安全。
AI.conclusion: LARC相较传统方法能大幅减少运算量，并保留连续时间安全性，但若基于采样验证，仍有部分“安全”轨迹无法被证实。

title: Detecting and Guiding LLM-Generated Korean Poetry with Interpretable Form-level Features
summary: LLMs often struggle with modern Korean poetry, producing outputs that resemble "line-broken prose." We address two coupled tasks: detecting whether a Korean poem is human- or LLM-authored, and guiding LLMs to generate poetry closer in form to human writing. We quantify the human-LLM gap along four form-level linguistic dimensions: output length (Volume), the diversity and connective use of line-final forms (Structure Variation), the irregularity of line lengths (Rhythmic Irregularity), and adherence to standard orthography (Normative Adherence). We operationalize these dimensions as five interpretable features. For detection, a logistic regression classifier over these five features attains an average AUC-ROC of 83.60 in zero-shot out-of-distribution detection across seven unseen LLMs, versus 75.84 for the strongest baseline in our comparison, KatFishNet, an absolute gain of 7.76 AUC points and a 10.23% relative improvement; one generator-specific punctuation pattern outside our taxonomy remains a boundary case. For generation, expert evaluation on GPT-5.2 prefers feature-guided poems over the unconstrained baseline, and analyses across GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3 show that targeted length, rhythm, and ending statistics move toward the human distribution. These results suggest that interpretable, language-specific features can bridge the diagnosis and guidance of LLM-generated poetry.

AI.tldr: 本文致力于提升大语言模型（LLM）生成现代韩诗的能力，并提出检测及引导诗歌生成的语言学特征方法。通过五项可解释的形式特征，对模型生成和人类诗作进行区分与优化。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在生成现代韩语诗歌时，常出现“断行散文”的问题，与人类诗歌风格有较大差异。因此，研究旨在：1）检测诗歌是否为人或LLM所作；2）指导LLM生成更贴近人类的诗歌形式。
AI.method: 作者提出四项语言学维度（篇幅、行尾结构变化、行长度韵律不规则及规范性遵守），并据此定义五个可解释特征。通过Logistic回归模型用这些特征进行检测任务，并用特征约束指导生成任务。
AI.result: 检测任务中，基于五特征的Logistic回归在七种未见LLM中平均AUC-ROC达到83.60，优于最强基线KatFishNet。生成任务中，专家更偏好特征引导生成的诗歌，且多项统计特征接近人类分布。
AI.conclusion: 本文表明，语言特定的可解释特征能够有效区分并优化LLM诗歌生成质量，推动机器诗歌更贴近人类创作风格。

title: Blind Stereoscopic Omnidirectional Image Quality Assessment Using Predictive Coding Hierarchy
summary: Stereoscopic omnidirectional images (SOIs) have provided users with newly immersive quality of experience in virtual reality environments. However, developing efficient and accurate perceptual quality assessment metrics for SOIs remains challenging due to many factors such as freely changeable field of views and binocular vision. In this paper, based on the characteristics of the human visual system (HVS), we propose a Predictive Coding Hierarchy-inspired metric (PCH) for blind/no-reference stereoscopic omnidirectional image quality assessment. Motivated by the viewing process of SOIs, the proposed PCH includes a local cyclopean perception module, a global predictive perception module, and a visual quality regressor. First, observers browse different spherical sceneries from viewports, and aggregate the local visual information to infer the perceptual quality of SOIs. Therefore, we extract various viewports, followed by cyclopean conversion and saliency detection to approach the perception and attention of the human brain. After the local aggregation, viewers then infer the global scene in their minds. Based on the binocular mechanism, we fuse left and right views to perform predictive coding hierarchy modelling. Finally, the visual quality regressor is exploited to obtain the ultimate quality score related to both local and global perceptual cues. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed PCH achieves competitive and consistently improved performance compared with state-of-the-art quality assessment methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于预测编码层级的无参考立体全景图像质量评估新方法（PCH），通过模拟人类视觉系统特性，同时考虑局部和全局感知，实现了更高效和准确的质量评价，在多项实验中表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的立体全景图像质量评估方法受限于视场自由变换和双眼视觉机制，难以提供既高效又准确的感知质量评价，因此需要更贴合人类视觉特性的算法来提升评估性能。
AI.method: 作者设计了一个模仿人类视觉过程的框架，包含局部立体视知觉模块（模拟观察者浏览不同视角）、全局预测编码模块（整合左右眼图像进行全局建模）以及最终视觉质量回归器，用于输出综合局部和全局感知信息的质量分数。采用无参考（Blind）方式，无需原始图像，通过视角裁剪、融合与显著性检测来建立模型。
AI.result: 大量实验结果显示，该方法在多个指标上优于当前最先进的质量评估方法，在准确性和鲁棒性方面都有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于预测编码层级的人类视觉感知机制，可以有效提升SOIs的无参考质量评估准确率，为相关虚拟现实应用和图像处理领域提供了有力工具。

title: SmoothRL: Online Reinforcement Learning During Asynchronous Execution
summary: Deploying robot policies in the physical world requires satisfying two fundamental desiderata: reliability and smooth real-time execution. However, deploying state-of-the-art generalist models presents challenges on both fronts. Achieving the precision and robustness required for real-world deployment necessitates sample-efficient online reinforcement learning (RL) to adapt pretrained models. Meanwhile, the increasing scale of robot foundation models has led to higher inference latency. To satisfy real-time constraints under high latency, modern systems adopt asynchronous inference with action chunking, overlapping policy computation with chunk execution to hide latency and enable smooth control. Despite their complementary roles, integrating asynchronous execution with gradient-based online RL remains underexplored. We present SmoothRL, an online RL framework that fine-tunes a pretrained policy within an asynchronous inference loop. SmoothRL follows a value-gradient paradigm, directly updating policy parameters using gradients of the action-value function with respect to policy actions. To enable correct optimization under asynchronous execution, SmoothRL explicitly models the asynchronous inference process during training. Specifically, each generated action chunk is partitioned by frame index into three regions: a committed region, consisting of actions committed by the previous inference cycle; an execution region, containing newly generated actions executed by the robot; and a discarded region, containing actions superseded by the next inference cycle. Gradients are propagated only through the execution region, ensuring policy optimization aligns with the trajectory distribution induced by asynchronous execution. We evaluate SmoothRL on real-world robotic tasks requiring high precision, as well as highly dynamic tasks that necessitate asynchronous execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SmoothRL，一个在异步推理循环中对预训练策略进行微调的在线强化学习框架。该方法通过显式建模异步推理过程，实现了在高精度和高动态的机器人任务中的平滑、实时控制。
AI.motivation: 现实环境中的机器人策略部署要求高可靠性和流畅的实时执行，但当前通用大模型在精度、实时性等方面仍面临挑战，特别是在异步执行和强化学习结合上探索不足。
AI.method: 提出SmoothRL框架，在异步推理循环中基于值-梯度范式直接更新策略参数。训练时，结合对异步推理过程的显式建模，将每个生成的动作序列分为已提交区、执行区和废弃区，仅对执行区进行梯度传播，保证策略优化和实际异步执行的轨迹分布一致。
AI.result: 在需要高精度和高动态反应的现实机器人任务上，SmoothRL展现了优异的控制效果，有效实现了高效、平滑的策略部署。
AI.conclusion: SmoothRL为异步执行下的机器人在线强化学习提供了一种有效的解决方案，促进了高性能机器人模型在现实世界中的可靠应用。

title: A Unifying Perspective on Language Model Representations: From Filler-Role Structure to Mechanistic Interpretability
summary: A wide range of methods have been proposed for interpreting language models, delivering important insights into their inner workings. However, different methods and their resulting insights stand in relative isolation: what could the underlying structure of language models be, such that they give rise to all our interpretations? In this work, we propose using Tensor Product Representations (TPRs) as a unifying hypothesis. TPRs give a concrete proposal for how compositional structure could be represented in vector space --- as filler-role bindings. We show, both mathematically and empirically, that TPRs can unify several prior interpretability methods: additive analogies, linear probing, sparse autoencoders, and activation patching. Mathematically, we show that these methods can all be derived from TPRs. Empirically, we apply the derivations to a range of different models --- from small toy models to LLMs --- to construct instances of each of the above interpretability methods; these constructed variants perform comparably to their standard variants. We view this work as a step toward what interpretability will ideally provide: a unified account of the nature of neural networks, corroborated not just by individual observations but also by an explanation of the connections between them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用张量积表示（Tensor Product Representations, TPRs）作为解释语言模型的统一框架，并证明多种已有可解释性方法可由此推导，理论和实证均得到支持。
AI.motivation: 现有对语言模型的解释方法众多，但彼此独立且缺乏统一理论，亟需找出解释不同可解释性方法结果的底层结构和联系。
AI.method: 作者提出采用TPRs理论作为统一假设，数学上推导additive analogies、linear probing、sparse autoencoders及activation patching均可由TPRs衍生，再通过实验在多种模型上重构并验证这些方法。
AI.result: 数学推导表明多种主流可解释性技术实为TPRs的不同表现，实验证明基于TPRs构造的这些技术在多个模型上效果与传统方法相当。
AI.conclusion: TPRs有望作为理解与统一解释语言模型内部机制的基础理论，为构建系统性神经网络解释框架奠定基础。

title: A Large-scale Evaluation of Text-guided Models for Facial Editing
summary: Facial appearance editing powers popular applications like FaceApp and Photoshop. Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and 3D Morphable Models (3DMMs) have been widely used for facial editing. GANs can perform varied facial edits (e.g., changing hair color, hairstyle), but often produce unstable edits. 3DMMs produce stable edits, but can only alter pose and facial expression. Recently, text-guided diffusion models like Nano Banana have become popular for image editing. Text-guided models are a compelling alternative to GANs and 3DMMs since they can produce both stable and varied image edits. While text-guided models have been widely tested for whole-scene edits (e.g., ``make the woman play a guitar''), they have not been comprehensively tested for facial editing. We conducted the first large-scale evaluation ($\sim1$M images evaluated) of six popular text-guided models on a sequential facial editing task. We present Face-Edit-Attributes, the largest collection of $169$ facial editing attributes focused on hair, accessories, and pose edits. We compared model performance using two popular celebrity face datasets: CelebA and CelebSET. Our results show that most models performed hair and accessory edits well, but struggled with editing pose. All models over-edit (e.g., changing hair color when asked only to change the hairstyle). We also evaluated demographic biases in each model. Our results show surprising biases in overediting: almost all models created more overedits for dark-skinned male faces and old faces. The code and data for our results (including our repository of $\sim 1$M images) can be accessed \href{https://github.com/rahul1801/Face-Edit-Bench}{\textcolor{blue}{here}}.

AI.tldr: 本论文对主流文本引导扩散模型在面部编辑任务上的表现进行了大规模系统性评测，发现它们在细粒度面部编辑表现有限，还存在明显的群体偏见问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管文本引导扩散模型在整体场景编辑上广泛使用并取得成功，但它们在面部细节编辑上的能力缺乏系统性评估。此前主流GAN方法与3DMM方法各有短板（不稳定或编辑能力有限），有必要探索并分析新兴文本引导扩散模型能否克服这些问题。
AI.method: 作者构建了Face-Edit-Attributes数据集，包含169种关注发型、配饰和姿态的面部属性编辑，使用CelebA与CelebSET两个主流名人脸数据集，针对六种流行的文本引导扩散模型，开展了约100万张图片的大规模序列化面部编辑对比实验，并分析了模型在不同人群上的编辑偏见。
AI.result: 结果显示，主流模型在发型和配饰的修改效果较好，但对面部姿态（如头部转动等）的编辑能力薄弱。所有模型都存在“过度编辑”问题，例如仅要求改发型却连头发颜色也发生变化。并且，模型对深色皮肤男性和老年面部的过度编辑现象更严重，揭示出明显的族群偏见。
AI.conclusion: 文本引导扩散模型虽在部分面部编辑任务中具备潜力，但距离高质量、可控且公平的面部编辑还有较大差距，对功能与偏见问题的进一步研究至关重要。

title: Learning Agile Perceptive Traversal of Sparse 3D Structures for Humanoids
summary: Traversing sparse 3D structures requires humanoid robots to perceive thin, overhanging geometry while executing agile, accurate whole-body motions. We study this problem through monkey-bar traversal, where the robot must jump to the structure, traverse it through sparse bar interactions, and land safely. For this task, we present a reinforcement-learning-based perceptive control system that operates directly on observations from a head-mounted solid-state lidar. To extract task-relevant geometry from the sparse returns, the policy consumes the raw lidar scan through an attention-based encoder with recurrent memory. This policy is obtained by a phase-scheduled teacher- student pipeline that combines privileged experts for jumping up, brachiating, and jumping down. For transfer to hardware, we model lidar noise, battery-voltage sag, and actuator thermal limits, and equip the humanoid with passive hook end-effectors for robust bar interaction. On hardware, the resulting policy completes the full jump-up->brachiation->jump-down sequence in 14 of 15 trials across three bar configurations and reaches brachiation speeds up to 0.5 m/s. Beyond brachiation, the same perception backbone supports a separately trained policy that ducks beneath thin overhead obstacles with 2 cm cross-sections.

AI.tldr: 本文针对人形机器人在稀疏三维结构（如猴子架）中的灵活移动与感知问题，提出了一种基于强化学习的感知控制系统，能够实现跳跃、悬挂向前摆动和安全落地，并在真实机器人硬件上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 在人形机器人任务中，灵活地穿越稀疏、细长且存在悬挂构件的三维结构很具挑战性，尤其是需要高效的感知和全身协调运动，如猴子架的横杠攀爬。这不仅有助于扩展机器人在复杂环境中的适用性，也对机器人感知及运动控制提出了更高要求。
AI.method: 提出端到端的感知与动作强化学习策略，通过头戴式实心激光雷达直接感知环境，利用带注意力机制和时序记忆的编码器处理稀疏点云输入。训练采用阶段性（跳升、摆越、落地）的专家示教-学生迁移方法，并针对实际应用引入了激光雷达噪声、电池电压下降、执行器热限等物理因素，配合被动钩状末端执行器提升交互鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在实物机器人上测试，策略在三种绰号杆布局下共完成15次完整的跳升-摆越-落地任务，有14次成功，最高摆越速度达0.5 m/s。感知主干的能力也支持了机器人在2厘米横截面障碍下的伏地穿越任务。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，该强化学习感知-控制系统能高效执行复杂三维稀疏结构下的人形机器人动作，具备良好的泛化和鲁棒性，为机器人在真实复杂环境中的灵活运动打下基础。

title: RouteSparse: Input-Conditional Pattern Routing for Budgeted Long-Context Prefilling
summary: Dynamic sparse attention can reduce the quadratic cost of long-context prefilling without changing model weights. MInference assigns each attention head one pattern offline and estimates that pattern's sparse indices for every prompt. This design is efficient, but it assumes that a head's preferred pattern and sparsity budget remain suitable across inputs. We introduce RouteSparse, which routes each head and prompt segment among a small library of GPU-efficient sparse patterns. A low-cost probe estimates pattern utility and uncertainty; a latency-aware router then selects a pattern and budget, while uncertain cases fall back to a denser mask. We formulate routing as constrained risk minimization, derive an attention-output error certificate from omitted probability mass, and evaluate the method on long-context retrieval, question answering, summarization, and language modeling. On Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct with 128K-token prompts, RouteSparse achieves $6.5\times$ dense prefill speed with a 0.2-point RULER drop relative to dense attention, compared with $7.3\times$ speed and a 1.6-point drop for fixed per-head routing. Ablations confirm that input-conditional routing, hardware profiling, and selective dense fallback each contribute to the quality--latency tradeoff.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种动态稀疏注意力方法RouteSparse，可在不改变模型权重的前提下降低长上下文前填充的计算成本。RouteSparse通过条件化路由和硬件感知策略，有效提升了推理速度，同时保持较小的性能损失。
AI.motivation: 现有的动态稀疏注意力（如MInference）为每个注意力头固定稀疏模式，效率虽高，但假设每头的模式和稀疏预算在不同输入下都合适，限制了灵活性和性能。针对不同输入，如何动态选取更优的稀疏模式以更好权衡质量和推理速度，是该工作的动机。
AI.method: RouteSparse为每个注意力头和输入片段，在一个GPU高效稀疏模式库中动态路由，采用低开销的探针来估算最优模式的效用和不确定性。根据估算结果，延迟感知路由器为每个查询选择稀疏模式和预算，不确定情形则选用较密集的掩码，并以风险最小化为目标进行路由优化。方法还推导了基于遗漏概率质量的误差证书，指导准确率与速度的权衡。
AI.result: 在Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct和128K-token超长输入中，RouteSparse实现了6.5倍的稠密前填充速度提升，只带来0.2分的RULER性能损失。相比固定每头稀疏路由（快7.3倍但性能降1.6分），RouteSparse在速度和质量之间实现更优权衡。消融实验验证了按输入动态路由、硬件配置感知和部分场景退回使用密集掩码均对最终效果有积极贡献。
AI.conclusion: RouteSparse通过面向输入与硬件动态路由稀疏注意力模式、提供误差保障和选择性稠密退化，用较小的代价显著提升了超长上下文Transformer的推理效率，并优于传统固定模式下的权衡方案，对大模型高效推理具有实践意义。

title: FigMirror: Ground It, Code It, Plot It
comment: Code and data available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/FigMirror
summary: Converting scientific figures into executable code has gained increasing attention, yet existing methods primarily focus on reproducing the reference figure itself. A more practical setting is to plot new data while preserving the visual style of a reference figure (e.g., color scheme and typography). Prior approaches mimic the reference through pixel-level optimization and struggle to carry its style to new data. We show that the key to this task lies in the coordinate grounding and coding capabilities present in modern computer-use models. We propose FigMirror, an agentic framework that unlocks these capabilities through Grounded Measurement, which locates visual elements by coordinates and measures their properties through executable code. We further introduce PlotTwin-Bench, an expert-curated benchmark with fine-grained code and image-level style metrics. Experiments show that FigMirror consistently outperforms existing methods on reference-conditioned style transfer. All plots in this paper are generated by FigMirror, except those produced by other methods for comparison. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/VILA-Lab/FigMirror.

AI.tldr: 提出了FigMirror框架，可实现科学图表的风格转移到新数据，实验优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多关注还原原图，难以将图形风格迁移到新数据上。而科学绘图实际更需将原有视觉风格保持在新数据展示中，当前方法在此方面表现有限。
AI.method: 提出FigMirror代理型框架，通过Grounded Measurement技术，将视觉元素与坐标绑定，并用可执行代码测量属性。此外，设计了新的基准PlotTwin-Bench，包括精细代码和图像级风格评测。
AI.result: 在参考风格条件下，FigMirror在风格转移任务中，实验结果均优于现有方法。文中所有非对比方法生成的图均用FigMirror绘制。
AI.conclusion: FigMirror有效提升了科学绘图中风格迁移到新数据展示的水平，支持社区共享。

title: Sampling-based Certified Planning with Graphs of Convex Sets
summary: Planners on graphs of convex sets return trajectories that are collision-free by construction, provided the convex regions are collision-free. The region generator only promises that property probabilistically, and no planner in the family verifies it. We report the first measurement of what the gap costs. On a scaled 14-DOF bimanual library, $3.2\%$ of interface samples are in collision, and a search-based GCS planner (\gcsstar) turns that volume error into a $62\%$ answer error: $18$ of $29$ pick-and-place queries return trajectories that drive the arms through the shelves, up to $91$\,mm deep, reported as successes. Repairing the library does not work; a ten times stricter acceptance contract, sums-of-squares certified regions, and uniform margins each destroy the connectivity planning needs before they deliver soundness. We instead build a planner that certifies its answers. It samples the overlaps and shared faces of the decomposition, prunes with an admissible informed bound, and verifies the one candidate each search round proposes, continuously, by a chain of clearance certificate balls with no resolution parameter; failures are repaired with local in-region detours, and the convex polish is re-verified. Head-to-head on all $29$ task queries it delivers zero invalid answers against $21$ for the reference, reaches its first certified answer in $0.11$\,s against $1.59$\,s for the reference's unverified one, and reproduces the reference optimum exactly on every query whose reference answer is physically valid.

AI.tldr: 本文测量了传统GCS路径规划器因凸区域概率性碰撞导致的实际路径无效问题，并提出了一种带验证的规划器，显著提升了解的有效性和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于凸集图的路径规划不验证凸区域无碰撞性，仅概率保证。实际应用中，这导致路径实际碰撞但被误判为有效，影响机器人操作安全与可靠。作者首测量此差距带来的损失，驱动提出解决方法。
AI.method: 作者首先统计了典型GCS库中接口点的实际碰撞率，并观察基于GCS的规划器如何将这一小概率碰撞率放大成大比例的错误轨迹（62%的任务答复碰撞）。他们尝试收紧区域生成标准，但发现这会破坏规划所需的连通性，无助于提升可靠性。最终作者设计了一种新型规划器，通过采样重叠面、使用可采纳的界约束筛选解候选，并对每一步规划路径做无分辨率参数的连续碰撞验证，必要时局部修复，再次验证。
AI.result: 新方法在全部29个任务上实现0个无效路径（对照组21个无效），且首次给出可验证解比对照组更快（0.11秒 vs 1.59秒）。物理上可行的任务两方法最优解一致。
AI.conclusion: 传统GCS方法在实际环境中容易误判可行路径，难以用更严格的凸域生成弥补。所提带验证方法能高效、可靠地产生完全检验的安全路径，提升了自动规划的实际适用性。

title: Not All or None: Dynamic Construction of Target-aware Memory Graph for Conversational Stance Detection
summary: Stance detection is crucial for understanding the underlying attitude of an expression towards a target. Conversational stance detection is a more challenging stance detection task in real-world social media scenarios, as it involves detecting the user's stance by leveraging the target-related historical statements across conversational sessions. In this paper, we propose target-aware Memory Graph TamGraph, a novel method that dynamically leverages target-related statements for conversational stance detection. Instead of considering all preceding historical conversations or using no prior conversation information for stance detection, our TamGraph employs a stepwise, entropy-guided backtracking mechanism to selectively activate memory from historical conversations and dynamically constructs a target-aware graph to model the stance relations among utterances. This allows the exploitation of target-related information from the conversation history for stance detection while preventing the introduction of noise. Experimental results on both English and Chinese benchmarks demonstrate that our TamGraph substantially improves LLM performance on conversational stance detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的面向目标的记忆图方法TamGraph，用于提升对话立场检测的效果，通过动态选择性激活对话历史信息，显著提升了大模型对对话立场检测任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 在实际社交媒体场景中，对话立场检测因需结合目标相关的对话历史而更为复杂，现有方法要么忽略历史信息，要么无差别利用全部历史信息，存在引入噪声和无法捕捉关键信息的问题。因此作者提出一种更精细地利用历史信息的新方法。
AI.method: 作者提出TamGraph方法，利用逐步、信息熵引导的回溯机制，针对不同目标选择性地激活与目标相关的历史对话信息，并动态构建面向目标的图结构，刻画各句子之间的立场关系，从而提升立场检测准确性并减少噪声干扰。
AI.result: 在英文和中文主流对话立场检测基准数据集上，TamGraph方法相比现有大语言模型显著提升了立场检测效果。
AI.conclusion: TamGraph能更有效地利用历史对话中的目标相关内容进行立场检测，证明了该方法对提升对话立场检测准确率的有效性。

title: Text-Driven Artistic Staging: Pose, Lighting, and Camera References from Paintings
summary: Artists coordinate human pose, illumination, and camera placement to convey narrative and emotion, but existing generative methods typically model these elements independently. We introduce text-to-editable 3D staging, a task that jointly generates human poses, a dominant light, and a camera configuration from an affective description. We construct 11,911 text--staging pairs from 2,328 figurative paintings by reconstructing SMPL bodies, estimating low-frequency illumination, recovering camera parameters, and pairing each scene with ArtEmis descriptions. We train a flow-matching transformer that supports variable numbers of figures and produces multiple staging alternatives for each prompt.
