On held-out descriptions, the model achieves 32.2\% retrieval R@1, compared with 16.6\% for CLIP-based nearest-neighbor retrieval, while approximately preserving corpus-level diversity. These results demonstrate the feasibility of generating editable, emotionally conditioned 3D staging references from text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将文本描述转化为可编辑3D场景（人物姿态、主光源、摄像机配置）的方法，为情感和故事叙述提供新型工具。
AI.motivation: 艺术家往往需协调人物姿态、灯光和相机以强化表达，但现有生成方法多为单独建模，缺乏端到端场景表达能力。这限制了基于文本快速生成丰富且准确3D艺术场景的可能性。
AI.method: 作者收集了2,328幅具叙事性的油画，重建人物SMPL骨架，估算主光源和相机参数，并将其与ArtEmis情感描述配对，总计11,911组数据。基于此数据集，设计了flow-matching transformer网络，可灵活处理不同数量人物，对每个文本生成多种3D场景参考。
AI.result: 在未见过的文本描述上，模型的图片检索R@1为32.2%，显著优于CLIP的16.6%。同时生成结果保持了整体风格与内容多样性。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了该方法实现从文字到可编辑情感化3D场景表达的可行性，可支持艺术创作与相关生成任务。

title: Self-Aware Active Learning Enables Continual Improvement in Autonomous Driving
summary: Learning-based autonomous driving (AD) systems can perform reliably in familiar conditions, yet rare distribution shifts and long-tail events remain a major source of abrupt failure. A central limitation is that most agents learn primarily from passive experience and lack mechanisms to estimate when their competence is insufficient, seek timely assistance, and convert safety-critical encounters into targeted improvement. Here we present self-aware guided exploration (SAGE), an active learning framework for post-training adaptation in AD. SAGE learns a predictive world model that generates two online intrinsic signals: fear, which estimates short-horizon predictive risk and model uncertainty, and curiosity, which measures novelty through prediction error. Curiosity adaptively calibrates the intervention threshold for fear, allowing the agent to regulate risk in a context-dependent manner. When predicted fear exceeds this adaptive threshold, the agent transfers control to an expert or fallback policy and uses the resulting takeover trajectories for focused imitation learning. In parallel, fear is integrated into policy optimization and evaluation as a safety-oriented constraint to reduce performance regressions during adaptation. We evaluate SAGE in simulated route-transfer tasks, Waymo-based logged driving scenarios, CARLA occlusion hazards, and real-world mobile robot navigation tests. Across these settings, SAGE improves robustness in novel and safety-critical scenarios, reduces safety violations, and maintains task performance comparable to strong baseline policies. These results suggest that agents can improve after initial training by estimating the limits of their competence, requesting guidance when needed, and learning selectively from rare high-value events.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自主驾驶系统主动学习新框架SAGE，增强系统对罕见场景和安全风险的适应能力。
AI.motivation: 当前学习型自动驾驶系统在熟悉环境下表现良好，但遇到分布偏移或罕见长尾事件时易发生突发性故障。主要原因在于这些系统主要基于被动经验学习，缺乏识别自身能力不足、请求帮助及针对安全关键场景主动改进机制。
AI.method: 提出SAGE（self-aware guided exploration）框架：1）构建世界预测模型，生成“恐惧”（短期风险和模型不确定性）与“好奇心”（通过预测误差衡量新颖性）两个内在信号；2）好奇心自适应调节恐惧的干预阈值，从而使系统能情境感知地管理风险；3）当恐惧超阈时切换至专家或备用策略，通过收集的接管轨迹进行强化模仿学习；4）恐惧信号也作为安全约束融入策略优化和评估环节，防止适应过程中性能回退。
AI.result: 在多种任务验证下（仿真路线迁移、Waymo日志驾驶、CARLA遮挡风险和真实移动机器人），SAGE在新颖和安全关键场景中提升了鲁棒性，降低了安全违规率，同时任务执行力保持与强基线相当。
AI.conclusion: SAGE表明，通过估计能力边界、主动请求引导并聚焦于罕见高价值事件的学习，自动驾驶系统可在初始训练后持续提升性能和安全性。

title: Recognition-Refusal Misalignment in LLMs: Why Models Answer Structurally Unanswerable Questions
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 29 pages, 6 figures
summary: Large language models often answer structurally unanswerable questions, such as computing cot(-540°) or evaluating (1).startswith("1"), instead of abstaining. We ask whether this failure reflects missing recognition or failed routing from recognition to abstention. Across instruction-tuned models from 1.7B to 70B parameters, a single linear direction in the hidden state separates answerable from structurally impossible math and code prompts, showing that models represent impossibility before generation. Yet this recognition direction is nearly orthogonal to the canonical safety-refusal direction that mediates trained harmful-content refusal. An in-domain behavior-defined invalidity-aware direction is closer to recognition, but only partially aligned with it, and remains near-orthogonal to safety refusal. Generation-time steering along the recognition direction changes invalidity-aware behavior bidirectionally and dose-responsively on structural math and code cells, while random directions do not. Base/instruct comparisons further show that the low-cosine geometry is already present at the pretraining endpoint. The confident-on-impossible failure is therefore better explained as a routing failure than as an encoding failure: the model has a usable "no admissible answer" signal, but the safety-refusal pathway is not aligned to use it.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在面对结构性无解的问题时，往往不会选择回避，而是尝试给出答案。本文发现，模型内部实际上能分辨出哪些问题是无法回答的，但这种识别并没有有效转化为拒绝作答的行为，这是路径选择（routing）的失败而非识别（encoding）的失败。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型有时对明显无法回答的数学或代码问题仍自信地回答，而不是选择拒绝。弄清这种行为背后的机制，有助于提升模型的可靠性和安全性。
AI.method: 作者在1.7B至70B参数量的多种指令调优语言模型上，通过分析隐藏状态空间中的线性方向，研究模型在生成答案前是否已区分出可回答和结构性无解的问题，并考察这一“识别方向”与安全拒绝路线之间的关系。
AI.result: 发现存在一条能够明显区分可回答与结构性无解问题的线性方向（识别方向），而这一方向与用于训练有害内容拒绝的安全拒绝方向几乎正交。同时，基于任务内行为定义的无效方向仅部分对齐识别方向，且仍与安全拒绝方向接近正交。此外，沿识别方向实时调整，能双向和剂量响应地影响模型对无解问题的行为。
AI.conclusion: 模型对于“无可接受答案”的问题有有效的内部信号，但该信号并未被现有安全拒绝通路利用，因此模型拒绝无解问题这一能力的缺失，应归因于路径选择失败，而非对不可回答性的编码失败。

title: BlobBoards: Robust Markers for Accurate Pose
summary: We propose BlobBoards, a fiducial marker system comprising a dense, multi-scale field of Gaussian blobs and a feature-based pipeline for joint detection, identification, and pose estimation. Each board is registered from hundreds of blob features whose dense spatial coverage constrains pose, while multiple scales preserve detectability across large changes in focal length, distance, and obliquity. Learned local descriptors are matched to the reference pattern and spatially verified, so the correspondences determine pose and certify identity. Against motion-capture ground truth, BlobBoards achieve median translation errors of 3.6-5.0 mm, reducing AprilTag's median translation error by 89% on small boards and 70% on large ones. They also produce far fewer large-rotation failures than state-of-the-art tag systems. BlobBoards achieve the highest detection rate, 80% versus 74% for AprilTag and 58% for ArUco, with the largest margin on the smallest markers. Under 50% occlusion, they still detect 69% of boards with essentially unchanged median translation error, while AprilTag and ArUco detect none. In experiments BlobBoards give state-of-the-art detection rate, pose accuracy and occlusion robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为BlobBoards的高密度多尺度高斯斑点基准标记系统，通过特征匹配实现高精度的检测、识别和位姿估计，并在多个标准下优于现有的AprilTag和ArUco系统。
AI.motivation: 当前主流的基准标记系统（如AprilTag、ArUco）在小尺寸标记、遮挡和大角度旋转下的检测率和位姿精度存在明显不足，亟需更高密度、鲁棒性强的新型标记解决这些问题。
AI.method: BlobBoards采用高密度多尺度的高斯斑点布局，结合基于学习的局部特征描述子，实现特征级别的密集匹配和空间验证，从而联合完成标记检测、身份确认和位姿估计。
AI.result: 在与专业动作捕捉系统对比实验中，BlobBoards显著降低了位姿估计误差（如在小型板中将translation误差下降89%），大幅减少了旋转大角度下的检测失效，并在遮挡50%情况下仍保持较高的检测率和精度，优于AprilTag、ArUco等系统。
AI.conclusion: BlobBoards在检测率、位姿精度、遮挡鲁棒性方面均达到或超过当前最优水平，是性能全面领先的新一代基准标记系统。

title: EMERGE-Policy: A Robot Mind Emerges Beyond a Single Policy
summary: A robot's effective ``mind'' need not reside in a single policy. It can emerge when specialized components perceive, reason, predict, act, verify, and remember within a shared orchestration process. EMERGE-Policy turns this perspective into a graph-structured agentic framework that coordinates both capability invocation and information exchange. A Main Agent retains task-level state within an active context window, while role-specific Sub Agents process perception, execution monitoring, verification, and memory consolidation in isolated contexts and return structured, task-relevant evidence. Role-specific contexts control information load by exposing only decision-relevant evidence to the Main Agent, while the functional Skill interface composes heterogeneous backends as Operational, Imagination, and Evaluation Skills. Criterion-grounded verification, textual failure diagnosis, and Branch Stack recovery provide localized correction, with token-aware external memory preserving task-relevant state. Together, their closed-loop interaction realizes the system-level policy captured by the name EMERGE-Policy. Without additional fine-tuning, we achieved outstanding performance on several public benchmark that have had a wide-reaching impact, and conducted a series of real robot experiments. These system-level results suggest that through the division of different functional sub-tasks among multiple agents and their concurrent collaboration, as well as the technical paradigm where the model is regarded as a skill and called within the framework, EMERGE-Policy can extend the robust robot policies beyond isolated runs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种称为EMERGE-Policy的新型机器人智能决策框架，将机器人的“心智”分解为多个专职模块（如感知、推理、执行监控等），通过图结构和技能接口协作，实现更强大的系统级策略，无需额外微调即在多项基准测试与真实机器人实验中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 传统机器人多采用单一决策策略，难以应对复杂、动态环境，对信息处理与功能拓展有限。作者旨在解决如何通过模块化、多代理协作提升智能体的灵活性和稳健性。
AI.method: 采用主代理与分角色子代理组成图结构，各自处理任务相关感知、监控、验证与记忆巩固，决策过程按需交换证据信息，通过技能接口调用异构模型作为不同功能技能，采用基于标准的验证与分支机制实现局部纠错。
AI.result: EMERGE-Policy无需额外微调即在多个公开基准和真实机器人实验中取得卓越表现，技术分工与模型调用方式有效提升策略的健壮性和扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 多代理功能分工与协同，以及模型化技能调用框架，能够显著拓展机器人策略的经历范围与稳健性，有望推动机器人智能的进一步发展。

title: HEAR Who Said What: Unlocking Speaker-Attributed Reasoning via Counterfactual Voice Grounding
summary: Speech Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-speaker environments, yet their ability to attribute speech to the correct speaker and reason over speaker identities remains unclear. Hence, we introduce HEAR, a conceptually hierarchical benchmark diagnosing the foundational capabilities of speaker-attributed reasoning, comprising 2.4K human-verified samples from 887 diverse multi-party audio clips. Evaluating 20 leading SLMs on HEAR reveals they struggle with these foundational tasks, often relying on semantic priors rather than actual vocal cues. To address this, we present A2R, a 30B model optimized on Counterfactual Audio with Speaker-level Hard negatives (CASH), a dataset designed to guide the model to prioritize acoustic vocal cues over linguistic signals. A2R achieves strong performance on HEAR and exhibits zero-shot generalization to diverse multi-speaker downstream tasks, demonstrating that learned speaker attribution unlocks the model's latent capacity for speaker-aware reasoning. All resources are available at https://attributetoreason.github.io/AttributeToReason/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HEAR基准，用于系统评估语音大模型（SLMs）在多说话人环境下的说话人归因与推理能力。结果显示现有主流SLMs对此表现有限。为改进，作者提出A2R模型，利用重构的新数据集CASH训练，在多个任务上实现了更好的说话人感知推理。
AI.motivation: 随着SLMs被广泛应用于多说话人环境，模型能否正确归因说话人并进行说话人相关推理成为关键，但目前尚无系统诊断其能力的基准。该工作旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 作者设计并公布了HEAR基准，由887个多方音频片段的2,400个人工审核样本组成，用以测试和分析SLMs的说话人归因与推理。随后评测了20个主流SLMs。针对现有模型倾向依赖语义而非声学线索的问题，提出A2R大模型，并用包含说话人对照硬负样本（CASH）的新数据集进行优化训练。
AI.result: 20个主流SLMs在HEAR基准上表现不佳，普遍依赖语义信息，缺乏对音频说话人属性的依赖。A2R模型则在HEAR基准上取得优异成绩，并能零样本泛化到其他多说话人任务中，展现了更强的说话人感知与推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 有效的说话人归因对于SLM的推理能力至关重要。通过优化训练，使模型专注于声学属性，显著提升了模型在多说话人场景下的归因与推理能力。HEAR基准和A2R模型为进一步研究提供了新工具和思路。

title: MWIR-4-Plastic: The Identification of Complex End-of-Life Industrial Plastic using Mid-wave Infrared Hyperspectral Imaging and Machine Learning
summary: The automated sorting of shredded black plastics from end-of-life (EOF) industrial waste presents a significant challenge in recycling facilities, primarily due to the limitations of current sensing and analytical approaches. Existing studies predominantly rely on single-point contact-based mid-infrared spectroscopy or laboratory hyperspectral imaging (HSI) setups, which fail to provide the spatially resolved analysis necessary for fast, bulk processing. Moreover, available datasets are laboratory-controlled and focus on intact rather than shredded plastics, hindering further recycling refinement. Black industrial plastics, in particular, are underrepresented, while most classification pipelines depend on manual region selection and rule-based spectral matching, neglecting spatial information and modern deep learning (DL) methods. To address these gaps, we introduce the first publicly available HSI dataset of shredded black plastics from EOF vehicle, comprising four industrial polymers across 13 co-registered RGB, VNIR, SWIR, and MWIR scenes and their segmentation pipeline. We developed a multi-modal spectral-spatial framework that integrates foreground isolation, pixel-wise classification, and object-level majority voting. By adapting advanced hyperspectral transformers from earth observation and incorporating chemometric band selection, we achieve accurate classification of complex black plastics. The study establishes the first comprehensive benchmark using nine processing methods, including chemometric, machine learning, and DL architectures. To ensure reproducibility, the complete dataset and methodologies are publicly released, establishing a benchmark for a hyperspectral object-analysis pipeline in industrial inspection.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种用于回收工厂破碎黑色塑料自动分拣的新型高光谱成像数据集与多模态深度学习分析框架，并首次建立了完整基准体系。
AI.motivation: 当前回收工厂难以高效自动分拣破碎黑色塑料，原因在于现有检测手段主要为单点或实验室环境，不适用于碎片化且批量处理需求，且缺乏公开真实数据集。黑色工业塑料在数据中极度稀缺，导致自动化与深度学习方法难以应用。
AI.method: 作者采集了来自废机动车的破碎黑色塑料的首个公开多光谱数据集（涵盖RGB/VNIR/SWIR/MWIR），并构建了集前景提取、像素级分类与对象级多数投票于一体的多模态光谱-空间分析框架。引入了土壤遥感领域高性能的Hyperspectral Transformer，并结合化学计量学波段选择，提升分类性能。通过9种方法（包括化学计量、机器学习和深度学习）进行了系统性能对比。
AI.result: 提出的数据集和方法可对复杂混合的黑色塑料实现准确分类。实验结果表明多模态深度学习架构（尤其是改进型HSI Transformer）在工业碎片塑料的分拣和识别任务中表现优越。
AI.conclusion: 公布了数据集与全流程，实现了工业黑色废塑料分拣的高效、可复现解决方案，并为今后相关深度学习和分拣系统研究提供了基准和数据基础。

title: System Identification of Admittance Models for Large Real-World Objects
summary: Simulation of admittance-type models requires physically consistent dynamic models that are rarely available for off-the-shelf, everyday objects, limiting the fidelity of haptic interfaces that rely on such simulations. This paper presents the first complete workflow for producing physically consistent models of large real-world objects with various constraints and mechanisms, guaranteeing physical consistency of inertia and friction parameters. The workflow separates each object and identifies the handle and body in two stages, requiring no torque sensors at hinges, axles, or other constrained joints. Models are produced for a heavy, closer-actuated door and a wheelbarrow, representing objects of differing constraint types and model complexity. The door is modeled using four-bar linkage kinematics and a fluid dynamics-based lumped parameter model including opening, backcheck, swing, and latch zones. The wheelbarrow is modeled as a rigid body with a spherical wheel and no slip during rolling. Handle estimation RMS errors were below 0.64 N and 0.042 Nm across both objects. Door body estimation had RMS error of 2.19 Nm and wheelbarrow body estimation had RMS error of 6.77 Nm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套完整流程，用于生成物理上一致的现实大型物体动力学模型，显著提升相关仿真和触觉界面的精度。
AI.motivation: 鉴于大多数现成物体缺乏物理一致的动力学模型，制约了触觉仿真的真实性，因此需要开发通用且物理一致性强的建模方法。
AI.method: 该流程无需在关节处安装力矩传感器，分两阶段识别把手与本体。门采用四连杆动力学与分段流体动力学模型，独轮车则视为无滑动的刚体模型。
AI.result: 把手估算的均方根误差均低于0.64N、0.042Nm；门体与手推车本体的估算误差分别为2.19Nm和6.77Nm。
AI.conclusion: 所提流程可高效准确地产生复杂受限物体的物理一致模型，适用于不同类型约束与结构复杂性的大型现实对象。

title: AI Historian: Helping historians organize and verify person-centred temporal clues from dispersed historical narratives
summary: History is not preserved in complete, continuous form. Accounts of a person's activities, relationships and historical contexts are scattered across texts, chapters and narrative perspectives; historians must retrieve, identify and compare these materials to reconstruct temporal sequences and verify them against sources. Here we present AI Historian (AIH), an AI agent system that helps historians organize person-time evidence from dispersed biographical narratives. It takes source sentences as evidence units, identifies people and temporal cues, verifies candidate cross-text associations and infers comparable temporal ranges while preserving traceable source-text evidence. We evaluated AIH on six Shiji cases concerning Liu Bang, Xiang Yu and Xiao He. AIH Agent achieved a temporal-localization MicroIoU of 86.2%, compared with 81.3% for human-only annotation and 17.1% for direct large-language-model prompting; it required about 14 min, versus 1 h 32 min for human-only annotation. We further applied AIH to the Twenty-Four Histories and other ancient Chinese histories, ancient Japanese and Korean histories, and modern and contemporary historical materials, and released the results through Westlake Historian. These results indicate that AIH can reduce the cost of organizing historical materials at scale while turning connections obscured by chapter-based narration into traceable, revisable research questions for collaborative testing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为AI Historian（AIH）的AI系统，用于高效整理和关联分散的历史叙述中的人物与时序信息。AIH在史记等古今历史材料上取得了比人类标注更高的时序定位准确率，且大大提高了效率。
AI.motivation: 历史事件相关信息常散落于多种文本与叙事视角中，人工整理和时序重建繁琐且易出错，迫切需要自动化方法提升研究效率和可溯性。
AI.method: 提出AIH系统，将原始历史文本句子作为证据单元，借助AI自动识别人名、时间线索，并对跨文本关联进行验证和时间推断，保证信息可回溯可追踪。并与人工和大模型提示法进行了对比实验。
AI.result: 在六个史记案例中，AIH系统的时序定位MicroIoU为86.2%，高于人类标注（81.3%）和直接大模型提示（17.1%）；标注时间显著缩短（14分钟 vs 92分钟）。该方法还成功应用到中日韩古今等多种历史材料中。
AI.conclusion: AIH能够极大降低大规模历史材料整理成本，将原本章节叙事中被掩盖的关联转化为可溯源、可修订与协作验证的研究问题，为历史研究带来新的效率与方法革新。

title: Pixel-wise Geo-registration of Drone and Satellite Images
summary: Pixel-level cross-view geo-registration aims to align a query image (e.g., drone) to a geo-referenced satellite map so that every query pixel can be mapped to real-world GPS coordinates. Despite strong progress in cross-view geo-localization, existing benchmarks largely provide only GPS labels, limiting evaluation to a single coordinate per image and leaving dense geodetic alignment underexplored. We introduce SkyReg, a dataset and standardized benchmark for pixel-level drone-to-satellite geo-registration, providing dense per-pixel geo-location supervision across diverse settings (orthographic and perspective), scene types (urban, landmark-centric, suburban/rural), and camera configurations. Using SkyReg, we evaluate a broad set of baselines spanning retrieval, feature matching, homography-based alignment, and feed-forward 3D reconstruction. Finally, cross-view pairs from SkyReg, we train a geometry-aware reconstruction pipeline that achieves state-of-the-art results,improving performance by a significant margin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SkyReg数据集和基准，用于像素级无人机图像与卫星地图的地理配准评测，为每个像素提供精确地理位置监督，推动更精细的地理对齐研究。实验表明，基于几何感知的重建方法能显著提升对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位任务主要聚焦于图像级的GPS坐标，缺乏像素级地理配准评测手段，限制了高精度地图应用的进一步发展。因此，迫切需要公开像素精度地理标注数据集与评测基准。
AI.method: 作者构建了SkyReg数据集，提供无人机-卫星图像对的像素级地理位置监督，覆盖多种场景与相机视角。评测了多种基线方法，包括检索、特征匹配、单应矩阵与三维重建，并提出基于几何感知的重建方法进行像素级配准。
AI.result: 实验表明，作者提出的几何感知重建流水线在SkyReg数据集上的像素级配准任务中，较现有方法取得了大幅性能提升，实现了新的最优结果。
AI.conclusion: SkyReg填补了像素级跨视角地理配准基准的空白，推动了更细粒度地图配准技术研究，作者的方法也为高精度地理信息应用提供了有力支持。

title: Training-Free Action Correction for VLA Model Failures via Language Feedback
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate strong semantic understanding yet exhibit systematic failures during deployment. The conditions under which these failures occur, and whether they can be corrected without retraining, remain poorly understood. In this paper, we take steps toward addressing this gap. We present CorrectVLA, a framework that translates task-level natural language corrections into additive action magnitude adjustments without modifying policy weights. A human provides a single task-level correction, applied uniformly across all rollouts without per-episode intervention. In simulation, CorrectVLA recovers execution misalignment failures across both in-distribution and OOD tasks. In real-robot experiments on a UFactory xArm7 under environment shift, CorrectVLA restores near-perfect success where the base policy almost entirely breaks down, generalizing across object locations and identities. Through a taxonomy of failure modes on LIBERO-90, we find that execution misalignment failures, where the policy reaches the correct target but miscalibrates action magnitudes, represent the correctable subset, while other failure modes where semantic comprehension itself breaks down are not amenable to this approach. The approach succeeds when policies possess strategic correctness and fails when fundamental comprehension is absent, establishing a practical operational boundary for inference-time correction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需重新训练即可针对VLA模型执行失误进行校正的方法，通过调整动作幅度来纠正策略表现，尤其适用于策略语义理解正确但动作幅度不当的情形。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在部署时经常出现系统性失误，目前尚不清楚是什么条件导致这些失误，以及能否无需重新训练就加以修正。作者希望找到不修改策略权重情况下修正此类失误的有效方法。
AI.method: 提出CorrectVLA框架，可将人类以自然语言描述的任务级别校正转化为动作幅度调整，无需修改策略权重或分集干预，仅需一次统一校正便可作用于所有执行。方法在仿真环境和真实机器人（UFactory xArm7）下进行验证，并在LIBERO-90任务集上归纳故障类型。
AI.result: CorrectVLA能够在策略已具备语义/策略正确性，但动作幅度失调时，有效修正并恢复执行表现，在环境变化下的实际机器人实验中恢复接近完美的任务成功率，对目标位置和身份等具备泛化能力。但如果策略本身语义理解能力不足，此方法无效。
AI.conclusion: 当VLA策略具备‘策略正确性但执行误差’时，无需重新训练，通过操作时校正可有效修正，适用范围为理解到位但执行失衡的情况，不适用于根本性理解错误。

title: Quantifying Error Tolerance in Synthetic Data: An Atomic-level Operand vs. Operator Perturbation Study
summary: Synthetic data generation has become a cornerstone for advancing large language models. However, the lack of the quantitative analysis for error tolerance became a critical bottleneck. Consequently, current filtering strategies fluctuate between two extremes: they are either overly aggressive, risking the exclusion of potentially valuable samples, or overly permissive, failing to eliminate erroneous samples effectively. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces Atomic Tree Operation Modeling (ATOM), a framework that decomposes data into functional units ($f(x)\rightarrow y$). ATOM distinguishes benign Operand $x$ perturbations from fatal Operator $f$ perturbations. The former are needlessly discarded by aggressive filtering, while the latter slip through permissive filtering. Our experiments reveal a double dissociation: models are robust to operand perturbations but collapse under operator perturbations. By prioritizing operator over aggressive operand precision, our ATOM-synthesized data outperforms rigorous baselines (e.g., +3.1% gain over LIMA), suggesting that operator diversity matters more than operand precision. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lut-hub/ATOM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的数据过滤与生成框架 ATOM，有效区分并处理大模型训练中不同类型的数据扰动，提升了生成数据的价值。
AI.motivation: 当前合成数据生成缺乏对错误容忍的定量分析，现有的数据筛选策略要么过于严格（错删有价值数据），要么过于宽松（未能有效过滤错误数据），严重影响大模型的训练效果，成为发展瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 Atomic Tree Operation Modeling (ATOM) 框架，将复杂的数据分解为函数型单元（f(x)→y），区分不可避免的操作符 f 扰动（严重影响输出）与操作数 x 扰动（对结果影响有限）。通过有针对性的过滤，保留有价值的样本，避免误删或错放。
AI.result: 实验表明，模型对操作数扰动较为鲁棒，但对操作符扰动极为敏感。基于该分析，优化了数据过滤流程，ATOM 生成的数据在多个严格基线（如 LIMA）上均表现更优，提升幅度达 3.1%。
AI.conclusion: 精确把握数据扰动类型，优先关注操作符多样性而非操作数精度，可有效提升数据利用率和模型性能。ATOM 框架为合成数据生成和过滤带来了新思路和实证提升。

title: ReconSplat: Generalizable 3D Scene Reconstruction Beyond Observed Views
comment: ECCV 2026. Code and additional visual results are available on our project page: https://visinf.github.io/reconsplat
summary: We introduce ReconSplat, a feed-forward model for 3D scene reconstruction that aims to address the longstanding trade-off between plausible view generation for unobserved regions and geometric consistency, providing both geometrically aligned novel views and sharp depth estimates. Our approach builds on 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) as an intermediate differentiable scene representation and integrates it with a multi-view latent diffusion model (MV-LDM) trained to act simultaneously as a refiner and an inpainter for appearance and scene geometry. We enforce geometric consistency by guiding the diffusion process with variational 3D latent features for appearance and geometry, encoded by the feed-forward 3DGS representation and rasterized to 2D latent space. ReconSplat produces both photorealistic novel views and accurate depth maps on real-world benchmarks, RealEstate10K and DL3DV-10K, outperforming existing methods in challenging extrapolation setups. Notably, ReconSplat allows the extrapolation of unseen and challenging viewpoints jointly with coherent and precise scene geometry.

AI.tldr: ReconSplat是一种结合3D高斯镶嵌与多视角扩散模型的三维场景重建方法，能够生成视图真实且深度精确的新视角，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统三维场景重建在未观测区域的真实感视图生成和几何一致性之间存在权衡问题。作者希望同时实现新颖视图的几何对齐和清晰深度估计，提升真实感和准确性。
AI.method: 以3D高斯镶嵌（3DGS）为中间可微场景表示，和多视角潜在扩散模型（MV-LDM）结合，将3DGS编码为外观和几何的潜在特征引导扩散过程，以实现对场景外观和几何的联合修复与完善。把3D特征栅格化为2D潜在空间，增强几何一致性。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K和DL3DV-10K等实际数据集上，ReconSplat不仅生成了写实的新视图，还输出了准确的深度图，且在复杂视角外推上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: ReconSplat能在保持场景精确几何的前提下，实现对未见视角的高质量外推，兼具真实感和几何一致性，推动三维重建技术进步。

title: MiBOT: A head-worn robot that modulates cardiovascular responses through human-like soft massage
comment: Published at 2024 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
summary: Massage therapy is helpful for the rehabilitation of various diseases, such as headaches caused by migraines and stress. Existing robotic systems have focused on massage therapy on the torso and limbs, but performing massage motions through suitable actuation on a person's head has been a challenge. In this paper, we present MiBOT, a head-worn massage robot that actuates two soft tactors to produce touch motions mimicking human massage. A key design principle behind MiBOT is its silent actuation, which we achieve through pneumatic artificial muscles in conjunction with a controller loop to respond to contact pressure. We evaluated the effectiveness of MiBOT in a controlled study and assessed subjects' blood pressure and heart rate levels while applying MiBOT. We found that our mechanical system generated positive and conclusive quantitative outcomes that are similar to the human-administered massage, decreasing participants' mean systolic and diastolic blood pressure by 2.8 mmHg and 1.7 mmHg, respectively, as well as calming their heart rate by 8-10% on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型头戴式按摩机器人MiBOT，采用气动人工肌肉实现无声按摩，在临床试验中表现出与人类按摩相似的生理益处。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人按摩系统多集中于躯干和四肢，难以针对头部实施有效按摩；而头部按摩对缓解偏头痛和压力引起的头痛有重要作用。
AI.method: 设计并实现了MiBOT，一种通过气动人工肌肉静音驱动、可穿戴于头部并模仿人类按摩动作的机器人。系统包括软性按摩子和压力传感控制回路。通过对受试者进行血压和心率监测评估其疗效。
AI.result: MiBOT能有效降低受试者的收缩压（2.8 mmHg）、舒张压（1.7 mmHg）以及平均8-10%的心率，效果与人类按摩相当。
AI.conclusion: MiBOT作为头部可穿戴无声按摩机器人，不仅能实现接近人工的按摩动作，还能带来实质性的生理放松效果，有望作为未来头部康复治疗的辅助工具。

title: Toward a Cross-Lingual Romanization Ecosystem for Sinitic Languages: A Paired Mandarin-Cantonese Case Study
comment: Accepted to ISCSLP 2026. Tan Lee and Benyou Wang are co-corresponding authors
summary: This paper proposes the Sinitic Romanization Ecosystem, a cross-lingual Sinitic romanization design framework with supporting digital infrastructure and a community-driven open-source workflow. The design framework addresses the lack of systematic cross-lingual romanization alignment among Sinitic languages through four design principles: phonetic correspondence for representing similar sounds with similar romanized symbols, historical-phonological correspondence for aligning cognate romanization strings, one-phoneme-one-symbol, and basic Latin-letter use, with a balancing consideration recognizing trade-offs among these principles. For the main paired case study, we devel-op CantRomZJ1 and MandRomZJ1, Cantonese and Manda-rin romanization schemes following the design framework, respectively. We also develop schemes for several other Sinitic languages, including Meixian Hakka, Shanghai Wu, and Nanjing Jianghuai Mandarin, following the same de-sign framework. To bring the romanization schemes into practical use, we develop open-source infrastructure for structured romanization storage, conversion, parsing, dic-tionary construction, and input-method generation. Finally, we evaluate the design framework through speech-to-romanization experiments based on Meta's Massively Mul-tilingual Speech (MMS) fine-tuning. Compared with the Pinyin+Jyutping baseline, our Man-dRomZJ1+CantRomZJ1 condition reduces Cantonese WER and CER by 7.80% and 10.61%, respectively. These results suggest that cross-lingual romanization alignment can improve transfer in low-resource Sinitic speech technology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“汉语罗马化生态系统”，一个支持多语言汉语罗马字转写的设计框架，并辅以数字基础设施和开源社区流程。通过统一的设计原则，对多种汉语方言制定了一致的罗马化方案，并用实际语音实验验证其效果。
AI.motivation: 当前汉语各方言的罗马化方案缺乏系统性的一致性，对多语种间的跨方言迁移支持不足，影响资源稀缺语言的语音技术发展。
AI.method: 论文提出以四项原则为核心的罗马化设计框架，并据此为粤语、普通话等多种汉语方言开发了一致的罗马化方案，构建了开源数字基础设施和工具链，并通过大规模多语语音模型微调后的转写实验进行效果验证。
AI.result: 新的跨语言罗马化方案（MandRomZJ1+CantRomZJ1）在粤语语音转写上，相比Pinyin+Jyutping基线将词错误率（WER）降低7.80%，字符错误率（CER）降低10.61%。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言一致性的汉语罗马化设计能有效提升低资源汉语方言语音技术的跨语言迁移效果，对推动相关领域发展具有重要意义。

title: Coarse to Fine: Iterative Adversarial Neural Cellular Automata for Medical Image Synthesis
summary: Large-scale, publicly available datasets have driven advances in deep learning, but privacy and legal restrictions often limit data sharing in medical imaging. Synthetic data generation offers a privacy-friendly alternative to enable the training of high-performance models on health data. While most state-of-the-art generative models produce high-quality images, they remain computationally expensive, which limits their applicability on resource-constrained hardware. We propose StyleGANCA, the first lightweight general-purpose NCA-based generative adversarial network. The architecture integrates a StyleGAN-inspired mapping network and adaptive style modulation into a multi-scale NCA synthesis process, enabling latent-controlled image generation through iterative local interactions. We evaluate StyleGANCA on BloodMNIST and PathMNIST against adversarial, variational, diffusion, and NCA-based baselines. Experimental results demonstrate that StyleGANCA achieves competitive image quality with substantially fewer parameters than baseline architectures, achieving the best FID and KID scores on PathMNIST with only 617k parameters. Furthermore, downstream experiments show that the generated images preserve class-specific information and effectively support the training of multi-class classifiers. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/MECLabTUDA/StyleGANCA

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了StyleGANCA，这是一种轻量级的基于神经细胞自动机（NCA）的生成对抗网络，用于医学图像的合成，在生成质量与网络参数规模之间实现了良好的平衡。
AI.motivation: 虽然深度学习依赖大规模公开数据集，但医学影像的数据共享因隐私和法规受限，制约了模型开发。合成数据可作为隐私友好的训练来源，但主流生成模型计算消耗大，难以应用于资源受限硬件。
AI.method: 提出了StyleGANCA网络，结合了StyleGAN的映射网络和自适应风格调制机制，并将其集成到多尺度NCA合成流程中，实现了可通过隐变量控制的迭代式局部图像生成。
AI.result: 在BloodMNIST和PathMNIST两个数据集上，StyleGANCA相比于现有GAN、变分、扩散及NCA基线，在参数量大幅减少的前提下生成出竞争性的高质量医学图像，PathMNIST上达到最佳FID和KID分数，仅用61.7万参数。生成图片也支持多类别分类器的训练。
AI.conclusion: StyleGANCA能以极低参数量生成高质量医学影像，在满足隐私保护的前提下对医学人工智能模型的训练具有实际应用前景。

title: Rethinking Language's Role in Efficient VLA for Autonomous Vehicles: Toward Smarter, Trustworthy Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are reshaping autonomous driving (AD) by unifying perception, reasoning, and control through language, enabling semantic grounding, interpretable decisions, and better long-tail generalization. But language is expensive onboard: latency and memory budgets are tight, and autoregressive decoding is inherently sequential. This work reframes the central question as when and where language should act at inference, since inference cost recurs at every deployed frame while training cost is paid once. We introduce the Language Residue taxonomy to organize methods by their inference-time use of language: train-time-only supervision (L1), latent non-textual reasoning (L2), conditional invocation (L3), and full per-frame generation (L4). We review representative methods and tag each across five deployment axes (latency, parameters, memory, FLOPs, tokens), analyzing them on major open- and closed-loop driving benchmarks (e.g., nuScenes, NAVSIM, Bench2Drive). We further trace how efficient methods from NLP/LLM are adapted in AD, identifying the constraints and motivations driving these adaptations. A continuously updated repository will be available at Github.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在自动驾驶领域的高效推理成本问题，提出了基于推理阶段语言使用的Language Residue分类，并对现有方法在真实驾驶基准上的性能和效率进行了系统分析。
AI.motivation: 随着VLA模型在自动驾驶中结合感知、推理与控制，语言的使用大大提升了决策的可解释性与泛化能力，但推理阶段语言处理带来延迟、内存和计算资源挑战。因此，作者提出需要明确推理时语言的作用及其带来的高昂代价。
AI.method: 作者提出Language Residue分类法，将VLA模型按推理阶段语言使用方式划分为L1（仅训练时语言监督）、L2（推理时潜在非文本推理）、L3（条件性调用）、L4（每帧生成语言），并从延迟、参数量、内存、计算量、token等五个维度对主流方法在多个自动驾驶基准上进行分析与标注。
AI.result: 通过对比分析，作者总结出各类VLA方法在推理效率和部署约束下的优劣势，揭示了部分NLP/LLM高效技术向自动驾驶领域转化时面临的实际限制和动机。
AI.conclusion: 适当减少推理时语言作用可以大幅提升自动驾驶系统的部署效率。合理设计语言介入时机与方式，实现语义可解释性的同时，有助于兼顾性能与资源开销。作者还提供了持续更新的代表性研究方法列表。

title: Toward Cultural Alignment: Human-Centered Evaluation of Multimodal AI Stories Across Five African Communities
summary: In this paper, we examine how well AI-generated multimodal stories align with the lived practices, relationships, language, values, and visual expectations of the communities they represent. We conduct a community-grounded mixed-methods evaluation with 19 culture representatives across five African communities, combining quantitative annotations with qualitative focus group discussions. We find that cultural alignment depends not simply on recognizable cultural markers, but on how those markers fit social, linguistic, procedural, and visual context. From these evaluations, we develop a taxonomy of cultural alignment comprising five broader cultural marker categories and eight recurring mechanisms of misalignment. We additionally evaluate five multimodal LLM judges to examine whether automated evaluation can approximate community-grounded judgments at scale. Judge reliability and score calibration vary substantially across communities, with no single judge performing consistently across all five settings. These findings motivate community-calibrated evaluation pipelines in which automated judges are validated against community judgments to determine where they can be trusted and where human review remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了AI生成的多模态故事与其所代表社区的文化契合度，并开发了分类体系和评价机制。
AI.motivation: 当前AI多模态生成模型在文化表达上常存在脱节，无法准确反映特定社区的实际生活、语言和价值，需要系统性评估与改进。
AI.method: 通过混合方法：包括量化标注和定性小组讨论，邀请5个非洲社区的19位代表参与，对AI生成故事进行文化契合度评价。同时评测5种多模态大模型作为自动判官，分析其评价准确性。
AI.result: 发现文化契合不仅取决于可识别的文化标志，更关系到标志与实际社会、语言、程序、视觉语境的契合。提出5类文化标志及8种失配机制。自动判官的可靠性与评分一致性在社区间差异大，无一模型在所有社区均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 应建立社区校准的自动化评价流程，先由社区判定自动判官的可靠性，只有部分情形可自动化，其他需人工复核，以提升AI内容的文化契合度。

title: mmIR: Frequency-Space Inverse Rendering for 3D Millimeter-Wave Radar ADC Synthesis
comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026. Project page: https://mmwave-inverse-rendering.github.io/
summary: High-resolution 3D radar data is scarce. Commodity mmWave sensors use small antenna arrays that limit angular resolution to several degrees, and existing datasets provide only 2D range-azimuth maps or sparse point clouds rather than raw analog-to-digital converter (ADC) signals. Hardware scaling is expensive, synthetic-aperture scanning is impractical at fleet scale, and learned synthesis methods are bottlenecked by the very data shortage they aim to address. We present mmIR, an open-source differentiable frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar inverse renderer that fits a physics-based forward model to real captures and re-renders from dense virtual apertures to synthesize high-resolution 3D radar data. Because radar resolution is too coarse to recover geometry directly, mmIR performs LiDAR-assisted inverse rendering: using LiDAR-derived meshes as a geometric scaffold, mmIR optimizes per-vertex International Telecommunication Union (ITU) physics materials, vertex normals, and antenna beam patterns through end-to-end automatic differentiation of a phase-coherent multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) forward model with multi-bounce propagation, polarization, and free-space diffraction. On seven outdoor and six indoor ColoRadar scenes, mmIR achieves 0.914 mean Pearson correlation on range-azimuth maps versus 0.307 for Sionna-RT. Scenes trained on a cascaded imaging radar transfer to a co-located single-chip radar without re-training (0.554 correlation), and dense virtual arrays (100x100 elements) produce single-frame 3D occupancy validated against LiDAR. Project page: https://mmwave-inverse-rendering.github.io/

AI.tldr: 论文提出了mmIR，一种可微分的FMCW毫米波雷达逆向渲染器，通过物理模型拟合真实数据并虚拟合成高分辨率三维雷达数据，解决了高分辨率3D雷达数据稀缺的问题。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率3D毫米波雷达数据稀缺，现有商用mmWave传感器天线阵列小，角度分辨率有限，现有数据集仅为2D或稀疏3D点云。硬件扩展成本高，合成孔径扫描实际不可行，数据驱动的方法又受制于数据本身的稀缺性。
AI.method: 提出mmIR，可微分的FMCW雷达逆向渲染器。它结合物理基础的正向模型与真实雷达数据拟合，并借助LiDAR生成的三角网格作为几何支撑，通过端到端自动微分，联合优化每个顶点的物理参数、法线与天线波束等，实现高分辨率雷达信号的合成。
AI.result: 在7个户外与6个室内ColoRadar场景实验证明，mmIR在range-azimuth图达到0.914的平均皮尔逊相关系数，远高于Sionna-RT的0.307。模型在多个传感器间具备迁移性，密集虚拟阵列可输出单帧3D占据图并用LiDAR验证。
AI.conclusion: mmIR方法能以软件方式合成高分辨率3D雷达数据，突破硬件与数据集限制，对毫米波雷达领域具有实际应用价值。源码与数据已开源，有助于后续研究。

title: Contrast-Free Autonomous Navigation of Untethered Endovascular Microrobots Using Single-Plane Fluoroscopy
summary: Reliable three-dimensional (3D) navigation of magnetically actuated untethered microrobots remains a major barrier to clinical translation. X-ray fluoroscopy is the standard real-time imaging modality for endovascular procedures, but single-plane fluoroscopy provides only a two-dimensional (2D) projection, eliminating depth information and complicating autonomous navigation. Recovering this information through biplane imaging or repeated contrast-enhanced angiography increases procedural complexity, radiation exposure, or contrast burden. Here, we introduce VISTA (Virtual Integration for Spatial Tracking and Autonomy), a digital twin framework enabling contrast-free autonomous navigation under single-plane fluoroscopy. VISTA reconstructs vascular anatomy as a 3D digital twin, discretizes the vessel centerline into navigation milestones, and assigns the detected 2D robot position to the nearest projected milestone. Consecutive milestones define the local vessel orientation used to generate magnetic actuation commands, converting single-plane fluoroscopic observations into topology-constrained navigation states without requiring contrast injection during navigation. VISTA is demonstrated across anatomically distinct vascular phantoms under continuous flow and within the inferior vena cava of a live rat in vivo. Compared with conventional fluoroscopic human-in-the-loop control, VISTA reduced navigation time by up to 62%, corrective actuation commands by up to 98%, and radiation exposure by up to 57%. These results establish VISTA as a digital twin-guided framework for contrast-free autonomous navigation of untethered endovascular microrobots using widely available single-plane fluoroscopy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的数字孪生框架VISTA，实现了在单平面X射线透视下，无需对比剂即可对磁控微型机器人进行自主三维导航，大大简化了内血管操作流程。
AI.motivation: 目前用于磁控微型机器人的临床导航主要依赖单平面X射线透视，仅能提供二维图像，缺乏深度信息，导致自主导航困难。现有通过双平面或重复注射对比剂增加三维信息的方法会增加操作复杂性、辐射暴露或对比剂负担。亟需一种无需对比剂、能在常规单平面透视下实现三维导航的技术。
AI.method: VISTA系统通过对血管解剖结构进行三维数字孪生重建，将血管中心线离散为一系列导航目标点，并将透视下检测到的机器人的二维位置匹配到最近的三维投影目标点；使用相邻目标点确定局部血管方向，进而计算磁控命令，实现拓扑约束下的自主导航，全程无需额外注射对比剂。
AI.result: VISTA系统在不同解剖结构的体外模型和活体大鼠腔静脉内均成功验证。与人工操控相比，导航时间缩短至原来的38%，修正操作减少98%，辐射暴露降低57%。
AI.conclusion: VISTA证明了在普及的单平面透视条件下，无需对比剂也能对磁控微型机器人实现自主三维导航，显著提升了效率和安全性，为临床应用带来新可能。

title: Attribute-Based Activation Steering of LLMs for Group-Specific Explanation Generation
summary: To effectively enable people to understand new topics, explanations should be tailored to their backgrounds and abilities. So far, prompting alone has been shown to be insufficient for creating such explanations and other computational methods are missing. Therefore, this paper investigates whether LLMs can be steered to generate explanations that are tailored to a specific group of people. To this end, we propose an approach that first identifies group-specific attributes in terms of explanatory style and knowledge of a specific target group. Building on activation engineering, it then computes attribute-based steering vectors and adds them to the internal activations of an LLM during inference to enable a fine-grained steering. In our experiments, we assess the steering effectiveness of our approach in terms of specificity and factuality of the generated explanations. Additionally, we evaluate the explanations in a study with human experts from different target groups. Compared to prompting and state-of-the-art steering baselines, our approach tailors the explanations significantly better to the target group while largely maintaining factuality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于神经激活工程的属性引导方法，有效引导大语言模型（LLM）为特定人群生成更合适的解释，优于传统提示和现有引导方法。
AI.motivation: 目前仅靠Prompt很难让LLM自动生成针对不同背景和能力人群的解释，缺乏有效的计算型定制方法。如何定向引导LLM，更好地满足具体群体的信息需求，是值得研究的问题。
AI.method: 首先分析目标群体的解释风格和知识属性；然后通过激活工程计算基于属性的引导向量，在推理阶段将这些向量加入LLM内部激活，实现细粒度引导。通过实验测试生成解释的针对性和事实性，并邀请不同群体的专家进行评价。
AI.result: 实验证明，该方法在对特定群体解释的针对性上明显优于基于Prompt和现有引导基线，同时能较好保持内容事实性。
AI.conclusion: 基于激活工程的属性引导方法能有效提升LLM为特定用户群体定制解释的能力，具有较大应用潜力。

title: ActiveAugment: Online Active Learning for Augmentation Selection in Deep Learning
summary: Data augmentation is a cornerstone of deep learning pipelines, yet existing strategies treat it as a static, model-agnostic preprocessing step, either relying on expensive dataset-specific policy search or applying transformations uniformly at random, regardless of what the model has already learned. We introduce ActiveAugment, a unified framework that treats augmentation selection as an online active learning problem. For each training minibatch, ActiveAugment generates a pool of candidate augmented views and scores each candidate using a combination of the model's predictive uncertainty and the feature discrepancy induced by the augmentation. The augmentation under which the current model is most fragile is selected per sample, and the model is then trained with a joint supervised classification and supervised contrastive objective that enforces intra-class invariance to the selected augmentations while maintaining inter-class separation. We evaluate ActiveAugment on eight benchmark datasets spanning natural and medical imaging, using CNN and transformer architectures across three training regimes (training from scratch, full fine-tuning, and linear probing), and comparing eight active selection strategies for augmentation scoring. ActiveAugment outperforms AutoAugment, RandAugment, and TrivialAugment under controlled augmentation shifts across all domains and budgets, with the most pronounced gains at low labelling budgets. On medical imaging datasets, where data is scarce and domain shift relative to natural-image pretrained models is large, ActiveAugment achieves higher test F1 than all baselines, demonstrating strong cross-domain adaptability. Our analysis reveals that the augmentation selection policy evolves meaningfully during training and that strategy choice has a direct impact on generalisation. Code is available at: https://github.com/noahvide/ActiveAugment.

AI.tldr: ActiveAugment将数据增强视为在线主动学习问题，为每个训练批次动态选择最易使模型出错的增强样本，并在多个数据集和场景下超过现有增强方法，提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有数据增强方法通常是静态、模型无关的预处理步骤，要么依靠高昂的策略搜索成本，要么对所有样本统一随机增广，无法考虑模型当前已学到的内容，也无法针对模型弱点进行增广选择。
AI.method: 提出ActiveAugment框架，将数据增强选择建模为主动学习问题。每个训练小批量内，生成多个候选增强视图，并结合模型对每个增强样本的预测不确定性和特征扰动幅度进行打分，选出对当前模型最具挑战性的样本进行训练，结合分类和对比损失以提高判别与泛化能力。
AI.result: 在8个涵盖自然和医学图像的数据集上（包括CNN和Transformer、不同训练策略），ActiveAugment在多种Augment方法下都取得了更优的表现，尤其在标签资源稀缺和医学影像等场景下提升显著，F1分数整体高于AutoAugment、RandAugment和TrivialAugment等主流方法。
AI.conclusion: ActiveAugment能够有效提升模型对数据增强的适应性和泛化能力，特别适用于数据稀缺和跨领域任务。不同的主动选择策略对最终泛化有显著影响，选择合适的策略能够进一步提升效果。

title: Optimized Modular Design and Development of a Tilt-Rotor Bicopter Drone
comment: 7 pages, conference, Index terms -Tilt-Rotor Bicopter Drone, Optimal Modular Design, Static Analysis, Dynamic Flight Analysis
summary: Hybrid systems like tilt-rotor bicopter drones combine the beneficial characteristics of both fixed-wing and rotary-wing technology, enabling long endurance and VTOL capability. However, such drones also require an optimum design to ensure both static and dynamic stability. The modular design of a traditional bicopter is developed in this paper based on extensive analysis and in-depth structural and aerodynamic simulations. The structural analysis has been performed to ensure that the aircraft's structure withstands the stresses encountered during different flight modes. Controlling the relative positions of the Center of Gravity (CG) and Neutral Point (NP) is an essential aspect of the design, ensuring stability during hover and positive stability during forward flight. The thrust and power analyses have been conducted to assess the flight performance and endurance. After analysis, the drone has been developed, and flight tests with a basic flight controller were conducted to validate the performance metrics obtained in the simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对倾转双旋翼无人机的设计进行了全面分析与实验，验证其结构和飞行性能。
AI.motivation: 结合固定翼和旋翼技术，实现垂直起降（VTOL）和长续航能力，但如何保证静态和动态稳定性成为设计难点。
AI.method: 采用模块化结构设计，通过结构和气动仿真进行分析，确保强度和稳定性；重点分析重心与中性点相对位置，进行推力和功率计算，并开发原型机进行实际飞行测试。
AI.result: 各项结构和气动仿真得到了理想结果，实测中无人机表现出预期的稳定性和续航能力，验证了仿真和设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 倾转双旋翼无人机通过优化设计实现了结构强度、飞行稳定性与性能的平衡，具有一定的实用价值。

title: Anchoring Speech with Semantics: A Multimodal Adapter Mechanism for Automatic Speech Recognition in Low-Resource Languages
summary: Low-resource ASR remains difficult because scarce transcripts provide limited supervised evidence for target-side generation. To address this gap, we propose SAMA-ASR, a lightweight adapter mechanism that augments the decoder with semantic anchors from auxiliary translations and an acoustic anchor from speech; in principle, the mechanism can be applied to similar encoder--decoder multitask speech models. Through cross-modal adaptation, SAMA-ASR conditions decoder states on translation-derived semantic embeddings and a speech embedding, combining utterance-level meaning with speech-grounded evidence before token prediction. At evaluation time, these semantic anchors can be generated automatically by an upstream speech-to-text translator rather than supplied as oracle translations. Experiments on two 30-hour datasets covering the low-resource Sinitic varieties Taiwanese Hokkien and Hakka show that SAMA-ASR improves over acoustic, prior prompt-based, and semantic-only translation-guided baselines and remains effective in practical automatic semantic-anchor settings; translator-capacity analyses show that useful semantic anchors can be produced by a compact ST model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SAMA-ASR的轻量级适配器机制，通过引入辅助翻译的语义锚和语音锚，增强低资源语音识别（ASR）的解码器性能，在低资源条件下取得更优表现。
AI.motivation: 在低资源语音识别中，标注语料稀缺，导致监督信号不足。为此，需要探索如何利用多模态辅助信息（如翻译和原始语音）提升ASR性能。
AI.method: 作者提出SAMA-ASR机制，将解码器的状态与辅助翻译产生的语义嵌入和语音嵌入结合，实现跨模态的适配。评估时，这些语义锚可以通过自动语音翻译模型生成，无需人工翻译；同时，方法易于集成到类似的编码器——解码器多任务模型中。
AI.result: 在30小时的台湾闽南语和客家话低资源数据集上进行实验，SAMA-ASR在全部基线（纯声学、基于提示以及仅用语义翻译辅助）上均有提升，在自动生成语义锚场景下也表现有效，并且小规模端到端翻译模型生成的语义锚依然有效。
AI.conclusion: SAMA-ASR适配器能够有效利用跨模态语义和声学信息，提升低资源语音识别性能，且该方法适用于实际自动语义锚生成场景，对低资源语音识别提供了新的有效途径。

title: NBS: No Bias Stereo
summary: Stereo reconstruction is one of the last remaining Computer Vision tasks where all state-of-the-art methods employ a heavy architectural inductive bias. Even though it has been demonstrated that the task can be solved using general-purpose methods, it is widely believed that inductive biases in stereo are strictly necessary for both high-quality results and computational efficiency. We challenge this paradigm. In this paper, we demonstrate that both state-of-the-art accuracy and superior runtime efficiency are achievable with a model completely devoid of architectural inductive biases, relying instead on a simple, end-to-end Vision Transformer. By training on massive synthetic datasets, we show that pure data-driven learning can surpass explicitly engineered geometry. This work proves that explicit inductive biases are no longer a prerequisite for stereo matching, ultimately unlocking true scaling laws for continuous improvement in 3D reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种完全基于Vision Transformer、没有任何结构归纳偏置的端到端立体视觉重建方法，并且在精度和效率上均达到了当前最优水平。
AI.motivation: 当前立体重建任务普遍依赖于结构性归纳偏置（如几何先验），尽管通用方法也可用于该任务，但学界普遍认为归纳偏置是高质量结果和高效计算不可或缺的。作者希望挑战这种观念。
AI.method: 作者采用了一个完全没有结构归纳偏置的简单端到端Vision Transformer模型，并利用大规模合成数据进行纯数据驱动训练。模型结构上摒弃了传统立体任务的几何或先验设计。
AI.result: 基于大规模合成数据训练，这种纯数据驱动的模型在精度和运行效率上都超过了依赖归纳偏置的状态最优模型。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了立体匹配任务中显式归纳偏置已非必要，标志着立体重建可朝着真正依赖数据规模和模型能力持续提升的发展方向前进。

title: Motus2: A Self-Evolving General World Model for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: General embodied agents should perceive, predict, act, evaluate, and improve within a unified system. World models have shown great promise in building such agents, yet existing models typically append an action output head to a world simulator, without coupling them into a closed decision-and-learning loop for policy improvement. We present Motus2, a self-evolving general world model for dexterous manipulation. Motus2 advances world modeling through model scaling and data scaling. For model scaling, a single model with shared weights exposes three control interfaces: a policy (world-action model), a simulator (action-conditioned world model), and an evaluator (value model). The policy proposes candidate action chunks, the simulator predicts their visual consequences, and the evaluator assesses the predicted outcomes. Their coupling forms a closed decision-and-learning loop for policy improvement. This formulation uses curated expert demonstrations for action learning, while failed and suboptimal interactions provide valuable evidence for dynamics modeling and value learning. For data scaling, Motus2 progresses from large-scale monocular egocentric data to synchronized stereo egocentric data, followed by robot-domain adaptation with robot trajectories and supplementary human-robot alignment data. Motus2 further studies global-autoregressive and hybrid-memory extensions of its sliding-window context, adds tactile feedback for contact-aware control, and is instantiated on a fully biomimetic platform with stereo vision, dual arms, dual dexterous hands, and tactile sensing. Together, egocentric data scaling and closed-loop general world model scaling provide a general path toward self-evolving dexterous manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Motus2，一种能够自我进化的通用世界模型，专为灵巧操作设计，将感知、预测、行动、评估和改进集成于一个闭环系统中，支持更通用和自适应的机器人操控。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界模型多将行为输出简单地附加到模拟器上，缺乏与学习和决策紧密耦合以便持续提升策略的闭环机制，限制了通用体化智能体的自我进化能力。
AI.method: Motus2以单一权重共享模型结合三大控制界面（策略、模拟器、评估器），三者形成闭环，实现决策优化；采用专家演示和失败案例促进行为学习和建模。同时通过数据规模化，从单目到双目数据，再到机器人域适配与人机对齐，加强泛化能力。
AI.result: Motus2完善了世界模型的扩展能力，支持多模态输入（视觉、触觉），在全仿生平台（双目视觉、双臂、双手、触觉）上实现自我进化的灵巧操作。
AI.conclusion: 结合封闭循环的决策与数据规模扩展，Motus2为实现自适应、进化的机器人灵巧操作提供了通用且有效的路径。

title: When Patients Cut In: Extending Clinical Conversational AI Safety to Interruptions
summary: Clinical voice agents are now deployed in routine care, where real patients do not wait their turn: they interrupt. These systems typically use a cascaded architecture (speech-to-text -> LLM -> text-to-speech), so when a patient cuts the agent off mid-utterance, clinically required content can be lost even when the model handles cooperative transcripts well. Yet clinical conversational-AI benchmarks almost universally assume patients wait for the agent to finish, missing interruption-induced loss of required content. We present a transcript-based evaluation of interruption recovery, adapting conversation-analytic overlap categories into three operational types (recognitional, competitive, transitional sub-unit) and testing four deployment-oriented, non-reasoning LLM configurations across four cells spanning history-taking (information gathering) and FAQ (information provision), scored on whether the agent preserves the clinically required content. In the gathering cells, target-question failure varied across models; in the provision cells, where arms are directly comparable, failure rose for every model. Rankings differ across cells, and competitive FAQ interruption produced 30/30 provision-coverage failures for all four models (Wilson 95% CI: 88.6-100.0%; baseline 0/30 for three, 4/30 for Llama). A brief apology marker ("sorry to interrupt") shifts recovery by tens of percentage points, inconsistently across models, and for one it reduces recovery. Interruption robustness therefore cannot be a single score: evaluation must be content-grounded, reported per cell, and matched to the deployment's interruption profile.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了临床语音代理系统在真实医疗场景下遇到用户打断时，关键信息丢失的问题，并提出了一种基于转录内容的评估方法，发现目前系统对打断的鲁棒性较弱。
AI.motivation: 实际医疗对话场景中患者常常会打断AI语音助手，但现有系统和评测普遍假设“轮流说话”，忽视了打断情况下的临床信息丢失风险。提升系统面对现实交互的健壮性具有重要意义。
AI.method: 作者提出了将对话分析中的重叠类型简化为三类打断（识别性、竞争性、过渡子单元），结合四种无推理LLM模型，在信息采集和答疑两类对话任务上测试模型对打断的恢复能力，并以关键内容能否保留下为得分标准。
AI.result: 在信息采集任务中，不同模型对关键问题的丢失率有差异；而在信息提供任务中，所有模型在竞争性打断下，都无法完整保留所需内容。例如，FAQ场景竞争性打断导致四个模型全部发生重大内容覆盖失败。部分场景中加入道歉语（如“抱歉打断”）可以提升恢复率，但效果不统一，甚至对个别模型有负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 临床语音助手在应对用户打断时表现不佳，内容丢失严重，且这种鲁棒性无法以单一指标衡量，必须基于内容、场景和实际应用情况分项具体分析与评估。

title: FractureFields: Contact-Aware Binary Multi-Field Transfer for Fractured 3D Gaussian Simulation
summary: Physics-integrated 3D Gaussian representations make it possible to simulate image-reconstructed assets directly as particles, but current Gaussia-MPM pipelines keep a single Eulerian velocity field even after fracture. When disconnected fragments share interpolation support, they still write to and read from the same grid nodes, producing cross-fragment momentum leakage that appears as residual adhesion and non-physical stretching. We present FractureFields, a topology-adaptive transfer for fractured 3D Gaussian objects. After a structural event assigns persistent fragment identities, FractureFields builds fragment-specific mass and momentum fields in a single P2G pass, advances each field independently, and performs a field-aware G2P update so particles only sample their own fragment's grid state. To handle re-contact, we add a momentum-conserving contact projection that applies equal and opposite normal impulses only when two fragment fields are approaching, preserving free separation otherwise. Experiments on reconstructed scenes and a controlled re-contact benchmark show that fragment-conditioned routing eliminates realized cross-fragment mixing by construction, while contact projection reduces interpenetration during collision without reintroducing residual coupling. Overall, we argue that post-fracture simulation should treat structural disconnection as a change in local dynamical state, not merely a change in constitutive stress.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了FractureFields方法，实现了3D高斯对象断裂后动力状态与质量的精确分离，使物理模拟能更真实地反映断裂碎片间的独立动态行为，显著减少了碎片间的非物理耦合问题。
AI.motivation: 现有Gaussian-MPM物理模拟方案在断裂后，所有碎片依然共用同一欧拉速度场，导致断裂后各碎片在网格节点间写读信息时出现动量混叠和非物理拉伸等现象，无法准确表现断裂和再碰撞时的独立运动。需要有方法消除这些物理模拟中的碎片间“渗漏”与残余性粘连。
AI.method: FractureFields方法在结构断裂事件发生后为每个持久化碎片分配唯一身份，并在单次P2G（Particle to Grid）阶段为每个碎片分别构建质量与动量场；各碎片的场独立推进，只有同一碎片的粒子会采样本身的场，实现拓扑自适应的流体力学转移。为精准处理碎片再接触，本文引入动量守恒的接触投影机制，仅在两碎片接近时施加法向脉冲，保持自由分离时的物理独立。
AI.result: 实验包括重建场景及可控的再接触基准，结果表明碎片条件化的路由彻底消除了碎片间的动量混合，接触投影在避免碰撞期间的碎片穿透的同时，也没有带来新的残余耦合。系统整体表现出更真实、物理一致的断裂后模拟动态。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了在断裂后，结构性分离应视为局部动力学状态变化，而不仅是应力的调整。FractureFields彻底分离和独立推进各碎片的动力场，显著提升了断裂后高斯对象物理模拟的真实性和稳定性。

title: CanonNav: Disentangling Navigation Behavior from Camera Geometry in Cross-Platform Visual Navigation
summary: While visual navigation has advanced through imitation learning from cross-platform demonstrations, fully leveraging such data remains challenging. First, directly learning from image-trajectory pairs entangles navigation behavior with platform-dependent camera geometry. This hinders consistent learning by forcing the policy to implicitly infer camera geometry from visual observations, an inherently ill-posed problem. Second, imitation learning from demonstrated trajectories captures the expert's chosen motion but leaves the intermediate decisions underlying that motion implicit. To address these issues, we propose CanonNav, a visual navigation framework that disentangles navigation behavior from camera geometry and incorporates complementary planning supervision into learning from cross-platform demonstrations. CanonNav introduces camera geometry canonicalization, which transforms visual observations and trajectories into a camera-consistent representation space. Building on this representation, we derive safety and local-progress supervision using pseudo-labels from an offline traversability estimator. Safety supervision penalizes unsafe trajectories, while local-progress supervision guides where the robot should advance. Experiments across diverse camera configurations and environments show that, despite using only RGB at inference, CanonNav consistently outperforms RGB-based baselines and even surpasses RGB-D-based methods in challenging scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CanonNav，一种将导航行为与相机几何解耦，并结合规划监督的视觉导航方法，其在多种相机和环境下均优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有利用跨平台演示的视觉导航方法，常将导航行为与平台特有的相机几何耦合，导致学习效果不一致且难以泛化；同时仅依赖模仿学习，未能利用专家决策中的中间信息。
AI.method: 提出CanonNav框架，通过相机几何规范化将视觉观测和轨迹转化为一致的表征，并利用离线可通行性估算器生成伪标签，引入安全与局部进展监督，提升模型的导航能力。
AI.result: 在多种相机配置和环境下实验，CanonNav在仅使用RGB输入的情况下，不仅优于RGB基线，还在困难场景中超越了RGB-D方法。
AI.conclusion: CanonNav通过去除相机几何影响并引入额外规划信号，极大提升了视觉导航的泛化性和安全性，为跨平台视觉导航提供了新的方案。

title: Large Language Models Systematically Favor Popular Options: Evidence and Mitigation Across MCQs
summary: Multiple-choice questions (MCQs) are a standard format for evaluating large language models (LLMs), yet the popularity of answer options can confound evaluation. Modern LLMs systematically prefer popular but incorrect options over less popular correct ones, a vulnerability we call \textbf{popularity bias}. This pattern aligns with confidence miscalibration: model confidence remains high even as accuracy collapses for popular options. To systematically isolate this phenomenon, we introduce \textbf{PopMCQ}, a benchmark with six controlled strategies that vary option popularity while keeping the correct answer fixed. In our most adversarial setting, where all distractors are more popular than the correct option, models choose popular but wrong answers 66\% of the time. To mitigate this bias, we propose \textbf{PopDebias}, a lightweight inference-time correction that estimates and removes a popularity prior from model predictions. It requires no fine-tuning, is label-free at test time (using only a small calibration split for parameter fitting), and adds negligible computational cost. Experiments on 22 open-source LLMs (0.5B to 32B parameters) show consistent improvements, with accuracy gains up to 54.1 percentage points under strong popularity pressure. The code and data are available https://github.com/DataScienceUIBK/PopMCQ

AI.tldr: 本文发现和分析了大模型在选择题评测中存在的“选项受欢迎度偏置（popularity bias）”问题，并提出了有效的纠偏方法PopDebias，大幅提升了模型准确率。
AI.motivation: 虽然多项选择题（MCQ）作为评估大模型标准方法被广泛使用，但答案选项的流行度会干扰模型判断，导致模型更倾向于选受欢迎但错误的选项，从而影响评测公正性和模型实际表现评价。
AI.method: 作者提出PopMCQ基准，设计六种受控策略调整选项流行度，系统地评测大模型受流行度影响的偏置现象，并提出PopDebias方法，通过估算并去除模型预测中的流行度先验，无需微调，推理时只需极小的校准集即可，且计算量很小。
AI.result: 在22个公开大模型（参数量0.5B~32B）上的实验显示，强流行度干扰下，模型错误率高达66%；应用PopDebias后，准确率最高提升54.1个百分点，表现提升明显。
AI.conclusion: 当前大模型在MCQ测试中易受选项流行度影响产生偏置，PopDebias方法能够有效缓解这一问题，提高模型公正性和表现评估的准确性。

title: RoSe-SLAM: Robust Semantic-Aware Gaussian Splatting SLAM from Dynamic Monocular Videos
comment: Accepted by IEEE/RSJ INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON INTELLIGENT ROBOTS & SYSTEMS (IROS), 2026
summary: In dynamic and unstructured environments, conventional SLAM systems generally suffer from significant accuracy degeneration due to their static assumptions. In this work, we propose Robust Semantic-aware Gaussian Splatting SLAM (RoSe-SLAM), to address the dynamic challenge by a holistic semantic scene understanding from uncalibrated monocular inputs, achieving accurate camera tracking and high-quality geometry reconstruction. Unlike conventional semantic SLAM using handcrafted semantic labels, our RoSe-SLAM exploits the semantic feature from 2D foundation model to enhance the dynamic tracking and mapping performance. By distilling the rich semantic features to our Gaussian fields, our method effectively identifies dynamic distractors and achieves semantic-aware multi-view consistency, significantly enhancing the geometric reconstruction and scene inpainting. Specifically, we propose a spatial-temporal motion mask generation module, enabling both long-term motion monitoring and short-term transient dynamics capturing, achieving robust and effective disentanglement of dynamic objects and static backgrounds. During global bundle adjustment, we propose an occlusion-aware keyframe selection mechanism to prioritize the occlusion as metric to pick the keyframes, and a multi-view semantic consistency module to improve the mapping quality in dynamic environments. By combining geometric motion cues with semantic priors, our system dynamically filters unreliable observations and reconstructs accurate static scene geometry. Extensive experiments conducted on benchmark datasets including dynamic TUM, Bonn and Wild-Mocap datasets, demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance in both trajectory estimation and static scene mapping, outperforming existing dynamic RGB SLAM baselines in long-term dynamic indoor environments.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种具有强鲁棒性和语义感知能力的SLAM系统（RoSe-SLAM），能够在动态、无结构环境中实现高精度相机定位和高质量场景重建。
AI.motivation: 现有SLAM系统常假设环境静态，面对动态场景时精度明显下降。本文旨在解决动态环境下的鲁棒性和重建精度问题。
AI.method: RoSe-SLAM利用无标定单目输入，并结合2D基础模型输出的语义特征，通过空间-时间运动掩码和遮挡感知关键帧选择等机制，实现对动态物体与静态背景的有效区分。语义特征被蒸馏到高斯场中，提升动态追踪和多视角一致性。
AI.result: 在多个公开动态数据集（如dynamic TUM、Bonn、Wild-Mocap）上的实验表明，RoSe-SLAM在相机轨迹估计和静态场景重建方面均优于现有主流动态RGB SLAM基线。
AI.conclusion: RoSe-SLAM结合语义感知与几何约束，在动态环境下有效提升了SLAM的精度与鲁棒性，是应对动态场景下SLAM挑战的一种有前景方法。

title: CometVLA: Co-Training on an Embodied Data Pyramid towards Physical Understanding
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models remain brittle in manipulation tasks that require physical commonsense. Current physical VQA data is typically disembodied and misaligned with robot action domains. Egocentric videos are used only as auxiliary pre-training. It remains unclear whether improved VLM physical understanding actually benefits downstream action generation. Therefore, we present CometVLA to close this gap. We construct CometData and CometBench, an embodied physical VQA corpus and benchmark strictly aligned with the robot's action data and embodiment. We introduce Global Action Prior (GAP) tokens, a compact learnable bottleneck that isolates task-agnostic motion regularities and lets the action head consume physical commonsense without corrupting the pre-trained VLM backbone. We co-train CometVLA across the embodied data pyramid, spanning teleoperation, simulation, egocentric trajectories, and VQA layers. On real-world manipulation tasks and RoboTwin simulation, CometVLA consistently outperforms strong VLA baselines. Correlation analysis shows that stronger VLM performance on CometBench indicates higher VLA success rates. Results demonstrate that physical understanding pre-training genuinely benefits downstream manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CometVLA模型，通过构建与机器人动作紧密对齐的VQA数据集和基准，提升了具身物理理解对下游操作任务的影响，并在真实操作和仿真中取得了优于现有方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在需要物理常识的操作任务中表现仍有限，主要原因是现有物理VQA数据与机器人实际操作领域不匹配，且具身视频仅作为辅助预训练使用，尚不明确增强物理理解预训练是否真正有益于下游动作生成。
AI.method: 提出CometVLA模型，包括构建具身物理VQA语料库（CometData）和基准（CometBench），确保与机器人动作数据严格对齐，并引入GAP（Global Action Prior）token，作为隔离任务无关运动规律的信息瓶颈，同时保护预训练视觉-语言模型主干不被破坏。模型联合训练包括远程操作、仿真、第一视角轨迹及VQA等多层数据。
AI.result: 在真实世界操作任务及RoboTwin仿真环境中，CometVLA模型相较于强基线取得了持续领先。相关性分析表明，在CometBench上的VLM表现更好，其VLA下游任务成功率也更高。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了提升VLM的物理理解能力可以显著促进下游机器人操作表现，验证了具身物理预训练对VLA模型的实际益处。

title: SHADOWBENCH: Toward Reliable Automatic Evaluation of Semantic Alignment in Autoformalization
summary: Autoformalization translates informal mathematical theorems into code for proof assistants such as Lean. A central challenge is that current evaluation metrics can accept type-correct but misaligned statements or reject correct statements written in a different formulation. Inspired by Pass@$k$, we propose SA-Pass (*Semantic Alignment Pass*), which tests formal statements using auxiliary statements called *shadows* that characterize the intended statement. A generated statement receives full credit only when it compiles, implies each shadow (forward check), and is implied by their conjunction (backward check). We instantiate SA-Pass in ShadowBench, a Lean 4 full autoformalization benchmark of 178 postgraduate- to research-level problems spanning eight mathematical areas. Claude Code (Opus 4.8) with Numina-Lean-Agent reaches $61.8\%$ compile rate and $11.2\%$ SA-Pass. Across outputs generated by six agentic configurations, SA-Pass achieves $98.8\%$ binary agreement with expert judgments. An early version of ShadowBench served as the benchmark for Track 4 of the ICML 2026 AI4Math Challenge.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种用于自动形式化评估的新指标SA-Pass，通过引入辅助语句（shadows）来更准确评估自动形式化生成的数学陈述的语义一致性，并构建了基准测试集ShadowBench实现该指标。
AI.motivation: 现有自动形式化评估指标存在将类型正确但语义不符的结果接受或拒绝表达不同但语义正确的表达式的问题。在自动化数学证明的进展下，迫切需要精确评估生成内容与原始语义的一致性。
AI.method: 受Pass@$k$指标启发，提出SA-Pass指标：不仅要求代码编译通过，还需正向（生成内容蕴涵所有shadow）、反向（所有shadow合取蕴涵生成内容）检查。论文在Lean 4中基于178道高阶数学题构建了ShadowBench基准，覆盖8个数学领域，并比较多种agent方案表现。
AI.result: Claude Code (Opus 4.8) 与Numina-Lean-Agent在该任务上取得61.8%的Compile Rate及11.2%的SA-Pass分数。6种智能体配置下，SA-Pass与专家判定的二元一致率高达98.8%。
AI.conclusion: SA-Pass比传统编译通过的评估方式更能反映自动形式化系统的真实能力，为自动形式化方法的评估和改进提供了更可靠的基准。ShadowBench已在ICML 2026相关竞赛中作为标准测试。

title: Towards Fully Automated Medical Imaging Code Generation via Validation-based Context Engineering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable promise in program generation for small-scale and conventional application development; however, they remain limited when applied to complex, domain-specific tasks such as medical image processing. General-purpose models lack explicit domain knowledge and robust validation mechanisms to ensure correctness, often requiring substantial human intervention to produce reliable processing pipelines. To address these limitations, we propose AutoMedImg, a multi-agent framework for fully automated medical image processing code generation. AutoMedImg orchestrates specialised agents across two phases: a Planning Phase that performs dataset analysis and architecture design with semantic and formal verification, and a Coding Phase that generates modules in parallel with static checking, execution testing, and assembly validation. This multi-stage validation mitigates error propagation throughout generation, while comprehensive auto-context engineering combining domain-specific knowledge bases, shared memory, and validation feedback automates context construction without manual prompting. A cross-project adaptive pipeline synthesis mechanism further accumulates validated pipelines and retrieves proven components for new tasks based on project similarity, enhancing generation efficiency through cross-project learning. Extensive evaluation across six diverse and well-established medical imaging datasets with five backbone LLMs demonstrates that AutoMedImg achieves zero human intervention, with Dice scores of up to 0.90 for segmentation tasks and 99% accuracy for classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AutoMedImg，一种用于全自动医学图像处理代码生成的多智能体框架，通过自动规划、代码生成和多阶段验证，实现完全无需人工参与的医学图像处理管道构建。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在医学图像处理等复杂领域任务中应用受限，主要问题在于缺乏领域知识和健全的验证机制，需大量人工干预保证结果正确。
AI.method: 通过多智能体分工，AutoMedImg分为规划与编码两个阶段。规划阶段负责数据集分析和架构设计，并进行语义与形式化验证；编码阶段并行生成模块，结合静态检查、执行测试和组装验证，多阶段自动化验证防止错误传播。系统融合领域知识库、共享记忆和反馈自动构建上下文，无需手工提示，还通过跨项目管道合成机制复用经过验证的组件，提高效率。
AI.result: 在六个主流医学影像数据集和五种主流LLM上评测，AutoMedImg实现了零人工介入，分割任务Dice分数最高达0.90，分类准确率最高可达99%。
AI.conclusion: AutoMedImg显著提升了医学图像处理代码生成的自动化和准确性，无需人工参与，较好地解决了以往LLM在此类任务中面临的主要瓶颈。

title: Data-Centric Neuromotor Interfaces for Portable Human-Machine Interaction
summary: Dexterous human-machine interaction requires intuitive and expressive interfaces that can be efficiently deployed on constrained edge devices. Flexible material-based neuromotor interfaces hold considerable promise, as they decode human movement intention into natural control. Although emerging flexible electronic skins enable wearable high-fidelity data acquisition, practical deployment inevitably involves trade-offs between computational resources and portability. We present a data-centric paradigm where physiological features yield fundamental separability, providing sufficient discriminative cues for recognition. A wireless, high-bandwidth system developed for collecting various electrophysiological signals, when integrated with muscle-specific electrodes, forms a surface electromyography-based interface. Exploiting highly separable data, a 2,210-parameter model achieves 94.36% accuracy across 34 gestures and can be rapidly deployed on edge devices, establishing a new thousand-parameter benchmark for dexterous decoding. The underlying data-algorithm interactions in the data-centric paradigm are further clarified, demonstrating its feasibility in real-world scenarios. This study provides a principled and validated pathway for practical deployment of reliable neuromotor interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据中心的可穿戴神经运动接口，通过高质量的表面肌电数据与高分辨率、轻量级模型相结合，实现了高精度动作识别，并展示了其在边缘设备上实际应用的可行性。
AI.motivation: 灵巧的人机交互需要直观且可高效部署于边缘设备的接口。柔性电子皮肤虽能获取高保真生理数据，但受限于资源与便携性的平衡，促使研究者寻找高效的数据驱动方法以实现实用化。
AI.method: 开发了一套无线高带宽系统收集多种生理信号，并结合针对肌肉设计的电极，形成基于表面肌电(sEMG)的人机接口。采用可区分性强的生理特征，训练参数仅2210个的小模型，对34类手势实现高准确率识别，并可快速部署于边缘设备。
AI.result: 提出的系统和模型在34种手势识别任务中取得94.36%的准确率，将千参数量级模型在灵巧识别领域树立为新基线。同时，深入分析了数据-算法交互，证明了数据中心范式的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为可靠神经运动接口的实用化部署提供了理论和实验基础，展示了在资源受限环境下的部署路径，有助于推动灵巧人机交互技术的落地。

title: Modality Fault Lines: Structural Corruptions Reveal Fragile Omni-Modal Reasoning
summary: Omni-modal large language models are increasingly evaluated on clean text--vision--audio inputs, where every channel is present, synchronized, and readily interpretable. Such scores are often taken as evidence of robust cross-modal fusion, but clean evaluation cannot tell whether success depends on stable cross-modal structure or on cues sufficient only in intact inputs. To address this gap, we define a modality fault line: a boundary at which model behavior becomes unstable when a modality remains present and human-interpretable, but its internal evidence structure is perturbed. We introduce SCEval (Structure-Corruption Evaluation) a diagnostic evaluation protocol that keeps the question, answer space, and modality channels fixed while applying controlled structural corruptions to text, vision, and audio individually and jointly. Built from $273$ human-verified tri-modal examples from Social-IQ, OmniBench, and VALOR, SCEval evaluates $15$ proprietary and open-source omni-modal systems. The results show that structural corruption lowers clean accuracy, text--vision damage forms the most stable shared fault line, and multi-modal degradation is non-additive rather than a simple function of the number of corrupted modalities. Clean omni-modal accuracy therefore does not establish that a model will remain reliable when cross-modal evidence becomes structurally unreliable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCEval协议，用于诊断多模态大语言模型在输入结构破坏时的稳定性，发现模型准确率会显著下降，且不同模态间的损伤影响复杂。
AI.motivation: 目前多模态大模型通常在“干净”的、各模态完整且同步数据上评估表现，但这无法反映模型在现实复杂情况（如输入结构被破坏）下的健壮性。因此，急需一种方法专门评估模型对各模态结构扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出了“模态断层线”（modality fault line）的概念，即当某一模态虽在但其内部证据结构被扰动时，模型行为变得不稳定。基于该点，作者设计了SCEval评测协议，在文本、图像、音频三模态的输入保持同步的前提下，分别或同时对其结构施加干预和扰动。基于273个人工验证的三模态样本，对15个主流多模态模型进行了系统评测。
AI.result: 实验发现：在进行结构性破坏后，模型准确率显著低于“干净”情况下；而文本和视觉联合扰动造成的故障最为显著；多模态降级效应并不是各模态破坏效应的简单叠加。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖干净条件下的多模态评测结果无法评估模型在结构不可靠情况下的表现，提出的SCEval可作为更严格和现实的多模态鲁棒性评估基准。

title: Explainable Multi-Loss Distillation Framework for Efficient and Interpretable Shrimp Disease Text Classification
comment: Accepted at Journal of King Saud University Computer and Information Sciences
summary: Shrimp disease classification has become an urgent issue due to its significant impact on the import-export output of producing countries, particularly Vietnam. Most existing studies focus on image-based classification, which typically operates at the late stage of disease manifestation. Therefore, text-based classification has the potential to enable early and timely disease detection. To address this limitation, we introduce the SALT (Shrimp disease text Analysis with multi-Loss disTillation) framework, which incorporates explainability analysis using Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to evaluate model predictions and interpret the learned linguistic features. Experimental results demonstrate that SALT achieves competitive performance across multiple distillation objectives, outperforming supervised baselines while providing a favorable trade-off between predictive performance and computational efficiency. Moreover, it exhibits strong explainability, accurately identifying key linguistic features and semantic patterns relevant to disease descriptions. These findings highlight the potential of knowledge distillation-based text classification for future applications in early shrimp disease diagnosis and related research directions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了SALT框架，使用多损失蒸馏和可解释性分析，实现了对虾疾病的早期文本分类并优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 现有对虾疾病分类主要基于图像，通常在疾病后期进行，难以及时发现问题。因此，文本分类能在疾病早期实现快速响应，填补现有方法的空白。
AI.method: 提出SALT（Shrimp disease text Analysis with multi-Loss disTillation）框架，结合LIME与SHAP进行可解释性分析，通过多目标知识蒸馏提升文本分类性能并解释模型关注的语言特征。
AI.result: SALT在多种蒸馏目标下取得了优异性能，超过了传统有监督基线，并在预测准确性与计算效率间表现出良好平衡。此外，该方法能准确识别疾病相关语言特征，具有出色的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 基于知识蒸馏的文本分类在对虾疾病早期诊断和相关研究中具有巨大应用潜力，SALT框架为该领域提供了新思路。

title: SpectraTac: A Compact Camera-Free Optical Tactile Sensor with Distributed Color Sensing
summary: Tactile sensing is essential for physical interaction in robotics and human--machine systems. However, combining rich tactile information with compact hardware, low cost, and low computational overhead remains challenging. This work presents SpectraTac, a compact, camera-free optical tactile sensor that combines active red--green--blue (RGB) illumination with spatially distributed color sensing. Contact deforms a compliant transparent elastomer and modulates its internal light field, producing spatially differentiated changes in color and intensity. Three distributed color sensors capture these responses as low-dimensional spatio-spectral features, avoiding cameras, imaging optics, and high-dimensional image processing. The device measures 19.2 mm in diameter and 4 mm in height, with a material cost below USD~5. A data-driven decoding framework simultaneously estimates three-dimensional (3D) force and the contact region from the optical measurements. For 3D force prediction, the sensor achieved mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 0.161, 0.164, and 0.429 N along the x-, y-, and z-axes, respectively. The nine-region contact-classification accuracy was 99.9%. We further evaluated real-time 3D force tracking and contact-region-based human--machine interaction through an interactive control task. These results indicate that distributed color-resolved optical sensing offers a compact, low-cost alternative to camera-based tactile sensing for robotics, wearable sensing, and interactive systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需相机的紧凑型光学触觉传感器SpectraTac，利用分布式颜色传感技术，在低成本和低计算资源下实现高精度3D力和接触区域识别。
AI.motivation: 传统的触觉传感器通常依赖相机系统，硬件体积大、成本高且计算负担重，难以满足机器人和人机系统对小型化、低成本、高实时性的需求。作者希望寻找一种简化硬件和算法设计，同时能精准测量触觉信息的新方案。
AI.method: 该方法提出了一种新型的光学触觉传感器SpectraTac，通过主动RGB光照和分布式颜色传感器获取接触产生的光场变化，无需摄像头和高维图像处理。通过三个颜色传感器捕捉变形引起的颜色与强度变化，利用数据驱动的解码框架输出三维力与接触区域。
AI.result: SpectraTac尺寸仅19.2×4mm，材料成本低于5美元。在三维力预测任务中，MAE分别为0.161、0.164、0.429N（xyz轴），接触区域九分类准确率达99.9%。还在实时交互任务中展示了其实时跟踪能力。
AI.conclusion: 分布式颜色光学传感可在保持高精度的同时，实现紧凑、低成本、低算力的触觉传感，为机器人、可穿戴设备和交互系统中的触觉感知提供了良好替代方案。

title: Cloud and On-Premises Deployment of Uzbek Legal RAG via Targeted Retriever Fine-Tuning
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Industry Track). Project home: [https://metric-ai-lab.github.io/Uzbek-Legal-RAG/](https://metric-ai-lab.github.io/Uzbek-Legal-RAG/)
summary: Deploying large language models for legal question answering raises challenges that general-purpose leaderboards do not capture, particularly for low-resource languages and under hard operational constraints. We report on building and operating a retrieval-augmented (RAG) legal assistant for Uzbek that must run in two regimes: a managed cloud service that maximizes answer quality within a per-token cost ceiling, and an on-premises deployment for clients whose legal data may not leave their infrastructure, restricting us to open-weight models on limited local hardware under latency constraints. Because no evaluation existed for this setting, we build two domain benchmarks: a retrieval benchmark of 178 expert-annotated legal queries with gold provision spans, and an end-to-end benchmark of 504 expert-curated question--answer pairs scored by an LLM judge whose ratings we validate against human judgments and against an independent-family judge. Applying these benchmarks under each regime, we find the open-versus-proprietary gap is small and cheaply closed by fine-tuning. Therefore, we train UTE-1, which is a state-of-the-art text embedder among open models for Uzbek. We also demonstrate that closing the performance gap via fine-tuning is both impractical due to the intensive hardware demands of long-context legal Q\&A and unnecessary, given that legal acts change frequently. We support this by reporting a negative result from a QLoRA experiment. We distill practical guidance for similar deployments, drawn from a system serving real users in production. We release our benchmarks, evaluation code and the fine-tuned embedder (UTE-1) \href{https://metric-ai-lab.github.io/Uzbek-Legal-RAG/}{at this https URL} to support future work on low-resource legal NLP.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种为乌兹别克语部署的检索增强（RAG）法律问答助手，面向资源受限语言和实际业务约束，并在两种部署场景下进行评估，包括云端高质量和本地受限。作者创建了两个评测基准，结果显示开源与专有模型表现差距小且通过微调可以弥合。论文还发布了模型和基准，为今后低资源法律NLP研究提供支持。
AI.motivation: 一般问答榜单难以覆盖法律领域与低资源语言实际部署的挑战，尤其是在硬件受限、本地化和法律数据敏感不能外传等场景下。市场缺乏评测标准，实际部署需求驱动作者开发新型评测基准和实用系统。
AI.method: （1）设计乌兹别克法律问答RAG助手，支持云端和本地两种运行模式；（2）构建两套领域评测基准：一套检索基准（178条专家标注查询）、一套端到端问答基准（504对专家问答对，使用LLM与人工评分进行验证）；（3）对开源和专有模型在不同约束下评估，测试微调闭环和硬件消耗，以及长期维护难度；（4）推出和发布了乌兹别克开源嵌入模型UTE-1。
AI.result: 评测发现开源与专有模型差距很小，且可用低成本微调弥补。微调虽然能进一步缩小差距，但因长上下文法律问答需要大量算力，实际并不经济，并且法律条文迭代频繁使得频繁微调变得不必要。QLoRA实验中取得“负结果”佐证此观点。最终，作者给出了实际系统运维经验与实用建议。
AI.conclusion: 法律领域（尤其是低资源语言）智能问答系统开发应重视实际业务约束、评测体系建立和运维经验积累。开源与专有模型的实际使用差距不大，无需过度追求极致微调。作者贡献了数据集、评测代码和嵌入模型，为后续低资源法律自然语言处理研究奠定基础。

title: DocIntent: Answerability-Guided Agentic Restoration for Real-World Document Visual Question Answering
summary: Real-world degradations such as blur, shadow, distortion, and moire patterns severely impair the document question-answering capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Applying restoration tools before Visual Question Answering (VQA) is an intuitive solution. However, existing restoration approaches remain limited, as manually designing and executing restoration strategies is labor-intensive and requires domain expertise. Agentic restoration offers new possibilities for automation, yet existing frameworks primarily target natural images and pursue perceptual quality, overlooking that restoration should serve downstream tasks rather than optimize generic image quality metrics. To this end, we explore the value of agentic restoration for real-world degraded document VQA and propose DocIntent, a training-free Answerability-Guided Agentic Restoration framework. DocIntent first assesses question answerability, then identifies task-relevant degradations and selectively invokes restoration tools. A Comparison-Based Rollback mechanism validates each restoration step and reverts it when question-relevant evidence becomes less decipherable. The entire process requires no additional pretrained degradation classifier or image quality assessment model. Extensive experiments on the WildDoc benchmark show that DocIntent consistently improves the average score and consistency of different open- and closed-source MLLMs. The code and experimental data will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出了DocIntent框架，通过智能化选择修复工具，提升受损文档问答能力，无需额外训练，显著改善下游VQA任务表现。
AI.motivation: 传统恢复方法多关注视觉质量，操作繁琐且需专业知识，无法充分满足文档VQA等下游任务需求。现有自动化修复多针对自然图片，并未体现对任务相关性能的优化。因此亟需一种面向文档VQA的自动化、任务驱动的图像修复方法。
