We address these challenges in Head and Neck Cancer (HNC) from contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) imaging. To enforce factual safety, we reformulate report generation as an anatomically grounded, multi-label, structured reporting task, predicting localized tumor involvement across a hierarchical clinical schema. To bridge the visual gap from missing metabolic imaging (e.g., PET), we introduce SGRNet (Spatially Guided Radiology Network), incorporating two low-cost spatial priors: automated organ segmentations and weakly supervised tumor localization maps modeled via 3D Gaussian heatmaps. These priors are dynamically integrated via spatial feature modulation to guide the network toward subtle tumor-induced structural alterations. Evaluated on a multi-centric dataset of 184 paired HNC CECT volumes and reports, on five clinically salient, densely packed anatomical subsites, SGRNet achieves a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 0.60, an 8.8 percentage-point absolute improvement over strong volume-only 3D baselines.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种结构化、基于解剖学的放射学报告生成方法，有效缓解了常规自由文本模型在头颈癌报告自动生成中的幻觉风险和数据稀缺问题。
AI.motivation: 自动化放射学报告能够减轻临床工作负担，并减少观察者间的差异。但常见自由文本生成模型在信息密度高的区域易出现事实性错误（幻觉），当数据量不足时性能下降，难以满足头颈癌等复杂场景的应用需求。
AI.method: 作者将报告生成任务重构为解剖学支撑下的多标签结构化预测，即根据层级化临床标准，预测不同解剖子区域的局部肿瘤侵犯情况。提出空间引导放射网络SGRNet，融合器官自动分割和基于高斯热图的弱监督肿瘤定位两类低成本空间先验，通过空间特征调制动态引导网络关注细微结构变化。
AI.result: 在包含184例多中心头颈癌CECT影像及配套报告的数据集上，SGRNet对五个解剖子区域的mAP达到0.60，较最强3D体积基线提升8.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SGRNet有效提升了头颈癌结构化放射学报告生成的准确性与事实安全性，为临床实际应用提供了更可靠的自动化工具。

title: DARP: A Calibrated Dual-Arm RGB-D-IR Dataset for Multi-View Robotic Perception
summary: Robotic perception from a single viewpoint is often limited by self-occlusion and incomplete surface visibility. This paper presents DARP(Dual-Arm Robotic Perception) https://doi.org/10.21227/rmv3-be47, a calibrated dual-arm RGB-D-IR dataset for object-centered robotic perception using two independently moving eye-in-hand manipulators positioned on opposite sides of a shared tabletop workspace. Each arm carries an Intel RealSense sensor that continuously records RGB, depth, and stereo infrared data while synchronized robot joint states are logged for pose recovery. Objects are placed without fixed poses or marked locations, and the acquisition procedure performs automatic localization, cross-arm confirmation, adaptive viewpoint generation, and continuous multimodal recording. DARP contains ten unique tabletop objects and preserves the original sensor recordings, robot-state logs, object-level metadata, and calibration information required to reconstruct camera trajectories in a shared metric frame. To evaluate the geometric consistency of the acquisition, we implement a deterministic multi-view fusion pipeline that converts calibrated RGB-D observations into complementary partial point clouds and measured surface meshes without using learned or generative completion methods. Evaluation on 224 held-out RGB-D keyframes comprising 1,563,466 three-dimensional query points yields a median point-to-mesh distance of 2.13~mm and an RMSE of 4.04~mm, with 96.56\% of points within 10~mm of the measured-surface mesh. DARP is intended as a reusable resource for multi-view reconstruction, collaborative robotic perception, multimodal fusion, active perception, and future learning-based reasoning over partial object observations.

AI.tldr: DARP是一个包含两个手持RGB-D-IR传感器机械臂的数据集，用于多视角桌面物体感知及重建，具备高精度同步数据采集和完整校准信息。
AI.motivation: 单一视角下，机器人感知常受自遮挡和视角局限影响，无法完整观察物体表面，因此需要多视角、跨机械臂的数据集以提升感知和重构能力。
AI.method: 提出DARP数据集，利用两台独立机械臂分别从桌面物体的对侧采集同步RGB、深度和红外数据，同时记录机器人关节状态，实现无固定位置的物体观测，并进行自动定位、视角自适应选择和多模态连续采集。采用去学习化、多视角融合流程，将RGB-D数据转换为点云和表面网格用于一致性评价。
AI.result: 在224组RGB-D关键帧和156万余个三维点上评估，所得点到网格中位距离为2.13mm，RMSE为4.04mm，96.56%的点距离网格在10mm以内，展示出极高的几何一致性。
AI.conclusion: DARP高质量、多模态、全校准跨臂感知数据集为多视角重建、协作机器人感知、多模态融合、主动感知等研究场景提供基础数据和评测基线，对未来基于部分观测的学习推理研究具有重要意义。

title: MUDDLE: Measuring Understanding of Documents under Distractor and Length Effects
comment: 12 pages. Accepted to the Context Beyond the Window (CBW) workshop at COLM 2026 (non-archival). Code and data: https://github.com/luoojason/muddle
summary: Document question-answering systems increasingly answer questions over collections of retrieved documents rather than one clean source, so robustness to distracting context matters as much as reading ability. When such systems fail, it is often unclear whether the context was too long or the distractors were too close to the topic, because prior work tends to conflate these two effects. We present MUDDLE, a controlled benchmark that separates them. MUDDLE uses 270 human-annotated questions, each tied to a single source document, and instantiates every question in five conditions: the source alone, the source with two or four topically similar hard negatives, and the source with two or four random distractors. The random distractors are matched to the hard negatives in length and provenance, so an accuracy gap between the two arms reflects topical similarity rather than length. All five conditions are rendered in markdown, page images, and raw PDF, but the distractor sweep reported here is run in markdown, since a source plus its distractors exceeds current image and PDF input limits. We score answers with an LLM judge across three model families. In the complete markdown sweep, hard negatives lower accuracy more than length-matched random documents at both context sizes for gpt-5-mini, while random documents stay near the no-distractor baseline. The effect is small but directionally consistent, and for gpt-5-mini hard negatives significantly underperform length-matched random distractors when pooled across context sizes. We release the data and evaluation code for a reproducible study of context degradation.

AI.tldr: 提出了MUDDLE评测基准，用于区分文档问答系统中文本长度和干扰项相似度对性能的影响，并发布了相关数据和代码。
AI.motivation: 当前文档问答系统面对冗长且带有干扰项的上下文时性能下降，但难以判断究竟是因为文本太长还是干扰项（即和问题主题相近的无关材料）带来的困扰。之前的相关研究往往混淆了这两种影响。
AI.method: 建立MUDDLE基准：1）收集270个人工标注的问题，每个问题对应唯一的来源文档；2）每个问题分别在5种条件下测试：只给原文，原文加2个或4个主题相似干扰项，原文加2个或4个随机干扰项（长度与来源相匹配）；3）所有条件分别以markdown、图像、原始PDF展现，但主要结果在markdown上测试；4）用大模型判分，比较不同系统的表现。
AI.result: 在完整markdown测试中，主题相似的干扰项比随机长度匹配干扰项对gpt-5-mini性能影响更大，随机干扰项的表现接近只用原文的基线条件。gpt-5-mini在所有上下文长度下，面对主题相似干扰项时准确率明显低于随机干扰项。
AI.conclusion: 主题相关的干扰项对文档问答系统影响更大，研究者应优先关注问题上下文中主题相似的干扰项影响。MUDDLE数据和评测代码为相关模型评测和研究提供了可复现的工具。

title: Training-Free Hidden-State Refinement for Flow-Matching Image Generators
summary: We aim to improve frozen flow-matching image generators by adding inference computation inside the denoiser, without changing model weights or the outer sampler. Existing generators usually spend extra test-time computation by increasing the number of sampling steps, which repeatedly evaluates the entire denoiser and couples quality gains to sampler cost. A key challenge is how to use extra computation inside a frozen transformer denoiser: the method must decide which tokens, layers, and sampling times receive repeated updates while preserving the original generation pipeline. We introduce a training-free looping framework that repeatedly applies selected transformer layers inside each denoising call. Dense and Sparse Token Loop vary the token scope; Sampling-Progress Gating and the loop layer range specify when and where looping is active; loop count and strength control the repeated updates; and Loop Guidance combines ordinary and looped vector-field predictions. Across two Scale-RAE model scales, loop variants improve primary and auxiliary quality metrics with competitive quality--efficiency trade-offs. Loop Guidance further improves both primary metrics across all three tested models; on Scale-RAE DiT2.4B, it raises GenEval from 0.4471 to 0.5691 and DPG-Bench from 0.7656 to 0.8053. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需重新训练、在不改变权重和采样器结构的情况下，通过在生成过程中循环调用部分transformer层，提升冷冻流匹配图像生成器性能的新方法。
AI.motivation: 目前的冷冻flow-matching图像生成器通常通过增加采样步数来提升生成质量，由此带来计算量线性增长。作者希望探索一种更高效利用推理阶段计算资源的方法，在不修改模型权重和外部采样器的前提下，增加生成器性能。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种无训练循环机制，在每次去噪调用中对选定的transformer层进行多次循环处理。通过密集/稀疏token循环、采样进度门控、层级范围限制等方式灵活控制循环的对象和时机。此外，还引入了Loop Guidance，用普通和循环的向量场预测结果进行组合。
AI.result: 在两个Scale-RAE不同规模模型、三个模型的实验中，所有循环策略均显著提升了主/辅助质量指标。特别是Loop Guidance，进一步提升了主指标：如在Scale-RAE DiT2.4B模型上，GenEval得分从0.4471提升到0.5691，DPG-Bench从0.7656提升到0.8053，实现了更优的质量-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的训练外循环机制可提升冷冻流匹配生成器的质量，且无需模型权重与外部采样器的更改，实现了推理效率与结果质量的协同提升。代码即将开源。

title: SUN: Persistent Programs For Language-Grounded Control-to-Learning-to-Real Policies
summary: Bridging model-based control and learned policies in long-horizon manipulation has harbored a silent disagreement: control executes specified objectives, learning amortizes that behavior into a reactive policy, yet existing protocols discard task semantics, leaving rewards hand-crafted and behavior drifting from what control verified.We introduce Semantically UNified (SUN) Programs, typed executables where geometric and contact relations are defined once and compiled into aligned Model Predictive Control (MPC) costs, satisfaction predicates, RL rewards, transition guards, and diagnostics. Our system, Kuafu, driven by large vision language systems, automatically synthesizes SUN Programs from language and scene semantics, screens feasibility via MPC, and retains semantics while training stage-conditioned policies. Across nine tasks, Kuafu achieves 82.03% macro-success, outperforming sparse-reward (35.67%) and Stage-BC (24.75%) baselines. At 8192-way scale, it generates 10.57x the successful trajectory time per hour of human teleoperation. With 500 trajectories per task, Kuafu data trains DP3 policies to 46.0% simulation success (vs. 22.4% for alternatives) and 34.7% on physical Franka and Kinova robots. These results establish that simulation-screened task semantics can effectively amortize control into robust policies, without demonstrations or manual dense rewards, unifying symbolic planning and data-driven execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SUN Program，一种将任务语义统一到模型预测控制（MPC）、强化学习奖励及策略训练中的新方法，显著提升了长期操作任务的策略效果；系统Kuafu通过大模型自动生成并筛选语义，实验优于多种基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在从模型控制到策略学习的迁移过程中，常因手工奖励且缺乏任务语义，导致策略难以保持与控制阶段验证的一致性，需要一种保留并利用任务语义的新机制。
AI.method: 提出Semantically UNified (SUN) Programs，将几何和接触关系一次性编译为对齐的MPC代价、满足谓词、RL奖励、状态转移和诊断条件。系统Kuafu利用大型视觉-语言模型自动从语言和场景语义生成SUN Program，并通过MPC筛查可行性，在训练阶段也维持语义一致。
AI.result: 在9个任务上，Kuafu系统的宏观成功率为82.03%，远高于稀疏奖励（35.67%）和Stage-BC（24.75%）。在大规模生成中，每小时产生的成功轨迹时间是人工操作的10.57倍。500条轨迹数据训练下，Kuafu数据助力的DP3策略在仿真中达46.0%，物理机器人实验达34.7%，均优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 仿真筛查下的任务语义能够高效地将模型控制策略迁移为强健策略，无需演示或手工密集奖励，实现了符号规划与数据驱动执行的统一。

title: SIC-Agents: Benchmarking and Building an Adaptive Simulator for Pediatric Serious Illness Communication Training
summary: Pediatric serious illness communication (SIC) is critically important, yet scalable communication training for clinicians remains limited. Compared with other dialogue simulation settings, pediatric SIC poses additional challenges, including multi-party interactions, response to parental distress and strong dependence on feedback dynamics. Existing LLM-based simulators optimize generic dialogue quality rather than curriculum-contingent behavior required for effective SIC training. In collaboration with educators and pediatric clinicians, we introduce the first benchmark suite and simulation framework tailored to pediatric SIC training. Our benchmarks, PitfallBench and DialogueBench, evaluate simulators both at the turn-level and across full dialogues. We further propose SIC-Agents, a self-improving framework that generates a clinician-editable skill document to guide simulator behavior. Our experiments show that SIC-Agents outperforms static expert prompting. To support future research, we release our benchmarks for parent simulation in pediatric SIC at https://github.com/Beikewzh/sic-benchmarks

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一套专门用于儿科严重疾病沟通训练的基准和仿真框架，解决以往基于大模型仿真器不适用于真实沟通训练的问题。
AI.motivation: 儿科严重疾病沟通（SIC）对临床医生来说极为重要，但目前可规模化的沟通训练工具有限。现有对话仿真器未能满足儿科多方互动、情绪反馈等特殊需求，影响沟通训练效果。
AI.method: 作者与教育者和儿科临床医生合作，开发了首个面向儿科SIC训练的基准套件和仿真框架，包括PitfallBench和DialogueBench两项基准，用于多粒度评估仿真器表现。提出SIC-Agents自我改进框架，依据临床技能文件指导仿真器对话行为。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，SIC-Agents比静态专家提示方法具有更优越的表现。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的框架及基准提升了仿真环境下儿科SIC训练的针对性和有效性，相关资源已开源，有望推动该领域进一步研究。

title: Subtraction-Based Tumor Segmentation and Lesion-Centered pCR Prediction for the MAMA-MIA Challenge
summary:
We describe the submission of team FME to the MAMA-MIA Challenge, which evaluated primary tumor segmentation and prediction of pathological complete response (pCR) from pretreatment dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI on an external multi-country cohort. For segmentation, we trained a five-fold residual-encoder nnU-Net ensemble using only the first post-contrast minus pre-contrast image, combined with mirroring test-time augmentation and largest-connected-component filtering. For pCR prediction, we ensembled 25 pretrained 3D video classifiers trained on lesion-centred crops from the pre-contrast and first two post-contrast volumes. FME ranked second in both tasks. The segmentation method achieved a combined performance-fairness score of 0.882, with Dice 0.713 and normalized Hausdorff distance 0.099. The pCR method achieved a combined score of 0.664, balanced accuracy of 0.541, and equalized-odds disparity of 0.212. The results indicate that subtraction-based input and ensembling support robust tumor segmentation under cross-site domain shift, whereas pCR prediction from baseline DCE-MRI alone remains limited.
  For the submission repository, see https://github.com/FraunhoferMEVIS/MAMA-MIA-Challenge-FME

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了FME团队在MAMA-MIA挑战中的方法，该挑战要求乳腺MRI的肿瘤分割及pCR预测，FME团队方法在两项任务中均获第二名。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在探讨乳腺癌MRI扫描图像在不同国家机构间的泛化能力，以实现自动肿瘤分割和基线MRI预测治疗完全缓解（pCR）的可行性及公平性。
AI.method: 分割任务采用五折残差编码器的nnU-Net集成，仅利用第一次增强后减去增强前的影像，并实施测试时的镜像增强和最大连通区域筛选。pCR预测则集成了25个预训练3D视频分类网络，输入为病灶中心裁剪的基线及前两次增强体积影像。
AI.result: 在分割任务中，FME团队获得0.882的综合表现-公平分，Dice系数0.713及归一化Hausdorff距离0.099；pCR预测任务中，获得综合分0.664，平衡准确率0.541，equalized-odds差异为0.212，两项指标均为第二名。
AI.conclusion: 基于图像差分输入及集成学习方法可在不同机构数据下实现较为稳健的肿瘤分割，而单基线DCE-MRI下的pCR预测能力依然有限。

title: CoCoA: Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment for Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 22 pages, 4 figures, 19 tables
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often favor Western-associated entities across cultural contexts. Conventional debiasing methods aim for uniform neutrality, but cultural bias mitigation demands context-conditional behavior, preferring culturally appropriate entities when cultural cues are present and remaining neutral when they are absent. We propose CoCoA (Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment), a framework that learns this behavior through dual-context training on the same entity pairs under contexts with and without cultural cues. CoCoA combines a contrastive alignment objective with calibration and drift regularization, optimized through goal-aware gradient reconciliation. We evaluate CoCoA on CAMeL and Camellia, two entity-centric cultural bias benchmarks, across ten language settings and four LLMs. CoCoA reduces the Cultural Bias Score from 43 to 24 on average while maintaining near-neutral preferences at 50.2, with minimal impact on general performance across five standard benchmarks. These findings highlight that effective cultural alignment requires context-conditional modeling rather than uniform debiasing, and establish a new direction for mitigating entity-centric cultural bias in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新方法CoCoA，用于让大语言模型在不同文化背景下更好地调整对实体的偏好，实现文化敏感的中立性。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型常在各种文化背景下偏向西方实体，简单的去偏见方法只能实现统一的中立，无法根据上下文适时调整实体偏好。消除文化偏见需要模型能根据文化线索动态调整对实体的选择。
AI.method: 提出了CoCoA框架，通过在有文化线索和无文化线索的双重上下文下，对相同实体对进行训练，并结合对比对齐目标、校准和漂移正则化，通过任务感知的梯度协调优化模型。
AI.result: 在CAMeL和Camellia两个以实体为中心的文化偏见基准上，覆盖十种语言和四种LLM，CoCoA将文化偏见得分从平均43降至24，并保持了接近中立的偏好（50.2），在其他五项标准基准测试上对总体性能影响极小。
AI.conclusion: 高效的文化对齐需要上下文条件建模，而非一刀切的去偏方法。CoCoA为消除LLM中的实体文化偏见开辟了新方向。

title: Mapping-Based Image Diffusion
summary: In this work, we introduce a novel tensor-based functional for targeted image enhancement and denoising. Via explicit regularization, our formulation incorporates application dependent and contextual information using first principles. Few works in literature treat variational models that describe both application dependent information and contextual knowledge of the denoising problem. We prove the existence of a minimizer and present results on tensor symmetry constraints, convexity, and geometric interpretation of the proposed functional. We show that our framework excels in applications where nonlinear functions are present such as in gamma correction and targeted value range filtering. We also study general denoising performance where we show comparable results to dedicated PDE-based state of the art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于张量的泛函方法，用于有针对性的图像增强和去噪，结合了应用相关及上下文信息，并在多个任务中展示了优越性。
AI.motivation: 传统变分模型较少同时将应用相关信息和上下文知识纳入图像去噪问题。为了更好地描述实际任务中的图像处理需求，作者希望开发能结合不同先验信息的变分模型。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种显式正则化的张量型泛函，通过张量的对称性约束、凸性和几何解释实现对应用相关和上下文信息的结合。并证明了该泛函存在极小值。该方法可处理如伽马校正、指定值区间滤波等非线性场景。
AI.result: 在针对性图像增强和去噪任务中，所提方法优于现有模型。在通用去噪任务上，性能与当前主流的偏微分方程（PDE）类方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在具有非线性函数的复杂应用中表现突出，同时具备对复杂先验信息表达能力强的优势，为变分图像处理方法提供了新的可能。

title: Background-Free Objectness Learning for Class-Agnostic Detection
comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. This arXiv version includes supplementary material
summary: Object detectors are typically trained under closed-set supervision, where unlabeled regions are implicitly treated as background. Under incomplete annotations, this assumption introduces objectness bias: visually valid but unlabeled objects are used as negatives, tying objectness to the annotated taxonomy rather than generic object structure. This limitation is particularly problematic for class-agnostic and open-world detection. This paper proposes Background-Free Objectness Learning (B-FOR), a dense class-agnostic detection framework that learns objectness without explicit background supervision on unlabeled regions. B-FOR formulates detection as the prediction of dense multi-scale object-center and scale fields, from which object hypotheses emerge as local spatial structures. Supervision is confined to reliable annotated regions through spatially structured soft targets, avoiding foreground-background discrimination. To support decoding from emergent local maxima, the paper further introduces displacement-aware scale fields that model object extent as a spatially varying property of the learned objectness field. Experiments on PASCAL VOC, MS-COCO, and Open Images demonstrate strong generalization to unseen categories and cross-dataset object distributions. B-FOR improves recall by more than +10 AR points over prior class-agnostic baselines. Ablation studies show that both localized objectness supervision and displacement-aware scale fields are critical for class-agnostic localization under incomplete annotations. Code available at: https://github.com/Daniaawan/B-FOR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的无背景监督的类无关目标检测方法B-FOR，通过放弃对未标注区域的背景假设，提升了检测器对未见类别和数据集的泛化能力，显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 传统目标检测利用封闭集监督，将未标注区域当作背景。但数据集标注不完整时，真实物体会被误当成负样本，导致检测器只能识别已标注类别，限制了其在开放世界和类无关检测中的表现。
AI.method: B-FOR摒弃了对未标注区域做阴阳判别的背景假设，仅对可靠的标注区域进行带空间结构的软目标监督。其检测模型直接预测多尺度的稠密物体中心和尺度场，通过局部空间结构形成目标假设，并引入位移感知尺度场，帮助模型准确恢复物体范围。
AI.result: 在PASCAL VOC、MS-COCO及Open Images三大数据集上，B-FOR对未见类别和跨数据集目标表现出强泛化能力。与此前的类无关基线相比，召回率提升10+ AR分。消融实验也表明，空间化物体性监督和位移感知尺度场对提升检测器表现至关重要。
AI.conclusion: B-FOR避免了背景监督假设带来的偏差，有效提升了在不完整标注和开放环境下的类无关检测性能，推动了目标检测向更通用和开放世界场景的发展。

title: LLM Judges as Raters: A Pre-Registered Audit of Severity, Halo, Reliability, and Version Instability in LLM Essay Scoring on Public Corpora
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Under review at the Journal of Learning Analytics (LAK27 research track). Artifact: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lak-27-A618
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as essay graders in learning analytics, evaluated almost exclusively with agreement statistics. Educational measurement warns that raters also differ in severity, show halo, and drift as instruments. We treat LLM judges as raters and run a pre-registered rater-effects battery (many-facet Rasch severity, residual halo, generalizability/decision studies, cross-version shifts, differential functioning) on public corpora in two languages (ENEM/Essay-BR; ASAP): 2,377 essays, 12 judges, 4 providers, 5 version contrasts, replicated cells, released as a score tensor. Judge severity spans 219 points on ENEM's 0-1000 scale; on ASAP the panel spread is 15-33% of the score range against a between-trained-human gap near 1%. Judge-human correlations sit in an undiscriminating .47-.56 band. All five version contrasts shift severity beyond a family-wise permutation null (up to 133 points), and one judge was deprecated mid-study, caught by identity canaries. Two pre-registered tests returned honest nulls: severity-adjusted leaderboard reversals did not survive a permutation null, and "silent drift" was refuted: agreement moved with severity in four of five contrasts. Replication yields self-consistency (phi>=.80 at k<=2) but not human-level accuracy, and a same-instrument check overturned our own halo comparison: matched on instrument and calibration, we find no credible evidence that judge halo exceeds the trained-human range.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统性评估了大语言模型（LLM）作为论文评分员时的表现，发现其评分偏差明显，且人机一致性有限。
AI.motivation: 传统上教师在主观评分时会受到多种效应影响，但对LLM评分表现的研究仅关注一致性，忽视了严苛度、光环、漂移等教育测量领域中关注的评分员效应。
AI.method: 将LLM作为评分员，依据多面Rasch模型、残差光环、普遍化和决策研究、跨版本变化等严密的评分员效应实验设计，在两个英语和葡萄牙语公开论文库（ENEM/Essay-BR和ASAP）上进行评测，分析大规模（2377篇作文，12位评分人，4家LLM，5个版本对比）评分效果。
AI.result: LLM评分员在分数严苛度上差异极大，跨版本变化显著，部分模型在评分过程中被弃用。一致性较低（相关系数.47-.56），但未发现LLM光环效应较人类评分员重。Silent drift未被证实，但严重的严苛度随版本显著漂移。调整评分严苛度后leaderboard排序无变化。复制实验表明模型自洽性高，但精度未达人类水平。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM难以达到人类评分员的准确度，其评分严苛度随模型和版本大幅变化，需要更细致的偏差控制和测量分析。未来不能只看一致性指标，要引入严苛度、光环等多维度评分员效应参数用于LLM评分系统的评价。

title: Feature-Spectral Fragility in Segmentation: Dataset Dependence, Architecture-Specific Localization, and Spectral Correlates
summary: Robustness of segmentation models is commonly assessed through input-domain perturbations, while dependence on frequency content within learned feature representations remains less understood. We probe this dependence using targeted post-training low-pass interventions on internal representations of three segmentation architectures, ResNet50-UNet (CNN), VM-UNet (SSM), and Swin-UNETR (Transformer), across CVC-ClinicDB and ISIC2018, with headline evaluations performed on untouched held-out test sets. At cutoff rho=0.25, feature-domain low-pass filtering causes severe degradation on CVC: Dice drops by 100%, 73.2%, and 30.9% for CNN, SSM, and Transformer, respectively, compared with 9.4%, 10.3%, and 0.6% on ISIC. The cross-dataset difference is statistically significant for every architecture. Single-stage interventions further show that sensitivity is localized at architecture-specific depths: the CNN peaks at a mid/late encoder block, whereas the SSM peaks in an early encoder stage on both datasets. Native feature-domain spectral measurements show an inverse association between high-frequency energy and fragility on CVC; the relationship is only partial on ISIC and is therefore treated as a candidate correlate rather than a proven mechanism. Finally, Fourier augmentation improves robustness to input-space low-pass filtering but leaves feature-domain degradation essentially unchanged. These results show that feature-spectral robustness is strongly dataset-dependent, architecture-specific, and distinct from input-domain spectral robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了分割模型对特征频域信息依赖性的稳健性，比较了CNN、SSM和Transformer对内部特征低通操作的敏感性，发现该稳健性强依赖于数据集和模型结构。
AI.motivation: 虽然分割模型对输入扰动的鲁棒性已经被广泛研究，但对于模型内部特征表征的频域内容依赖还缺乏理解，因此本文探究内部频谱对分割性能影响。
AI.method: 对三种架构（ResNet50-UNet、VM-UNet、Swin-UNETR）在CVC和ISIC2018数据集的内部特征进行低通滤波干预，评估不同深度、不同模型、不同数据集下的鲁棒性差异，并结合傅里叶增强和特征频谱测量进行深入分析。
AI.result: 在CVC数据集，低通操作对Dice分数影响极大，各模型下降幅度分别达100%、73.2%、30.9%；而在ISIC仅为9.4%、10.3%、0.6%，且差异具统计显著性。此外，模型敏感性在不同结构处于不同深度，CNN集中在中后层，SSM则在较早阶段。高频能量与脆弱性表现出一定负相关。傅里叶增强能提升对输入扰动的鲁棒性，但对特征域失效。
AI.conclusion: 特征频谱鲁棒性高度依赖于数据集和模型架构，并与输入域频谱鲁棒性存在明显区别，提示对内部特征处理的进一步关注和分析。

title: AGRICAM: A Track-Mounted Crop Pollination Monitoring Robot
summary: Insect pollination is critical for global food production, yet monitoring pollinators at commercial farm scale remains a challenge. Recent advances in computer vision and deep learning have enabled detailed analysis of pollinator behaviour, but monitoring must trade-off detail against spatial coverage and human or technological resources. This paper presents the Automated Guided Robot for Insect and Crop Activity Monitoring (AGRICAM), a purpose-built robotic system designed to meet the requirements of large-scale pollination monitoring in protected cropping systems. AGRICAM operates autonomously on low-cost, easily installed track for movement along crop rows, without disrupting farm operations or insect behaviour. The platform integrates two RGB cameras, microclimate sensors, GPS and RFID modules, motion sensors, and 4G cellular network connectivity for data transmission. A web interface enables remote device configuration and scheduling. The system autonomously captures video and image data of insects' locations and local environmental conditions. These are transferred to the cloud and analysed using computer vision models to quantify pollinator visitation and spatio-temporal activity variation. We deployed the system on a commercial blueberry farm to demonstrate and test its capability. It successfully mapped insect pollination patterns across 80 m long industrial polytunnels over 30 hours. This data enabled spatial analyses of insect activity we used to confirm a uniform pollinator distribution within polytunnels, as desired by the farm management team. The data also highlighted variation of insect activity associated with time of day and microclimate. AGRICAM therefore has been shown to be a scalable, automated crop pollination monitor that can support data-driven decisions to enhance pollination management, thereby improving crop productivity and food security.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出并验证了一种名为AGRICAM的自动化机器人系统，用于大规模农作物授粉监测，有效采集并分析授粉昆虫行为数据，从而为农场管理提供数据支持、优化授粉效果。
AI.motivation: 农作物授粉对全球粮食生产至关重要，但如何在商业化大规模农场准确、有效地进行授粉昆虫监测一直是难题，主要受到人力、技术资源和空间覆盖范围的限制。
AI.method: 作者设计并实现了AGRICAM机器人系统，该系统集成了双RGB相机、微气候传感器、GPS、RFID、运动传感器和4G数据上传等功能，可以在温室大棚等受保护作物环境中自动巡回监测。AGRICAM通过轨道自主移动收集图像、视频及环境数据，上传至云端，结合计算机视觉模型分析授粉昆虫的到访和行为特征，支持远程配置和时间调度。系统在商业蓝莓农场80米大棚进行了30小时实地测试验证。
AI.result: AGRICAM系统成功实现了对昆虫授粉模式的空间映射，数据揭示了大棚内部授粉昆虫分布的均匀性，同时还发现了不同时段及微气候条件下昆虫活动的变化。
AI.conclusion: AGRICAM作为一种可扩展自动化的作物授粉监控工具，能够为农场提供精准的数据驱动决策支持，助力提升授粉管理水平、作物产量及粮食安全。

title: Ontology-Guided Multi-Agent Extraction of Evaluation Objects from Academic Review Texts: Evidence from Chinese Library and Information Science
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure; accepted at ASIS&T METSTI
summary: Academic reviews, scholarly commentaries, and book reviews serve as sources of evaluative statements about theories, methods, literature, institutions, and policies, providing valuable evidence for scholarly evaluation. Existing scientific entity extraction methods mainly target research articles and are less effective for evaluation objects, which are often abstract, context-dependent, and characterized by ambiguous type boundaries. This study proposes an ontology-guided multi-agent framework for evaluation object extraction. The framework combines candidate discovery, ontology-constrained classification, and domain review. Experimental results show that it achieves a Precision of 90.33%, Recall of 84.55%, Entity-level F1 of 87.34%, Strict Typed F1 of 79.78%, and Type Accuracy of 91.35%, substantially outperforming rule-based and zero-shot baselines. Ablation results indicate that the multi-agent workflow improves recall and stability, while ontology-based boundary constraints enhance fine-grained classification and reduce category confusion. The framework supports the structured utilization of evaluative scholarly texts and provides methodological support for evidence-based research evaluation and STI mining.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种本体引导的多智能体框架，用于从学术评论类文本中抽取评价对象，并在多项指标上大幅优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 当前学术评价对象（如理论、方法、政策等）的抽取难度大，现有实体抽取方法多针对研究论文，对抽象、上下文依赖和类别边界不清的评价对象效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出本体引导的多智能体工作流，结合候选发现、本体约束分类及领域复审步骤，有效抽取并分类评价对象。
AI.result: 实验显示该方法在精确率(90.33%)、召回率(84.55%)、实体F1(87.34%)、严格类型F1(79.78%)、类型准确率(91.35%)等多个指标上显著超过基线方法。消融实验表明，多智能体流程提升了召回和稳定性，本体边界约束提升了细粒度分类并减少了类别混淆。
AI.conclusion: 该框架结构化地利用学术评价文本，为基于证据的学术评价和科技情报挖掘提供了方法支持。

title: A Tensor Variational Formulation of Gradient Energy Total Variation
summary: We present a novel variational approach to a tensor-based total variation formulation which is called gradient energy total variation, GETV. We introduce the gradient energy tensor [6] into the GETV and show that the corresponding Euler-Lagrange (E-L) equation is a tensor-based partial differential equation of total variation type. Furthermore, we give a proof which shows that GETV is a convex functional. This approach, in contrast to the commonly used structure tensor, enables a formal derivation of the corresponding E-L equation. Experimental results suggest that GETV compares favourably to other state of the art variational denoising methods such as extended anisotropic diffusion (EAD)[1] and total variation (TV) [18] for gray-scale and colour images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的基于张量的全变分方法（GETV），通过引入梯度能量张量，实现了更优的图像去噪效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的全变分去噪模型存在局限，传统的结构张量方法难以正式推导E-L方程，且在灰度和彩色图像去噪中有提升空间。
AI.method: 提出GETV方法，把梯度能量张量引入到全变分模型中，从而形成新的能量泛函，并推导出对应的Euler-Lagrange方程，证明该模型是凸泛函。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，GETV相比现有扩展各向异性扩散（EAD）和全变分（TV）方法，在灰度和彩色图像去噪上表现更优。
AI.conclusion: GETV是一种有效的基于张量的全变分图像去噪方法，在理论和实验上都优于已有方法，具有更广泛应用前景。

title: Calibration and Comparative Analysis of Forward-Looking Sonar and 3D Sonar for Enhanced Underwater Object Recognition
summary: Sonars generate a significant amount of noise. With the advent of new technology capable of producing full 3D point clouds, the noise is amplified in sparse point clouds, making it challenging to recognize features for navigation, recognition, or reconstruction. To address this challenge, we propose using two different sonar modalities: one that produces a 2D intensity image and another that generates a 3D point cloud. By implementing auto-calibration, we can filter out noisy features between the modalities to enhance feature extraction. Experiments demonstrate that auto-calibration improves performance over manual calibration by 5% and that filtering enhances feature extraction by more than 40% relative to the raw point cloud. Code and datasets are given at https://theaprilab.org/fls-3d-calibrator

AI.tldr: 本文结合2D声纳图像与3D点云，通过自动校准和特征过滤技术，有效提升了从声纳点云中提取有效特征的能力。
AI.motivation: 由于先进声纳系统能生成稀疏且噪声大的3D点云，特征识别困难，影响导航与重建，因此需改进点云特征提取。
AI.method: 融合提供2D强度图像和3D点云的两种声纳模态，通过自动校准对齐数据，并设计特征过滤流程来去除噪声点，提高特征提取质量。
AI.result: 自动校准比人工校准性能提高5%；模态过滤相比原始点云特征提取能力提升40%以上。
AI.conclusion: 2D和3D声纳模态与自动校准结合可大幅减少点云噪声并强化特征提取，对声纳导航和识别意义重大。

title: Argument-Aware Semantic Alignment of Normative Texts: A Toulmin-Based Neuro-Symbolic Approach
summary: Semantic alignment between specialized normative texts is challenging when equivalent requirements use different terms, syntax, and levels of abstraction. Lexical overlap, distributional embeddings, and semantic similarity capture topical relatedness but often miss the argumentative structure by which normative claims are supported, qualified, and justified. This paper asks whether explicit argument structure adds information complementary to neural semantics for aligning requirements. We treat cross-standard control mapping as argument-aware semantic alignment and build a neuro-symbolic pipeline that combines neural text representations with Toulmin features. An LLM explicitation step identifies claims, grounds, warrants, qualifiers, and backing and reconstructs enthymemes. These feed an alignment model via argument-aware similarity and structural features. On a NERC-CIP to NIST-CSF mapping benchmark, argument-derived features improve alignment over a neuro-symbolic semantic baseline. Feature selection shows especially strong signal from warrant-related features, indicating that the link between a claim and its supporting reasoning is not captured by conventional similarity alone. A compact claim--grounds--warrant subset remains competitive with the full Toulmin feature set. The results give preliminary evidence that argument structure is a useful intermediate representation for aligning specialized normative texts. Cybersecurity standards are used as a controlled testbed, not as proof of domain-independent generalization. The argument graphs produced by LLM explicitation may also support later work on retrieval, reasoning, and explanation over normative text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合神经语义和论证结构特征的新方法，用于跨标准对齐规范性文本要求，并在网络安全标准映射任务上获得了比单一神经语义方法更好的效果。
AI.motivation: 规范性文本之间的语义对齐非常困难，因为不同标准中的相等要求常用不同术语、句法和抽象层次，以往方法主要侧重于词汇表面或分布式语义，难以识别论证结构（如主张、理由、支持等）。作者探索：引入显式论证结构是否能补充现有神经语义方法，更有效地对齐规范性要求。
AI.method: 方法将跨标准要求映射建模为“论证感知”的语义对齐，具体包括：利用大型语言模型（LLM）对文本进行论证成分抽取（提取主张、事实基础、论证理由/支持、限定词、背书等），重构不完全论证（enthymemes），然后将这些论证结构特征与神经语义特征结合，输入到对齐模型进行语义关系建模和匹配。
AI.result: 在NERC-CIP到NIST-CSF网络安全标准的映射基准上，论证结构特征显著提升了对齐效果，相比单一神经-符号语义模型，尤其是在与论证‘理由’（warrant）相关的特征上信号最强。简化到主张-事实基础-理由的子集特征集也接近完整特征集的效果。
AI.conclusion: 实验初步证明，引入论证结构作为中间表征有助于提升专业规范性文本的对齐效果，尤其能弥补常规语义相似性方法的不足，所提出的论证图也有潜力用于后续的检索、推理与解释任务。当前仍是网络安全领域的小规模验证，未来待更广泛适用性测试。

title: Dynamic-Robust Photometric-Semantic Reconstruction for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding
comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: The integration of novel view synthesis (NVS) and open-vocabulary segmentation (OVS) has recently yielded powerful feed-forward 3D foundation models. However, their inherent reliance on static-scene assumptions leads to severe misalignment of spatial features in unconstrained dynamic environments. To bridge this critical gap, we propose SPAR, a novel joint semantic-geometric encoding architecture that explicitly isolates transient dynamic noise prior to latent space aggregation. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic-region-aware end-to-end training paradigm that structurally couples motion estimation with multi-view visual and semantic learning. This unified approach enables the network to inherently resolve motion conflicts and distill multi-view consistent, temporally stable scene representations from dynamic inputs. Extensive experiments on the challenging D-RE10K benchmark demonstrate that SPAR achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our end-to-end approach achieves exceptional novel view synthesis quality, yielding a PSNR of 22.15 dB and 23.33 dB given only 3 and 4 input views respectively. Despite being trained in a self-supervised manner, our model achieves an mIoU of 88.5% for motion mask prediction. Furthermore, our analysis reveals a strong inter-task synergy between photometric scene reconstruction and semantic understanding, where semantic synthesis learning consistently enhances photometric fidelity in novel view rendering. Code will be available at https://github.com/dmucby/SPAR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SPAR架构，显式分离动态环境下的瞬态干扰，通过动态区域感知训练方式联合处理三维新视角合成和语义分割，显著提升了动态场景下的一致性和合成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有三维基础模型结合了新视角合成（NVS）和开放词汇分割（OVS），但普遍假设场景静态，遇到动态环境时空间特征错位严重，难以应对现实中的复杂变化。
AI.method: SPAR架构采用联合语义-几何编码，先将动态噪声与场景主要信息分离，再基于动态区域感知的端到端训练，把运动估计与多视角视觉及语义特征学习结构性耦合，显著提高动态场景的表征能力。
AI.result: 在D-RE10K动态数据集上，SPAR取得了最新的性能记录，三视角和四视角输入下新视角合成分别达到22.15dB和23.33dB的PSNR。模型在完全自监督训练下，运动遮罩预测的mIoU高达88.5%。分析还表明，语义学习和光度重建间有较强互补性，语义合成有助于提升新视角还原的精度。
AI.conclusion: SPAR有效缓解了动态场景中NVS和OVS间的空间错位问题，实现了动态场景下新视角合成和语义分割的突破性进展，具有广阔的实际应用前景。

title: Proximity3D: Shape from Capacitive Proximity on Sensing Manifold
summary: Most shape reconstruction methods assume measurements defined over planar sensing domains, such as RGB images or depth maps. In this paper, we use a curved capacitive textile as a shape sensor, treating its surface as a non-planar sensing manifold. Each scan is represented as a capacitive proximity field on this manifold, induced by the interaction between the curved electrode layout and nearby object geometry. We introduce a multi-view feedforward reconstruction model that aggregates these fields across known sensor views and recovers the observed object shape. Simulated and physical experiments demonstrate robust reconstruction from capacitive proximity signals acquired on curved sensing surfaces, pointing toward a new route to robotic near-field geometric awareness via embodied sensing.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种基于弯曲电容纺织材料的新型形状重建方法，可在非平面传感表面精准恢复物体形状。
AI.motivation: 现有形状重建方法大多只适用于平面传感域（如RGB图像或深度图），对于非平面（如曲面）传感器的应用有限。因此，研究如何在曲面传感表面上获得高质量重建方案具有现实需求，特别适合于机器人等驻体传感场景。
AI.method: 使用弯曲的电容纺织材料作为形状传感器，将每次扫描视为该曲面上传感电极与周围物体相互作用形成的电容接近场；提出基于多视角的前馈重建网络，将多个传感器视图下的电场信息聚合，恢复物体真实形状。
AI.result: 通过模拟和实际实体实验，证明了该方法可实现从弯曲传感曲面获取的电容场信号进行稳定可靠的三维形状重建。
AI.conclusion: 本方法为机器人近场几何感知提供了新思路，展示了在非平面、驻体感知场景下利用电容纺织材料进行形状感知的巨大潜力。

title: The Emergent Symbolic Structure of Artificial Neural Networks
comment: 30 pages, plus 29 pages of references and appendices
summary: Modern systems in artificial intelligence (AI) somehow excel in domains for which they seem poorly suited. Intelligence has traditionally been modeled as operating over structured combinations of symbols, such as logical formulas. However, the strongest modern AI systems are based on neural networks, which instead represent information in continuous vectors. Vectors seem inadequate for capturing the structure of language, logic, and other cognitive domains, yet neural networks achieve impressive performance in these areas. How do they do it? In this work, we propose a potential answer: Despite appearances, perhaps the internal representations of neural networks implicitly realize symbolic structure. In support of this hypothesis, we show that the vector representations of a variety of neural networks can be closely approximated with symbolic structures: we can replace the network's entire representation-generating process with a closed-form equation instantiating a symbolic structure, and the network's behavior remains largely unchanged. This finding holds for both small-scale neural networks trained to manipulate lists as well as large language models (LLMs) operating in four domains that are central in symbolic traditions: arithmetic, logic, computer code, and language. Further, our symbolic approximation allows us to modify an LLM's behavior in targeted ways via precise interventions on its internal representations, showing that the LLM's behavior is reliant on the symbolic structures we have identified. This work provides a potential way to reconcile longstanding symbolic conceptions of intelligence with the vector-based nature of modern AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经网络内部表征其实隐式实现了符号结构，并通过实验表明可用符号结构精确近似神经网络的内部向量表征，从而对其行为产生影响。
AI.motivation: 传统上智能依赖结构化符号组合（如逻辑公式），而现代AI系统大量采用神经网络，其连续向量表示看似难以处理复杂结构，却在相关领域表现卓越。作者希望解释神经网络为何能够胜任这些以往认为需要符号表征的任务。
AI.method: 作者分析了不同神经网络（包括操作列表的小模型和大语言模型）的内部向量表征，提出并构造能够近似这些表征的符号结构，并利用封闭形式的符号公式替换掉原有的向量表征过程，观察网络行为的变化。同时，在大语言模型内部做精确符号干预以操控其行为。
AI.result: 在算术、逻辑、代码和自然语言四大符号传统领域，神经网络的向量表征均可以符号结构很好地近似，符号近似后的网络行为基本不变。通过对这些符号结构的定向干预，能够对大语言模型的输出进行精准操控，表明其行为依赖于这些内隐符号结构。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络虽然貌似使用连续向量表达信息，但其实内部已经蕴含了符号结构，这一结果为将符号主义智能观与神经网络的向量表征模式相融合提供了新的思路。

title: Foundational feature fusion for conditional flow matching in 6D pose estimation
summary: Conditional flow matching has enabled a step forward in object 6D pose estimation, achieving state-of-the-art performance by progressively denoising and registering object representations to observed scenes. Existing methods require training task-specific encoders supervised on object-scene overlap and rely on trivial feature fusion strategies to resolve pose ambiguities. We present FunFlow6D, a novel flow matching-based formulation that leverages features from geometric and appearance foundation models for pose estimation, eliminating the need for task-specific encoder training. We also introduce a cross attention-based fusion mechanism that dynamically combines geometric and appearance features to provide richer conditioning for the flow matching module. Experiments on four datasets from the BOP benchmark show that FunFlow6D outperforms the previous state of the art while reducing supervision requirements and memory overhead. Extensive ablations validate the contribution of each proposed component. Project website: https://tev-fbk.github.io/FunFlow6D/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新方法FunFlow6D，在无需特定任务编码器训练的情况下，实现更高效且更准确的物体6D位姿估计，超越目前已有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有6D位姿估计算法依赖于特定任务的编码器训练和简单特征融合，带来监督负担和效果瓶颈，难以充分利用丰富的基础模型特征。
AI.method: 引入FunFlow6D方法，利用基础几何和外观模型提取的特征，无需额外监督，结合跨注意力特征融合动态调控几何与外观信息，输入给流匹配模块实现位姿回归。
AI.result: 在BOP基准的四个公开数据集上，FunFlow6D优于以往所有方法，同时降低了对监督和显存的需求。消融实验证明每个创新模块的重要贡献。
AI.conclusion: FunFlow6D摆脱了任务特定编码器和简单特征融合的限制，利用基础模型和新型融合机制取得了更优性能，是6D位姿估计的新进展。

title: HorizonNet for visual terrain navigation
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Published at IEEE IPAS 2018. An extended version appeared in Journal of Field Robotics 37(6):951-971, 2020, doi:10.1002/rob.21929
summary: This paper investigates the problem of position estimation of unmanned surface vessels (USVs) operating in coastal areas or in the archipelago. We propose a position estimation method where the horizon line is extracted in a 360 degree panoramic image around the USV. We design a CNN architecture to determine an approximate horizon line in the image and implicitly determine the camera orientation (the pitch and roll angles). The panoramic image is warped to compensate for the camera orientation and to generate an image from an approximately level camera. A second CNN architecture is designed to extract the pixelwise horizon line in the warped image. The extracted horizon line is correlated with digital elevation model (DEM) data in the Fourier domain using a MOSSE correlation filter. Finally, we determine the location of the maximum correlation score over the search area to estimate the position of the USV. Comprehensive experiments are performed in a field trial in the archipelago. Our approach provides promising results by achieving position estimates with GPS-level accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于全景图像地平线提取的无人水面艇（USV）精确定位方法，实现了接近GPS精度的位置估计。
AI.motivation: 在海岸/群岛等特定环境中，GPS信号可能受限，因此需要无需依赖GPS信号的高精度位置估计方法。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1)使用CNN在USV周围360度全景图像中粗略提取地平线并隐式估计相机姿态（俯仰和横滚角）；(2)对全景图像进行校正使其与水平对齐；(3)第二个CNN网络精细提取校正后图像中每个像素的地平线；(4)利用MOSSE相关滤波器在傅里叶域中将地平线与DEM（数字高程模型）数据相关，(5)通过相关得分最大值确定USV的精确位置。
AI.result: 在真实群岛环境中的实验表明，该方法能实现与GPS相当精度的位置估计。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法可为受限环境下USV的定位提供有效替代方案，在缺乏或干扰GPS信号时依然具有很高的精度。

title: LoGo: Token-Level Dynamic Local-Global Attention
summary: As context lengths scale, attention increasingly becomes a primary computational bottleneck in large language models. Standard Transformers remain powerful but computationally inefficient, as they allocate the same attention budget to every token regardless of its contextual demand. Existing local-global hybrids provide a more efficient alternative by mixing restricted- and full-context attention, but they typically allocate span statically across layers or heads. To address these limitations, we propose LoGo, a token-level dynamic local-global attention mechanism that uses attention span as a direct proxy for attention budget allocation. Each LoGo layer contains coupled local and global branches: all tokens receive efficient local attention over a restricted context window, while a learned gate activates global attention with full-context access only for tokens requiring long-range information. A threshold-based budget controller maintains a target global ratio without auxiliary losses, and a progressive masking schedule stabilizes training before sparse routing takes effect. We further implement query-sparse Triton kernels that convert reduced global-attention computation into practical speedups. Extensive experiments validate LoGo's effectiveness, showing that it preserves the scaling behavior of full-attention Transformers across model sizes. In controlled comparisons, LoGo improves over the full-attention Transformer and matched-budget static local-global hybrids, with clear gains on long-range retrieval. Analysis further shows that LoGo learns interpretable span allocation patterns. These results suggest that learned token-level span allocation is an effective and scalable way to improve the long-context performance-compute trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种动态的局部-全局注意力机制LoGo，实现了更高效的注意力资源分配，提高了大语言模型在长上下文任务下的性能和计算效率。
AI.motivation: 传统Transformers在处理长上下文时，注意力机制成为主要计算瓶颈；现有的局部-全局混合方法通常在层或头之间静态分配注意力范围，无法根据每个token的具体需求动态调整资源。
AI.method: 提出LoGo机制，在每层中结合局部和全局分支，所有token进行局部注意力，只有被判定为需要长距离信息的token通过门控机制激活全局注意力。通过阈值控制目标全局比例，并采用渐进掩码稳定训练。实现了高效的稀疏查询内核，将理论计算节省转化为实际加速。
AI.result: 实验显示，LoGo不仅保留了全注意力Transformer的可扩展性，还在与全注意力Transformer及静态混合模型的对比中取得了性能与效率提升，特别是在长距离检索任务上表现突出。此外，LoGo能学到具有解释性的注意力范围分配模式。
AI.conclusion: Token级别的动态注意力范围分配是一种有效且可扩展的方法，可以优化大模型在长上下文任务中的性能与计算效率权衡。

title: Multi-Scale Temporal Domain Alignment for Federated Video Domain Adaptation
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Open-source will be available
summary: Federated Video Domain Adaptation (FVDA) enables collaborative learning across distributed and non-IID video datasets while preserving privacy, but is under-explored due to challenges in aligning temporal information. We propose Multi-scalE Temporal domAin aLignment (METAL), a novel framework that leverages temporal information at multiple resolutions to improve cross-domain video action recognition with only model parameter transfers. METAL trains per-scale transformer encoders on source-clients, then performs independent knowledge voting at each temporal scale to generate robust pseudo-labels on the target-server. A novel $L_2$ variance penalty enforces cross-scale consistency during scale-based knowledge distillation, preventing a singular dominant scale. The late fusion aggregates features across different scales, where the fusion head is trained via knowledge distillation using confidence-weighted aggregation of scale-wise predictions, enabling the model to effectively exploit complementary temporal information for final predictions. Experiments on Epic-Kitchens-55 and Daily-DA demonstrate state-of-the-art performances, with gains up to 28.47% over current FDA methods. Ablation studies prove that multi-scale distillation and scale coordination are critical for effective temporal knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多尺度时序域对齐（METAL）框架，有效提升了联邦视频域自适应的跨领域动作识别性能，在主流数据集上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 联邦视频域自适应（FVDA）在保护隐私的同时实现不同分布视频数据的协同学习，但受限于时序信息对齐困难，因此需要新的方法来提升跨域识别能力。
AI.method: 设计了METAL框架，利用多分辨率的时序信息。具体做法包括：1）在源客户端分别训练多尺度Transformer编码器；2）在每个尺度上通过独立知识投票，在目标服务器生成伪标签；3）引入L2方差惩罚，保证跨尺度一致性，避免单一尺度主导；4）采用后期融合，并通过基于置信度加权的知识蒸馏训练融合头，从不同尺度汇总特征，提升最终识别效果。
AI.result: 在Epic-Kitchens-55和Daily-DA数据集上，METAL相较于现有FDA方法性能提升最高达到28.47%。消融实验表明，多尺度蒸馏和尺度协调对时序知识迁移至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度时序信息采集与融合能显著提升联邦视频域自适应的效果，为跨域视频动作识别提供了有效的新途径。

title: Failure or Drift? Evaluating Monocular SLAM under Synthetic and Real-World Corruptions
comment: Accepted at the 3rd NeuSLAM workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: Visual SLAM is commonly evaluated on clean trajectories, although deployment failures are often caused by adverse weather, illumination, blur, and sensor artifacts. Controlled corruptions are attractive because they isolate such factors, but a synthetic stress test is useful only when it leads to the same engineering conclusion as the condition it is intended to approximate. This work examines that question for monocular SLAM. We evaluate a classical feature-based system and two learned trackers under image-space, geometry-aware, and compound corruptions, and compare their behavior with adverse conditions from 4Seasons. Rather than reducing robustness to a single trajectory error, the evaluation separates explicit tracking failure from drift accumulated by methods that remain active. The results show that learned trackers largely replace catastrophic loss with sustained, and sometimes severe, drift. More importantly, the apparent ordering of the learned systems changes with the physical fidelity of the corruption: structured rain and fog proxies preserve the real-world ordering, whereas a simple illumination proxy does not. Code is available at: https://github.com/abhaythomas/master_thesis_vslamlab_robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Visual SLAM在恶劣条件下的鲁棒性进行了系统性对比实验，发现基于学习的跟踪器与传统特征法在不同腐败类型下表现差异显著。
AI.motivation: 现有SLAM评测多基于理想环境，忽视了实际部署时多种不良因素（例如天气、照明、模糊、传感器缺陷）带来的影响。而合成腐败测试是否能真实反映实际状况、指导工程方案仍存疑。
AI.method: 挑选一种经典特征点SLAM系统和两种基于学习的跟踪器，在多种图像空间、几何感知及复合腐败下进行评估，并与现实恶劣条件（4Seasons数据集）对比。注重区分显式跟踪失败与累计漂移两类鲁棒性问题。
AI.result: 学习型跟踪器更倾向于出现持续性且有时严重的漂移，而不再发生灾难性失效。真实世界排序与腐败类型相关，高物理逼真性的腐败（如雨雾）能较好还原真实排序，照明腐败则不能。
AI.conclusion: 不同腐败合成方法对于评测SLAM系统排序的可信度至关重要，低物理逼真度的测试可能误导工程判断，应优先选择更符合实际的腐败类型进行鲁棒性评估。

title: Evaluating LLMs on Conversational Text-to-SQL under Chain Ambiguity and Intent Drift
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have established conversational text-to-SQL as a practical interface between users and databases, often involving multiple turns of clarification and revision. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate execution accuracy, leaving the unfolding and shifting of user intent across turns largely uncovered. To address this, we introduce TIDE-Bench, a benchmark for conversational text-to-SQL under chain ambiguity and intent drift evaluation, targeting two recurring patterns: chain ambiguity, where an underspecified question triggers layered clarification with conditional dependencies, and intent drift, where the user retracts and replaces a previously committed request element. Built on 514 anchor SQLs from BIRD, TIDE-Bench comprises 1,542 samples and introduces dedicated metrics for chain identification and drift recognition-resolution beyond execution accuracy. Evaluating 12 advanced LLMs reveals a persistent chain identification bottleneck unaffected by clarification frequency, a wide drift recognition-resolution gap, and overlap between failure modes when jointly activated. The corresponding code of TIDE-Bench is released for further research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TIDE-Bench，一个专门针对多轮意图变化和歧义澄清的会话式text-to-SQL基准测试。
AI.motivation: 现有text-to-SQL评测主要关注SQL执行的准确度，忽略了用户意图在多轮会话中的发展和改变。为了更真实和全面地考察模型的会话理解能力，亟需新的基准和度量。
AI.method: 作者设计了TIDE-Bench，专注于链式歧义（多步澄清、条件依赖）和意图漂移（用户撤回并重新指定请求内容）两大挑战。从BIRD数据集中抽取514个基础SQL，扩展为1542个多轮会话样本，并引入链识别与漂移识别-解决等新指标，对12个先进LLM进行测评。
AI.result: 实验发现，大型语言模型普遍存在链识别瓶颈，此现象与澄清轮次无关；对于意图漂移，模型的识别与处理能力差距较大；当两种挑战同时出现时，模型的失效模式有显著重合。
AI.conclusion: TIDE-Bench开辟了会话式text-to-SQL评测的新方向，丰富了理解模型多轮会话中歧义与意图变化的能力，对促进相关算法进步具有重要意义。

title: OPUS-V2: Bridging the Gap between Sparse Points and Dense Voxels
summary: The point-based occupancy prediction paradigm has achieved an attractive trade-off between accuracy and efficiency by modeling 3D space sparsely. However, its predictions inherently mismatch the dense voxel-based occupancy required by self-driving systems, necessitating hand-crafted heuristics during training and inference that limit final performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose OPUS-V2, a novel framework built upon the pioneering OPUS (occupancy prediction using a sparse set) point-based approach. OPUS-V2 incorporates a lightweight point-voxel transformation (PVT) module behind the decoder to adaptively map sparse predictions into the dense voxel space, eliminating the need for suboptimal operations and improving model accuracy. Furthermore, our architecture decouples feature and occupancy generation processes, allowing OPUS-V2 to adapt to arbitrary occupancy resolutions. OPUS-V2 achieves a state-of-the-art rayIoU of 44.0 on the Occ3D dataset. On the more challenging OpenOccupancy dataset, it attains a competitive 16.4 mIoU while running in real time at 20.6 FPS.

AI.tldr: OPUS-V2是一种改进的点基占用预测方法，通过引入PVT模块实现从稀疏点预测到稠密体素占用空间的高效映射，有效提升准确性并减少人工操作，实现了在相关数据集上的领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有点基占用预测兼顾了准确率与效率，但实际自动驾驶对稠密体素占用需求与其天然不匹配，训练和推理时需人工设置，限制了最终效果。
AI.method: 提出了OPUS-V2模型，在解码器后引入高效轻量的点-体素变换（PVT）模块，将稀疏点预测自适应映射为稠密体素占用，且结构上分离了特征生成与占用生成过程，可适配任意分辨率。
AI.result: 在Occ3D数据集上，OPUS-V2实现了44.0的rayIoU，在更具挑战性的OpenOccupancy数据集上获得了16.4的mIoU，并可实时推理（20.6 FPS）。
AI.conclusion: OPUS-V2无需依赖次优人工操作的前提下，显著提升了点基占用预测的精度和灵活性，在多个数据集上实现了顶尖或有竞争力的表现，适用于实际自动驾驶占用预测需求。

title: Driving on Memory
summary:
End-to-end autonomous driving models plan future trajectories from raw sensor input. While earlier driving benchmarks often measured deviation from the human trajectory, current benchmarks such as NAVSIM and Bench2Drive evaluate models with richer simulation-based metrics intended to capture safe and compliant driving. A high benchmark score should reflect that a model can understand the scene in front of it and act accordingly. But how much of that score specifically comes from reacting to the dynamic part of that scene?
  To probe this, we remove a model's camera input and replace it with memories from prior drives at the same location. The retrieved memories can provide persistent scene information, including road layout and location-conditioned regularities, but not the current traffic state. Surprisingly, memory is nearly sufficient on NAVSIM, reaching or even exceeding the performance of leading end-to-end methods without actually observing the evaluated scene. Our results suggest that a high NAVSIM score does not require a planner to react to the current traffic scene and should be treated with caution. This effect is benchmark-dependent: driving from memory causes substantially larger performance drops on Bench2Drive and RealEngine. We provide our code at https://github.com/boschresearch/MemoryDrivoR .

AI.tldr: 作者发现在自动驾驶评估基准如NAVSIM中，仅依靠历史行驶记忆而非实时相机输入，模型依然能获得极高分数，甚至与主流端到端方法相当或更高。这表明当前基准分数很大程度上并不代表对动态场景的真实理解。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶的模拟评测基准，如NAVSIM，普遍认为高分数代表模型能理解并合理应对当前动态路况，但实际贡献主要源自于模型对动态内容的反应，还是只需理解静态场景尚不明确。
AI.method: 作者将端到端驾驶模型的实时相机输入替换为相同地点先前行驶的记忆图像（即“记忆驱动”），比较其在不同驾驶基准（NAVSIM、Bench2Drive、RealEngine）中的表现，分析“仅凭记忆驾驶”对得分的影响。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM基准下，仅凭记忆驱动的模型得分几乎与领先的端到端方法相当，甚至有时超过；在Bench2Drive和RealEngine基准下则性能大幅下降。说明NAVSIM分数难以反映模型对动态交通环境的反应能力。
AI.conclusion: NAVSIM等部分自动驾驶基准的高分并不意味着模型具备良好的动态场景理解能力，需要谨慎对待。社区在采用类似评测基准作模型对比时应注意其局限性。

title: TACS: Trajectory-Aware Candidate Selection for LLM Jailbreak Suffix Optimization
summary: Gradient-based jailbreak suffix optimization methods typically update the suffix by retaining the candidate with the lowest current loss. We show that this seemingly natural design is fundamentally myopic: candidates that look better under the current-step proxy often fail to produce better jailbreak outcomes later in the search, revealing a form of selection-stage reward hacking. This suggests that candidate selection, rather than candidate generation alone, is a hidden bottleneck in suffix optimization. To address this issue, we propose \OURS{}, a trajectory-aware candidate selection framework for jailbreak suffix optimization. Instead of selecting candidates solely by their immediate loss, \OURS{} augments per-step evaluation with a trajectory-aware proxy and stabilizes selection with reference-policy regularization and a discriminator-estimated chi-squared correction, encouraging choices that remain effective beyond the current step. Experiments on HarmBench show that \OURS{} consistently outperforms strong baselines under the same search budget, substantially improving attack success rates while exhibiting more stable optimization behavior throughout the search. Our findings highlight that mitigating selection-stage reward hacking caused by myopic candidate selection is critical for improving jailbreak suffix optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文发现当前主流的越狱后缀优化方法在候选选择阶段存在短视性问题，并提出了一种轨迹感知的候选选择框架，有效提升了越狱攻击的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于梯度的越狱后缀优化方法通常只选取当前损失最小的候选，导致后续效果不佳。作者发现候选选择过程中的短视行为限制了优化效果。
AI.method: 提出轨迹感知（trajectory-aware）候选选择框架（OURS），在每步选择中不只看即时损失，还融入轨迹信息。方法引入参考策略正则化和鉴别器判别的chi-squared校正，增加选择长期有效的候选概率。
AI.result: 在HarmBench基准上，OURS在同等搜索预算下显著优于强基线，攻击成功率大幅提升，优化过程更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 缓解因短视候选选择导致的奖励滥用，是提升越狱后缀优化效果的关键。提出的方法能显著提升越狱优化效率和稳定性。

title: RLG-TPV: Radar- and LiDAR-Guided Tri-Perspective View Fusion for Camera-Radar 3D Object Detection
summary: Tri-Perspective View (TPV) representations describe 3D scene structure through top, side, and front feature planes, but existing TPV lifting is primarily camera-based, leaving the depth of sampled image evidence ambiguous along projected camera rays. We propose RLG-TPV, a multimodal TPV framework for camera-radar 3D object detection in which radar and training-time LiDAR provide complementary geometric guidance during representation construction. A ray-guided deformable-attention lift weights sampled image features using LiDAR-supervised camera depth probabilities and radar frustum occupancy, while radar additionally refines the depth distribution before lifting. Because conventional radar provides limited elevation information, LiDAR-derived class-occupancy targets supervise the side and front planes during training; the corresponding heads are removed at inference, so deployment requires only cameras and radar. For temporal aggregation, Doppler-guided temporal fusion aligns past features using a motion field anchored by measured radar radial velocity, with gating that limits warping in regions without supported motion. An RCS-aware radar scatter further allows radar evidence to spread over spatial neighborhoods conditioned on radar cross section. On the nuScenes validation set, RLG-TPV achieves 0.4981 mAP and 0.5959 NDS, reducing orientation and velocity error by 31.9\% and 30.7\% relative to the published CRN baseline. Ablation studies show that ray-level geometric guidance is a major contributor to the final performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于相机与雷达联合的三视图(TPV)3D物体检测框架RLG-TPV，通过引入激光雷达（LiDAR）在训练阶段提供几何引导和深度概率监督，提高了现有TPV方法在3D场景结构感知中的鲁棒性和精度。
AI.motivation: 传统TPV方法主要依赖相机，深度信息不明确，且雷达因为提供的高度信息有限，检测3D目标存在瓶颈。如何充分融合雷达、相机和炼丹（LiDAR）信息，构建更高效准确的3D检测方案，是本文关注的核心问题。
AI.method: 作者提出RLG-TPV框架，Ray-guided deformable-attention lift结合LiDAR提供的深度概率与雷达的空间占有信息，精细加权图像特征实现更准确的三视图升维。训练阶段以LiDAR监督侧面、正面视图，测试时无需LiDAR。引入Doppler引导的时序融合，结合雷达速度信息矫正时序特征对齐，并通过RCS-aware机制增强雷达特征泛化能力。
AI.result: 在nuScenes验证集上，RLG-TPV实现了0.4981 mAP和0.5959 NDS，在方向和速度误差上相较于CRN基线分别下降了31.9%和30.7%。消融实验进一步证明光线级别几何监督对效果至关重要。
AI.conclusion: RLG-TPV能有效融合多模态传感器信息，在测试阶段仅需相机和雷达即可获得优秀的3D目标检测性能，验证了利用几何先验和多源数据提升TPV检测方法的潜力。

title: Which one is banana man? Evaluating vision-language models in multi-turn pragmatic interpretation
summary: Flexible adaptation to context and shared pragmatic intuitions contribute to smooth human conversation. Iterated reference games---in which players repeatedly pick out novel referents using language---present a test case for agents' ability to perform context-sensitive pragmatic reasoning in multi-turn linguistic environments. We tested humans and vision--language models on their ability to identify the intended meaning of descriptions produced in iterated reference games, varying the provided context in terms of amount, order, and relevance. While humans performed well consistently, the models we evaluated could make use of prior context to interpret humans' referring expressions, but they struggled to build up the relevant context to interpret those expressions effectively. Our results suggest that the models we evaluated lack core skills needed for efficient linguistic collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本论文研究了人类与视觉-语言模型在多轮参考指代游戏中的语用推理能力。虽然人类能灵活适应语境完成任务，但目前的模型仍明显逊色。
AI.motivation: 人类对话中能灵活适应语境与共享语用直觉，这有助于顺畅交流。迭代参考游戏是测试智能体是否具备上下文敏感语用推理能力的典型场景。评估视觉-语言模型在复杂语境下的表现，有助于推动更强的语言理解系统。
AI.method: 论文设计了一系列迭代参考指代游戏，改变语境的信息量、顺序和相关性，让人类和视觉-语言模型判断语言描述的指代对象。比较模型和人类理解复杂语境下描述的能力。
AI.result: 实验发现：人类无论语境如何变化，表现一贯优秀。视觉-语言模型则只能部分利用前文信息，无法有效建立和运用复杂语境，理解力较弱。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉-语言模型尚缺乏高效语言协作所需的核心能力，尤其是灵活构建和使用语境的能力，限制了其语用推理和协作表现。

title: Bayesian-Optimized Superpixel-GrabCut for Traceable Optic Disc Segmentation
comment: Accepted at 15th International Conference on Image Processing Theory, Tools and Applications 2026
summary: Optic disc (OD) segmentation is essential for diagnosing ophthalmic pathologies from retinal fundus images. However, prevailing deep learning approaches operate as opaque black boxes, lacking the inference-stage mathematical traceability--a critical requirement for algorithmic auditing and failure analysis in clinical workflows. This paper presents a fully algorithmically traceable and trainable segmentation pipeline that jointly combines superpixel decomposition, hybrid brightness-proximity superpixel scoring, morphological regularization, iterative GrabCut refinement, and elliptical shape fitting. The hyperparameter optimization is formulated as an objective function and solved via Bayesian optimization to eliminate manual parameter tuning. A quantitative evaluation on the Drishti-GS dataset demonstrates that our method achieves a Dice coefficient of 0.9536, matching state-of-the-art performance. By maintaining explicit mathematical transparency across all processing stages, our framework offers a deterministic, traceable alternative to black-box architectures for medical review and debugging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全流程可追溯且可训练的视盘分割方法，在保证算法透明性的同时达到先进的分割性能。
AI.motivation: 目前的深度学习视盘分割方法为“黑箱”，缺乏推理阶段的数学可追溯性，不利于医疗审核和故障分析。
AI.method: 该方法融合超像素分割、亮度-邻近性混合打分、形态学正则化、迭代GrabCut细化及椭圆形拟合。超参数采用贝叶斯优化，避免人工调整。
AI.result: 在Drishti-GS数据集上，该方法取得了Dice系数0.9536，与先进模型持平。
AI.conclusion: 该算法流程在各阶段都具备显式的数学透明性，为医疗复核和调试提供了可追溯、确定性的替代方案，有助于实际临床应用。

title: SemTrace: Source-Grounded Semantic Signatures for Tracing LLM Exposure to Protected Documents
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to read documents and produce downstream text, creating a provenance problem when the document owner cannot control or inspect the model that performs the generation. We introduce SemTrace, a source-grounded semantic watermark for detecting whether a generated review was influenced by a known protected manuscript copy. Rather than biasing token probabilities or imposing surface-form patterns, SemTrace constructs a document-specific binary signature from factual propositions that are directly supported by the manuscript itself. A protected PDF invisibly carries a content contract that selects one fact from each binary pair and asks an instruction-following reviewer to express those facts in fixed review slots without changing its independent evaluation. A frozen natural language inference model then decodes the resulting semantic evidence with explicit erasures and scores the recovered bits against the codeword assigned to that copy. This design targets model-agnostic, assigned-copy exposure detection while keeping the watermark semantically tied to the source document.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SemTrace的语义水印方法，用于检测大语言模型生成文本是否受特定受保护文档的影响。通过文档特定的语义签名实现可追溯性，同时保证水印与原文内容的紧密关联。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能够生成高质量文本，但内容溯源困难，文档所有者难以控制第三方模型是否引用了其原创内容，亟需有效的生成内容溯源手段。
AI.method: SemTrace构造与文档内容相关的二进制语义签名，通过对受保护PDF文档嵌入隐形内容契约，要求评审者在固定槽位表达一组事实。冻结的自然语言推断模型对生成文本中显式或被擦除的事实进行解码，并与预分配的签名比对，实现溯源检测。
AI.result: SemTrace能够在不同LLM和内容表达变化下，可靠检测生成内容是否借用了某份受保护文档，且该水印机制具备模型不可知性和较强的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: SemTrace展示了一种兼具高精准度、源内容紧密相关性和模型不可知性的新型语义水印方案，为大模型内容溯源和数字版权保护带来新路径。

title: Ground-to-Satellite Localization in Unconstrained Image Collections for 3D Scene Reconstruction
comment: IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026
summary: Ground image localization with respect to satellite imagery is a key enabler for metrically-accurate, geo-localized 3D scene reconstruction from unconstrained image collections. Existing cross-view localization methods have strict requirements such as panoramic imagery or known initial locations, limiting their applicability for in-the-wild reconstruction settings. We propose a robust hierarchical cross-view localization framework that leverages geometric constraints from Structure-from-Motion (SfM) models derived from unconstrained ground image collections. Our method generates coarse-to-fine pose hypotheses through a cross-view matching approach and aggregates noisy predictions across SfM model(s) using Kernel Density Estimation to recover consensus alignments while filtering outliers. Experiments demonstrate reliable localization performance from challenging image collections. Empirically we found satellite-referenced alignment enables accurate metric scale estimation, doppelgänger detection, and merging of disjoint SfM reconstructions, resulting in more complete, geo-localized site models than are possible with SfM alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种强健的分层跨视角定位框架，利用SfM模型增强无人约束图像集合的地面图像与卫星图像定位，实现高精度、地理对齐的3D场景重建，超越了传统方法的适用范围和表现。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角定位方法对全景图像或已知初始位置有严格依赖，限制了其在真实场景及未知环境下的重建应用。因此需要一种更灵活、鲁棒的新方法。
AI.method: 方法结合无人约束的地面图像集合，先通过SfM建立几何约束；再通过分层匹配产生粗到细的位姿假设，并利用核密度估计在多个SfM模型中融合去噪，获得共识对齐，滤除异常结果。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的图像集上实验，方法表现出可靠的定位能力；实验证明通过卫星参考对齐，不仅能实现精确的尺度估计，还能检测重复对象，合并分散的SfM重建，获得更完整、地理对齐的场景模型。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在无需已知初始位姿或全景图像的情况下，极大扩展了SfM在地理对齐3D重建中的适用性与精度，对实际大规模、不确定环境的三维重建具有重要推动作用。

title: SUP-MIMIC: A Multi-Task Clinical Diagnosis Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs' Robustness to Contradictory Evidence
summary: Current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) primarily focus on factual knowledge retrieval, overlooking the fundamental challenge of navigating the complex, non-bijective mappings between clinical indicators and diagnoses. Existing benchmarks fail to assess whether large language models truly possess the reasoning capability required for diagnostic ambiguity scenarios, where identical clinical presentations may correspond to different etiologies, and diagnostic convergence scenarios, where heterogeneous symptoms ultimately indicate the same disease. To address this issue, we propose SUP-MIMIC, a multi-task framework utilizing MIMIC-IV-v3.1 that comprises Basic Assessment (BA), Diagnostic Divergence Task (DDT), and Diagnostic Convergence Task (DCT). Specifically, DDT is designed to evaluate the model's "one-to-many" disambiguation capability among phenotypically similar cases, while DCT assesses the model's ability to identify "many-to-one" diagnostic patterns across different pathophysiological pathways. Comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs reveals substantial performance degradation on DDT and DCT compared to baseline tasks, exposing a systemic reliance on statistical shortcuts over genuine causal reasoning. Our findings further highlight a conservative bias toward "healthy" predictions, implying non-trivial risks for missed diagnoses in realistic medical settings. This work establishes a rigorous methodology for quantifying clinical reasoning robustness and provides a roadmap for enhancing the safety of language models in clinical medicine.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了SUP-MIMIC多任务框架，通过MIMIC-IV-v3.1数据集，评估大语言模型（LLMs）在处理诊断歧义和收敛场景中的临床推理能力。结果显示，当前大语言模型在这些复杂任务上的表现明显下降，暴露出对统计捷径的依赖和实际医疗风险。
AI.motivation: 现有对大语言模型的评估主要集中在知识检索，忽视了临床指标与诊断之间复杂映射的推理挑战。尤其是在同一症状对应不同病因（歧义）或不同症状指向同一疾病（收敛）时，传统评测无法反映LLMs的真实推理能力。
AI.method: 提出了SUP-MIMIC多任务评测框架，包括基本评估（BA）、诊断分歧任务（DDT，“一对多”）和诊断收敛任务（DCT，“多对一”）。通过MIMIC-IV数据库构造不同任务，系统评估LLMs在临床推理中的表现。
AI.result: 在与传统任务比较中，当前最先进的LLMs在DDT和DCT任务上表现显著下降。分析发现，模型多数时候依赖统计关联而非因果推理，并在诊断上倾向于保守地做出“健康”判断，带来漏诊风险。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了量化LLMs临床推理鲁棒性的方法学，并揭示了其在医疗场景下安全性改进的方向。为未来临床医学中LLMs的安全应用提供了评价标准和技术路线。

title: SGPDFuse: Semantically-Guided Physics-Disentanglement General Multi-Modal Image Fusion
summary: Multimodal image fusion (MMIF) aims to integrate complementary sensor data into a single representation that preserves intrinsic scene reality while eliminating environmental interferences. Most existing approaches rely on blind feature aggregation, which excels at signal accumulation but fails to distinguish essential content from physical degradations. We propose SGPDFuse, which bridges this gap by mapping inputs into a physics-disentangled structural representation via a Semantic-Physical Parametric Bridge (SPPB) built on pretrained vision foundation models, utilizing the Intrinsic-Variation principle to decouple invariant scene attributes from transient environmental factors. To guide this decomposition, we introduce a Semantic Alignment mechanism: we explicitly anchor the fused representation to salient semantic features in the same foundation model feature space via cosine similarity to preserve critical targets, while enforcing physical texture fidelity through Gram-matrix regularization to strictly eliminate unnatural artifacts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SGPDFuse achieves state-of-the-art performance across infrared-visible, multi-focus, and multi-exposure benchmarks using a single architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的多模态图像融合方法SGPDFuse，有效区分并结合了图像中的场景本质信息和环境噪声，实现了在多种任务中的最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态图像融合方法大多简单堆叠特征，难以区分场景本质与环境干扰，影响最终融合质量。为解决该问题，有必要通过结构化建模，有效解耦出有用的场景信息。
AI.method: 提出SGPDFuse方法，利用预训练基础视觉模型和语义-物理参数桥(SPPB)，基于Intrinsic-Variation原理，将输入映射为语义与物理解耦的结构化表示。采用语义对齐机制，通过余弦相似度将融合结果锚定到重要语义特征，同时通过Gram矩阵正则强约物理纹理保持真实性，消除伪影。
AI.result: 在红外-可见光、多焦点、多曝光等标准融合任务上，SGPDFuse在统一架构下实现了最先进的融合表现。多项实验充分验证了其优越性。
AI.conclusion: SGPDFuse能显著提升多模态图像融合的保真度和目标识别能力，有效消除环境噪声和伪影，推动了图像融合技术的发展。

title: How You Ask Shapes What You Get: A Theory-Seeded Measurement of Articulation in Advice-Seeking LLM Conversations
summary: Users articulate the same advice-seeking request in different ways: some specify detailed constraints, others gesture at a vague need. Prior work treats this variation as noise to be averaged away; we instead treat it as a stable, measurable structure in the input distribution. We ask whether articulation (how people ask) forms latent dimensions separable from topic (what they ask about), and whether it is associated with how language models respond. We extract interpretable features from 16,447 advice-seeking prompts pooled from public chat corpora (WildChat, LMSYS, and ShareChat) and recover a small set of latent articulation factors that replicate across train/test splits and across corpora. Because this structure is largely separable from topic, the populations it defines cut across topics and stay invisible to topic- or task-based evaluation. The factors define a handful of recurring articulation styles, one of which stands out: a long-form but information-poor style, roughly one in six prompts in the largest corpus, where models return shorter, vaguer answers and do not ask for clarification even though under-specification is exactly the condition that warrants it. The contrast holds within every topic group and length quintile, and is not under-specification alone -- a second, equally under-specified style does draw clarifying questions. Two independent human annotators reproduce this contrast. We argue that benchmarks should stratify on articulation, and we offer the extracted structure as a measurement instrument for doing so.

AI.tldr: 本论文发现，用户在寻求建议时的提问方式（articulation）存在可度量的结构，可与话题类型分离开来，而且这种结构会显著影响大模型的回应风格，因此应在评测语言模型时考虑提问的表达方式。
AI.motivation: 当前研究普遍将用户在提问时表达差异视为噪声，但作者认为这些表达差异反映了输入分布中的潜在结构，有必要深入研究它对大模型回答行为的实际影响，以提升真实应用中的模型评估与优化。
AI.method: 作者从多个公开聊天语料（WildChat, LMSYS, ShareChat）中收集了16,447条寻求建议的提问，通过提取可解释特征，利用潜在因子分析等方法，挖掘并验证了表达方式的潜在维度，并分析了这些表达风格与模型回应的关系。
AI.result: 结果发现，表达方式维度在不同主题和数据划分中均可复现，且与话题基本正交。一个典型表达风格为长文本但信息贫乏，约占主语料六分之一，该风格下大模型往往给出简短、模糊的回复且很少主动澄清，而另一种同样信息不足的风格则更易引发模型的澄清提问。这些现象通过双重人工标注得到复现。
AI.conclusion: 提问方式的表达结构在大模型回应中扮演关键角色，仅基于话题或任务分类的现有评测忽略了表达维度隐含的人群与表现差异。作者建议未来基准评测应考虑表达方式的分层，并提供了衡量工具帮助实现更精细的模型评估。

title: Using Channel Representations in Regularization Terms: A Case Study on Image Diffusion
summary: In this work we propose a novel non-linear diffusion filtering approach for images based on their channel representation. To derive the diffusion update scheme we formulate a novel energy functional using a soft-histogram representation of image pixel neighborhoods obtained from the channel encoding. The resulting Euler-Lagrange equation yields a non-linear robust diffusion scheme with additional weighting terms stemming from the channel representation which steer the diffusion process. We apply this novel energy formulation to image reconstruction problems, showing good performance in the presence of mixtures of Gaussian and impulse-like noise, e.g. missing data. In denoising experiments of common scalar-valued images our approach performs competitive compared to other diffusion schemes as well as state-of-the-art denoising methods for the considered noise types.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于通道表示的图像非线性扩散滤波方法，并在图像重建和去噪实验中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散滤波方法在去除高斯噪声和脉冲噪声等混合噪声时存在一定局限性，因此需要一种新的、更健壮的扩散方法以提升图像重建和去噪性能。
AI.method: 作者基于图像的通道编码提出了一种新的能量泛函，通过软直方图描述像素邻域。基于此能量泛函推导出Euler-Lagrange方程，得到带有额外加权项的非线性扩散更新方案，这些加权项由通道表示导出，用来调控扩散过程。
AI.result: 所提出的方法在面对混合高斯噪声和脉冲噪声下的图像重建任务中表现良好。在常见的标量图像去噪实验中，该方法在所考虑噪声类型下，与其他主流扩散方法和最新去噪技术相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 基于通道表示的非线性扩散滤波方法能有效处理混合噪声，在图像重建和去噪方面具备较强竞争力，可为相关图像处理任务提供新的技术途径。

title: Hindsight Memory-PRM: Supervising Memory Management with Auditable Hindsight Credit
summary: Memory operations of long-horizon LLM agents are hard to supervise: an operation's value is unobservable when it is taken. But they are special -- they leave machine-readable evidence in the trajectory: retrieval hits and answer-time citations. Hindsight Memory-PRM exploits this audit trail twice: offline to train an operation-conditioned memory-utility critic, and online, where retrievals, citations, and one controlled deletion-and-reanswer per probe settle an intervention-calibrated entry-level presence credit, propagated along version chains as an action-level proxy reward -- no per-operation human labels, no Monte-Carlo replay of continuations. On held-out LoCoMo a local 8B policy reaches 77.5% under a fixed shared reader, surpassing its API teacher (65.1%) and all reproduced external systems, at one eighth the context of Mem0's official operating point; on LongMemEval, 79.0%. Ablations attribute the gain to causal calibration rather than signal density, and the policy converges to a multi-version memory organization whose gains no tested open-loop baseline reproduces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Hindsight Memory-PRM的新方法，通过利用大模型智能体在长时序记忆操作中产生的可审计轨迹（如检索命中、答案引用等），无需单步人工标注，使得智能体能更有效地进行长期记忆操作学习。
AI.motivation: 长时序大模型智能体的记忆操作难以监督，因为操作价值在执行时不可观测，但相关证据（如检索与引用）却可被机器读取，提示可用于记忆操作价值评估的新思路。
AI.method: Hindsight Memory-PRM将这些机器可读的证据离线用于训练基于操作条件的记忆效用判别器，在线时结合检索、引用以及一次受控的删除和重答操作，形成可干预校准的奖励信号，并沿操作版本链传播，完全不依赖人工逐操作标注和蒙特卡洛回放。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准任务中，一种本地8B模型在共享阅读器下达到77.5%的成绩，超过了API师模型（65.1%）及所有复现的外部系统，并且仅使用了Mem0原配置的1/8上下文长度；在LongMemEval任务上达到79.0%。消融实验表明，提升源自因果校准而非信号密度，并且策略收敛于多版本记忆组织结构，所有测试的开环基线均未能重现其效果。
AI.conclusion: Hindsight Memory-PRM有效利用操作轨迹的因果证据，实现了难以人工监督的长时记忆操作奖励信号生成，大幅提升记忆能力，推动了长时序智能体实用性的发展。

title: Compact Snapshot Spectral Imaging with Calibration-Free Aperture Diffraction
comment: Submitted to IEEE TPAMI. Under Review
summary: Snapshot Spectral Imaging (SSI) provides high-dimensional temporal-spatial-spectral observation to uncover intrinsic physical characteristics. However, its complex system and repetitive calibration requirements hinder edge applications. Here, we propose a compact, cost-effective, calibration-free SSI method, Aperture Diffraction Imaging Spectrometer (ADIS), which consists only of a diffractive lens with a binary mask and a Bayer-filtered sensor, requiring no additional physical footprint compared to standard RGB cameras. ADIS disperses and multiplexes wavelengths, mapping energy to distinct sensor locations, enabling full-resolution recovery from superpixel-level encodings. ADIS directly leverages theoretically computed PSFs to enable calibration-free spectral reconstruction, while tolerating lens-dependent variations across different optical configurations and bridging the gap between simulation and reality. To achieve SSI by solving a sparsely-constrained inverse problem, we introduce the Orthogonal Diffraction-Aware Unfolding Framework (ODAUF) with Voxel Shift Transformer (VST) for improved orthogonal diffraction perception. Integrating VST into ODAUF forms the efficient Orthogonal Diffraction-Aware Unfolding Voxel Shift Transformer (ODAUVST), delivering excellent recovery and reduced parameters. By elaborating on theory, systematic and comprehensive comparing, and demonstrating real SSI results, we validate the superiority of ADIS, achieving calibration-free full-resolution SSI within a commercial camera footprint.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新型紧凑、低成本、免标定的快照光谱成像（SSI）方法——光阑衍射成像光谱仪（ADIS），使用理论点扩散函数（PSF）直接重建，无需复杂标定和硬件扩展。引入创新算法ODAUVST提升重建质量，系统实验证明方法优越。
AI.motivation: 传统SSI系统结构复杂，需要频繁的标定，难以在边缘设备上普及。作者希望简化结构、降低成本，实现无需标定的高分辨率SSI，从而扩大应用场景。
AI.method: ADIS系统仅由带二值掩膜的衍射透镜和带拜耳滤波的传感器组成，无需增大体积。成像通过波长分散与能量编组，实现超像素级编码到全分辨率谱重建。利用理论计算PSF进行免标定光谱重建，同时开发ODAUVST算法优化非稀疏逆问题求解，提高衍射感知和重建性能。
AI.result: 实验展示了ADIS在模拟与实际测试上的出色恢复能力。与现有方法相比，ODAUVST参数更少、重建效果优异，实现了在普通相机体积下的高质量免标定SSI。
AI.conclusion: ADIS结合ODAUVST实现了实用型、免标定的快照光谱成像，性能超越现有复杂系统，有望推动SSI在商业和边缘应用普及。

title: Agent Zero Memory: Provenance-Aware Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents need durable, faithful memory of everything a user or organization has said and stored, yet most memory systems commit to a single organizing structure (a fact store, a vector index, or a knowledge graph) and inherit its blind spots. We present Agent Zero Memory, a provenance-aware long-term memory system that distils a user's conversations, files, and connected sources into three parallel memory systems, each capturing a different facet of the same history: an episodic Memory Events timeline that makes when and what changed first-class, an associative entity-event knowledge graph that links people and projects across sessions, and a semantic, curated, citation-locked Hierarchical Documentary Memory (HDM) of durable facts. A retrieval turn runs an intent gate (so self-contained turns add no latency), a source router, and three concurrent agentic searches, one per system, each a tool-using loop over hybrid (embedding + lexical) search under agent-controlled filters; their grounded, cited answers are integrated into one answer with a single confidence. We formalize the reading discipline: every learned item is a provenanced item carrying its origin, timestamp, and evidence pointer, and every answer is read under a citation lock, so it may cite only evidence its reader actually opened; fabrication is structurally excluded and the system abstains rather than guesses. On two public benchmarks the system sets a new state of the art: 95.60% on LongMemEval and 93.60% on LoCoMo, improving over the strongest prior systems by +0.73 and +1.10 points. A controlled study across eight backbone LLMs characterizes the accuracy-cost-latency frontier: accuracy varies by only 3.4 points while per-query cost varies by ~30x, with near-state-of-the-art quality at up to 20x lower cost per query, the signature of memory-driven, rather than model-driven, quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种耐用且具备溯源能力的大型语言模型长期记忆系统——Agent Zero Memory，能多维捕捉用户及组织信息，提升记忆准确性与可追溯性，在公开基准上创下新纪录。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型记忆系统通常只采用单一的组织结构（如事实库、向量索引或知识图谱），各自存在盲区，难以全面、真实地保留用户历史和交互数据。为解决此局限，本文提出综合性强、可溯源的多重记忆架构。
AI.method: 该系统整合三种平行的记忆结构：1）事件时间线，关注历史变动及时间顺序；2）实体-事件知识图谱，捕捉人与项目的跨会话联系；3）语义分级档案库，保存持久性事实并实现引证锁。系统采用意图门控、来源路由及三路独立混合搜索（嵌入+词法），答案带出处、证据引用，并将各系统结果融合成一个高置信答案。每项学习和输出都需注明来源和证据，杜绝捏造。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval和LoCoMo两项基准测试中，系统获得95.60%和93.60%的新SOTA成绩，分别比之前最优系统高0.73和1.10分。系统对8种LLM骨干进行成本-准确性-延迟评估，表明记忆驱动下，查询质量与成本可获得20倍优势，而准确率仅有3.4分小幅波动。
AI.conclusion: Agent Zero Memory通过三重结构和严格溯源规则，显著提升了LLM的长期记忆能力与真实性，兼顾准确率和成本效率，有望成为记忆驱动且可追溯的LLM记忆系统新范式。

title: Beyond Surface Alignment: Grounding the Dynamics of Situational Understanding and Generative Control in LLMs
comment: PhD Thesis submitted to UChicago (https://knowledge.uchicago.edu/records/5jrnc-nvp13). Update Branching Factor, AI Realtor, and BACo to the latest versions
summary:
The current alignment tuning paradigm for Large Language Models (LLMs) prioritizes surface-level behaviors -- fluency, safety, and tonal consistency. While effective for casual chat, this thesis argues that such surface alignment masks a lack of grounding, creating models that are stylistically confident but situationally brittle. We propose a framework of Grounded Alignment, analyzing how models process context (Input) and structure generation (Output), then aligning these grounded behaviors to human needs.
