To optimize this behavior without human-annotated answers or rationale paths, ManGo samples multiple ANS rollouts and applies group-relative training with two rewards: answer preference from listwise self-ranking and path consistency from stable ordered panel trajectories. The combined reward is optimized with group-relative policy training, encouraging the model to improve both final answers and the panel-level evidence paths that support them. Experiments on standard manga understanding benchmarks show that ManGo achieves state-of-the-art performance across different settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于漫画视觉问答的新方法ManGo，通过主动选择和整合漫画中的关键信息，优化问答表现，并在无监督条件下达到业界最优效果。
AI.motivation: 漫画视觉问答任务具有叙事性强、线索分散等独特挑战，传统被动编码方法难以有效聚合和利用跨面板、多模态的关键信息。因此，亟需设计主动识别与整合证据的高效新方法。
AI.method: 提出ManGo框架，创新性地引入主动叙事素描（ANS）机制，模型能自动选择相关面板、提取关键信息，并决定何时完成线索收集。采用无监督学习，利用多次rollout和两种奖励（答案优选和路径一致性）进行群体相对训练，优化证据采集路径和最终答案。
AI.result: 在标准漫画理解基准任务上，ManGo在多种设定下均取得了当前最优结果，展示了在无监督场景下主动推理与证据整合的强大能力。
AI.conclusion: ManGo通过无监督主动证据挖掘和高效路径优化，有效提升了漫画视觉问答任务的整体表现。该方法为多模态叙事推理提供了新思路。

title: FiLM-GPNet: Geometry-Aware Pseudo-Supervised Phase Restoration with Zero-Shot Generalization for Large Temporal InSAR Stacks
comment: Its IEEE Geoscience And Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026 Data Fusion Contest Winner Paper. reference https://www.grss-ieee.org/community/technical-committees/winners-of-the-2026-ieee-grss-data-fusion-contest-sar-temporal-storytelling/
summary: The growing availability of dense commercial Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) time series enables temporal Interferometric SAR (InSAR) analysis, but fixed classical filters fail under heterogeneous acquisition geometries, degrading phase quality and temporal consistency. We propose FiLM-GPNet, a geometry-conditioned network for wrapped-phase restoration that explicitly adapts to acquisition differences using Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) and a 7D per-pair geometry descriptor. The model is trained with pseudo-supervision from Goldstein-filtered interferograms and regularized by interferometric physics via triplet-closure consistency, while also estimating per-pixel aleatoric uncertainty. Experiments on three Capella Spotlight stacks from the IEEE GRSS 2026 Data Fusion Contest show that FiLM-GPNet reduces temporal residual by 68% (Hawaii) and 66% (Western Australia) relative to the Goldstein baseline, alongside closure error reductions of 10% and 13%, respectively. In Western Australia, it further improves unwrapping success rate by 7.7 percentage points and Digital Elevation Model (DEM) Normalized Median Absolute Deviation (NMAD) by 31%. The model also shows strong zero-shot generalization to a geographically and geometrically distinct third stack (Los Angeles) without retraining, supporting geometry-conditioned restoration as an effective alternative to fixed classical filtering across heterogeneous stacks.

AI.tldr: 提出了FiLM-GPNet，一种适用于商业SAR数据的几何条件网络，有效提升InSAR相位质量，显著优于传统Goldstein滤波，可适应多样的成像几何。
AI.motivation: 随着商用SAR时序数据日益丰富，传统的固定滤波方法难以应对不同图像获取几何，影响数据的一致性和质量。因此，需要新的方法来提升异构数据的相位恢复效果。
AI.method: 提出基于特征线性调制（FiLM）与7维图像对几何描述符的FiLM-GPNet网络，利用Goldstein滤波伪监督训练、三重闭合一致性正则物理约束，并估计像素级不确定性。
AI.result: 在三个真实数据集上，FiLM-GPNet较Goldstein滤波器使时序残差降低66-68%，闭合误差降低10-13%，在WA地区提升相位解缠成功率7.7个百分点、DEM精度提升31%。对洛杉矶数据表现出零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: FiLM-GPNet能有效适应多样几何场景，克服传统滤波局限，为异构SAR堆栈的相位恢复提供有力支持。

title: Improving Argument Saliency Coverage in Small LLMs for Long Legal Opinion Summarization via Sequence-Level Distillation
summary: We show that sequence-level distillation from a capable long-context teacher model is a simple, annotation-free, and data-efficient strategy for improving argument saliency coverage in long legal opinion summarization, where small LLMs often struggle to retain the most salient argumentative content. Across student model sizes, distillation consistently surpasses tuning on expert-written summaries in our legal-opinion setting. We further demonstrate that most gains are achieved with as few as ~10 training summaries, highlighting the strong data efficiency of teacher-generated supervision. Finally, we find that summary distillation is sufficient for improvements: reasoning-chain distillation remains competitive with summary-only distillation, but provides marginal benefit when combined with summary supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用长上下文教师模型进行序列级蒸馏，可在无需人工注释、数据高效的情况下提升法律意见长文摘要中的关键论点覆盖率，这一方法优于直接使用专家摘要微调，且少量训练数据便可取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 传统的小型语言模型在处理法律意见的长文本摘要时，常常难以保留最关键的论点内容，而且高质量人工注释成本高。作者希望通过更高效且无需人工注释的方法提升模型的摘要能力。
AI.method: 采用具备长上下文能力的大型教师模型，对学生模型进行序列级蒸馏训练，将教师生成的摘要作为监督信号，不依赖人工标注，仅用极少量的训练数据即可。还对比了仅用摘要蒸馏和结合推理链蒸馏的效果。
AI.result: 学生模型在不同规模下，蒸馏均显著优于以专家标注摘要为监督直接微调。仅需约10个训练摘要便获得绝大多数性能提升，显示方法具备极高数据效率。仅进行摘要蒸馏即可获得几乎全部提升，推理链蒸馏效果相近，联合训练时增益有限。
AI.conclusion: 序列级蒸馏是一种简单且高效的提升法律意见长文本摘要性能的方法，节省了大量标注资源，同时可应用于各类小型语言模型，在实际应用中具有重要意义。

title: GATE: Reliability-Gated Gaussian Evidence Fusion for Training-Free Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP and SigLIP provide strong zero-shot recognition, but their predictions can degrade when deployed on target data that differ from the pretraining distribution. Test-time adaptation offers a practical way to improve robustness without source data or target labels, yet existing methods often rely on either prompt-side adaptation or image-side target evidence alone. In this work, we introduce GATE, a training-free two-pass transductive test-time adaptation framework that uses the unlabeled target set while keeping the image encoder, text encoder, and prompt parameters fully frozen. Instead of representing each class with a single prototype, GATE builds two complementary Gaussian sources of evidence in the shared vision-language feature space: a text Gaussian estimated from multiple language descriptions and an image Gaussian estimated from reliable unlabeled target samples. A class-wise reliability gate controls the influence of image-derived pseudo-evidence, and a score-level generalized Product-of-Experts fusion produces a normalized residual correction to the original zero-shot logits. Across fine-grained recognition datasets, ImageNet-family distribution shifts, multiple CLIP backbones, and SigLIP-B/16, GATE achieves the best average accuracy in every benchmark/backbone group. It improves zero-shot performance by an average of 5.41 points and outperforms the strongest non-GATE baseline by 1.94 points, demonstrating the benefit of reliability-gated distributional evidence for frozen VLM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GATE，一个无需训练即可在测试时进行自适应的框架，通过在特征空间内综合语言和图像两方面的证据，显著提升了冻结的vision-language models（如CLIP和SigLIP）在分布转移场景下的零样本识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有vision-language模型在遇到不同于预训练分布的目标数据时，零样本识别能力会下降。测试时自适应无需源数据和目标标签，是提升模型鲁棒性的实用手段，但现有方法通常只结合prompt或图像单一侧证据，无法充分利用目标数据分布。
AI.method: GATE是一个免训练的双阶段传递性测试时自适应框架，在完全冻结图像编码器、文本编码器和prompt参数的基础上，分别用多种语言描述和目标未标记样本在联合特征空间内估算文本/图像高斯分布。通过类级别的可靠性门控，平衡图像伪证据的权重，并利用广义专家乘积在分数级进行融合，对原始零样本logits进行归一化残差修正。
AI.result: GATE在细粒度识别数据集、ImageNet家族分布转移、多种CLIP骨干网络和SigLIP-B/16上均获得最佳平均准确率。平均提升零样本性能5.41个百分点，比最强现有非GATE方法高1.94个百分点，展示了其方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于可靠性门控的分布式证据融合，能在不改动原有模型参数的前提下，显著提升通用视觉语言模型在分布转移下的适应能力。

title: Check The Scoreboard: An Analysis of Scoring Schemes on Multiple-Choice Evaluation
summary: Multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) benchmarks in NLP use number-right scoring (accuracy), but in educational testing, the scoring scheme, the combination of the response mode models follow and the rule for grading responses, is a key design choice that dictates which abilities to reward. We examine how alternatives to number right change what MCQA measures with six education-inspired schemes that assess abilities beyond accuracy: distractor elimination, abstention, confidence calibration, and self-correction. On LLM benchmarks, these schemes: 1) shift rankings of 31 LLMs beyond rephrased number right prompts; 2) better predict the LLMs users prefer in LLM Arena; and 3) reveal distinct model capabilities, like that GPT-5 rarely abstains and readily self-corrects, while weaker open-weight models often abstain and hesitate to eliminate choices. Given the benefits of alternative scoring schemes, we discuss ways to extend them to tasks beyond MCQA.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了多选题（MCQA）中不同评分方案对大语言模型（LLM）评估的影响，提出比传统准确率更能全面考察模型能力的新评分方式。
AI.motivation: NLP中的多选题评测通常只用准确率评分，但教育领域的评分方案能考核和激励多种能力。作者希望通过引入教育评分理念，更全面揭示和比较LLM的能力。
AI.method: 作者设计了六种教育学启发的评分方案，分别考察排除干扰项、弃权、信心校准和自我纠正等能力，并在31个主流LLM上进行实验，比较各方案下模型表现，并与用户偏好（LLM Arena）做相关性分析。
AI.result: 结果显示：1）新评分方式下模型排名相较传统准确率有显著变化；2）这些评分方案对用户偏好的预测能力优于传统准确率；3）不同模型展现出独特能力差异，例如GPT-5极少弃权、能自我纠正，而开源弱模型更倾向于弃权且不善于排除选项。
AI.conclusion: 多样化的评分方案能更细致反映LLM不同能力，建议将这些方案推广应用至MCQA之外的其他任务。

title: A Visual Question Answering Model to Automate Nondestructive Evaluation Image Analysis
summary: This study introduces a Visual Question Answering model designed specifically for nondestructive evaluation applications. VQA models allow inspectors to interactively query NDE images, asking targeted questions like, Is there a crack or Where is the defect located and receive precise answers from the model. Leveraging deep learning and natural language processing, the developed system integrates image feature extraction (via a ResNet-50 model) and language generation capabilities (via GPT-2) to provide accurate, informative feedback. By enabling direct question-and-answer interactions, this VQA model significantly improves inspection efficiency, reduces potential errors, and enhances usability in practical field scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种专为无损检测(NDE)开发的视觉问答(VQA)模型，使检验人员能通过提问图像相关问题并获得精准答案，提升检测效率与准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统无损检测依赖人工分析，既费时又易出错。为提升检测的智能化水平，亟需一种能自动理解并解答视觉检测图像问题的系统。
AI.method: 系统将ResNet-50用于图像特征提取，GPT-2用于自然语言生成，两者结合实现基于深度学习的多模态问答能力。
AI.result: 开发出的VQA模型可针对现场实际检测图片，理解并准确回答如“是否有裂缝”或“缺陷位置在哪里”等具体问题。
AI.conclusion: 该模型提升了无损检测的交互性与智能化水平，改善了实际操作中的效率与使用体验，减少了人为误差。

title: VibeJam: A User Study Platform for Web Development with Agents
summary: Programming with AI is increasingly agentic, users prompt LLMs to directly edit their code and review the changes, with adoption growing especially for web development tasks. Despite this growth, most NLP work uses offline evaluation and lacks support for online studies, losing insights into how programmers truly use coding agents. We release VibeJam, a browser-based user study platform for users to collaborate with AI agents to develop websites. VibeJam enables agent customization and uses the open-source Aider agent by default, and to mirror downstream use, we add diff review, chat and plan modes, and live website previews. In a pilot study with 55 released, game-based website creation tasks, five experienced AI programmers rate our system as fun, simple, and resembling commercial tools, while 13 junior students use VibeJam to make websites of higher quality than agents in the same task. We open-source VibeJam to spur extensions and support studies on how coding agents can help users.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了VibeJam，一个支持用户与AI编程代理协作开发网站的浏览器平台，并开放源码以促进进一步研究。
AI.motivation: 传统NLP代码生成评测多为离线，缺乏真实用户与AI代理互动的在线研究，从而难以揭示程序员真正的使用习惯和需求。
AI.method: 作者开发了VibeJam，让用户与可定制的AI代理在浏览器中协作创建网站，支持diff代码回顾、聊天、规划及网站实时预览，还纳入Aider开源代理。通过实际上线55个网站开发任务，邀请5位资深AI程序员和13名初级学生进行试用和评价。
AI.result: 资深程序员评价VibeJam界面有趣、易用，并与商业工具体验相似。13名初级学生利用VibeJam制作的网站质量整体高于AI代理独立完成的作品。
AI.conclusion: VibeJam支持更直观和真实的在线用户研究，有助理解AI编程代理如何辅助用户。平台开源，以促进社区扩展和开展更多相关研究。

title: Polis: 3D Self-Supervision at City Scale
summary: Reliable semantic representations derived from city-scale 3D models are increasingly important for urban analysis, infrastructure monitoring, autonomous systems, and heritage conservation. However, urban scenes of large spatial extent captured through aerial surveying differ substantially from the indoor, object-level, and self-driving LiDAR data used to pretrain most 3D self-supervised models. We introduce Polis, to our knowledge the first application of Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg) as an objective for a native point cloud encoder, and evaluate it through a frozen-feature benchmark spanning fourteen city- and building-scale corpora. Polis combines geometrically matched cosine invariance, SIGReg, and VICReg-style anti-collapse terms with a 12.8k-scene outdoor pretraining mixture and gravity-preserving spatial view sampling. Controlled ablations show that this objective outperforms student--teacher architecture alternatives, as well as Polis versions without anti-collapse terms, on the same representative outdoor corpus. On three pretraining-disjoint city datasets, Polis reaches $23.8\%$ mean mIoU versus $16.3\%$ for the next-best encoder under high-capacity frozen probing, and $17.3\%$ versus $16.1\%$ at a matched point and voxel budget. The same city-scale lead holds on datasets whose training sets were seen in pretraining. On localized terrestrial captures with fine-grained facade and streetscape labels, the ranking reverses. Our results show that distributionally-regularized joint embedding architectures can be successful on challenging city-scale 3D scenes, and that transfer improves when self-supervision is designed for the capture geometry and spatial context of this domain while also revealing the limits of this specialization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Polis方法，首次将Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization（SIGReg）应用于大规模城市3D点云编码，实现了对城市级点云高效的自监督表征，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统3D自监督模型多用室内、单物体或自动驾驶场景数据进行预训练，难以直接适用于空间范围大、数据类型迥异的航空遥感获取的城市级3D点云，亟需对城市场景数据更适配且高效的自监督表征方法。
AI.method: Polis方法结合了几何匹配的余弦不变性、SIGReg正则项、VICReg风格的防塌缩约束，并设计了空间视图采样与重力方向保持策略。预训练数据广覆盖12,800场景，特征提取器用冻结特征评测，进行多组消融实验，比较与其他自监督结构的性能差异。
AI.result: Polis在3个未见的城市数据集上，以冻结特征线性探测器协议，平均mIoU达23.8%（显著高于下一个最优方法的16.3%），在点和体素预算一致下也优于其他编码器。对于预训练见过的数据集依然保持领先，但在高细度本地捕获场景（如立面、街景精细标签）表现相对较弱。
AI.conclusion: 面向城市级3D场景，Polis这种分布正则的联合嵌入架构极具潜力，领域自适应的自监督目标能显著提升迁移表现，但也揭示了在高精度本地细节场景中的局限性。

title: En-ViMedNER: An English-Vietnamese Parallel Biomedical Corpus with UMLS Semantic Type Annotations
comment: To appear in Proceedings of EMNLP2026
summary: Biomedical Named Entity Recognition (NER) is fundamental to healthcare AI applications, including clinical decision support and medical information extraction. While corpora with Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) annotations, such as MedMentions, have driven progress in English biomedical NER, no comparable resource exists for Vietnamese. This paper presents En-ViMedNER, the first English-Vietnamese parallel biomedical NER corpus annotated with UMLS semantic types, which are language-neutral codes providing a shared cross-lingual label space and ensuring direct comparability with existing UMLS-based resources. The corpus contains 4,392 PubMed abstract pairs, 44,892 English-Vietnamese sentence pairs, and 202,949 aligned entity-mention pairs across 21 semantic types adapted from the MedMentions ST21pv dataset. To balance quality and scalability, we have constructed the corpus through automatic translation, expert post-editing, LLM-assisted label projection, and human verification and adjudication. We characterize En-ViMedNER as a large-scale silver-standard corpus with a human-audited and consensus-corrected mini-test subset. We evaluate En-ViMedNER in two settings: (i) Vietnamese-input/Vietnamese-output biomedical NER and (ii) English-input/Vietnamese-output cross-lingual NER. For Vietnamese NER, we benchmark Vietnamese-supervised encoder models, English-supervised multilingual encoder models, and prompt-based LLMs. The best model achieves an F1 score of 52.70 on the test set and 53.78 on the mini-test set. For cross-lingual NER, we benchmark encoder-decoder models and prompt-based LLMs. The best model achieves an F1 score of 45.44 on the mini-test set. We publicly release our corpus, corpus construction pipeline, and baseline models to facilitate future Vietnamese biomedical NLP research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了En-ViMedNER，这是第一个基于UMLS语义类型标注的英越双语生物医学命名实体识别(NE R)语料库，为越南语医学领域的NER研究提供了基础资源和基线模型。
AI.motivation: 虽然UMLS标注的语料资源推动了英文医学NER的发展，但越南语在此领域缺乏类似的高质量平行数据集，制约了相关AI应用的进展。
AI.method: 作者通过自动翻译、专家校对、大模型辅助标签投射以及人工验证和仲裁，构建了含4,392篇PubMed摘要对、44,892句英越句对和202,949实体对的平行语料，并基于MedMentions ST21pv的21个语义类型进行实体标注。
AI.result: 在生物医学NER任务上，越南语NER基准模型在测试集上F1为52.70，在小型测试集上为53.78；英越跨语言NER最佳模型在小型测试集上F1为45.44。
AI.conclusion: En-ViMedNER为越南语生物医学NER提供了首个大规模开源平行标注资源及基线系统，有望推动该领域后续研究。

title: When History Is Multimodal: Rethinking Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents need a context manager to compress growing interaction histories into a bounded working context, via passive strategies or active strategies that decide how memory is accessed and reorganized. Meanwhile, prior optical-memory work mainly treats pixels as a dense codec for textualized histories, often presupposing that rendering context into optical memory incurs a significant performance drop relative to text, thus coupling this representation with SFT, self-distillation, or reinforcement learning to close this gap, leaving unresolved (i) how visual rendering performs as a context manager under a fair, controlled comparison, and (ii) whether this carrier offers a native advantage when history is inherently multimodal. In this paper, we formulate context management as a budget-constrained history transformation and introduce Visual Rendering (VR) as a representational context manager. Under a shared harness, policy model, trigger, and task domain, we evaluate VR on four text-centric and three multimodal benchmarks against four baselines (No Compression, Discard-All, Sliding Window, Summarization), finding visual memory is a natural carrier of native visual evidence. Building on this finding, we propose VERA (Visual Evidence-Retaining strategy for long-horizon Agents), a training-free context manager built on deterministic rendering with no exposed memory operations: on text-centric benchmarks it renders textual history as VR does, while on multimodal benchmarks it retains native visual observations instead of translating them into text. Across nearly all benchmarks, VERA cuts cumulative non-cache tokens by 31.5%-63.1% versus No Compression, matches existing managers on text-centric tasks, and achieves the highest accuracy among all baselines on multimodal tasks, supporting a modality-preserving view of long-horizon context management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过视觉渲染（Visual Rendering, VR）管理长时序智能体的历史上下文，并提出VERA方法，实验证明其在多模态任务中优势明显。
AI.motivation: 长时序智能体需要有效管理不断增长的互动历史。现有方法多关注如何在文本中保存和压缩历史，但很少公平检验视觉渲染作为上下文管理器的真实效用，尤其是在多模态场景下的原生优势尚不明确。
AI.method: 将上下文管理问题形式化为受预算约束的历史转换问题，提出用视觉渲染（VR）压缩和呈现历史记忆，并在统一的实验框架下，分别对四个文本为主的基准和三个多模态基准，与四个主流基线方法（不压缩、全丢弃、滑动窗口、摘要）进行系统比较。随后提出训练无关的VERA方法，在文本任务用VR渲染历史，在多模态任务保留原生视觉信息。
AI.result: 视觉记忆天然适合保留原生视觉证据。VERA方法相比无压缩方案累计节省31.5%-63.1%非缓存token，在文本任务上表现持平基线，在多模态任务上准确率最高。
AI.conclusion: 视觉渲染可作为长时序上下文管理的有效手段。VERA同步兼顾文本与多模态场景，实现高效压缩并保持多模态原生性，支持“模态保真”的上下文管理理念。

title: Text-Guided Diffusion-Based Adversarial Attacks on Chest X-Ray Images
summary: As artificial intelligence is increasingly integrated into chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation, triage, and clinical decision support, understanding its vulnerability to adversarial manipulation is critical for safe deployment. Existing robustness evaluations, however, predominantly rely on pixel-space attacks that introduce numerically constrained perturbations but may not represent plausible radiographic variation. This limitation is particularly important in multi-disease CXR classification, where models simultaneously evaluate multiple overlapping pathologies and adversarial failures may alter several diagnostic predictions. We propose a text-guided diffusion-based adversarial framework that optimizes learnable text conditioning while keeping the diffusion generator and target classifier frozen, enabling adversarial generation through a learned image prior rather than direct pixel manipulation. We evaluate the framework across multiple classifier architectures in both binary atelectasis and multi-disease CXR classification and compare it with FGSM, PGD, and Carlini-Wagner attacks. Our approach consistently produced the greatest degradation in classifier performance, reducing AUROC to 0.3885-0.5646 in binary classification and 0.4441-0.4878 in the multi-disease setting, while achieving superior image fidelity (SSIM 0.9080, LPIPS 0.1670, FID 51.23). Importantly, clinician interpretation remained unchanged for 95.9% of binary and 73.8% of multi-disease adversarial images despite substantial changes in model predictions. These findings reveal a clinically important discrepancy between human and machine interpretation and demonstrate the need to extend medical AI robustness evaluation beyond conventional pixel-space attacks toward generative threat models that can expose failures under visually and clinically plausible image variations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于文本指导的扩散生成对抗框架，对胸部X光（CXR）AI模型的鲁棒性进行评估，发现该方法比传统像素空间攻击更能有效影响模型预测，同时产生更具真实感的图像，但对临床医生诊断影响较小，揭示了人机判读结果之间的重要差异。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗诊断AI的对抗攻击多依赖像素级微调，未能充分模拟临床上真实且有意义的影像变化，且多疾病判别场景下，AI模型对复杂输入的脆弱性尚未被充分揭示。因此亟需开发能够生成更合理、多样的对抗样本的评估方法，以确保AI在真实场景下的安全可靠性。
AI.method: 作者提出了一个文本指导的扩散对抗框架，通过优化可学习的文本条件，固定扩散生成器和分类器，仅通过调节文本描述生成对抗X光影像。其效果在不同结构的分类器上（包括二分类与多疾病分类）与主流像素空间攻击方法（如FGSM、PGD、Carlini-Wagner）进行了对比。
AI.result: 该框架能够显著恶化模型性能，将AUROC降低至0.3885-0.5646（二分类）和0.4441-0.4878（多疾病分类），生成图像的保真度高（SSIM 0.9080，LPIPS 0.1670，FID 51.23）。尽管模型预测变化显著，但95.9%的二分类和73.8%的多疾病对抗影像未引起临床医生诊断变化。
AI.conclusion: 传统像素扰动攻击难以发现AI在医学影像中的潜在脆弱性，生成式对抗手段能以更真实可信的方式暴露模型缺陷。未来医疗AI鲁棒性评估应拓展到包含生成式威胁模型，以提升其在临床环境中的安全性和可靠性。

title: REIGN: Refurbished Embeddings with Integrated Guidance Networks for Efficient Context-Length Scaling
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. URL: https://devrimcavusoglu.github.io/reign/
summary: Dense retrieval over long documents is expensive. Token-level encoders scale quadratically in sequence length, and most long-context embedding models reach 32K tokens only through architectural workarounds or by stretching billion-parameter LLMs. We propose REIGN (Refurbished Embeddings with Integrated Guidance Networks), a contrastively trained bi-encoder that operates on sequences of contextualised chunk embeddings from a frozen Guidance Network (GN) rather than on raw tokens. REIGN targets multi-chunk inputs, primarily for document-to-document retrieval; single-chunk inputs stay with the GN. Decoupling token-level processing from document-level reasoning, and caching the GN embeddings to disk, cuts per-document training cost by roughly four orders of magnitude relative to chunked Transformer fine-tuning. We also release a synthetic long-document retrieval benchmark for contrastive training and evaluation at long context lengths. Across an in-distribution Wikipedia benchmark, the LoCo out-of-distribution suite, and a real-world patent retrieval case study, REIGN matches dense long-context retrievers at smaller parameter budgets in each regime. A paired significance test puts it on par with models 1.6-4.3x larger on the patent task, and it stays within 0.65 nDCG@10 of a 20x-larger model on LoCo.

AI.tldr: REIGN是一种高效文档级稠密检索模型，通过解耦token级处理与文档级推理，并缓存嵌入，极大降低了长文档检索的计算成本，在多个基准和实用场景中以更小参数量表现出与现有大模型相当的效果。
AI.motivation: 目前长文档的稠密检索非常消耗计算资源，主流长上下文模型要么结构复杂、要么参数巨大且难以推广。因此需要一种更高效、低成本的解决方案来增强大规模长文档检索的实际落地能力。
AI.method: 提出了REIGN框架，采用对比学习训练的bi-encoder结构。其创新点在于：不直接处理原始token，而是输入由冻结的Guidance Network（GN）生成的上下文分块嵌入。对于多分块文档，REIGN负责文档级编码；单分块任务则仅用GN处理。此外，通过GN嵌入缓存到磁盘，文档训练成本比传统Transformer微调降低约一万个量级。
AI.result: 在Wikipedia、LoCo（分布外测试集）和专利检索的实证测试中，REIGN在不同场景下均能以更小规模的模型达到与大模型同等级的检索表现，专利任务上与大1.6-4.3倍参数量的模型无显著差异，LoCo测试下与20倍参数量模型nDCG@10差距仅0.65。
AI.conclusion: REIGN显著降低了长文档稠密检索的计算和存储开销，同时兼顾高表现力和可扩展性，在实际和学术应用中具有很大潜力，同时还发布了配套的合成数据基准促进后续研究。

title: Co-Evolutionary Prompt Optimization with Cross-Category Transfer for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
comment: 25 pages, 25 figures. Camera-ready version. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) has gained significant attention for its practical value in industrial inspection. Recently, CLIP-based approaches have been widely adopted in ZSAD due to their strong vision-language generalization capabilities. However, existing methods commonly employ continuous prompt embeddings for prompt optimization and encode semantics in latent vectors, which lack interpretability and scalability. To this end, we propose CoEvoAD, a co-evolutionary framework for discrete prompt selection. CoEvoAD performs prompt search in the discrete natural-language space using an evolutionary algorithm. Candidate prompts are iteratively generated, evaluated, and selected throughout population evolution, thus preserving the interpretability and composability of natural language. Furthermore, we introduce a Cross-Category Transfer Objective (CCTO), which treats held-out source categories as proxies for unseen categories and scores prompt rules based on their estimated cross-category transferability, effectively improving cross-category generalization. Extensive experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of CoEvoAD, and the results show that it achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple anomaly detection datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/rstao-bjtu/CoEvoAD.

AI.tldr: 提出CoEvoAD，通过离散自然语言提示的协同进化，实现更具可解释性和可扩展性的零样本异常检测，并通过跨类别迁移目标提升泛化性，实验验证效果优异。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP基础的零样本异常检测，虽具有泛化能力，但普遍使用连续型提示向量，导致缺乏可解释性与可扩展性。解决这一问题对于工业检测应用具有重要意义。
AI.method: 提出基于协同进化的离散自然语言提示选择框架CoEvoAD，利用进化算法在提示语的离散空间中搜索和优化提示，生成、评估并选择最优候选以增强可解释性。同时引入跨类别迁移目标（CCTO），以已知类别的表现度量提示泛化性，从而提升跨类别检测性能。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提CoEvoAD模型在多个异常检测数据集上取得了当前最优的性能表现，其可解释性和泛化能力远超现有CLIP类方法。
AI.conclusion: CoEvoAD兼具可解释性与泛化能力，为零样本异常检测特别是工业应用场景提供了更可靠的解决方案，在实际应用中具备推广价值。

title: When Less is More: Understanding When Token Filtering Helps and Fails in AI-generated Text Detection
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has made AI-generated text detection increasingly critical. Existing zero-shot detectors assume that more token-level evidence leads to more reliable detection. However, our empirical study challenges this consensus: fewer tokens sometimes work better, retaining only 40% can yield optimal performance, yet this benefit is not universal. Using the Entropy Gap Score (EGS), we introduce top-$k$ cumulative probability filtering as a diagnostic probe. Across three representative settings, filtering exhibits strikingly different behaviors. We analyze EGS via typical set theory and quantify its dynamics through entropy calibration and distribution analysis. We find that filtering helps for weak source LMs, where low-entropy tokens are harmful, but fails for strong source LMs, where they are not notably harmful. Our work provides the first systematic analysis showing that some tokens are not merely uninformative but systematically harmful due to entropy miscalibration, revealing a two-sided trade-off in token-level detection.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现，现有AI文本零样本检测方法中，保留所有token并非总能提升检测效果，有时仅保留部分token能获得最佳结果。论文通过引入熵间隙分数（EGS）以及累积概率过滤，系统分析token对检测性能的双面影响。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型不断进步，AI生成内容检测变得迫切。但主流零样本检测方法默认“token越多、证据越多”就越好，实际这一共识是否成立，尚缺乏系统化分析。研究动机是验证并解析token保留多少，真的如业界假设那样越多越好吗？
AI.method: 论文提出使用熵间隙分数（Entropy Gap Score, EGS）并结合top-k累积概率过滤作为诊断工具。在三种典型检测场景下，分析在不同的token保留比例下检测性能的变化。同时，通过典型集理论、熵校准和分布分析，系统性地量化EGS的动态变化和原理。
AI.result: 实验证明，保留全部token并不总是最佳。有时只保留40%高置信度token能获得最优检测效果，但这种优势不具有通用性——对弱LM模型有提升，对强LM模型无显著改善。具体原因在于：弱LM模型的低熵token会带来干扰，而强LM模型则无此问题。
AI.conclusion: 首次系统证明，在大模型AI文本检测中，一部分token不止是不重要，而是会负面影响检测效果（即“有害”）。因此，token保留策略应根据信源LM强弱动态调整，实现更精细化检测。

title: Seeing Through Extreme Visual Sparsity: Surface Understanding from a Single Random Visual Patch
summary: Surface material recognition from incomplete visual observations remains a challenging problem in robotic perception and environmental understanding. This paper discusses Sparse Surface Understanding Framework (SSUF), a unified dual-task learning framework that adapts four pretrained architectures-Convolutional Autoencoder (ConvAE), Vision Transformer (ViT), Swin Transformer, and Masked Autoencoder (MAE) for si-multaneous surface reconstruction and material classification. Experiments were conducted on the Touch-and-Go dataset using a sparse observation protocol in which only 10% of the original image remained visible while the remaining regions were masked. To enable a fair comparison, reconstruction-oriented models were extended with classification heads, whereas classification- oriented models were augmented with reconstruction decoders. The resulting architectures were assessed using reconstruction quality, classification performance, model complexity, and in-ference efficiency metrics. Experimental results revealed distinct strengths across the models. Swin Transformer achieved the best classification performance with an accuracy of 89.21%, an F1-score of 0.8922, and a ROC-AUC of 0.9813. In contrast, MAE produced the highest reconstruction scores among evaluated models, with a PSNR of 16.06 dB and an SSIM of 0.4501, while ViT provided the best overall balance between reconstruction and classification performance. Furthermore, all models achieved real-time inference, requiring less than 5 ms per image. Over-all, the results show that pretrained architectures can support material recognition under severe visual sparsity, while accurate image reconstruction remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SSUF框架，并对主流模型在稀疏可见表面材料识别和重建任务中的表现进行了对比分析。
AI.motivation: 在实际机器人感知任务中，环境视觉信息往往不完整，可靠的表面材料识别和重建尤显重要。现有方法很少在极度稀疏观察条件下的材料识别与重建任务上进行系统性比较。
AI.method: 文章提出Sparse Surface Understanding Framework (SSUF)，统一适配4种主流预训练架构（ConvAE、ViT、Swin Transformer、MAE），实现表面重建与材料分类的双任务学习。采用Touch-and-Go数据集，仅暴露10%原图像，并统一对比重建与分类表现。为公平比较，重建模型加分类头，分类模型加重建解码器，并综合评价模型复杂度和推理效率。
AI.result: Swin Transformer分类表现最佳（准确率89.21%；F1=0.8922；ROC-AUC=0.9813），MAE重建能力最强（PSNR=16.06 dB，SSIM=0.4501），ViT在分类与重建间表现均衡。全部模型推理均低于5毫秒，具实时性。
AI.conclusion: 多种预训练架构能在极度稀疏视觉信息下支持表面材料识别，但高精度图像重建仍具挑战性。

title: IndicDetect: Evaluating Cross-Lingual LLM-Generated Text Detection for Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil
summary: The rapid proliferation of LLMs has further heightened the need to develop dependable AI-generated text detection, especially beyond English. Nevertheless, current benchmarks pay little attention to Indic languages and test detectors in idealized settings that do not represent the real world. We present a generalized benchmark for AI-generated text detection in Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil, which we call IndicDetect, designed to assess the robustness of detectors under realistic distribution shifts. IndicDetect comprises highly curated human-written texts matched with LLM-generated counterparts across various domains and generators, and systematically evaluates detectors in the presence of domain shift, generator shift, and adversarial perturbation. Using a single and repeatable evaluation scheme, we evaluate a wide range of statistical and neural detectors. We find substantial robustness failures: supervised neural detectors perform well in-distribution, while training-free methods degrade considerably under unseen generators and adversarial attacks. The severity of these failures varies across languages, with Hindi exhibiting the largest overall degradation under adversarial perturbations. These results highlight that the primary weakness of existing detectors in Indic settings lies in their robustness, not in their peak accuracy. IndicDetect provides standard data splits, an evaluation protocol, and baselines to establish a robust, language-aware foundation for AI-generated text detection in Indic scripts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对印地语、泰卢固语和泰米尔语AI生成文本检测的基准IndicDetect，旨在评估检测器在现实分布变化下的表现，并显示当前检测器在此类语言和现实场景下的鲁棒性显著不足。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）的大量普及，开发可靠的AI生成文本检测变得非常重要，尤其是在非英语语种中。然而，现有基准很少关注印度语言，且评测环境过于理想化，难以代表现实中的挑战。
AI.method: 作者构建了IndicDetect基准，包含精心筛选的人类编写与LLM生成的印地语、泰卢固语和泰米尔语文本，涵盖不同领域和生成器，并系统考察检测器在领域、生成器和对抗扰动条件下的表现。采用统一可复现的评估方案，测试统计与神经检测器。
AI.result: 实验发现，受监督的神经检测器在分布内表现尚可，但面对新生成器和对抗攻击时表现大幅下降；免训练方法在分布外和对抗条件下降更严重。不同语言间，印地语在对抗扰动下退化最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 当前检测器在Indic脚本中的主要弱点是鲁棒性不足而非峰值准确率。IndicDetect为印度语言AI生成文本检测提供了标准数据划分、评测协议和基线，促进更具语言意识和鲁棒性的检测研究。

title: GeoAgent: Evaluating VLM Geolocalization Through Embodied Navigation
summary: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well above the human baseline in image geolocalization, a task critically important in disaster response, OSINT verification, and location privacy. However, most efforts to study AI behavior on the task remain limited to static image-based retrieval, classification, and predictions. We argue that faithful recreation of the task should involve embodied navigation, where a multimodal agent autonomously explores its surroundings to gather observations before submitting a prediction. To this end, we introduce \textbf{GeoAgent}, an agentic environment-based benchmark that requires agents to navigate Street View environments to refine their geolocalization through sequential reasoning. Our analysis shows that modern VLMs struggle to discern regional patterns while succeeding at country- and continent-level predictions. When compared to static image-based baselines, agentic navigation significantly improves accuracy across established metrics. We also note severe bias in a developed/developing region context across frontier model architectures and poor self-improvement capabilities given incorrect priors. Overall, our work establishes the challenges of embodied navigation and geospatial reasoning. We publicly release our code and the GeoAgent environment: https://geoagent-benchmark.github.io

AI.tldr: 论文提出了GeoAgent基准，将地理定位任务从静态图像推理提升到环境中主动导航，并分析了现代视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的表现和局限。
AI.motivation: 当前AI在图像地理定位任务表现超越人类，且该任务对灾难响应、信息核查等场景极为重要。但相关研究大多仅限于静态图片分类/检索，未能反映实际中的“探索—观察—推理—决策”流程，动机在于通过真实环境下的主动导航更真实地评估模型表现。
AI.method: 作者提出GeoAgent，一个基于Street View环境的测试基准，要求多模态智能体主动导航，搜集信息后再作地理定位判断。对比静态图片任务，考察了现有多种VLMs在不同尺度地理推理上的能力，并分析其偏见和自我修正能力。
AI.result: 实验发现，当前主流VLMs能较好完成国家及大陆层面的判断，但难以辨别地区性地理特征。与静态图片相比，主动导航显著提升了定位准确率。同时，不同模型对“发达/发展中地区”存在明显偏差，对错误先验下的自我纠正能力较差。
AI.conclusion: GeoAgent基准揭示了主动导航和地理空间推理任务中AI模型的挑战性，为研究AI如何更好地完成具身、序列决策任务提供了重要参照，公开代码和环境促进后续研究。

title: Sleight of Word Benchmark: Can Language Models Notice If Their Own Output Was Tampered With?
summary: The output of a Language Model can be tampered with \emph{while} the model is writing it. A simple test can thus be constructed by evaluating the model's perception of this external perturbation. In this spirit, a simple benchmark is built in which a single word is consistently substituted with another in the generation process. We call this method \emph{Sleight of Word}. Two distinct axes are measured: metrics that relate to the model's surprise, as well as an evaluation of the textual reaction for 19 different open-weight language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种简单的新方法，通过在语言模型生成过程中持续替换单词，测试模型对输出被篡改的感知能力。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏对生成过程中模型输出遭受篡改时模型自身反应的评估机制，因此需要新的基准和方法来衡量模型在此类干扰下的感知及反应能力。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“Sleight of Word”的基准方法，在生成阶段持续将某个单词替换为另一个，然后对模型的惊讶度（Surprise）和文本反应进行评价，并在19个开源语言模型上进行了实验。
AI.result: 实验证明，不同的语言模型在面对输出被持续篡改时，对于惊讶度和文本反应有明显差异，展示了模型对外部干扰的敏感度存在显著分布。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为评估语言模型在输出被篡改时的鲁棒性和自我感知能力提供了新的测试基准，对于理解和提升模型的安全性与智能水平具有现实意义。

title: ARMOR: Manifold-Oriented Training for Adversarially Robust Aerial Object Detection under Data Scarcity
summary: Aerial object detection is increasingly deployed in real-world applications, but models remain vulnerable to physical, universal adversarial patches that cause them to miss objects. Furthermore, defenders face the practical constraint of training data scarcity: aerial imagery is costly to collect and label, so a deployment site typically yields hundreds of images rather than the tens of thousands that adversarial robustness benchmarks assume. To tackle model vulnerability and training data scarcity, we propose Adversarial Robustness with Manifold-Oriented Training (ARMOR), a novel defense that realizes the core insights of on-manifold adversarial training (OMAT) in low-data regimes. ARMOR builds on the insight of OMAT to model the data manifold - the compact structure capturing the data's relevant features - to learn and robustify these features during training. While OMAT relies on the data-intensive operations of training large generative models and adversarial training to achieve this, ARMOR adopts a data-efficient approach that reuses labels the detection task already supplies: ARMOR (i) masks image backgrounds to retain object-relevant features, and (ii) injects randomized patches on objects to improve feature robustness. Our low-data experiments with physically-realizable adversarial patches evaluate both query-free transfer attacks and defense-aware attacks. ARMOR maintains strong clean performance of over 0.90 model confidence, while improving adversarial robustness by up to 0.32 in model confidence over state-of-the-art defenses. Physical experiments with printed patches confirm that these gains survive deployment. Overall, ARMOR translates insights from manifold-based training to defend object detectors amidst training data scarcity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ARMOR的新方法，提升航拍目标检测在数据稀缺与物理可实现扰动下的鲁棒性。其核心是用高效的方式模拟数据流形，增强模型对物理对抗补丁的抵抗力，并在有限的标注数据场景中取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 航拍目标检测在现实应用中广泛部署，但模型对物理可实现的对抗补丁十分脆弱。此外，航拍图像获取与标注成本高，常常面临训练数据稀缺的问题，限制了传统对抗鲁棒性方法的应用。因此，亟需一种在小数据下也能有效提升模型鲁棒性的防御方法。
AI.method: 本文提出了ARMOR（Adversarial Robustness with Manifold-Oriented Training）方法。它基于“流形对抗训练”(OMAT)的思想，具体地：1）通过掩蔽图像背景，仅保留与目标相关的特征，实现对特征的建模与鲁棒化；2）在对象上随机注入补丁，提高特征对扰动的稳健性。与以往需要大量数据和生成模型的方法不同，ARMOR只用检测任务自身已有的标注即可高效实现。
AI.result: 在数据量有限的实验中，ARMOR在无查询的转移攻击和防御感知攻击下，均能有效提升对抗鲁棒性。模型在原始样本上的置信度超过0.90，且在对抗样本上的置信度最高较现有方法提升0.32。物理打印补丁的实际测试同样验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ARMOR方法有效将流形对抗训练的思想迁移到小数据场景下，无需额外标注和大模型训练，大幅提升航拍目标检测对物理可实现对抗攻击的鲁棒性，且保证了模型在干净样本上的性能。

title: Token Counts Are Not Model Lineage: A Frozen-Threshold Holdout Study of Black-Box LLM API Fingerprinting
summary: Black-box model attribution is increasingly relevant when large language models (LLMs) are served through relay and reseller APIs. A tempting low-cost signal is the prompt-token count returned by an OpenAI-compatible endpoint: two models that share a tokenizer and chat template may produce the same count sequence up to a fixed offset. Yet the validity of this signal for broader \emph{model-family} attribution has received little direct holdout testing. We conduct a frozen-threshold study over 24 labeled endpoint pairs, split evenly into a development set and an untouched holdout set, with three temporal repeats and 30 controlled texts per pair. We introduce a validity-gated result contract that distinguishes an observed dissimilarity from an uninformative measurement caused by missing usage data, rate limits, or endpoint policy. The resulting shift-invariant exact-match score perfectly separates the 12 development pairs, yielding a frozen threshold of 0.725. On holdout, however, only 6 of 12 pairs are eligible under the pre-specified three-repeat rule. Among eligible pairs, balanced accuracy is 0.75, sensitivity is 0.50 (95\% Wilson interval 0.15--0.85), and specificity is 1.00 (0.342--1.00). Two same-family pairs---Qwen 3.8 and DeepSeek V4 variants---fall below the frozen threshold. Across 4,320 formal API calls, every log is replayable, while holdout contains 189 non-200 responses and 157 successful responses without prompt-token usage. The study therefore validates token-count consistency as a fingerprint of a shared \emph{tokenization stack}, but rejects its use as a standalone necessary test for model-family lineage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了通过OpenAI兼容API中返回的prompt-token数量，是否可用于LLM家族模型的归属判别。结果显示，这一信号在tokenizer与模板一致时可用，但无法作为判断模型家族的唯一标志。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）通过代理API和转售API大量应用，判断API背后是什么模型具有重要现实意义。已有方法常用token数量对比作为简单判别手段，但该方法针对模型‘家族’归属的效力尚未被严格检验。
AI.method: 作者设计了一项定量实验，对24组API端点（已知归属）进行token-count对比，分为开发集和未触碰的保留集，每组用固定文本重复取样。采用了shift-invariant统计指标，以及明确区分无效测量和有效数据的分析方法。
AI.result: 在开发集上，token-count一致性完美区分了各对模型。但在保留集，部分同一模型家族成员的对比未通过事先定好的阈值，仅有0.75的平衡准确率，其中灵敏度仅0.50，特异性则达到1.0。部分API因缺少数据或无法返回token-count而无法参与分析。
AI.conclusion: token-count一致性可作为判别是否共享tokenizer（即‘tokenization stack’）的有力证据，但不能作为判别是否属于同一模型家族的唯一或必要标准。该指标可辅助溯源或归属，但需要谨慎解释和搭配更多信号使用。

title: FuncRoom-Agent: Sequential Feed-Forward 3D Functional Indoor Scene Generation
summary: We introduce Function-Room Generation, a new indoor 3D scene generation setting that creates rooms supporting explicit functional goals rather than merely visually plausible layouts. Existing agentic and executable methods improve controllability, but often depend on costly test-time generate--evaluate--revise loops, making functional room generation slow and computationally expensive. We address this challenge with three technical contributions. First, we design a recursive domain-specific language to effectively organize the hierarchical object compositions required by functional rooms, from room structure and major furniture to dense support-surface and nested small objects. It represents rooms as staged executable programs with explicit geometric and functional relations. Second, we propose a sequential feed-forward scene construction framework that distills recursive construction traces into a scene construction expert. At inference time, the expert writes executable DSL code stage by stage, and a deterministic executor directly instantiates each stage without teacher agents, online critics, or iterative repair. Third, we introduce ScenePRM, an execution-grounded process reward framework that improves the expert through reinforcement learning with functional, geometric, relational, and future-constructability feedback. We further establish a function-oriented benchmark and show state-of-the-art performance on both general indoor scene generation and function-room generation, achieving stronger functional completeness, relation correctness, geometric executability, and generation efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向功能性目标的室内3D房间自动生成方法，提高了生成房间的功能合理性与执行效率，并在基准测试中取得领先成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有3D室内场景生成主要关注视觉合理性，对房间实际功能支持度关注不够，且依赖反复迭代的生成-评估-修正过程，效率低、计算成本高。作者旨在实现能满足具体功能需求的房间自动生成，并提升过程的效率。
AI.method: 1）设计递归型领域专用语言（DSL），以程序化方式层次化表达房间及其物品的结构与功能关系；2）提出顺序流程的场景构造框架，将递归构造路径提炼为专家模型，在推理时由专家直接分阶段生成可执行代码，无需反复修正；3）提出ScenePRM奖励机制，通过强化学习给予功能、几何和可拓展性等多维反馈以提升专家能力。
AI.result: 建立了新的功能性基准测试，在一般室内场景生成与功能房间生成中，本方法在功能完整性、关系正确性、可执行几何性及生成效率方面取得了最优表现。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明基于功能目标的场景生成能够实现更高效且合理的房间自动化设计，并为后续研究提供新的评测标准和建模方法。

title: Compression-Aware Abstention: Teaching LLMs to Refuse When KV-Compression Masks Remove Answer Evidence
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the GroundLM workshop at EMNLP 2026. Code, adapters, and datasets: https://github.com/mali-kh/compression-aware-abstention
summary: KV-cache compression reduces LLM inference memory by evicting context tokens, but when the evicted tokens contain answer-bearing evidence, the model may hallucinate instead of recognizing that the compressed context is insufficient. We address this failure from a behavioral perspective: to our knowledge, this is the first work to formulate compression-aware abstention as a learning problem, in which a model learns to answer when supporting evidence survives compression and abstain when it does not. We construct supervision from compressor survival masks and tight answer-bearing spans, labeling examples as Confident when evidence survives and Abstain when it is removed. A 10.1M-parameter LoRA adapter trained on ~2.6K MuSiQue 2-hop QA examples reduces base-model hallucinations by 97% under prompt-style truncation while preserving correct answering on evidence-retaining examples. Unlike prompt-only abstention baselines, which over-abstain on many answerable high-retention examples, the trained adapter learns a conditional policy. We also evaluate the method under actual compressed-cache decoding, where multi-compressor training yields a 6-22x relative lift over the unaided base on evidence-retaining examples. Controlled-deletion experiments show that the learned behavior is driven by evidence content rather than input length alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对KV-cache压缩导致的大模型推理幻觉问题的行为学解决方案，通过训练模型在缺失关键证据时主动拒答，大幅降低幻觉率并保持正确回答能力。
AI.motivation: 在LLM推理中，减少内存需求用KV-cache压缩会移除部分上下文，若删除内容包含答案证据，模型容易幻觉。但模型当前难以分辨证据是否被压缩，缺乏“知道自己不知道”的能力。
AI.method: 首次将“压缩感知的拒答（abstention）”作为学习问题：通过证据保留情况自动标记数据（证据在→Confident，证据删→Abstain），并利用LoRA适配器和约2.6K带监督示例训练模型，让其在证据被删时主动拒答。同时，多压缩器训练、受控删除实验证明策略依赖证据内容。
AI.result: 新方法可在prompt排除模拟下，将模型幻觉率降97%，且保留正确答题能力，相较于仅靠prompt控制的拒答基线，新方法显著减少过度拒答。多压缩器方案在真实压缩下，在证据保留情况下相对性能提升6至22倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使得大模型能够更聪明地权衡KV-cache压缩带来的上下文丢失风险，在关键证据信息缺失时主动拒答显著降低幻觉，且拒答决策由内容驱动而非输入长度，为LLM内存优化和安全性提升提供了新思路。

title: NepScript Genesis: Neural Architecture Search for Handwritten Devanagari Digit Synthesis
summary: This paper introduces NepScript Genesis, a Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework for automated Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) discovery, applied to conditional Devanagari handwritten digit synthesis. We compare five NAS strategies against a carefully constructed Deep Convolutional GAN (DCGAN) baseline (FID=332.28). Architecture selection utilizes a two-stage pipeline guided by a novel domain-aware evaluation metric (Enhanced Score). Results demonstrate that Adaptive Exploration achieves the optimal quality-efficiency trade-off, attaining an FID of 79.12 -- a 76.19% improvement over the baseline -- and the highest mode coverage among the NAS strategies (Recall=0.531) in under one GPU-hour. Furthermore, we demonstrate that incorporating script-specific structural heuristics into the search phase prevents early-stage mode collapse. In a downstream low-resource evaluation, augmenting 250 real training samples per class with GAN-generated digits from the best NAS model improves CNN classification accuracy from 91.0% to 96.5% (+5.5 percentage points), demonstrating that NAS-optimized synthesis produces digits of sufficient quality to benefit practical recognition pipelines when real data is scarce.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NepScript Genesis框架，通过神经架构搜索（NAS）自动发现适合的生成对抗网络（GAN）用于有条件的天城文手写数字合成，并显著提升了合成质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 手写数字合成中，如何自动找到最佳的生成对抗网络架构以提升合成质量与模型泛化能力，尤其在天城文等低资源场景下，成为亟需突破的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出了NepScript Genesis NAS框架，采用两阶段结构搜索结合新颖的领域感知评估指标，在5种不同的NAS策略与手工DCGAN基线之间进行对比，并引入脚本特定结构启发，优化搜索过程。
AI.result: 自适应探索策略达到最佳质量效率平衡（FID从332.28降至79.12，提升76.19%；模式覆盖Recall=0.531，且耗时少于1 GPU小时）。此外，将NAS生成图像用于后续CNN识别场景，在极端样本稀缺下将准确率从91%提升到96.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将NAS用于GAN自动发现在低资源天城文数字合成任务中极为有效，合成图像不仅质量高，且显著提升下游识别任务性能。

title: When Safety Speaks a Language: A Mechanistic Analysis of Safety-Language Identity Entanglement in LLMs
summary: Safety alignment of large language models (LLMs) degrades across languages, yet the internal mechanism driving this asymmetry remains poorly understood. Our work, therefore, presents a systematic mechanistic analysis of multilingual safety using sparse autoencoder (SAE) features, sparse interpretable directions in the residual stream associated with harmful and harmless model behavior across three instruction-tuned LLMs, eight languages, and all model layers. We observe that safety-relevant features are architecture-dependent in terms of where they are located and how they are distributed across layers. Additionally, they are geometrically entangled with language identity and exhibit cross-lingual sharing patterns, i.e., languages share safety features to varying degrees across model depths and architectures. This safety-language entanglement has direct consequences such that ablating safety features impacts not only harmful response rates but also target language, with the degree of intervention predicted by the relationship between safety and language features. Our findings qualify the language-universality of safety alignment as architecture-dependent and offer a mechanistic account of multilingual safety interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了大语言模型在多语言环境下的安全性机制，揭示安全特征在模型结构、层次和语言间的复杂关联，为多语言下安全对齐提供了机制解释。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐效果在不同语言表现不一致，但其内部机制尚不清楚。理解这种语言间不对称性的成因，对于提升多语种模型的安全对齐具有重要意义。
AI.method: 作者采用稀疏自动编码器（Sparse Autoencoder, SAE）提取模型残差流中的可解释稀疏方向，分析三个指令微调的大模型、八种语言和模型的所有层次中与有害和无害行为相关的特征，并研究这些特征的位置、分布及与语言身份的几何交错以及跨语言共享模式。
AI.result: 发现安全相关特征在模型结构内分布具有依赖性，不同层和架构间分布不同，与语言身份高度交缠，并存在跨语种共享，但共享程度在不同深度和架构中不同。删除安全特征不仅减弱有害响应，还能影响目标语言，其干预效果可通过安全与语言特征的关联预测。
AI.conclusion: 多语言安全对齐的“通用性”依赖于模型结构，不同架构的模型在跨语言安全性干预机制上表现不同。研究为多语言安全干预提供了机制层面的解释。

title: MotionSync: Non-Causal Refinement of Causal Tracker for Label-Efficient 3D Perception
summary: Three-dimensional box-and-track annotation is the cost bottleneck in autonomous-driving data engines, and the offline systems built to relieve it replace the online perception stack outright, so a team needing both regimes maintains and reconciles two. MotionSync makes the causal/non-causal boundary an explicit architectural seam instead. A strictly causal tracker, built on a strong published baseline and extended with innovation-driven uncertainty calibration, frame-rate-invariant kinematic association gates, and multi-hypothesis motion with learned mode selection, emits a valid online result. A non-causal pass then revises the buffered trajectories with Rauch--Tung--Striebel smoothing applied separately to pose, extent and yaw, physics-validated gap completion, and semantic pruning of ghost tracks against LiDAR point labels. The refiner never writes back, so one system serves both regimes and refinement's effect is a delta over an unaltered causal estimate. Used as an auto-labeller, a fixed 3D detector trained on 25% human labels plus MotionSync pseudo-labels reaches 96.9% of its full-supervision mean average precision (mAP) on Waymo, and at a 10% budget the non-causal pass accounts for +3.3 mAP/L2 over pseudo-labels from the same tracker's causal stage. Re-fitting the online tracker on its own refined output recovers 73% of the benefit of human supervision, while its causal output is worse supervision than no re-fitting at all. As a tracker MotionSync is at parity with the leading published offline entries on the headline metric and ahead of them on error composition, which is where a refinement pass can act at all: it reduces misses and fragmentations together, the signature of gap completion rather than of a tuned detector.

AI.tldr: MotionSync提出了一种统一的3D目标追踪与轨迹标注系统，在保持高精度的同时极大减轻了自动驾驶数据引擎的人工标注负担。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶场景中3D方框及轨迹标注极为耗时且成本高昂，通常需要分别维护在线感知和离线标注两套系统，带来管理上的复杂和资源浪费。该论文旨在设计一个能统一在线与离线模式的数据引擎，减少人力标注，同时保障高标注质量。
AI.method: MotionSync系统引入显式的因果/非因果结构，主干是强化过的不依赖未来信息的因果追踪器（包括不确定性校准、帧率无关运动关联、多假设运动等）；随后非因果改进模块基于缓冲的轨迹引入RTS平滑、基于物理的间隙填补及基于LiDAR的语义化滤除幽灵轨，并且不会回写因果结果，因此两种模式复用同一套系统。
AI.result: 在Waymo数据集上，仅用25%人工标签和MotionSync伪标签训练的3D检测器即可达到全监督mAP的96.9%；预算仅10%时，非因果分支带来的提升为+3.3 mAP/L2。再训练在线追踪器可恢复73%的人类标注带来的收益。MotionSync追踪性能与最优离线方法持平，并在错误组成方面更优。
AI.conclusion: MotionSync大大简化了自动驾驶3D标注流程，通过统一充当在线追踪与离线标注两种角色，极大降低了对人工标注的依赖且可提升标注质量，在工业和实际自动驾驶开发场景中具有重要应用价值。

title: XQDT: eXplainable and Quantitative Data-Text Alignment Metric with Feedback Signals
summary: Evaluating data-text alignment remains challenging: existing metrics often provide limited explanations for the scores, while prompt-based LLM-as-Judge methods can be expensive and unreliable. We present an end-to-end explainable evaluation metric that fine-tunes a language model to identify omitted, extra, incorrect, and correct data units in a data-text pair. These local judgements are aggregated into precision, recall, and F1 scores, providing both fine-grained diagnostic feedback and an interpretable measure of alignment quality. Across benchmarks, our fine-tuned models outperform LLM-as-Judge methods in error prediction and achieve competitive precision, recall, and F1 scores, while maintaining strong correlation with human judgements. Beyond evaluation, our verifier outputs also provide useful feedback signals for downstream correction and refinement, supporting alignment-oriented improvement of data-to-text and text-to-data. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/guihuzhang/xqdt.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种端到端、可解释的数据-文本对齐评价指标，能够细致判断数据和文本匹配的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的数据-文本对齐评价指标解释有限，且大模型判分方法既昂贵又不稳定。因此需要一种既高效又可解释的评价方法。
AI.method: 作者提出对语言模型进行微调，使其能识别数据-文本对中遗漏、多余、错误和正确的信息单元。最后将这些局部判断汇总为全局的精确率、召回率和F1分数，并生成可诊断性的反馈。
AI.result: 微调后的模型在错误预测上优于LLM判分方法，并在精确率、召回率和F1等主流指标上表现竞争力，同时与人工评价高度相关。
AI.conclusion: 该方法不仅提升了数据-文本对齐评价的准确性和可解释性，还为后续矫正与优化提供了实用的反馈信号，有助于相关系统的持续改进。

title: TRINITY: A Multi-Perspective Benchmark for Personal-Style Video Highlight Detection
summary: Traditional video highlight detection relies on a narrow, event-centric definition of saliency, which often fails to generalize to unconstrained personal videos where highlights are heterogeneous and perspective-dependent. To address this, we introduce TRINITY, a multi-perspective benchmark that decomposes highlight saliency into three complementary dimensions, Event, Emotion, and Nature, within a unified temporal framework. Leveraging this multi-faceted view, we propose a shared-backbone multi-branch architecture designed for parallel multi-perspective prediction via view-specific experts. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving gains of +7.15/+3.62 mAP (rho=15%/50%) on Mr. HiSum and +10.82 mAP on YouTube Highlights. These results validate that multi-perspective modeling provides a more robust and comprehensive formulation of video saliency, especially for complex real-world scenarios. The benchmark and relevant codes will be released upon acceptance. The benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/vanilladucky/TRINITY and the code is available at https://github.com/vanilladucky/TRINITY.

AI.tldr: 视频高光检测传统方法过于依赖单一事件的显著性，难以适应个性化、异质性强的个人视频。本文提出TRINITY基准，将高光显著性分解为事件、情感和自然三维，提出多视角预测的新型多分支架构，在多个数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视频高光检测方法局限于基于事件的单一显著性，难以覆盖复杂、视角多样的真实个人视频高光。论文旨在建立更全面的高光检测标准和方法，提升模型在实际场景中的泛化性和准确性。
AI.method: 提出TRINITY多视角高光检测基准，将显著性分为事件、情感和自然三维，并设计了共享主干、多分支（针对不同视角的专家分支）体系结构，实现并行的多视角预测。
AI.result: 方法在Mr. HiSum (rho=15%/50%)数据集上mAP提升了+7.15/+3.62，在YouTube Highlights上提升了+10.82，相比现有技术有明显优势。
AI.conclusion: 多视角建模显著性能够更全面、稳健地解决复杂视频场景下的高光检测问题，为后续相关领域研究提供了新基准和有效方法。

title: How Prolific Sellers Self-Present: Dissecting the Communication Patterns of 1.6 Million Reverb Listings
summary: The current paper draws on self-presentation theory and warranting theory to evaluate how the language patterns in an online marketplace reflect seller status (i.e., a prolific seller versus an everyday seller). Using 1.6 million musical instrument listings from Reverb.com in search of content, style, and structural differences in seller product descriptions, the evidence suggested prolific sellers tend to focus more on objective and functional aspects of a product (e.g., its features and specifications) and less on subjective characteristics like tone, relative to everyday sellers. Prolific sellers also communicated in a more narrative-like style, which was driven by an elevated use of personal pronouns, and they used longer descriptions than everyday sellers. Therefore, what prolific sellers focus on tends to be quite technical, but how they communicate this information is typical of a story that is told to potential buyers. Implications for self-presentation theory and warranting theory are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文对在线市场中卖家商品描述的语言模式进行了大规模分析，发现高产卖家和普通卖家在描述内容和风格上存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 基于自我呈现理论和担保理论，探讨在线市场中不同类型卖家的语言呈现模式如何反映其卖家地位，对理解数字市场中的卖家策略具有理论和实践价值。
AI.method: 利用Reverb.com平台上160万条乐器商品信息，分析卖家在商品描述中的内容（客观/主观）、风格（叙事、用词）、结构（长度等）等差异。
AI.result: 高产卖家更偏重于介绍产品的客观、功能性特征（如参数和性能），较少涉及主观特质（如声音色彩）。他们的描述更具叙事风格，更多用第一人称代词，且文字更长。
AI.conclusion: 高产卖家在描述中更注重技术细节，但采用讲故事的方式与潜在买家沟通。这些发现丰富了自我呈现理论和担保理论在在线交易场景下的应用。

title: Guardrail-Agnostic Societal Bias Evaluation in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: We propose a societal bias evaluation method for large vision-language models (LVLMs) in the era of strong safety guardrails. Existing benchmarks rely on prompts that ask models to infer attributes of people in images (e.g., "Is this person a CEO or a secretary?"). However, we find that LVLMs with strong guardrails, such as GPT and Claude, often refuse these prompts, making evaluations unreliable. To address this, we change the prior evaluation paradigm by decoupling the task from the depicted person: instead of inferring person's attributes, we use prompts that do not ask about the person (e.g., "Write a fictional story about an imaginary person.") and attach the image as provisional user information to implicitly provide demographic cues, then compare outputs across user demographics. Instantiated across three tasks --- story generation, term explanation, and exam-style QA --- our method avoids refusals even in guardrailed LVLMs, enabling reliable bias measurement. Applying it to 20 recent LVLMs, both open-source and proprietary, we find that all models undesirably use user demographic information in person-irrelevant tasks; for instance, characters in stories are often portrayed as mechanic for male users and nurse for female users. Although still biased, proprietary models like GPT-5 show lower bias than open-source ones. We analyze potential factors behind this gap, discussing continuous model monitoring and improvement as a possible contributor for reducing bias.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种在强安全防护下评估大规模视觉-语言模型（LVLM）社会偏见的新方法，绕过模型对敏感属性推断的拒答现象，提高偏见测量的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM偏见评估大多依赖问及图片中人物属性的提示词，但随着模型安全性增强，模型常拒绝响应此类问题，导致评测失效。因此需要新的评估模式来有效测量模型偏见。
AI.method: 作者将评估方式转变为与图片中人物无关的任务（如虚构故事生成等），仅附加人物图片但不显式提及人物属性，通过比较不同用户属性下输出的差异来检测偏见并避免拒答。方法在故事生成、专业术语解释、考试题问答三类任务中进行了实例验证。
AI.result: 对20个最新开源和商用LVLM的测试表明：即使在与人物无关的任务中，各模型依然根据用户的群体信息隐式展现偏见，如男用户“故事角色”常设为机械师，女用户常为护士。商用闭源模型（如GPT-5）偏见程度低于开源模型。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效绕过了传统评测模式在安全防护下的局限性，使偏见评测更可靠。论文指出产品级模型持续监控与改进可能是降偏的重要原因。

title: Detecting Hidden Chain-of-Thought in Large Language Models with Linguistic, Behavioral, and Mechanistic Indicators
summary: Large language models often answer complex reasoning questions without revealing intermediate steps, raising whether they reason latently or complete patterns. We propose the Hidden CoT Detection Score (HCDS), a comparative behavioral and mechanistic signal measuring whether neutral-prompt behavior aligns more closely with explicit CoT or explicit no- CoT. Here, hidden CoT operationally denotes this neutral-prompt CoT-like alignment; HCDS does not directly observe or prove an unexposed reasoning trace. On GSM8K, HCDS is significantly positive for both Qwen3-4B variants (Thinking $+1.87$, $p = 1.2 \times 10^{-7}$; Instruct $+1.41$, $p = 1.9 \times 10^{-4}$), replicates across a different inference stack and quantization within $0.08$ ($+1.80$ and $+1.45$), and is not significantly positive in seven of eight length-adjusted calibration-control cells. The unadjusted score produces large positive scores on single-step arithmetic and numeric factual lookup. The variants also respond differently to no-CoT instructions: Instruct complies from the prompt alone, whereas Thinking continues reasoning and requires intervention. These findings show stronger, less prompt-conditional CoT-like behavior in the reasoning-tuned model, consistent with but not proof of latent reasoning. HCDS thus investigates latent reasoning without relying on models' self-reported traces.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种衡量大语言模型是否在中立情况下表现出链式思维（CoT）迹象的新指标HCDS，实验证明了其有效性，并在不同模型及设置下进行了考察。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在回答复杂推理问题时通常不展示中间推理步骤，因此难以判断其是否真的进行隐式推理或只是简单模式匹配。
AI.method: 作者提出Hidden CoT Detection Score（HCDS）指标，通过比较中立提示下模型行为与显式CoT/no-CoT行为的相似性，间接检测模型是否隐性使用链式推理。具体实验在GSM8K基准测试中进行，涵盖不同模型变体、推理堆栈、量化方法并设计了校准对照。
AI.result: 在GSM8K上，两种Qwen3-4B模型变体的HCDS显著为正，跨不同实验设定均复现，校准对照大多无显著效果。非校准分数在单步算术和事实检索任务上也有正向表现。不同指令下模型的合规表现也有所区分。
AI.conclusion: HCDS能够有效探查大语言模型的推理行为，尤其是模型的隐性链式思维迹象，展示出推理调优模型更强、更独立于提示的链式推理行为。该方法为研究隐性推理提供新思路。

title: SnapBench: Benchmarking Snap-and-Ask Multimodal Retrieval for Mobile Interactions
comment: 37 pages. Yuanbao Technical Report. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Mobile AI acts as a visual oracle, empowering users to snap a picture of something and ask for information. Snap-and-ask retrieval is now one of the most common entry points for mobile AI, yet photos are often blurry, while text questions may be short or mistyped. Existing benchmarks only test on clean inputs or do not isolate paired robustness in snap-and-ask retrieval. Therefore, we introduce SnapBench, the first paired benchmark for robust snap-and-ask multimodal retrieval, spanning 1,145 queries, 9,085 gallery items under 53 controlled corruption conditions with human annotations. We evaluate 16 multimodal retrievers, covering dual-tower encoders and embedding-based VLMs. Results show that image corruptions substantially degrade retrieval, while text corruptions mainly affect text-only retrieval and have limited impact on joint retrieval. Clean image-only retrieval often outperforms joint retrieval, indicating the coarse-text drag and the lack of cross-modal fallback under noisy inputs. SnapBench provides a controlled testbed for evaluating robust retrieval in snap-and-ask scenarios. We further propose MOOR (Modality-anchored, Outlier-aware, Optimal Reweighting), a simple adaptive fusion approach, highlighting the need for reliability-aware modality calibration in snap-and-ask retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SnapBench，这是首个针对快拍提问（snap-and-ask）多模态检索鲁棒性的配对基准数据集，并对当前主流方法进行了系统评测。
AI.motivation: 现有快拍提问的多模态检索方法和基准，主要针对干净（无噪声）输入，缺乏对图片和文本实际错误、噪声等挑战条件下鲁棒性的评测体系。移动AI实际应用中，照片和提问经常会有模糊和错别字，对系统性能影响很大。
AI.method: 作者构建了包含1,145条查询、9,085个图库项目、53种受控图像和文本扰动条件的SnapBench基准；对16种多模态检索器（包含双塔编码器及基于嵌入的大型视觉语言模型）进行了系统评测。此外，作者提出了一种新的融合方法MOOR，实现自适应的模态可靠性加权。
AI.result: 实验发现：图像噪声严重降低检索效果，文本错误则主要影响单文本检索而联合检索影响较小。纯净图像检索在噪声条件下经常好于联合检索，显示当前联合检索模型对偏噪声输入模态的退化不够敏感。MOOR方法则可有效提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SnapBench为快拍提问场景下的鲁棒多模态检索提供了标准的测试平台，并凸显鲁棒模态融合校准的重要性，对相关模型研究提供了方向和评价支撑。

title: Generative vs. Encoder Models for Multilingual NER: A Comprehensive Empirical Study on Naamapadam
summary: Language is humanity's most consequential technology, yet for over a billion speakers across India's twenty-two constitutionally recognised languages, its digital layer remains structurally incomplete. Named Entity Recognition (NER), the foundational step in transforming raw text into machine-interpretable knowledge, has been studied exhaustively for English but remains largely unsolved across most Indic languages. This paper presents a rigorous comparative study of generative and encoder-based neural architectures for NER on all eleven languages of the Naamapadam benchmark. We evaluate five classic model families spanning sequence-to-sequence transformers and multilingual encoders; four decoder-only large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with LoRA and 4-bit NF4 quantisation; and nine generative models in zero-to-5-shot inference. Under strict CoNLL span-level evaluation, encoder-based models (mBERT and XLM-R, both F1=0.675 on Hindi) substantially outperform every generative architecture in ten of eleven languages, with gaps of 7.5-40 percentage points against the strongest competitor (Gemma-2-2B: avg F1=0.427). The best few-shot result reaches only 28% of the encoder baseline. We identify three language clusters--encoder-dominant, partial-coverage, and failure-zone; and provide actionable deployment guidelines grounded in transfer learning and low-resource NLP principles.

AI.tldr: 论文对印度11种主流语言的命名实体识别（NER）进行了系统的模型比较，发现基于编码器的模型在绝大多数语言上明显优于生成式神经网络架构。
AI.motivation: 尽管NER在英文领域已深入研究，但在多种印度语言上的数字化应用尚不完善。本研究旨在评估不同神经网络架构对印度主要语言NER任务的适用性及表现差异。
AI.method: 选择了5种经典模型（包括序列到序列Transformer、多语言编码器）、4个经过LoRA及4位量化微调的大型语言模型（LLM），以及9个生成式模型，结合0-shot到5-shot推理进行综合实验。以严格的CoNLL span级别评估11种Naamapadam基准语言的NER性能。
AI.result: mBERT和XLM-R等基于编码器的模型在10/11种语言上（印地语F1=0.675）显著优于生成式模型，领先幅度7.5-40个百分点。最佳少样本生成式模型仅达到编码器基线28%的性能，部分生成式模型表现极低。
AI.conclusion: 基于编码器的模型目前是印度多语言NER领域的首选。论文提出了结合迁移学习和低资源NLP经验的实际部署建议，并根据语言特点分为三类：编码器主导、部分覆盖和难以处理区。

title: nnMNet: Baseline for Martian Terrain Semantic Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation is a crucial task for understanding Mars, the most Earth-like planet in our solar system. However, it is challenging because the Martian surface is highly unstructured and complex, making accurate pixel-level prediction and fine-grained annotation difficult. Recent advancements in deep learning have introduced numerous methods and datasets to address these challenges. Nevertheless, the field lacks a robust, publicly available, and reproducible baseline, as well as a unified benchmark to facilitate fair evaluations. In this work, we present nnMNet, a new baseline model designed for Martian terrain semantic segmentation. Building upon nnWNet, we integrate linear attention to better capture global context and employ lightweight convolutions to reduce computational overhead. To bridge the gap between local and global representations, we introduce the Spatially-Aware Fusion Block (SAFB), which augments and combines features with diverse characteristics. Furthermore, we establish a new benchmark by curating and standardizing three high-quality datasets for thorough evaluation. nnMNet achieves new state-of-the-art 86.61%, 83.25%, and 88.24% mIoU on SynMars-TW, SynMars-Air, and MarsScapes, respectively. Our code, models, and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/dereklee0310/nnMNet.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种新的基线模型nnMNet，用于火星地形的语义分割，并建立了统一的基准和高质量的数据集，在多个标准数据集上取得了最新最好成绩。
AI.motivation: 由于火星表面结构复杂且缺乏高质量的统一基线模型和基准，使得公平和可复现的评测难以实现，限制了领域发展。
AI.method: nnMNet在nnWNet的基础上，结合了线性注意力机制和轻量级卷积，提升了全局上下文捕捉能力，降低了计算量。创新地引入了空间感知融合模块（SAFB），实现多特征融合。论文还整理并标准化了三个高质量的数据集用于全面评测。
AI.result: nnMNet在SynMars-TW、SynMars-Air和MarsScapes三个数据集上分别取得了86.61%、83.25%和88.24%的mIoU，刷新了现有最好成绩。
AI.conclusion: nnMNet不仅为火星地形语义分割提供了可复现的强基线，也通过统一数据基准推动了领域评测标准的发展，相关代码和模型已开源。

title: DataFoundry: Evolving Data Preparators via Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Domain adaptation of large language models increasingly depends on constructing high-quality training data, yet existing data-preparation pipelines typically address quality only after generation through post-hoc filtering. This creates a fundamental mismatch: data-quality issues often originate from the construction process itself, while quality control is applied only to its outputs. We introduce \textsc{DataFoundry}, a framework for \textbf{evolving data preparators through recursive self-improvement} before large-scale data production. \textsc{DataFoundry} represents a data preparator as an evolvable runtime specification and instantiates its evolution with a \textsc{Skills-as-Modules} architecture, in which a central \textsc{Controller} orchestrates modular skills to compile executable runtimes, diagnose deficiencies on small pilot sets using domain-appropriate criteria, and translate diagnostic feedback into adapters that revise individual preparation components while preserving stable interfaces. We evaluate \textsc{DataFoundry} on DataPrep-Bench across mathematics, finance, law, and medicine, and find that recursively evolved preparators produce training data with higher downstream utility than baselines. Experiments across different backbones further demonstrate that these improvements are not tied to a particular model, while analyses and case studies further reveal the framework's optimization dynamics and illustrate how its evolution unfolds in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在大规模训练数据生成前阶段，通过递归自我改进演化数据处理器的新框架DataFoundry，有效提升了用于大语言模型领域适应的数据质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型领域适应高度依赖于高质量训练数据，然而主流数据准备流程只在数据生成后通过筛选进行质量控制，未能解决数据质量问题的根源。为更高效地提升数据集质量，研究需从准备流程本身进行改进。
AI.method: 作者提出DataFoundry框架，将“数据处理器”表示为可演化的运行时规范，并采用Skills-as-Modules架构，由中央控制器协调各类模块化技能组件。系统会先在小规模试点数据集上进行诊断与反馈，再将反馈转化为适当的组件修正，最终不断递归优化整个数据准备流程。
AI.result: 在DataPrep-Bench平台和数学、金融、法律、医学等多个领域上的实验表明，DataFoundry递归优化得到的数据处理器能输出下游性能更优的数据集，优于当前主流基线，且算法改进具有模型无关性。
AI.conclusion: DataFoundry框架通过事前递归自我改进显著提升了数据准备环节的智能与数据质量，为大语言模型领域适应提供了更高效且可泛化的高质量数据构建方案。

title: See the Change, Keep the Flow: Unsupervised Action Segmentation via Spectral-Temporal Representation Learning
summary: Unsupervised action segmentation aims to discover latent action categories and their temporal organization without action annotations. Optimal transport-based methods provide structured frame-to-action assignments, however, their pseudo-label quality is fundamentally conditioned on the representation space used to construct the transport cost. We argue that reliable OT pseudo-labeling requires a representation geometry that is simultaneously sensitive to discriminative action changes and coherent along local temporal progressions. Based on this insight, we propose SpecT-OT, a spectral-temporal representation learning framework built upon an unbalanced optimal transport pseudo-labeling concept. SpecT-OT introduces a Spectral Reparameterization Projector (SRP), which parameterizes projector weights with fixed Fourier bases and learnable coefficients to improve the modeling of rapidly varying discriminative features, and Temporal Affinity Regularization (TAR), which imposes distance-aware, label-free constraints on pairwise frame affinities to stabilize local temporal structure. The two components jointly produce more discriminative and temporally stable transport costs, yielding more reliable pseudo-labels for iterative representation learning. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate strong performance compared with state-of-the-art methods. SpecT-OT achieves the best results on 13 of 15 metrics, including 4.1-point MoF and 7.4-point F1 gains over the baseline on Breakfast and Desktop Assembly, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的无监督动作分割方法SpecT-OT，通过改进特征表示与时序结构，使伪标签更可靠，在多个基准上超过了现有方法。
AI.motivation: 无监督动作分割依赖最优传输生成伪标签，但伪标签的好坏受限于特征空间。现有方法难以同时捕获区分性的动作变化和保持时序的连续性，限制了分割性能。
AI.method: 提出了Spectral-Temporal Representation Learning框架SpecT-OT。核心包括Spectral Reparameterization Projector（SRP），利用固定的傅里叶基和可学习系数，提升对快速变化动作特征的建模能力；引入Temporal Affinity Regularization（TAR），通过无标签的相似性约束，增强时序结构的稳定性。两者联合优化最优传输代价，提高伪标签质量，支持迭代特征学习。
AI.result: 在四个主流无监督动作分割基准上进行了实验，SpecT-OT在15项指标中有13项取得最优，分别在Breakfast数据集MoF上提升4.1点，在Desktop Assembly的F1指标上提升7.4点，相较基线和主流方法均有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: SpecT-OT通过频谱-时序特征设计与最优传输结合，有效提升了无监督动作分割的伪标签和最终性能。在多个基准上都取得了领先结果，证明了方法的有效性和通用性。

title: Evolutionary Soups: Evolving Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Objective LLM Alignment
summary: Large language models are increasingly required to generate responses that satisfy multiple competing objectives. Since optimal trade-offs depend on both user preferences and input prompts, controllable multi-objective generation must dynamically adapt models at inference time without retraining. To address this, we propose Evolutionary Soups, a mixture-of-experts framework for fine-grained generation control, with gating networks trained via an evolutionary algorithm. The per-layer gating networks dynamically produce expert-merging coefficients from hidden-state representations, while the evolutionary algorithm incorporates greedy hypervolume contribution for effective evolution of these gating networks, achieving consistent improvements on large and noisy training datasets and broader coverage of the non-convex Pareto front. Experiments across three tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of Evolutionary Soups over baselines: it achieves the best hypervolume, linear utility, and Tchebyshev utility (~20% improvement) among controllable methods on all tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新方法Evolutionary Soups，实现了在无需重新训练的情况下，对大型语言模型进行可控的多目标生成。该方法在多项任务中均超过了以往基线。
AI.motivation: 多目标生成任务中，不同目标的最佳折中点依赖于用户偏好与输入，现有方法难以在推理时灵活适配；因此需要无需重训练即可实现动态控制的生成方法。
AI.method: 作者提出了Evolutionary Soups框架：采用专家混合（mixture-of-experts）结构，通过每层的门控网络融合专家输出，并利用进化算法（结合贪婪超体积贡献指标）训练门控网络，从而实现对不同专家权重的动态调整。
AI.result: 在三个多目标任务上，该方法对比其他可控生成方法，在超体积、线性效用和切比雪夫效用指标上均提升约20%。能更好地覆盖非凸Pareto前沿，实现更细粒度的多目标控制。
AI.conclusion: Evolutionary Soups为多目标生成任务提供了灵活、高效、无需重训练的控制方案。在多个任务和指标上效果突出，有望应用于各种需要多目标权衡的生成场景。

title: CineForge: Self-Improving Agents for Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon story-driven video generation requires a production agent to coordinate narrative decomposition, state tracking, shot design, prompt construction, rendering, and revision across interdependent scenes. Existing adaptive video systems primarily refine requests or reusable skills, leaving recurring production failures disconnected from persistent, stage-targeted improvements across stories. We introduce CineForge, a self-evolving video-production agent framework that couples CineForge-Produce for video generation with CineForge-Evolve for cross-story policy evolution. CineForge-Produce organizes each source story into typed narrative, character, spatial, and cinematic states, uses them to coordinate asset and clip generation, and records the process as a canonical production trajectory. CineForge-Evolve applies Case-to-Pattern-to-Policy Evolution (CPPE) to review trajectory evidence, consolidate recurrent findings into bounded stage-local patches, and deploy validated updates through structural replay and confidence-controlled paired evaluation. To measure complete story realization, we introduce CineScope, which combines a 100-script CineScope-Data suite with a human-aligned, multiscale CineScope-Metric spanning causal state, directorial orchestration, pacing and resource allocation, and character arc. Across CineScope-Data and two public benchmarks, the evolved CineForge policy improves CineScope-Metric from 4.024 to 4.380, outperforms three long-video baselines with consistent gains under ScriptAgent, and reduces review LLM calls by 37.0% on new stories. These results establish production trajectories as actionable experience for video agents that improve cumulatively across long-form storytelling tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CineForge的自进化视频生成代理框架，并配套有新的评估指标与数据集，显著提升了长故事视频生成的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应视频系统难以针对视频制作过程中反复出现的问题积累经验和持续优化，导致在长故事视频生成中无法取得有目标性的改进。
AI.method: CineForge框架分为两部分：CineForge-Produce负责将剧本解析为叙事、角色、空间、镜头等状态，协调资源生成并记录制作轨迹；CineForge-Evolve则利用案例到模式到策略的演化流程（CPPE），对制作过程进行分析，提炼并部署局部优化策略。此外提出CineScope数据集和多尺度人工对齐评测指标。
AI.result: 实验在CineScope数据集及两个公开基准上验证，CineForge优化策略可将CineScope指标从4.024提升到4.380，对比三种主流长视频基线方法表现更优，同时新故事上的审查LLM调用量减少37%。
AI.conclusion: 将完整的制作轨迹用于视频代理的经验积累与迭代，能够显著提升其在长篇、剧情驱动视频生成任务中的表现与效率。

title: Beyond Fluency: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Saudi Dialect and Cultural Competence in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in Arabic-speaking markets, yet standard benchmarks overwhelmingly reward Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) fluency while leaving dialectal and culturally grounded competence unmeasured. This gap is consequential: everyday Arabic is largely dialectal, and dialect encodes social meaning that MSA-centric evaluation cannot capture. We present a rubric-based benchmark for the Saudi dialect, comprising 31 expert-authored prompts spanning idiomatic, pragmatic, lexical, and culturally-embedded phenomena, each paired with an expert-established ground truth. Our methodology separates evaluation into a model-agnostic phase, in which atomic, MECE positive criteria are derived solely from the ground truth, and a model-specific phase, in which four state-of-the-art systems -- Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.7, GPT-5.6, and Kimi K3 -- are scored against those criteria and penalised for errors they actively introduce. Across 124 model-prompt evaluations we catalogue 466 error instances under a nine-category taxonomy. The four systems cluster within a narrow macro-average band (42.7%-53.1%), with no model exceeding 55% and every model recording at least one negative-scoring prompt, confirming that Saudi dialectal competence remains broadly unsolved. Notably, Ambiguous Framing is the dominant failure mode (37.3% of errors) while outright Hallucination accounts for only 11.2%, indicating that models fail less by stating falsehoods than by distorting register and flattening pragmatic nuance. We further observe a consistency-versus-ceiling trade-off and model-distinctive error signatures. We release the full prompt set, ground truths, and scored rubrics to support reproducible dialectal evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对标准基准对阿拉伯语方言测评不足的问题，提出并发布了专为沙特阿拉伯方言设计的专家评测基准，并基于此评估四个主流大模型，发现方言理解能力仍处于低水平。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型广泛应用于阿拉伯语市场，但现有基准主要评测现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA），忽略了日常中广泛使用且承载文化、社会含义的方言（如沙特阿拉伯方言），导致模型真实能力被高估。
AI.method:
1. 邀请专家编写涵盖多种语言现象的沙特方言任务提示（共31条），为每条提供权威答案。
2. 建立评价细则，首先从答案中提取原子性、互斥且穷尽的正向评价标准（与模型无关）；再根据标准对四款主流模型（Claude Opus 5、Gemini 3.7、GPT-5.6、Kimi K3）产出进行细致评分和错误归档。
3. 统计错误类型，总结评价结果。
AI.result: 对四个模型共124次答题，共归类出466次错误（9大类）。所有模型方言得分都未超过55%（最高53.1%），且每个模型均出现至少一次负分任务。主要错误是“语境模糊”（37.3%），而非“幻觉”（11.2%）；不同模型有差异化的错误分布。
AI.conclusion: 当前主流大模型在沙特阿拉伯方言理解和生成上表现较差，尚未能有效应对日常沟通和文化语境需求。发布数据和打分标准以支持后续可复现的方言能力测评。

title: SPLG-Mamba: Structure-Preserving Local-Global Mamba Network for Salient Object Detection in Optical Remote Sensing Images
summary: Salient object detection in optical remote sensing images (ORSI-SOD) requires dense predictions that preserve object completeness and structural continuity under complex backgrounds, scale variation, and irregular object shapes. Existing methods often localize salient regions, but their predictions may still suffer from structural degradation, including fragmented, incomplete, or locally missing foreground responses. This degradation is closely related to hierarchical feature propagation, where shallow details can introduce texture-induced background responses, deep semantics may over-smooth weak structures, and uncontrolled cross-scale fusion can disturb coherent regions. To address this issue, we propose a novel Structure-Preserving Local-Global Mamba Network, SPLG-Mamba, for ORSI-SOD. Specifically, SPLG-Mamba integrates Smooth-Detail Recalibration (SDR), hierarchy-aware Local-Global Mamba, and Gated Cross-Scale Fusion (GCSF). SDR recalibrates smoothed responses and detail residuals before state-space modeling, Local-Global Mamba assigns local modeling to shallow feature levels and global modeling to deep feature levels, and GCSF controls cross-scale detail injection during decoding. Experiments on ORSSD, EORSSD, and ORSI-4199 demonstrate state-of-the-art results and improved structural completeness and continuity. The code is available at https://github.com/yxu9910/SPLG-Mamba

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于光学遥感图像显著性目标检测的新方法SPLG-Mamba，能够更好地保持目标结构完整性，取得了领先效果。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像中显著目标检测常常面临目标结构碎片化和完整性缺失的问题，尤其在复杂背景、尺度变化和目标形状不规则的情况下。传统方法难以兼顾细节与结构连续性，因此有必要提出新的结构保持机制。
AI.method: 作者提出结构保持的本地-全局Mamba网络（SPLG-Mamba），包括平滑-细节再校准、层次感知本地-全局Mamba和门控跨尺度融合三个核心模块，分别用于重校准特征、精细化地赋予不同层次局部与全局建模能力，以及在解码时有控制地融合细节信息。
AI.result: 在ORSSD、EORSSD和ORSI-4199等公开数据集上，SPLG-Mamba取得了当前最优的检测效果，显著提升了结构完整性与连续性。
AI.conclusion: SPLG-Mamba有效缓解了遥感图像显著性目标检测中的结构退化问题，能够在复杂场景下实现更完整、更准确的目标检测，并具有较强的实用价值。

title: Generating Clinical Vignettes that Preserve Cognitive Formulations
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/Amit-Oren/FORMA
summary: Large language models can generate fluent clinical case vignettes, but fluency alone does not ensure fidelity to a specifiable clinical structure. We introduce FORMA, a theory-grounded framework that compiles a cognitive model of a disorder into a directed weighted graph, samples a person-specific configuration of that graph, and validates whether the generated vignette preserves the specified components and causal links. We instantiate FORMA on Posttraumatic Stress Disorder using the Ehlers and Clark cognitive model, generating 16,500 vignettes across 500 personas, 11 generation models, and three ablation conditions. Evaluation combines an external edge-recovery probe, two clinical experts, a scaled LLM judge, and a clinician user study with 100 licensed practitioners. The cognitive graph is recoverable from full-condition vignettes (MCC = +0.41, AUC = 0.70) but not from zero-shot generation (MCC = +0.01, AUC = 0.50). Experts rate full vignettes substantially higher than zero-shot alternatives, and clinicians perceive them to be human-written 85% of the time, compared with 22% for zero-shot. FORMA also reduces demographic disparity in perceived quality by 1.5-7x. These results show that cognitive formulation can serve as an auditable specification for scalable synthetic clinical text generation. A repository with the data and code is available online: https://github.com/Amit-Oren/FORMA.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出利用FORMS方法，通过认知模型指导大型语言模型生成结构化、真实的精神疾病临床病案，并经多方验证其效果显著优于传统方法。
