However, when spatial masking is introduced for representation learning, it can introduce representation ambiguity, while discrete quantization further amplifies small fluctuations in the latent space. The interaction between these two factors often leads to unstable code switching and severe temporal jitter near action boundaries.To address these limitations, we propose a novel Mask-aware Action Spatiotemporal Quantization (MASQ) framework. Our framework decouples the conflicting tasks of spatial feature inference and temporal smoothing.In the spatial dimension, we introduce a Joint-Level Structured Dropout (JLSD) mechanism that masks the entire temporal trajectory of selected joints, to encourage the model to learn discriminative inter-joint coordination patterns. In the temporal dimension, we design a mask-aware velocity loss that enforces motion consistency only on visible joints, that prevents gradient conflicts caused by masked signals and stabilizing temporal predictions. Extensive experiments on three widely used skeleton datasets, including HuGaDB, LARa, and BABEL, demonstrate that the proposed MASQ framework significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art unsupervised methods. In particular, our model establishes a comprehensive and substantial leading advantage in the Mean over Frames accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的无监督骨骼动作时序分割框架MASQ，通过空间和时间维度的解耦，有效提升动作边界识别的稳定性和准确性，在多个数据集上大幅超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督骨骼动作分割方法在引入空间掩码学习表征和离散量化的同时，面临表征歧义和边界不稳定等问题，造成动作切换时的严重时间抖动。
AI.method: 提出了Mask-aware Action Spatiotemporal Quantization (MASQ) 框架，空间维度使用JLSD（关节级结构化Dropout）机制，对选定关节的整个时序轨迹进行掩码，引导模型学习判别性强的关节协调模式；时间维度设计了mask-aware velocity loss，仅对可见关节施加运动一致性约束，从而缓解掩码信号的梯度冲突并稳定预测。
AI.result: 在HuGaDB、LARa、BABEL三大公开骨骼数据集上，MASQ的性能显著优于目前最好的无监督方法，尤其在Mean over Frames准确率指标上取得了全面且大幅度的领先。
AI.conclusion: MASQ有效解决了空间掩码与离散量化引发的模型不稳定问题，显著提升了无监督骨骼动作分割的表现，为人类行为理解提供了更鲁棒的工具。

title: The Differential Reasoning Router: Operationalizing Cost-Aware LLM Annotation in E-commerce
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to annotate structured product data in e-commerce, but early deployment often begins as a cold-start problem: only limited pre-launch labels are available, the value of expensive reasoning is unknown, and human review is needed before the system can be trusted at scale. This challenge is especially common in rule-based annotation workflows, where each item must satisfy multiple business rules and both model errors and ambiguous rule boundaries affect final decisions. We introduce the Differential Reasoning Router (DRR), a cost-aware framework for cold-start LLM annotation that jointly optimizes model selection and human escalation. Rather than treating a reasoning model as a default fallback, DRR estimates separate success probabilities for a direct model and a reasoning model at both the sample and business-rule levels, enabling adaptive routing: easy cases are handled directly, reasoning is reserved for cases where it is expected to improve the decision, and likely double-failure or rule-disagreement cases are escalated to human annotators. The resulting labels provide targeted ground truth for prompt engineering, supervised fine-tuning, calibration, and rule refinement, enabling a gradual shift from human-heavy cold-start annotation toward high-confidence automated routing. In a production e-commerce workflow, DRR reaches accuracy parity with the strongest confidence-based router while achieving more than 60\% reasoning-token cost savings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DRR的冷启动成本感知注释流程，大幅提升了大型语言模型在电商结构化数据标注的效率和准确性。
AI.motivation: 面对电商结构化数据的冷启动标注难题，初期样本有限且仍需大量人工复核，现有基于规则的流程对模型能力和成本的权衡存在不足。
AI.method: 提出Differential Reasoning Router (DRR)框架，分别对直接模型和推理模型在样本及规则层面估算成功概率，结合成本感知动态路由，自动判定哪类任务适合直接处理、推理处理还是须人工升级。
AI.result: 实际电商流程中，DRR在保持与最强的信心路由方法同等准确率的同时，推理token成本节省超过60%。
AI.conclusion: DRR能有效降低标注过程中的推理成本，同时通过动态路由与有效人工干预，大幅提升冷启动阶段的数据流转与模型优化效率，助力高置信自动化标注逐步替代人工。

title: Off-Manifold Refinement: Guiding Video Generators with a Frozen World Model
comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. Project page: https://itruonghai.github.io/omr
summary: Modern video generators routinely fail at physical dynamics: objects float, trajectories violate gravity, contacts vanish. Standard denoising and flow-matching objectives fit visual data distributions but do not explicitly penalize such physical violations. Existing remedies can improve physical consistency, but typically add substantial inference or training cost. Candidate-selection methods generate and score multiple videos, while gradient-based world-model guidance repeatedly decodes and re-encodes intermediate estimates. Generator-internal refinement adds perturbation and re-denoising loops, whereas post-training requires curated data and additional optimization. We propose Off-Manifold Refinement (OMR), an inference-time method that instead injects world-model feedback directly into a single sampling trajectory. During scheduled middle ODE steps, we augment the generator velocity with the gradient of an adapter-space V-JEPA 2.1 surprise energy. This external correction can move the latent away from the uncorrected sampling trajectory and toward regions ranked as more physically plausible by the frozen predictor, after which the generator continues rendering from the corrected state. A small trained latent-to-embedding adapter keeps the gradient tractable at inference, and both the video generator and the world model remain frozen. On our fixed 400-prompt VideoPhy-2 detailed subset, OMR lifts the joint Semantic-Adherence-and-Physical-Commonsense metric from 47.0% to 52.0% (+5.0pp absolute, +10.6% relative) over the base Wan2.2-T2V-A14B sampler. On a separate fixed 50-prompt efficiency subset, it requires $1.71 \times$ the base runtime rather than the multiplicative cost of reward/search alternatives. Project page: https://itruonghai.github.io/omr.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为Off-Manifold Refinement (OMR)的新方法，通过在推理过程中直接将物理反馈注入视频生成器采样轨迹，有效提升模型生成视频的物理一致性，并且计算开销较低。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频生成器在物理动态方面表现不佳，如物体浮空、轨迹违背重力、接触消失等现象频发。主流的去噪与流匹配目标函数无法显式惩罚这些物理违例，现有改善方法虽有效但计算开销大，影响实际应用。因此，亟需一种兼顾物理一致性和推理效率的方法。
AI.method: OMR方法在采样过程中选择特定时间步，将世界模型（V-JEPA 2.1）反馈生成的‘惊奇能量’梯度注入生成器速度，以引导潜变量脱离原始轨迹，趋向世界模型评估的物理合理区域。该方式无需额外训练生成器本身，仅需训练一个轻量级的适配器；生成器和世界模型均保持冻结，使梯度在推理时检测且计算开销可控。
AI.result: 在VideoPhy-2数据集的固定子集上，OMR方法将生成视频的语义与物理常识联合指标从47.0%提升至52.0%，绝对提升5个百分点，相对提升10.6%；在高效性测试子集上，仅需1.71倍基础采样时间，远优于多次采样或搜索等方法的成倍开销。
AI.conclusion: OMR方法无需大幅增加训练或推理开销，即可显著提升视频生成的物理一致性与语义质量，是一种高效实用的生成优化策略。

title: Quantifying and Mitigating Korean Jamo-Level Typographical Vulnerabilities in Large Language Models
summary: Korean introduces an additional typographical perturbation level not captured by ordinary character-level edit models: because syllable blocks are internally composed of sub-character units called jamo, keyboard-level errors can occur within a syllable, either producing a valid but semantically altered character or exposing raw jamo on the surface. Both outcomes disrupt sub-word tokenization and are not reliably corrected by existing grammatical error correction pipelines, leaving LLMs directly exposed to corrupted inputs. To quantify this vulnerability, we apply five jamo-level perturbation types to the KMMLU benchmark and evaluate four language models, finding that accuracy declines monotonically with perturbation intensity and that parameter scaling does not confer robustness against intra-syllabic noise. We further show that typo-corrupted inputs induce a distinct shift in internal representations that is not reducible to ordinary answer incorrectness, and that a simple linear probe trained on these representations detects unseen perturbation types with high AUROC. Motivated by this signal, we propose Typo-Aware Chain-of-Thought (TACoT), which routes inputs to chain-of-thought inference only when the probe detects a likely typo, recovering a substantial portion of the CoT accuracy gain at a fraction of the inference cost.

AI.tldr: 韩语在键盘输入时存在音节内部的微细打字错误（jamo级扰动），现有语法纠错与大模型难以应对这一问题。本文通过对基准测试集引入不同类型jamo扰动，评估多种大模型的稳健性并提出了一种打字错误感知的推断机制（TACoT）提升模型在这类扰动下的表现。
AI.motivation: 针对韩语独特的表征方式（音节由更细粒度jamo构成），输入中因键盘误操作容易造成音节内部错误进而严重影响分词与模型理解——这一现象传统英文语料与纠错方法不涉及，成为LLM对韩语处理的薄弱环节。
AI.method: 设计并实施五种jamo级别的扰动，应用于韩语高阶推理测试集KMMLU，评估四种主流语言模型在不同扰动强度下的表现。进一步，通过训练线性判别器检测内部表征变化来区分普通错误还是jamo扰动。基于检测信号，提出TACoT框架，在高疑似打错时自动采用chain-of-thought推理以增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: 1. 大模型准确率随着jamo扰动强度增加持续下降，模型参数规模扩大并未带来扰动鲁棒性的提升；2. 扰动输入会显著改变模型内部表征，这与常规语义错误不同，可以通过简单的线性探针检测区分且性能优秀（高AUROC）；3. TACoT机制能以较小推理代价恢复大部分chain-of-thought提升的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 韩语jamo级打字错误对当前LLM影响巨大且模型本身难以自适应。本文提出的扰动检测+动态推理方法可在不增加过多推理成本下大幅减轻这一盲点，为依赖细粒度文字结构的语言提供了一种污染鲁棒性的解决思路。

title: OrnaStyler: Ornament-Aware Latent Editing for Content-Preserving 3D Stylization
summary: Text-guided style editing of 3D assets is essential for adapting existing objects to diverse visual aesthetics in digital content creation. Despite rapid progress in 3D shape modeling, faithfully stylizing an existing asset remains challenging when the desired stylization involves fine-grained structural ornamentation, which requires the model to preserve the source geometry and object identity, while coherently integrating new style-specific details. We propose \textbf{OrnaStyler}, a zero-shot framework for text-guided ornament-aware 3D stylization. Built upon rectified flow-based generative modeling, OrnaStyler introduces an inversion-guided editing strategy that recovers content-aware latent representations at both geometry and appearance levels in a staged manner to facilitate faithful editing. Our core idea is to explicitly model the spatial configuration of stylistic elements, thereby mitigating the fundamental tension between content preservation and style expression in the voxel space. Specifically, at the geometry level, we manipulate voxel representations through flow inversion to synthesize ornament-enhanced structures while preserving the spatial identity of the source asset. Then, at the appearance level, we introduce an adjacency-aware feature inpainting mechanism to harmonize newly generated ornaments with the original content, yielding coherent geometry-appearance integration. Our approach operates solely in the inference phase and enables selective editing over geometric augmentation or appearance stylization. Extensive experiments on both generated and real-world 3D assets against prior methods demonstrate that OrnaStyler achieves state-of-the-art editing performance in terms of content preservation, style fidelity, and overall visual realism. Code is available at: https://github.com/tomohiro0427/OrnaStyler

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为OrnaStyler的零样本文本引导三维资产风格化方法，实现对三维对象在结构和外观上的高保真风格编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有三维资产风格化手段在需要精细结构装饰时难以兼顾原有几何保留与风格表达，阻碍了三维数字内容多样化和高质感的创作。
AI.method: OrnaStyler建立在流式生成模型基础上，采用反演引导编辑策略，分阶段回收内容感知的潜在表征：首先在几何层面通过流反演操作体素，以增加结构装饰并保持空间身份；其次在外观层面引入邻域感知的特征修补机制，使新装饰与原内容协调，实现几何与外观一体化编辑，该方法仅在推理阶段运行，无需训练。
AI.result: 在合成和真实三维资产上的大量实验显示，OrnaStyler在内容保留、风格还原和整体视觉质量上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: OrnaStyler实现了高质量的三维资产文本引导风格编辑，解决了内容与风格兼顾的难题，可为数字内容创作带来更大灵活性和视觉表现力。

title: PaperBanana-Interact: Scientific Diagram Refinement with Multi-Turn Human Feedback
summary: Recent efforts have aimed to automate scientific diagram generation from paper content (Lin et al., 2026; Zhu et al., 2026a). However, fully satisfying an author's visual and communicative preferences in a single turn is challenging: in our formative user study (N = 14), all participants requested further revisions after viewing an initial draft, and 86% of them rated the refined diagrams as more satisfactory. Despite the clear demand, the multi-turn workflow remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present MTPaperBananaBench, a benchmark for multi-turn diagram generation containing 292 images annotated with 3,518 user requirements. To reduce expensive human studies and enable scalable benchmarking, we construct a user simulator that, at each turn, identifies unsatisfied requirements and converts k of them into natural language feedback. Evaluating both requirement satisfaction and overall diagram quality reveals two key failure modes shared across baseline multiturn systems: (1) quality drift, where diagram quality progressively declines over turns, and (2) forgetting, where previously implemented features are lost in subsequent turns. To address these issues, we introduce PaperBanana-Interact, a multi-agent system that refines diagrams via an internal critique-and-refine loop. PaperBanana-Interact consistently improves rather than degrades diagram quality across turns, outperforming baselines by 11.9-18.6 points in quality score and reducing forgetting by 3.7-6.2 points.

AI.tldr: 本文针对科学论文内容自动生成多轮交互图表提出了新基准和改进方法，有效提升了交互式图表生成的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化科学图表生成方法难以一次性满足作者的视觉和表达需求，多轮交互需求高却相关工作不足。作者通过用户调研证实了多轮修改的重要性。
AI.method: 作者构建了MTPaperBananaBench多轮交互图表生成基准（292张图，3,518条用户需求），设计了用户模拟器来标注和生成多轮自然语言反馈，并提出了PaperBanana-Interact多代理系统，通过内部批判-改进循环提升图表质量。
AI.result: 评测显示，现有多轮基线方法普遍存在“质量漂移”和“遗忘”两个主要问题。PaperBanana-Interact 明显改善多轮图表生成质量（提升11.9-18.6分），并降低遗忘（减少3.7-6.2分）。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统性推动了多轮科学图表自动生成，提出的基准和方法均有效提升了交互生成的表现，为后续研究搭建了良好的基础。

title: Matrix-Game 3.5: Enhancing Real-Time Streaming Interactive World Models with Patch Memory
summary: Interactive world models extend video generation from offline clip synthesis toward persistent simulation of interactive virtual worlds, enabling applications in games, robotics, embodied agents, and XR. Achieving stable long-horizon interactive generation, however, remains challenging, as the model must simultaneously preserve scene geometry, dynamic consistency, and camera control while supporting real-time autoregressive generation. Building upon Matrix-Game 3.0, we present Matrix-Game 3.5, as shown in Figure 1, which advances real-time interactive world generation toward geometry-aware and long-horizon consistent simulation through three key improvements. First, we propose a unified geometry-aware memory framework, whose patch-memory and tiled-PRoPE components introduce no additional learnable parameters, combining explicit 3D patch retrieval with projective camera conditioning to enable geometry-consistent camera control and faithful long-horizon scene recall. Second, we introduce a static-dynamic disentangled world representation that separately models static scene geometry and dynamic subjects, preserving both geometric consistency and subject identity throughout long-horizon generation. Third, we develop a two-stage progressive real-time distillation framework that converts a bidirectional diffusion model into a few-step causal generator through Perceptual Flow Matching and curriculum based Self-Rollout DMD, enabling minute-long real-time interactive generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, with a unified training corpus spanning Unreal simulation environments, open-world games, and internet videos, MatrixGame 3.5 achieves strong performance in long-horizon scene recall, precise camera control, subject consistency, prompt-driven world generation, and stable real-time open-world interaction.

AI.tldr: Matrix-Game 3.5 提升了实时交互式虚拟世界模拟，在几何一致性、长时序回忆和动态一致性方面实现了重大突破。
AI.motivation: 当前视频生成模型难以在长时序下兼顾场景几何、一致性及实时交互需求，限制了虚拟世界、游戏和机器人等领域的应用。
AI.method: 1. 利用无参数化的几何感知记忆架构（patch-memory+tiled-PRoPE），实现基于显式3D补丁检索与投影相机调控的几何一致性和长时序场景回忆。2. 采用静-动态解耦表达，将静态场景几何和动态主体分开建模，长时序内保持结构与身份一致。3. 两阶段级进式实时蒸馏，将双向扩散模型转化为因果生成器，通过感知流匹配与自举DMD，支持分钟级实时交互。
AI.result: 在大规模统一训练语料（虚幻引擎、开放世界游戏、互联网视频）上，Matrix-Game 3.5展现了长时序回忆、精确相机控制、主体一致性、按需生成及稳定实时交互能力。
AI.conclusion: Matrix-Game 3.5 显著提升了交互式虚拟世界的建模和生成能力，为多领域的长时序及交互场景模拟提供了坚实基础。

title: Beyond Surface Forms: Symbolic Edits as a Test for Logical Reasoning with LLMs
summary: Logical reasoning with large language models (LLMs) is a critical capability, as it reflects a system's ability to correctly deduce hypotheses from a given context using faithful deductive processes. However, LLM reasoning has often been shown to be sensitive to small surface-level variations in problem formulation, raising questions about whether models truly follow the underlying logical structure. Studying this behavior is challenging because the symbolic components of logical problems, such as operators and predicates, are difficult to systematically manipulate in natural language. We introduce a tool-driven framework for generating controlled, label-preserving edits to logical reasoning problems. Our method operates on symbolic representations of first-order logic and constraint satisfaction problem tasks, enabling targeted modifications to logical operators and other structural components before translating them back into natural language. Using this framework, we evaluate various LLMs under cumulative and individual operator edits and analyze their behavior in response to these changes. Our quantitative and qualitative analyses show that LLM reasoning behavior under controlled operator edits is inconsistent, regardless of model size or family: models sometimes adapt correctly to structural changes but often fail to track their logical consequences. The results from this automated stress test enable an evaluation of language models across different dimensions and help measure the reliability of their reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新工具，用于系统性地修改逻辑推理题目，从而分析大语言模型（LLMs）在逻辑推理任务上的表现及稳定性。实验表明，LLMs在面临逻辑结构变化时表现不稳定，推理可靠性存在问题。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在逻辑推理任务中对于问题表述的微小变动表现出敏感性，这让人质疑它们是否真正理解和遵循逻辑结构。但由于自然语言中的逻辑符号难以系统地操纵，因此很难精确评估这种现象。
AI.method: 作者提出了一套工具驱动的框架，能够在一阶逻辑及约束满足问题上，对符号化表示进行受控编辑（如修改逻辑算子、谓词等），然后再转换回自然语言。通过这种方式，对各种LLMs进行包含单独及累积编辑的系统性测试，并定量和定性分析其表现。
AI.result: 结果显示，无论模型规模及家族如何，LLMs应对受控逻辑结构变化时的推理表现都不一致。有时模型能正确适应，但更多时候不能准确跟踪逻辑后果，表现出不可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为评估语言模型的逻辑推理能力和可靠性提供了新的测试手段。实验证明当前LLMs在面对逻辑结构变化时，推理行为往往不稳定，显示它们还不能很好地理解和执行逻辑结构。

title: FoundYou: A Unified Model for Personalized Segmentation and Retrieval
summary: Personalized segmentation and personalized retrieval both aim to identify the same physical object across different images. While the former localizes the object within a target image, the latter retrieves images where it appears. Despite this shared instance-level objective, the two tasks have largely evolved separately and are addressed with distinct solutions. In this work, we introduce FoundYou, a unified framework built on the observation that Segment Anything 2 (SAM 2), trained to preserve object identity across video frames, inherently captures instance-level cues. We leverage this property to match objects across independent images, enabling segmentation and retrieval to emerge as two outcomes of the same instance alignment process. This unified view unlocks new capabilities beyond traditional benchmarks, including few-shot personalized retrieval and promptable personalized segmentation with flexible prompts. Extensive experiments show consistent gains over unified and task-specific methods, including +18.4 mIoU on PerMIS and +17.8 mAP on ILIAS. Performance scales with additional references and remains robust to weaker prompts. Beyond personalization, FoundYou achieves state-of-the-art results on category-level retrieval benchmarks. Notably, our approach keeps the SAM 2-small model entirely frozen and adds only 5.9 M trainable parameters, yielding a 52 M-parameter model that is over 75x faster and 20x smaller than the only prior unified solution. Code is available at https://github.com/ga1i13o/FoundYou .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FoundYou，一个结合个性化分割与检索的统一框架，实现了在不同图片间同一目标的对齐与识别，性能强且高效。
AI.motivation: 目前个性化分割（定位目标）与个性化检索（检索目标出现的图片）虽目标一致，但方法各自为战，缺乏统一高效的解决方案。提升两者结合的能力，可带来新的应用与性能突破。
AI.method: 利用Segment Anything 2（SAM 2）模型在视频帧中保持对象一致性的能力，将其应用于多图像中对象实例的匹配，实现分割与检索的统一。框架冻结SAM 2主干，仅增加少量可训练参数，支持灵活的输入提示与少样本检索。
AI.result: 在PerMIS（个性化分割）和ILIAS（个性化检索）数据集上分别提升18.4 mIoU和17.8 mAP。对类别级检索，同样取得SOTA表现。模型体积小、速度快，仅用52M参数，远超之前的统一方法，且强于专用方法。
AI.conclusion: FoundYou打破了分割与检索两大任务的界限，提供了高效且性能优越的统一解决方案，在多项基准任务上均取得领先，同时为个性化应用拓展了新可能。

title: Stratified Consistency Distillation for Natural Language Formalization
summary: Neurosymbolic reasoning has shown promising success in addressing complex reasoning tasks by combining large language models (LLMs) and symbolic solvers. While this approach shows promise, a fundamental challenge remains: improving the accuracy of translations from natural language to logical formulas. Current methods predominantly rely on prompt engineering, which is difficult to scale across different domains and input formats. Drawing inspiration from the success of fine-tuning in other model adaptation and alignment applications, we propose a fine-tuning-based Stratified Consistency Distillation approach: (1) We generate K logical translations per input using a frontier LLM and cluster them by semantic equivalence (2) Based on the entropy level, we apply majority voting (low entropy), LLM-as-a-Judge (medium entropy), or unification/abstention (high entropy), and (3) fine-tune a smaller model using the selected pseudo-labels. Our experiments show significant and consistent improvements in both Pass@K and our novel Equivalent Logical Similarity metrics, demonstrating the potential of advancing logical translation through consistency distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通过细致的一致性蒸馏（Stratified Consistency Distillation）提升自然语言到逻辑公式翻译准确性的微调方法。
AI.motivation: 现有神经符号推理方法依赖于Prompt工程，跨领域和输入格式时难以扩展，亟需新的高效准确的翻译优化方法。
AI.method: 利用大型语言模型（LLM）为每条输入生成K个逻辑翻译，对其按语义等价性聚类。依据熵水平，采用多数投票、LLM判断或统一/弃权等策略选取伪标签，并据此微调小模型。
AI.result: 实验显示，该方法在Pass@K和新提出的Equivalent Logical Similarity指标上获得了显著且稳定的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 分层一致性蒸馏不仅提升了翻译的准确性，还具有推广潜力，对神经符号推理领域具有积极推动作用。

title: Continual Test-Time Adaptation via Entropy Sensitivity-Guidance in Strict Online Setting
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) promises robustness under distribution shift by updating a pretrained model on unlabeled test data, but strict online TTA with batch size one and no access to source data is especially prone to drift or collapse. We introduce Sensitivity-Guided Erasing Adaptation (SEGA), a method for strict online continual TTA (CTTA) on corruption-style streams. SEGA uses a small number of structured erasures to probe how predictive entropy changes as information is removed, and uses the resulting per-sample sensitivity trajectories to coordinate recovery and sample selection rather than relying on raw entropy or batch statistics. This yields a practical feedback signal for long-horizon batch-size-one adaptation without periodic resets or model reservoirs. In experiments on ImageNet-C, CIFAR10/100-C, and corruption-generated aquaculture streams treated as controlled corruption-style proxies, SEGA yields consistent robustness and stability gains over strong CTTA baselines while reducing backward passes through sensitivity-based gating.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SEGA的新方法，提升了在分布漂移情况下在线增量测试时自适应的鲁棒性和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 严格的在线测试时自适应(batch size为1且无源数据)容易出现模型漂移或崩溃，现有方法在此场景下表现不佳，因此需要新的方法提升长期稳定自适应能力。
AI.method: 提出Sensitivity-Guided Erasing Adaptation (SEGA)方法，通过有结构地抹除输入信息，观察预测熵的变化，通过采样的敏感性轨迹进行自适应和样本选择，而非依赖原始熵值或批统计信息，实现严格在线单样本增量自适应。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-C、CIFAR10/100-C等受控腐化测试集上，SEGA方法较现有强基线方法表现出更高的鲁棒性和稳定性，同时减少了反向传播次数。
AI.conclusion: SEGA为长期、严格的在线测试时适应提供了一种实用且高效的反馈信号，有效提升了模型在腐化流场景下的适应效果。

title: Using Prosody to Predict Syntactic Structure
summary: While it is well-established that prosody carries crucial cues for syntactic structure, the degree and nature of correspondence between these two domains remains contested. We investigate the syntax-prosody interface through an information-theoretic lens, quantifying the interaction between prosodic features and syntactic representations as their mutual information. We provide a general-purpose framework for estimating this quantity over large speech-text corpora using multimodal language models. Our framework is structure-agnostic and modular, insofar as it can be used to measure the contributions of individual prosodic features or components of structure. We evaluate the syntax-prosody relationship for two features (word duration and inter-word pauses) across two domains--read audiobooks and spontaneous conversations--both in English. Our results demonstrate that prosody contains measurable syntactic information, with prosodic features reducing syntactic uncertainty in spontaneous conversations by up to 10.2%. Our findings offer new empirical support for several theoretical accounts of the syntax-prosody interface.

AI.tldr: 本文利用信息论方法，量化韵律特征与句法结构之间的关联，并提出了一种可在大型语音文本语料库中估算该关联的通用性框架。结果显示韵律能传递可观的句法信息。
AI.motivation: 虽然已有研究指出韵律与句法结构相关，但二者关联的强度和具体方式仍有争议。为系统量化二者的交互，作者提出了新的信息论视角。
AI.method: 作者基于互信息指标，利用多模态语言模型，分析了韵律特征（如单词时长、词间停顿）与句法结构的关系。该框架对结构类型不敏感、可扩展性强，并应用于英语有声书朗读和自发对话两个领域。
AI.result: 研究显示，在英语自发对话中，韵律特征可使句法不确定性降低至多10.2%。韵律中的句法信息可被实际度量。
AI.conclusion: 韵律与句法结构的关系可通过定量分析得到实证支持，本文成果支持了语法-韵律界面的多种理论假设。

title: Towards Continual Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models in Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) relies on vision-language alignment to recognize arbitrary text-defined categories, yet this alignment is fragile under continual test-time distribution shift. Our diagnostic analysis reveals that entropy minimization drives patch-level class collapse, continual updates erode vision-language alignment, and redundant gradients from low-shift samples waste computation. We propose Diversify, Anchor, and Filter (DAF), a stabilization framework that augments entropy-based adaptation with a marginal diversity loss that resists collapse, a cross-modal anchor consistency loss that constrains feature drift relative to a frozen source model, and feature salience filtering that skips low-value backward passes to offset part of the source-anchor overhead. We evaluate on five datasets spanning natural scenes, autonomous driving, underwater imagery, and remote sensing with their corrupted variants. Across the evaluated continual shifts, DAF remains stable where entropy minimization collapses, improving mIoU by over 8 points on Pascal VOC20-C, over 9 points on LoveDA, and over 3 points on Foggy Cityscapes compared to the source model, and is robust to aggressive adaptation and learning rate choices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种稳定开放词汇语义分割在测试时分布连续漂移时性能的新方法（DAF），显著提升了分割准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇语义分割在面对分布连续漂移时表现不稳定，现有基于熵最小化的自适应方法容易导致类别塌缩和视觉-语言特征错位，而且计算资源被冗余样本浪费。亟需一种更鲁棒和高效的针对这一场景的自适应方法。
AI.method: 作者提出DAF框架：在熵自适应基础上，添加特征多样性损失以防类别塌缩；引入跨模态锚点一致性损失，利用冻结源模型约束特征漂移；通过特征显著性过滤跳过低价值样本的反向传播，减少冗余计算。
AI.result: DAF在自然场景、自动驾驶、水下和遥感等5个数据集及其受扰动变体上进行了评估。在顺序分布漂移环境下，DAF比基线方法更稳定。例如，在Pascal VOC20-C上提升超过8个mIoU点，LoveDA提升9个点，Foggy Cityscapes提升3个点，对自适应策略和学习率也表现出更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DAF在应对分布顺序漂移下的开放词汇语义分割非常有效，显著优于现有的熵最小化自适应方法。其策略有效防止类别塌缩和特征漂移，同时更高效利用计算资源。

title: Read the Room, Read the Image: Understanding Indirect Speech Acts in Multimodal Visual Contexts
summary: Indirect speech acts (ISAs) require pragmatic reasoning over context, as directive intent can- not be inferred from surface form alone. Prior text-based studies and existing multimodal benchmarks largely overlook this requirement, focusing instead on explicitly encoded context or perceptual recognition, and thus underex- plore context-dependent pragmatic understand- ing, particularly in high-context languages such as Korean. We introduce READI, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating ISA understanding through integrated reasoning over visual con- text and dialogue. READI models graded in- directness grounded in pragmatic theory and formulates the task as vision-based pragmatic question answering (V-PQA), supporting cross- lingual evaluation in English and Korean. Ex- periments show that even state-of-the-art multi- modal models struggle with visually grounded indirect speech acts, with performance declin- ing as indirectness increases, underscoring the need for benchmarks that explicitly target con- textual pragmatic reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为READI的多模态基准，用于评测模型在图像与对话上下文下对间接言语行为（ISA）的理解能力，强调对情境语用推理的考查。
AI.motivation: 现有研究在处理间接言语行为时，往往忽视了对语境依赖的语用推理，尤其在如韩语这样的高语境语言中显得不足。因此，作者提出了新的基准以补足该领域的空白。
AI.method: 作者构建了READI多模态基准，结合视觉场景和多语种对话（英语与韩语），模拟语用理论下的间接言语行为梯度，将任务形式化为基于视觉的语用问答（V-PQA）。
AI.result: 实验表明，即使是最先进的多模态模型，在处理涉及时境的间接言语行为时表现不佳，且随间接性增强表现进一步下降。
AI.conclusion: 该基准显著揭示了当前模型在复杂语境下的语用推理能力不足，表明未来模型亟需提升对情境语用推理的处理能力。

title: Hallucination Mitigation for Large Vision-Language Models via Implicit Feature Stabilization
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are prone to hallucinations: they fluently describe objects, attributes, and scenes that are not in the image. We connect part of this failure to a measurable property of their representations, feature instability, where mild semantics-preserving perturbations of the input cause large changes in the learned embeddings; hallucination rates rise together with this variability. Existing stability-motivated remedies are explicit, in the sense that they intervene at inference time through latent steering or constrained decoding, and pay for it on every query. We propose implicit stabilization instead: perturbation-invariance is built into the model weights during fine-tuning, and nothing extra runs at deployment. Our framework, INFUSE, first stabilizes visual and textual representations around perturbation-averaged and ground-truth anchors, then aligns the stabilized representations across modalities with bidirectional contrastive objectives. We prove that the anchor's root-mean-square deviation from the perturbation-mean representation shrinks at rate $1/\sqrt{K}$ in the number of views, and that under a Lipschitz decoder, this bounds how much any perturbation can change the model's hallucination behavior. On LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-1.6, and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, INFUSE reduces AMBER CHAIR by 46-63% relative to each base model, improves ObjHal, MMHal, HallusionBench, and POPE, and preserves VQA-v2 and TextVQA, all with no inference-time overhead.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出INFUSE方法，通过在微调阶段增强视觉-语言大模型（LVLM）对输入微扰的稳定性，从而有效减少模型在图文描述任务中出现的幻觉现象，无需在推理时增加任何计算开销。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言大模型常因输入轻微扰动而产生表示不稳定，导致对图片内容产生虚假描述（幻觉），已有解决方案多依赖推理时显式干预，带来额外成本与复杂度。
AI.method: INFUSE框架在微调阶段，通过对输入进行多视角扰动，稳定视觉和文本特征在扰动均值及其锚点附近，再利用双向对比损失对齐多模态特征，通过理论分析说明特征均值锚的偏差随视角数增加而快速收敛，有效限制扰动对幻觉行为的影响。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-1.6和Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct等模型上，INFUSE将AMBER CHAIR等指标上的幻觉率降低了46%至63%，在ObjHal、MMHal、HallusionBench和POPE等评测上表现更优，同时保持对VQA-v2和TextVQA等数据集的性能，无推理时开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过在模型训练时内建输入扰动不变性，可以显著提升LVLM对幻觉的鲁棒性，而无需增加部署和推理负担，证明了INFUSE方法在实际与理论上效果俱佳。

title: AIA$^{2}$: Attribute-Agnostic Imbalance Augmentation for Subgroup Robustness
summary: Attributes describing data content and context can induce diverse imbalance patterns that go beyond label imbalance alone. However, existing studies primarily address label imbalance while overlooking data attributes, such as topics and demographics, which can induce meaningful subgroup structure while causing model degradation on underrepresented subgroups. We propose Attribute-Agnostic Imbalance Augmentation (AIA$^{2}$), a framework for improving model robustness under varying subgroup imbalances without explicit subgroup annotations. AIA$^{2}$ automatically discovers varying imbalances via latent semantic distributions, obtains slices with both learning difficulty and subgroup imbalance deficits, and deploys a large language model (LLM) for subgroup-aware imbalance augmentation. We have evaluated AIA$^{2}$ on 5 popular corpora with rich domains and their attribute values, covering social issues and diverse topics. Results show improved performance on the lowest-performing subgroups and consistent gains over competitive baselines. Ablation studies confirm complementary contributions from each component, and additional analyses show that AIA$^{2}$ provides a practical and consistent way to improve worst-group robustness under data subgroup imbalance. Code is available at https://github.com/trust-nlp/AIA2-Subgroup-Robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新框架AIA²（Attribute-Agnostic Imbalance Augmentation），旨在无需显式子群体标签下，通过发现和增强数据中的隐藏属性不均衡（如主题、人口统计等）来提升模型在不同子群体上的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统的类别不均衡研究主要关注标签分布，却忽视了数据内容和上下文属性（如主题、人口统计）所带来的子群体结构，这会导致模型在某些弱势子群体上表现退化。论文关注“属性诱导的不均衡”，并试图解决现实应用中由于属性多样性导致的“最差子群体”鲁棒性不足问题。
AI.method: AIA²框架无需子群体显式注释，先通过潜在语义分布自动发现数据中的多样不均衡，再找到学习难度大且子群体不均衡突出的数据切片，并基于大型语言模型对弱势子群体进行增强数据生成，实现子群体感知的不均衡增强。
AI.result: AIA²在5个拥有丰富领域与属性多样性的公开数据集（包含社会议题和多元话题）上进行了评估。实验结果显示，相较于竞争性基线方法，该框架显著提升了在最低表现子群体上的性能。消融实验验证了各模块的互补贡献，额外分析证实AIA²提升了最差子群体的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: AIA²能够在无须显式子群体标签的情况下，为子群体不均衡问题提供一种实用且一致的提升最弱子群体鲁棒性的方法。

title: Dior: Drawing the Light of Image via Material-Decoupled Illumination Representation
summary: Controllable image relighting is an important problem in image editing, and hand-drawn scribbles provide an intuitive interface for specifying the desired illumination. However, existing methods do not establish a consistent and effective mapping between scribble inputs and relighting results, limiting their ability to control illumination intensity, chromaticity, and complex spatial distributions. We address this limitation by introducing a material-decoupled illumination representation, termed the Lumi Map, which establishes an explicit mapping between user scribbles and the resulting illumination, thereby improving both relighting accuracy and controllability. Specifically, we use a renderer to synthesize source image-Lumi Map-relit image triplets and train the model to predict the target relighting result conditioned on the Lumi Map. To mitigate the domain gap introduced by synthetic data, we further perform reconstruction training on real relighting pairs, improving the model's generalization to real-world images. Finally, we present Dior-Light, an image relighting method controlled by hand-drawn strokes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in relighting accuracy and enables effective control over illumination intensity and chromaticity on in-the-wild images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用手绘涂鸦（scribble）进行可控图像重光照的新方法，通过引入名为Lumi Map的物理分离光照表示，大幅提升了重光照的准确性和可控性，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统手绘涂鸦进行图像重光照的方法，难以精准控制光照的强度、色度及其复杂空间分布，因为缺乏输入涂鸦与实际光照之间的一致有效映射。因此，亟需一种高效映射策略来提升编辑控制能力。
AI.method: 作者提出物理属性分离的光照表示Lumi Map，用以建立用户涂鸦到光照结果的显式映射。具体做法为：用渲染器合成出源图-Lumi Map-重光照图像三元组，训练模型在Lumi Map条件下预测目标重光照结果；同时结合真实重光照配对数据做重建训练，以弥合合成数据与真实世界数据的域差异。最终提出可由手绘笔触控制的图像重光照方法Dior-Light。
AI.result: 通过大量实验证明，Dior-Light方法在重光照准确性方面超过了现有方法，并且能有效控制图片中光照的强度与色度，即使是自然场景的真实世界图片也有良好效果。
AI.conclusion: Lumi Map和配套的训练方式有效地解决了手绘涂鸦控制图像重光照的可控性、准确性及泛化性问题，为图像编辑任务提供了更便捷和强大的用户交互式工具。

title: Lazy Grounding: Attacking Search Agents with Factual Evidence
summary: Search agents reduce hallucination by grounding answers in retrieved web evidence. Yet reliance on retrieval also creates an attack surface: poisoned corpora with false or malicious documents can cause agents to reproduce misinformation. We show that falsehood is not necessary -- a search agent can be misled by factual evidence for a nearby question, adopting that nearby answer even when it does not answer the current question. We call this failure lazy grounding. We expose lazy grounding using nearby evidence from answer-changing rewrites of benchmark questions. Each document truthfully supports a neighboring rewritten question, but is surfaced for the original question. Across 12 model-benchmark pairs, nearby evidence reduces accuracy by 5.9 points on average and by up to 17.3 points, while inducing nearby-answer adoption in every setting. The effect is stronger when nearby evidence appears later or is more answer-shaped. Our results show that robust search agents must defend against not only misinformation but also the misapplication of factual evidence. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/frankyzha/lazy-grounding.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并分析了一种名为“lazy grounding（懒惰归因）”的新问题，即搜索型智能体即使获取到真实证据，也可能由于证据适用于相邻问题而被误导，导致答非所问。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于检索的智能体能通过网络真实证据减少幻觉，但也因此暴露于被篡改内容的攻击风险。作者想要证明，即使没有虚假内容，只需真实但不相关（适用于“邻近”问题）的证据，也足以误导智能体。
AI.method: 作者通过对标准问答数据集的问题进行邻近重写，构造仅支持相邻问题的真实文献证据，并测试多种大模型与基准在这种证据扰动下的表现，比较模型准确率和错误答案来源分析。
AI.result: 在12组模型-基准实验中，当模型被暴露于“邻近证据”时，平均准确率下降5.9个百分点，最严重达到17.3个百分点，并在全部被试设置下诱发了错误采用“邻近答案”的现象。效应在相关伪证据出现在较后位置或具备完整答案结构时更强烈。
AI.conclusion: 检索型智能体除了防范虚假信息，更需要防止真实但不适用的“邻近证据”被误用。研究为智能体安全和鲁棒性提出新的防御方向。

title: Everybody Tracking Every Body
summary: We address the problem of 3D body pose estimation of multiple interacting people from their egocentric views with centralized coordination. Each individual wears a camera recording egocentric video and IMU data. Processing this video with VIO SLAM provides high-quality tracking of each egocentric camera through space. The first-person view from one individual provides third-person observations of other people, although these exocentric observations are sparse, intermittent, and of highly variable reliability as both cameras and subjects move. To integrate these synchronized data streams, we propose a diffusion-based approach that fuses estimates of pose based on head motion derived from egocentric camera motion with exocentric pose observations, conditioning on both observation content and reliability. Our model is trained on a mixture of single-person motion-capture data and multi-person video in order to learn rich priors for body motion trajectories and video observation reliability. Evaluation on challenging multi-person datasets suggests our fusion approach improves over motion-only and vision-only baselines in terms of both absolute and relative pose accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过结合来自佩戴者自视角摄像头和IMU数据的信息，实现多人的三维身体姿态估计的新方法。通过融合头部运动（由相机轨迹推断）与第三人称的断续观测，实现了更精确的多人姿态重建。
AI.motivation: 多人互动场景下，如何从每个人的自视角摄像头和IMU数据准确恢复出所有人的三维身体姿态是一个重要但具有挑战性的问题。现有方法很难同时综合摄像头移动、自身运动和外部观测数据，导致姿态估计精度不足。
AI.method: 每个参与者佩戴一台摄像头，采集视频与IMU数据，通过VIO SLAM进行相机高精度定位。然后，提出一种基于扩散的融合方法，将基于头部运动推断的自视角身体姿态与第三人称（他人视角）观测的信息，以及这些观测的可靠性，进行条件融合。训练过程中使用了单人动作捕捉数据和多人视频，学习丰富的身体运动先验和观测可靠性。
AI.result: 在多人的公开挑战数据集上评估，所提的融合方法在绝对姿态和相对姿态精度上均超越了仅用动作或仅用视觉的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨模态、多源数据的有效融合，本文方法实现了更高鲁棒性和精度的多人三维身体姿态估计，为复杂多人交互场景提供了有效解法。

title: Beyond Token-Level Guidance: Inference-Time Alignment of Specialized LLMs via Cross-Family Representation Steering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) finetuned for specialized domains represent crucial high-impact applications. Inference-time alignment improves safety degraded from specialization finetuning without requiring substantial computational resources, complementing finetuning-based methods with an easy-to-use, plug-and-play solution. However, existing inference-time methods fail to reliably improve safety without disrupting domain capability. We identify the root cause as complementary expertise orthogonality: specialized base models and general-domain guidance models have orthogonal competencies, making the guidance signal unreliable for specialized generation. This primarily manifests as stop token interference, where the guidance model's tendency toward continuation overrides the base model's decision to stop, burying correct answers under guidance-induced continuation. To address this problem, we propose CREST, an inference-time alignment method that steers base model hidden representations using safety directions extracted from a guidance model of any family, avoiding token-level structural limitations entirely. CREST improves safety where specialization has weakened it while preserving both domain-specific capability and the safety of already well-aligned models, outperforming baselines by up to 22.2\% on safety benchmarks. Our code is available at: https://github.com/DecayingSeart/CREST.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了CREST，一种用于特定领域大模型推理时提升安全性的对齐方法，在不损失领域能力的前提下，有效提升安全性，且优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 针对大型语言模型在特定领域微调后，安全性通常下降且推理时现有对齐方法无法兼顾安全与领域能力，提出一种更优的方法满足实际需求。
AI.method: 提出CREST方法，通过推理时引导模型的隐层表征，利用指导模型的安全方向来提升安全性，规避了token级别结构带来的限制，可与任意家族的指导模型结合使用。
AI.result: CREST在维持领域专长的同时显著提升模型安全性，比现有基线在安全性基准上高出最高22.2%。
AI.conclusion: CREST方法有效地解决了推理时对齐下安全提升与领域能力保持的矛盾，为特定领域大模型的安全部署提供了新方案。

title: Biomechanical 3D Body: Self-Supervised Distillation of Biomechanical Pose from a 3D Body Foundation Model
comment: Accepted to the ECCV 2026 Workshop MoCha
summary: State-of-the-art monocular body recovery methods predict mesh vertices and angles on the corresponding kinematic tree, but their outputs lack biomechanically defined joint angles that downstream applications like clinical and biomechanical analyses require. We extend an existing foundation model, SAM-3D-Body, with an additional biomechanical prediction head that, from a single RGB image, regresses the joint angles and scales of a biomechanical model. Training this model presents a challenge, as there are limited datasets of paired images and biomechanical fits. To overcome this, we supervise biomechanical outputs with in-loop optimized targets from a Levenberg-Marquardt solver performing inverse kinematics fits against markers from the mesh predictions. This allows distilling the biomechanical head from the mesh head, even from unlabeled images. To make this work with GPU-optimized biomechanical models in MuJoCo, the entire model was implemented in JAX using Equinox. We trained this distilled output head on the publicly released SAM-3D-Body dataset. We then validated this model on biomechanical fits to two publicly available marker-based datasets, MoVi and BioCV, as well as movements from a clinical cohort captured with multiview markerless motion capture. The resulting model outperforms existing models for direct regression of biomechanics from images while only slightly underperforming the state-of-the-art monocular biomechanics method that performs more costly inference-time optimization of entire trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于单张RGB图像直接回归生物力学关节角度的新方法，并通过扩展SAM-3D-Body基础模型实现。该方法在多个公开数据集上表现优异，准确度接近目前最先进（但推理成本更高）的单目生物力学方法。
AI.motivation: 目前的单目人体恢复方法往往只预测网格顶点和关节角度，并不能满足临床和生物力学分析所需的高精度生物力学关节角度输出。因此，提出一种能直接预测符合生物力学定义关节角度的方法具有重要意义。
AI.method: 作者在SAM-3D-Body基础模型上增加了“生物力学预测头”，该分支能回归出生物力学模型的关节角度及缩放参数。由于缺乏配对的图像和生物力学标签数据，作者通过对网格预测进行逆运动学求解（Levenberg-Marquardt算法），用优化后的目标来监督训练生物力学预测头，从而实现无标注图像的蒸馏训练。该方法全程基于JAX和Equinox实现以适配MuJoCo。
AI.result: 在SAM-3D-Body公开数据集上训练后，模型在MoVi和BioCV两个标注数据集以及临床多视角数据集上进行验证，直接通过单张图片回归的准确度优于当前其他直接回归模型，并接近目前依赖耗时优化方法的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法在提升单目图像直接回归生物力学关节角度准确性的同时，极大降低了推理成本，有望应用于临床、运动分析等领域。

title: On the Design of Qwen3.8-Next Architecture: Evaluation, Efficiency, and Training Stability
summary: We describe the architecture and ablations of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 125B parameters, 6B activated per token, and additional 51B parameters of n-gram embedding tables held off the accelerator. On fourteen pre-training benchmarks the model leads the 397B-A17B predecessor on eight and trails it on the rest by at most 2.6 points, at 1/3 the activated parameters, 1/3 the training tokens, and roughly 1/9 the training FLOPs. Token mixing uses a layer-wise hybrid of Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and global attention, with one full-attention layer in every four; at continued-pretraining time those full-attention layers are replaced by Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA), which scores context at micro-block granularity with a compressed lightweight indexer. The residual stream is widened to four branches and read through an elementwise gate, a design we call the Gated Residual (GR). Capacity is added outside the backbone by a single n-gram embedding layer whose tables are prefetched from host memory. We evaluate every candidate change along three axes: loss together with downstream benchmarks; the cost of the change in training, prefill and decode; and its effect on the optimal hyperparameters and training stability. Loss and downstream accuracy do not always move together: enlarging the n-gram vocabulary lowers loss monotonically while downstream accuracy saturates. The architecture and the Muon optimizer together shift the optimal learning rate and batch size upwards, render batch-size warmup unnecessary, and substantially improve stability under stress tests. Loss, benchmarks, efficiency and stability form one design problem. Solved jointly, they yield a recipe that is simultaneously more efficient, more capable and more stable.

AI.tldr: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next是一个稀疏混合专家模型（SMoE），拥有1250亿参数，采用多种创新结构和优化方法，实现了高效率、高性能和更高稳定性。
AI.motivation: 提升大模型的训练效率、能力和稳定性，通过参数利用和结构创新减少算力消耗，同时提升实际任务指标。
AI.method:
1. 采用稀疏混合专家结构，每个token只激活60亿参数。
2. n-gram嵌入表额外扩容至510亿参数，存放于非加速器内存，通过prefetch机制加载。
3. Token互信息融合采用Gated DeltaNet（GDN）和全局注意力的混合，每四层有一层为全注意力；继续预训练时这些层被Qwen Sparse Attention（QSA）替换，提升效率。
4. 残差流做四分支扩宽，设计为“门控残差”（GR），用以提升模型的信息流动。
5. 系统性评估各改进对损失、下游任务表现、训练及推理效率、超参数稳定性的影响。
AI.result: 在14项预训练基准任务中，Qwen3.8-Flash-Next在8项上超越了先前的大模型397B-A17B，在剩余任务上最多差2.6分。而且仅用1/3激活参数、1/3训练token、1/9训练FLOPs，效果更高效。增大n-gram词表可持续性降低loss但下游分数饱和。架构与Muon优化器共同提升了最优学习率和batch size，训练更稳定，warmup不再必需。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出的整体设计，使得新模型在效率、能力和稳定性上三者兼顾，给出了一套实际可行、在多方面均提升的高性能大模型结构和训练方案。

title: Evaluating 2D and 3D-Aware Vision Foundation Models for Vehicle Attribute Recognition
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 Conference on Graphics, Patterns and Images (SIBGRAPI)
summary: Vehicle attribute recognition is an important task in intelligent transportation systems, particularly when Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR) is unavailable or unreliable. Although vision foundation models have shown strong transferability across domains, their effectiveness for fine-grained vehicle classification remains underexplored. Moreover, given the inherently three-dimensional structure of vehicles, it is unclear whether emerging 3D-aware foundation models offer advantages over standard 2D architectures. This paper presents an empirical benchmark of 14 state-of-the-art 2D and 3D-aware vision foundation models. Using the challenging real-world UFPR-VeSV dataset, we evaluate these models as frozen feature extractors via linear probing for vehicle type, make, and model recognition. We further stress-test the best-performing models under few-shot learning and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) domain shifts. Our results show that standard 2D self-supervised models, particularly DINOv3, substantially outperform 3D-aware models in fine-grained tasks, achieving over 93% Macro-Accuracy for make and model recognition. However, the 3D-aware Depth Anything v2 exhibits stronger invariance to viewing angles in vehicle type classification. These findings motivate hybrid approaches that combine 2D and 3D priors for robust vehicle recognition. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/UFPR-IPASPPR/3D-Vision-Benchmark/.

AI.tldr: 本文对比研究了2D和3D视觉基础模型在车辆细粒度属性识别中的表现，发现2D自监督模型如DINOv3在大多数任务中表现更佳，但3D模型在视角不变性上有优势。
AI.motivation: 在实际智能交通场景中，自动车牌识别有时不可用，需依赖车辆属性识别。随着大模型的发展，目前缺乏针对车辆细粒度分类的系统评估，尤其对3D-aware模型的潜力尚不清楚。
AI.method: 用UFPR-VeSV真实世界数据集，对14种SOTA的2D和3D视觉基础模型作为冻结特征提取器，通过线性探查进行车辆类型、品牌和型号识别，并在极少样本和分布外数据条件下对表现最优模型进行深入测试。
AI.result: 标准2D自监督模型（如DINOv3）在车辆的品牌和型号识别上，宏平均准确率超过93%，明显优于3D模型；但3D-aware模型（Depth Anything v2）在不同视角的车辆类型分类上具有更强的不变性。
AI.conclusion: 在车辆细粒度识别任务中，2D自监督模型总体效果更好，但3D模型对视角变化更鲁棒。未来可以尝试融合2D和3D先验，提升车辆识别的鲁棒性。

title: Sequential Trajectories and Simultaneous Blending: Multi-Emotion Modeling for Instruction-Following TTS
comment: Code is available at https://github.com/ictnlp/HybridEmo. Demo page: https://zhouyan19.github.io/HybridEmo-demo/
summary: Natural-language instructions enable flexible control of synthesized speech, yet emotional TTS systems primarily model a single utterance-level affect, leaving multi-emotion control underexplored. We study two complementary multi-emotion TTS tasks: emotion trajectory, which spans several ordered affective stages, and emotion blending, in which multiple emotions coexist throughout an utterance. These tasks expose a supervision mismatch: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) does not explicitly evaluate emotion features, while single-emotion rewards provide neither structure-aware feedback for trajectory completion nor pair-aware feedback for blending. We introduce HybridEmo, a post-training framework that initializes both tasks with SFT and then aligns the speech-token policy through Group Relative Policy Optimization using a sample-aware hybrid reward. For trajectory samples, segment-aligned consistency combines average and weakest-stage evidence to preserve the correctness and completeness of prescribed stages. For blending samples, a GMM-based reward combines frame-level support from the union of target-emotion anchors in an offline emotion space with an utterance-level weaker-target margin. Both branches share an ASR reward and are routed within a unified policy. On MultiEmo-Test, HybridEmo significantly improves trajectory correctness and blending intensity, without a noticeable degradation in speaker similarity. Human evaluation prefers HybridEmo to CosyVoice 3 and EmoVoice-0.5B, with nearly balanced preferences against Qwen3-TTS.

AI.tldr: 作者提出HybridEmo框架，实现多情感TTS系统对情感轨迹和情感混合两项复杂任务的控制。与现有方法相比，HybridEmo显著提升情感表现力和任务完成度。
AI.motivation: 目前情感TTS系统主要只支持单一句子级情感表达，难以应对句子内多阶段或多情感混合控制的实际需求。为解决这一不足，作者研究了更贴合真实应用场景的多情感TTS任务，推动TTS系统灵活应用。
AI.method: 作者定义了情感轨迹（句子内多阶段情感）与情感混合（复合多情感）两种任务。方法上，先用传统的有监督微调（SFT）预训练模型，然后提出 Group Relative Policy Optimization 策略，结合轨迹和混合样本的混合奖励函数，对TTS策略进行对齐：对于轨迹样本，用分段一致性奖励；对于混合样本，用GMM联合情感空间奖励。此外，两个任务共享ASR相关奖励，统一政策框架。
AI.result: HybridEmo在MultiEmo-Test测试集上，显著提高了情感轨迹的准确性和情感混合的表现力，且保持语者相似性。人类主观测评中，HybridEmo优于CosyVoice 3与EmoVoice-0.5B，并与Qwen3-TTS持平。
AI.conclusion: HybridEmo为多情感TTS任务提供了有效的新范式，让TTS系统可以更精准和多样地控制复杂情感表达，有望应用于对情感要求更复杂的语音合成场景。

title: On the Role of MRI Sequences in Cross-Dataset Generalization for Brain Tumor Segmentation
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 Conference on Graphics, Patterns and Images (SIBGRAPI)
summary: Brain tumor segmentation in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a critical task for diagnosis and treatment planning. Despite the success of deep learning architectures such as U-Net and its variants, performance degradation across datasets remains a major challenge, particularly under domain shift and limited annotated data. To address this issue, this study systematically evaluates how individual MRI sequences influence model robustness across two well-known datasets. A ResUNet-based framework is employed, where each modality is trained independently to isolate its effect under a controlled cross-dataset evaluation protocol with tumor size stratification, without target-domain training, or with limited domain adaptation. Results show that the T2f/FLAIR sequence achieves the best cross-dataset performance, with Dice scores exceeding 75%. It consistently outperforms other modalities across most tumor size ranges, while multi-sequence training further improves performance. Additionally, even limited target-domain adaptation yields rapid initial gains, reducing the need for extensive annotations and costly retraining. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/henrique-zan/brain_tumor_segmentation/.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了不同MRI序列对脑肿瘤分割模型在跨数据集任务中的鲁棒性影响。结果表明，T2f/FLAIR序列表现最佳，且多序列训练进一步提升性能。有限的领域适应已可显著减少标注和训练需求。
AI.motivation: 虽然深度学习方法在脑肿瘤MRI分割上取得了进展，但模型在不同数据集间表现下降，主要受领域转移和标注数据有限影响。亟需探索不同MRI序列对模型泛化能力的实际贡献。
AI.method: 本文采用ResUNet框架，分别独立训练各MRI模态，通过跨数据集评测和不同肿瘤体积分层，考察各模态对鲁棒性的影响，涉及无目标域训练和有限领域适应场景。
AI.result: T2f/FLAIR序列在跨数据集分割中获得最高Dice分数（>75%），在多数肿瘤体积区间均优于其他序列。多序列结合进一步提升效果，有限的目标域适应亦有明显增益。
AI.conclusion: T2f/FLAIR序列对提升模型的跨域鲁棒性作用最为突出，多序列训练和有限领域适应方法有效减少了对大量标注和高昂再训练的依赖。

title: Do Small Models Use the Law You Give Them? Measuring Context Use on a Bilingual Bangladesh Legal Benchmark
summary: Fine-tuning can improve legal question-answering accuracy without improving how models use law supplied in context. We study this distinction in bilingual Bangladeshi legal QA, where observed errors can arise from answer scoring, retrieval, or failure to use relevant law. We construct a hierarchy-preserving statutory corpus, 2,165 reviewed bilingual fine-tuning examples, and a 150-item supplied-law control. We evaluate six instruction-tuned models: Llama-3.2-1B, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen3.5-0.8B, Qwen3.5-2B, Qwen3.5-4B, and Gemma-4-E2B, with three LoRA seeds per model. To separate effects, we combine constrained option-letter scoring, cyclic option rotation, and controlled removal of the governing provision. On 398 Bar Council outputs, an exact-line parser attributes an accuracy gain of 50.0\% to the Qwen3.5-2B seed-42 adapter, whereas option scoring yields only $3.0\%$. For Gemma-4-E2B, the two scoring methods favor different systems. When the governing provision is guaranteed to be present, five of six reference models improve by $14.7\%-19.3\%$ under the four-order criterion. Removing that provision reduces accuracy by $8.0\%-15.3\%$ for models and by $13.8\%-14.9\%$ points for their adapters. However, difference-in differences estimates show no increase in reliance on the governing provision after fine-tuning. Results show that legal adaptation claims require separating scorer, retriever, and model effects. Our Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/bangladesh-legal-qa-11E3

AI.tldr: 本研究针对孟加拉双语法律问答，发现微调虽可提升问答准确率，但并未改善模型实际利用法律文本的能力。通过构建高质量数据集与多模型测试，细致划分和分析了模型性能提升的来源。
AI.motivation: 在法律问答任务中，当前微调方法常提升表观准确率，但未必改进模型对法律条文的理解和运用。本文旨在探明微调提升的本质，并检验模型实际依赖法律依据的深度，尤其是在双语复杂语境下。
AI.method: 作者构建了一套保留法律层级结构的孟加拉双语法条语料库，2,165个审核过的微调样例，以及包含150道带法条限定的对照题目。评测了6种主流指令微调模型（Llama和Qwen系列及Gemma），每种3组LoRA种子。通过结合选项打分、选项顺序轮换与法条有/无对照等手段，多维度拆解性能和法条使用效果。
AI.result: Qwen3.5-2B seed-42在限定评分下准确率提升达50%，传统选项评分仅增3%；Gemma-4-E2B对不同评分方式偏好不同。当确保法条充分提供时，大多数模型准确率提升14.7%-19.3%；移除法条后准确率显著下降，但微调后模型仍未表现出更强的法条依赖。
AI.conclusion: 论文指出，法律领域微调成果不应简单归因于更好地引用法律条文。需细致区分评分机制、信息检索和模型本身带来的提升。法律问答模型“适法化”宣传必须基于这种系统性拆解。

title: RIDGE: Region-Informed Derivative-Guided Evidence Selection for Long Video Understanding
summary: Long videos contain far more visual content than Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) can process under a fixed visual-token budget, making frame selection essential. Existing query-aware selectors usually estimate frame-query relevance and build a compact subset from high-scoring frames. Although their mechanisms differ, the similarity sequence is still often treated primarily as values to rank or sample from, rather than as an ordered signal whose shape reflects how query-relevant evidence emerges, peaks, and fades over time. This can obscure frames that explain, contextualize, or follow an event, because such evidence may lie on the rising or falling sides of a nearby relevance peak and receive lower absolute scores. We propose RIDGE, a frame selection framework that reads the frame-query similarity curve as a temporal signal. By using local changes and curvature, RIDGE partitions the timeline into structural regions and applies region-specific selection to preserve event cores, transitions, buildup, aftermath, and contextual frames under a fixed budget. It is a lightweight post-processing step on precomputed frame-query scores and requires neither training nor iterative LVLM calls. Across four long-video benchmarks and three backbones, RIDGE achieves the best performance in most settings and remains competitive in the others.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RIDGE方法，将帧与查询的相似性曲线视为时序信号，据此分区并选择关键帧，提高长视频下视觉-语言模型的信息保留效率。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频帧选择方法多依赖帧与查询的相关性得分进行排序或采样，忽略了相似性随时间变化的结构特征，从而可能遗漏描述事件上下文或转场的关键帧。
AI.method: 提出RIDGE框架，将帧-查询得分序列作为时序信号，通过分析局部变化和曲率，将视频时间轴分割为不同结构区域（如事件核心、过渡、铺垫、余波、上下文），并针对各区采用不同的帧选择策略，无需训练亦无需反复调用大型视觉-语言模型，仅基于预计算的相关分数进行轻量后处理。
AI.result: 在四个长视频基准与三种主流视觉-语言模型backbone上，RIDGE大多数情况下性能优于现有方法，其他场景中也具备竞争力。
AI.conclusion: RIDGE能更有效保留与查询相关并具有结构意义的关键帧，为长视频在视觉-语言任务中的处理带来了更高效且简单的帧选择解决方案。

title: Auditing MCQA Benchmarks through Probability Landscapes
summary: As Large Language Models rapidly advance, performance on standard multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) benchmarks is reaching saturation. While the community has responded by developing increasingly difficult datasets, validating question quality and filtering flawed items remains a labor-intensive process. To provide a scalable diagnostic approach, we propose a two-component probabilistic framework for auditing MCQA benchmarks using model output distributions. First, for benchmark-level analysis, we characterize the probability landscape using the top prediction probability ($P_{top1}$) and normalized residual entropy ($H_{norm}$), summarized globally by Mean Pairwise Distance (MPD). Second, for item-level diagnostics, we introduce noise injection to reduce meaningful distractor competition, enabling us to flag candidate items for targeted human review and categorize residual failure patterns. Across four MCQA benchmarks, our landscape analysis reveals benchmark-level differences in model confidence and residual option competition. Concurrently, our noise-injection method flags potentially actionable item-level issues, showing alignment with expert error annotations from MMLU-Redux. These results suggest that our probability-based framework provides a lightweight audit lens for comparing macro-level benchmark structure and prioritizing individual items for targeted human review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于概率分布的MCQA（多选题）基准评测审核框架，能自动发现题目与数据集的问题，提高审查效率。
AI.motivation: 当前大模型在MCQA基准测试中表现趋于饱和，人工筛查难题与发现瑕疵题目耗时费力，迫切需要高效的自动化审查工具。
AI.method: 框架包含两部分：一是在基准级别，利用模型的最高预测概率（Ptop1）和归一化剩余熵（Hnorm），通过平均成对距离（MPD）刻画整体概率分布特性；二是在题目级别，通过噪音注入方法削弱选项干扰，筛查需重点人工审查的题目并归类错误模式。
AI.result: 对四个MCQA基准测试的分析显示，该方法能够揭示模型在不同基准上的置信分布和选项竞争程度差异，同时，噪音注入法有效标记出需进一步人工核查的题目，并与专家注释较为一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于概率分布的审核框架为MCQA数据集提供了高效轻量的评估和筛查工具，能比较宏观结构并为人工复核提供优先级建议，有助于大规模提升数据质量。

title: Confidence-Aware Ensemble and Long-Word Refinement for Artistic Text Recognition
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 Conference on Graphics, Patterns and Images (SIBGRAPI)
summary: Artistic Text Recognition (ATR) remains challenging because word images often combine decorative fonts, curved layouts, object-like characters, clutter, and severe distortions. This paper studies WordArt-V1.5 as a standardized benchmark for this setting and evaluates recent scene and artistic text recognizers under a common protocol. We propose a confidence-aware ensemble that combines SVTRv2, PARSeq, and MAERec after fine-tuning on the official training split. The ensemble selects predictions using the minimum confidence over disagreement positions, emphasizing characters that separate competing hypotheses. For long words, where a single character error can invalidate the whole prediction, we add a targeted refinement stage based on Needleman-Wunsch alignment and lexicon-guided correction. On the WordArt-V1.5 Test B split, the proposed system reaches 89.90% Word Recognition Accuracy, improving the best individual fine-tuned model by 1.77 percentage points. The long-word refinement produces a modest global gain, but improves the targeted long-word subset by 2.72 percentage points. Finally, an error analysis of all remaining mistakes shows that 48.8% are associated with labeling issues, visual ambiguity, or illegible samples, highlighting the value of diagnostic reporting for future ATR benchmarks and models. Our source code is available at https://github.com/lucas-azdias/Artistic-Text-Recognition/.

AI.tldr: 本文针对具有艺术性变形的文本识别难题，提出了集成多模型并引入置信感知和长词优化的新系统，显著提升了公开数据集WordArt-V1.5上的识别效果。
AI.motivation: 艺术文本由于字体装饰、弯曲排版、干扰、变形等多种复杂因素，给现有文本识别方法带来极大挑战。作者希望通过统一的评测框架和改进的模型，推动ATR领域的发展。
AI.method: 作者以WordArt-V1.5基准为研究对象，对比并集成了3个当前主流识别模型（SVTRv2, PARSeq, MAERec），采用置信度感知的模型集成策略来提升结果稳定性。对于长词情况，基于Needleman-Wunsch对齐与词典引导进一步校正预测，以减少长词中的单字符错误对整体的影响。
AI.result: 该系统在WordArt-V1.5 Test B集上达到89.90%的识别准确率，比单一最优模型提升1.77个百分点。长词子集利用对齐校正策略提升2.72个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 集成方法和长词专项优化能有效提升艺术文本识别性能。对剩余错误深入分析发现接近半数源自标注质量或不可辨识因素，表明未来Benchmark建设仍需关注数据本身的诊断和改进。

title: Beyond Consensus: Downward Bias and Role Asymmetry in Multi-Agent LLM Judges for Subjective Evaluation
summary: Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) has been widely adopted to improve LLM-based evaluation by prompting multiple agents to negotiate and reach a consensus. However, for subjective rubric-based scoring, inter-agent agreement does not guarantee alignment with human judgments. In this paper, we compare a single-judge baseline against a consensus-based MAD protocol on subjective evaluation tasks and design three ablations to isolate the impact of role prompting, multi-round interaction, and explicit score sharing. Evaluations across six LLMs show that the single-judge baseline achieves the strongest human alignment on average across six judge models, whereas MAD shows degradation in human alignment on both tasks. Our ablations demonstrate that this performance drop stems primarily from asymmetric role prompting rather than the interaction itself. Specifically, assigning a strict judge role introduces a systematic downward bias that the consensus process fails to correct. The central finding is that this bias reflects strict-stance dominance beyond averaging: the consensus score falls well beyond the arithmetic midpoint of the standalone strict and lenient conditions, rather than averaging them out. Removing role asymmetry (Symmetric MAD) largely recovers baseline performance, while masking peer scores widens inter-agent disagreement on average and worsens average human alignment. These findings demonstrate that multi-agent consensus can enforce artificial agreement at the expense of true human alignment, revealing a structural limitation in consensus-style, role-specialized MAD protocols for subjective scoring.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了多智能体协作（MAD）在主观任务中的有效性，发现共识并不能保证与人类观点一致，反而可能拉低一致性。
AI.motivation: 近年来，MAD常用于提升LLM评估的可靠性，但在主观标准的打分场景下，模型之间达成一致未必等同于对齐人类判断，因此有必要系统分析MAD协议在此类任务中的表现。
AI.method: 作者将单评审（single-judge）与基于共识的MAD协议在主观评价任务上直接对比，并设计了三项消融实验，分别考察角色提示、轮次互动和分数共享的影响，实验涵盖六大主流LLMs。
AI.result: 结果显示，单评审在与人类一致性方面优于MAD，其它消融实验表明：性能下降主要由于不对称的角色设定，严格裁判角色带来持续下偏，而共识机制无法修正该偏差；对称MAD可基本恢复基线表现，而遮蔽同侪分数则加大分歧，进一步损害人类对齐度。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体共识在主观评分场景下容易牺牲与人类的一致性，当前主流依赖角色分工的MAD协议存在结构性局限性，需警惕共识机制‘人造一致’的问题。

title: SpanCalib-VLM: Calibrated Hallucination Span Detection in Vision-Language Models
summary: Detecting hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) requires both accurate span localization and well-calibrated confidence scores. Fine-tuned generative VLMs excel at identifying hallucinated text spans but suffer from overconfidence and high inference latency. Discriminative sequence taggers offer deterministic speed and superior calibration but exhibit conservative span recall. We present SpanCalib-VLM, a hybrid dual-system for the SHROOM-Visions Shared Task that combines a multimodal sequence tagger, consisting of XLM-RoBERTa-Large fused with a SigLIP vision encoder via cross-attention, with our fine-tuned generative VLM (Qwen3.5-4B-SHROOM-SFT). Through a Union-Calibrated Fusion strategy, candidate spans from the generative model are re-scored with calibrated probabilities from the sequence tagger. On the SHROOM-Visions English evaluation split, our ensemble achieves a Pearson calibration correlation of 0.41 and an overall IoU of 0.39, with a clean-response IoU of 0.91} and overall detection accuracy of 70.7%. We make our model weights and code publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种检测大规模视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）幻觉的新方法SpanCalib-VLM，结合生成式模型和判别式模型，提升了幻觉文本片段定位的准确性和置信度校准效果。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在检测幻觉问题时，生成式方法虽然能较好定位异常文本，但置信度易过度自信且推理慢；判别式方法推理快、置信度校准好，但召回率较低，容易漏检。因此需要结合两者优点，提升检测效果。
AI.method: 提出 SpanCalib-VLM 混合系统，将XLM-RoBERTa-Large与SigLIP视觉编码器通过交叉注意力融合形成多模态序列标注器，并与微调的生成式VLM（Qwen3.5-4B-SHROOM-SFT）联合，通过'Union-Calibrated Fusion'策略对候选片段进行校准评分。
AI.result: 在SHROOM-Visions英文数据集测试集上，所提方法的Pearson校准相关性为0.41，总体IoU为0.39，清洁答案IoU为0.91，总体检测准确率为70.7%。
AI.conclusion: SpanCalib-VLM能高效且准确地检测和校准LVLM产生的幻觉片段，实现了性能和置信校准的平衡。模型及代码已开源，促进相关领域研究发展。

title: Kathleen Remembers: Length-Invariant One-Shot Recall Without Attention
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Paper 4 of the Kathleen series. Mechanism covered by U.S. Provisional Patent Application No. 64/140,260
summary: Recurrent, attention-free sequence models share a structural weakness: a fading state cannot perform exact recall of something seen once, far in the past. We add to the Kathleen trunk a second memory layer -- a "notebook": a fixed-key holographic (HRR) associative store with a learned local write gate, a self-gating raw read, and write-triggered forgetting -- 25K parameters that attach to the logits of any trunk. (1) Mechanism: on a controlled needle-in-haystack task the notebook reaches 80-82% one-shot recall at 4x the training length, where the bare trunk scores ~4% and a parameter-matched attention head scores 100% inside its training length and 0% beyond it. Addressing is length-invariant by construction; the untrained memory alone recalls at 90% accuracy identically at 512, 2048 and 4096 bytes. Because the store is a linear superposition, two capabilities follow from arithmetic alone: selective unlearning (one subtraction erases one fact to chance, retained facts unharmed) and per-token attribution (counterfactual erasure names the source fact of every correct byte, 100% provenance). (2) Real text: on WikiText-2 bytes the notebook improves prediction of repeated rare words by +0.15-0.27 bits/byte, the gain growing with the distance between mentions and holding zero-shot at 4x training length; write-triggered forgetting eliminates memory pollution at 8x length (first-mention cost +0.33 -> -0.004). (3) Scope and scale: a parameter-matched attention head does generalize on natural-text repetition, so the notebook's claim is exact recall at O(L); on a WikiText-103 ladder (8 to 512 MB) the zero-shot repeat gain rises monotonically. All experiments are pre-registered, seeds reported, and reproducible on a single free-tier GPU.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出在序列模型（如Kathleen架构）中，增加一个无注意力但可精确回忆单次输入的‘notebook’记忆层，以显著提升序列模型长期精确记忆与回溯能力。该方法在特定任务下表现优于传统方法，并证实可在真实文本任务中提升表现。
AI.motivation: 当前循环及无注意力序列模型存在状态衰减，导致无法准确记忆很久以前的单次信息；而传统注意力机制虽能精确回忆，但其计算复杂度和参数量大。论文旨在寻找一种计算高效、参数低、且具备精确长期记忆能力的机制。
AI.method: 作者在Kathleen主干网络上增设了一层‘notebook’：固定键的全息（HRR）联想存储，通过可学习的局部写入门控、自门控的原始读取以及写入触发的遗忘机制，实现信息的高效编码、选择性遗忘和字节级归因。
AI.result: 在needle-in-haystack（针捞稻草堆）任务中，notebook层远超原始模型，在训练长度4倍时仍能达到80-82%的单次回忆准确率（原模型仅4%），且优于同参数量的注意力头。在真实文本任务中，可有效提升对重复罕见词的预测，且能控制跨序列污染。实验结果在不同长度、真实数据集和规模下均有一致显著进步。
AI.conclusion: 提出的notebook记忆层能以极低参数量，赋予主干网络跨长序列精确回忆、选择性遗忘和溯源归因的能力，兼具高效性与可扩展性，解决了传统方法的缺陷。

title: FIS-OT: Feature-Induced Optimal Transport for Unsupervised Action Segmentation
summary: Unsupervised action segmentation is a challenging task. It involves finding action categories and boundaries in videos without labels. Existing Optimal Transport (OT) methods use global constraints. This causes them to overlook the use of local information. Furthermore, existing Optimal transport architectures are prone to confirmation bias because they overly trust the pseudo-labels they generate. This causes models to learn from noise in the early training stages. To address these issues, we propose FIS-OT. It is a novel Feature-Induced Structured Optimal Transport framework. First, we introduce a Feature Enhanced Generator (FEG) module. It serves as an internal regularizer. By using triplet loss, FEG captures local consistency. It provides robust supervision that is independent of noisy pseudo-labels. Second, we propose a Feature-Induced Residual Structural Prior. This combines a fixed temporal backbone with dynamic feature similarities. This design ensures temporal continuity. It also allows the solver to adapt to complex action structures. Finally, we establish a cyclic optimization loop. This aligns local feature learning with global structural alignment. Extensive experiments on the three datasets show the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的无监督动作分割方法FIS-OT，通过引入特征增强生成器和残差结构先验，有效利用局部信息并缓解伪标签噪声问题，实验验证了方法有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督动作分割方法依赖最优传输(OT)全局约束，忽略了局部信息利用，并在早期训练阶段容易产生确认偏差（模型过度信任自身生成的伪标签），导致从噪声中学习，影响分割性能。
AI.method: 提出FIS-OT框架，包括：（1）特征增强生成器（FEG）模块，通过三元组损失捕获局部一致性，作为内部正则因子，提升抗噪声能力；（2）特征诱导残差结构先验，将固定时序骨干与动态特征相似性结合，确保时序连续性及适应复杂动作结构；（3）循环优化机制，实现局部特征学习和全局结构对齐的协同优化。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，FIS-OT在无监督动作分割任务中取得了优异的性能，优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: FIS-OT通过引入特征和结构层面的新机制，有效克服了现有OT方法的局部性和噪声问题，为无监督动作分割任务提供了更高鲁棒性和准确性的解决方案。

title: Using Grounded Theory for Agent Behavior Analysis at Scale
comment: 33 pages. Accepted to the Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Understanding agent behavior requires methods that scale to thousands of trajectories and surface new patterns in long, often unfamiliar tasks where pre-built classifiers fall short. We propose to bring grounded theory into agent trajectory analysis: a six-decade-old qualitative method from the social sciences, with a principled saturation criterion and an auditable trail from data to theory. We propose AutoTraceGT (Automated Trace analysis through Grounded Theory), the first multi-agent pipeline that automates grounded theory on agent trajectories. It iteratively performs open, axial, and theoretical coding until saturation, producing a behavioral taxonomy tailored to each task. Across six trajectory corpora, AutoTraceGT produces codebooks that recover 73-91 percent of the failure modes in human-annotated taxonomies and surface additional patterns that those taxonomies miss. The emergent theoretical narrative aligns with prior expert accounts. Used as a deductive feature space, the codebook outperforms zero-shot and few-shot LLM baselines on downstream failure prediction. These results suggest Grounded Theory offers a scalable analytic tool for ML researchers and agent developers studying what agents actually do.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合扎根理论的自动化多智能体轨迹分析工具，用于规模化发现并解释智能体行为中的新模式。
AI.motivation: 现有的行为分析方法难以应对成千上万条轨迹的数据量，且在面临长且陌生任务时，预设分类器的表现有限，不能有效发现新模式。
AI.method: 作者将社会科学中的扎根理论方法引入智能体轨迹分析，提出了AutoTraceGT系统。该系统自动化地执行开放编码、主轴编码和理论编码，直到饱和，生成针对每个任务的行为分类体系。
AI.result: 在六个不同的轨迹数据集上，AutoTraceGT生成的代码本能够复现73-91%的人工标注失败模式，同时挖掘出人工标注遗漏的新模式。其生成的理论结构与专家已有认知一致，并且在后续失败预测任务中，特征表现优于LLM的zero-shot和few-shot基线。
AI.conclusion: 扎根理论可为机器学习和智能体开发者提供可扩展的行为分析工具，帮助更深入理解智能体实际执行的动作和失败机理。

title: SVI2LoD3: Agent-Driven Reconstruction of LoD3 Facade Openings in Semantic 3D City Models from Volunteered Street View Imagery using Large Language and Visual Models
comment: Accepted for publication in the ISPRS Annals of the Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing and Spatial Information Sciences
summary: This paper presents an end-to-end, agent-driven pipeline for the LoD3 reconstruction of facade openings in 3D city models, producing directly usable CityGML-conform outputs. In contrast to existing approaches that rely on supervised semantic segmentation and therefore require large amounts of manually annotated training data, the proposed method employs a zero-shot segmentation strategy. This substantially reduces the annotation effort while still achieving strong performance in our benchmark on the eTRIMS dataset. A further key contribution is the enforcement of correct partonomic hierarchies, thereby producing CityGML-conform LoD3 building models. Beyond the reconstruction pipeline itself, this work also introduces a novel evaluation metric for facade reconstruction, termed Facade Feature Distance (FFD). Unlike conventional metrics such as mIoU or FRDS, which assess similarity primarily through pixel-wise overlap, FFD measures distance in a high-level feature space derived from a vision transformer. In doing so, it captures both semantic correctness and architectural layout, providing a more suitable assessment of facade reconstruction quality. The proposed pipeline and evaluation strategy together offer a practical and scalable contribution toward the automated generation and analysis of semantically enriched 3D city models. The developed code is published at: https://github.com/hcu-cml/citydb-SVI2LoD3-ai.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种端到端、基于agent的LoD3立面开口重建方法，实现免注释、零样本分割，并直接输出符合CityGML标准的3D城市模型。还提出了一种新的评估指标（FFD），更符合建筑立面重建需求。代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有方法普遍依赖大量人工标注数据进行有监督的语义分割，造成高昂的人力和时间成本，且对数据质量依赖较大。此外，现有评价指标未能准确评估建筑立面重建的语义与结构正确性。
AI.method: 采用agent驱动且端到端的自动化管线，用零样本分割技术替代传统有监督分割，极大降低了数据标注需求。同时，方法强制保证部件层级关系，确保输出满足CityGML LoD3规范。此外，提出了一种基于视觉Transformer高层特征距离的Facade Feature Distance（FFD）新指标，用以捕捉语义与结构信息进行评估。
AI.result: 在eTRIMS数据集上实验显示，该方法即使无需手工标注，也能达到良好重建效果。提出的FFD指标能够更真实反映立面重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能自动高效生成语义丰富、符合标准的LoD3级别3D城市模型，并通过新评估指标更合理地评价模型质量，推动了自动化城市三维建模的发展。

title: Quantitative Evidence Mining for Plausibility-Aware Biomedical AI
summary: Biomedical artificial intelligence (AI) systems increasingly extract, organize, and reuse scientific claims from literature, clinical trials, and regulatory documents. But automatic extraction alone does not make a claim reliable evidence: a claim becomes useful only when it can be traced to its source, linked to the quantitative details that support it, and read within its biomedical context and uncertainty. This matters as large language models (LLMs) and increasingly autonomous systems drive evidence synthesis, knowledge graph (KG) construction, and decision support. Many text-mining and LLM pipelines remain relation-centric: they capture entities and relations such as Drug--TREATS--Disease, but drop the dose, effect size, population, comparator, uncertainty, and conditions under which a claim holds. Such relations can look actionable yet remain hard to verify, compare, or reuse. In this perspective, we argue for a shift toward quantitative evidence mining---extracting values, units, measured entities and properties, context, uncertainty, provenance, and plausibility as structured evidence units that populate evidence-aware KGs and can be checked for source grounding, unit consistency, completeness, and biological plausibility. We outline a framework for plausibility-aware AI that treats extracted claims not as final answers but as auditable evidence objects, making clear what was measured, how much it changed, in which setting, with what uncertainty, and from which source. The central risk is not only incorrect extraction, but claims that look like evidence while lacking the structure needed to trust them.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，当前生物医学AI系统提取的证据存在粒度不足与可验证性弱等问题，呼吁将抽取重点从关系抽取转向包括量化细节和上下文等的“结构化证据”采集。
AI.motivation: 现有AI文本挖掘和大模型系统，多以关系为核心（如药物-治疗-疾病），忽略了关键的量化细节（剂量、效应量等）、不确定性、适用条件等，这些细节对于证据的可核查性和复用至关重要。随着AI系统广泛参与证据综合和知识图谱建设，提升证据粒度和信任度变得尤为迫切。
AI.method: 作者主张证据采集应超越简单关系抽取，提出“量化证据挖掘”框架——系统性地抽取与证据相关的数值、单位、测量实体与属性、上下文、不确定性、来源、合理性等，结构化填充到可审计、可验证的证据知识图谱中。
AI.result: 作者提出了包含可审计性、量化信息以及上下文元数据的AI证据结构模型，并阐释了这种方法相较传统模型更具可追溯性和信任基础。
AI.conclusion: 自动关系抽取不足以支撑高可信度的证据构建，生物医学AI需要转向结构化、量化和证据感知的知识采集，挖掘和组织具有可核查性的、高粒度细节的证据单元，从而提升证据的透明性、可验证性和重用价值。

title: Partition-Aware Unlearning for Removing Spurious Correlations in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve strong performance across many multimodal tasks; however, they often exploit spurious object-background correlations, resulting in predictions driven by contextual shortcuts rather than object-relevant visual evidence. Despite growing interest in hallucination and robustness evaluation, existing benchmarks provide limited control over whether model predictions are grounded in the target object or induced by correlated background cues. In this work, we introduce PURGE (\underline{P}artition-aware \underline{U}nlearning for \underline{R}emoving spurious-correlation \underline{G}enerated \underline{E}rrors), a framework for constructing, benchmarking, and mitigating spurious-correlation-induced failures in LVLMs. The framework consists of: -- (1) Structured dataset construction wherein we develop three complementary structured data construction strategies that partition examples by object-relevant evidence and spurious background cues, enabling controlled diagnosis of shortcut reliance; and -- (2) Partition-aware unlearning, which uses these partitions to selectively remove spurious object-background associations while preserving object-based reasoning. We evaluate the \algo~framework across multiple LVLMs, including LLaVA-1.6-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, and Qwen3.5-9B, together with CLIP as a vision-language encoder, on a diverse suite of benchmarks, including CHAIR, POPE, Causal-HalBench, MM-SpuBench, AMBER, MMHal, and Waterbirds. Our results show that PURGE consistently reduces hallucinations and spurious-correlation-driven errors while maintaining or improving overall performance in most evaluated settings, providing both a reusable evaluation protocol and an effective mitigation framework for more reliable LVLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PURGE框架，旨在诊断和缓解大规模视觉语言模型（LVLMs）中过度依赖背景线索的问题，从而减少“幻觉”与虚假相关错误。实验证明该方法显著提升了模型的稳健性。
AI.motivation: 当前LVLMs在多模态任务上表现优异，但常常利用了对象与背景之间的虚假相关性，这导致模型决策依赖于不相关的背景而非核心对象证据，影响其可解释性和鲁棒性。现有的基准测试无法精细控制模型是否真正关注目标对象，这一现象亟需更系统的诊断和改进方法。
AI.method: 提出PURGE框架，包括：（1）结构化数据集构建，采用三种策略将数据划分为对象相关证据与背景线索分区，实现对模型依赖“捷径”的诊断；（2）分区感知去学习（partition-aware unlearning），基于这些划分有选择性去除虚假对象-背景关联，保留对目标对象的推理。将该方法应用于多个主流LVLMs及多种公开基准上进行评估。
AI.result: 实验证明，PURGE在多个LVLMs和多项基准测试中均能有效降低幻觉和虚假相关错误，并在大多数场景下保持或提升了模型的整体表现。
AI.conclusion: PURGE为LVLMs提供了一个通用的评估和改进策略，既提升了模型的可靠性，也为未来多模态模型的鲁棒性研究提供了新思路。

title: When LLM Meets Tree Search: A Systematic View of Inference as Search in Large Language Models
summary: As pretraining scaling laws approach saturation, Test-Time Scaling (TTS) has emerged as an important direction for improving reasoning by allocating inference-time compute to a fixed model prior. Viewed at a high level, TTS reframes inference as search over a space of partial reasoning states. While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) exposes intermediate steps, common instantiations rely on single-trajectory decoding, limiting recovery from early errors and exploration. This survey systematizes recent progress in tree-search-based reasoning, viewing inference as instance-specific optimization rather than decoding. We trace the evolution from uninformed search to Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), highlighting how sampling-based control supports principled exploration-exploitation trade-offs. To unify a fragmented literature, we introduce a Unified Design Space spanning search topology, evaluation signals, and control dynamics, and advocate a standardized compute-reporting abstraction to make compute-accuracy trade-offs explicit and comparable.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述了基于树搜索的推理方法在语言模型推理中的最新进展，并提出了统一的设计空间和评估标准，推动领域标准化。
AI.motivation: 随着预训练扩展法则接近饱和，单靠提升模型规模提升推理能力变得有限。推理时计算（Test-Time Scaling, TTS）通过在模型推理阶段动态分配计算资源，成为提升推理质量的新方向，尤其是在面向复杂或推理任务时。
AI.method: 论文调研和系统化了树搜索型推理的演化路径，包括从无信息搜索到Monte Carlo树搜索（MCTS），强调采样驱动的探索-利用平衡。此外，提出了包含搜索结构、评估信号、控制动态的统一设计空间，以及标准化的计算-准确率评估机制。
AI.result: 文献系统化表明，基于树搜索的方法相比单一路径推理更能兼顾探索与利用，有效提升了模型在复杂推理任务中的表现。统一设计空间有助于对比不同方法下的效果和计算消耗。
AI.conclusion: 基于树搜索的推理方法为语言模型推理提供了可扩展和可控的能力，建议未来研究采用统一的设计与评测标准来推动算法进步和可比性，提高领域的整体发展速度。

title: Discrete Diffusion Bridges for Spatiotemporally Aligned Image Translation and Generation
summary: We propose Discrete Diffusion Bridges (DDB), a novel framework designed to resolve the fundamental spatiotemporal misalignment of standard discrete diffusion in image translation and generation. By corrupting data into a pure mask state via a random schedule, the conventional forward process induces a twofold misalignment: spatially, this pure-mask destination entirely discards the rich structural priors of the source image; temporally, the random masking order inherently contradicts the ``easy-first, hard-last'' decoding mechanism used during inference. To address this, DDB constructs a direct and efficient trajectory between domains. Spatially, we introduce a hybrid absorption mechanism that redefines the absorbing state to a stochastic mixture of mask and source tokens, effectively injecting source prior as spatial anchors into the latent space. Temporally, we design an information-guided noise schedule that quantifies semantic variation to prioritize the corruption of high-information regions at earlier timesteps. This ensures the model learns to resolve difficult semantic changes using robust context from invariant regions. Extensive experiments validate the versatility and robustness of our framework across diverse generative paradigms. DDB effectively balances edit alignment with structural fidelity across both text-guided semantic manipulation and pure structural image translation, while inherently complementing text-to-image generation and guaranteeing robust high-quality decoding under extremely low sampling steps. Code and models are available at \href{https://github.com/HKU-HealthAI/DDB}{https://github.com/HKU-HealthAI/DDB}.
