AI.tldr: 本文提出了离散扩散桥（DDB）框架，解决了标准离散扩散在图像翻译与生成任务中的时空错位问题，通过引入混合吸收机制和信息引导噪声日程，有效平衡了编辑一致性和结构保真度。
AI.motivation: 标准离散扩散在前向过程中会将图像退化为全掩码状态，导致空间上丢失结构先验、时间上随机遮罩也与推理过程的不匹配。现有方案难以同时保障编辑灵活度和结构还原度，因此需要新的机制来优化扩散过程。
AI.method: DDB 空间上引入“混合吸收机制”，将吸收状态重定义为掩码与源 token 的随机混合，从而将源图像结构引入潜空间作为锚点。时间上，设计“信息引导噪声日程”，基于区块语义信息量，优先对高信息区域进行早期掩盖，促进模型利用环绕上下文解决复杂语义变化。
AI.result: 在多种生成范式上的大量实验表明，DDB 框架适用性强、鲁棒性好，在文本引导语义编辑及纯结构图像翻译任务中，能有效兼顾编辑精度与结构还原，也有利于文本到图像的高效生成，尤其在极低采样步数下仍能保持高质量。
AI.conclusion: DDB 有效改善了离散扩散的时空对齐问题，赋予图像编辑与生成任务更强的表达能力和图像还原度，并具备极强的泛化性和实用价值。

title: Co-Evolving Actor-Conditioned Critics for Non-Verifiable Generation
summary: Natural-language critiques provide supervision beyond scalar rewards for non-verifiable generation, which lacks deterministic verifiers. In critique-guided refinement, a critic gives feedback on an initial response and an actor revises it. However, final revision quality does not reveal whether the critique was actually useful: a capable actor may improve without following the feedback, while valid feedback may fail if the actor cannot execute it. We frame critique as actor-conditioned revision guidance, where usefulness depends on whether the feedback helps the target actor address the intended weakness. We introduce TAIScore (Targeted Actionable Improvement Score), a reward that evaluates the instruction, initial response, critique, and revision together, assessing whether the critique targets a real weakness, whether the actor follows it, and whether the intended aspect improves. We use this reward to train an actor-tailored critic with GRPO, and use critique-guided refinements to construct DPO preference pairs for the actor, forming a co-evolving critic-actor loop where the critic adapts to the actor's changing capability. Experiments show that an 8B critic trained with TAIScore outperforms both a zero-shot 120B critic and critics trained with outcome-only or critique-only reward signals. Co-evolving the critic and actor further improves performance, suggesting that effective critique supervision should adapt as the actor changes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用自然语言评论作为生成模型的监督信号，通过创新指标TAIScore量化评论对于模型改进的有效性，实现评论员-行为者的协同进化机制，从而提升非标定生成任务的表现。
AI.motivation: 非标定生成任务缺乏可验证的评测标准，传统标量奖励信号不可区分评论反馈的真实作用，因此需要一种能判断评论有效性的机制，来提升生成内容质量。
AI.method: 提出TAIScore指标，综合评估给定初始回复、评论内容及修订后回复，判断评论是否针对真实弱点、行为者是否采纳以及相应弱点是否改进。利用此奖励信号训练评论员，同时构建DPO偏好对以优化行为者，形成行为者与评论员协同优化的闭环，通过GRPO等方法使评论员适应不同能力水平的行为者。
AI.result: 实验发现，使用TAIScore训练的8B参数评论员，表现优于零样本的120B大模型评论员以及仅用结果或评论信号训练的评论员。评论员-行为者协同进化进一步提升了最终表现。
AI.conclusion: 自适应的评论监督机制明显优于固定标准，评论员需针对行为者不断调整反馈方式以发挥最大监督效果。这为非标定生成任务提供了有效的评测和优化范式。

title: OPAL: Orthonormal Prototype Alignment Learning for Interpretable Image Classification
summary: Prototypical part-based models provide explainable predictions by comparing input regions to learned prototypes. However, current approaches are burdened by complex, multi-stage training pipelines and heavily rely on auxiliary regularization to prevent prototype collapse. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Orthonormal Prototype Alignment Learning (OPAL), a single-stage, end-to-end framework that simplifies interpretable classification. Our approach anchors the latent space using predefined orthonormal bases, embedding each class within a dedicated subspace spanned by fixed part-prototypes. To achieve precise part localization, OPAL enforces spatial competition across feature maps. This mechanism isolates sparse, discriminative regions, directing each prototype to consistently attend to the same semantic concept across different images. By framing classification as a direct representation alignment task, our method eliminates the need for auxiliary losses. Extensive experiments on fine-grained benchmarks demonstrate that OPAL outperforms both its non-interpretable counterparts and state-of-the-art part-prototype methods, delivering granular visual explanations by explicitly revealing the specific image regions driving every prediction. Code is available at https://github.com/ilancarretero/OPAL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种新的可解释分类方法OPAL，简化了部分原型模型的训练流程，并提升了性能和解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有的部分原型模型虽然可解释，但训练流程复杂且过度依赖辅助正则化，存在原型坍缩等问题，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 提出OPAL（一种正交原型对齐学习方法），将每个类别嵌入固定的正交子空间，通过空间竞争机制实现语义部位的稀疏、稳定定位，避免了辅助损失的需求，实现了端到端、单阶段训练。
AI.result: 在多个细粒度分类基准上，OPAL优于非可解释模型和当前最先进的部分原型方法，并且提供细粒度的视觉解释，明确展示模型关注的图像区域。
AI.conclusion: OPAL大幅简化了可解释分类模型的训练流程，提升了性能和可解释性，为可解释AI提供了新思路。

title: Beyond Polarization: The Generative Constraint of Chain-of-Thought in Pointwise Reranking
summary: In pointwise document reranking, Chain-of-Thought models typically underperform direct scoring models. While existing diagnostics attribute this to inferior classification, score polarization, or calibration breakdown, whether targeted training can bridge this gap remains unclear. Our empirical study first confirms that this gap is stable across scales up to 32B parameters, ruling out model and data capacity confounders. We then apply stress tests utilizing reinforcement learning, fine-grained supervision, and architectural decoupling to explicitly repair these deviations. Although these interventions improve classification accuracy and absolute scores, the relative ranking gap persists. These findings suggest that, within the pointwise scoring paradigm, routing continuous relevance semantics through discrete text constrains ranking signal resolution, revealing a bottleneck that is stable and difficult to overcome under current standard methods, rather than an easily resolvable training bias.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现，在pointwise文档重排任务中，Chain-of-Thought模型的排名表现始终不及直接打分模型，并且该差距难以通过常规训练方法消除。
AI.motivation: Chain-of-Thought（CoT）推理方法近来在多任务和推理型NLP任务中表现优秀，但在文档重排场景下始终逊色于直接打分模型。此前的诊断未能揭示该差距是否因训练偏差所致，因此有必要系统性检验不同训练与方法调整是否可以弥合该差距。
AI.method: 作者首先在不同规模（最高至320亿参数）的模型上实证验证两种方法表现的稳定差距。随后采用包括强化学习、细粒度监督及结构解耦等干预手段，对CoT模型的分类偏差、极化问题进行修正和压力测试，观察其对模型表现的提升作用。
AI.result: 尽管上述干预方法能够提升分类准确率及绝对分数表现，CoT模型与直接打分模型在排名上的差距依旧明显且难以消除。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明：在pointwise打分范式中，通过离散文本传递连续相关性语义限制了排名信号的分辨率，该机制构成了当前通用方法下难以逾越的性能瓶颈，而不仅仅是训练偏差所能修正的问题。

title: Input-Adaptive Gating of a Dehazing Front-End for On-Device Perception in Smoke-Obscured Environments
summary: Two-stage vision pipelines often place an enhancement network before a task network, on the assumption that a cleaner input produces a better output. We evaluate this in a firefighter assistance pipeline, where a dehazer precedes an edge detector that renders smoke-filled rooms as structural outlines. Both were designed for a Raspberry Pi 4, at 355K and 23K parameters, and quantized to UINT8 via TensorFlow Lite. The float dehazer reaches 18.60 dB peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) on held-out real smoke against 13.60 dB unprocessed and 17.08 dB for an AOD-Net trained on the same data, and the edge detector reaches an F-measure at optimal dataset scale (ODS) of 0.738, outperforming an optimized Canny's result of 0.692. Dehazing improves edge extraction under dense smoke but degrades it on clear and lightly hazed frames, where the dehazer discards more detail than the haze obscures. We therefore run the dehazer only when a dark channel haze estimate exceeds a threshold, a 10.1 ms test that lets the pipeline save 469.6 ms on the dehazing stage. Averaged over four haze levels, gating is more accurate than either fixed decision, at 0.675 mean ODS against 0.664 for always dehazing and 0.630 for never dehazing. It reduces the mean per-frame time on the Raspberry Pi from 569 ms to 321 ms, and on clear frames increases the frame rate fivefold, from 1.8 to 9 frames per second.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析了一种应用于火灾救援场景的两阶段视觉处理管线：先进行图像去雾，再用边缘检测。针对Raspberry Pi 4设计，并通过TensorFlow Lite进行量化优化。实验显示，仅在烟雾较重时采用去雾模块，并通过门控机制控制，既能提升边缘检测准确性，又能显著提升运行速度。
AI.motivation: 火场监控需要在复杂环境下提取结构信息，烟雾会严重影响图像质量和后续任务。作者希望通过前置去雾以提升关键任务（如边缘检测）的表现，同时兼顾嵌入式平台上的效率。
AI.method: 设计了一条包括去雾和边缘检测的视觉流水线，两子网均使用极轻量模型，并量化为UINT8。提出用暗通道估计判断是否需要去雾处理，超过阈值才启用去雾模块，实现门控加速。实验对比不同管线策略及其在烟雾不同浓度下的表现。
AI.result: 去雾模块在重烟雾条件下显著提升边缘检测的准确性（F-measure ODS最高达0.738），但在清晰或轻雾环境下反而降低表现。门控机制提升了整体检测准确度（平均ODS 0.675优于总是/从不去雾），并大幅减少处理时延，最大帧率提升至9fps。
AI.conclusion: 去雾对提升重烟环境下结构信息提取有效，但需动态决策以避免在无雾时不必要的信息损失。提出的门控机制兼顾准确率和效率，适用于资源受限的实际场景，如Raspberry Pi。

title: SemPOI-RL: Aligning LLM Semantic Reasoning for Interpretable Out-of-Town POI Sequential Generation
comment: 19 pages in total, including 9 pages of main text and 4 figures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic reasoning and open-ended generation abilities, but aligning these abilities with structured sequential generation remains challenging. This challenge is particularly evident in out-of-town (OOT) POI sequence generation, where a model must infer transferable travel intent from a user's hometown behaviors, adapt to cross-city interest drift, and generate a coherent destination trajectory under structural constraints. Existing approaches either rely on latent ID-based transfer with limited interpretability or directly use LLMs for sequence generation without explicitly grounding inferred semantics into position-aware predictions. To address this gap, we propose SemPOI-RL, a framework that aligns LLM semantic reasoning with structured sequence generation for interpretable OOT recommendation. Specifically, we first fine-tune an LLM to infer destination-oriented travel styles from users' hometown trajectories, using natural language as an interpretable semantic intermediate. We then introduce a Semantic POI Alignment Module (SPAM) to ground these inferred styles into a style-conditioned masked autoencoder for position-aware trajectory generation. Finally, we apply reinforcement learning with recommendation-oriented rewards to align LLM-generated styles with downstream sequence quality. Experiments on two real-world datasets show that SemPOI-RL consistently outperforms both traditional recommenders and direct LLM baselines, while providing interpretable style attribution across different phases of a trip. The code is available at https://github.com/Wind-Flipped/SemPOI-RL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将大语言模型（LLMs）的语义推理能力与结构化序列生成任务相结合的新方法，显著提升了跨城景点推荐（OOT POI推荐）的准确性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在OOT场景景点推荐任务中，要么只用ID转移缺乏可解释性，要么直接用LLMs生成序列却未结合位置相关性和结构，难以同时兼顾表达力与推荐结构的对齐。对于需要从家乡行为推断目标城市出行方式的推荐场景，这一矛盾尤为突出。
AI.method: 提出SemPOI-RL框架：1）微调LLM，根据用户家乡轨迹使用自然语言推理可解释的目的地出行风格；2）引入语义POI对齐模块，结合风格信息与位置感知，通过条件编码和掩码自编码器生成结构化轨迹；3）利用强化学习，根据推荐目标对LLM生成风格进行优化。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界的数据集上，SemPOI-RL在推荐效果方面超越了传统推荐方法与直接基于LLM的序列生成基线，同时能在旅途不同阶段赋予风格可解释性。
AI.conclusion: SemPOI-RL有效结合了大语言模型的语义推理能力与结构化推荐需求，实现了可解释的高性能跨城旅游推荐，为相关场景中的推荐系统设计和模型可解释性提供了新思路。

title: TAKE 85: Testing Audiovisual filmmaKer's intEnt across 85 Hours of Film
summary: Films communicate through deliberate creative choices, including lighting, color, composition, editing, dialogue, music, and sound. Humans naturally interpret these signals as directorial intent, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are evaluated almost exclusively on understanding what happens rather than why it is presented that way. We introduce TAKE 85, the first benchmark for directorial-intent understanding, comprising 398 short films (85 hours) with expert-verified question-answer pairs spanning global and fine-grained visual and audio intent. Through controlled modality ablations, TAKE 85 enables systematic evaluation of multimodal reasoning. Experiments on state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal a substantial gap between perceptual recognition and intentional understanding: while models accurately describe events and narratives, they consistently fail to infer the communicative role of filmmaking decisions. Our results establish directorial intent as a previously overlooked dimension of multimodal understanding: even the strongest model reaches only 58 out of 100, and our ablations show that no input modality is sufficient on its own. All code, Q&As, and models are publicly available from https://github.com/KaiShinozakiConefrey/Take-85

AI.tldr: 本论文提出TAKE 85，这是第一个用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）导演意图理解能力的基准数据集。实验发现当前模型能识别剧情，却难以理解导演创作意图。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型主要评估模型对影视内容“发生了什么”的识别能力，极少关注“为何这样呈现”——即导演意图。理解导演如何通过视听手法表达深层信息，是多模态理解的重要维度，因而需要专门的数据集与评测方式。
AI.method: 作者收集并标注了398部短片（总计85小时），由专家生成覆盖视觉与音频意图的问题与答案，构建了TAKE 85基准。通过有控制的模态消融试验，对多模态大语言模型是否能理解各类导演意图进行系统评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，主流MLLM虽然能准确描述画面与叙事，但几乎无法推断导演的创作意图。最强模型在意图理解上的得分仅为58/100，且单一输入模态均无法支撑高水平理解。
AI.conclusion: 本工作揭示导演意图理解是多模态认知中被忽略的重要问题。TAKE 85为该领域提供了新的挑战和评测平台，有助于推动多模态模型向更深层的信息推理发展。

title: Generative Models Enhanced by Sequence Labelling and Aspect-Code Switching Improve Cross-lingual Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
comment: Accepted for The 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Cross-lingual aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) transfers knowledge from a source language with annotated data to a target language, enabling fine-grained sentiment analysis without annotated target-language data. While monolingual ABSA has seen significant progress, cross-lingual ABSA remains underexplored, especially for complex tasks involving multiple sentiment elements like target-aspect-sentiment detection (TASD). In this paper, we propose a novel SeqLab framework that enhances cross-lingual ABSA using a sequence-to-sequence model with an auxiliary sequence-labelling task performed by the encoder, enhancing aspect term recognition and sentiment predictions. Additionally, we incorporate aspect-code switching (ACS), a translation-based technique that swaps aspect terms between source and translated sentences, generating additional training data to enhance the model's cross-lingual understanding. We evaluate our approach across eleven languages, three domains, and two backbone models, surpassing previous state-of-the-art results for the commonly studied E2E-ABSA task. Unlike most prior work that relies solely on English as the source language, we systematically assess different source-target language pairs and extend our evaluation to the more challenging, yet underexplored TASD task in cross-lingual settings. Finally, we provide a detailed error analysis highlighting key challenges and limitations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新颖的跨语言细粒度情感分析（ABSA）方法，结合编码器辅助序列标注任务和翻译驱动的数据增强技术，在多种语言、领域和任务上均取得领先效果。
AI.motivation: 跨语言ABSA能让只在源语言有标注的情况下，在目标语言实现细粒度情感分析，这对低资源语言尤为重要。但复杂任务（如TASD）研究较少，现有工作也大多只用英语做源语言，方法局限显著。
AI.method: 提出SeqLab框架：采用序列到序列模型，编码器端进行辅助序列标注任务（帮助识别aspect term，提升情感预测），另引入aspect-code switching（ACS）——通过替换源句和翻译句中的aspect term，生成更多跨语言训练样本。
AI.result: 在11种语言、3个领域、两种主流骨干模型上全面评估，新方法在主流E2E-ABSA任务上超过SOTA，并探索更具挑战的TASD跨语言任务，多源-目标语言对系统性评估。
AI.conclusion: SeqLab框架通过结合辅助任务和数据增强，有效提升了跨语言ABSA的性能，对低资源语言和复杂任务具有广泛应用前景，并通过误差分析指出未来改进方向。

title: The Nearest Target Is the Wrong One: Target Separation in Arc2Face Identity Unlearning
comment: 16 pages, accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Unlearning and Model Editing (U&ME)
summary: Unlearning an identity from a face-conditioned generator by redirecting its conditioning embedding can silently fail if the redirected output is still verified as the original person. We show that this failure depends on a controllable choice of how far the redirection target lies from the forget identity in recognition space, and that the most intuitive target, the nearest neighbour, is the one most likely to cause it. We audit Arc2Face with a locked ArcFace protocol and a projection adapter that redirects identity conditioning before generation. On a hard-neighbour stress test built from the hardest 0.5% of eligible identities, four target-selection policies show a monotonic response: clean forgetting rises from 9/30 groups under the nearest hard target to 30/30 under the least similar one. Mean forget-identity re-identification falls from 51.9 to 0.0 while mean retention stays flat. This reflects successful redirection rather than outputs becoming unverifiable: 710 of 720 least-sim-hard generations arrive at the chosen target, with no leakage to unrelated identities. Re-verifying identical images with an independent recogniser (AdaFace) preserves that trend, correlating at r=0.94, arguing against a verifier artefact. Target separation is thus a first-order, reportable design variable for identity unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了如何通过调整条件嵌入向量，使面部图像生成模型“忘记”某个特定身份，但发现简单地重定向到临近身份很容易失败，需增加目标身份间的分离度才能实现有效遗忘。
AI.motivation: 随着面部生成模型的发展，出于隐私或安全需求，常常需要让生成器“遗忘”某个人的身份信息。传统方法通过重定向身份嵌入向量尝试达成目标，但极有可能失败（即生成结果依然能被验证为原身份），需要更系统方法分析这一现象。
AI.method: 提出在Arc2Face模型中利用ArcFace协议和投影适配器，对身份条件进行重定向，并设计了多种目标选择策略。在难度最高的0.5%相邻身份上，通过分组实验，比较不同目标分离度对遗忘效果的影响。
AI.result: 结果显示，随着目标身份与原身份的分离度增加，“干净遗忘”的分组数由9/30提升到30/30，被遗忘身份再识别率由51.9降至0.0，而原有身份保留率几乎不变，验证了方法的有效性。关联检验也证实不是识别算法本身的伪影。
AI.conclusion: 身份重定向目标的选择极大影响遗忘效果，目标身份与遗忘身份应尽可能分离。目标分离度应成为身份遗忘研究和应用中的重要、可报告设计变量。

title: Learning to Reason and Use Tools through Unsupervised Fine-Tuning in Task-Oriented Dialog Systems
summary: Current dialogue systems struggle with dynamic information retrieval, often leading to hallucinations and lower response accuracy. We address this by adapting the ReAct framework for Task-Oriented Dialogue, enabling Large Language Models (LLMs) to access external knowledge and produce factual responses. Mainly, we propose an unsupervised fine-tuning pipeline that harvests reasoning trajectories via in-context learning inference. High-quality samples are filtered using an LLM-based judge to construct a robust training set. This is enhanced by a unsupervised self-improvement loop, where improved checkpoints generate increasingly better trajectories for subsequent fine-tuning iterations. Experiments on the SIMMC dataset demonstrate that ReAct-based systems outperform baselines due to superior reasoning and tool use. Notably, our fine-tuned 8B model surpasses a 70B in-context system. Finally, we present an error analysis, impact of scene complexity, and cross-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文针对对话系统在动态信息检索上的不足，提出将ReAct框架应用于任务型对话，通过无监督精调和自我提升方法提升大模型事实性和工具调用能力，实验效果显著超过当前基线。
AI.motivation: 现有对话系统在动态信息检索时容易产生虚假内容和准确率低，亟需结合外部知识以提升响应可靠性。
AI.method: 将ReAct推理框架引入任务型对话系统，设计无监督精调流程：1）用大模型推理收集推理轨迹，2）利用大模型评判筛选优质样本构建训练集，3）通过自我提升闭环迭代优化模型。
AI.result: 在SIMMC数据集上，所提基于ReAct的系统在推理能力和工具调用上均优于基线方法。精调后8B模型性能超过70B的in-context模型。
AI.conclusion: ReAct框架与无监督自我优化流程显著提升了对话系统动态检索和事实性表现，实现了跨领域泛化，并对系统错误、场景复杂度和泛化能力进行了深入分析。

title: A Hybrid State-Space Approach for Census-Tract Population Estimation
summary: Sequence models---the architecture family behind large language models and, increasingly, state-of-the-art image recognition---have redefined how machines learn from high-dimensional data. Yet population estimation from satellite imagery, a task that underpins infrastructure planning, public health, and disaster response, has scarcely benefited: leading systems still bind population to a uniform raster, disaggregating census counts onto grid cells through weighting surfaces built from ancillary data (e.g., in WorldPop and LandScan), which can introduce systematic spatial bias, and predicting population per grid cell with convolutional neural networks. In this approach, the administrative-unit structure in which the census was actually collected is discarded. We close this gap with MambaPop, which renders each administrative unit as a single polygon-masked satellite image and treats tract-level population estimation as a sequence-modeling problem over its image patches, pairing each tract image directly with its population label and eliminating the disaggregation step entirely. Built on the hybrid state-space--attention MambaVision backbone, MambaPop is, to our knowledge, the first method to learn population directly from an administrative unit's own image as well as the first to apply a state-space based (Mamba) hybrid architecture to the population estimation task. Across all $\sim$84{,}000 contiguous-US census tracts of the 2020 census, MambaPop attains a mean absolute error (MAE) of $1{,}141$ persons per tract, matching the strongest convolutional baseline (YOLOv11, MAE $1{,}122$).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为MambaPop的新方法，将序列模型引入卫星影像的人口估算任务，直接利用行政单元影像进行建模，消除传统栅格分解步骤，实现精度与主流CNN模型相当。
AI.motivation: 目前卫星影像人口估算主流方法依赖栅格分解和辅助数据，带来系统性空间偏差，且未充分利用行政单元结构。序列模型对高维数据建模能力已被验证，有望改进现有不足。
AI.method: 提出MambaPop，将每个行政单元作为多块影像patch的序列输入，配对真实人口标签，以序列建模方式端到端学习人口分布，省去栅格分解步骤。模型基于MambaVision（state-space与attention混合）的新型骨干网络。
AI.result: 在2020年美国八万余个census tract上测试，MambaPop的平均绝对误差为1,141人/区，与最强CNN基线（YOLOv11，1,122人）相当。
AI.conclusion: MambaPop首次实现在行政单元影像上直接序列化学习人口估算，简化流程、避免空间偏差，精度与现有最佳CNN方法持平，为领域贡献新方法与思路。

title: Ceiling-Clipped Acceptance Histograms Indicate Stranded Speed-up in Block-Diffusion Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up generation with an efficient draft model (drafter) that proposes tokens for a target model to verify in one pass, preserving the target's output distribution. High-acceptance block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash and DFlare fill an entire block in one parallel pass. In many cycles, the target accepts the whole block, so the drafter exhausts its trained block horizon before verification fails. We call this unrealized acceptance stranded speed-up. A mean committed length, per prompt or per cycle, hides it, whereas the acceptance histogram exposes it as a spike in the ceiling bin, the fraction of cycles that accept the entire block. We recommend the histogram as a preflight check before spending training compute. Naively widening the block at inference does not recover the speed-up, because once the block outgrows its training size, the drafter's bidirectional attention shifts its distribution even at early positions and erodes front-of-block verification. Instead, we post-train the drafter on a longer block with a short curriculum that emphasizes the newly exposed positions, a method we call DBloom. Expanding the pretrained DFlash and DFlare drafters from block size 16 to 24 across Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B targets raises the per-prompt committed length on the high-ceiling benchmarks by a median of +0.8 tokens (up to +1.1). Once continuation fine-tuning precedes expansion, the increase reaches 1.37 tokens. The same expansion also lifts committed length on all seven benchmarks for Gemma-4-12B-IT, a different model family, by a median of +0.41 tokens (Arm A), and the full continuation-then-expand pipeline (Arm B) adds +0.29 to +0.98 tokens over the same B16 drafter. In a prompt-matched comparison against JetSpec, a contemporary tree-based drafter not used in our design, DBloom commits more tokens on every benchmark at tree budgets up to 64 nodes.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 speculative decoding（投机解码）在大语言模型生成速度提升中的性能瓶颈，提出通过后训练方法（DBloom）扩展 drafter 的并行块大小，提高每步“提交长度”与实用加速效果。
AI.motivation: 高接受率的 block-diffusion drafter（如 DFlash, DFlare）在多数情况下能一次接受整块输出，但由于训练块长的限制，实际加速受限，有未被利用的性能提升空间（stranded speed-up）。常用的均值指标掩盖了这一点，需要新的分析和优化方式。
AI.method: 提出通过可视化验证的直方图分析 acceptance ceiling 暴露隐藏加速空间，并以简短的课程后训练（DBloom）扩展 drafter 的块长。在扩展时重点微调新暴露出来的区块位置，从而避免单纯拓宽块造成生成分布漂移及性能下降。实验在多个模型（Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B, Gemma-4-12B-IT）和基准任务上验证方法有效性。
AI.result: 扩展 DFlash 和 DFlare drafter 的块长（16到24），在高 ceiling 基准上推进每 prompt 提交长度中位数提升+0.8（最高+1.1）；增加预续写微调后最大提升1.37。在 Gemma-4-12B-IT 上有+0.41 token，中间完整流程提升+0.29至+0.98。对比 JetSpec，DBloom 在所有基准和树状设置下都能更高 token 提交。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出的方法有效利用原本闲置的受训区块范围，通过后训练策略能进一步提升 speculative decoding 的实际加速和效果，在主流 SOTA tree-based drafter 上同样具备优势。

title: Aligning Multi-Trajectory Supervision with Policy Optimization for VLA Driving
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) driving methods increasingly combine multi-trajectory imitation learning with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), making trajectory selection critical to final performance. However, some high-scoring trajectories that improve imitation can degrade subsequent GRPO by inducing advantage estimates misaligned with the current policy's feasible behavior distribution, driving updates away from safe and compliant behaviors. To address this, we propose a novel framework that aligns multi-trajectory supervision with policy optimization. To address the policy gradient bias induced by infeasible noisy trajectories outside the feasible region, augmented trajectories are constrained to a neighboring manifold of the ground-truth feasible region, and a Pareto-optimality criterion is adopted in place of the conventional aggregate score, retaining only non-dominated candidates and thereby filtering out conflicting samples at the source. To ensure that expanded trajectory supervision is effectively absorbed during policy optimization, we introduce two complementary mechanisms: feasibility-first advantage assignment and dynamic distillation. The former adapts Pareto credit to the feasibility composition of each rollout group and guides fully infeasible groups toward safe references. The latter updates teacher trajectories across refinement rounds to continually transfer useful supervision. Together, they progressively translate the benefits of expanded supervision into policy improvement. On NAVSIM v1 and v2, our method achieves 91.4 PDMS and 89.1 EPDMS, respectively, under single-trajectory inference, and recovers 440 of 658 initially failed scenes, 11.1\% higher than the original GRPO baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的视觉-语言-行为（VLA）驱动方法，旨在改善多轨迹模仿学习与组相对策略优化（GRPO）的协同，显著提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA方法在多轨迹监督和GRPO结合时，某些高分轨迹虽然提升模仿效果，却会误导优势估计，从而导致策略更新偏离安全、合规行为。本文提出针对性机制以避免此类问题。
AI.method: 1）将扩增轨迹限制在真实可行区域邻近流形上，避免不可行轨迹引入偏差；2）采用Pareto最优标准，保留非支配轨迹，源头过滤矛盾样本；3）引入可行性优先优势分配和动态蒸馏两种互补机制，分别调配奖励分配和持续优化教师轨迹，有效吸收扩展监督信息。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM v1和v2环境下，单轨迹推理分别取得91.4 PDMS和89.1 EPDMS成绩，并成功恢复440/658个最初失败场景，比原GRPO基线高11.1%。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能够高效对齐多轨迹监督与策略优化，实现显著性能提升和更好的安全性、合规性，优于传统GRPO方法。

title: Lies We Can See: Joint Verbal and Non-Verbal Deception by VLM Agents in Embodied Social Interactions
comment: Workshop on Agent Behavior (WAB) at COLM 2026. Project page: https://junseokim0103.github.io/Lies-We-Can-See/
summary: Strategic deception by LLM and VLM agents has emerged as a central AI alignment and safety concern. Social-deduction games (where each player holds a hidden role and communicates with others to deduce identities) serve as the canonical testbed, particularly in multi-agent settings. Existing testbeds, however, are text-only and run on a single fixed agent configuration, missing the non-verbal sensorimotor channels treated as core by deception taxonomies and leaving it ambiguous whether an observed behavior reflects the underlying model or the surrounding harness. We introduce MineAmongUs, a 3D multimodal Among Us sandbox where imposter agents must deceive crewmates through joint verbal and non-verbal action. We also propose ARIA, a configurable VLM-agent harness that exposes five cognitive-component ablation axes; and an atom- and arc-level annotation scheme grounded in deception taxonomies and operationalized at scale by an LLM-as-a-Judge reaching near-human atom-labeling agreement. Empirical results show that VLM agents pursue imposter wins through joint verbal and non-verbal deception, with non-verbal channels emerging as the more decisive winning contributors across both harness ablation and cross-VLM evaluation. Taken together, our work opens a new path for embodied VLM-agent alignment research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为MineAmongUs的3D多模态沙盒环境和ARIA VLM-agent测试工具，用于研究视觉语言模型（VLM）和大语言模型（LLM）在欺骗行为上的对齐和安全问题。实验证明，VLM代理通过联合的言语和非言语欺骗取得成功，非言语因素成为制胜关键。
AI.motivation: 现有AI欺骗研究多局限于文本环境，忽略了真实欺骗中关键的非言语感知与动作渠道，也难以区分行为源自模型本身还是测试工具。为真实、系统地测试和剖析多模态代理的欺骗能力，需要新的测试平台及注释体系。
AI.method: 作者开发了MineAmongUs，一个以《Among Us》为模板的3D多模态环境，允许代理通过言语和非言语交互进行社会推理和欺骗。提出ARIA VLM-agent harness，能在五个认知成分上做消融实验，配合基于欺骗分类学的注释方案，并用强大的LLM做裁判实现大规模标注。
AI.result: 实验显示，VLM代理在扮演卧底时能通过协同言语与非言语策略欺骗队友；多模态（尤其是非言语）渠道在胜利中作用显著。不同代理的消融实验及跨VLM对比也验证了这一结论。
AI.conclusion: MineAmongUs和ARIA为VLM/LLM社会推理与欺骗的安全对齐研究提供了强大新工具，深化了我们对多模态AI欺骗行为及其关键机制的理解。为未来具身多模态智能体的安全性和对齐路径开拓了新方向。

title: Efficient and High-Quality Depth Estimation via Pixel-Space Diffusion with Linear Attention
summary: This work presents $\textbf{Lapis}$, a $\textbf{l}$inear-$\textbf{a}$ttention-based $\textbf{pi}$xel-$\textbf{s}$pace generative framework that achieves efficient and high-fidelity depth estimation with one-step diffusion. While generative frameworks have significantly advanced monocular depth estimation with superior detail fidelity, the $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ complexity of standard attention and the multi-step denoising process introduce prohibitive computational costs when scaling them to high-resolution image applications. Although linear attention and one-step prediction are intuitively viable, directly applying them leads to poor structural consistency, detail loss, and noise. Lapis rectifies these limitations through a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. Specifically, a Patch-level Consistency Module restores structural coherence by integrating semantic and spatial priors. Subsequently, a Pixel-level Refinement Module recovers sharp geometric boundaries via skip-connection-based pixel correspondence. Furthermore, to mitigate sampling noise inherent in one-step diffusion, we leverage the manifold assumption and adopt a direct $\mathbf{x}$-prediction strategy to target the clean data manifold. Extensive evaluations on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Lapis consistently achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) accuracy and boundary sharpness across various resolutions, reducing inference latency by up to 7.6$\times$ at 1080P and 10.9$\times$ at 1440P resolution compared to previous SOTA generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Lapis的线性注意力生成式单步扩散深度估计框架，显著提升高分辨率下的效率与细节表现。
AI.motivation: 尽管生成模型在单目深度估计上取得很高细节表现，但其标准注意力机制（O(N^2)复杂度）和多步去噪过程导致高分辨率应用下计算量激增、效率极低。急需一种同时兼顾效率和高保真度的方案。
AI.method: Lapis采用线性注意力和单步扩散框架，主结构分为两部分：1）Patch-level Consistency Module，融合语义与空间先验，提升结构一致性；2）Pixel-level Refinement Module，通过跳跃连接，加强像素级边界锐利度。此外，采用manifold假设和直接x-prediction，有效降低单步扩散采样带来的噪声。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，Lapis在不同分辨率下的准确度与边界锐度均优于现有SOTA，且推理延迟大幅降低：在1080P分辨率下快7.6倍、1440P下快10.9倍。
AI.conclusion: Lapis实现了高效率与高保真细节的兼顾，为高分辨率单目深度估计提供了先进且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Graph Evidence Is Not Enough: Diagnosing Native Decoder Use in Graph-Augmented LLMs
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, ccepted at EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)
summary: Graph-augmented large language models often assume that graph evidence produced by external computation and placed in the input can be used by the native decoder. We test this assumption with HopQA, a deliberately bounded diagnostic that asks for the shortest-hop distance between two query nodes. Because the answer is a small integer and the target is purely topological, failure cannot be dismissed as open-ended generation or ambiguous evaluation. Yet existing graph-augmented baselines still fail on this setting, showing that providing graph evidence is not the same as making it usable. We introduce an intervention triangle with three matched conditions: readable graph evidence, shuffled graph evidence, and no-graph input. This separates evidence inclusion, structural readability, and decoder-usable topology. Guided by this diagnosis, we present S$^2$GE as an instance showing that diagnosis-driven interface design can improve native decoder usability. S$^2$GE uses query-aware sampling, endpoint and proximity-based ordering, and structure-preserving alignment. Across DBLP, Biomedical, GoodReads, and PubMed, S$^2$GE achieves strict exact-match scores of $36.5\%$, $57.8\%$, $76.6\%$, and $52.0\%$, improving over the strongest native-generation baseline by $53.5$ points on average. The interventions further reveal harmful-shuffle, shuffle-robust, and no-graph-saturated regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文针对图增强大模型（graph-augmented LLMs）能否真正利用输入中提供的图结构证据进行了系统诊断，发现当前方法大多无法有效利用这些证据，并设计了一种新的接口以提升解码器可用性，从而显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 许多图增强大模型假设，通过外部计算得到的图结构证据只需放入输入，大模型就可以利用这些信息进行推理。作者质疑并系统测试了这一假设，希望弄清当前方法为何常常无法发挥图结构的真正价值。
AI.method: 作者提出了HopQA诊断任务：仅要求模型输出最短路径跳数，抽去了语义与内容干扰，纯粹考查模型对输入图结构的利用能力。设计了三组干预条件（可读图、乱序图、无图输入），区分了证据包含、结构可读性以及解码器可用性。还据此提出新接口S²GE，采用查询感知采样、端点与距离排序、结构对齐等设计，提升原生解码器处理能力。
AI.result: 在DBLP、Biomedical、GoodReads和PubMed四类图数据集上，S²GE分别实现了36.5%、57.8%、76.6%、52.0%的准确率，平均比最强基线提升53.5个百分点。同时，干预实验揭示了现有方法存在的可用性瓶颈，并区分出混乱无益、稳健和饱和三大解码行为模式。
AI.conclusion: 简单提供图证据并不能让大模型真正理解和利用图结构。需要针对性设计更友好的接口，以提升结构信息对解码器的可用性。本文方法证明了诊断驱动的接口优化能极大改善原生大模型的图推理能力。

title: Repeatability Characterisation and Error Budget of a Consumer Structured-Light Scanner for 3-D Wound Geometry:A Rigid-Phantom Study
summary: We characterise the measurement error of a free- hand consumer structured-light scanner used to derive three- dimensional geometric wound descriptors. Rigid wound-care phantoms cannot change, so every difference between repeat scans of one site is measurement error; all repeats come from a single scanner unit, nine sites and 23 scans, so this charac- terises one instrument. The 95 percent repeatability limit for reconstructed surface area is a factor of 4.8, with a confidence interval from 3.0 to 7.0, so rescanning an unchanged site can shift the reading from a 79 percent decrease to a 377 percent increase. Forty-four of 45 descriptors fall below an intraclass correlation of 0.50, and none of 248 descriptor and pipeline combinations reaches 0.75. An error budget formed by holding the analy- sis region fixed, leaving sensor and reconstruction untouched, bounds the share of variance attributable to how much surface the operator captured at 75 percent for surface area, 91 percent for hull area and 95 percent for bounding-box diagonal; only hull volume is majority instrumental, at 48 percent, so a better sensor would buy little. No wound is delineated anywhere in the chain, so the comparison against the four-week area reduction used clinically to predict healing, a ratio near 2.1, is a lower bound on the noise an unsegmented pipeline must overcome, not a measurement of wound-area reproducibility. Standardising the analysis region cuts the limit to 2.13, meeting that ratio rather than clearing it. Statistical outlier removal imposes a measured systematic area deficit near 11 percent.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了消费级自由手持结构光三维扫描仪用于获取伤口三维几何描述时的测量误差。结果表明重复性差，绝大多数描述指标相关性低，影响主要来自操作者而非仪器本身。标准化分析区域可提升稳定性，但仍难以满足临床所需的精度。
AI.motivation: 三维扫描仪被用于评估伤口几何变化，用于伤口愈合监测。商业设备易用但其测量误差和可重复性尚不明晰，尤其对于临床使用的可靠性缺乏系统评估。研究动机是量化此类扫描仪对伤口面积和形状测量时的误差特性，及分析其误差来源。
AI.method: 通过对9个固定伤口模型（刚性phantom）进行23次重复扫描，统计不同三维几何描述指标的衡量重复性（主要用重建表面积和各类空间描述符的相关性），并对分析区域标准化、统计异常值剔除等操作的影响进行评估。
AI.result: 重建表面积的95%重复性区间可达4.8倍（区间3.0~7.0），意味着重复测量的误差极大。绝大多数描述符的组内相关系数（ICC）低于0.50，无一组合超过0.75。误差来源分析显示，操作者采集到的表面范围占主要影响，仅有体积参数受仪器误差主导。标准化分析可略提升重复性。异常值剔除带来系统性低估。
AI.conclusion: 消费级结构光三维扫描仪用于伤口监测时，测量误差主要受操作者影响，可重复性远低于临床实际需求，标准化操作虽可改善但仅勉强达到最低预测阈值。提高仪器精度对改善总体误差有限。

title: From Final Artifacts to Trajectories: Retrospective Process Supervision for Evidence-Grounded Long-Form Generation
summary: Trajectory data is getting more vital for training large language models for boosting the agentic abilities. Unlike the verifiable domains such as coding or mathematics, scaling trajectory data for open-ended tasks is much more difficult because these tasks lack singular ground truth and are costly to annotate or verify. In this paper, we propose RetroGen, a self-improving framework of retrospective process supervision. Our key observation is that although expert trajectories are scarce, high-quality final artifacts such as literature reviews, analyst reports and legal judgments, are abundant in pre-training data and can be viewed as compressed traces of the evidence-seeking processes that produced them. RetroGen reconstructs candidate latent trajectories from expert artifacts, verifies them against both the artifact and supporting evidence, and trains models on their own successful reconstruction data, without requiring trajectory data from stronger models. Experiments show that RetroGen improves grounding, faithful synthesis, and long-form evidence-seeking agent tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了RetroGen框架，通过复原和利用高质量成品背后的过程轨迹，提升大模型在复杂开放任务中的表现，无需依赖大量昂贵人工标注。
AI.motivation: 在开放任务中用于训练大模型的轨迹数据难以获取且贵，因为没有唯一“正确答案”，且标注/验证成本高。而优质的最终成果（如文献综述、分析报告等）却较为丰富。如何利用这些成品提升模型能力是一大挑战。
AI.method: 提出RetroGen框架：从预训练语料库中的高质量最终成品出发，自动重建其背后的潜在决策与证据搜集过程（轨迹），将轨迹与成品及相关证据核查，选用高质量的重建结果用于模型训练，实现“自我提升”的过程监督。方法强调无须依赖更强模型的人为生成轨迹。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，RetroGen能显著提升大模型在溯源、真实合成及需要长篇证据搜索的任务中的表现。
AI.conclusion: RetroGen为开放型复杂任务数据不足问题提供了创新解决思路，有效提升了模型的证据溯源与复杂推理能力，并降低了数据采集成本。

title: CedarCypress3D: an annotated UAV-LiDAR dataset of individual trees in planted cedar and cypress forests
summary: Individual tree measurements derived from Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) mounted on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) provide valuable information for forest inventory, ecosystem monitoring, and sustainable forest management. Recent advancements in machine learning have increased the demand for annotated datasets to develop and evaluate point cloud-based approaches, especially for individual tree segmentation. However, publicly available annotated UAV-LiDAR datasets in temperate forests are limited. In this article, we present CedarCypress3D, a manually annotated UAV-LiDAR dataset collected in Japanese cedar (Cryptomeria japonica) and Japanese cypress (Chamaecyparis obtusa) plantations in Japan. The dataset consists of UAV-LiDAR point clouds and field survey measurements from 34 circular plots across two sites with different topographic characteristics, along with terrestrial LiDAR point clouds available for a subset of 22 plots. A total of 1,627 trees were measured in the census field survey and manually annotated to match the corresponding trees in the UAV-LiDAR point clouds. For the subset of plots with terrestrial LiDAR data, semantic labels (i.e., stem and non-stem) were additionally assigned to tree points in the UAV-LiDAR data. CedarCypress3D provides high-quality annotated UAV-LiDAR data for developing and evaluating individual tree instance segmentation and semantic segmentation methods in temperate planted forests. The dataset can also support research on tree attribute prediction and multi-platform LiDAR analysis. The dataset is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22168721.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了一个高质量、人工标注的日本杉木与扁柏人工林的UAV-LiDAR数据集CedarCypress3D，为林业与生态监测提供支持。
AI.motivation: 随着基于点云的树木分割需求日增，尤其是在机器学习方法快速发展的背景下，对高质量、公开、人工标注的UAV-LiDAR数据集的需求日益迫切。然而，温带林分的相关数据集稀缺。
AI.method: 作者在日本两个具有不同地形特征的人工林中，基于UAV-LiDAR采集了34个样地的点云数据，并结合地面调查对1627棵树进行标注。部分样地还额外采集了地面激光点云，对UAV-LiDAR中的树木点赋予了‘树干/非树干’语义标签。
AI.result: 最终形成CedarCypress3D数据集：包含UAV-LiDAR点云、地面调查数据、部分地面激光点云，以及详细的人工标注信息，可支持个体树分割、语义分割、树属性预测以及多平台激光分析等多种研究。
AI.conclusion: CedarCypress3D填补了公开温带林UAV-LiDAR高质量标注数据集的空白，有助于推动林业点云分割与多源数据研究发展，数据已公开提供。

title: Enhancing Low-Resource Language Reasoning via High-Resource Language Feature Transfer
summary: Large language models exhibit substantial performance variation across languages, even when solving semantically equivalent tasks. Existing analyses often treat this phenomenon as an observational disparity caused by differences in pretraining data, tokenization, or benchmark coverage. We study a complementary hypothesis: high-resource languages (HRLs) may more reliably elicit latent computations useful for task-specific (i.e. mathematical) reasoning, while lower-resource languages (LRLs) may under-activate those computations despite expressing the same task. To test this hypothesis, we introduce a mechanistic intervention framework for identifying and transferring task-relevant sparse latent features across languages. Using sparse autoencoders over residual-stream activations, we isolate features enriched in successful HRL task-specific reasoning while filtering out source-language and generic-generation features. We then construct steering directions from these features and inject them during LRL inference. The resulting interventions test whether the selected features are functionally involved in the observed reasoning gap: suppressing them should impair source-language reasoning, while activating them should partially recover target-language reasoning beyond random and non-task controls. Our framework reframes some cross-lingual reasoning gaps as failures of mechanism elicitation rather than capability absence, and offers a causally testable route to feature-mediated transfer without translation, fine-tuning, or changing the user-facing language.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种通过识别和转移任务相关稀疏潜在特征，提升大语言模型在低资源语言数学推理任务中的性能的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在不同语言上的任务表现存在明显差异，普遍认为这与预训练数据、分词和评测覆盖有关。然而，作者提出另一假说：高资源语言能更好激活模型中对推理有用的潜在机制，而低资源语言则未能激活这些机制。
AI.method: 作者提出机制干预框架，利用稀疏自编码器对模型残差流激活进行建模，提取在高资源语言中显著关联于成功推理的特征，排除语言本身和通用生成特征。随后，构造‘操纵方向’，并在低资源语言推理时注入这些特征，以检验它们是否能缩小推理能力差距。
AI.result: 结果显示：抑制这些特征会削弱高资源语言的推理，激活这些特征则能在低资源语言中部分恢复推理能力，显著优于随机或无关特征。
AI.conclusion: 部分跨语言推理差距并非能力缺失，而是模型未能在低资源语言中激活正确机制。该方法可无需翻译、微调或改变用户语言，实现特征级知识迁移并具有因果可验证性。

title: AI-enabled Low-Cost 3D Maize Ear Morphometry Platform at Breeding Scale
summary: Maize ear geometry (length, width, curvature, and volume) is closely tied to yield and grain-filling outcomes, but existing high-throughput phenotyping pipelines remain constrained by the cost, labor, and specialized hardware they require. We developed and validated a low-cost pipeline that reconstructs a watertight 3-D mesh of a maize ear from a single 20-second video captured with a consumer-grade DSLR on a motorized turntable under uniform LED illumination. Camera poses from a multi-seed COLMAP procedure initialize a Neural Radiance Field (NeRF), and a cylindrical holder of known diameter, visible in every frame, provides automatic metric scaling with downstream geometric quality control. Applied to 300 ears spanning a diverse maize inbred panel, 250 (83.3%) passed automated processing and quality control. Skeleton length agreed with manual caliper measurements across all 250 ears (R^2 = 0.964, RMSE = 4.68 mm), and convex-hull volume agreed with water-displacement volume on a 15-ear subset spanning the full size range (R^2 = 0.982, RMSE = 5.26 mL). Residual length error grew with ear curvature, whereas bounding-box height, which records the same straight-line chord as calipers, showed no such trend; the discrepancy therefore originates in the measurement definition, since calipers record the chord while skeleton length traces the geodesic arc. The capture hardware costs approximately 607 USD, and operator involvement fell from roughly five minutes to one minute per ear, with all downstream processing running unattended. The platform provides a foundation for breeding-scale 3-D ear phenotyping.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种低成本、高效的玉米果穗三维表型测量管道，仅需一台普通单反相机和一个电动转台，通过拍摄视频和自动化软件分析来重建玉米果穗的三维网格，实现了高精度、高通量的表型数据采集。
AI.motivation: 传统高通量果穗表型测量系统存在成本高、操作复杂和对专用硬件依赖强等问题，难以大规模应用于育种领域，因此亟需一种低成本、自动化且易用的方法以提升玉米果穗性状的快速、准确测定能力。
AI.method: 利用消费级单反相机和电动转台拍摄20秒视频，借助COLMAP与NeRF重建果穗的三维密闭网格，并通过已知尺寸的圆柱体进行自动尺度校准，最后结合自动化质量控制筛选有效样本。
AI.result: 在测试的300个玉米果穗中，83.3%自动完成处理且通过质控。果穗骨架长度与人工游标卡尺测量高度相关（R^2=0.964，RMSE=4.68mm），凸包体积与排水法测定体积也高度一致（R^2=0.982，RMSE=5.26mL）。测量误差主要源于不同定义的长度测量方式（弦长vs.弧长）。
AI.conclusion: 该系统成本低（约607美元）、操作便捷（每穗仅需1分钟人工参与），自动化程度高，能够为大规模育种和3D表型测量提供可靠的基础技术。

title: More Capable, Less Faithful: A Multilingual Analysis of Mathematical (Un)Solvability Detection in LLMs
summary: Solvability detection is one of the most challenging aspects of mathematical reasoning for Large Language Models (LLMs). While prior work has studied this capability extensively, these analyses have been limited to English. Consequently, it remains unclear whether multilingual failures arise from differences in internal Solvability Belief or from language-dependent failures to express it. To address this gap, we introduce the first multilingual benchmark of paired solvable and unsolvable mathematical problems, extending ReliableMath to French and Greek. Using this, we train multilingual probes predicting Solvability Belief and analyze the solvability detection capabilities of state-of-the-art LLMs behaviorally, representationally, and in terms of faithfulness. We find that Solvability Belief is encoded as a largely universal, language-agnostic feature, and that higher-resource languages such as English, despite achieving stronger mathematical reasoning performance, exhibit lower solvability-detection faithfulness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个多语言成对可解和不可解数学问题的数据集，并用来分析大模型在不同语言下的可解性检测能力。
AI.motivation: 此前有关可解性检测的研究只针对英文，尚不清楚多语言下模型可解性信念及其表达方式的差异。
AI.method: 扩展ReliableMath数据集，收集法语和希腊语的成对数学题，并训练多语言探针分类可解性信念，从行为、表示和忠实度多角度评估主流LLM可解性检测能力。
AI.result: 实验发现，LLM内部对可解性的编码主要是语言无关的。但在如英语等高资源语言中，尽管推理能力更强，但模型检测可解性的忠实度反而较低。
AI.conclusion: 多语言情况下，可解性信念是通用且高度一致的特征，但高资源语言并不意味着可解性检测更准确。

title: ATGS: Anchored Temporal Gaussian Splatting for Long Volumetric Video Representation
summary: Volumetric video enables immersive free viewpoint rendering of dynamic real world scenes, yet existing methods struggle with long sequences and complex motions, often leading to temporal instability and visual artifacts. To address these challenges, we propose \ourname, a Gaussian splatting based framework for volumetric video reconstruction. Our key insight is that explicitly tracking long term complex motion with individual Gaussian primitives is inherently unstable. Instead, we organize Gaussians around time conditioned anchors that localize their spatial and temporal support, thereby reducing long range motion complexity. We further introduce a temporal windowing strategy to activate only anchors relevant to the queried time, which improves scalability and temporal coherence. In addition, to ensure spatial and temporal stability, we design a compact set of multi level anchor features that encode global features, local spatial features, and local temporal features, jointly constraining Gaussian generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \ourname \ consistently outperforms prior methods on long sequence volumetric videos with complex motions. Project page: https://github.com/WuJH2001/ATGS.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的基于高斯点渲染（Gaussian Splatting）的体积视频重建框架，能够更稳定和高效地处理长序列和复杂运动。
AI.motivation: 现有体积视频技术在处理长时间、复杂运动的动态场景时，容易出现时间不稳定性和可视化伪影。作者旨在提升体积视频在长视频和复杂运动场景下的稳定性和品质。
AI.method: 引入基于高斯点的框架，通过时间条件锚点做空间/时间归约，将高斯点组织在锚点附近以减少运动复杂度。同时采用时间窗口策略，动态激活与特定时间相关的锚点，提升可扩展性和时序连贯性。此外，设计了多层锚点特征（全局、局部空间和局部时间）共同指导高斯点生成，提高空间和时间的稳定性。
AI.result: 在具有复杂运动的长序列体积视频实验中，方法显著优于现有工作，并在多个实验中取得更好的稳定性和可视化效果。
AI.conclusion: 新提出的基于高斯锚点的体积视频重建方法，有效提升了长序列和复杂运动下的时空稳定性和渲染质量，优于现有主流方法。

title: Hi-Q: Hierarchical Evidence-guided Query Refinement for Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: A central bottleneck in multi-hop Question Answering (QA) is that the granularity at which a question is expressed often differs from the granularity at which corpus evidence is retrievable. Existing methods address this mismatch by imposing fixed graph structures over the corpus, by iteratively reformulating the query, or by executing a generated program over it, but these strategies do not explicitly decide when a query unit is already supported by evidence and when it should be refined. We formulate this bottleneck as retrievable granularity discovery and introduce Hi-Q, an evidence-conditioned framework for hierarchical query refinement. At each query node, a resolution operator tests whether retrieved evidence supports the current query unit; resolved nodes terminate, while unresolved nodes are expanded by a dependency-preserving binary operator and checked by a semantic coverage verifier. Hi-Q therefore grows a query tree whose topology is determined by corpus support signals rather than by a fixed decomposition template or a pre-built graph. We evaluate Hi-Q on three multi-hop QA benchmarks, primarily under full-corpus retrieval, where dependent evidence must be located among open-domain distractors rather than within a small annotated pool. In this setting Hi-Q reaches 52.3 EM and 64.0 F1 averaged over the three benchmarks, ahead of the iterative retrieval baseline IRCoT by 15.1 EM / 18.2 F1 on that same average, and ahead of the graph-based RAG baseline PropRAG by 11.5 EM / 12.0 F1 on MuSiQue-full, without corpus-wide graph construction. In the restricted supporting/distractor setting used by prior work, Hi-Q likewise attains the best accuracy, with 57.9 EM and 69.3 F1 on average, ahead of PropRAG by 5.6 EM / 3.9 F1 and IRCoT by 13.7 EM / 15.8 F1. The project page is available at https://hi-q-project.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Hi-Q，一种用于多跳问答任务的分层查询细化方法，通过证据驱动方式动态发现适宜的检索粒度，并在三个数据集上显著优于主流基线模型。
AI.motivation: 多跳问答面临一个核心问题：问题表达和证据检索粒度不一致。现有方法缺乏动态调整粒度能力，导致检索效果受限。
AI.method: Hi-Q框架以检索粒度发现为核心思想，对于每个查询单元，采用分辨算子检测当前单元是否已被证据支持，若未支持则使用二元扩展算符细化查询，并通过语义覆盖检验节点扩展的合理性，从而动态生成由证据支持结构驱动的查询树，无需固定的分解模板或预建图。
AI.result: 在三个多跳问答基准上，Hi-Q在全语料检索场景下（需要从大量开放域干扰项中查找依赖性证据）平均达到52.3 EM和64.0 F1，分别领先于迭代检索IRCoT基线15.1/18.2和基于图的PropRAG基线11.5/12.0（以MuSiQue-full为例）。在有限候选集环境下，Hi-Q同样取得最佳成绩，平均57.9 EM和69.3 F1，领先PropRAG 5.6/3.9，领先IRCoT 13.7/15.8。
AI.conclusion: Hi-Q通过证据驱动的分层查询细化显著提升了多跳问答检索与推理效果，展示了动态粒度调整方法相对传统固定模板和图结构方法的优势。

title: NoisEasier: Test-Time Noise Optimization for Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Diffusion models have recently advanced text-to-video (T2V) generation, yet they still struggle with fine-grained compositional alignment, such as attribute binding, spatial relations, and object interactions. While reward-based fine-tuning improves alignment, it is susceptible to reward hacking and adapts poorly to new prompt distributions. In this work, we propose NoisEasier, a test-time scaling framework that improves T2V generation through differentiable reward-guided noise optimization without modifying the underlying model. By combining efficient short-step generators with a multi-objective reward formulation, NoisEasier enables stable and practical test-time optimization under realistic inference budgets. Our key insight is that jointly optimizing the entire stochastic trajectory accelerates reward convergence and improves compositional alignment over optimizing only the initial latent, with negligible additional computational and time cost. Experiments on VBench and T2V-CompBench demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple backbones, achieving over 10% average gains on challenging dimensions such as attribute binding, object interaction, and numeracy. Overall, NoisEasier serves as both a flexible alternative and a complementary enhancement to reward-based fine-tuning, establishing test-time scaling as an effective paradigm for controllable text-to-video generation.

AI.tldr: NoisEasier通过在推理时用可微分奖励引导的噪声优化，不改动模型本身，显著提升了文本生成视频（T2V）在属性绑定、空间关系等细粒度合成能力。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在文本到视频生成中，对细节成分（如属性绑定、空间关系、物体间交互）对齐能力不足，奖励微调虽有提升但易被黑箱利用且泛化性弱。因此，需新方法提升合成对齐且适合实际推理。
AI.method: 提出NoisEasier，在测试时结合短步生成器和多目标奖励机制，无需修改模型，通过对整个随机轨迹做奖励引导的可微噪声优化，实现高效实用的推理时优化。
AI.result: 在VBench、T2V-CompBench等基准上，对多个主流模型骨干结构，NoisEasier在属性绑定、物体交互、数性等维度平均提升超过10%。
AI.conclusion: NoisEasier是一种灵活有效的推理时可控T2V生成新范式，可作为奖励微调的补充与替代，大幅提升合成对齐能力，适用于实际场景。

title: ImageEval 2026: Culturally Grounded Arabic Multimodal Evaluation
comment: Arabic LLMs, Multilingual, Multimodal, Shared Task
summary: We present an overview of the ImageEval 2026 shared task on culturally grounded Arabic multimodal evaluation. It includes two tasks: (i) AynVQA, covering spoken visual question answering and image-grounded hallucination detection in English and Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), and (ii) CRAI-Bench, evaluating the cultural accuracy of text-to-image generation. A total of 14 teams participated in the test phase, with 12 teams submitting system description papers. Participating systems used a range of approaches, including zero-shot prompting, fine-tuning of vision-language models, speech-recognition pipelines, ensembling, and score calibration. We describe the task setup, datasets, evaluation procedure, and participating systems, and summarize the main results across the different tracks. All datasets and evaluation scripts from the shared task are released to the research community. The shared task highlights the challenges of culturally grounded multimodal evaluation, particularly for Arabic speech and image-text reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文介绍了ImageEval 2026阿拉伯语多模态评测的概要，包括视觉问答、幻觉检测和文化相关的文本生成评测。涵盖了多语种、多个系统和多种技术路线，并公开了所有数据集和评测脚本。
AI.motivation: 随着多模态AI系统的广泛应用，来自不同文化和语言背景（如阿拉伯语）的问题逐渐突出，现有评测标准对文化和语言的适应性不够。因此，作者希望推动阿拉伯语及其文化语境下的多模态评测标准和研究。
AI.method: 该工作设立了两个评测任务：AynVQA（涵盖英语和阿拉伯语下的视觉问答与幻觉检测）和CRAI-Bench（关注文本生成的文化准确性）。参与团队采用包括零样本提示、视觉-语言模型微调、语音识别管道、模型集成和分数校准等多种方法，对数据集进行测试，综合评比系统表现。
AI.result: 14个团队参与测试，其中12个团队提交了系统描述论文。参赛系统实现了不同程度的多模态理解和文化对应性，在阿拉伯语语音与图像文本推理等方面得出了经验总结。
AI.conclusion: 作者总结了不同赛道的主要表现，同时强调阿拉伯语文化相关多模态评测的复杂性和挑战。全部评测数据与脚本已开源，推动该领域进一步研究与发展。

title: DICS: Exploring Data Intrinsic Consistency for Visual Instruction Selection
summary: Visual instruction tuning is crucial for advancing the vision-language alignment and instruction-following capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, identifying optimal subsets under a fixed ratio constraint from rapidly expanding datasets remains a significant bottleneck. While existing methods largely depend on distribution diversity or heuristic filtering, they often overlook the internal coherence within individual samples. To bridge this gap, we propose Data Intrinsic Consistency (DIC), a self-scoring metric designed to quantify the sample-level inter-component consistency. DIC consists of two modules: Visual Information Consistency (VIC), evaluating the alignment between visual content and instructions, and Response Information Consistency (RIC), assessing response coherence relative to the instruction. Building upon DIC, we introduce Data Intrinsic Consistency Selection (DICS), an adaptive data selection method that optimizes the trade-off between high intra-sample consistency and global distributional diversity under varying data budgets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DICS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across diverse dataset scales and model architectures, surpassing full-dataset fine-tuning while using only 25% of the LLaVA-1.5-665K data. We further curate DICS-6M, a 6M-sample multi-modal instruction corpus that enables the largest-scale visual instruction selection study to date; remarkably, DICS reaches 94.52\% of the official InternVL3-8B-Instruct performance using less than 25\% of its reported training data. Code can be seen at https://github.com/cqu-student/DICS

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为DIC（数据内在一致性）的自评分指标，用于衡量视觉-语言数据内部的一致性，并据此提出DICS自适应数据选择方法，大幅提升数据利用效率。
AI.motivation: 在视觉-语言模型的训练中，数据集迅速膨胀，如何在有限数据占比下选择最优子集成为瓶颈。现有方法侧重于整体分布多样性，忽略了单样本内部视觉、指令与响应三者之间的一致性。
AI.method: 提出DIC评分，引入视觉信息一致性（VIC）和响应信息一致性（RIC）两个模块，分别评价视觉内容与指令、响应与指令之间的一致性。基于此设计DICS数据选择方法，实现数据子集高内部一致性与全局多样性的兼顾，适应不同数据预算。
AI.result: DICS方法在不同数据规模和模型架构下均优于现有最优方法，在仅用25%数据情况下超过全量微调效果，并成功构建了600万样本级别的大型多模态指令数据集DICS-6M。在多项评测中使用极少数据达到大型模型训练效果的94.52%。
AI.conclusion: DICS显著提高了视觉-语言模型训练中数据利用效率，兼顾样本一致性与分布多样性，可用极少数据取得接近全量模型训练的性能，具有重要实际意义。

title: Agents in the Large: Perception-Centered Architecture for Persistent Agents
summary: Cognitive language agents have achieved substantial progress by equipping language models with memory, tools, and decision-making procedures, enabling agents to reason and act in interactive environments. Existing frameworks largely cast these agents as systems for solving user-specified, bounded tasks. An increasingly important goal is for language agents to provide persistent assistance in long-lived settings where user needs, context, and service procedures persist and change, and to remain useful across the broad range of tasks that arise over time. Yet we still lack a framework to characterize persistent AI agents, organize existing work, and guide future development. To this end, we propose a Perception-Centered Architecture for Persistent Agents (Pera). Pera describes a persistent agent organized around perception and control components that continually perceive service-relevant signals from episodic task executions, internal context, and changes in the surrounding environment, and use these signals to construct lifecycle tasks. These tasks drive the ongoing operation and adaptation of the agent's service procedures. We use Pera to retrospectively organize recent work, examine a detailed case study, and offer forward-looking insights for building more capable persistent agents. Just as software engineering moved from programming in the small to programming in the large, Pera frames the evolution of language agents as an analogous architectural transition toward long-lived, adaptive intelligence systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种以感知为核心的持久性智能体架构（Pera），旨在推动语言智能体从解决单一任务向长期、持续为用户提供服务的智能体转变。
AI.motivation: 当前的语言智能体在交互式环境中具备记忆、工具和决策能力，但大多集中于解决用户指定的、有限的任务。随着用户需求、环境和服务流程的持续变化，将智能体扩展为能够长期适应并持续提供服务成为重要目标，然而缺乏相应的理论框架。
AI.method: 提出了Pera架构，将智能体组织为以感知和控制为核心的系统，能持续感知任务执行、内部状态与环境变化，从而动态构建和调整生命周期任务，驱动服务方式的持续运行和自适应。
AI.result: 利用Pera架构对近年来相关工作进行了整理，深入案例分析，并提出了推动语言智能体向长期、适应性系统演进的指导思路。
AI.conclusion: Pera架构为持久性AI智能体提供了一套新的组织理念和发展方向，有助于系统地理解和引导后续更强大、能长期自主演化的语言智能体的设计与实现。

title: Towards a Joint Khmer Text Recognition and Word Segmentation
summary: Text recognition, or extracting electronic text from document images, has been indispensable for knowledge retrieval tasks, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). For Khmer, extracted text is subject to an extra word segmentation step, as Khmer does not use any visible word delimiters to denote word boundaries. Thus, a recognition-then-segmentation pipeline for Khmer requires two separate sequential models; this is not only error-prone but also adds significant latency for large-scale document processing. This paper proposes a novel joint Khmer text recognition and word segmentation framework in a unified model. The proposed model, using a connectionist-temporal-classification (CTC) decoder for fast, parallel decoding, can be instructed to recognize Khmer text with ($b=1$) and without ($b=0$) word segmentation. Experimental results on different benchmark datasets of different document modalities (document, scene, and handwritten images) show that the proposed model can not only recognize characters in document images but also locate word boundaries, removing the need for an extra word segmentation step in a conventional sequential pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种将柬埔寨语文本识别与分词联合进行的统一模型，有效减少了传统流水线中分步处理带来的错误和延迟。
AI.motivation: 柬埔寨语在文本识别后还需额外进行分词处理，因为其写作没有明显的词间分隔符。传统顺序流程需用两个模型，容易累积错误且效率低下，尤其是在大规模文档处理中更为突出。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种统一的模型，将文本识别与分词合并到一起，使用CTC（connectionist-temporal-classification）解码器，实现快速并行的文本识别及分词，可根据参数选择是否输出分词结果。
AI.result: 在多个不同类型的文档数据集（包括文档图片、场景图片和手写图片）上进行实验证明，该模型不仅可以准确识别柬埔寨语字符，还能有效定位词边界，整体性能优于传统两步流水线方案。
AI.conclusion: 联合识别-分词模型简化了柬埔寨语文档处理流程，降低系统错误率并提高效率，无需额外分词步骤，适用于大规模应用场景。

title: Two Centuries of Sexism in British Parliament: A Computational Analysis of Women's Representation in the Hansard Corpus
summary: The language a legislature uses to debate women's rights, even in favour of them, encodes systematic patterns of sexism that persist across two centuries. In this work, we analyse 6,531 speeches over 200 years of UK parliamentary debate (Hansard, 1803-2005) by using large language models to classify a speaker's perspective towards women's suffrage and political representation, as well as analyse sexist speech in parliament from the lens of the Ambivalent Sexism Inventory. We also release this parliamentary dataset, an organized and metadata-enriched version of the publicly available Hansard Corpus optimized for computational social science research, with 6.7 million speeches across 1.2 million debates, with 89% gender-matching for speeches by MPs from the House of Commons. We find that 54% of speeches opposing women's representation contain sexist content, compared to 21% of speeches that are for the cause, and that the two sides use fundamentally different types of sexism: anti-suffrage rhetoric combines hostile and benevolent framing, while pro-suffrage sexism is overwhelmingly benevolent. Female MPs support women's political rights at 93% compared to 70% for male MPs, a gap that closes only after enfranchisement. Our findings are evidence that benevolent and hostile sexism are used in different rhetorical contexts in a manner consistent with the theory of Ambivalent Sexism.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用大模型分析了英国议会历史上关于女性权利辩论的系统性性别歧视语言，并公开发布了丰富的议会辩论数据集。
AI.motivation: 尽管关于女性权利的辩论逐步进步，但隐藏或公开的性别歧视在议会话语中持续存在。理解性别歧视的语言模式对性别平等及政策发展十分关键。
AI.method: 作者收集整理了1803-2005年间6,531条英国议会关于女性选举权相关的发言，应用大型语言模型判别发言倾向，并以矛盾性别歧视量表分析其性别歧视内容。此外，作者还制作并公开了结构化和带元数据的Hansard语料库。
AI.result: 反对女性参政的发言有54%带有性别歧视，而支持者为21%。两派使用不同类型的性别歧视：反对方结合敌意和善意，支持方则多为善意。女性议员对女性权利的支持率（93%）远高于男议员（70%），直至妇女获得参政权后才趋于接近。
AI.conclusion: 议会讨论反映了敌意与善意性别歧视的不同语境运用，符合矛盾性别歧视理论，提示性别歧视的隐显多样性及其历史持续性。

title: Amortized Anchor Refinement for Deployable Continuous-Time 4D Gaussian Reconstruction
summary: Continuous-time 4D reconstruction remains impractical on standalone XR headsets. Per-scene optimization demands deployment-infeasible compute, and lower budgets cause collapse rather than degrade gradually. Feed-forward prediction is fast, but struggle to recover scene-specific detail. We present Amortized Anchor Refinement, which uses a frozen backbone to predict an initial Gaussian representation and a short optimization to specialize it under a fixed compute budget, with a capacity floor preserving representational density. A training-free stage then applies a persistent-homology constraint to prune unstable Gaussians while preserving topologically persistent structures, and streams the resulting trajectories directly as scene flow. On the Stage-Capture benchmark, Amortized Anchor Refinement achieves 24.31$\pm$2.22dB, while our deployment experiments demonstrate reconstruction within the target budget on a single consumer GPU and playback on a standalone XR headset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Amortized Anchor Refinement的新方法，用于在算力受限设备（如XR头显）上实现高效的连续4D重建，兼顾速度和场景细节。
AI.motivation: 现有方法either需要场景定制化优化，算力需求高，难以部署到独立XR头显，or采用前馈预测速度快但细节不佳，难以取得折中。需要一种既高效又能还原细节的方法。
AI.method: 1）采用冻结主干网络，快速预测高斯表示；2）在固定算力预算下做短时优化，提升场景特异性并保证表示密度；3）无训练的persistent-homology约束阶段，利用拓扑信息剪除不稳定、高斯点，同时保留持久结构，并直接生成场景流。
AI.result: 在Stage-Capture基准上，方法获得24.31±2.22dB的重建质量分数。实验表明，这一方法可在消费级GPU上实现目标内的重建预算，并可在独立XR头显上回放。
AI.conclusion: 本文方法兼顾实时性、能耗与重建质量，有效突破了以往4D重建方法在边缘设备上的瓶颈，为实际XR设备上的高效场景重建带来可行方案。

title: UTILMEM: Benchmarking Evidence Utilization in Long-Term Conversational Memory
summary: Long-term memory is increasingly important for conversational agents, yet existing benchmarks primarily measure memory through pointwise factual recall: whether a system can recover isolated facts or event-level details from prior interactions. Real-world memory use, however, often requires a more demanding capability: integrating distributed, implicit, and noisy evidence across extended interaction histories into coherent, task-oriented outputs. We call this capability memory utilization. Here, we introduce UtilMem, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 1,717 instances across five domains, designed to evaluate four underexplored aspects of memory utilization: reasoning over dense histories, identifying implicitly relevant memories, synthesizing distributed evidence into summaries, analyses, or plans, and resisting interference from semantically similar distractors. Evaluating a diverse set of retrieval-based and memory-augmented systems, we find that strong performance on conventional factual-memory benchmarks does not reliably translate into effective memory utilization. Moreover, retrieval alone is insufficient: even when relevant evidence is successfully recovered, systems frequently fail to integrate information across sessions or to distinguish useful evidence from plausible distractors. These findings expose a substantial gap between accessing stored information and using it effectively, and suggest that progress in long-term conversational memory will require architectures that explicitly support evidence integration and robustness to retrieval interference. Code is available at https://github.com/peijunallin/UtilMem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新基准UtilMem，用于检测对话系统长期记忆的有效利用，强调了真实应用中不只是简单事实回忆，而是更复杂的证据整合和抗干扰能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只关注对单点事实的回忆，无法衡量对话系统在真实世界中对分散、隐式、噪声信息的整合和利用能力。
AI.method: 作者设计了UtilMem基准，涵盖五个领域共1,717个例子，检验四种记忆利用能力：对密集历史推理、挖掘隐式相关记忆、整合分布式证据、抵抗相似干扰项影响。并评测了几类基于检索和记忆增强的对话系统。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，传统记忆基准的高分不能保证在复杂记忆利用上的好表现。仅仅检索到相关信息也不够，模型常常不能整合多轮信息或区分干扰。
AI.conclusion: 对话系统从“获取信息”到“有效利用信息”之间有巨大差距，光靠当前检索机制难以支持复杂记忆利用，未来需关注证据整合机制与抗干扰能力的架构创新。

title: Semantic-Spatial Discriminability Enhancement for Generalized Visual Grounding
summary: Generalized Visual Grounding (GVG) task aims to localize targets in an image based on referring expressions, extends the classical visual grounding paradigm by integrating multi-target and non-target scenarios. Previous methods typically rely on global semantic matching or coarse-grained region interactions for localization, where the discriminative cues are primarily derived from sentence-level semantics or regional context. In complex multi-target scenarios, such approaches tend to confuse visually similar targets, making it difficult to establish stable instance-level decision boundaries. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel Semantic-Spatial Discriminability Enhancement (SSDE) framework for generalized visual grounding, which aims to enhance the discriminative ability on fine-grained semantics and spatial localization, improving both cross-modal understanding and instance-level grounding. Specifically, to enhance the semantic discriminability of query representations at the fine-grained level, we propose a Semantic Discriminability Enhancement (SeDE) module, which leverages spatially guided cross-attention to disentangle fine-grained target-relevant visual attributes and integrates them with the textual subject semantics. Furthermore, to strengthen the spatial discriminability of the referred targets, we introduce a Spatial Discriminability Enhancement (SpDE) module, which models an instance center density map to characterize the spatial distribution of targets, and explicitly constructs instance separation structures in the spatial domain by employing them as an auxiliary supervision signal. Extensive experiments show that SSDE achieves superior performance on ten datasets across both classic and generalized visual grounding tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对广义视觉指代定位任务的新框架SSDE，显著提升了多目标和复杂场景下的定位准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉指代定位方法在多目标及无目标复杂场景中，易混淆视觉相似目标，难以精确区分个体实例，影响定位性能。本文致力于提升模型对细粒度语义及空间区分能力，解决现有方法难以稳定区分实例的问题。
AI.method: 提出了语义-空间可区分性增强（SSDE）框架，包括两个核心模块：1）SeDE模块，利用空间引导的跨模态注意力机制，实现细粒度视觉属性与文本语义的耦合，提升语义区分能力；2）SpDE模块，通过实例中心密度图刻画目标的空间分布，并借此构建空间区分结构，通过辅助监督信号强化目标的空间识别。
AI.result: 在十个数据集（涵盖经典与广义视觉指代任务）上的大量实验表明，SSDE框架在两类任务中均取得了优越性能，超越现有主流方法。
AI.conclusion: SSDE通过增强细粒度语义区分与空间定位能力，有效提升了多目标与复杂场景中的广义视觉指代定位效果，在视觉理解与实例级定位领域具有重要应用价值。

title: WebWorld: The Browser as a World Model for Self-Improving Web Code
summary: VLM-driven self-improvement of web code has a structural flaw: the model that proposes the repair is the model that judges it, and visual plausibility under that judge is a poor proxy for whether the page actually works. What the loop is missing is a counterparty the VLM cannot fool, and the browser already is that counterparty: a deterministic, executable simulator of how an HTML artifact behaves under user actions, and in everything but name a world model for web code. We present WebWorld, the interface that lets a VLM prior interact with this browser-as-world-model autonomously and decides which interactions become supervision. Each round, the VLM emits a critique that the planner compiles into a typed interaction contract; the browser re-executes the candidate and issues an acceptance certificate only when both target progress and preservation of every previously verified capability hold; certified transitions accumulate as a quality ratchet that is the only thing the SFT export ever sees. Under matched training, WebWorld-27B improves Raw-27B by 5.3 points on HTMLBench-400 and 14.9 points on MiniAppBench-Val, and reaches the level of strong frontier systems such as Kimi-K2.6 and GPT-5.4 on interactive HTML generation. Equal-size ablations show that browser-backed admission carries the gain: without the certificate, the matched 9B lift nearly disappears.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WebWorld，一种让视觉语言模型（VLM）与浏览器互动，从而实现Web代码自我改进的新方法，克服单靠模型自监督的结构性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 传统VLM对Web代码自我改进流程存在结构性缺陷：模型既生成代码修复，也自我评判，只重视觉可行性而忽视实际可用性，容易自欺。需要引入一个VLM无法欺骗的真正判官。
AI.method: 开发WebWorld接口，使VLM能自主与浏览器（Web代码的真实执行环境）交互。每轮迭代中，VLM先自我批判，规划器将其转为带类型的交互契约，浏览器执行候选代码，仅在性能和所有已验证能力得以保持时颁发验收证书。只有经认证的变更被记录并用于后续微调。
AI.result: 在HTMLBench-400和MiniAppBench-Val等基准上，WebWorld-27B比分别提升5.3和14.9分，达到Kimi-K2.6和GPT-5.4等强大系统水平。消融实验显示，去除浏览器验收机制，性能提升几乎消失。
AI.conclusion: 引入浏览器作为“真实世界”模型参与VLM驱动的Web代码自改，能大幅提升自动Web代码生成和优化的有效性，是突破模型自我监督局限的重要进展。

title: OPUS: A Simple yet Effective Unified Framework for Open-Vocabulary Detection
summary: Recent unified open-vocabulary detection (OVD) supports heterogeneous prompts, including text queries, visual exemplars, and their combinations, but often rely on increasingly complex designs such as heavy cross-modal fusion, staged training, and iterative annotation pipelines. We revisit whether such complexity is necessary in the era of stronger foundation models. Our finding is that unified OVD can be made substantially simpler with semantic-rich visual representations and scalable grounding supervision. We present OPUS (\textbf{O}pen-vocabulary, \textbf{P}rompt-\textbf{U}nified, \textbf{S}imple), a unified detector supporting text, interactive visual, generic visual, and mixed prompting within one framework. OPUS adopts a simple three-part design. Its model architecture combines a semantic-rich visual encoder, built on a DINOv3-ConvNeXt-B backbone with efficient hybrid encoding, with a prompt-aware decoder that avoids prompt-specific branches for unified prompt reasoning. OPUS is trained with a one-stage text-visual training strategy with Instance-level Contrastive Alignment (ICA), and is supported by a SAM3-based single-pass data engine for heterogeneous grounding supervision. Experiments on COCO, LVIS-minival, and ODinW35 show that OPUS achieves state-of-the-art Visual-I performance, reaching 68.1/69.2/54.7 AP, while maintaining balanced Text and Visual-G accuracy. OPUS also turns mixed prompting from interference into complementarity, improving over text or visual prompt alone. These results show that simplicity and strong unified prompting capability can be achieved together.

AI.tldr: OPUS提出了一种简单统一的开放词汇检测框架，支持多种提示方式，在多个数据集上取得了领先性能，并证明“简化设计”可以与强大的统一操作能力兼得。
AI.motivation: 当下的开放词汇检测方法支持多种异质提示（如文本、视觉示例及其组合），但常依赖于复杂的模型结构和训练流程。作者探索：在更强基础模型普及的今天，是否有必要保持如此高的复杂性？
AI.method: OPUS采用分为三部分的简单设计：（1）用DINOv3-ConvNeXt-B骨干获得语义丰富的视觉编码器；（2）用与提示无关的通用解码器统一不同类型的提示推理，无需分支；（3）采用一阶段的文本-视觉联合训练和基于SAM3的数据引擎，利用实例级对比对齐实现高效的异质监督。
AI.result: 在COCO、LVIS-minival和ODinW35数据集上，OPUS分别取得了68.1/69.2/54.7的AP，达到Visual-I任务的SOTA水平，同时保证了文本和视觉提示的平衡表现。混合提示甚至优于单一文本或视觉提示。
AI.conclusion: OPUS证明了，用基础强大的视觉编码和高效监督，可以在简化设计的同时，实现统一开放词汇检测在多种提示类型下的高性能。

title: Seeing the Unseen: Visual Similarity for Pixel Language Model Adaptation
summary: Pixel-based language models (LMs) replace traditional tokenizers by processing rendered images of text, making cross-lingual transfer heavily dependent on the visual and structural properties of writing systems. However, the dynamics of adapting these models to low-resource languages with complex morphology and written in unique scripts are not yet explored. Using Tibetan as a case study, we analyze how continued pre-training of pixel-based LMs is influenced by data scale, initial script exposure, and cross-lingual transfer from languages written in other Brahmic scripts. We introduce four rendering-level metrics to quantify visual script similarity. We evaluate downstream performance across three tasks. Our results show that higher orthographic proximity enhances semantic transfer, even under severe data constraints. Additionally, we find a performance asymmetry based on the pre-training starting point: while multilingual pre-training PIXEL-M4 has stronger initial performance, its capacity for subsequent adaptation seems to be constrained, whereas adapting a monolingual model PIXEL with mixed scripts yields more gains on sentence-level tasks. Our metrics and case study offer empirical observations that could help inform data selection and script adaptation choices when working with pixel-based models in similar low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: 本论文研究了基于像素的语言模型在低资源、复杂书写系统语言上的跨语种迁移与适应性，重点分析了数据规模、初始脚本曝光和视觉脚本相似性对模型学习效果的影响。以藏语为例，提出了评估脚本相似性的指标，并在多项任务中进行了实证测试。
AI.motivation: 当前基于像素的语言模型依赖于文本渲染图像，跨语种能力极大受限于文字的视觉和结构特性，但对于低资源、特殊书写体系（如藏文）适应和迁移机制尚不明晰。因而需探究影响其适应力的因素，并为相关场景下脚本选择和数据准备提供参考。
AI.method: 以藏语为对象，利用像素级语言模型，设计了对比实验，从数据规模、原始脚本接触（如是否见过藏文）、以及与其它婆罗米系文字的视觉相似性等角度分析模型迁移表现。提出了四种衡量视觉脚本相似性的指标，并在三个下游任务上进行评测。
AI.result: 实验表明，视觉上更接近的书写体系促进了模型的语义迁移能力，即使在数据极为有限的条件下也如此。多语种预训练的PIXEL-M4模型起点高，但后续适应空间有限，而混合脚本的单语模型在句子级任务上适应能力更强。
AI.conclusion: 文章提出的视觉相似性指标和藏文案例分析，为低资源环境下基于像素模型进行数据选择和脚本适配提供了具体经验和建议，对相关研究和应用具有一定的指导意义。

title: Centering before Pruning: Lightweight Geometry Correction for Diversity-Based Visual Token Pruning in LVLMs
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) incur substantial inference costs due to their long and highly redundant visual-token sequences. Diversity-based pruning mitigates this cost by selecting token subsets based on pairwise cosine similarity. We find, however, that similarities between raw visual tokens are strongly concentrated in the positive range, limiting their ability to distinguish non-redundant tokens. A natural way to improve this resolution is to center token features before computing cosine similarity. Centering indeed reveals a substantially richer pairwise structure, yet unexpectedly degrades pruning performance when used alone. We show that this apparent contradiction arises because the raw geometry does more than represent pairwise diversity: it also implicitly favors globally distinctive tokens, which tend to contain semantically informative content. Centering better resolves subset diversity but loses this useful token-wise preference, revealing that diversity and distinctiveness are entangled in the raw geometry. Based on this analysis, we propose the \textbf{Cen}tered Geometry \textbf{Prune}r (Cen-Prune), which measures subset diversity using centered cosine similarity while retaining raw-space distinctiveness as a complementary token-wise preference. This lightweight, plug-and-play correction leaves the underlying selection mechanism unchanged and incurs negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments across multiple image- and video-understanding benchmarks and LVLM architectures demonstrate that Cen-Prune provides robust improvements in overall performance across existing diversity-based pruners.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种改进大规模视觉语言模型（LVLMs）视觉token剪枝的新方法Cen-Prune，通过结合居中和非居中的特征，提升分词多样性剪枝效果，从而提高推理效率和最终性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLMs推理时需处理大量视觉token，造成高昂的计算消耗。多样性剪枝虽能降低冗余，但是传统余弦相似性计算分辨能力有限；直接对特征居中虽改善多样性，但损失了对语义性强token的偏好，导致性能下降。作者希望解决这一剪枝机制的本质矛盾。
AI.method: 系统分析了居中和非居中特征在token选择上的优劣，并提出Cen-Prune方法：用居中余弦计算来优化token多样性，同时保留原始空间中对全局性、语义性token的偏好。该方案为在任何多样性剪枝器上‘即插即用’的轻量级修正。
AI.result: 多组实验（涵盖多种图像与视频理解基准、不同LVLM架构和多种现有剪枝方法）表明，Cen-Prune能稳定提升整体性能，降低推理成本。
AI.conclusion: Cen-Prune方案可有效分离并结合多样性与区分性的特征偏好，显著优化基于多样性剪枝的推理效果，适用于提升多种LVLM剪枝法的表现，具有广泛应用价值。

title: Language Proficiency Assessment from Eye Movements in Naturalistic Passage Reading
summary: Standard language proficiency tests rely on linguistic tasks such as vocabulary, grammar and reading comprehension quizzes. An alternative, cognitively motivated approach, introduced in Berzak et al. (2018), proposed instead to predict language proficiency from behavioral traces of eye movements in reading. In this work, we validate and extend this approach from single sentences to more naturalistic reading of contextualized passages in English as a second language, new proficiency measures, prediction models, and reading in an information seeking regime. We find that the approach is effective in all these evaluations. We further address two key open questions on eye movement based proficiency testing: (1) potential scoring biases that reflect the proximity of the reader's native language to English, which may undermine validity, and (2) its reliability. We find that eye movement based proficiency scores are indeed biased towards L1s that are linguistically closer to English. We propose a score debiasing method which effectively remedies this issue. The reliability analyses suggest that eye movement proficiency scores are more reliable than standard language proficiency scores. Overall, our results strengthen and broaden the empirical foundations for future eye movement based language assessment technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文基于眼动追踪技术，通过分析受试者在英语阅读过程中的行为表现，预测其语言熟练度，并探讨了其有效性、偏差及可靠性。
AI.motivation: 传统的语言能力测试主要依赖于词汇、语法和阅读理解等语言任务，但这些方法未能捕捉到真实阅读过程中的认知行为。本文旨在验证利用眼动行为预测语言能力的可行性，并解决此法中潜在的母语偏差和可靠性问题。
AI.method: 研究将眼动追踪应用到更自然的连贯篇章阅读，并采用新的熟练度测量方法和预测模型。作者评估了该方法在多种阅读任务和应用场景下的有效性，并专门分析了母语与英语亲近度造成的评分偏差，同时提出了去偏差算法，比较了眼动法和标准方法的可靠性。
AI.result: 研究发现，基于眼动的语言能力预测在所有测试场景中均有效。分析显示得分会因被试母语与英语相近度不同而存在偏差，但提出的去偏差方法能有效解决该问题。此外，该评分方法的可靠性高于标准方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于眼动的语言能力评估方法不仅更可靠，还能通过技术手段减少语言亲缘关系带来的评分偏差，为未来该类语言测评技术的应用提供了更扎实的实证基础。

title: Motion-Saliency Complementary Masked Modeling for Point Cloud Video Understanding
summary: Point cloud video representation learning is crucial for 3D dynamic scene understanding. In this paper, we propose MoSaiC, a novel Motion-Saliency Complementary masked modeling framework for self-supervised point cloud video representation learning. MoSaiC couples three components: Curriculum Motion-Saliency Masking (CMSM), which guides the masking process toward motion-salient tokens under a curriculum schedule; Normal-Flow Motion (NFM) modeling, which supervises the local rigid rotation of each token in the Lie algebra so(3) as an explicit geometric motion target; and Cross-view Token Consistency Prediction (CTCP), which enforces consistency between two complementary masked views at the token level. Together, these components allow MoSaiC to effectively capture both appearance and motion dynamics. Extensive experiments on multiple downstream tasks, including action recognition, temporal action segmentation, and point-level semantic segmentation, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新颖的自监督点云视频表示学习框架MoSaiC，通过运动显著性掩码、显式运动建模以及跨视图一致性，有效提升了3D动态场景理解能力。
AI.motivation: 3D点云视频理解在许多任务（如动作识别、场景分析等）中至关重要，但缺乏高效的自监督表征学习方法，尤其难以同时结合外观与运动信息。
AI.method: 提出MoSaiC框架，包括：（1）课程式运动显著性掩码（CMSM），在掩码过程中优先关注运动显著的token；（2）法向-流运动建模（NFM），以Lie代数so(3)表述显式的几何旋转监督每个token的局部刚性运动；（3）跨视图token一致性预测（CTCP），强制不同掩码视图之间token级一致性。
AI.result: 在动作识别、时序动作切分和点级语义分割等多个下游任务上，通过大量实验验证了MoSaiC的有效性，表现优异。
AI.conclusion: MoSaiC框架能够充分融合点云的外观和运动动态，为自监督点云视频表示学习提供了更高效、鲁棒的新思路。

title: Reading the News: Adapting Large Language Models to Swedish Journalism Through Continued Pre-Training
summary: Large language models are increasingly capable in general, but their utility can remain modest in niche or understudied areas. One approach to address this limitation is to specialise existing models through additional training on target-domain corpora. In this work, we investigate such continued pre-training for adapting large language models to Swedish journalism, using a high-quality dataset that we curate from millions of news articles. To evaluate the adaptation efficacy, we also construct a novel domain-specific benchmark that covers six editorial tasks. Through full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning across two model sizes, we find that continued pre-training yields benefits in the target domain, but only when paired with experience replay to mitigate forgetting. We observe consistent enhancements in the models' generation quality and factual knowledge, but not their proficiency in discriminative tasks. Exploring a training-free method to facilitate instruction following, we see further improvements, but exclusively for models trained with low-rank adaptation. Crucially, we demonstrate the importance of targeted evaluation in the adaptation process, as an existing Swedish benchmark largely fails to capture the models' in-domain performance gains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了通过持续预训练提升大语言模型在瑞典新闻领域的能力，并创建了相应的高质量领域数据集和基准评测。结果显示，持续预训练结合经验回放可有效提升模型在生成和事实性任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在通用领域表现良好，但在特定小众或研究不足的领域（如瑞典新闻）效用有限，需要方法专门适应目标领域。
AI.method: 对大语言模型在收集自数百万新闻文章的高质量瑞典新闻语料上进行持续预训练，并进行全参数和高效参数微调，同时构建涵盖六个编采任务的领域基准，评估适应效果。还探索了无需训练的方法提升指令遵循能力。
