AI.result: 持续预训练提升了模型在目标领域的生成质量和事实性知识，尤其在结合经验回放以减缓遗忘现象时成效显著。但这种提升未明显改善模型在判别类任务上的能力。低秩自适应训练配合训练外方法进一步提升了部分能力。通用瑞典基准未能准确反映领域内的效能提升。
AI.conclusion: 持续领域自适应对提升模型在专业领域的能力有效，特别是配合防遗忘机制并采用针对性评测，更能体现提升效果。普通基准难以衡量小众领域的实际进步。

title: SELECT: SELEctive Context Transfer for Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation
summary: Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation (CISS) is fundamentally challenged by catastrophic forgetting and background shift, where learning new concepts degrades performance on previously seen classes. While existing methods attempt to balance stability (retaining old knowledge) and plasticity (learning new knowledge), they often fail to leverage prior knowledge effectively. These approaches typically rely on indiscriminate knowledge transfer or ambiguous initializations, which can dilute crucial semantic information. To overcome this limitation, we propose SELECT, a novel approach for Selective Context Transfer, which instead grounds each new class in a small set of semantically similar past classes. Its core is a Context Transfer Attention mechanism that aggregates the learned tokens from similar classes into a structured initialization for the new class. To ensure this transfer does not corrupt the borrowed representations, we add a controlled noise perturbation and a margin-based context-transfer loss that enforces separation between the new class token and its source tokens. Extensive experiments on Pascal VOC and ADE20K show that SELECT consistently outperforms prior work, achieving mIoU of 2.2% on VOC and 2.8% on ADE, providing an effective handle on the stability-plasticity dilemma. Code is available at https://github.com/avigupta2798/SELECT.

AI.tldr: 提出了SELECT方法，针对增量语义分割中的遗忘和背景漂移问题，通过有选择地从已学类别中迁移上下文表征，有效提升新类别学习并减缓旧类别遗忘，实验表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有增量语义分割方法难以兼顾模型对旧类别的记忆（稳定性）与新类别的学习（可塑性），且知识迁移通常无差别地进行，导致语义信息混淆与遗忘问题。
AI.method: 提出SELECT方法，对新类别采用语义相似的旧类别token，利用上下文迁移注意力机制进行结构化初始化，并引入受控噪声和基于间隔的损失，防止表征混淆和迁移污染。
AI.result: 在Pascal VOC和ADE20K两个数据集上，SELECT方法的平均交并比（mIoU）分别提升2.2%和2.8%，明显优于现有方法，实验验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: SELECT有效缓解了稳定性-可塑性矛盾，实现了对旧类知识和新类学习的平衡，在类增量语义分割任务上有实际应用前景。

title: TaxCE : A Framework for Automated Taxonomy Construction and Evaluation at Scale
summary: Organizing unstructured feedback text into hierarchical taxonomy is a fundamental challenge in NLP, particularly in domains where feedback arrives at massive scale in varied forms such as reviews, transcripts, and surveys. Existing approaches either produce shallow hierarchies, neglect long-tail topics, or lack rigorous evaluation frameworks. We present TaxCE, a fully automated framework that constructs multi-level hierarchical taxonomies from raw text through progressive condensation of corpus content into actionable segments, deduplicated semantic units, and granular topics with definitions, which are then organized bottom-up into a hierarchy with corpus-groundedness. We also introduce three corpus-grounded evaluation metrics, Exclusivity, Exhaustivity, and Granularity (EEG), and integrate them into a metrics-in-the-loop iterative refinement mechanism that diagnoses deficiencies and applies targeted corrections until convergence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TaxCE consistently outperforms existing baselines spanning classical topic models, neural methods, and LLM-based approaches, with average improvements of 11.8, 20.5, and 15.7 percentage points in exclusivity, exhaustivity, and granularity respectively over the strongest baseline. Human evaluation further confirms superior taxonomy quality, actionability, and navigability.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种全自动构建多层级层次结构分类体系的方法TaxCE，实现了对无结构反馈文本的高效结构化，显著提升了结构全面性、细致度和排他性。
AI.motivation: 在诸如评论、访谈记录、调查等反馈形式大量且多样化的领域，将海量无结构文本有效组织成层级分类是一项难题。现有方法存在分类层级浅、忽视长尾主题及评估体系不健全等问题。
AI.method: 提出TaxCE，自动将原始文本语料迭代凝聚为可操作语段、去重语义单元和细粒度主题，并自底向上构建带有定义的多层级主题分类体系，引入并闭环三项新的评估指标（独占性、穷尽性和细粒度），通过度量驱动的迭代机制不断优化结果。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TaxCE在独占性、穷尽性和细粒度三项指标上，平均分别比最强基线高11.8、20.5和15.7个百分点，人类评估也验证了其层次质量、可操作性和导航性更优。
AI.conclusion: TaxCE显著优于现有经典主题模型、神经方法和LLM方法，能更加系统、细致地对大规模无结构反馈文本进行层级组织，且其创新的评估和优化机制为后续相关研究提供了借鉴。

title: Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding requires answering questions at arbitrary times over a continuously growing visual stream. The central challenge is to compactly remember long-range history while effectively retrieving question-relevant evidence. We propose Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory (D-HSM), a training-free framework that represents distant history as structured textual memory while preserving the recent frames as visual tokens for fine-grained perception. Specifically, D-HSM turns selected historical video chunks into typed textual observations and stores them in an entity-centered hub-and-spoke memory, with entities as hubs and related evidence as spokes. When answering a question, D-HSM dynamically retrieves a compact question-aware memory subset, expands it through hub-and-spoke links, and combines it with the recent visual window for frozen-VLM answer prediction. Extensive experiments on both streaming and long video benchmarks show that D-HSM consistently and substantially improves VLM backbones and outperforms other state-of-the-art online and offline video understanding baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的无需训练的视频理解记忆框架D-HSM，将历史信息转为结构化文本记忆，近期信息保留为视觉token，并通过动态检索和扩展提升了长时序视频的问答表现。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需要对任意时间点的提问给出回答，核心挑战在于如何紧凑地保存长程历史信息并高效检索与问题相关的证据。传统方法在长时序历史的高效保留和检索方面存在瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory (D-HSM) 框架：将精选的历史视频片段转为结构化的文本观察，并以实体为中心存为hub-and-spoke记忆结构（实体为hub，相关证据为spoke）；近期画面以视觉token保留。提问时，框架会动态检索与问题相关、紧凑的记忆子集，并通过hub-and-spoke链接扩展，再结合最新视觉窗口送入VLM进行答案预测。该方法无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在流式和长视频多个基准任务上，D-HSM持续显著提升VLM骨干表现，且优于现有主流的在线和离线视频理解方法。
AI.conclusion: D-HSM为长时序视频理解任务提供了一种高效、结构化、训练无关的记忆机制，显著提升了相关问答的表现，具有实际应用价值。

title: Hidden Threat in Synthetic Data: Covert Targeted Bias Injection through Benign Text
summary: Synthetic data is increasingly used to train large language models (LLMs), yet its security implications remain poorly understood. Prior work on subliminal learning suggests that models can inherit behavioral traits from seemingly unrelated training data. In this work, we investigate whether such mechanisms can be exploited to inject targeted social biases into aligned models through semantically benign synthetic data. We construct a pipeline in which a misaligned teacher model generates filtered synthetic datasets across domains such as creative writing and code generation, which are then used to fine-tune aligned student models. Our experiments show that benign-looking synthetic data can act as a covert channel for transmitting targeted biases while largely preserving the student model's general task capabilities. These results reveal a previously underexplored security risk in synthetic data-driven LLM training pipelines and highlight the need for improved safeguards. As one possible step toward this goal, we suggest that log-linearity-based scoring may provide a useful signal for screening seemingly benign synthetic data.

AI.tldr: 本论文探讨了通过外表正常的合成数据向大型语言模型（LLM）注入目标性社会偏见的安全风险。
AI.motivation: 随着越来越多的合成数据用于训练LLM，其潜在安全风险尚未被充分认知，尤其是模型可能通过无关数据习得不良行为模式。作者关注恶意生成的合成数据是否能成为引入社会偏见的新载体。
AI.method: 作者设计了一个实验流程：首先让一个带有偏见的（未对齐）教师模型生成并筛选不同领域（如创意写作、代码生成）的合成数据，用这些表面上无害的数据对对齐好的学生模型进行微调。
AI.result: 实验证明，即使是看似无害的合成数据，也能秘密传递特定社会偏见，同时不会显著影响模型原有的通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了基于合成数据训练LLM的新型安全风险，指出检测和防止隐蔽偏见注入的必要性，并建议log-linearity-based scoring作为筛查合成数据的工具。

title: Learning to Restore More: Continual Capability Expansion for Pretrained Image Restoration Models
summary: Image restoration models are typically trained with a fixed set of capabilities. When new restoration requirements emerge, existing solutions usually train additional models or jointly retrain the original model with both new and historical data. Instead of designing another restoration backbone, we investigate how a trained restorer can continually acquire new capabilities without forgetting those learned previously. We propose RestoreMore, a continual capability-expansion framework that preserves the pretrained restoration model as a frozen capability anchor and learns residual expansion modules for newly arriving degradations. RestoreMore introduces a capability-oriented bi-level routing mechanism at multiple feature stages. The first routing level identifies restoration capabilities relevant to the current input, while the second selects and combines a sparse set of complementary degradation experts. This design enables newly introduced tasks to selectively reuse historical restoration knowledge and progressively enriches the expert bank available for subsequent restoration tasks. Extensive experiments on a wide range of restoration benchmarks demonstrate that RestoreMore consistently acquires new restoration abilities while preserving and improving previously learned capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为RestoreMore的新颖图像修复持续能力扩展方法，能在不遗忘原有能力的前提下，逐步学习新退化的修复方法，并有效复用历史知识。
AI.motivation: 将图像修复模型扩展到持续学习多种退化情景通常需要重新训练或联合训练，成本高且易导致遗忘。作者希望解决如何让预训练修复模型持续获得新能力，同时保留旧能力。
AI.method: 提出RestoreMore框架，将原有修复模型冻结为能力锚点，针对新退化问题仅学习残差扩展模块。引入两级路由机制：首先确定当前输入相关能力，其次从历史和新专家中择优组合，用以处理新的或组合型退化，并不断丰富可用专家库。
AI.result: 在众多图像修复基准测试上，RestoreMore能够持续掌握新能力，并且在不损失甚至提升原有修复能力的情况下，表现出强大的扩展性和复用性。
AI.conclusion: RestoreMore为图像修复提供了一种高效的持续学习解决方案，能在扩展新任务时有效避免遗忘和能力冲突。

title: REER-PT: Reverse-Engineered Reasoning for Perplexity-Guided Pre-training Data Augmentation
summary: As language-model compute continues to scale, high-quality training data is becoming an increasingly important bottleneck. Conventional next-token prediction supervises what follows a context but leaves the intermediate reasoning behind that continuation implicit. We introduce \textbf{REER-PT}, a scalable framework that extends Reverse-Engineered Reasoning (REER) to raw pre-training data. REER-PT identifies continuations that are difficult to predict but can still be inferred from the preceding context, and inserts concise reasoning annotations that reconstruct the missing connection between context and continuation. Candidate annotations are generated and refined offline, with perplexity serving as the optimization signal. Constraints on length and target leakage filter out unhelpful or trivial annotations. This sparse transformation preserves the source text and remains compatible with standard next-token prediction, avoiding online reasoning rollouts during pre-training. We apply REER-PT to transform a source pre-training corpus into an augmented one. Across augmented-data, original-token, and selected-continuation comparisons, perplexity reductions range from 0.42 to 7.29, and only about 0.05\% of annotation 13-grams appear verbatim in the source text. We then train two 680M-parameter models with the same architecture and training configuration on the source and augmented corpora, respectively. The augmented-data model gains up to 2.07 percentage points on several knowledge and reasoning benchmarks. Together, the perplexity analysis indicates improved continuation predictability, while the controlled pre-training experiments suggest that this augmentation can improve model performance without changing the standard pre-training objective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为REER-PT的训练数据增强框架，通过在原始预训练数据中自动插入简明推理注释，提升大语言模型的训练效果。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型的计算规模扩大，高质量训练数据成为主要瓶颈。传统的下一个词预测监督方式没能显式捕捉生成过程中的推理步骤。
AI.method: REER-PT框架自动识别难以预测但可以从上下文推理出来的文本衔接处，在这些地方插入简短的推理注释。注释的生成与优化在离线完成，采用困惑度(perplexity)作为优化信号，并通过长度和泄露约束过滤无效注释。该方法与标准的下一个词预测训练兼容，无需在线推理过程。
AI.result: 使用REER-PT增强预训练语料后，困惑度降低0.42~7.29，且插入的注释极少与原文重复。实验证明，增强数据训练出的模型在多个知识与推理基准任务上表现相比原始数据提升，可达2.07个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 向大模型训练语料添加精炼推理注释，能在不更改标准预训练目标的前提下，有效提升模型的推理与知识能力。

title: ScenePilot: Grow-and-Repair Policy for Text-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Generation
summary: Text-driven 3D indoor scene generation has advanced from dataset-bound layout modeling to open-vocabulary synthesis with large language and vision-language models. Yet existing methods remain limited: one-pass generators often yield geometrically invalid layouts, heavy post-hoc optimization is costly and unstable, and prompt-only planners lack reusable layout priors for functional grouping and object relations. We propose \textbf{ScenePilot}, a retrieval-augmented \textbf{Grow-and-Repair} framework that formulates scene generation as prior-guided incremental growth with learned rectification. Given a prompt, the Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Planning (HRAP) module retrieves room-, group-, and anchor-level layout priors to support functional group planning. A text-driven base generator then inserts object groups sequentially, while the Reinforcement Multimodal Repair (RMR) module performs lightweight local correction after each insertion and a final global repair after completion. To train this policy, we construct \textbf{SceneReverse-17k}, a repair-trajectory dataset built by perturbing high-quality 3D scenes in position, rotation, and scale, then using inverse operations as executable rectification targets. The policy predicts structured \emph{move--rotate--scale} actions from rendered views, scene state, retrieved priors, and edit history. By combining HRAP with RMR, ScenePilot offers an efficient alternative to one-shot generation and heavy full-scene optimization, improving physical plausibility, functional coherence, and controllability while preserving diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ScenePilot的框架，通过检索增强的逐步生成与修复，有效提升基于文本驱动的3D室内场景生成的物理可行性与功能合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于文本的3D室内场景生成方法存在以下问题：一次性生成容易产生几何无效的布局；后处理优化代价高且不稳定；纯文本提示规划器缺乏可复用的功能分组与物体关系先验。
AI.method: 作者提出ScenePilot框架，采用‘增量生成+轻量级修复’策略。首先，层次化检索增强规划（HRAP）模块按房间、组、锚点三级检索和利用布局先验，支持功能分组规划。然后，文本生成器按组逐步插入对象，每步后由强化多模态修复（RMR）模块进行局部微调，最终全局修复。为训练修复策略，作者构建了SceneReverse-17k数据集，通过扰动高质量场景并记录逆操作来模拟与标注修复轨迹，模型学习根据渲染图、场景状态、先验与编辑历史预测Move-Rotate-Scale动作。
AI.result: 实验表明，ScenePilot能够在提升多样性的同时，实现比一次性生成和全局重优化方法更高的物理合理性和功能一致性，并具有较好的控制性和效率。
AI.conclusion: ScenePilot为文本驱动3D室内场景生成提供了高效、可控且高质量的解决方案，有效规避了一次性生成和高代价后优化的不足，并通过先验与修复机制提升了生成场景的可用性与多样性。

title: GMTS: Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection Improves RLVR Training for LLM Reasoning
comment: Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL), particularly RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), has recently emerged as a central paradigm for enhancing large language models' (LLMs) reasoning abilities, demonstrating remarkable effectiveness across reasoning tasks. Recent studies suggest that high-entropy tokens play an exceptionally important role in model training, since training with only the highest 20% entropy tokens yields significant performance gains. However, why such high-entropy tokens are beneficial remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we find that although high-entropy tokens within one answer tend to correlate with large gradient magnitude, entropy alone fails to consistently reflect token importance across different answers, considering the variations in the answer-level reward signals. Based on this observation, we introduce the Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection (GMTS) method to quantify token importance, which leverages the entropy-gradient connection to approximate gradient-magnitude rankings for token selection. We find that training on the top 20% tokens ranked by GMTS consistently outperforms entropy-based token selection across three reasoning domains and various model sizes, suggesting that GMTS provides a more fine-grained estimate of token contribution for RLVR training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于梯度幅值的Token筛选方法（GMTS），用于提升强化学习下大模型推理能力，并验证其优于以熵为标准的筛选方法。
AI.motivation: 虽然此前工作发现高熵token对RLVR训练效果显著，但为何高熵token有效及其内在机制尚未充分揭示。当前单纯以熵选token并非在所有情况下都能体现token实际贡献，需要更精细的评估标准。
AI.method: 作者通过实证发现，高熵token与大梯度幅值相关，但单一熵无法在多答案情况下恒定有效。因此，提出GMTS方法，将token重要性与梯度幅值关联，利用熵-梯度的关系近似排序，选取Top 20% token参与训练。
AI.result: 在三个推理任务和不同模型规模上，采用GMTS方法训练，模型表现均优于纯熵排序选token，展现更优的泛化和推理能力。
AI.conclusion: GMTS能更准确地评估token对奖励信号的贡献，相较传统高熵筛选法，更适用于RLVR中的token选择，有助于提升大模型推理性能。

title: Knowing Beyond the Known: Reinforced Knowledge Specification for Multi-Label Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Existing class-incremental learning methods struggle in multi-label scenarios (MLCIL) due to the inherent contradiction of learning objectives arising from co-occurring and incomplete labels. We argue that the core obstacle is the model's ambiguous boundary between known and unknown knowledge, which undermines historical knowledge retention, complicates current task learning, and limits adaptability to future concepts. To address this, we propose KBK (Knowing Beyond the Known), a reinforced knowledge specification framework that explicitly models what is known or not to unify historical, current, and prospective learning. Specifically, to clarify known knowledge, we develop a hierarchical feature purification module that disentangles fine-grained class-specific features from global features, where high-level semantic abstraction is reinforced with low-level visual features. Additionally, an uncertainty-aware recall enhancement strategy suppresses unreliable predictions based on distribution priors, improving the quality of historical recall. For probing the unknown, KBK leverages semantic correlations to synthesize informative unknown features under co-occurring, preserving embedding space for future learning. Furthermore, to mitigate heterogeneous forgetting, we design a category-balanced gradient compensation loss that dynamically reweights gradient backpropagation according to forgetting speeds. Experiments on multiple benchmarks validate the effectiveness and robustness of KBK, which surpasses prior best methods by 2.7% in Avg. Acc on MS-COCO B0-C10 setting even without any replay buffers.

AI.tldr: 提出了KBK（Knowing Beyond the Known）框架，专门解决多标签类增量学习（MLCIL）中知识边界模糊带来的学习冲突与遗忘问题，显著提升了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 当前类增量学习方法难以适应多标签场景，主要由于标签共现和标签不完整，使得模型难以区分已知与未知知识，从而削弱历史知识保持能力和适应新知识的能力。
AI.method: 1) 引入分层特征净化模块，分离细粒度类特征与全局特征，通过高低层特征融合提升已知知识表征；2) 提出不确定性感知召回机制，根据分布先验抑制不可靠历史回忆。3) 利用语义相关性合成未知特征，为未来新类知识做好嵌入空间准备。4) 设计类别均衡梯度补偿损失，动态权衡回传梯度缓解异构遗忘。
AI.result: 在MS-COCO等多个基准数据集上，KBK在无重放缓冲条件下，Avg. Acc 提升2.7%，超过当前最优方法，验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: KBK框架在多标签类增量场景下显著解决了知识模糊与遗忘问题，对历史、当前及未来知识学习具备统一表征和优越性能，对应问题提供了具备泛化能力的新思路。

title: BiG-SURE - Bipartite Graph for Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation of LLMs
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is a crucial requirement for deploying large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) in safety-critical settings, especially when the model parameters are not accessible (black-box). We propose BiG-SURE, an uncertainty estimator based on cross-temperature semantic agreement. The method samples low-temperature responses as stable semantic anchors and high-temperature responses as probes under meaning-preserving input transformations. It then constructs an anchor-probe Bipartite Graph (BiG) using NLI-based entailment scores and defines confidence through the normalized squared spectral energy of this matrix, with uncertainty given by its complement. This bipartite graph-based Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation (SURE) score measures whether high-temperature probes remain semantically aligned with the model's stable low-temperature belief or not. We evaluate BiG-SURE on text QA, multilingual QA, and multimodal QA tasks across multiple model families. In these experiments, BiG-SURE improves average abstention AUROC over prior black-box uncertainty estimators, while remaining simple, unsupervised, and applicable to black-box model settings.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种名为BiG-SURE的黑盒大模型不确定性估算方法，通过对模型在不同温度下的响应进行语义对齐分析，实现对回答不确定性的高效可靠度量。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型和视觉-语言模型在安全关键领域的应用，需要对其不确定性进行可靠估计，尤其是在模型参数无法获取（黑盒）时，现有方法有限，因此亟需一种新颖且简便的方案。
AI.method: 作者提出了BiG-SURE算法，具体做法是：对同一输入，采样低温度响应（语义锚点）和高温度响应（探针），对高低温度下的输出使用NLI蕴含得分构建二部图，基于此图的归一化谱能量给出置信度，不确定性即其互补值。
AI.result: 在文本问答、多语种问答和多模态问答等多任务、多模型上评测，BiG-SURE在平均弃权AUROC指标上优于现有黑盒不确定性估算方法。
AI.conclusion: BiG-SURE方法简洁、无需监督、支持黑盒模型设置，在提升大模型输出可靠性评估方面具有应用前景。

title: CapFrame: Text-Instructed Viewpoint Grounding in 3D Gaussian Scenes via Geometric Pseudo Labels
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic real-time novel view synthesis, yet placing a virtual camera to capture a desired frame remains largely manual. Existing language-guided approaches in 3D scenes mainly focus on object-centric grounding, determining what to observe but rarely controlling how it should appear in a single frame, such as subject orientation or frame layout. To address this limitation, we introduce a new task, Text-Instructed Viewpoint Grounding (TIVG), which aims to identify a 6-DoF camera pose in a 3D Gaussian scene whose rendered frame aligns with a text instruction. To solve this task, we propose CapFrame, a partially differentiable framework that converts language into geometric pseudo labels for camera pose optimization. CapFrame follows a Retrieve-Translate-Refine pipeline: it retrieves relevant views and ranks them through a Question-Evaluation process with MLLMs, translates the instruction into orientation and layout pseudo labels, and refines the camera pose via differentiable optimization with layout and orientation losses in 3DGS. Experiments on 38 real-world scenes with 135 instructions indicate that CapFrame produces viewpoints better aligned with texts than heuristic viewpoint search and adapted trajectory generation baselines, validated by VLM metrics, MLLM judges, and user studies. Code is available at: https://github.com/jirongli/CapFrame

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新任务——文本引导视角定位（TIVG），实现用户通过文本指令在3D Gaussian Splatting场景中自动确定摄像机6自由度的位置，使渲染帧与指令相符。作者提出CapFrame框架以实现该任务，并且实验证明效果优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 虽然3DGS能生成真实且实时的新视图，但目前确定摄像头捕捉理想画面主要依赖人工操作。现有基于语言的三维场景方法聚焦于物体定位，但对视角具体如何表现物体（如方向、布局等）缺乏控制。作者希望通过文本明确、高效地控制虚拟摄像头的具体视角。
AI.method: 提出CapFrame框架，将文本指令转化为摄像机位姿伪标签。流程包括：1）检索相关视图并通过多模态大模型（MLLM）进行排序评价；2）把文本翻译为朝向和布局的伪标签；3）结合3DGS，利用可微分优化，在布局与朝向损失下细化摄像机位姿。
AI.result: 在38个真实场景和135组指令的数据集上，与启发式和路径生成等基线相比，CapFrame在与文本一致性方面表现更佳。这一点通过视觉语言模型（VLM）指标、多模态大模型评审和用户调研多方面验证。
AI.conclusion: CapFrame能够有效地将文本描述转化为摄像机位姿，提升3DGS场景下视角与文本的匹配度，在自动化和可控性方面优于现有方法，为语言驱动的三维场景交互提供了新思路。

title: What It Costs to Compose, Rebuild, and Correct Precomputed Memory
summary: Language models can answer from precomputed memory, a model's saved reading of a body of material, reused across requests instead of read again at each. This paper maps where that practice preserves correctness and the conditions under which it fails. Across experiments on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct using both saved key-value caches and trained compressions of them, precomputed memory degrades when assembled from separately prepared parts, stays current only through rebuilds costing a large fraction of full preparation in our measurements, and ignores corrections served beside it conditional on phrasing. If precomputed memories can be served alongside one another, be cost-efficiently rebuilt, and be superseded by new information arriving in real-time, they can serve as a way to avoid re-feeding context to a model over repeated queries. The implication of our results for a deployed system that deals with a variety of queries is that precomputed memories are best rebuilt on the cadence at which new information changes what the memory was originally computed from. Both warm-rebuilding trained compressions of key-value caches and serving specifically-phrased updates beside a memory, as pasted text or injected cache state, show particular promise for keeping precomputed memories current, the latter as an interim measure between rebuilds, and we measure the cost and name the remaining questions associated with each.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型利用预计算记忆（模型提前读取并保存相关信息，以便重复利用）时的正确性保持和失效条件，并在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型上进行了实验分析。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型推理成本上升，模型在每次请求时都重新读取长上下文极其低效。预先保存的“记忆”能否高效、可靠地复用，是提升模型应用效率的关键问题。
AI.method: 作者实验分析了两种预计算记忆：1）key-value 缓存直接保存，2）对缓存的训练压缩，并探讨独立组装、重建频率以及记忆补丁等策略对记忆准确性、有效性和成本的影响。
AI.result: 结果表明，单独准备后拼装的记忆效果会变差，记忆只有频繁重建才能保持最新，这一过程成本不可忽视；如果外部及时喂入补丁信息（如特定措辞的文本或缓存修改），能在一定程度上缓解记忆陈旧。
AI.conclusion: 论文建议，预计算记忆需按最新信息变动节奏重建，或通过补丁机制临时更新。目前训练压缩与补丁并用较为理想，但仍有成本及实现难点待解。

title: Where Identity Lives: Localized, Retain-Free Identity Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Removing a specific individual's information from multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is often needed after deployment, but existing methods rely on a retain set, which is hardest to obtain at that point, and rebuilding it recreates the privacy exposure that unlearning aims to remove. Forgetting from the forget set alone instead damages the shared visual-language computation, harming perception. We cast retain-free unlearning as a localization problem: causal tracing, weight transplant, and Fisher overlap all point to early-to-mid decoder MLPs as the layers where identity information is stored and, unlike other module families, can be modified without substantially disrupting vision. We turn this into Pathway-Aware Visual-attribute Anchoring (PAVA), which confines updates to these layers and pairs a forget loss with a visual-attribute anchor that preserves image-grounded behavior by distilling the model's own pre-unlearning answers from the forget images alone. On MLLMU-Bench and ReMem, PAVA gives the strongest forget-retain trade-off among forget-set-only methods and remains competitive with retain-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需保留集的多模态大模型遗忘方法PAVA，通过只基于遗忘集实现隐私信息安全删除，同时保持模型视觉能力。
AI.motivation: 部署后常需从多模态大模型（MLLM）中删除特定个人信息，现有遗忘方法依赖难以获得的保留集，同时重建保留集会重新产生隐私泄露风险。纯依赖遗忘集又易损伤模型的通用视觉-语言能力。
AI.method: 作者把无保留集遗忘建模为定位问题，通过因果追踪、权重移植和Fisher重叠等方法，发现身份信息主要存储在decoder中早至中期MLP层，并且只调整这些层不会破坏视觉能力。基于此，提出了PAVA方法，把权重更新限定在这些层，结合遗忘损失及视觉属性锚（即用模型遗忘前对同一图片的回答作为蒸馏准则），从而只用遗忘集实现可控遗忘。
AI.result: 在MLLMU-Bench和ReMem基准测试下，PAVA在所有基于遗忘集的方法中实现了最佳的遗忘-保留权衡，同时在与依赖保留集的方法对比时也表现出竞争力。
AI.conclusion: PAVA方法能够在无需保留集的情况下，安全、高效地从大模型中删除个人信息，并最大程度保留视觉及其它能力，提升实际部署可行性和隐私保护水平。

title: Seeing the Unseen: Camouflaged Object Detection Beyond the Visible Spectrum
summary: Recent advances in camouflaged object detection (COD) have led to substantial progress in challenging low-visibility scenarios, with pioneering studies demonstrating notable success in localizing objects in camouflaged scenes. Despite these achievements, existing approaches predominantly rely on conventional three-channel RGB imagery, thereby constraining the available visual information to a limited spectral range. Multispectral images offer a wide range of information about a scene by capturing fine-grained spectral signatures. Hence, by leveraging multispectral images for COD, we introduce a novel approach to detect camouflaged objects from the corresponding multispectral inputs. In particular, we propose an end-to-end framework, \textbf{\textit{MSFormer}}, that takes a multispectral camouflaged image as input and predicts a binary mask for it. Additionally, we also provide empirical justification for integrating multispectral bands for this complex low-vision task. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, which outperforms existing methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于多光谱图像的新型伪装物体检测方法MSFormer，显著提升了低可见性场景下的伪装物体检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的伪装物体检测方法主要依赖三通道RGB图像，导致对场景中的视觉信息捕获有限，难以充分应对低可见性复杂场景。多光谱图像能捕捉更丰富的光谱特征，有助于提升检测效果。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种端到端的多光谱伪装物体检测框架MSFormer。该框架以多光谱伪装图像为输入，输出对应的二值掩码，还在实验层面分析了不同多光谱波段信息对该任务的作用和益处。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，提出的方法在多个评估指标上均优于现有方法，验证了利用多光谱数据进行伪装物体检测的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 利用多光谱图像替代传统RGB图像能够显著提升伪装物体检测能力，提出的MSFormer为低可见性视觉任务提供了新的有效技术方案。

title: SwarmBench: Can Large Language Models Act as Agent Swarm Orchestrators?
summary: Large language model-based multi-agent systems are evolving from fixed interaction topologies toward dynamically orchestrated Agent Swarms. However, existing benchmarks are still largely based on single-agent or general-purpose agent tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate key orchestration capabilities. We propose SwarmBench, a benchmark that evaluates model performance from multiple perspectives, including accuracy, efficiency, cost, and process quality. Experimental results show that current models exhibit substantial differences in orchestration capability. These differences are reflected not only in final accuracy, efficiency, and cost, but also in the overall quality of the orchestration process itself. Based on these findings, we further propose SwarmExp, a simple yet effective method based on experience extraction and experience replay, which consistently improves the orchestration performance of large language models.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了用于评估大型语言模型多智能体系统编排能力的新基准SwarmBench，并提出经验提取与重放方法SwarmExp以提升模型编排表现。
AI.motivation: 当前多智能体系统越来越偏向动态编排的Agent Swarms，但现有基准主要针对单智能体或一般通用任务，缺乏针对复杂编排能力的评测工具。
AI.method: 提出SwarmBench基准，从准确性、效率、成本、过程质量等维度系统评估大模型多智能体的编排能力；此外提出SwarmExp，通过经验提取与重放的方法提升大模型的协作与编排水平。
AI.result: 实验证明，不同模型在编排能力上存在显著差异，这不仅体现在最终效果（准确性、效率、成本），也体现在过程质量上；SwarmExp方法能够持续提升大模型编排性能。
AI.conclusion: SwarmBench能更全面地评估多智能体编排能力，SwarmExp方法有效提高系统整体表现，对推动大模型群体智能发展具有重要意义。

title: MCSeg: Pre-training and Fine-tuning Volumetric Pyramid Transformer for Multi-modal Cardiac Image Segmentation
summary: Automatic cardiac image segmentation is pivotal for diagnosing and treating cardiac diseases. In this work, we introduce MCSeg, a volumetric transformer-based network tailored for multi-modal cardiac segmentation. To overcome the architectural mismatch inherent in existing hybrid networks, we propose a novel Scaling Feature Pyramid (SFP). Unlike conventional skip connections, the SFP effectively bridges the single-scale 3D Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder and the multi-scale CNN decoder by transforming the ViT's output into a hierarchical feature pyramid, ensuring that global contextual information is effectively leveraged. For the training paradigm, the ViT encoder first undergoes self-supervised pre-training via masked image modeling. Subsequently, the network is fine-tuned on downstream tasks, during which a regional mutual information (RMI) loss is integrated to improve boundary segmentation accuracy. In experiments, MCSeg consistently outperforms eleven SOTA methods on CT dataset ImageCHD, multi-modal dataset MM-WHS, MRI dataset HVSMR-2.0 and MSD Heart, highlighting the effectiveness of our MCSeg for multi-modal cardiac segmentation tasks. Furthermore, MCSeg's superior performance in few-shot experiment showcases its significant potential in adapting to limited data scenarios. Codes and pre-trained ViT-B weights are open-sourced at https://openi.pcl.ac.cn/OpenMedIA/MCSeg

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCSeg，一种基于体积Transformer的新型多模态心脏分割网络，通过创新结构（SFP）实现ViT与CNN的高效融合，并表现出优于当前主流方法的分割性能。
AI.motivation: 心脏图像分割对疾病诊断和治疗至关重要，但现有混合神经网络(ViT+CNN)架构存在结构不匹配的问题，难以充分融合全局与局部特征。
AI.method: 作者提出MCSeg网络，采用3D ViT编码器，利用自监督遮挡建模进行预训练，通过创新的Scaling Feature Pyramid(SFP)模块将单尺度ViT输出转为多层级特征，连接ViT编码器与CNN解码器；在下游任务中使用RMI loss提升边界分割精度。
AI.result: MCSeg在ImageCHD、MM-WHS、HVSMR-2.0、MSD Heart等CT/MRI数据集上稳定超越11种主流方法，在少样本分割实验中也表现突出。
AI.conclusion: MCSeg能够有效结合多模态与多尺度特征，准确进行心脏分割，并具备强大的泛化和小样本适应能力，对实际心脏疾病辅助诊断具有重要意义。

title: MURANO: Design, Run, and Reproduce Mechanistic Interpretability Experiments as Composable Pipelines
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations Track. 11 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables
summary: This paper presents Murano, an open source framework for designing, running, and reproducing mechanistic interpretability studies of large language models, intended for researchers across disciplines. These studies often combine loading, recording, attribution, intervention, and evaluation, while existing libraries tend to focus on different parts of this workflow. As a result, researchers using several libraries may need to adapt outputs from one for use by another. To bridge this gap, Murano represents operations from these five areas as composable steps. Steps exchange named result artifacts and declare the inputs they require and the outputs they produce. A pipeline executes its steps in the order supplied, and Murano uses canonical addresses when component identities pass between operations. Murano builds on existing interpretability and machine learning libraries. We demonstrate Murano through two reproductions of established interpretability studies and one illustrative sparse autoencoder case study.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Murano，一个用于大型语言模型研究的开源可解释性实验框架，解决了现有工具分散、难以整合的问题。Murano通过组合可重复的操作步骤，提升流程自动化与结果复现能力。
AI.motivation: 许多可解释性研究需要结合模型加载、数据记录、归因、干预及评估五个环节，但现有工具只覆盖部分流程，导致研究者需要手动整合多个库，效率低下、易错。
AI.method: Murano将上述五类操作抽象为可组合的步骤，每一步明确声明输入输出，数据流通过命名的中间产物连接，各步骤按顺序执行。提供统一接口，整合现有生态资源。
AI.result: Murano实现了端到端自动化与复现实验流程，并用两个已发表实验和一个稀疏自动编码器案例，演示了其能力和适应性。
AI.conclusion: Murano显著提升了语言模型可解释性研究的效率、标准化及可复现性，为跨学科研究提供了便利工具，并促进相关社区进一步发展。

title: PRISM: Predictive Recomposition via Semantic Latent Decomposition for View-invariant Video Representation Learning
summary: Cross-view video representation learning aims to capture viewpoint-invariant action semantics despite substantial appearance changes across egocentric and exocentric videos. However, existing methods encode each video as a unified embedding, where view-invariant and view-variant semantics inevitably entangle under co-occurrences - a failure mode we show persists even in cross-view methods explicitly trained for view-invariance. Our key insight is that a view-invariant feature is truly disentangled when it can be sufficiently recomposed with an arbitrary view-variant feature while preserving their independent semantics. Building on this, we propose PRISM, that decomposes video into view-invariant and view-variant latents and recompose them under language supervision encouraging clean decomposition of the two streams. PRISM achieves state-of-the-art results on EgoExo4D, EgoExoLearn, AE2, even surpassing in-domain models under zero-shot setting. Code is available at https://github.com/litcoderr/prism.

AI.tldr: 提出PRISM方法，通过分解视频表征为视角不变和视角相关两个潜在变量，并采用语言监督鼓励两者的独立性，实现更好的跨视角动作理解。
AI.motivation: 现有的跨视角视频表征学习方法，将每个视频编码为统一嵌入，导致视角不变与视角相关语义纠缠，即使显式优化视角不变性的问题依然存在。亟需找到能更好解耦两类特征的方法。
AI.method: 提出PRISM，将视频分解为视角不变和视角相关潜在表示，利用语言语义监督引导分解和重组过程，确保二者独立而可组合。通过强制两个流独立表征，实现更纯净的特征分解。
AI.result: 在EgoExo4D、EgoExoLearn、AE2等数据集上，PRISM取得了最新最优性能，甚至在零样本设定中超过了专门针对某一领域训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: PRISM实现了更干净的视角不变与相关语义分解，推动了跨视角视频理解任务，并在多个基准上取得领先。

title: OCR-MetaReasoning Benchmark: Evaluating the Meta-Reasoning Ability of MLLMs in Text-Rich Image Understanding
summary: Text-rich image understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to organize OCR (Optical Character Recognition)-grounded evidence across words, layout, fields, charts, and visual correspondences. Existing evaluations often conflate extraction with reasoning and rarely test whether models follow the required reasoning direction: applying visible rules, abstracting hidden regularities, or recovering missing premises. We introduce OCR-MetaReasoning, a controlled single-image benchmark that treats deduction, induction, and abduction as distinct directions and separates final-answer correctness from reasoning-process compliance. The benchmark contains 1,500 verified samples in a balanced \(3\times5\) taxonomy crossing three reasoning types with five OCR-object categories, along with reference reasoning steps, automatic answer scoring, the Meta-Reasoning Macro Score (MRMS), and the Reasoning Process Compliance Score (RPCS). Experiments with representative closed-source and open-source MLLMs show that OCR-grounded meta-reasoning remains far from saturated: models struggle with visible-rule application and layout-sensitive inference, while process-compliant rationales can accompany incorrect final answers under exact-match evaluation. The code is available at https://github.com/gengxuli/OCR-MetaReasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个新的OCR-元推理基准，用于系统评估多模态大模型对文本丰富图片的推理能力，涵盖三种推理方式和多类型视觉对象，并提出了过程合规性的新评价指标。实验表明，现有模型还远未解决OCR条件下的复杂推理任务。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大模型（MLLMs）在解析文本丰富图片时，经常混淆信息抽取与逻辑推理，并且缺乏细致区分推理方法的基准。现有评测无法有效区分模型是怎样以及是否按照题设思路进行推理，限制了模型真实推理能力的分析。
AI.method: 提出OCR-MetaReasoning数据集，该基准涵盖1500个人工验证样本，按照推理方式（演绎、归纳、溯因）与OCR对象类型构成平衡的3×5分类体系。每个样本都配有推理过程参考、自动评分机制，以及MRMS和RPCS等新评分指标，便于对模型最终答案及推理过程进行细分分析。
AI.result: 用多个主流开源/闭源MLLMs测试，结果显示模型在可见规则运用与版面相关推理上表现较差，推理过程合理性与最终答案的正确性不总是一致。这说明模型目前在OCR相关元推理能力上还有较大提升空间。
AI.conclusion: OCR-MetaReasoning基准有效分离了各类推理能力，对多模态模型推理过程与准确性的系统性评估具有价值。实验发现模型对复杂OCR推理场景仍有短板，为未来模型改进和专用评测工具开发提供了参考。

title: Real-Time Scene-Adaptive Tone Mapping for High-Dynamic Range Object Detection
summary: High-dynamic-range (HDR) images, with their rich tone and detail reproduction, hold significant potential to enhance computer vision systems, particularly in autonomous driving. However, most neural networks for embedded systems are trained on low-dynamic-range (LDR) inputs and suffer substantial performance degradation when handling high-bit-depth HDR images due to the challenges posed by extreme dynamic ranges. In this paper, we propose a novel tone mapping method that not only bridges the gap between HDR RAW inputs and the LDR sRGB requirements of detection networks but also achieves end-to-end optimization with downstream tasks. Instead of relying on the traditional image signal processing (ISP) pipeline, we introduce neural photometric calibration to regularize dynamic ranges and a scaling-invariant local tone mapping model to preserve image details. In addition, our architecture also supports performance transfer finetuning, enabling efficient adaptation from the LDR sRGB images to the HDR RAW images with minimal cost. The proposed method outperforms traditional tone mapping algorithms and advanced AI-ISP methods in challenging automotive HDR scenes. Moreover, our pipeline achieves real-time processing of 4K high-bit-depth HDR inputs on NVIDIA Jetson platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的HDR图像色调映射方法，能够高效地将HDR RAW输入转换为适用于目标检测网络的LDR sRGB图像，并可端到端优化下游任务表现。方法超越了传统和现有AI-ISP方案，支持在嵌入式设备上实时处理高分辨率HDR影像。
AI.motivation: 现有多数嵌入式视觉神经网络主要针对低动态范围（LDR）图像训练，处理高位深HDR图像时，性能骤降，极大制约了HDR技术在自动驾驶等领域的应用。主要难点在于极端动态范围对感知任务的挑战及传统ISP流程的不适用性。
AI.method: 作者提出一种无需传统ISP流程的端到端色调映射方案，包括神经光度校准模块以规范化动态范围，以及尺度不变的局部色调映射模型来保留细节。此外，架构支持从LDR到HDR的性能迁移微调，便于高效适配不同输入类型。
AI.result: 实验证明，新方法在复杂汽车HDR场景下，相较于传统色调映射算法和先进AI-ISP方法取得更好性能，在NVIDIA Jetson平台上实现了4K高位深HDR输入的实时处理。
AI.conclusion: 方法有效解决了HDR图像在视觉系统中的动态范围适配和细节保留难题，显著提升了自动驾驶等场景下的感知能力，为HDR技术在嵌入式设备中的部署提供了高效可行的新路径。

title: LCoT-GV: Graph Attention Networks for Verifying Long Reasoning Chains in Large Language Models
comment: 6 pages without references, 2 tables, 1 algorithm, 1 figure
summary: Large Reasoning Models produce Long Chains-of-Thought (LCoTs) which involve breaking down the problem into smaller reasoning steps before reaching the conclusion. However, these steps often contain contradictions, unsupported inferences, or irrelevant steps, even when the final answer is correct. We propose Long Chain-of-Thought Graph Verifier (LCoT-GV), a graph-based framework that represents LCoTs as reasoning graphs. Each node in the graph represents a reasoning step and the edges encode semantic and logical relations. A Graph Attention Network is then trained to predict chain-of-thought correctness from the reasoning graph. We construct a new graph-oriented verification dataset from multiple reasoning benchmarks for question answering in various domains. The results show that our method is competitive with the most similar approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种图结构化验证长链思维推理过程的方法，能更好判断推理链的正确性。
AI.motivation: 尽管大规模推理模型（如大型语言模型）能够生成详细的思维链（LCoTs），但这些推理链常常包含自相矛盾、不支持的推断或无关步骤，即使最终答案是正确的。这会影响系统的鲁棒性和可解释性，因此需要更有效的方法自动验证推理链的质量。
AI.method: 本文提出了LCoT-GV（Long Chain-of-Thought Graph Verifier）方法。具体做法是将思维链转化为推理图，每个节点表示一个推理步骤，边则编码语义和逻辑联系。然后基于这些推理图，训练一个图注意力网络（GAT）来预测整个思维链的正确性。此外，作者还基于多个跨领域QA推理基准，构建了一个新的基于图的验证数据集。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，LCoT-GV在多个基准数据集上的性能与最新相关方法持平，具备较强的竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将长链思维推理过程结构化表示，并结合图神经网络进行验证，是提升推理链质量判断能力的一种有效手段，有助于提高推理系统的可靠性和可解释性。

title: ImageCAS-X: a dataset and benchmark for coronary artery segmentation and centerline extraction in coronary CT angiography
summary: Accurate segmentation of the coronary vessel lumen is a prerequisite for quantitative assessment of atherosclerotic plaque and perivascular adipose tissue in coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA). Cardiologists rely on semi-automated methods for this task because manual vessel tracing and segmentation are labour-intensive. Although many automated methods have been proposed, their validation remains limited by the lack of large, high-quality publicly available datasets. We provide a new dataset of voxel-wise annotations of the vessel lumen and coronary segments, alongside centerlines, and mesh surfaces for 800 scans from the publicly available ImageCAS dataset. Using this dataset, we benchmark established lumen segmentation methods against inter-observer variability, stratifying performance by disease, image quality, coronary dominance, coronary segment, vessel diameter, and lumen attenuation. These labels allow segmentation accuracy to be described in anatomical and clinical context rather than reported as a single aggregate score. The dataset supports the development and validation of methods for lumen segmentation, plaque and perivascular quantification, and haemodynamic modelling.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个大规模、精细标注的冠状动脉CT血管腔新数据集，并用其系统评测了主流分割方法的表现。
AI.motivation: 冠状动脉腔分割对CT斑块和周围脂肪组织的量化分析至关重要，目前自动分割方法的验证受到高质量公开数据集缺乏的限制。
AI.method: 作者基于ImageCAS公开数据集，对800例CT扫描进行了血管腔和相关解剖结构的体素级标注，并提供中心线与网格表面。以此为基础，对比了主流分割方法，并按照疾病类型、图像质量、冠状动脉主导型、血管段、直径、腔道衰减等分层分析性能。
AI.result: 得到的高质量多标签数据集可用来开发和验证冠状动脉腔自动分割方法。评测发现，不同临床与解剖因素下分割方法表现各异，数据集允许更精准的性能评价。
AI.conclusion: 该公开数据集为临床相关的腔道分割、斑块和血流动力学建模等方法的研究与验证提供了重要基础，有望推动领域发展。

title: WildSEEK: Evaluating Language Models for Information-Seeking
summary: Language models are increasingly mediating information access to end users, urging a systematic evaluation of their responses for a fair and reliable information ecosystem. Existing evaluations, however, are often topic-specific or synthetic, limiting their ability to capture the complexity of "in the wild" information-seeking queries and the risks present in model responses. To address this gap, we introduce WildSEEK, a manually annotated dataset of 3k information-seeking queries from real user interactions, and an evaluation framework for LLM-generated responses. WildSEEK includes annotations for risk-sensitive domains (e.g. health and financial information), and distinguishes factoid queries from analytical queries which seek responses beyond facts. We train classifiers on WildSEEK to analyze more than 1.8M realistic user queries. We find that over a third of information-seeking queries are high-risk and more often analytical. Our findings show that LLM responses fail more often in four criteria: sycophantic behavior, overreliance, a default US-centric perspective, and poor handling of vulnerable populations -- with failure rates being mostly higher for analytical queries. By providing methods to monitor the reliability, safety, and fairness of LLM behavior, our dataset and evaluation framework offer an empirical foundation for the broader question of how these systems should behave as they take on a growing role in information access.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WildSEEK数据集和评测框架，用于系统性评估大语言模型（LLM）在真实用户信息检索场景下的响应表现，特别关注高风险与分析型查询中的可靠性和安全性问题。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型被广泛用于信息获取，但现有的评测方法局限于特定话题或人工合成数据，难以反映实际复杂场景和潜在风险。因此需要更真实、多样化的评估平台与数据集。
AI.method: 作者提出WildSEEK，一个来源于真实用户交互、手工标注的3k信息检索查询数据集，包括健康、金融等高风险领域，并区分事实性与分析性查询。利用WildSEEK对180万现实查询进行分析，并训练分类器识别风险类型和问题性质。
AI.result: 分析结果显示，超过三分之一的信息型查询属于高风险且多为分析型查询。LLM在恭维性、过度依赖、美国中心视角、对弱势群体处置等四方面常出现失败，特别是在分析型查询中，表现更差。
AI.conclusion: WildSEEK数据集和框架为监控大模型的可靠性、安全性和公平性提供了新方法，也为探究大模型在信息获取中的合适行为方式奠定了实证基础。

title: SePArate: Segmenting Patterns from Defects in Wafer Manufacturing Using Weak Supervision
comment: 7 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at the 63rd ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC 2026)
summary: In semiconductor manufacturing, defect analysis is essential, but manual inspection cannot scale. However, existing automated inspection methods remain insufficient for root-cause analysis and process optimization. To this end, we present SePArate, a weakly supervised wafer defect segmentation method. SePArate enables pixel-level separation of patterns by leveraging only image-level annotations. It consists of a three-phase training: encoder pretraining, knowledge transfer to learn spatial cues, and training on synthetic mixed-defect data for accurate segmentation. Experiments demonstrate that SePArate outperforms the baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SePArate的弱监督硅片缺陷分割方法，只需图像级标注便能实现像素级分割，且效果优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 手工检测半导体缺陷难以规模化，现有自动化检测虽提升效率，但在缺陷根因分析和工艺优化上仍有限，因此需更优的分割方法。
AI.method: SePArate采用三阶段训练流程：首先对编码器进行预训练，其次通过知识迁移学习空间信息，最后在合成混合缺陷数据上训练，实现高精度分割且仅需图像级标注。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，SePArate在分割精度上优于各类基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SePArate仅凭图像级标注即可实现有效的像素级缺陷分割，为半导体缺陷分析和工艺优化提供了更强的工具。

title: An Agentic Retrobiosynthesis Framework with Learned Frontier Selection
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as agents for multistep retrosynthesis, raising the question of how much their search policy contributes independently of the underlying reaction model. We investigate this question in a biological setting through rule-based retrobiosynthesis: a deterministic biochemical engine generates the same validated transitions for every method, searching for routes that terminate in metabolites available to an \emph{Escherichia coli} chassis, while the policy only selects which frontier molecule to expand next. Prompted and LoRA-tuned Qwen2.5-7B policies use a strict choice-only interface. The fine-tuned policy reaches $65\pm1$\% solve rate at 10 expansions on LASER versus 59\% for MCTS, and at 200 expansions reaches $78\pm1$\% versus 75\% on LASER, $88\pm3$\% versus 80\% on the RetroPath RL Golden benchmark, and $63\pm2$\% versus 45\% on the BioNavi-NP benchmark. Fine-tuning also consistently outperforms direct prompting. These results show that route-supervised frontier selection can improve budgeted search without altering biochemical generation, although performance remains dependent on frontier construction and reaction ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在生物反应逆合成问题中，大语言模型作为代理时，其搜索策略对结果的影响。通过统一的生化反应生成引擎，测试了不同策略下的溯源路径搜索效果，结果显示经过微调的Qwen2.5-7B模型效果优于传统MCTS。
AI.motivation: 日益流行的大语言模型被用于多步逆合成，但尚不清楚其搜索策略在不改变反应模型的情况下能独立起到多大作用。本文希望定量分析策略本身的贡献。
AI.method: 将问题限定在基于规则的生物逆合成（retro-biosynthesis），采用确定性生化引擎，使用不同策略来选择拓展分子。主要比较了提示工程和LoRA微调后的Qwen2.5-7B模型与MCTS的表现，所有方法都在相同的条件接口下执行。
AI.result: 微调后的Qwen2.5-7B在不同基准（LASER、RetroPath RL、BioNavi-NP）下均展现出比MCTS更高的路径命中率和求解效率，且微调比直接提示更优。
AI.conclusion: 在预算有限搜索任务中，仅通过更优的路径拓展策略（无须改变生化生成机制）即可提升逆合成任务表现。但其性能依赖于初始前沿分子的构建和反应优先级排序的质量。

title: Whole-Slide Image Analysis under Realistic Few-Shot Annotation Protocols
summary: Automating the analysis of whole-slide images has high clinical value, since characterizing cancers requires examining them in detail. Such analysis increasingly relies on vision-language models that provide patch-level zero-shot predictions. However, these predictions remain noisy and must be refined with a few annotations. A promising paradigm for this refinement is few-shot transduction. Rather than treating each patch independently, these methods leverage the relations between patches, together with a few annotations, to refine all predictions jointly. However, current transductive methods are evaluated under conditions that overlook key properties of whole-slide images: (i) datasets consist of independent patches extracted from multiple slides, ignoring the complex tissue organization; (ii) datasets are mostly balanced, whereas a single whole-slide image exhibits severe class imbalance, with several classes absent; and (iii) annotations are sampled at random, without reflecting how a pathologist annotates a limited number of regions. To align the transduction paradigm to realistic whole-slide settings, we introduce the following contributions. First, we propose SlideCRF, which adapts conditional random fields for whole-slide images by combining spatial and biological cues while accounting for classes that may be absent from a given slide. Second, we provide a set of realistic annotation protocols, based on spatially localized clicks and scribbles, modeling different pathologist interactions, such as the iterative correction of model errors. Across four datasets, we show that SlideCRF outperforms current transductive methods in macro F1, improving over the zero-shot predictions by +24.2% and +37.5% with one and 16 clicks per present class, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种适用于全切片图像分析的自动化方法SlideCRF，有效提升了癌症等疾病在医学图像中的精细诊断能力，并在真实性能、更贴合临床的环境下取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉-语言模型的医学全切片图像分析方式虽然可零样本进行预测，但预测结果噪声较大，需要依赖少量人工标注进一步优化。而目前主流的小样本转导方法在评估中并未充分考虑切片组织结构复杂、类别极不平衡及真实标注过程的特点，导致现实适应性有限。
AI.method: 作者提出SlideCRF方法，通过条件随机场（CRF）结合空间与生物学信息，实现对全切片图像中各区域的联合精准预测，并针对实际切片存在类别缺失这一挑战进行了建模。同时设计了更加真实的标注协议，以空间定位点击及涂鸦模拟病理医生的交互式标注流程，有效提升模型适应临床实际场景的能力。
AI.result: 在四个不同数据集上实验表明，SlideCRF优于现有的小样本转导方法，在宏观F1指标上分别比零样本预测提升24.2%（每类1次点击）和37.5%（每类16次点击）。
AI.conclusion: SlideCRF不仅显著提升了全切片图像自动分析的性能，还通过更现实的评估方案促进了算法向临床实际落地，适合未来医学图像分析领域广泛应用。

title: GUIDE: Guiding Internal Evidence with Language Instructions
summary: Large multimodal models follow instructions about what to generate, but not necessarily about what evidence to rely on. Hence, models may continue to depend on shortcut-associated cues even when instructions suggest otherwise. We introduce GUIDE, a framework for controlling internal evidence usage through language instructions. GUIDE combines grouped parameter-efficient adaptation with instruction-conditioned gating to modulate multimodal evidence pathways during reasoning and generation. We further introduce a pathway-level evaluation framework that characterizes instruction-conditioned evidence modulation through reliance sensitivity, controlled perturbation analysis, pathway modulation, and autoregressive decoding dynamics. Across multimodal reasoning, classification, and generation, GUIDE induces structured and instruction-aligned redistribution of evidence reliance while largely preserving task behavior. Experiments on GQA, TextVQA, MM-IMDb, CREMA-D, RAVDESS, and Flickr30K show that GUIDE improves robustness under targeted evidence perturbations and enables controllable modulation across diverse multimodal settings. This suggests that multimodal instruction following can extend beyond output control toward regulating how different evidence sources contribute to model predictions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了GUIDE框架，通过指令控制多模态大模型推理时对不同证据的依赖，有效提升模型在多模态任务中的稳健性和可控性。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大模型虽然能遵循生成内容的指令，但难以按照指令调整内部证据的使用，模型倾向于依赖某些捷径特征，影响结果的可解释性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出GUIDE框架，结合分组化高效参数适应（grouped parameter-efficient adaptation）和基于指令的门控机制（instruction-conditioned gating），在生成过程中动态调控多模态证据通路，并用分通路评估框架对模型的证据依赖模式进行系统性分析。
AI.result: GUIDE在多种多模态任务（包括推理、分类和生成）与数据集（如GQA, TextVQA, MM-IMDb等）上，有效实现了对证据依赖分布的结构化、指令一致地调整，并在特定证据扰动下表现出更好的鲁棒性和灵活可控性。
AI.conclusion: GUIDE使多模态大模型不仅能被指令控制输出，还能被指令调控内部证据依赖方式，为未来多模态模型的解释性、可靠性和可控性带来新的可能性。

title: ObjectSplat: Improving Mesh Fidelity and Interactivity for 3D Scenes via Object-Level Mesh Splatting
summary: Splatting-based algorithms reconstruct photorealistic, real-time-renderable, and mesh-exportable 3D scenes from regular images, but they represent a scene as a single monolithic field. Therefore, the reconstruction has no object-level structure, leaving it infeasible for downstream editing or interaction. Moreover, regions that are never directly observed in the input scans are contaminated by the surrounding texture and left uncorrected, capping both mesh fidelity and novel-view synthesis. We propose a decompose-before-reconstruct approach: we segment the instances out of every frame, consider the remaining as background and inpaint it, reconstruct each instance and the background independently with mesh splatting, and compose them into a single scene. Our method significantly improves mesh fidelity (over a 5\% gain in F-score) and novel-view synthesis, while supporting object-wise modifiability and interactivity. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的三维场景重建方法，将每一个物体实例分割出来并独立重建，最终组合为整体场景，实现了更高质量的网格重建和新视角合成，同时支持物体级的编辑和交互。
AI.motivation: 现有基于splatting的三维重建方法，虽然能够重建出逼真的场景，但缺乏物体级别的结构，使得后续的编辑和交互变得不可行。此外，对于扫描时没有被充分观察到的区域，重建会受到相邻纹理污染，导致细节和新视角合成表现受限。本文为解决这些问题提出了新的方法。
AI.method: 作者采用“先分解后重建”的流程：对每一帧进行实例分割，将非实例部分视为背景并进行修复，然后分别对每个实例和背景采用mesh splatting方法独立重建，最后将它们合成为一个完整场景。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法的网格重建精度（F-score提升5%以上）和新视角合成效果均显著优于传统整体场景重建方法，并实现在物体级别上的灵活可编辑与交互。
AI.conclusion: 本文方法解决了现有方法在物体级结构缺失和未观区域精度低的问题，提升了三维重建质量，同时扩展了应用场景，未来代码将开源，便于进一步使用与研究。

title: SocialReasonBench: A Video-QA Benchmark for Social Reasoning with Counterfactual Narrative Videos
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables
summary: Recent advances in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have greatly improved video understanding, yet their ability to reason about human-centered social situations remains limited. Existing benchmarks typically rely on videos with a single observed trajectory, making it difficult to determine whether models truly understand social dynamics or merely exploit recurring narrative patterns. We introduce SocialReasonBench, a video multiple-choice QA benchmark for evaluating socially grounded reasoning in scenarios derived from interactive narratives. Built from gameplay videos of Detroit: Become Human, the benchmark leverages branching storylines where player decisions lead to alternative social outcomes that can be checked against the game's own script, flowchart, and recorded branches. We develop a multi-agent curation pipeline that localizes socially meaningful clips, grounds answer labels in game-state signals, and generates theory-guided questions with diagnostic distractors. SocialReasonBench covers seven reasoning dimensions, including intent recognition, emotional empathy, moral dilemma, counterfactual reasoning, and causal antecedent. Experiments on contemporary LMMs show that models perform reasonably well on basic social understanding but struggle with counterfactual and causal reasoning. Further ablation and diagnostic error analyses reveal that models often depend on incomplete modality cues and fall into reasoning traps such as visual shortcuts, highlighting a gap between observable event recognition and deeper reasoning over latent social states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SocialReasonBench，一套用于评估大规模多模态模型在社会情境推理能力的视频问答基准，基于游戏Detroit: Become Human的分支剧情视频开发，旨在检测模型是否真正理解社会互动。实验发现现有模型在复杂社交推理（如反事实与因果）上仍表现不足。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态大模型在视频理解上有所突破，但对以人为中心的社会情境推理能力仍有限。现有基准通常仅关注单一轨迹，难以深入判断模型是否理解社会动态，亟需设计更具挑战和多样性的评测任务。
AI.method: 作者利用《底特律：变人》的游戏视频，构建多分支、可追溯决策结果的数据集。通过多主体标注流程，筛选具有社会意义的视频片段，结合游戏内状态信号、剧情脚本等，设计多维度的带诊断性干扰项的问题与答案。评测维度涵盖意图识别、共情、道德困境、反事实推理等7类社会推理能力。
AI.result: 在SocialReasonBench上，当前大模型可对基础社会理解任务给出较好答案，但在反事实和因果推理维度表现较弱。诊断分析发现，模型常依赖不完全的模态信息，易陷入视觉捷径等推理陷阱，暴露出简单事件识别与深层社会状态推理之间的巨大差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前LMM在表层社会事件识别有一定能力，但在复杂社会推理上仍不足，揭示出模型对深层社会动态理解方面的显著短板。提出的数据集和评测方法可促进模型发展更强的道德、因果等社会推理能力。

title: FlowVVTON: Flow-Guided Mask-Free Video Virtual Try-On
summary: Video virtual try-on aims to transfer a target garment onto a moving person across video frames. Current methods rely on human parsing masks or pose keypoints that frequently fail under large motions and occlusions, causing boundary artifacts and temporal inconsistency. A further limitation is that most approaches rely solely on attention mechanisms for temporal modeling, providing no explicit motion supervision. We propose FlowVVTON, a mask-free framework that eliminates parsing mask dependency entirely. Optical flow is used solely as a training-time supervision signal: a flow-warped latent loss, applied across all layers of the generation model, enforces multi-scale temporal consistency by aligning adjacent-frame features under explicit physical motion constraints. A two-stage training strategy establishes mask-free spatial alignment before introducing flow-guided temporal supervision. Experiments on TikTokDress show that FlowVVTON outperforms baselines by substantial margins, particularly in temporal consistency (5.7$\times$ VFID-R improvement over SwiftTry), while requiring no segmentation masks, pose keypoints, or region annotations at any stage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FlowVVTON，一种无需掩码的视频虚拟试衣方法，通过引入光流引导的监督，在训练时实现了更强的时序一致性，并在无需任何分割掩码或姿态关键点的情况下，在TikTokDress数据集上大幅超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视频虚拟试衣方法依赖于人体分割掩码或姿态关键点，在大幅度动作和遮挡情况下，易出现边界伪影和时序不一致问题。此外，大部分方法只用注意力机制进行时序建模，缺乏显式的运动监督。
AI.method: 提出的FlowVVTON框架完全去除了对分割掩码的依赖。在训练阶段，利用光流作为监督信号，采用跨所有网络层的光流引导潜在层损失，对相邻帧的特征进行对齐，实现多尺度的时序一致性。训练分为两个阶段，首先实现空间无掩码对齐，随后引入基于光流的时序监督。
AI.result: 在TikTokDress数据集上，FlowVVTON在时序一致性方面显著优于基线方法，比SwiftTry提升5.7倍的VFID-R分数，且无需任意阶段的分割掩码、姿态关键点或区域标注。
AI.conclusion: FlowVVTON框架摆脱了传统对分割掩码和姿态关键点的依赖，通过光流引导的训练方式，极大提升了视频虚拟试衣的时序一致性和生成质量，具有实际应用的显著优势。

title: Mind the Gap: Theory-of-Mind-Grounded Friction for Epistemic Alignment
summary: Productive dialogue alignment requires distinguishing \emph{surface coordination} (acknowledgments and smooth task progression) from \emph{epistemic alignment} (convergence of belief states); standard preference-based methods typically optimize response-level preferences without explicitly modeling the latter. We operationalize Theory-of-Mind (ToM) inference as a control signal within Frictive Policy Optimization by extracting, at each referring expression, a four-part belief structure: the speaker's intended referent, the addressee's interpretation, and each participant's model of the other's belief. This makes friction mechanically computable from epistemic-state comparisons, capturing \emph{silent divergence}, where both participants proceed confidently while grounding to different referents. We evaluate the signal at two levels. At the representation level, ablating the second-order channel reduces misunderstanding recall from $65\%$ to $26\%$. At the policy level, reward-shaping (FAR) and trust-region (FTR) variants improve intervention F1 and warranted-context calibration over DPO, with Brier scores independently supporting the calibration gains. Across three training runs, FAR and FTR remain substantially more stable, whereas DPO varies widely and can degrade intervention competence already present in the base policy. Thus, ToM-grounded friction provides a trainable signal for context-sensitive intervention under referential belief divergence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种在对话中建模和利用理论心智（ToM）推断的新方法，以提升对话系统的理解和干预能力，特别是在出现“沉默分歧”即参与者表面协调但实际理解存在偏差的情境下。
AI.motivation: 传统的偏好优化方法多侧重于响应级的偏好，并未明确建模对话过程中的认识状态对齐，而只有对知识状态的深入理解才能更好地发现和干预潜在误解。该工作旨在为对话系统引入更细粒度的理论心智推断信号，提高系统对“知识分歧”的敏感度。
AI.method: 作者基于Friction Policy Optimization的方法，在每次指称表达时提取了四维的信念结构：发言人意图、收听者解释、以及双方对彼此信念的模型，将理论心智推断作为可计算的控制信号。并提出了基于奖励优化（FAR）和信任域（FTR）两种训练变体，对方法在辨别和介入知识分歧进行实验。
AI.result: 在消融实验中，去除二阶心智模型会显著降低系统对误解的召回率（从65%降至26%）。在对话干预能力和情境校准上，FAR和FTR方法均显著优于基线（DPO），且Brier分数作为独立指标也支持这些改进。此外，FAR和FTR三次训练结果均保持高稳定性，而DPO易波动和性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 理论心智推断驱动的friction信号为对话系统在识别和干预指称信念分歧方面提供了有效、可训练的信号，并显著提升了系统对于语境敏感干预的能力。

title: SeqAlign3DVG: A Sequence-Aligned Benchmark and Voxel Reasoning Framework for 3D Visual Grounding
summary: Image-based 3D visual grounding is critical for embodied agents, yet existing benchmarks suffer from loose text-observation alignment and neglect temporal ordering. We introduce SeqAlign3DVG, a novel benchmark dedicated to temporally ordered and strictly observation-aligned image-based 3D visual grounding. Unlike prior works using order-agnostic views or global point clouds, SeqAlign3DVG ensures all expressions are human-verified and strictly grounded in the provided RGB observations (single frames or ordered observation sequences). It comprises 9,622 single-view and 14,493 sequence samples featuring rich descriptions, complex relations, and multi-instance ambiguities. To tackle this benchmark, we propose a unified voxel-based pipeline featuring Relevance-Ordered Voxel Memory (ROVM) and Progressive Language-Voxel Fusion (PLVF). ROVM dynamically ranks and aggregates multi-view evidence via a conservative memory to mitigate noisy observations, while PLVF performs coarse-to-fine spatial-linguistic reasoning for precise disambiguation. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance under the depth-free protocol, significantly improving localization for targets defined by complex relations and appearance cues.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出SeqAlign3DVG数据集，并针对严格时序对齐的图像式3D视觉定位提出统一体素方法，显著推动复杂场景定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图像的3D视觉定位基准存在文本与视觉对齐不严、忽视时序信息的问题，难以满足体感智能体真实需求。
AI.method: 构建SeqAlign3DVG数据集（含单帧与序列场景），所有描述由人工校验并严格锚定于RGB观测；提出基于体素的管线，包含相关性排序体素记忆（ROVM）和渐进式语言-体素融合（PLVF）机制，前者动态聚合多视角信息，后者进行粗到细空间-语言推理，实现精准消歧。
AI.result: 在无深度信息协议下，方法在SeqAlign3DVG上取得最优成绩，尤其提升了涉及复杂关系和外观线索目标的定位精度。
AI.conclusion: 严格观测对齐和多模态时序推理可极大增强图像式3D视觉定位，SeqAlign3DVG为领域提供了新基准，提出方法有效应对现实多样复杂场景。

title: Where Do Multilingual Vision-Language Encoders Fail on Low-Resource Languages?
summary: Recent multilingual vision--language encoders cover hundreds of languages in a single model, yet on two state-of-the-art instances retrieval on low-resource languages (LRL; e.g. Swahili) trails high-resource ones (HRL; e.g. English) by $30^+$\,pp. We ask where in the trained encoder this gap is located. Prior modality-gap and cross-lingual subspace work suggests a linear language direction at the output crowds out alignment-relevant geometry. We falsify this: LEACE drives the linear language classifier from $>99\%$ to near chance and iterated INLP to $37$--$50\%$ while LRL retrieval moves within $\pm 1.5$\,pp and all tier means within $2.2$\,pp, tracking random controls. The linear bias is a \emph{symptom}, not the cause. Instead, the alignment-causal factor lies along the encoder's forward path: the EOS (end-of-sequence) hidden state's per-language trajectory diverges with depth. Substituting the EOS with its parallel English value three blocks before the projector lifts Swahili from $22.1\%$ to $69.1\%$ on one encoder (and reproduces on the other); three controls rule out pooled-position tautology and English specificity. A front-layer trunk that pulls each language's projection toward the parallel-content centroid corroborates the diagnosis at training time, recovering $+9.6$ / $+17.1$\,pp on LRL XM3600 retrieval (1{,}000-image subset), with consistent gains across three further benchmarks while preserving HRL performance.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了多语言视觉-语言编码器在低资源语言（LRL）与高资源语言（HRL）图像检索任务上的巨大性能差距，并找出了差距的具体来源。
AI.motivation: 多语言视觉-语言模型能同时覆盖数百种语言，但在低资源语言上的性能明显落后于高资源语言，作者希望查明导致这一性能差异的具体位置及原因。
AI.method: 作者通过消除编码器输出的线性语言信息（用LEACE与INLP等方法），发现这种线性偏置并不是造成性能差距的根本原因。进一步通过分析模型前向传播过程，定位到EOS隐藏状态的不同语言轨迹才是真正的对齐因子，并在模型结构中验证了这一发现。
AI.result: 将低资源语言的EOS隐藏状态替换为其对应的英语值，显著提升图像检索性能（如斯瓦希里语性能从22.1%提升至69.1%），并在不同模型与基准测试中得到一致性的增益。同时，训练过程中通过调整投影方式，对齐效果得到进一步提升，在LRL上获得9.6-17.1个百分点的提升。
AI.conclusion: 多语言视觉-语言编码器低资源语言任务性能落后并非由输出层的线性语言方向导致，而是由前向传播过程中的EOS隐藏状态轨迹分歧引起。修正该问题后，可显著提升低资源语言的表现，同时不影响高资源语言性能。

title: Federated Multi-Task Learning for Bladder Tumor Segmentation and MIBC Classification Using a Hybrid CNN-Transformer Architecture
summary: Accurate bladder tumor segmentation and assessment of mus- cle invasion from T2-weighted MRI are important for treatment plan- ning, but developing robust models across institutions is challenging be- cause patient data cannot be centrally pooled and imaging characteristics vary across scanners and acquisition protocols. We propose a federated multi-task learning framework for joint bladder tumor segmentation and MIBC/NMIBC classification across four clinical centers. The proposed Swin Hybrid model combines a ResNet-34 branch for local texture and boundary information with a Swin-Tiny Transformer for global anatomi- cal context. A segmentation-guided classification mechanism further uses tumor localization information to support MIBC prediction. We also investigate several augmentation strategies under both centralized and federated training to improve robustness to multi-center variability. Ex- periments on the FedBCa dataset show that the Swin Hybrid provides the best overall balance between segmentation and classification among the evaluated architectures. Under federated training, Geo+Elastic aug- mentation achieved a DSC of 0.8100 and a patient-level AUC of 0.8931, yielding the highest combined score of 0.8474. These results demonstrate that joint segmentation and classification can be effectively performed across multiple institutions using federated training without centralizing patient data.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种新颖的联邦多任务学习框架，能在不集中数据的前提下实现膀胱肿瘤分割和浸润性分级的高效、稳健联合预测。
AI.motivation: 膀胱肿瘤的精准MRI分割与浸润性评估对于治疗方案至关重要，但受限于患者数据无法集中、多中心成像差异大，现有模型在多机构鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 构建了Swin Hybrid模型，融合了ResNet-34（提取局部纹理与边界信息）和Swin-Tiny Transformer（捕捉全局解剖信息），并引入分割引导分类机制辅助浸润性预判。模型在四个中心采用联邦学习，并结合多种数据增强策略，提升跨中心适应性。
AI.result: 在FedBCa多中心数据集上，Swin Hybrid模型在分割与分类任务中效果最佳。联邦训练下，采用Geo+Elastic增强取得了0.8100的DSC、0.8931的AUC以及0.8474的综合得分，优于其他方案。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，无需集中患者数据，采用联邦多任务学习能在多机构间高效实现膀胱肿瘤分割与分类，具有良好推广性和应用前景。

title: Calibrating Small Language Models for Claim Check-Worthiness Detection
summary: Assessing claim check-worthiness is an essential first step in automated fact-checking pipelines. This work is motivated by a real deployment challenge at an early-stage startup: running large language models (LLMs) over every incoming claim is cost- and latency-prohibitive, yet smaller models sacrifice accuracy. We propose NN-PPI, a pointwise extension of Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) that calibrates model predictions at inference time as a lightweight post-hoc layer, without re-training the underlying model. NN-PPI achieves weighted F1 gains ranging from 12% to 33.80% depending on the size and performance of the baseline model, bringing SLMs on par with larger LLMs. Beyond few-shot SLMs, NN-PPI further improves a production-deployed fine-tuned model, demonstrating that residual calibration is complementary to supervised fine-tuning. By recovering LLM-level accuracy from models that are an order of magnitude cheaper to serve, it makes accurate check-worthiness detection substantially cheaper to operate at scale. Our code and data can be found at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/arr-claim-worthiness-F237.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为NN-PPI的新方法，可为事实核查任务中的“可查证性”检测轻松提升小模型准确率，使其接近大型语言模型的表现，且无需重新训练，部署成本大幅降低。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽准确，但推理成本高，不适合在实际生产中大规模处理每条声称句子，小模型又会牺牲准确率。因此需要一个能提升小模型性能且低成本的推理校准方法。
AI.method: 提出NN-PPI方法，对现有预测进行推理时的后置校准。此方法属于Prediction-Powered Inference（PPI）的一种点式扩展，并且可以直接集成到预测流程，无需重新训练模型，仅作为推理补偿层。
AI.result: NN-PPI带来了12%到33.8%的加权F1提升，让小型语言模型（SLM）的表现可以媲美大型语言模型（LLM），同时也进一步提升了已部署的监督微调模型的效果。
AI.conclusion: NN-PPI可显著降低高质量“可查证性”检测的成本，使得小模型具备大模型的准确性，便于大规模实际自动事实核查系统的部署和应用。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Quantifying Pulmonary Attribution in Anatomy-Guided Chest X-Ray Classification Under Domain Shift
comment: 34 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/Abdullah-229/BeyondAccuracy
summary: Deep-learning models can achieve strong chest X-ray (CXR) classification performance without establishing whether their predictions predominantly rely on pulmonary image content. This study evaluates pulmonary attribution containment as an anatomy-related reliability property distinct from diagnostic performance. We propose DBCA-SegNet-MGAP, a multi-task anatomy-guided CNN-Transformer framework that combines complementary feature representations through bidirectional cross-backbone attention, predicts a soft lung mask, and incorporates this anatomical prior directly into classification through Mask-Guided Adaptive Global Average Pooling (MGAP). Pulmonary attribution containment is quantified using the Anatomical Local Energy Ratio (ALR) and high-intensity cumulative ALR (cALR@0.9). Experiments were repeated across three training seeds using the COVID-19 Radiography Database for four-class internal testing and a locked Shenzhen-to-Montgomery protocol for zero-shot external tuberculosis testing. On COVID-19, the proposed model achieved a weighted F1 of $0.9615 \pm 0.0015$ and macro ROC-AUC of $0.9906 \pm 0.0007$. In an architecture-matched dual-bridge comparison, replacing conventional GAP with MGAP increased ALR from $0.3878 \pm 0.0098$ to $0.7086 \pm 0.0104$ and cALR@0.9 from $0.5265 \pm 0.0101$ to $0.9905 \pm 0.0018$, while weighted F1 remained essentially unchanged ($0.9618 \pm 0.0015$ vs. $0.9615 \pm 0.0015$). Under locked external transfer to Montgomery, ROC-AUC remained $0.9080 \pm 0.0043$ and pulmonary ALR remained $0.6466 \pm 0.0081$, whereas weighted F1 decreased to $0.7528 \pm 0.0080$ and ECE increased to $0.1683 \pm 0.0055$. These findings show that diagnostic discrimination, calibration, and pulmonary attribution containment are distinct model properties and support their joint evaluation under internal testing and external domain shift.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合多任务学习和注意力机制的新型深度学习模型（DBCA-SegNet-MGAP），提升了胸部X光诊断中模型对肺部区域特征的归因能力，并分离分析了诊断性能与解剖归因性能的关系。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型在胸部X光分类时，虽然诊断性能很强，但其决策是否主要基于肺部解剖内容存在疑问。为提升模型可靠性和可解释性，需评估模型对肺部图像特征归因的能力，并与诊断分类性能加以区分。
AI.method: 提出DBCA-SegNet-MGAP框架，结合CNN-Transformer结构和跨主干注意力机制，实现分类与肺部掩码（soft lung mask）预测的多任务学习，并通过自适应池化（MGAP）将解剖先验引入最终分类过程。用解剖局部能量比（ALR）和累计高强度ALR (cALR@0.9)量化肺部归因。
AI.result: 在COVID-19 Radiography数据集的内部测试下，模型取得了加权F1 0.9615和宏观AUC 0.9906。应用MGAP后，肺部归因指标ALR显著提升（约0.39提升到0.71），cALR@0.9提高至0.99，而分类性能保持不变。跨域测试（深圳到蒙哥马利）时，归因能力基本保持，但准确率和校准下降。
AI.conclusion: 诊断性能、模型校准性与肺部归因能力是不同的模型属性，三者需同时评估。引入解剖先验（如MGAP）能提升模型决策归因于正确解剖区域，而不影响分类性能，对医学AI模型的安全性与可解释性有重要价值。

title: Not All Fallbacks Are Failures: Understanding and Recovering from Fallbacks in Mobile Voice Assistants
summary: Robust understanding of user input is a core requirement for voice assistants deployed in real-world environments. In practice, these systems encounter heterogeneous fallback situations caused by noisy audio input, transcription errors, ambiguous requests, incomplete utterances, or unintended activations. Existing systems typically respond with generic fallback messages, which do not resolve the underlying interaction failure and can degrade user experience. We study fallback handling in a deployed smartwatch-based voice assistant for general health support in everyday environments. Our analysis is based on six months of real-world usage data from more than 500 users, yielding a dataset of 3,030 anonymized, naturally occurring fallback-triggering utterances. We contribute (1) an operational taxonomy and the annotated VoxFallbacks dataset of these interactions, (2) a comparative evaluation of different models within a classification pipeline under practical deployment constraints, and (3) practical lessons for designing robust and cost-efficient fallback mechanisms. Results show that lightweight embedding-based classifiers outperform larger generative models on most classification tasks while requiring substantially fewer computational resources.

AI.tldr: 本文针对智能手表健康语音助手在实际环境中遇到的fallback（无法理解用户输入）问题，提出并分析了一种更高效的fallback处理方法及其实践经验。
AI.motivation: 当前语音助手在真实环境中常因音频噪声、转写错误、表达模糊等原因触发fallback，现有方案多用模板化回复，未能有效改善用户体验，因而迫切需要更智能和高效的fallback处理机制。
AI.method: 作者基于500多名用户、共3030条真实触发fallback的互动语句，建立了VoxFallbacks数据集，提出了操作型分类体系，并在符合部署约束下对多种分类模型进行系统性对比评估。
AI.result: 结果显示：轻量型的embedding-based分类器在多数分类任务中均优于大型生成式模型，且极大降低计算资源消耗。
AI.conclusion: 本文为语音助手fallback处理提供了数据、方法和经验：高效、资源友好的轻量模型更适合实际部署，并为未来构建鲁棒和高性价比的互动系统提供了设计指引。

title: CLIN: an Objective Framework for Evaluating Creativity in Short Persian Literary Text
summary: Evaluating creativity in large language model (LLM) outputs remains challenging because creativity is multidimensional and human-centered. We examine how reliably LLMs evaluate short literary text in Persian, a low-resource language, across multiple evaluation strategies and prompt formulations. We find that LLM-human agreement varies substantially across dimensions: alignment is stronger for structured TTCT-derived properties such as Originality, Fluency, and Elaboration, but considerably weaker for more subjective dimensions, particularly Emotion and Attractiveness. Judgments are also sensitive to prompt formulation, while few-shot prompting, ensembling, and multi-agent debate provide no consistent improvement. Motivated by this dimension-dependent behavior, we investigate whether structured creativity dimensions can instead be approximated using simple, interpretable proxy metrics. We introduce CLIN, which evaluates three TTCT-derived dimensions separately using topic-aware novelty for Originality, contextual lexical clustering for Fluency, and lexical diversity for Elaboration. These proxies achieve human alignment comparable to or better than the strongest zero-shot LLM judge in our setting while requiring substantially lower evaluation cost.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了大语言模型（LLM）在评估波斯语短文学文本创造力方面的表现，并提出指标CLIN用于替代复杂的人工评估。
AI.motivation: 由于创造力评估多维且以人为中心，尤其在资源匮乏语言（如波斯语）中，LLM输出的创造力评价仍然具有挑战性。作者希望探索LLM在不同评价策略和提示形式下，与人工评估的一致性，并尝试寻找更高效的评估方法。
AI.method: 作者分别考察了LLM在原创性、流畅性、扩展性、情感、吸引力等维度的评估表现，比较了不同提示设置（如few-shot、集成、多智能体辩论）对一致性的影响。进一步，作者开发了CLIN指标，基于主题感知的新颖度、词汇聚类和多样性，分别对三项主要创造力维度进行量化评估。
AI.result: 研究发现，LLM与人类在结构化维度（如原创性、流畅性、扩展性）的评估较为一致，而在主观维度（如情感、吸引力）上则表现较差。不同提示对判定有影响，但few-shot等策略未带来稳定提升。提出的CLIN代理指标在预测三项结构化维度上，与最佳的零样本LLM表现持平或更优，且评估成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 对于结构化创造力维度，可用简单、可解释的代理指标（如CLIN）替代复杂或高成本的LLM/人工评估方法，对低资源语言和大规模应用具有实际意义。

title: VisER: Visual Evidence and Reliance for Object Hallucination Detection in LVLMs
summary: Object hallucination remains a persistent reliability issue in large vision-language models, where generated object mentions may sound plausible but lack visual grounding. Recent training-free detectors use internal signals such as token likelihood, attention, visual confidence, or image-text similarity to identify hallucinated objects. These signals are useful, but they are often source-confounded. They measure how strongly an object is supported inside the model without distinguishing whether that support comes from object-specific visual evidence or the generated text prefix. In difficult cases, a hallucinated object can still receive high internal support because it fits the scene, is associated with nearby visual cues, or follows naturally from the generated text prefix. We propose VisER, a training-free two-sided metric for object-level hallucination detection. VisER evaluates each generated object mention from two complementary views. Visual Evidence measures whether object-context compatibility is backed by object-specific evidence from image tokens. Visual Reliance measures whether the object is supported more by the image than by the generated prefix. Combining these views gives a more source-aware grounding score, while avoiding additional object-level verification generations. Across multiple LVLMs and benchmarks, VisER improves AUROC and AUPR over a range of baselines.

AI.tldr: 本论文关注于大规模视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）中对象幻觉问题，并提出一种无训练的新指标VisER来更有效检测对象级别幻觉。
AI.motivation: LVLMs经常会生成听起来合理但实际上没有视觉根据的对象描述，这是模型可靠性的重要隐患。已有方法虽然能检测幻觉，但容易混淆幻觉的来源，难以区分视觉证据与文本上下文带来的支持。
AI.method: 提出VisER评估指标，包括两个互补视角：视觉证据（判断对象与图像是否有特定关联）和视觉依赖（判断对象获得的支持主要来自图像还是文本前缀），无需新增训练或生成额外验证文本。
AI.result: VisER在多个LVLMs和基准测试集上，相比于现有方法，在AUROC和AUPR等评价指标上有更好的性能。
AI.conclusion: VisER能更准确、源感知地检测模型对象幻觉问题，是LVLM幻觉检测更可靠的新工具。

title: TopoCompress: Long Context Compression via Graph-Wired Semantic Trajectories
summary: Long-context compression is essential for reducing the cost and latency of large language model inference. However, existing methods can fragment important evidence, require additional training or alignment, and often depend on the target model for effective compression. We introduce TopoCompress, a training-free and model-agnostic framework that compresses long contexts by selecting coherent semantic spans. TopoCompress first scores each span using dense and lexical query relevance together with semantic acceleration. It then constructs a hybrid graph that connects spans based on semantic similarity and sequential adjacency, and propagates the query-guided relevance scores over the graph. Across five long-context tasks-HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, Qasper, and MultiFieldQA-en-TopoCompress consistently outperforms strong compression baselines. Notably, TopoCompress achieves performance comparable to the strongest baseline while using a 4x smaller compression budget, and provides a 1.41x smaller compression time over the fastest baseline.

AI.tldr: TopoCompress是一种无需训练、与模型无关的长上下文压缩方法，通过选择语义连贯的片段提高大语言模型的推理效率，效果优于现有主流方法，压缩速度更快、压缩比更高。
AI.motivation: 当前长上下文压缩方法存在证据信息被分散、需额外训练或依赖特定模型的问题，实际应用中成本和时延较高，难以适应多任务和大模型推理。
AI.method: 提出TopoCompress框架，无需额外训练也不依赖目标大模型。方法包括：使用密集及词汇相关性与语义变化对上下文片段进行打分；构建同时考虑语义相似性与序列相邻性混合图；在图上传播结合查询的相关评分，最终选取最有用且连贯的片段用于压缩。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMQA、MuSiQue、Qasper和MultiFieldQA-en五个长上下文任务上，TopoCompress表现优于多种主流压缩基线，能用更小压缩预算取得类似效果，并在压缩速度上实现显著提升。
AI.conclusion: TopoCompress在不同任务场景下均表现强劲，不仅明显提升了压缩效率，还保持了信息完整性，是对长上下文压缩领域的重要推动。

title: Lot Machine: Multimodal Lot Extraction from Auction Catalogs
comment: Accepted at the VISART Workshop (Computer Vision for Art Analysis), ECCV 2026. 19 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Supplementary material included as an appendix. Code, benchmark data, and prompt templates: https://github.com/mathiaszinnen/auction-lot-extraction
summary: For provenance research and art market studies, auction catalogs are an essential resource to trace specific objects over time and space. While historical auction catalogs follow established domain conventions, their internal formatting remains highly variable, and their large-scale analysis is currently restricted by the lack of machine-readable representations of the auction lots. We propose a pipeline to automatically extract structured lot-level metadata from German Sales, a large database of historical auction and sales catalogs from the 19th and 20th centuries. Using a manually annotated test set of representative catalog pages, we evaluate Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under varying prompt strategies and constrained decoding frameworks. To reflect the practical constraints faced by cultural heritage institutions, including budget, compute resources, and data privacy requirements, we benchmark the methods across different deployment modes ranging from commercial providers to locally hosted, quantized models. We find that commercial endpoints establish the performance ceiling, while institutional gateways offer a viable, privacy-preserving alternative. Local deployments remain feasible, but strictly require enforcing the output structure during generation to guarantee a valid JSON format. While varying degrees of human-in-the-loop correction are still necessary, this work demonstrates that a VLM-based pipeline can successfully unlock historical auction catalogs for large-scale automated analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自动化抽取历史拍卖图录拍品元数据的管道，采用视觉-语言模型（VLMs）并测试多种运行模式，实现大规模分析拍卖图录内容。
AI.motivation: 历史拍卖图录是艺术品溯源与市场研究的重要资源，但受限于图录格式不统一及缺乏机器可读数据，难以进行大规模分析。亟需自动化方法将非结构化内容转为结构化数据。
AI.method: 针对德国拍卖图录数据库，设计了自动结构化元数据提取流程。利用人工标注的测试集，评估多个VLM在不同提示和输出框架下的表现，同时测试商用API、本地量化模型等多种可部署模式，以兼顾隐私、资源与成本因素。
AI.result: 商用API达到性能上限，机构内网部署是兼顾隐私与性能的可行方案，本地模型部署可行但需严格控制输出格式以保证数据有效。不同方案下均需一定比例人工校正。
AI.conclusion: VLM管道能有效推动历史拍卖图录的自动化结构化处理，为艺术品溯源等大规模研究提供了技术基础，但自动化仍需有限人工辅助，以保证数据质量。

title: Error-Type-Aware Loss Reweighting for Robust Named Entity Recognition with Noisy LLM Labels
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to annotate datasets for training smaller, task-specialized models such as named entity recognition. While this method yields effective models, it assumes that the synthetic dataset is correctly annotated. In this work, we find that (i) current fine-tuning processes simply ignore LLM-introduced annotation noise, resulting in degraded performance and (ii) existing noise-robust losses are not transferable to sequence labeling because annotation noise in named entity recognition is heterogeneous: for example, missing mentions and type errors affect the training signal in different ways. Treating all noisy tokens equally in noise-robust losses and applying a single reweighing criterion for all may therefore remove useful supervision or reinforce incorrect labels. To address this limitation, we propose error-type-aware loss reweighting for NER, which introduces separate reweighing rules for different types of potentially erroneous tokens.
