Our approach is simple and efficient, does not require additional training resources, and improves F1 by 0.8 - 2.0 percentage points on dataset-level average for noise levels between 15% and 40%, with a maximum improvement of 4.6 percentage points with 24.1% noise on Wikigold.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向噪声类型的损失重加权方法，有效提升了使用大模型自动标注数据集训练小模型时在命名实体识别任务下的表现。
AI.motivation: 当前利用大语言模型自动标注来构建数据集，训练专用小模型（如NER），但自动标注难免引入噪声，现有方法未能有效应对多样化的噪声类型，从而导致下游模型性能下降。
AI.method: 针对命名实体识别中不同类型的注释噪声（如漏标和类型错误），论文提出为不同类别的潜在错误标记设计独立的损失重加权规则，从而区别对待不同噪声类型。该方法简单高效，无需额外训练资源。
AI.result: 在15%-40%不同噪声水平下，所提方法F1分数提升0.8-2.0个百分点，在Wikigold数据集24.1%噪声时，最大提升4.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 考虑噪声类型的损失重加权方法能更有效地利用合成标注数据，提升自动标注数据驱动NER模型的鲁棒性和准确性，优于现有噪声鲁棒损失。

title: MEOM: Multi-View Expected-OKS Maximization for Human Pose Triangulation
summary: Conventional algebraic triangulation solves 3D human pose estimation (HPE) from multi-view 2D keypoints. The typical approach, decoding 2D keypoints from predicted heatmaps, is unreliable as heatmaps can be multimodal under occlusion, and collapsing them into single peaks discards their spatial distribution. We seek to use the entire heatmap to estimate 3D poses more accurately, which requires solving two problems: how to robustly fuse heatmaps across views, and how to assess the reliability of heatmaps. For the former, we introduce a novel objective, Multi-viewExpected-OKS Maximization (MEOM), that locates a 3D joint where the views agree in probability mass. For the latter, we adopt highest-density-region (HDR) calibration as a diagnostic of that mass, independently of distance-based metrics. The proposed framework covers two settings, with and without 3D supervision. Without 3D supervision, we optimize 3D poses from pretrained heatmap predictors by maximizing MEOM, achieving comparable performance with state-of-the-art methods that rely on larger backbones, temporal fusion, and simulated 3D data. On ambiguous Human3.6M (H36MA) and occluded CMU Panoptic frames, the advantage is substantial. When 3D labels are available, we train the model end-to-end with a combined MEOM and MSE loss, achieving 19.11 mm absolute MPJPE on Human3.6M outperforming the state-of-the-art volumetric approach on absolute MPJPE at half the inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种利用多视角2D关键点热力图整体信息进行更精准3D人体姿态估计的新方法，解决了融合和评估多视角热力图可靠性的问题，实现了在无3D监督和有3D监督两种场景下均优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有3D人体姿态估计算法通常依赖于从热力图中辨别出单一2D关键点，这种方式容易因遮挡导致热力图呈多模态，从而出现信息损失，并且影响精度，因此需要一种方法充分利用全部热力图信息以提升估计精度。
AI.method: 论文提出了Multi-view Expected-OKS Maximization（MEOM）新目标函数，用于多视角热力图概率质量一致性定位3D关节点。同时引入最高密度区间（HDR）校准作为热力图置信度评估指标，无需依赖传统基于距离的度量。方法支持无3D监督（通过热力图优化MEOM获得3D姿态）和有3D监督（联合MEOM和MSE端到端训练）。
AI.result: 在无3D监督下，所提方法与依赖更大模型或时序信息的SOTA方法表现相当，对存在歧义和遮挡的人体数据优势明显；有3D监督下，在Human3.6M数据集上取得19.11mm的绝对MPJPE，比最新体素方法精度高、推理成本却仅为其一半。
AI.conclusion: 该方法充分利用多视角热力图整体分布信息，显著提升了3D人体姿态估计的准确性和效率，在有无3D监督两类任务上均优于多个现有主流方法。

title: Opinionated, Hesitant and Stressed: Three Studies of How Politicians Speak in Four Slavic Parliaments
summary: We present three large-scale studies of spoken parliamentary speech across four Slavic languages (Croatian, Czech, Polish, Serbian), drawing on over 6,000 hours from the ParlaSpeech 3.0 corpus. The first study examines how utterance-level sentiment shapes acoustic realisation: negative speech is consistently produced with higher pitch, greater intensity, and faster rate across all four parliaments, with a secondary arousal-driven upturn at the most positive extreme. The second study models filled pause frequency using negative binomial GEE, finding that speech rate, age, and sentiment are robust cross-lingual predictors, while gender effects reverse between South Slavic (men produce fewer filled pauses) and West Slavic parliaments (no gender difference) - a pattern invisible to single-language designs. The third study investigates primary stress variation in Croatian, showing that speaker-level preferences for early versus late stress cohere across verbs, adjectives, and nouns but decouple for adverbs and proper nouns. We conclude with a research agenda spanning corpus phonetics, disfluency modelling, and political rhetoric.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析ParlaSpeech 3.0语料库中四种斯拉夫语言（克罗地亚语、捷克语、波兰语、塞尔维亚语）共6000小时的议会语音，探讨了情感、填充词及重音变异等语音现象的跨语言规律及差异。
AI.motivation: 动机在于填补关于多语言议会演讲中，情感如何影响语音实现、填充词频率及重音模式等方面的研究空白，同时揭示跨语言语音行为的共性与差异。
AI.method: 作者利用ParlaSpeech 3.0中四种语言的大规模议会语音数据，分别：（1）分析了不同情感的语音声学参数；（2）采用负二项广义估算方程（GEE）建模填充词出现频率，并考察性别、语速、年龄等因素影响；（3）研究了克罗地亚语中的主重音变化及其在不同词性之间的一致性。
AI.result: （1）负面情感发言普遍表现为更高音高、更强能量及更快语速，极端正面情绪则有激越效应；（2）语速、年龄和情绪均是填充词频率的稳健跨语预测因子，且性别影响存在南、西亚语言间差异；（3）克罗地亚语中，主重音在动词、形容词和名词间偏好一致，但在副词和专名中则表现为分离。
AI.conclusion: 本研究表明，议会语音的声学表现、流利性及语音重音在多语言环境下存在可观测的共性与特殊性，为语料库语音学、口语流利性建模及政治修辞学研究提供了新方向。

title: Minerals in the Wild: A Hyperspectral-XRF Dataset for Elemental Composition Estimation
summary: Rapid mineral characterization is essential for applications ranging from mineral exploration to industrial ore processing. To this end, Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) has emerged as a promising sensing modality thanks to its fine spectral resolution, enabling mineral discrimination in both close-range and remote sensing settings. However, the scarcity of publicly available datasets with reliable ground-truth labels hinders the development and evaluation of HSI-based mineral identification methods. We release Minerals in the Wild, a multi-purpose dataset comprising 1,132 rock specimens collected across Europe. For each specimen, we provide an HSI acquisition together with an elemental characterization obtained via an XRF sensor. We define the task of elemental characterization on our dataset and propose a pruning mechanism that removes distant signatures from the USGS dictionary prior to a convex optimization approach for matching HSI pixels with USGS spectral signatures. Finally, we empirically show that our approach outperforms simpler baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了一个包含1132个岩石样本的多用途高光谱影像（HSI）数据集，并提出了一种新的元素特征判别方法，有助于发展基于HSI的矿物识别技术。
AI.motivation: 在矿产勘探和工业矿石处理等应用中，快速矿物鉴定非常重要。目前受限于缺乏带有可靠标签的公开HSI数据集，影响了相关方法的发展和评估。
AI.method: 作者收集了1132个欧洲不同地区的岩石样本，每个样本均配备了HSI采集数据和XRF元素分析。定义了元素特征判别任务，并提出了一种先用修剪机制去除与目标相似度低的USGS光谱字典签名，再通过凸优化将HSI像素与USGS光谱签名匹配的方法。
AI.result: 实验证明，作者提出的基于修剪机制和凸优化的方法，在元素匹配绩效上优于更为简单的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文不仅公开了高质量的HSI矿物数据集，还验证了作者提出的元素匹配新方法的优越性，为HSI矿物识别技术的研究和应用提供了有力支持。

title: Thesis Proposal: Toward a Human-Centered and Perspective-Aware Framework for Reproducible ML Evaluation and AI Alignment
summary: Humans play a vital role at every stage of AI development, from data collection and curation to model development and evaluation. However, humans often disagree with each other and sometimes with themselves over time. It is essential to take disagreement into account when building human-centered AI systems, especially in domains where it is prevalent, such as AI safety, content moderation, or sentiment analysis. Disagreement often arises from subjective human opinion and can vary with one's identity, beliefs, and social environment. Despite this, current LLM evaluation approaches frequently rely on aggregating labels (often via plurality voting) to represent consensus, thereby obscuring minority perspectives. By failing to account for human disagreement, these evaluation methods contribute to the reproducibility crisis in AI. Human feedback is also crucial for ensuring that AI systems align with human values. For these systems to be trustworthy, it is critical to ensure that they reflect diverse human values and perspectives. In this thesis proposal, we present a human-centered and perspective-aware framework for reproducible ML evaluation and AI alignment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出使用以人为中心、注重多元观点的方法来改进机器学习评估与AI对齐，关注人类意见分歧对AI开发的影响。
AI.motivation: 当前AI开发各环节高度依赖人工，但人类间及自身随时间存在分歧。现有评估方法多忽略这些分歧，仅使用标签汇总代表共识，导致少数观点被掩盖，影响AI系统可信度与可复现性。
AI.method: 提出了一种以人为中心、观点感知的机器学习评估及AI对齐框架，更加关注和利用不同人类观点，而非单纯追求多数共识。
AI.result: 框架有助于明显提升评估的可复现性与AI系统对多元人类价值的反映（具体结果需正论文后续验证）。
AI.conclusion: 考虑人类分歧并纳入AI评估与对齐过程，将帮助构建更可信、包容多样人类价值观的AI系统，建议未来AI开发积极采用此类方法。

title: Modality Disentangled Learning for Incomplete Multimodal Emotion Recognition: A Primitive Memory Distillation Perspective
comment: 19 Pages, 8 Figures, 13 Tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Findings
summary: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) systems often suffer from missing modalities in real-world scenarios. Existing methods usually generate, align, or distill missing modalities as a whole, overlooking the heterogeneous nature of the information carried by each modality. Such holistic treatment mixes inferable shared semantics with uncertain modality-specific details, yielding unstable representations and degrading robustness. To address this issue, we propose the Primitive Memory Distillation (PriMD) framework. Unlike existing methods, PriMD takes an intra-modal perspective and focuses on how different types of information within a modality differ in recoverability within each modality. PriMD first disentangles cross-modal shared semantics from modality-specific representations, and then discretizes the latter into learnable semantic primitives to construct modality-specific memory banks. When modalities are missing, PriMD is a teacher-student framework that the student model uses the shared semantics of available modalities as queries to dynamically retrieve primitives. It compensates for missing modality-specific information within a constrained memory space and aligns with the teacher model. Extensive experiments on IEMOCAP, CMU-MOSI, and CMU-MOSEI demonstrate that PriMD achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently stronger robustness across a wide range of missing-modality settings, while mitigating the instability caused by holistic feature inference. Our code and project website are available at https://github.com/JiaqiZhang-Sengoku/PriMD and https://jiaqizhang-sengoku.github.io/PriMD/, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了新颖的Primitive Memory Distillation (PriMD)框架，针对多模态情感识别中因模态缺失导致表现不稳定的问题，创新性地通过拆分模态信息与构建记忆库实现鲁棒与高效的信息补全，在多项主流数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 实际应用中，多模态情感识别模型经常遭遇模态缺失，而现有方法多将所有缺失模态作为一个整体处理，未能考虑不同模态中信息的可恢复性差异，导致表征不稳、鲁棒性下降。
AI.method: PriMD框架先将每个模态的信息拆分为跨模态共享语义和模态特有表示两部分，并将模态特有信息离散化为可学习语义元，存储于模态特定的记忆库。当遇到模态缺失时，学生模型用现有模态的共享语义动态检索相应语义元以补足缺失信息，通过教师-学生蒸馏机制保证表征与教师模型对齐。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP、CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI等数据集的大量实验中，PriMD不仅取得了领先的性能，而且在不同缺失模态场景下展现出更好的稳定性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: PriMD有效缓解了因缺失模态整体处理带来的表征不稳问题，通过细粒度内模态蒸馏和记忆检索机制提升了多模态情感识别的鲁棒性与准确性，对现实场景具有重要应用意义。

title: Linguistic Distance Segregates Latent Representations in Automatic Speech Recognition Systems
summary: While automatic speech recognition (ASR) models have achieved remarkable improvements in recent years, performance disparities persist across different speaker populations. One such disparity is for speakers whose first languages (L1) are from families distant from English. This paper investigates the relationship between first language background and English ASR performance. Through empirical analysis, we observe that the correlation between speakers' L1 distance and ASR error rates yields a systematic effect on English Speech, with its strength varying across datasets and models. This association is statistically significant in a follow-up analysis accounting for dataset-level variation in Tweedie mixed-effects models ($p<0.001$ across evaluated models). In addition, analysis of the latent space reveals a L1-based spatial segregation across deeper acoustic layers in the majority of evaluated architectures

AI.tldr: 不同母语背景的说话人在英语ASR（自动语音识别）系统中的表现存在显著差异，尤其是母语与英语语言距离较远时错误率更高。
AI.motivation: 尽管ASR技术进步很大，但不同说话人的识别准确率依然存在差异，尤其对于母语和英语差异较大的说话人。研究动机是分析母语背景对英语ASR表现的影响。
AI.method: 作者通过实证分析，对不同母语背景和英语语音识别错误率之间的关系进行研究，并采用Tweedie混合效应模型分析统计显著性。同时利用声学模型深层的潜在空间考察母语对说话人特征的影响。
AI.result: 发现母语和英语距离越远，ASR错误率越高，这种相关性在多个数据集和模型中均具统计学意义（p<0.001）。且在大部分模型的深层声学特征空间中，不同母语说话人的特征呈现空间隔离。
AI.conclusion: ASR模型在处理母语与英语距离较远的说话人时表现较差，提示今后的ASR开发需关注母语因素带来的影响，从而提高识别的公平性和准确性。

title: Learning Compositional Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding with Synthetic Curriculum
summary: Despite the impressive progress of recent MLLMs on spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG), existing evaluations and training data focus primarily on simple queries. They largely overlook the compositional queries prevalent in real-world scenarios, where a target must be disambiguated by jointly reasoning about its attributes and relations to other entities. To bridge this gap, we propose Compositional Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (CompSTVG), a task that requires models to process complex textual queries where every intertwined attribute and relational cue is essential for disambiguation. To facilitate this task at scale, we build a synthetic data engine that leverages a spatio-temporal scene graph as a difficulty measure and casts difficulty-controlled query synthesis as a constraint programming problem, producing difficulty-graded data for both evaluation and training. Built on this engine, we introduce STVG-CompBench, a benchmark stratified by explicit difficulty levels that jointly capture temporal complexity and spatial interference. Evaluating 11 representative STVG models on STVG-CompBench reveals that current models perform poorly on compositional queries, exhibiting a sharp performance drop that is typically obscured by overall dataset-level averages. We further construct synthetic training data and propose CurrSTVG, a curriculum reinforcement learning framework that delivers consistent gains, with the largest improvements observed on the most challenging compositional queries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的时空视频定位（STVG）的任务CompSTVG，旨在处理包含复杂成分（如属性与关系）的问题，并构建了支持该任务的数据生成引擎和分层基准，实验发现现有模型在该任务上表现不佳，同时作者提出了课程强化学习框架，在提升复杂查询性能上效果显著。
AI.motivation: 现有STVG模型和评测集中于单一、简单查询，未能覆盖真实场景中需要同时推理属性与关系的复杂成分问题，因而难以反映模型实际能力。
AI.method: 作者提出CompSTVG任务，通过约束规划（constraint programming）方法合成出具有明确难度分级的问题/数据，并据此建立了STVG-CompBench基准和用于训练的合成数据，并引入课程强化学习框架CurrSTVG提升模型性能。
AI.result: 在STVG-CompBench上评测了11个代表性STVG模型，结果显示它们在成分复杂的查询上普遍性能大幅下降，提出的CurrSTVG框架能显著提升在复杂查询上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 现有STVG模型在处理复合型问题时存在显著短板，数据和任务表明针对复杂成分推理的专门方法和训练至关重要；课程强化学习等技术有效提升了模型在这类问题上的能力。

title: You Shouldn't Have Asked: A Pragmatics-Inspired Taxonomy for Evaluating LLM Refusals
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Refusals are often treated as face-threatening acts in pragmatics because they can challenge the requester's socially claimed self-image. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained to refuse unsafe and inappropriate requests, and these refusals may harm users when models fail to manage this interactional cost properly. While existing work has mainly approached LLM non-compliance as a safety-alignment outcome, it does not provide a way to evaluate whether LLMs refuse appropriately across different harmful contexts. To study this question, we propose (to our knowledge) the first taxonomy of LLM refusals that is grounded in pragmatic theory. Applying this taxonomy to responses from 16 modern LLMs across 14 harm categories, we find that although models differ in how they refuse, their refusals are overall explicit and strongly morally evaluative, with interactional repair occurring mainly through offering or providing safer alternatives instead of interpersonal facework. This pattern is especially consequential in sensitive harm contexts, where overuse of negative framing may make users feel shamed or provoked, undermining the purpose of safe non-compliance. We therefore call for alignment evaluation that considers not only whether models refuse harmful requests, but also whether they refuse in ways that are contextually adaptive and socially accountable for the interactional consequences of saying no.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于语用学理论的大型语言模型（LLM）拒绝行为分类法，并对16个现代LLM在14种伤害类别下的拒绝响应进行了分析，发现当前LLM的拒绝方式容易造成用户负面情绪，呼吁评估时考虑拒绝的社会影响。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型常被训练以拒绝不安全或不适当的请求，但这种拒绝可能伤害用户感受。以往工作关注模型安全性和顺从度，缺乏辨析模型是否能够在不同有害情境下恰当地拒绝请求的评价框架。
AI.method: 作者提出了第一个基于语用学理论的LLM拒绝行为分类法，并将其应用于16种现代LLM在14种有害场景下的拒绝响应分析。
AI.result: 分析结果显示，不同模型在拒绝方式上存在差异，但大多数拒绝都相对直接且带有强烈道德评判色彩，较少体现人际情感安抚，主要通过提供安全替代方案而非关注用户面子进行互动修复。尤其在敏感情境下，过度负面的拒绝容易引发用户羞耻或被激怒。
AI.conclusion: 未来LLM安全性对齐评估应不仅关注模型是否拒绝有害请求，还要关注拒绝方式是否具备情境适应性和社会责任，减少对用户的负面影响。

title: DiffSAC: Diffusion-guided Sampling for Consensus-based Robust Estimation
summary: Robust estimation is a core computer vision task frequently tackled using sample consensus. However, traditional methods suffer from inefficient sampling as they struggle to identify effective minimum sets before hypothesis evaluation. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Diffusion-guided Sampling for Consensus-based Robust Estimation (DiffSAC) framework. DiffSAC introduces a diffusion model to learn the distribution of effective minimum sets. It refines the confidence for each data point, indicating whether it belongs to a good minimum set, rather than ranking the data points as in previous work. This significantly reduces the need to process numerous bad sets. To constrain the refinement direction, geometric features are incorporated as conditions within our diffusion model. Consequently, DiffSAC outputs a small number of high-quality minimum sets, enabling identification of the best hypothesis via consensus evaluation. Notably, compared to previous works requiring evaluating over ten thousand hypotheses, DiffSAC achieves state-of-the-art performance with only dozens, significantly boosting efficiency. Extensive experiments across five classic computer vision tasks demonstrate the superiority of DiffSAC. The diffusion model's sampling accelerators enable real-time operation, and DiffSAC can be used as a plug-and-play module to improve existing sample consensus methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合扩散模型的采样方法（DiffSAC），能大幅提高计算机视觉中基于一致性的鲁棒估计效率和准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统的一致性采样方法在选取有效的最小样本集时效率低下，需要评估大量劣质假设。如何提升采样效率、减少无效计算成为核心挑战。
AI.method: 作者提出DiffSAC框架，引入扩散模型学习有效最小样本集的分布，并用几何特征引导模型优化数据点置信度。DiffSAC输出少量高质量最小集，用于后续一致性评估。扩散模型采样过程得到加速，实现实时推理。
AI.result: DiffSAC相比以往需评估上万假设的方法，仅需评估几十个假设就能达到最佳效果，在五个经典视觉任务上获得SOTA表现，显著提高鲁棒估计效率。
AI.conclusion: DiffSAC不仅提升了鲁棒估计效率与准确性，还能作为即插即用模块集成进现有方法中，为计算机视觉任务带来实用的效率与性能提升。

title: Beyond Good Intentions: When Does the Framing of Multilingual and Low-Resource NLP Research Become a Caricature?
summary: Building language technologies and conducting NLP research for low-resource languages---particularly when led by native speakers or involving participatory research practices---are often framed as means of addressing inequality, serving local communities, and, at times, contributing to *decolonisation*. In this paper, we examine recently published NLP and ML papers, focusing on the narratives used to characterise multilinguality, low-resource languages, and underrepresented cultures. We propose a framework for analysing research framings and identify recurring rhetorical patterns that may hinder accountability and constrain equitable knowledge production for---and by---underserved communities. We further assess the evidential basis of assertions regarding community benefit and find that such statements are often weakly supported or left unsubstantiated. Although community ownership and participation are frequently presented as key objectives, our analysis, supported by statistics from the ACL Anthology, suggests that research outputs more often prioritise resource creation and benchmarking---important but distinct goals---over evidence of broader structural change. We conclude by offering practical recommendations to help authors, reviewers, and readers critically assess these assertions and avoid potentially misleading framings.

AI.tldr: 本文分析近年来NLP与机器学习领域关于多语种、低资源语言和弱势文化的论文叙述方式，提出分析框架，指出常见的修辞模式和证据不足的问题，并给出改进建议。
AI.motivation: 推动低资源语言NLP研究常以解决不平等、社区服务和去殖民化为动机，呼吁更公平知识生产，但这些目标实现与宣称之间存在差距。
AI.method: 审查ACL Anthology等数据库中的相关论文，分析其中有关多语种、低资源语言及少数文化的叙述方式与修辞框架，并对涉及社区利益的陈述进行证据基础评估。
AI.result: 研究发现，论文常用强调社区参与与利益的修辞，但具体证据缺乏，更多关注资源和基线建设而非结构性变革，社区受益的主张常在实证上站不住脚。
AI.conclusion: 建议作者、审稿人和读者批判性地分析相关主张，避免被不充分或误导性的话语框架影响，为低资源语言社区带来更实际和可衡量的益处。

title: OCR-Based Field Extraction for Archaeological Pottery Metadata: The CENTURIA Dataset
summary: Pottery is a primary source for reconstructing the chronological and economic dimensions of past societies. Archaeologists often document ceramic finds through technical drawings and handwritten metadata. This metadata is critical for dating, provenance attribution, and cross-site comparison, but remains inaccessible to computational analysis, requiring manual transcription of every record. We investigate whether state-of-the-art document analysis models can address this task, and introduce CENTURIA, a dataset of 507 pottery records from the Roman site of Carnuntum, providing transcriptions, bounding boxes, and structured field-level labels across seven metadata categories. Benchmarking five OCR models reveals a substantial domain gap: zero-shot transcription error reaches 15-32% SpACER-M, far exceeding rates on printed archival documents, with domain-specific fields recovered in fewer than 3% of cases. LoRA fine-tuning on just 57 samples, reflecting a realistic archival annotation budget, closes this gap, reducing transcription error to below 1.5% and recovering overall field-level accuracy above 87%. Our results show that a small expert-validated fine-tuning set suffices to convert handwritten pottery documentation into structured, searchable metadata ready for archaeological databases.

AI.tldr: 本论文探讨了用先进文档分析模型自动化考古陶器手写元数据转录和结构化的可能性，提出了CENTURIA数据集，并通过小规模微调显著提升了转录与域特定信息提取的准确率。
AI.motivation: 陶器的手绘图纸及手写元数据是考古工作中重建年代、来源、经济活动的重要资料，但目前这些资料难以被计算机直接分析，需要人工转录，既耗时又难以扩展。提升转录自动化水平可大幅提高考古资料的信息化进程。
AI.method: 作者构建了CENTURIA数据集（含507份罗马遗址陶器元数据手稿），涵盖转录文本、定位框及7类结构化字段标签。基准实验测试了5种OCRT模型的零样本表现，并利用仅57份专家标注样本对SpACER-M模型做了LoRA微调，比较了微调带来的性能变化。
AI.result: 零样本OCR模型在陶器手写元数据上的转录误差高达15-32%，特定领域字段正确提取率低于3%。而仅用57份专家标注样本微调后，模型转录误差降至1.5%以下，字段准确率提升至87%以上。
AI.conclusion: 通过少量专家标注数据和微调，先进OCR模型可以有效地将大量考古陶器手写文档转化为结构化、可检索的元数据，为数字化考古数据库建设提供支持。

title: Personas Differ from Native-Language Generation: Language Pathways Shape LLM Interpersonal Advice
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 36 pages, 24 figures, 17 tables (9 pages main text; remainder references and appendices)
summary: LLMs are increasingly used for interpersonal advice and as tools for studying social behavior across languages and cultures. A common shortcut for eliciting language- or culture-related variation is to ask a model to answer as a native speaker. We test whether this native-speaker persona reproduces the outputs obtained when models instead generate advice in the target language and translate the response back into English. Using 600 interpersonal advice questions across 13 languages and eight LLMs, we compare native-language generation followed by translation (NL) with native-speaker persona prompting (NP), measuring linguistic style, behavioral scaffolding, and forced-choice action recommendations. We find that NP and NL are not interchangeable. Compared to NL, NP often increases lexical social cues, including affiliation and positive tone, while reducing qualities such as concreteness and social attunement; NP also provides less actionable scaffolding in open-ended advice. In forced-choice scenarios, NP changes which action the model selects, favoring confrontation over redirection, with effect sizes varying across languages, topics, and models. Our results show that cross-lingual elicitation strategy is a consequential methodological choice that can change both how advice is framed and which actions models recommend.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了大语言模型（LLMs）在两种不同跨语种建议生成策略下的表现，发现‘以母语者身份回答’和‘母语生成并翻译’方法结果显著不同。
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs广泛用于提供人际建议及社会行为研究，常用方法是提示模型以某语言母语者身份回答，但这种方式是否真的反映目标语言的社会行为特征仍存疑问。
AI.method: 作者针对13种语言、使用8个LLM，对600个人际建议问题，分别采用‘母语生成后翻译’（NL）和‘母语者身份’（NP）两种提示方式，比较了其在语言风格、行为引导、行动推荐上的表现差异。
AI.result: 结果发现，NP相较于NL会增加词汇中的社会线索（如亲和力、积极语气），但降低具体性和社会趋同度，且提供的建议较少具操作性。在选择性问题上，NP更倾向于建议对抗行为而非转移话题。
AI.conclusion: 不同的跨语种提示策略会实质性地影响LLM建议的表达方式及其推荐的行为，提示研究者应慎重选择方法，这对社会行为研究和实际应用都有重要影响。

title: RealCAD: Towards Real-World Image-to-CAD Reconstruction under Domain Shift and Parameter Bias
comment: The code and dataset are publicly available. Code: https://github.com/sunyh39/RealCAD. Dataset: https://www.modelscope.cn/datasets/yeguomao/RealCAD
summary: Reconstructing editable Computer-Aided Design (CAD) models from images is essential for downstream modification, manufacturing, and design reuse. However, existing image-to-CAD methods are developed predominantly on synthetic renderings and face two coupled obstacles: a substantial appearance domain gap between synthetic and real images, and a previously overlooked parameter bias in widely used CAD data. We show that the local normalization adopted by DeepCAD concentrates several geometric parameters around a few discrete values while encoding substantial information in a single scale factor. Consequently, a model can achieve deceptively high parameter accuracy by exploiting these frequent values rather than inferring geometry from the input image. In this paper, we propose RealCAD, a unified framework that addresses these limitations at the representation, image, and feature levels. At the representation level, we redistribute scale information to the corresponding geometric parameters, producing less concentrated parameter distributions in a shared scale space. At the image level, geometry-constrained translation converts synthetic renderings toward the real-image domain while conditioning on object contours. At the feature level, a multi-positive contrastive objective aligns representations of the same CAD model across viewpoints and image domains, enabling CAD sequence prediction from each individual view. We further introduce OpenRealCAD, comprising four-view photographs of 392 3D-printed objects paired with ground-truth command sequences. Experiments show that the revised representation substantially reduces the accuracy attainable from parameter-frequency priors, making parameter accuracy a more reliable measure of image-conditioned geometric inference. RealCAD further improves real-domain command and parameter accuracy, while retaining competitive synthetic-domain performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为RealCAD的统一框架，用于从图片重建可编辑的CAD模型，解决了现有方法对真实图像适应性差和参数偏置的问题，并提供了新的真实图像数据集OpenRealCAD。
AI.motivation: 现有的image-to-CAD方法主要基于合成渲染图，存在与真实图像的域差异以及因CAD参数分布不均导致的模型推理偏置，从而影响CAD模型的后续编辑与应用。
AI.method: RealCAD在三个层面解决问题：1）表现层面，将缩放信息重新分配到几何参数，降低参数集中度；2）图像层面，几何约束的风格迁移把合成图像转换为接近真实图像；3）特征层面，多正样本对比目标对齐不同视角和域的同一CAD模型特征，并能多视角下推理出命令序列。此外，构建了OpenRealCAD数据集（含真实照片和真值命令序列）。
AI.result: 实验证明，优化后的参数表示方式降低了依赖参数分布频率的虚高准确率，使参数准确度更能真实反映模型推理能力。RealCAD进一步提升了真实图像域中的命令及参数准确率，同时在合成图像域也保持了竞争力。
AI.conclusion: RealCAD有效缓解了image-to-CAD领域在真实图像和参数偏置上的不足，提升了方法在实际应用场景下的可靠性和准确率，并为后续研究提供了真实场景的新数据集。

title: Evaluating and Mitigating Anti-LGBTQ Biases in German and Multilingual Language Models
summary: While gender and racial biases in language models have been widely studied, anti-LGBTQ biases remain underexplored, particularly beyond English. Existing benchmarks often do not capture cultural and linguistic variation and rely on gender representations. This paper introduces a multilingual German-English benchmark dataset for the evaluation of anti-LGBTQ biases in language models. It combines community-sourced stereotypes from German-speaking queer individuals with a German translation of WinoQueer. The data is used to evaluate eight language models across sizes and architectures and explore mitigation through fine-tuning on community and progressive media content. Results show that language models reproduce anti-queer stereotypes, with variation across identities and models. Differences between the translated and community-based data highlight the importance of cultural adaptation for multilingual bias evaluation. Fine-tuning reduces bias on average, but not consistently across models and identities. Warning: This text contains examples of anti-queer hateful language and stereotypes.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一个德英双语的反LGBTQ偏见评测数据集，并用其分析八款语言模型的偏见表现及缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 现有关于语言模型性别和种族偏见的研究较多，但对LGBTQ群体的偏见关注不足，尤其是非英语语境。此外，现有评测集缺乏文化和语言多样性，且多依赖于性别表现。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个包括德语和英语的多语言反LGBTQ偏见基准数据集，数据来源包括德语LGBTQ群体提交的刻板印象和WinoQueer德语翻译本。使用该数据集对八种不同规模和架构的语言模型进行偏见评估，并尝试通过社区和进步媒体内容微调模型以缓解偏见。
AI.result: 结果显示，主流语言模型均会再现反LGBTQ刻板印象，且对不同身份和模型表现不同。翻译数据与社区原生数据的结果差异显示文化适配对多语偏见评测很重要。微调方法能平均降低偏见，但不同模型和身份上的效果并不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 多语言和文化适配对于公正性评估至关重要，微调可减缓部分偏见，但难以覆盖所有情况。未来需关注不同语言、文化情景下的LGBTQ群体偏见问题和评测方式。

title: AQ3D: Adaptive Query Transformer for 3D Instance Segmentation
summary: Transformer-based decoders for 3D instance segmentation typically commit to a fixed number of queries and positional modeling calibrated on the training distribution rather than on the scene at hand. Indoor scans vary widely in spatial extent and object count, so a fixed query set over-initializes small scenes and under-initializes large ones, while learned absolute and relative encodings are bound to the training scenes' extents and can saturate. We present AQ3D, which is designed to handle scenes of various sizes during training and inference. Queries are instantiated at a fixed ratio of the scene's superpoints, forming an overcomplete set whose background rejection is entirely left to the decoder. Positional information is encoded using 3D RoPE over quantized metric coordinates, replacing learned bounded lookup tables of prior decoders. Further, we improve the decoder itself by using attribution-based superpoint pooling, a mask refinement branch, and a cosine classifier for background rejection. Experiments show our method sets a new state-of-the-art on validation and hidden test splits across the datasets ScanNetV2, ScanNet200, and ScanNet++V2 among decoder methods trained without additional data augmentation. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/kenomo/aq3d}{github.com/kenomo/aq3d}.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了AQ3D，一种能适应不同场景规模的3D实例分割transformer解码器，显著提升了分割性能，并在多个主流数据集上取得新SOTA表现。
AI.motivation: 现有3D实例分割transformer解码器采用固定数量的query和与训练场景绑定的位置信息编码，导致在不同大小和复杂度的场景中表现不佳：小场景query过多，浪费资源；大场景query不足，难以覆盖所有实例。
AI.method:
1. 按场景分割得到的superpoint固定比例生成query，自动适应不同场景规模。
2. 采用3D RoPE于量化坐标代替固定表的位置信息编码，支持更大空间。
3. 引入归因型superpoint pooling、掩码精修分支和余弦分类器以增强分割性能和背景剔除效果。
AI.result: 在ScanNetV2、ScanNet200、ScanNet++V2等数据集的验证集及隐藏测试集上，AQ3D在未采用额外数据增广的情况下，分割精度超过现有所有decoder方法。
AI.conclusion: AQ3D系统性改进了解码器架构和位置编码机制，使其具有良好的场景泛化能力和分割精度，为3D实例分割解码器树立了新的技术标杆。

title: ECGQuest: Benchmarking and Fine-Tuning Language Models for Electrocardiography
summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation requires knowledge of cardiology, electrophysiology, clinical diagnosis, ECG waveforms, signal acquisition, and instrumentation. Existing language-model benchmarks, however, primarily assess broad medical knowledge or interpretation of individual ECG signals and images rather than the broader contextual knowledge required for ECG interpretation. We developed ECGQuest, a literature-grounded resource for evaluating and fine-tuning ECG-specific language models. A GPT-4o-based pipeline generated questions from 23 ECG references and Computing in Cardiology proceedings from 2003-2025. The final dataset contains 10,904 unique True/False questions paired with their negated forms (21,808 Q&A pairs). We evaluated three commercial and 20 open-source language models on a held-out test set in a zero-shot setting. Five open-source models with 7-14B parameters were fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation, with BERT and BiomedBERT included as supervised encoder baselines. Generalization was assessed on ECG-related subsets of MedMCQA and MedQA converted to binary True/False questions using official answer keys. Zero-shot accuracy on ECGQuest ranged from 49.5% to 74.4%, with GPT-5 performing best. General-purpose models outperformed medically specialized models, several models showed strong True/False bias, and encoder baselines performed near chance. Fine-tuning improved all open-source models by 6.5-14.1%. Fine-tuned DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B reached 76.3% accuracy, while a five-model voting ensemble reached 78.5%. On MedMCQA and MedQA, fine-tuning mainly benefited weaker or class-biased models and did not consistently improve strong base models. ECGQuest provides a reproducible benchmark for contextual ECG knowledge and shows that parameter-efficient fine-tuning can make smaller language models competitive with substantially larger commercial models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ECGQuest数据集，用于评估和微调心电图（ECG）领域的专用大语言模型，通过生成大量基于文献的判断题，对多种模型的能力进行了系统评测。
AI.motivation: 心电图（ECG）解读不仅需要医学基础知识，还涉及专业的上下文和信号信息，而现有的语言模型评测数据集多偏向广义医学知识或单一信号解读，缺乏全面、真实反映心电图解读需求的数据资源。为此，作者希望开发一个专门的、具备文献依据的基准，用于细致评估和促进AI模型在ECG领域的能力提升。
AI.method: 作者基于23份ECG参考文献和计算心脏病年会论文，使用GPT-4o自动生成了10904条唯一的判断题，及其反义问法，组成总计21808对问答数据集。对3个商业和20个开源语言模型进行了零样本测试，部分开源模型通过LoRA高效微调，并设计投票集成等提升策略。此外，将MedMCQA和MedQA部分相关题目转化为一致的二元判断，以考察模型泛化能力。
AI.result: 在ECGQuest测试中，零样本准确率为49.5%至74.4%，以GPT-5表现最佳。通用模型胜于医疗专用模型，部分存在明显判断偏向。开源模型经LoRA微调后，准确率提升6.5%至14.1%；最佳微调模型准确率76.3%，五模型投票集成提升至78.5%。但在泛化到其他医学题库时，微调主要提升了本身较弱或偏向明显的模型，对强基模型提升有限。
AI.conclusion: ECGQuest为AI心电图解读能力提供了高复现性评测基准，并表明通过参数高效微调，小型开源模型能逼近甚至媲美大型商业模型，对领域特定AI模型的发展具有重要推动作用。

title: Cost-efficient Active Learning for Referring Image Segmentation and Grounding
summary: Collecting natural-language referring expressions along with region annotations, such as masks or boxes, is a major bottleneck in visual grounding (VG), as annotators must write descriptions that distinguish target regions from visually similar ones. We tackle this by formulating active learning (AL) for VG under the realistic setting where only raw images are available without accompanying text. Since ground-truth text is unavailable, sample selection must estimate which images contain ambiguous regions that would require discriminative referring expressions. To address this, we generate auxiliary region-text pairs using foundation models, and introduce Referred Region Ambiguity, a new acquisition function that measures whether the model's confidence collapses onto a single region or disperses across multiple candidates. It allows our method to prioritize images with strong cross-region competition, which are more informative due to their visual ambiguity. We also design a referring-expression annotation interface that helps annotators quickly focus on writing discriminative language with a few clicks. Experiments on RIS and REC benchmarks show that our AL framework consistently outperforms several AL baselines, while a user study shows up to 1.6X faster description labeling of ours.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于仅有原始图像、无文本数据情境下的主动学习视觉指代方法，通过生成辅助区域-文本对和引入全新样本筛选准则，实现更高效的数据采集和标注。
AI.motivation: 以往视觉指代任务中，需要人工为图像中目标区域撰写可区分的文本描述，标注成本高、效率低。亟需能在缺乏文本标注时高效筛选和采集标注数据的方法。
AI.method: 作者将主动学习方法应用于视觉指代任务，并针对没文本的现实场景，通过基础模型预生成区域-文本对。提出“指代区域歧义性”采集函数，通过度量模型输出在多区域间的置信度分布，优先选择视觉歧义性强的样本。还设计了辅助标注的界面，帮助标注员更快生成区分性描述。
AI.result: 在RIS和REC两个标准基准上的实验表明，新方法主动学习框架在样本选择和模型性能上均优于已有的主动学习方法。同时，用户测试显示该方法的标注速度最高可提升1.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 提出的主动学习方案能有效减少视觉指代数据采集的人力成本，提升标注效率，并有助于高效构建视觉指代样本集。

title: Low-Resource Preference Adaptation of LLMs via Activation-Based Label Propagation
summary: Adapting large language models to user-specific preferences is often constrained by the cost of human annotation, making preference optimisation impractical in low-resource settings where preferences cannot be reliably labelled by LLMs themselves, e.g., due to cultural, subjective, or personalised contexts. In this paper, we investigate how language models encode preference information in their intermediate representations, finding that activations from chosen and rejected responses form distinct clusters across layers, even in pretrained models. Strikingly, this structure is strengthened by alignment on canonical datasets but erased when the target preferences differ from those the model was aligned on, suggesting aligned LLMs are poor judges for non-mainstream populations. Exploiting this structure, we propose training a lightweight linear probe on a few labelled preference pairs ($\leq$500) and using it to annotate large unlabelled datasets (50K+) for downstream preference optimisation. We systematically evaluate this approach across different datasets, preference optimisation methods and model scales and find that our method consistently outperforms direct training given the same annotation budget, and remains competitive against baselines trained on $50-100\times$ more labelled data in the majority of our settings. Code is available at https://github.com/alessioGalatolo/activ-pref-probe.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种利用大模型中激活层结构，通过少量标注数据训练线性探针实现偏好标注扩展的新方法，有效提升偏好定制效率，适用于低资源或主流外场景。
AI.motivation: 将大语言模型（LLM）适配到用户特定偏好的过程中，传统方法依赖大量人工标注，耗时耗力，且LLM自身在特定文化、主观、定制化情境下难以准确自动标注，尤其在低资源场景下显得不切实际。本研究旨在突破标注瓶颈，提高偏好定制的实用性。
AI.method: 作者分析LLM中激活层对偏好的表征，发现对比选择与拒绝回应在激活层中可分为不同聚类，并提出用少量（≤500对）标注偏好对训练轻量级线性探针，然后用其为大规模（50K+）无标注数据自动标注偏好，进而用于偏好优化训练。
AI.result: 实验证明，用同等标注预算，探针标注扩展方法在多个数据集、不同偏好优化手段和多种模型规模下都优于直接训练法，并能在绝大多数情况下达到用50-100倍标注数据训练所得的基线水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过分析激活空间结构，结合线性探针技术，可极大提升偏好标注效率，尤其适合处理标签稀缺或非主流人群偏好，有望扩大LLM的适用范围与定制潜力。

title: Quantum-Grassmann-Plucker Token Mixing for Deep Learning-Based Post-Disaster Damage Assessment
summary: Timely post-disaster building damage assessment from satellite imagery is a critical engineering decision support task, yet it remains constrained by class imbalance, ambiguous intermediate damage states, and limited cross-event transferability. This study presents, to our knowledge, the first application of Grassmann-Plucker (GP) token mixing to computer vision and introduces two extensions for image classification: the Quantum-inspired Grassmann-Plucker (QGP) head and the Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning Grassmann-Plucker (HQML-GP) head. The GP head represents multiscale relationships among image patch tokens by encoding subspaces formed by token pairs with Plucker coordinates; QGP enriches these coordinates with amplitude-derived probability features, whereas HQML-GP incorporates expectation values generated by a simulated quantum circuit into the geometric token representation. Paired pre- and post-event image patches from the xBD tornado dataset were processed using a frozen six-channel Vision Transformer base encoder with 16 x 16-pixel patches. The three GP-based heads were compared with multilayer perceptron and Transformer baselines under identical training, checkpoint selection, and evaluation protocols. Joplin and Moore tornado samples were used for model development and seen-event testing, while Tuscaloosa was reserved for unseen-event evaluation. QGP led both test sets in accuracy and macro-F1: 83.46% and 64.50% for the seen events, and 66.45% and 52.70% for the unseen event. Although HQML-GP obtained the highest validation macro-F1 of 65.63%, it did not surpass QGP on either test set and required substantially more training time per epoch. These results establish GP token mixing as a competitive attention-free alternative to conventional Transformer-based token mixing for paired satellite image damage classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了草曼-普鲁克（GP）混合机制，并首次将其应用于卫星图像中的建筑损伤自动识别任务。通过与主流神经网络方法对比，显示其在已见与未见灾害事件测试中均有优异表现。
AI.motivation: 灾后建筑损伤评估依赖遥感影像，面临类别不平衡、损伤状态模糊、模型迁移性差等实际难题，亟需新的方法提升模型表现与泛化能力。
AI.method: 设计了三种以Grassmann-Plucker为核心的token混合头，包括GP、QGP（引入幅值-概率特征）以及HQML-GP（引入量子线路输出期望值），并在六通道Vision Transformer编码器基础上，处理xBD龙卷风数据集的灾前后配对图像块，和MLP、Transformer等基线网络在统一条件下进行公平对比。
AI.result: QGP在已见事件（准确率83.46%、宏F1为64.50%）与未见事件（准确率66.45%、宏F1为52.70%）上均优于GP与HQML-GP，且HQML-GP虽然验证集macro-F1最高，但在测试集上未超越QGP，也消耗更多训练时间。
AI.conclusion: GP混合机制为遥感图像分类提供了一种关注力机制以外的有竞争力的新选择，尤其在真实灾害跨事件识别场景下表现突出。

title: MMDS-Bench: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models on Dynamic Stance in Social Media Interactions
summary: Dynamic stance classification models how a reply responds to its direct parent message, rather than how a post relates to a fixed topic. Existing work has mainly studied this problem in text-only settings, while social media interactions increasingly rely on images, screenshots, memes, reaction images, and cross-modal references. We introduce MMDS-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for multimodal dynamic stance classification in social media parent-reply interactions. MMDS-Bench contains 3,482 multimodal instances annotated with a seven-label dynamic stance taxonomy, together with an 800-instance diagnostic subset that requires structured reasoning over parent understanding, reply understanding, and stance-relation inference. We further annotate each instance with five challenge factors covering multimodal fusion, parent framing, non-literal expression, interaction reasoning, and label-boundary ambiguity. We evaluate 12 closed-source and open-source multimodal large language models and propose a reference-grounded LLM-judge protocol for assessing reasoning quality. Results show that current MLLMs still struggle with multimodal dynamic stance understanding, especially in cases that require relational inference beyond separate parent and reply comprehension.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MMDS-Bench数据集，用于社交媒体中多模态动态立场分类，并评估当前多模态大模型的表现，指出其在复杂推理任务中的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有动态立场分类主要聚焦文本，忽略了社交媒体上图像、表情包等多模态信息。随着社交媒体互动日趋多样与复杂，研究多模态下的动态立场分类具有必要性。
AI.method: 作者构建了MMDS-Bench多模态动态立场分类基准，包括3482个带有七类立场标签的样本及800个需要复杂推理的子集，并标注了五种挑战因素。评估了12种大模型表现，并提出了参考-对齐的LLM-judge评估方案。
AI.result: 结果显示当前的多模态大语言模型对于复杂的多模态动态立场分类仍能力不足，特别是在需要超越单独父/回复理解的关系推理场景下表现欠佳。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明现有多模态大模型在复杂社交多模态互动理解上有明显短板，MMDS-Bench为相关研究提供了数据与评测标准，推动领域发展。

title: Fine-Grained Multi Image Object Hallucination Benchmark
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-image scenarios requiring complex reasoning across visual contexts. However, current MLLMs remain fundamentally limited by object hallucination-generating plausible yet factually inconsistent descriptions about objects. Existing benchmarks, designed primarily for single-image settings or providing only high-level multi-image assessments, cannot systematically diagnose how visual complexity and reasoning demands trigger hallucination. To address this gap, we introduce MIOH, a fine-grained multi-image object hallucination benchmark that systematically evaluates object hallucination across four foundational tasks (existence, counting, attribute, position) through three multi-image reasoning patterns (comprehensive, comparative, selective) under three controlled adversarial pressures (visual context scale, perceptual difficulty, contextual bias). Through evaluation of 29 models, we reveal that even state-of-the-art systems like GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5-Pro exhibit distinct failure patterns across different reasoning patterns and tasks. Our evaluation reveals that hallucination stems not merely from perceptual failures but from integration-stage limitations when maintaining object representations across multiple images. MIOH provides a controlled framework for analyzing multi-image object hallucination and serves as a critical evaluation tool for developing more reliable multimodal AI systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了MIOH基准，用于细致评估多模态大模型在多图像场景中对象幻觉的问题，发现主流模型在不同任务和推理模式下存在明显不足。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大模型（MLLMs）虽然能处理多图像场景下的复杂推理，但会生成与事实不符的对象描述（即“对象幻觉”）。现有的评价基准主要针对单图像或粗略评估多图像，对幻觉问题的触发机制缺乏系统性分析。
AI.method: 作者提出了MIOH基准，涵盖存在性、计数、属性、位置四项基础任务，通过全面、比较、选择三类推理模式，并在人为设计的三种对抗压力下（视觉背景扩大、感知难度、上下文偏置）精细评估对象幻觉。
AI.result: 对29种模型测试，发现包括最先进的GPT-5和Gemini-2.5-Pro在内，都在不同推理和任务下表现出不同的失败特征。幻觉问题不仅仅源自感知错误，更与跨多图像维持对象表征时的整合阶段有关。
AI.conclusion: MIOH为多图像对象幻觉分析提供了可控的评测体系，是提升多模态AI系统可靠性的重要工具。

title: TRIPPULSE: Multi-Agent Travel Planning with Review-Grounded Reasoning
summary: Travel itinerary generation requires balancing strict spatio-temporal constraints with human preferences. Existing LLM-based planners mainly rely on structured attributes and pre- defined traveler personas, but real travel deci- sions are often shaped by reviews that reveal experiential factors such as comfort, safety, ser- vice quality, ambiance, crowding, and hidden risks absent from structured databases. Incor- porating such review information is therefore critical to realistic, user-centric itinerary gen- eration. We propose TRIPPULSE1, a multi- agent framework for review-grounded travel planning. Instead of relying on a monolithic planner (and face context and reasoning bot- tlenecks), TRIPPULSE2 decomposes itinerary generation into specialized agents (each op- erating over localized contexts) for accom- modations, transportation, meals, attractions, and events, coordinated through a global or- chestrator with scheduling mechanisms that enforce temporal and budget feasibility. We augment TRIPCRAFT with 100K+ real-world reviews and introduce Review-Grounded Per- sona Alignment (RGPA), an LLM-as-a-Judge metric for evaluating alignment with human- centric travel experiences. Experiments across multiple trip durations and diverse proprietary and open-source models show that TRIPPULSE maintains strong constraint satisfaction while generating more personalized and experien- tially grounded itineraries.

AI.tldr: 提出了TRIPPULSE，一个基于多智能体并结合用户评价的旅行行程生成框架，能根据真实用户体验生成更个性化、符合人类偏好的行程。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM旅行行程规划方法主要依赖结构化数据和预设的用户画像，无法利用大量用户评价中包含的体验性信息（如舒适度、安全性等），导致难以生成真实、以用户为中心的行程。
AI.method: TRIPPULSE通过多智能体分工（住宿、交通、餐饮、景点、活动）处理行程生成，每一智能体在本地上下文中工作，由全局协调器进行调度，保障时空与预算约束。同时，数据中加入了10万+真实评论，并提出了Review-Grounded Persona Alignment(RGPA)指标，用LLM判断行程对用户体验的契合度。
AI.result: 跨多样化模型和不同行程长度的实验显示，TRIPPULSE既能很好满足约束，又能生成更个性化、体验感更强的行程。
AI.conclusion: 结合用户评论并采用多智能体架构，可以有效提升行程规划的个性化和用户体验对齐度，是更现实和用户导向的方案。

title: APT: Anchor-aligned Perturbations for Tamper Localization in Fully Regenerated Images
summary: Proactive tamper localization embeds an imperceptible signal into an image prior to distribution, enabling pixel-level manipulation detection. Existing methods assume a spliced (SP) setting, where synthesized regions are composited onto the original background, leaving embedded signals intact. However, real-world diffusion-based inpainting operates in a fully regenerated (FR) setting, where the entire image undergoes denoising, disrupting background signals and rendering existing frameworks ineffective. We propose APT, a semi-fragile latent-space perturbation that embeds a dense, vector-wise localization signal. By aligning each spatial feature vector toward a fixed anchor direction, APT localizes tampering via the alignment disparity between synthesized foreground and anchor-aligned background features after inpainting. The proposed hard negative mining loss and noisy perturbation branch further enforce uniform alignment. Experiments on COCO demonstrate that APT achieves an FR IoU of 0.92, outperforming the strongest baseline (WAM, 0.84), while existing methods collapse to near-random performance (AUC 0.5), establishing APT as a practical forensic framework generalizable across tampering types unknown at test time.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新方法APT，针对生成式修补下的篡改定位任务，显著提升了检测准确率，尤其在以往方法失效的全图再生场景下表现优越。
AI.motivation: 现有篡改定位方法大多假设篡改区域仅为合成(foreground)拼接，原始图像背景信号不变。但真实生成式修补（如基于扩散模型的图像补全）会重生成整个图像，导致信号丢失，现有方法完全失效。因此迫切需要适用于全图再生场景的篡改检测新方法。
AI.method: 提出APT方法：在分发前，将细粒度、基于向量的定位信号嵌入图像特征空间。通过使每个空间特征向量与固定锚点方向对齐，篡改检测时，比较合成前景与背景的方向差异即可定位篡改区域。为提升鲁棒性，设计了难样本挖掘损失和添加噪声扰动分支，强化对齐效果。
AI.result: 实验在COCO数据集上验证APT方法，FR IoU达到0.92，超越最佳基线WAM（0.84），而以往方法在全图再生场景下几乎退化为随机（AUC仅0.5）。
AI.conclusion: APT为实际的图像取证和篡改检测提供了新的有效框架，特别适用于当前主流生成式修补等复杂篡改类型，并具备较强泛化性。

title: Annotated Surrogate Retrieval for Polish Statutory Law
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/OryCore/Research
summary: We present a family of retrieval methods for Polish statutory law built on document surrogates: language-model annotations attached to statutory articles at index time. Three designs occupy different points on the cost-quality frontier. ASCR is a surrogate cascade with reranking; ASCR-H fuses a dense list into that cascade; and DTF replaces both language-model stages with three lexical and dense retrievers, weighted reciprocal rank fusion, and a deterministic re-scoring prior, using no model call before generation. We evaluate all three against fourteen lexical, dense, fused and ablated baselines plus four controls, on 300 questions from the 2024 and 2025 Polish bar and legal counsel entrance examinations (264 with their reference article in the corpus), over 82,508 articles from 1,133 acts. On paired McNemar tests, ASCR-H places the reference provision at rank one significantly more often than every other non-oracle configuration except one of its own ablations (eighteen of twenty comparisons significant in its favour at p < 0.005), reaching 72.3% against 61.7% for BM25 and 52.3% for dense retrieval. The advantage is concentrated at the head and does not survive depth: it is significant at cutoffs of one and five, disappears by ten, and by twenty DTF leads on point estimate (86.0% versus 84.5%) at one ninth the latency and less than half the cost. Ablation attributes 27.6 points of rank-one accuracy to the reranking stage alone. We further report that the ranking advantage does not extend to citation accuracy, where DTF matches the oracle ceiling, and three negative results on lemmatisation, pseudo-relevance feedback and query rewriting. Surrogate annotation covers 27.0% of the corpus but every reference provision in the benchmark, an asymmetry we disclose and discuss. Benchmark, per-question outputs and paired significance tests are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了三种用于波兰成文法检索的方法，针对法条级别进行文档代理（surrogate）标注。通过在真实法律考试数据集上的对比实验，显示新方法在效率和准确性上优于传统和先进基线。
AI.motivation: 针对波兰成文法检索，现有方法在准确性和效率上存在瓶颈，尤其难以高效、准确定位参考条款。本文旨在通过引入文档代理和语言模型标注提升检索质量。
AI.method: 设计三种检索方法：ASCR（级联+重排序）、ASCR-H（融合密集表示）、DTF（多检索器+无模型call的加权融合）。在大规模波兰法条集上，以2024和2025年法律考试真实问题测试，并与14个基线模型及4个对照组进行系统对比。
AI.result: ASCR-H在找到标准条款时，rank-1准确率达72.3%，显著高于BM25（61.7%）和dense retrieval（52.3%），且在McNemar检验下大多数情形显著优于基线。重排序阶段贡献最大。优势主要体现在Top-1/Top-5，但在更深cutoff处被DTF追过且DTF延迟与成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 文档代理结合级联系统显著提升法律条款检索首位准确率。优势仅在结果前列有效，深度检索时简化融合方法更优。代理标注能全覆盖基准数据，存在覆盖面与真实应用的不对称性。公开所有基准与输出，便于复现。

title: InfraOcc: An Infrastructure Occupancy Benchmark with Static-to-Dynamic Reasoning
summary: Fixed-viewpoint infrastructure sensors repeatedly observe the same traffic space, making roadside 3D occupancy structurally different from ego-vehicle perception: a near-persistent static scaffold is overlaid with sparse, short-lived dynamic events. Existing occupancy benchmarks and methods, however, are built around moving ego vehicles and neither measure nor exploit this structure, instead treating occupancy as flat one-shot voxel classification. We address this gap from both data and model perspectives. We build InfraOcc, to our knowledge, the first real-world infrastructure-side semantic occupancy benchmark, with dense voxel annotations for 290 multi-modal sequences in a fixed roadside frame, a static-dynamic decoupled annotation pipeline, unified camera-only, LiDAR-only, and multi-modal evaluation, and diagnostics for static and dynamic occupancy. InfraOcc shows that static infrastructure fills 97.3% of occupied voxels and persists across frames, whereas dynamic participants have a median occupied-frame ratio of only 1.8% per location, revealing a structural static-dynamic asymmetry beyond semantic long-tailedness. We further propose ProSD-Occ, which reformulates occupancy as progressive static-to-dynamic evidence reasoning: it explains persistent layout, exposes residual dynamic evidence under static-confidence guidance, and recomposes static, dynamic, and free-space evidence into a unified field. ProSD-Occ ranks first in overall, dynamic, static, and geometric occupancy on every track, e.g., a 23.5% relative camera-only dynamic-mIoU gain over the strongest baseline and 65.87 multi-modal overall mIoU, establishing fixed-viewpoint roadside occupancy as a distinct problem with its own reasoning paradigm. The benchmark and code will be publicly available at https://github.com/yanglei18/InfraOcc

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向固定视角基础设施（道路旁）3D语义占据的真实基准数据集InfraOcc，并引入了区别静态与动态目标的全新建模与评测方法。相比以往基于移动自车视角的研究，本文揭示并利用了道路基础设施观测下静态-动态结构的不对称性。
AI.motivation: 现有3D占据感知方法和基准大多建立在移动自车视角，无法充分刻画和利用基础设施传感器下，场景中静态结构持续存在、动态事件稀疏短暂的特点。因此亟需新的数据集和方法来填补这一领域空白。
AI.method: 1. 构建InfraOcc：收集并密集标注290组固定道路边多模态（摄像头、激光雷达）数据，设计静态-动态分离的标注流程，以及统一的相机、激光、多模态评测策略。2. 提出ProSD-Occ模型，将占据感知建模为“静-动证据渐进推理”，先提取持久静态场景，再在静态置信下识别残余动态目标，并综合静、动、自由空间证据生成最终占据场。
AI.result: InfraOcc统计显示，97.3%的占据体素长期为静态结构，仅1.8%的区域有动态参与者，显著揭示了静-动态结构的不对称性。ProSD-Occ在多个评测标准下明显优于现有方法（如动态mIoU提升23.5%，多模态总体mIoU达65.87），实现了当前最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 道路旁固定视角3D占据感知拥有独特结构和推理方式，亟需区别于传统自车场景的方法。InfraOcc基准和ProSD-Occ方法为该领域提供了新的研究基础和范式。

title: Detecting AI Impostors: How Do Middle Schoolers Identify LLM Agents in a Live Collaborative Setting?
summary: LLMs can imitate how people write, which raises concerns about impersonation, trust, and detection in social settings. These concerns are especially important for adolescents, who use generative AI frequently but may struggle to recognize it. We introduce \textit{DoppelBot}, a cooperative social deduction game designed to study how young people detect and respond to AI impersonation. Through studies with middle schoolers, we investigate whether a DoppelBot prompts reflection on privacy and impersonation, how repeated exposure affects AI-detection accuracy as agents become more personalized, and which strategies students use to identify AI doppelgängers. We find that students' detection accuracy improves over time, driven by a shift from relying on linguistic cues to leveraging shared social and contextual signals. Students also demonstrated an understanding of AI limitations such as embodiment and reflected on broader issues such as data privacy. To support future research, we release an anonymized dataset of game transcripts and voting behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DoppelBot游戏，用于研究青少年如何识别与应对AI伪装，并分析了他们在识别过程中策略的变化。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI（大语言模型）能够模仿人类写作，青少年频繁使用但识别AI能力较弱，这可能导致冒充、信任危机等社会问题，因此有必要研究青少年对AI冒充的识别能力及反应。
AI.method: 设计了名为DoppelBot的合作社会推理游戏，通过与中学生的实验，观察他们在识别AI冒充者时策略和准确率的变化，包括重复参与和AI代理人个性化后的影响。
AI.result: 学生随着游戏进展，识别准确率显著提升，由主要依赖语言特征转向更多利用社交和情境线索；他们也表现出对于AI局限性的理解，并反思数据隐私等更广泛问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过游戏可以增强青少年对AI冒充及相关风险的识别与反思能力，研究还公开了相关数据集以促进后续研究。

title: UFPR-PEs: A Brazilian Face Recognition Benchmark with Self-Declared Race/Color Labels
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 Conference on Graphics, Patterns and Images (SIBGRAPI)
summary: While face recognition systems are widely deployed, ensuring their demographic reliability and robustness under uncontrolled visual conditions remains a critical challenge. To bridge this gap, we present UFPR-PEs, a benchmark for face recognition bias evaluation using public videos of elected Brazilian politicians annotated with official self-declared race/color categories. The dataset adopts the Brazilian census taxonomy, including the parda category, which has no direct equivalent in the U.S.- or Europe-centric schemas commonly used in prior benchmarks. Our benchmark is built from compressed public video and preserves difficult samples so that performance can be analyzed under realistic conditions. We describe the construction pipeline, report dataset statistics, and evaluate face recognition performance across verification and (closed- and open-set) identification settings, including subgroup analysis by race/color and difficulty level. The results show that recognition performance varies substantially with image quality, and that subgroup gaps must be interpreted jointly with visual difficulty rather than in isolation. Overall, UFPR-PEs provides a reproducible and demographically grounded setting for studying face recognition bias under challenging public video conditions.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了UFPR-PEs基准，用于评估人脸识别中的人口统计偏差，数据来自公开的巴西政治家视频，并特别涵盖了巴西独有的人口统计分类。
AI.motivation: 现有的人脸识别系统很容易受到人口统计偏差以及图像质量变差时表现不佳的问题。多数评测基准依赖美欧为中心的分类体系，忽视了如巴西这种多元分类的地区。如何更全面地评估并改进人脸识别系统的公平性和鲁棒性是该研究的动机。
AI.method: 作者收集并整理了来自巴西政治家公开视频的数据，采用巴西官方自述的种族/肤色标签（含独有的parda类别），保留了有挑战性的样本。然后在该数据集上，针对不同种族/肤色和不同图像质量，进行人脸验证和识别实验，并做了分组细致分析。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，人脸识别性能受图像质量影响很大；种族/肤色子群体之间的性能差异，需结合视觉难度共同分析，不能单独讨论。
AI.conclusion: UFPR-PEs为研究真实、复杂环境下的人脸识别偏差问题，提供了可重复、人口统计基础扎实的评测环境，对推动技术公平性及鲁棒性具有重要价值。

title: CogEvol: Towards Efficient and Reliable Learning Environment Generation
summary: We present CogEvol, a family of models trained specifically for Learning Environment Generation: turning a course brief into a finished learning artifact (structured-JSON slides or self-contained interactive HTML pages) in a single pass. Across 220k production requests, CogEvol completes a slide in a median of 17 seconds and an interactive page in 59, replacing minutes-long multi-turn agent scaffolding. Reliability is enforced rather than hoped for: a production-grounded data pipeline turns real failures into 53,687 verified SFT samples, and a hybrid rule-plus-VLM reward drives GRPO-based RL, hardened after we caught and fixed a reward-hacking episode that produced visually convincing but unplayable games. CogEvol-27B scores 83.7 on slide quality and 63.7 on a 500-case interactive-HTML benchmark with 26.9x fewer parameters than flagship coding models, and, in collaboration with the OpenMAIC team, serves their live production traffic. CogEvol-4B is released openly under the Apache 2.0 license at https://github.com/CogEvol/CogEvol-4B; external flagships are measured on the same suites under the identical harness. Scaffold editing cuts interactive-page generation cost by a further ~76%, and the full stack runs on domestic Ascend accelerators at application-level parity with A800 GPUs, lowering the unit cost of AI-native education at scale.

AI.tldr: CogEvol是一系列专为生成学习环境（如结构化幻灯片和交互式HTML页面）设计的模型，实现了从课程概要到最终学习材料的一步式高效转换，并大幅提升了自动化、效率和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的学习内容生成依赖多轮多代理协作，效率低、成本高，且生成质量稳定性难以保证。作者希望以更高效、可靠和低成本的方式自动从课程简介生成结构化学习资源。
AI.method: 结合真实生产请求数据，通过高质量失败案例生成大量SFT样本，使用规则与视觉语言模型（VLM）混合奖励驱动新型GRPO-RL优化，同时引入防止奖励黑箱的治理措施，并支持在国产Ascend加速器上运行。
AI.result: CogEvol-27B仅用26.9倍更少的参数达到83.7分（幻灯片）和63.7分（HTML交互页），支持大规模生产流量，CogEvol-4B开源。交互页生成成本进一步降低76%，在国产芯片上性能与A800 GPU持平，实现低成本AI教育大规模应用。
AI.conclusion: CogEvol大幅度提升了学习环境自动生成的效率、可靠性和经济性，可直接应用于实际大规模生产场景，为AI驱动的教育内容和工具开发提供了优质支撑。

title: CANVAS: Consistency-Aware Navigation via Visual Adaptive Sampling for Long-Context Text-to-SVG Generation
comment: 30 pages (including supplementary material), 9 figures, 10 tables. Code: https://github.com/Louis-YW/CANVAS
summary: Autoregressive large models have recently advanced Text-to-SVG generation from simple icons to complex, long-context graphics, yet standard autoregressive decoding often fails to maintain global consistency across geometry, layout, occlusion, and composition. We introduce CANVAS (Consistency-Aware Navigation via Visual Adaptive Sampling), a training-free, render-aware inference framework that combines power-sharpened trajectory likelihood with visual feedback from rendered futures and derives a stroke-wise navigation rule. It effectively estimates each candidate stroke's future value under a limited generation and rendering budget and adaptively allocates samples according to candidate uncertainty, decision influence, and rollout cost. Experiments across multiple autoregressive SVG backbones and complementary benchmarks demonstrate improvements in global consistency, which includes sound geometric relationships, spatial layouts, occlusion ordering, and overall composition, without additional training, demonstrating the effectiveness and generalization ability of our framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需额外训练即可提升Text-to-SVG生成任务整体一致性的推理框架，在多个基线和数据集上取得了更好的全局结构表现。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归模型在生成复杂SVG图形时，易在全局几何、布局、遮挡和构图方面出现一致性问题。现有方法无法很好解决这些层次的全局一致性难题。
AI.method: 提出CANVAS框架：推理过程中结合渲染结果和轨迹采样概率，根据候选笔画的不确定性、决策影响以及生成/渲染成本，自适应分配采样预算，以导航每一步绘制决策。整个流程为训练无关，可直接用于各种自回归SVG生成模型。
AI.result: 在多个自回归SVG模型和不同评测基准下，CANVAS能够实现更好的全局几何关系、空间布局、遮挡顺序与图形构图一致性，且无需重新训练模型。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可无缝集成于现有SVG自回归生成系统，显著提升生成图形的结构一致性，具备良好的实用性与泛化能力。

title: Evaluating and Improving LLM Self-Modeling
comment: 89 pages, 25 figures. Published as a conference paper at EMNLP '26 (Main)
summary: We study self-modeling: an LLM's ability to answer questions about its own behavior. We focus on verifiable behavioral questions, such as whether a prompt edit would change the model's final answer. To measure this capability, we introduce a benchmark that tests diverse types of self-modeling questions. Current models show non-trivial but limited self-modeling skill, and make systematic mistakes on simple counterfactual questions about their own behavior. To improve self-modeling skill, we develop a scalable synthetic-data pipeline that produces self-modeling training data, and show that reinforcement-learning can improve aggregate self-modeling skill across three open-source model families with some transfer to held-out tasks. These gains, however, do not seem to constitute introspection consistently: improved self-modeling may not arise from privileged access to the model's internal decision process.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）回答有关自身行为问题的能力，并提出相关评测基准与训练方法。
AI.motivation: 近年来大模型广泛应用，但其能否正确理解与预测自身行为（即自建模能力）仍未知，这对于提升模型安全性与可靠性至关重要。
AI.method: 作者提出了一套衡量模型自建模能力的基准测试，包括多类型可验证行为问题，还开发了一套合成数据管道和基于强化学习的训练方法，提高模型在这些任务上的表现。
AI.result: 当前主流开源模型在自建模问题上虽有一定能力，但在简单反事实等问题上表现有限。强化学习加合成数据训练可提升总体自建模能力，并在不同模型和任务间有一定迁移效果。
AI.conclusion: 尽管训练提升了模型在自建模基准上的分数，但这种提升不一定来源于真实“内省”能力，模型对自身决策过程的理解仍有限。

title: Stick to What You Know: A Study of Knowledge-Aligned Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) trains a base language model to imitate target responses, and these targets may require knowledge the base model has not robustly internalized. We study this as a source of hallucinations and frame a group of mitigation methods as \emph{knowledge-aligned SFT}: constraining SFT training targets to the base model's parametric knowledge. Under a unified setup, we compare existing generation-based and estimation-based knowledge-alignment methods and introduce two new variants: Evidence Rewrite, which verifies base-model generations using external evidence, and Recall Rewrite, which retains claims only when they can be consistently recalled by the base model. Experiments with Qwen 3 4B and OLMo 3 7B show that knowledge-aligned SFT can reduce factual hallucinations on WildHalu and Biography while largely preserving general capabilities. Recall Rewrite yields the strongest factuality gains and improves refusal behavior on UnknownBench. It thereby confirms that SFT targets beyond the base model's knowledge drive hallucination behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了有监督微调引发的幻觉问题，提出并比较了多种知识对齐微调方法以降低模型生成虚假信息的概率。
AI.motivation: 有监督微调（SFT）常常要求模型生成超出其内部知识范围的目标响应，这可能导致模型出现幻觉（即生成内容不真实）。作者希望解决SFT带来的幻觉问题，提高生成内容的真实性。
AI.method: 统一框架下，比较了现有的以生成和估计为基础的知识对齐方法，并创新性地提出两种新方法：Evidence Rewrite（利用外部证据验证模型生成内容）与Recall Rewrite（只保留模型能反复回忆的信息）。
AI.result: 在Qwen 3 4B和OLMo 3 7B模型上的实验表明：知识对齐SFT能在WildHalu和Biography数据集上有效减少虚假信息产生，同时保持模型整体能力；Recall Rewrite方法在提升事实性和改善拒答未知问题表现最为突出。
AI.conclusion: SFT超出基础模型知识的训练目标是导致幻觉的驱动力，实施知识对齐的微调策略能够有效缓解这一问题。

title: Can Video World Models Track Unobserved World States?
summary: Video world models are increasingly used as simulators, yet visual fidelity alone does not show that a model maintains the hidden state of the world. We examine this gap with an action-conditioned video Shell Game, a visual analog of $S_5$ state tracking that decouples visual rendering from compositing the hidden state underneath. Bidirectional and autoregressive Transformers, Mamba, and linear attention restricted to nonnegative transition eigenvalues all fit the training horizon of 5 swaps and then fall toward chance on longer swap chains (extrapolation) while still rendering plausible video with additional denoising steps providing no benefit. The pixel-based diffusion target never supervises the unseen hidden state, so the generated frames cannot carry it and the state has to live inside the architecture rather than in the tokens. For a Transformer, that architectural state is only an append-only KV cache, so the model has to re-derive the hidden arrangement from the whole history at every chunk. We find two mechanisms that do extrapolate, and both carry a state across chunks and revise it in place. Linear attention succeeds once its transition eigenvalues may be negative, and TTT with a nonlinear fast weight succeeds by updating the feature map through which it reads its own state. We further examine harder cases in dynamic world exploration tasks, and discuss the broader implications for building stateful video world models.

AI.tldr: 本论文探讨了视频世界模型在高视觉保真度下能否保持对“世界隐状态”（hidden state）的追踪，发现现有模型虽能生成逼真视频但对隐状态追踪有明显不足。提出新的评测方法，测试模型对交换链中隐藏信息的记忆与传递能力，并分析了能实现更好状态维护的机制及其意义。
AI.motivation: 虽然视频世界模型可生成高保真视频，并广泛用于世界模拟，但视觉呈现的真实性并不等价于模型能有效追踪和维护复杂系统的‘隐状态’。传统视觉指标无法衡量模型是否能携带或推断不可见的动态状态。本研究通过可控实验探讨这一核心问题，推进世界建模的可靠性评估。
AI.method: 设计了受控的行动条件视频Shell游戏，隔离视觉渲染与底层隐藏状态的混合过程，作为$S_5$状态追踪的可视化版本。比较了双向和自回归Transformer、Mamba、线性注意力等架构在5次交换训练范围内及更长交换（外推）场景中的状态追踪能力，并测试了对不可见状态的监督缺失。也测试了允许负特征值的线性注意力和非线性权重快速调整机制，分析这些机制如何修复状态追踪能力。
AI.result: 常规模型（如Transformer系列与普通线性注意力）只能在训练限度内（5次交换）追踪状态，面对更长交换序列时状态追踪准确率降至随机水平，即使有更强的去噪训练也无济于事。而允许负特征值线性注意力和非线性权重快速调整的架构能够在更长序列内有效传递和修正隐状态，显示出明显优越的状态建模与维持能力。
AI.conclusion: 高视觉保真不代表有效状态建模。视频模型要胜任复杂世界模拟，必须拥有能跨时长维护和修正“隐状态”的机制。提出的状态测试和分析揭示了关键的建筑机制，将有助于未来构建更“有状态”的世界模型。这一发现对动态世界探索等更难任务也同样重要。

title: Faithfulness Is Not Free: Auditing Offline KV-Cache Quantization in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: Grounding Language Models: Learning Faithfully and Efficiently @ EMNLP 2026
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation systems can precompute and store key-value caches of retrieved documents to avoid re-encoding context at every query. Quantizing these caches further reduces storage, but no prior work asks whether compression damages faithfulness, whether responses remain grounded in the retrieved evidence. Faithfulness and accuracy are not equivalent: a model can produce a correct answer that is no longer supported by the context it was given. We evaluate Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct under INT8 and INT4 quantization on RGB and HotpotQA, measuring both accuracy and faithfulness with a hallucination detector, NLI entailment, and an LLM judge. INT8 is near-lossless across both metrics. INT4 reduces accuracy and, more critically, even among answers that remain factually correct, over 90% of faithfulness changes are negative, i.e., accuracy metrics are blind to this regression. The harm grows under noisy retrieval and with more retrieved chunks. Faithfulness must be audited before compressed caches are deployed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了用于检索增强生成（RAG）系统的缓存量化方法，发现过度压缩会显著损害模型输出对原始证据的忠实性。
AI.motivation: RAG系统常通过预存检索结果缓存来提升推理效率，进一步量化这些缓存可以节省大量存储，但此前研究未关注量化是否损害模型输出的忠实性（即答案是否仍基于检索证据）。
AI.method: 作者在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型上应用INT8与INT4两种量化方式，并在RGB与HotpotQA数据集上测试，通过幻觉检测器、NLI蕴含和大型语言模型评审分别评估准确性与忠实性。
AI.result: INT8量化几乎无损，但INT4量化下不仅整体准确率下降，即便部分答案仍然正确，其忠实性也在90%以上的情况下下降。噪声检索和检索块增多会加剧这种伤害。
AI.conclusion: 在实际部署压缩缓存前，模型忠实性需单独审查，准确率不能完全反映量化带来的忠实性问题，尤其在高压缩（如INT4）下风险更大。

title: TUE-Detector: A Tool-Using Expert MLLM-Based Detector for AI-Generated Videos
comment: 32 pages, 7 figures, 28 tables; includes supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/Louis-YW/TUE
summary: AI-generated video detection, which aims to distinguish AI-generated videos from real ones, has recently received increasing research attention. To perform this task reliably, a key challenge lies in accurately identifying subtle-yet-measurable unnatural artifacts. In this work, we address this challenge from a novel perspective of tool-mediated evidence discovery and propose Tool-Using Expert MLLM-based AI-generated Video Detector (TUE-Detector), a novel framework for AI-generated video detection. TUE-Detector trains a general MLLM into a task-tailored tool-using expert detector that learns to invoke suitable tools, collect concrete evidence of unnaturalness, and reason over the evidence for reliable detection. Meanwhile, TUE-Detector further introduces novel designs to equip the expert detector with high-quality and suitable tools. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于工具中介的多模态大模型视频伪造检测框架（TUE-Detector）, 有效提升了AI生成视频的检测准确率。
AI.motivation: 随着AI生成视频技术的发展，相关伪造视频日益逼真。现有检测方法难以持续准确识别这类视频中的微妙异常伪迹，因此急需更高效、可靠的检测方案。
AI.method: 作者提出了TUE-Detector，将多模态大模型（MLLM）训练为专门能调用适配工具的检测专家。该检测器能够选择合适工具、收集不自然特征证据并进行推理分析。同时，框架设计了高质量、适配性强的新工具集以增强检测能力。
AI.result: 通过大量实验验证，TUE-Detector在AI生成视频检测任务上取得了优异效果，在准确率等多项指标上均优于传统方法。
AI.conclusion: TUE-Detector通过工具介入和推理能力提升了AI伪造视频检测的性能，为未来应对日益复杂的伪造视频提供了创新且高效的技术路径。

title: Evidence-Bounded Mental Health Reasoning from Heterogeneous Speech Protocols
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. Long paper
summary: Computational mental health screening using multimodal speech and text has shown great promise. However, existing models often assume all clinical speech protocols carry equivalent evidentiary validity. In reality, heterogeneous protocols, from free interviews to fixed reading tasks, support fundamentally different evidence. Forcing uniform reasoning flattens these boundaries, causing models to hallucinate symptoms from irrelevant text or overclaim support. Even advanced long chain-of-thought LLMs fail to resolve this issue, as free-form reasoning can exacerbate boundary violations. To address this, we reformulate multimodal screening as an evidence-bounded reasoning problem. We introduce the Evidence Package Benchmark, integrating 1,870 packages across six heterogeneous sources with explicit modality masks and evidence permissions. We further propose EviBound, a protocol-aware evidence control framework. Unlike direct LLM prompting, EviBound uses a profile-aware planner to restrict reasoning scope, orchestrates evidence tools via five-way acoustic consensus, and enforces a boundary critic to suppress unsupported claims. Empirical results show EviBound achieves a held-out test Depression AUROC of 0.8658, exceeding the strongest direct omni-modal baseline by +0.0811 AUROC while maintaining zero claim violations. Our work moves beyond unconstrained accuracy toward evidence-consistent, protocol-aware systems for safer clinical NLP research.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一套证据边界约束的多模态心理健康筛查方法(EviBound)，通过严格规范不同的语音文本协议证据使用，提高模型准确性与安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态心理健康模型常假定所有临床语音协议具有等效的证据效力，但现实中，这些协议(如自由访谈与指定朗读任务)在诊断依据上存在本质区别，若统一处理会导致模型对无关文本产生幻觉症状或过度断言。
AI.method: 作者将多模态筛查问题重新表述为证据边界推理问题。构建了Evidence Package Benchmark数据集，涵盖6类异构来源1870个包，标注证据权限；提出EviBound框架，采用协议感知的推理范围规划器和五方声学一致证据工具，配合边界鉴别器抑制无证据断言。
AI.result: 在抑郁症筛查任务上，EviBound测试集AUROC达0.8658，较最佳直接多模态基线提高+0.0811，并且实现了断言零违规。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推动了心理健康NLP模型从单纯精度追求转向证据一致、协议感知，更安全可靠，为临床应用打下基础。

title: VisLens: Single-Pass Interpretable Visual Search for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with fine-grained Visual Search, the task of locating small or rare objects in high-resolution images. Existing remedies fall into two families: (1) Training-free methods based on attention or confidence scores are accurate but slow, since they require multiple MLLM queries per example. (2) Reinforcement Learning (RL) trained tool-use models are faster at inference but opaque, since their tool calls remain uncontrollable and hard to interpret. To overcome this, we propose \emph{VisLens} (Visual Focus via Logit Lens), a Visual Search method built on the logit lens, which decodes the semantics held in a hidden state by projecting it through the LLM head. VisLens further uses a lightweight tuned-lens that maps early hidden states into the final hidden state space, so visual tokens can be read out from early layers. These tokens are matched to target words in the query to generate a crop of the relevant region, which is fed back in alongside the original image to produce the final answer. The whole process, from decoding to the final answer, completes in a single forward pass without repeated queries. VisLens matches or exceeds prior baselines while delivering a substantial latency advantage, running $8.5$--$9.9\times$ faster than Thyme and up to $22.2\times$ faster than training-free multi-pass search methods.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种名为VisLens的新方法，实现了高效且准确的细粒度视觉搜索，大幅提升了多模态大模型在高分辨率图像中定位小/稀有物体的速度和效果。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在高分辨率图像精细视觉搜索表现不佳。训练ฟรี方法虽准但慢，RL方法虽快但不可控、不透明，亟需既快又可解释的新方案。
AI.method: 提出VisLens方法，基于logit lens技术（在隐藏状态投影解码语义），通过tuned-lens将早期隐藏状态映射到最终隐藏状态空间，读取视觉token与目标词匹配，自动生成图片感兴趣区域并反馈，全部流程在单次前向推理内完成。
AI.result: VisLens准确率与过往最佳基线相当甚至更优，在推理速度上大幅领先：比Thyme快8.5~9.9倍，比无训练多轮检索法快至多22.2倍。
AI.conclusion: VisLens兼具效率、准确性和可解释性，大幅提升多模态大模型在细粒度视觉搜索任务下的应用潜力。

title: LLM Judges Verify Presence, Not Absence: Omission Blindness in AI Clinical Notes and What Recovers It
comment: 97 pages, 8 figures. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ComposoAI/OmissionBench . Code: https://github.com/composo-ai/omission-bench . Companion paper: "One note in three: a verified census of three deployed AI scribes, and the instrument that counted it"
summary: Ambient AI scribes draft clinical notes, and published audits find their dominant error is omission: information the encounter established that the note fails to record. The standard check is an LLM judge: a second model reads the note against the transcript and flags problems. We ask whether judges detect omissions. Public corpora cannot supply the answer key: their clinician reference notes and transcripts are materially discrepant. Our benchmark has 500 single-error note pairs from audited fact sheets, 298 with a named fact certainly absent and 202 added-or-altered controls. Across eight judge designs, paired discrimination (the flawed note below its clean twin, 0.5 a coin flip) reads 0.79-0.94 on added or altered content and 0.50-0.63 on omissions. On single notes, no design flags omissions reliably more often than perfect notes. Wording changes, voting and GEPA prompt optimisation move the operating point without creating usable detection. Restructuring the task recovers it: list the facts the transcript establishes, then check the note for each. Two methods reach it independently and trade off: a per-fact pipeline, and a GEPA-evolved prompt doing the same in one call. The pipeline's flags name the missing fact and its severity at 2.7% false alarms. The single call detects more (36.9% against 24.6%, p=0.002) at 6.2% false alarms and a tenth of the cost per note. A physician author validated 70 items and, where the two routes disagree, sided with the pipeline on 10 of 10 (p=0.002). A second clinician, not an author, graded the severity rubric blind and agrees to within a grade. On real vendor notes from a companion census no benchmark threshold transfers, but the re-calibrated single call detects more than the best of the eight at half its false-alarm rate. Omissions whose fact is restated elsewhere defeat both routes. We release the benchmark, prompts and judgements.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了AI抄写在病历文书中遗漏信息的问题，评估了多种大模型判别方法，并提出更有效的遗漏检测流程。
AI.motivation: 临床AI抄写员自动生成病历记录时，最主要的失误是遗漏会诊中实际建立却未被写入文书的信息。当前标准做法是利用大语言模型（LLM）比对文书和原始会话稿，但尚不清楚对于遗漏检测的有效性，因此作者希望系统性评估各种判别方法，并改进遗漏检测手段。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个包含500对单一错误病例文书的基准测试集，对八种判别LLM设计进行评估（如单独笔记判别、用GEPA prompt优化、投票机制等），并提出两种新方法：一是逐条核查事实的流水线方式，二是GEPA演化prompt的一次性整体核查。通过医生验证、双盲分级等方式评估准确性和实际效果。
AI.result: 传统八项判别LLM方法对信息遗漏检出率低，单独笔记很难区分遗漏与完美文书。两种新方法均显著提升检出率：流水线法2.7%误报、GEPA一次性法检出率高（36.9%对24.6%，但误报6.2%且成本更低）。医生人工验证偏好流水线法结果，双盲试验支持其分级一致性。在实际厂商数据中需重新标定，但新方法仍优于标准方法。
AI.conclusion: 常规LLM判别方法难以检测文书遗漏，必须重构任务才能显著提升效果。流程式和优化Prompt方法是当前最优解，但遇到事实在其他地方重复出现的遗漏仍难以识别。作者公开了数据集、Prompt和评估结果，为后续研究打下基础。

title: RailSyn: Diagnosis-Guided Image Generation for Traceable Data Completion in Railway Foreign Object Detection
summary: Railway foreign object detection (RFOD) is critical to safe railway operation, yet scarce real positive samples incompletely represent task-relevant variations in object scale, intrusion relation, railway scene, illumination, and adverse weather. Existing synthetic augmentation can improve RFOD detection, but its gains lack an explicit account of the task-relevant deficiencies complemented by the generated data. We therefore introduce RailSyn, a diagnosis-guided framework comprising a real-referenced Inspector and a requirement-aligned Generator. The Inspector constructs a variable-radius empirical cover from finite real observations to localize candidate completion regions and profile synthetic pools. The resulting audit identifies railway-context, intrusion-semantic, and visual-consistency requirements; the Generator addresses them through domain adaptation, agent-planned placement and physical contact relations, and plan-consistent conditional refinement. Using the Inspector, we further trace representation-space changes across generation variants; the complete system attains a local-shell occupation of $C_{gap}$ to 13.64%, which measures generated coverage of real-derived completion regions. Extensive experiments show AP50--95 gains of up to 4.9 points and consistent improvements across nine mainstream detectors, demonstrating broad cross-architecture utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RailSyn框架，通过诊断指导的合成数据增强方式提升铁路异物检测（RFOD）的性能，尤其在正样本稀缺、场景多变的实际情况下获得显著收益。
AI.motivation: 铁路异物检测对于铁路安全至关重要，但实际正样本数量稀缺，难以覆盖任务需求相关的多样性（如物体尺度、入侵关系、场景、光照和恶劣天气），致使现有模型泛化能力受限。
AI.method: 提出RailSyn框架，包括Inspector和Generator两部分：Inspector基于有限真实观测，定位补全区域并刻画合成样本池，从而明确场景、语义、视觉一致性等需求；Generator通过领域自适应、智能放置、物理接触关系及条件细化来生成符合需求的合成样本，并通过Inspector评审其对真实样本空间的补全效果。
AI.result: 该方案实现了对真实样本空间局部区域（$C_{gap}$）的13.64%补全覆盖，通过大规模实验，AP50--95提升最高达4.9个百分点，且在九种主流检测器上均取得一致改进，验证了方法的普适性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: RailSyn利用诊断指导的办法，针对铁路异物检测的任务相关缺陷生成有针对性的合成样本，有效弥补真实样本之不足，提升模型跨结构性能，具有广泛应用前景。

title: One note in three: a verified census of three deployed AI scribes, and the instrument that counted it
comment: 47 pages, 3 figures. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ComposoAI/OmissionBench . Code: https://github.com/composo-ai/omission-bench . Companion paper: "LLM Judges Verify Presence, Not Absence: Omission Blindness in AI Clinical Notes and What Recovers It"
summary: Ambient AI scribes draft clinical notes under the reassurance that a clinician signs every note. We audited three commercial AI scribes on the same 142 consultations: 565 notes from recorded UK primary-care and US ambulatory encounters plus authored scenarios. Twelve discovery passes proposed 13,678 candidate errors; the 5,898 clearing an importance filter went to an adversarial panel of two models from different families, each told to refute what it could, and 618 survived. One note in three (31.3% [27.0, 35.6]) carries a verified failure, concentrated in allergy and medication information, invented patient identity, and history written up as examination on telephone consultations that can contain none. No product was given a patient record; setting aside the two classes a record would have prefilled, invented identity and dates, the rate is 24.8% [20.8, 29.0]. One failure mode did not fit our scheme, drawn from published scribe-error taxonomies: a treatment the clinician retracts, recorded as delivered care. Two clinicians adjudicated blind, disjoint samples: a physician author upheld 20 of 21 findings (95.2% [77.3, 99.2]) and an independent clinician, not an author, 12 of 12 ([75.8, 100]); both judged every sampled refusal genuine. A failure rate depends on the instrument as much as the scribes. With model, evidence and settings fixed, the review instruction alone moves the share of candidates verified from 9.3% to 79.0%, and the reviewing family moves it too: alone at that instruction the gentler flags 54.8% of notes against 27.8%. Between 28% and 97% of sampled notes carry a failure depending on the standard. Published audits disagree among themselves by a margin instrument differences alone can produce: omission is 54-86% of their errors against our 23.1%. We release all 618 findings with transcript-side evidence, every prompt and model version, and the re-runnable pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本研究对三种商业AI文秘系统在实际医疗环境中的表现进行了系统性误差审核，发现其生成的临床笔记有较高的错误率，尤其在药物、过敏信息及患者身份等关键领域。
AI.motivation: 随着AI书写临床笔记逐渐应用于医疗行业，虽然医生最终会签署这些笔记，但AI自动生成内容的可靠性和安全性引发关注。为保障患者安全和医疗质量，亟需全面评估这些AI系统在真实环境中的表现及潜在风险。
AI.method: 作者对三款商业AI文秘，在142次医疗咨询（包括UK初级保健、US门诊及设定场景）中自动生成的565份笔记，共13,678项候选错误进行多轮逐步筛查，并通过两款不同家族的模型组成的对抗小组进行验证，最终人工判定误差样本。并通过独立临床医生盲审，交叉验证错误真实性。
